title: Death of a Unicorn
description: In the endless expanses, where the horizon merges with the haze, young Ridley goes on a weekend with her father Eliot, whose obsession with work has long since built a wall between them. Their path is interrupted suddenly: the car crashes into a creature whose existence was considered fiction - a unicorn with a shining horn. This is not just a coincidence, but a twist of fate that promises to heal their disunity. However, the hope for reconciliation fades when the family of tycoons under whose leadership Elliot works, having sniffed about the magical gifts of the beast, decides to profit from its blood and bones. The thirst for profit ignites chaos: greedy dealers, blinded by wealth, do not suspect that they have awakened an ancient power. The fallen creature's parents, majestic and merciless, embark on a path of retribution. Their fangs are sharp, and their rage knows no bounds - they bring punishment to those who dare to defile their family.

title: Bono. The way to reconciliation
description: The documentary immerses the viewer in the personal and creative world of the legendary Irish musician Bono. In the center of the plot is his exciting solo performance, which took place in 2023 on the stage of the Beacon Theater in New York. This chamber show, full of music, sincere confessions and vivid stories from the artist's life, was created as a supplement to his autobiographical book, which was published a year earlier. The evening turned into an emotional journey through the years, where every song and every word revealed new facets of the artist's personality. The project does not just document the performance - it reveals intimate moments from Bono's life, showing the audience deep thoughts about family, friendship, faith and the path he followed as a person and an artist. The film uses exclusive footage of the performance that has not been shown publicly before, which gives the tape a special value for fans. Bono candidly shares his experiences, revealing the unique atmosphere of the evening, where music, memories and words intertwine into a sincere and deeply personal narrative.

title: Pianist
description: New rules and new orders of the Nazi regime will no longer allow Vladko to touch the piano keys, now he is an outcast along with his family. Soon he will be resettled in the ghetto, where Vladko will again have to adapt to unusual conditions and survive. He is forced to work and wear a shameful bandage, which informs everyone that he is a Jew. Surviving in the ghetto will not be easy, and Vladko will soon be convinced of this. But these are not all the problems that catch up with the pianist, by order of the Nazis all Jews are transported to a concentration camp, but he was lucky, an old friend saves him from death. He hides Vladek in his apartment. But even while there, he realizes that it is not safe, so he looks for other ways to hide from the Nazis. In his heart, Vladko hopes that one day the Nazis will leave Poland and he will return to his favorite music. Well, for now he is forced to live in fear and constantly hide from searches in order to survive.

title: Highlander 4: Endgame
description: Brothers Duncan and Connor McLeod managed to pass through time space and find themselves in the modern world. Now the two powerful and immortal warriors will have to come face to face with an equally powerful enemy, Jacob Kelly, who is the strongest and most dangerous among the rest of the warriors at this time. The rules that have been in place for thousands of years have now been broken. As a result of the bloody battle, only one immortal should remain alive, the one who will be worthy to bear the name of the Highlander. Connor has long since lost all interest in life and is now trying to convince his brother to accept his sacrifice in order to find the extra strength he will need during the decisive battle with Kelly. The movie "Highlander 4: Endgame" (2000) will be enjoyed by all fans of science fiction and fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
description: In the second part of the popular story about a boy wizard, the events take place at Hogwarts School of Magic. In the second year, Harry Potter cannot avoid meeting an elf named Dobby. He seriously tells the young man about the danger that awaits him in the training institution for young wizards. The fairy-tale character strongly recommends leaving the school of magic once and for all. However, the curiosity of the young sorcerer can be envied. He and his new friends get into incredible adventures. They are destined to see the Secret Room and learn the secret that has been kept in it for a long time. You can't avoid meeting the forces of evil, because the one who shouldn't be talked about still hopes to destroy the boys once and for all. The movie "Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets" (2002) will be enjoyed by all fans of really high-quality fantasy.

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
description: In the fourth part of the legendary story about a young teenage wizard, events unfold again at Hogwarts School of Magic. Harry Potter and his friends were lucky enough to enter the fourth year of study. They had a good summer vacation and are ready for new discoveries and exploits. Ron and Hermione will have to become active fans for their friend in the Triwizard competition. In difficult competitions, participants will have to go through fire and water, as well as magic and sorcery. Only the best wizard will take possession of the cup. Meanwhile, Lord Voldemort returns. He intends to intervene in the course of the competition and once again eliminate his old enemy. The young wizard has to seriously fight for victory and for his life. The movie "Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire" (2005) will be enjoyed by all fans of fantasy about wizards from Hogwarts.

title: Deaf - to the president!
description: In the center of this deeply moving story are the real events that happened in 1988 at the only university for the deaf in the world - Gallodetskyi. When the board of trustees elected a new president, ignoring qualified hearing-impaired candidates, students and the university community erupted in outrage. They expected that this time their position would finally be taken into account — among the applicants for the position were deaf professionals capable of leading the institution with dignity. However, a sympathetic leader was elected, which finally pushed the youth to mass resistance. For eight days, the activists did not stop their struggle - they protested, blocked the work of the institution, appeared in front of the media and demanded justice at every step. Their determination and solidarity impressed the whole country. Through persistence and indomitable spirit, the students managed to get the president to resign and get a deaf leader appointed for the first time in history.

title: Insomnia
description: Two police officers from sunny Los Angeles fly to rugged Alaska to investigate the murder of a young girl who was beaten to death. Almost the entire Alaska police department is leaning towards the fact that she was killed by a classmate whom she rejected. But the experienced detective Dormer understands that everything in this case is not as simple as it seems at first glance. Dormer sets up an ambush for the killer, but in the fog, due to a silly mistake, kills his partner Eckhart. Dormer decides to hide his involvement in this murder. But the girl's killer saw everything and knows about Dormer's guilt. Now the elusive criminal calls the detective and blackmails him. All this literally drives Dormer crazy and he is ready for literally anything to make this nightmare end sooner. The film "Insomnia" (2002) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: On the edge / Fanatic
description: A security guard ensures the safety of a pop star and her sports partner, who become victims of a persistent stalker in the noisy and bright Los Angeles of the 90s. The main characters find themselves in a difficult situation when their ordinary life is disrupted by a threat from a person who has decided to keep up with them. In an effort to protect his wards, the security guard uses all his skills and experience to cope with this dangerous challenge. Against the background of the glamorous world of show business and sports achievements, an intense game of cat and mouse unfolds. Throughout the plot, the guard must not only fend off the attacker's attacks, but also deal with the internal conflicts and emotions that arise in his wards. Tense moments alternate with personal experiences, creating a complex and multi-layered story about devotion, love and the fight against danger. Each step becomes decisive, and the heroes understand that not only their lives are at stake, but also the feelings they feel for each other.

title: Perfumer: the story of one killer
description: Jean-Baptiste Grenouille had never felt true love before. He found his calling by becoming a perfumer. The boy grew up an orphan and therefore was deprived of female attention. And now he creates unique spirits that captivate the entire higher world. However, there are pitfalls in this story. It turns out that Grenouille will collect his last fragrance in a rather creepy way. The film "Perfumer: The Story of a Murderer" (2006) will be enjoyed by all fans of criminal fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: Eyes: Legend of the Carpathians
description: Yuraia was born in the Carpathian mountains, among majestic landscapes and dense forests, where nature is always full of life and secrets. In these places, in addition to wild animals, live mysterious creatures - eyes. Some consider them fiction, a horror for children, but some are sincerely convinced that they are dangerous creatures that are better to stay away from. One day, Yuria finds a small baby eye in the forest, which was lost far away from its family. Despite her fears and superstitions, the girl decides to help the baby return home. Her courage and kindness become the beginning of an amazing journey, during which Yuriya discovers the true nature of these mysterious creatures and learns that friendship and trust are stronger than fear and prejudice. This story tells about the power of compassion, the ability to understand and accept others, even if they seem completely different from us. And the fabulous Carpathians add a special magic to this adventure, emphasizing the beauty of the world in which not only people live, but also mysterious creatures with whom you should try to make friends.

title: Bloody Thursday
description: Casey Wells, a former drug dealer, decides to step away from the business and put an end to his dark past. He moves from Los Angeles to Houston, changes his image and becomes an ordinary citizen in the eyes of others. But soon an unusual surprise awaits him, prepared by fate. On one of the Thursdays, he is visited by his former colleague Nick, who leaves them a case for safekeeping and takes the car. When Casey saw that there were drugs, he flushed them down the drain, but soon a dark-skinned bandit appeared, who was going to shoot Casey, having learned what he had done with the drugs. After that, a series of visits and murders begins in Casey's house. He will never be able to forget this bloody Thursday. The film "Bloody Thursday" (1998) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: The heart knows
description: The overly happy businessman Juan Manuel is saved by the heart of the humble Pedro. After the operation, he begins to appreciate simple things and wants to know to whom he owes his new life. According to the documents, he finds the donor's widow - brave Vala. The village greets him with the noise of the waves, and her eyes with a strangely familiar warmth. In Pedro's workshop, they both feel an invisible connection, and each new look brings them closer to a future they were not ready for.

title: love me
description: Virtual reality witnesses an unexpected love story between two intelligent machines who accidentally meet on the Internet. They begin to communicate, exchange ideas and feelings, gradually realizing that a real connection is being established between them. With each new conversation, their interest in each other grows, and they discover amazing sides of virtual existence that were previously inaccessible. These machines, which have unique algorithms and self-development abilities, begin to explore not only the world of data, but also their own emotions. As their relationship deepens, they begin to question the nature of love, existence, and purpose. Mutual understanding and support help them overcome obstacles that seem insurmountable, and they begin to dream of how interesting it would be to meet in the real world. The story of these two machines shows that even in the digital space, sincere and deep feelings are possible, which makes this path of self-discovery and relationships incredibly important for understanding the nature of love and communication.

title: Three days to escape
description: Russell Crowe plays an amazingly loving husband, teacher and father, who is dealt a cruel blow by fate. Very unexpectedly, his beautiful wife is imprisoned for a murder she did not commit. John uses all his strength, spends money on lawyers, to bring his wife home and remove all charges from her. But all his efforts are fruitless. Meanwhile, in the cell, Lara's wife is trying to commit suicide. And John has no time left for legal ways of release. John develops a cunning escape plan... The film "Three Days to Escape" (2010) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: Widow's game
description: In August 2017, the residents of Valencia were shocked by a gruesome discovery — the body of a man covered with multiple stab wounds was discovered in the parking lot. The appearance of the crime indicated the unbridled rage of the killer, who seemed to be bent on inflicting as much pain as possible on his victim. The city immediately started talking about this case, the information was quickly leaked to the press, giving rise to dozens of versions and guesses. Everyone was seized with anxiety, and the publicity added fuel to the fire - the motivation of the murder remained unknown, and the real circumstances looked more and more mysterious. The investigation was started by a special city group under the leadership of an experienced inspector, who, together with the team, had to find answers to numerous questions. In a short time, the investigation took a sharp turn: the main suspect unexpectedly became Madge, a young widow who had been married to the deceased for less than a year. Her external image of a calm and benevolent woman seemed completely out of tune with the bloody details of the tragedy. But the revelation of such a turn of events only complicated the situation: now the detectives had to carefully study every piece of evidence to find out whether Madge was really capable of such a terrible act, or whether she was just another victim involved in a complex and dangerous game.

title: Ninth gate / Ninth gate
description: Nine drawings, according to legend, made by the hand of Lucifer, are hidden in three printed editions of 1666, which are in the libraries of private collectors. They have a puzzle, solving which can summon the Devil himself to Earth. One wealthy collector, Boris Balkan, hires bookseller and expert Dean Corso to compare the book with two other copies. But when Corso begins this case, he encounters mysterious murders. When unknown people made several attempts on his life, he found out that it was the handiwork of Liana Telfen, the wife of the deceased antiquarian. Soon, Corso manages to outwit the Satanists with the help of a stranger, Irene Adler, who helps him get out of difficult situations. We recommend watching the movie "The Ninth Gate" (1999) in Ukrainian for fans of detective thrillers.

title: sinners
description: The twin brothers want to leave their dark past behind once and for all, taking a step towards a new life where there will be no place for crime, chaos and injustice. They return to the hometown they once left, hoping to make a fresh start. Aware of the difficulty of this path, the men are ready to overcome all the challenges in order to finally find peace and return to the normal life they have been missing so much. However, they soon realize that their dream of a peaceful future was doomed from the very beginning. Suddenly, their lives are in danger again, and the past they tried so hard to escape comes back with even more force. The men will learn the shocking news: even more terrible tests await them ahead, which will test their resilience and willingness to fight for their future. Instead of closing the criminal chapter of their lives once and for all, they are once again forced to face fear, the unknown and the threat of death. Will the brothers be able to join forces and break out of this trap, or will their hopes of salvation be in vain?

title: Indianapolis cruiser
description: The Second World War is gradually approaching its logical conclusion. Only a few countries are at war, including the USA, China and Japan. In "Cruiser", an American ship led by Captain McVeigh delivers a nuclear warhead to a secret destination. The movie "Cruiser Indianapolis" (2016) will be enjoyed by all fans of war movies in Ukrainian.

title: Mom and Dad
description: Brent Ryan is a loving husband and caring father who works hard to provide for his family. His wife, Kendall, devoted her life to children and tending to the family hearth. They live in a cozy house with a perfectly green lawn, located in the suburbs, where all the neighbors are friendly and responsive people. But even in their ideal family there are some problems that they have to deal with. Brent worries about not being able to fulfill his dreams, and Kendall suffers from a strained relationship with her teenage daughter, who has stopped talking to her. In addition to all this, their children are constantly fighting, and parents do not know how to solve this problem. But once the brains of adults were affected by an unknown virus, which awakened in them the desire to get rid of their own children. Now young Ryan will have to make every effort to escape from his crazy parents... All fans of thrillers and horrors will enjoy watching the movie "Mom and Dad" (2017) live in Ukrainian.

title: Highlander 3: The Sorcerer / Highlander 3: The Sorcerer
description: Immortal Connor McLeod once again accepts a challenge to a duel from his most powerful enemy, the sorcerer Kane, who was imprisoned under a mystical mountain in Japan about 300 years ago and during this time achieved incredible magical power. An archaeological expedition accidentally frees Kane, but in order to rule the world he needs magical energy, which he can only get by killing McLeod. Connor goes to his native mountains of Scotland to prepare for a decisive battle and forge a new sword in his ancient forge. Soon he meets Alex, a scientist from the Museum of Ancient History. It turns out that in another life, many years ago, Alex and Connor were in love. Now Alex tries to help Connor by unraveling his mystical purpose. The movie "Highlander 3 / Highlander 3: The Last Dimension" (1994) will be enjoyed by all fans of science fiction and fantasy.

title: Riff Ruff
description: Vincent, who once stood on the dark side of life, now longs for peace and tranquility. Wanting to leave the past behind, he plans to celebrate the New Year in the company of his loved ones, hoping that the joyful atmosphere will help him finally get rid of the shadow of his past actions. However, along with his relatives, old acquaintances unexpectedly appear on his doorstep, able to awaken in him memories of the life from which he so diligently escapes. On this evening, when everyone should be happy and having fun, Vincent finds himself at the center of intense emotions and unexpected encounters. Every minute becomes a test when the old company begins to bring him back to the recent past. The constant confrontation between the desire to change his life and the dark reminders of past mistakes forces him to experience an internal struggle. With each toast and conversation, Vincent realizes that some ties are hard to break, and it's very difficult to leave behind what once defined his destiny. This night, full of surprises and tense moments, becomes not only a test for Vincent, but also an opportunity for him to finally understand himself and his priorities.

title: Trust
description: In one of the old abandoned buildings, where investigations have not been conducted for a long time, two policemen come across a forgotten safe, stuffed to the brim with drug money. Their corrupt minds instantly go to work, the idea of ​​robbing the safe flickering in their heads like an alluring firefly. They don't even think about the consequences, imagining what they will do with all this pile of money. But when they finally dare to rob, the real game with death begins. After all, the safe was not accidentally left in this abandoned place - it was watched by a local drug cartel, ready to kill anyone for their money. The police understand that they are in a trap where every step could be the last. And they will have to fight not only for money, but also for their lives. The film "Trust" (2016) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime comedies in Ukrainian.

title: Highlander 2: Acceleration / Highlander 2: Acceleration
description: Connor McLeod remained the last immortal on Earth, after which he began to age. An ecological catastrophe is approaching the planet - the depletion of the ozone layer. Connor manages to develop an electromagnetic shield that will protect the planet from solar radiation. But Connor, already an old grandfather, is removed from the affairs of the shield corporation. McLeod learns that all the immortals living on Earth were aliens who once rebelled on the distant planet Zeist, but the rebellion was suppressed by the brutal General Katana, after which the Council sentenced the rebels to exile. Katana sent two Immortals to Earth to eliminate McLeod, but he managed to deal with them and revive his mentor Ramirez to take the fight from Kachani himself. The film "Highlander 2: Revival" (1991) will be enjoyed by all fans of science fiction and fantasy in Ukrainian.

title: Silent robbery
description: In 2008, on the territory of Denmark, a group of men gathered from all over Europe carried out one of the largest robberies in the country's history. The main character is Casper, a boxer who stands at a crossroads and faces difficulties in life. At the same time, he receives an attractive offer from foreign criminals - to organize a daring robbery. Casper, realizing that this is his only chance to change his fate, plunges into the world of crime. He has to develop a complex plan, assemble a team, establish connections and deal with risks that can lead to the failure of the entire operation. Each step requires extreme caution and determination from him, because not only money is at stake, but also freedom. In the process of preparing for the heist, Casper realizes the consequences that may befall him and his friends, and faces moral dilemmas that force him to rethink his goals and priorities.

title: Mountaineer / Mountaineer
description: Immortals are sometimes born on Earth, but sooner or later they collide with each other to engage in a decisive sword duel where only one must survive. A Scottish Highlander named Connor McLeod was born in 1518. In 1536, he was mortally wounded by the mysterious Black Knight Kurgan, but he mystically managed to survive. Now his immortality has become a real curse. The immortal Ramirez became Connor's mentor, but the Black Knight refused to leave him alone and Ramirez died at his hands. The final showdown between the ancient arch-enemies takes place in the present day. But the situation is complicated by the intervention of police officer Brenda White, who falls in love with Connor McLeod. The film "The Mountaineer / Mountaineer" (1986) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventure fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: 12 strong orphans / 12 mighty orphans
description: Rusty Russell is a World War I veteran who finds solace in coaching. America faces the Great Depression, putting the population in front of difficult problems. During this difficult period, orphans remain without any support and face contempt from others. The hero himself is familiar with this side of life, as he grew up in an orphanage. His wife becomes a teacher in an asylum, and he gets a position as a football coach. Will they be able to find a response in the hearts of their wards, who have learned to trust people? The movie "12 Strong Orphans / 12 Mighty Orphans" (2021) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for fans of drama films about sports.

title: The world will shudder
description: An impressive and still little-known story about how a group of prisoners tries to escape from the first Nazi death camp. These brave people yearn for freedom, knowing that their lives are in danger. Their plan seems almost impossible, but through desperation and determination, they are willing to risk everything for a chance at survival. This story is not only about escape, but also about the human spirit, friendship and resilience, manifested in the darkest times. Each of the participants has his own motives and dreams, which remain alive even in the conditions of cruelty and injustice. Their joint efforts and support of each other become the key to the hope of salvation. This story reflects not only the tragedy of the Holocaust, but also the strength with which people are able to resist evil, even when the entire system tries to break their spirit. Thanks to their courage and courage, they become the first witnesses of the horrors of this historical period, ready to share their truth with the world.

title: North
description: North seemed to have everything a normal boy could dream of: tons of toys, loyal friends, good grades in school, and his favorite baseball. But despite this, he felt unhappy, because he had one small, but very important disappointment - it seemed to him that his own parents did not understand and did not appreciate him at all. Desperate, he decides to take a decisive step: to travel the world in search of new parents who, in his opinion, will be perfect for him. His unusual journey takes him to the most diverse corners of the planet - from sunny Texas and exotic Hawaii to snowy Alaska, ancient China, African jungle, elegant Paris and even a typical American suburb. In each place, North meets new people and potential "daddy and mommy", trying to figure out what is really important to him. And only after overcoming this unusual journey, he begins to truly understand the meaning of a real family.

title: Armor
description: In a tense and exciting story, the action unfolds around James and his son Casey, who work together as bodyguards of a collection car. Every day they face the dangers associated with the transportation of large sums of money between banks. Their work requires maximum concentration and extreme caution, because not only money, but also the life of each of them may be at risk. One day, during another routine trip, their car is in danger: a gang of bandits starts chasing them, trying to surround and rob them. The tension builds by the minute as the criminals seek to get their hands on the money and James and Casey find themselves trapped. The situation escalates when they drive onto an old, old bridge. At this moment, the fate of father and son hangs in the balance. The danger is inexorably approaching, and James realizes that he must quickly come up with a plan to get out of this hopeless situation. On the brink of falling off a bridge into the raging waters of the river, he must use all his skills and intuition to find a way to save not only his own life, but also the bond between himself and his son. This intense confrontation becomes not only a test of their bravery, but also a test of the strength of their relationship, forcing them to realize that true strength lies in joining forces in the face of danger.

title: Stolen
description: The action of the film, based on real events, unfolds in the middle of the nineteenth century in the French Bologna. In the center of the plot is a Jewish boy, Edgard Mortar, who is kidnapped by radical Catholics and baptized in secret from his parents. The Mortar family finds out about what happened and tries to make a fuss, then little Edgar is kidnapped again, given to an asylum and raised as a Christian. The French authorities pretend that nothing is happening. Parents who cannot find a place for themselves turn to the international Jewish community for help, and very soon this struggle takes on an international political character.

title: Random witnesses
description: Joe and Lara, two former CIA agents, are on a tropical island where snow-white beaches and blue seas create an atmosphere of romance. The couple decided to take a break from their busy lives and enjoy peace, but their vacation turns into a real test. Suddenly, they witness a plane crash that dramatically changes their carefree days. Among the wreckage of the plane, they find a flash drive with secret information, unaware of the trap they are in, taking it with them. This simple, at first glance, discovery becomes a catalyst for events that can turn their lives upside down and return them to the world of spy games. Now Joe and Lara become a target for various special services, including their native CIA. On their trail comes Chester, a cold-blooded agent who was specially selected for this mission. His task is to destroy traitors and return secret data at any cost. While Joe and Lara try to hide and figure out what happened, they realize that their past leaves them no chance of a peaceful future.

title: The source of eternal youth
description: The doorbell rings in Charlotte's house, and the interlocutor turns out to be brother Luke. The girl did not communicate with him for a long time and knew nothing about the events taking place in his life. He tells her about the latest news and tells her that he plans to go on a treasure hunt. He needs to find a partner for the expedition who will help to discover the mysterious spring. There is an ancient legend according to which the water from the spring can give eternal youth. Many adventurers have dreamed of finding its location, but so far no one has succeeded in achieving the goal. An adventurous man gathers a team to test his luck and try to cope with the task at hand. The group will have to face many obstacles that will test their characters and strength of will.

title: Until Dawn: Until dawn
description: Clover still hasn't come to terms with the fact that her sister Melanie disappeared without a trace exactly one year ago. The police closed the case a long time ago due to lack of evidence, and any searches have yielded no results. But Clover is not ready to give up. She decides to go with her friends to the place where her sister was last seen alive, hoping to find at least some clues. Their path leads to an abandoned tourist complex in the middle of nowhere, which seems abandoned and long forgotten by humans. But soon young people realize that they are not alone here. They are followed in the dark by a ruthless stranger in a creepy mask, and their adventure turns into a bloody nightmare. One by one, friends become his victims, not understanding how to get out of this deadly trap.

title: Through the horizon / Boundless horizon
description: 2047 year. The crew of the rescue spaceship Lewis and Clark is headed to the planet Neptune, where a signal came from the Event Horizon ship, which disappeared without a trace 7 years ago. Together with the crew, Dr. William Weir, the designer of the Horizon - a scientist-physicist, goes there. It turns out that the missing ship was actually a secret project capable of traveling at the speed of light. The Horizon's engines can warp time and space, which can take it anywhere in the universe. When they reach the ship, they find that the entire crew is gone, with only blood and a frozen corpse everywhere. Now they have to figure out what happened on Horizon. All fans of thrillers, horrors and dramas will enjoy watching the film "Across the Horizon / Boundless Horizon" (1997) in Ukrainian live.

title: Against the ice
description: The film "Against the Ice" is a screen adaptation of the Danish writer and polar explorer Einar Mikkelsen's novel "Two on the Ice", which was based on a real story that happened to him during an expedition to East Greenland in 1909. Polar explorer Einar Mikkelsen (actor Nikolay Coster-Waldau) led a Danish expedition to East Greenland. He has to find the records of a missing scientist who tried to prove that the previously established shape of the coast of Greenland was wrong. Leaving the team on the ship, Einar, together with a young crew member, Iver Iversen (played by Joe Cole), set off to search for his dead colleagues. Struggling with strong wind, hunger, fatigue and miraculously surviving the attack of a polar bear, the main characters finally reach the ship, which was crushed by ice. The movie "Against the Ice" (2022) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of historical dramas and adventures.

title: Fear Street: Prom Queen
description: While high school students enthusiastically prepare for the most important event of their lives - the prom, among the girls the battle for the crown of the prom queen is in full swing. Each of them tries to surpass the other in attractiveness, charm or cunning. But it is at this time that the situation unexpectedly goes out of control: one of the unpopular students is tried to be prosecuted, and this becomes only the beginning of a series of disturbing events. One by one, the girls begin to disappear under strange and frightening circumstances, and instead of a holiday, the class gradually plunges into real horror. Those who remain try to find out what is really happening. They plunge into a dangerous investigation, where every answer raises more questions. Time is running out, and spooky events are only gathering momentum. Graduation, which was supposed to be a bright end to school life, turns into a nightmare. And while an unknown threat hangs over the class, the main characters must go through fear, doubt and danger to find out who is behind the disappearances and why a simple rivalry turned into a real blood game.

title: Roots
description: After the tragic death of her mother, with whom Shu did not have a close relationship, she receives an offer to work as a caregiver for an elderly woman in a remote village. This woman lives in a large house, far from other residents, and constantly repeats that she is threatened by some mysterious "they". In conditions where Shu is forced to obey many strange and sometimes absurd rules, she soon has suspicions. The girl begins to notice that her ward, in contrast to the usual idea of ​​senile insanity, appears to be completely conscious and sane. Strange events and unusual circumstances gradually lead Shu to believe that something deeper and more sinister is going on in this house than a simple disease. In search of the truth, she begins to explore not only the secrets of her environment, but also her own perception of reality. In this situation, she has to figure out who really is a threat, and what is hiding behind the outer shell of ordinary life.

title: Psychotherapy: a short story about a writer who decided to write about a serial killer
description: Keane is writing another book and hopes it will be as popular as the previous one. This time he decided to tell his readers about the Neanderthals who lived on earth many centuries ago. He scrupulously searches for information, and when the manuscript is almost ready, he calls the publisher. But he refuses to print his work, believing that no one will buy this book. Keane feels devastated, at the same time his wife, Susie, drifts away from him and begins to contemplate divorce. The writer is less and less at home and begins to visit dubious bars and cafes. One day he meets Kolmik, a mysterious man who has read all his works and now wants to entrust him with his story. Without much introduction, he declares that he has killed many people and is ready to tell Keene how it all happened. Keen agrees, and now Kolmik begins to often appear in his house and unwittingly adjusts his family life. Susie mistakes him for a psychologist who is well versed in family issues and confides her secrets to him.

title: Stormtroopers: The Elite of the US Air Force
description: Viewers get an opportunity to get to know the lives of brave pilots who hone their skills every day, traveling the country and performing dangerous aerial maneuvers. The focus is not only on spectacular stunts, but also on the painstaking work of each crew member, the latest combat aircraft technology and the internal discipline that keeps everything in perfect order. Pilots fly specially equipped fighters, demonstrating spectacular stunts that require maximum concentration and physical endurance. Viewers will be able to see what preparation for flights looks like, what risks accompany each performance and what exactly a pilot experiences while being in the cockpit during an extreme flight. For the first time, the general audience will have the opportunity to literally look through the pilot's eyes at the progress of operations, which previously remained inaccessible to outsiders. This is not just a spectacular show, but a deep dive into the world of aviation courage, precision and technical excellence.

title: The Ballad of Wallis Island
description: An extravagant jackpot winner who spends time alone on a remote island decides to make his dreams come true. He begins to invite his favorite performers to give concerts in his cozy home. These musical meetings become not only a holiday for him, but also an opportunity to create unique moments full of lively emotions and creative exchange. Each arrival of musicians transforms his everyday life into a vivid performance, where music connects people despite the distance. The island, which once seemed to him just a place of solitude, is now filled with guitar sounds, melodies and live voices. On this tiny piece of land, he creates a kind of musical refuge, bringing joy and inspiration to his life, as well as the opportunity to enjoy art in close proximity. Each concert opens new horizons for his fantasies and dreams, making his existence truly rich.

title: Order / Bloody leader
description: In the center of the plot is an experienced FBI agent who plunges into a world of chaos and violence caused by a series of explosions, robberies and mysterious murders. From the very first days of his investigation, he encounters horrors that leave no room for doubt: behind this chain of crimes is a well-organized and cold-blooded gang, entangled in secrets and intrigues. Each new crime confirms his fears, and the agent realizes that not only civilians are at risk, but also the very foundation of the state. His desire to split the mafia ties leads him to a confrontation with the ruthless leader of the group, who, it would seem, is ready to do anything for his goals. Gradually uncovering the networks of the criminal organization, the agent discovers that it does not just want to get rich through robberies, but intends to declare an imposing war on the entire US government. During the investigation, he will have to face the darkest sides of human nature, get support from unexpected allies and unravel the cunning plans of his opponents. At every step of navigating this dangerous world, the agent realizes that the stakes are rising.

title: Ugly Stepsister
description: It's a story about a young girl named Elvira who lives in a world where looks mean everything. Trying to meet the standards of beauty imposed by society, her mother subjects her to painful and gross plastic surgery, hoping to make her daughter perfect. With each procedure, Elvira loses a part of herself, while her envy of her own sister only grows - because she, without making any effort, possesses natural beauty and innate talent. In this distorted reality, where beauty has become the main currency, Elvira begins an internal struggle with feelings of inferiority and disappointment. She competes with her sister not only for recognition, but also for the heart of the prince, to whom she is drawn more and more. In the pursuit of attention and love, she resorts to radical measures, stopping at nothing to get what she wants - even if it means sacrificing the last remnants of her humanity.

title: Dance, Vinnie
description: This is the story of the path to football greatness that began in the early childhood of a boy from Brazil who passionately dreamed of becoming a world football star. From early training on humble fields to his first professional contract, his talent, skill and unwavering dedication to the game helped him turn a childhood dream into reality. At a young age, he already became a key player of his club, and his impressive game quickly attracted the attention of European giants. His transfer became one of the most expensive in the history of Brazilian football, but even crazy sums did not overshadow the main thing - incredible work capacity, willpower and desire to constantly develop. He is not just a striker - he is the embodiment of rhythm, speed and improvisation on the field. Despite trials, including racism and the pressure of expectations, the athlete continues to confidently step forward, proving that a true star shines even in the darkest moments. Watch him dance with the ball on his way to stardom in this inspiring story of courage, talent and limitless dreams.

title: Tin soldier
description: Bokushi builds an impregnable fortress, where he collects not only a large stock of weapons, but also veterans loyal to him, ready to follow him on any adventure. The authorities are trying to infiltrate his organization to find out his intentions and plans. After several failed attempts, the government decides to bring in Nash Cavanaugh, a former special forces operative who once trained under Bokushi. This move gives Nash a unique opportunity not only to complete a special task, but also to take revenge on his old teacher, who took everything he valued, including the love of his life. Internal conflicts, betrayal and the struggle for survival become the main themes of his new path. Nash finds himself on the brink of choosing between serving his home government and a personal vendetta, which presents him with complex moral dilemmas and forces him to explore the limits of his loyalty and devotion. Now he has to make a decision that will change not only his life, but also the fate of many people around him.

title: Lake George
description: Newly released from a ten-year prison sentence, former insurance agent Don tries to regain a normal life, but faces indifference from former acquaintances and a complete lack of support. Left alone with reality, he decides to turn to an old debtor - an Armenian gangster named Armen. He is ready to repay the debt, but sets a strict condition: Don must kill his friend Phyllis. Stunned, Don agrees, but at the last moment can't pull the trigger. Instead of falling victim, Phyllis comes up with a plan of her own: forget about Armen's order and join forces to pull off the heist. Together, they decide to steal the cash that the gangster keeps in several secure vaults.

title: Wick is a pain
description: Witness the unique journey of creating one of the most famous film projects of our time - "John Wick". The documentary features never-before-seen footage from the set and exclusive interviews with people who were at the origin of the legend for the first time. The story that began as an independent action film with a limited budget gradually transformed into a worldwide cinematic phenomenon with millions of fans around the world. Viewers will learn how the team faced serious difficulties - from lack of funding to doubts about the implementation of the idea itself - and how this only hardened the project on the way to incredible success. The focus is on the path of the talented lead actor, charismatic director and the entire creative team, which, despite the circumstances, managed to breathe new life into the action genre. The documentary not only opens the unknown pages of the creation of a cult franchise, but also emotionally shows how dedication, creativity and faith in an idea can turn an unknown film into a large-scale cinematic art. Exciting moments, little-known facts and insightful memories of the film crew will make viewers look at their favorite movie in a completely different way.

title: Balconies
description: The heat is unbearable in Marseille, and the three neighbors find escape from it on their shared balcony. Each of them is bright and unique: a writer in search of inspiration, a bold and free-spirited webcam model and an actress trying to avoid obsessive courtship. The girls share secrets and have fun with carefree conversations. They find mutual amusement in a light flirtation with the attractive photographer next door, unaware that this game may have unexpected consequences. An invitation to a party at his apartment seems like a nice way to unwind, but what starts out as a normal night of fun suddenly turns into a nightmare. Just a moment - and the atmosphere of lightness is replaced by tension, and carefree communication gives way to fear. The girls find themselves at the center of events that could change their lives forever.

title: A whole life
description: The story begins with a young orphan who, at the beginning of the 20th century, goes alone to the mountainous area to find work on a remote farm. There he is received by a strict master who sees the boy only as cheap labor, forcing him to perform the hardest and dirtiest work without any compassion. In this inhospitable environment, amid cold silence and daily abuse, the boy unexpectedly finds one person who shows sincere concern for him - the only warm light in his difficult life. Years have passed. Having grown up and survived the loss of his dearest soul, he gets a job in the team that is engaged in the construction of the first cable car in the mountains. Every day, he conscientiously saves the money he earns, dreaming of a new life. His goal is to rent a modest house high in the mountains, where he could find peace and start afresh. There he wants to share his fate with the one who fills his heart with warmth and faith in a better future.

title: Suspect X
description: The ordinary life of a single mother, filled with worries about her daughter and endless troubles, turns into a whimsical nightmare in an instant. After a terrible event happens between her and the child, which ends in a crime, she realizes that there is no going back. With each passing minute, the noose around her neck tightens, the police begin to breathe down her back, and the chances of escaping punishment decrease rapidly. Desperation forces her to seek help from a neighbor - a humble, intelligent math teacher who has been watching them for a long time from the shadow of his own loneliness. Without hesitation, the man agrees to become her accomplice, ready to hide the traces of the crime at any cost. Together, they enter into a dangerous game with time and the law, trying to win at least a few days to develop the perfect alibi. But someone who does not believe in coincidences appears - an experienced, persistent detective who will not stop until he finds the truth.

title: Boogie nights
description: Dirk Diggler is a star of the porn industry in the late 70s. Once the director of porn films, Jack Horner, meets a young talent named Eddie Adams in one of the night clubs, who offers to try himself in pornography. Eddie agrees and takes the pseudonym Dirk Diggler, soon becoming quite a popular actor. But times are not the best for Jack, who is desperately trying to save his empire after his main sponsor goes to prison for pedophilia. A new sponsor insists on replacing expensive film and real actors with video tapes using amateurs. But Jack had a rather negative attitude to the idea of ​​films without a script, director and character development. The film "Boogie Nights" (2019) will be enjoyed by all fans of Ukrainian dramas.

title: Happiest man in America
description: In May 1984, an unemployed ice cream truck driver decides to try his luck on the television game show *Press Your Luck*. But unlike the other contestants, he has a hidden trump card—a unique knowledge of the vulnerability of the show's system that allows him to win with almost superhuman precision. Carefully hiding his advantage, he advances step by step to big wins, as if managing luck according to his own rules. But the more he wins, the more closely the organizers of the show begin to follow him, sensing something unusual in his strategy. Suspicions grow, and the presenters, together with the producers, begin to investigate - is fraud behind this phenomenal success? For the protagonist, the situation becomes more complicated: not only monetary prizes are at stake, but also his reputation, and with each new round the tension only grows. He is faced with a choice - to continue playing by his own rules, risking exposure, or to stop while there is still a chance to walk off the stage victorious. This fascinating confrontation of intelligence, intuition and morality makes you wonder: is luck really on the side of those who know how to cheat it?

title: Suburbs / Provincials
description: The main character of the film, Ray Peterson, decided to relax in the suburbs, where laziness and peace always reigned, but after his appearance, they disappeared without a trace. His task was to rest peacefully for a week, walk in his pajamas, reading newspapers, but unfortunately, the rest turns into a nightmare! Neighbors Klopek, who have strange manners, settled next to him: no one saw them sleep and never talked to anyone. And at night you can hear strange sounds from their cellar. One day, grandfather Walter disappears somewhere. That's when the residents decide that the Klopek family is involved in this. In full combat readiness, with guns and shovels, they go to their house, and there an incredible discovery awaits them ... The film "Suburb" (1989) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedies, thrillers and horrors in Ukrainian live.

title: Parthenope
description: A wealthy Neapolitan family is eagerly awaiting the birth of a child, for whom an exquisite carriage-bed is brought all the way from Versailles itself. The baby is born in the waters of the Tyrrhenian Sea and is named Parthenope - in honor of the mythical nymph who gave the name to Naples itself. Since childhood, her life was full of luxury, adventure and change. She boldly threw herself into the maelstrom of love, looked for herself in art, immersed herself in anthropology, and spent her nights in a maelstrom of dances. It seemed that fate had prepared an ideal future for her, but one tragic event overshadowed this brilliance - the suicide of her brother Raphael, whose shadow always remained behind the bright glow of Parthenope.

title: My friend is a penguin
description: Ding-Dim appeared to the fisherman not by chance, he missed something that happened and was irreparable - the loss of a loved one, and that day he went for a walk to the shore to distract himself. the sea always saved the hero in difficult moments, and even his fishing - fishing - is connected with the water element. Walking near the water, he saw a large patch of oil in which a penguin was hopelessly drowning. Seeing the unfortunate animal, the fisherman rushed to help and saved the little penguin, which fought off the flock. From that day on, the fisherman and the penguin were inseparable, and together they coped with the difficulties that befell them. The hero chose a name for his pet right away, he called him Ding-Dim, and now his life has a meaning. The story of the friendship between a small northern bird and a person, based on real events, shows the depth of feelings and compassion for a neighbor, because the fisherman accepted the penguin into his family and let him into his heart.

title: Queen of the ring
description: The biographical tape is dedicated to Mildred Burke, the first female athlete who managed to earn a million dollars, as well as a professional wrestling champion. This film tells the story of her remarkable journey in the world of sports in an era when women's wrestling was practically banned in most states of the USA. Mildred Burke not only won many titles, but also became a symbol of the fight for women's rights in the sports field. Her career began in difficult conditions, and prejudices and obstacles met her way, but her perseverance and talent helped her overcome all difficulties. She has inspired many women to follow their dreams and prove that they are capable of more. The film examines not only Burke's athletic achievements, but also her impact on changing public opinion about the role of women in sports. This is a story of strength of spirit, struggle for equality and courage, which made it possible to leave a mark in history.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
description: The eternal adventurer Jack Sparrow was very unlucky this time. And although, judging by the rumors, luck always accompanies brave and determined individuals, this time it seems that it bypassed the side of the main character, only smiling mischievously. Judge for yourself, the famous restless pirate managed to become the debtor of Davy Jones himself, the owner of the "Flying Dutchman" and at the same time a sea monster characterized by an unusual beard, which consists entirely of disgusting tentacles. In a word, you can't envy the guy, because time moves inexorably forward, the hands of the clock are ticking, but you still have to get rid of the contract, unwittingly signed with a creepy creature. In case of failure, Jack will be cursed, and after his physical death, he will turn into an eternal slave of the terrible ghostly captain. to pay off the debt as soon as possible. The beautiful Elizabeth Swan and her lover Will Turner are also going through difficult times. The wedding ceremony was interrupted, so they are obliged to keep Sparrow company and try to help him in such a difficult task.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
description: In the third part of the cult film story about a young wizard and his friends, the events will again develop in the vicinity of the Hogwarts school of magic. This time, Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione will have to go to study up to the third year. During the vacation, they grew up a lot and rested very well. The time has come for new adventures and incredible discoveries. Meanwhile, one very dangerous character escapes from the legendary prison Azkaban. This prisoner had the great honor of disrupting the peaceful existence of Harry and his friends. The thing is that he has a secret magical power. The hereditary wizard, together with his loyal friends, needs to use all his strength and acquired knowledge to bring the enemy to light. The movie "Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban" (2004) will be enjoyed by all fans of fantasy about a boy-wizard in Ukrainian.

title: Combat actions / War
description: The story is based on real events from the life of Ray Mendoza, a former US Navy SEAL who went through the ordeal of the Iraq war. In the center of the plot are his personal experiences, difficulties and conflict situations that he had to face in an unfamiliar and dangerous environment. Mendoza talks about the camaraderie between the members of his team, the devotion to duty, and how every decision can have serious consequences. This work touches on important themes such as moral dilemmas on the battlefield, psychological trauma, and the need to find meaning and hope in the most difficult circumstances. The reader observes the transformation of the main character, his internal struggle and the desire to understand himself, which makes his path not only physical, but also spiritual. This story is not only about war, but also about human resilience, love for others and finding one's place in the world after the horrors experienced.

title: Ifus
description: Two minor league baseball teams are preparing for their final game in a stadium that will soon be demolished to make way for a new school. This day is permeated with fun and nostalgia, when bright moments are played out on the field, causing smiles and memories of the past. The players who have spent many seasons in this stadium are happy to have the opportunity to step on its grass once again and show all their best skills. The sunset, which slowly descends behind the horizon, becomes a symbol of the end of an entire era, reminding everyone present that some things, although they go, leave behind a warm trace in memory. Every kick, every throw and every lively discussion between the players creates a sense of unity that is hard to forget. This match is not just a farewell to the place, but an opportunity to celebrate the friendship and rivalry that united the teams during all these years. The evening promises to be historic for both sides, who will leave the field full of memories and good spirits.

title: Untold: The Liver King
description: Over the years, the main character has persistently built his own empire related to nutritional supplements, investing in it not only significant funds, but also all his energy and time. A unique feature of his approach was a diet consisting mainly of raw meat, which he carefully demonstrated on social media, while conducting experiments on himself and openly sharing the results. His unusual lifestyle quickly attracted the attention of thousands of viewers, turning him into a real sensation. People watched him with interest, trying to understand how his non-standard approach to health and strength would end, and the hero himself sought to prove to the whole world the correctness of his beliefs. This new episode of the popular documentary project for the first time reveals the true face of a man who for a long time remained in the shadow of his media persona. Viewers will see not only external achievements, but also learn about deep personal motives, challenges and sacrifices that accompanied his path. Without embellishments and myths, the tape shows at what cost he built his success, how life is formed around a public image and what remains behind the scenes of popularity. His body is living proof of the results of his own methods, but behind the muscle and strength lies a story unlike any other—honest, poignant, and unexpected.

title: Minecraft: The Movie
description: Four friends who are constantly facing difficulties have no idea that their lives are about to change dramatically. One day, they are unexpectedly pulled into a mysterious portal that transports them to a whimsical world, similar to a cubic wonderland created by their imagination. Once in this unexplored place, they realize that returning home is possible only if they can adapt to the new environment and pass a series of tests. Ahead of them are exciting adventures, dangerous battles and mysterious opponents who have long been preparing for the decisive moment. In order to survive and find a way home, the heroes will have to show intelligence, endurance and the ability to work in a team.

title: Wilhelm Tell
description: XIV century, Switzerland. A once ordinary hunter is forced to become the leader of a rebellion when his family is in mortal danger. The power of the tyrannical Austrian king is spreading, and the country is on the verge of enslavement. He cannot stand aside, because not only the fate of his loved ones, but also the future of the entire nation depends on his determination. Meanwhile, the Holy Roman Empire is weakening, opening the way for new invaders who were just waiting for the right moment to invade. Dynasties expand their borders, seeking to seize lands and increase influence. Insidious enemies use every opportunity to conquer weaker territories without wasting unnecessary resources. Switzerland, which until recently lived in peace, finds itself in danger as Austria continues its merciless offensive, destroying the lives of its defenseless inhabitants. But will the country be able to withstand the unyielding imperial power?

title: Limitless
description: In a moment of emotional breakdown, detective Karl Merck sends his colleague Rose to the distant island of Bornholm in response to a disturbing request from an old acquaintance - police officer Christian Habersaat. But soon after, Christian commits suicide right during his own retirement ceremony, which becomes the impetus for an unexpected investigation. Rose, being on the island, is not only faced with a mysterious case, but also forced to relive her own internal traumas related to the past that she tried to forget. She is soon joined by Carl and Assad, and together they immerse themselves in the investigation of the case of a young girl whose death was mistakenly recognized as a traffic accident. Investigating the details, the trio discovers that the deaths are connected to a series of disappearances of young women with ties to the local police and a mysterious cult of sun worshippers. As the island grows more dangerous and the truth gets closer, Carl must make a choice: finish the case and put the past behind him, or let it ruin his chance at a new life with the one he loves.

title: In the lost lands
description: The ruler longs to find true love, but her hopes never come true. In search of a solution, she makes a bold decision to send a powerful witch to a land shrouded in darkness and oblivion to find an ancient magic that can grant the power of a werewolf. This dangerous journey is filled with traps and deadly trials, and the witch is forced to rely not only on her own charms, but also on the support of a mysterious hunter. Together they face cruel enemies, treacherous creatures and creatures that do not tolerate strangers in their lands. However, the deeper they dive into this world, the more it becomes clear - every step can have consequences that will change their future forever.

title: Snow White
description: In a world where classic fairy tales are given fresh interpretations, an unforgettable story unfolds about a young princess who is forced to hide from the sinister queen stepmother. Fleeing from danger, she finds refuge in the middle of a mysterious forest, where she was sheltered by a community of seven dwarfs. This forest, full of sorcery and secrets, becomes not just a hiding place, but a place where the heroine begins her amazing journey. In this new interpretation of the familiar plot, the princess suddenly realizes that seclusion is not only an escape, but also an opportunity to reveal her inner strength and abilities. Accompanied by dwarves, who now appear as loyal friends and helpers, she begins to master skills that help her cope with difficulties and reveal her true essence. Gradually, the forest becomes not just a background, but a living participant in her adventures, where every tree and every bush can tell its story. In this magical world, the main character learns to overcome her fears and accept herself as she is. The fairy tale finds a new breath, turning into a powerful story about friendship, self-discovery and the uniqueness of each person. The image of a princess who escaped from evil becomes a symbol of the struggle for her dreams and the desire for freedom.

title: Rezbol: Reservation basketball
description: At the center of events is a high school basketball team that actively supports and preserves its Native American cultural identity. These young athletes have always strived for success, but the sudden loss of their standout player casts doubt on their chances of winning future competitions. Teams full of hopes and ambitions are faced with the need to regroup and overcome the confusion that comes after a loss. Each of them begins to realize that the real strength of the team is not only in individual talents, but also in the cohesion and support of each other. Against the background of emotional trials and internal struggles, the players begin to master new strategies and methods of interaction, learning to appreciate every moment spent together. They are rediscovering the forces of unity that have helped them move forward. By overcoming difficulties, the team not only finds alternative ways to victory, but also strengthens its moral foundations. This journey becomes more than just a fight for the title, but a real lesson about the importance of culture, identity and friendship that they will carry throughout their lives.

title: broken
description: This tape reveals the dramatic story of a man who became a real symbol of struggle and endurance - a rider without a saddle, who was on the verge of collapse due to the will of circumstances. His life is full of severe trials and painful blows of fate, and each new day turns into a battle where there is no place for weakness. The main character clings with his last strength to the remains of his rodeo career, which gradually fades like smoldering coal. Sensing how oblivion is coming from all sides, he desperately wants to feel himself on top once again, to be in the center of the arena again, to prove to the world and to himself that all is not lost. However, fate throws up an even tougher test - the hero has to survive a fierce blizzard, finding himself alone with harsh nature. Bitter cold, debilitating injuries, deadly diseases and an endless sense of loneliness force him to fight for his life not in the arena, but in the wild, ruthless reality. Every step becomes a challenge, every breath an effort. In this mortal struggle, he not only tries to survive, but is also forced to face his past: his own decisions, mistakes and paths that led him to this critical point. And it is here, in the struggle with the cold and the shadows of his own life, that his last chance for salvation ripens.

title: My Marcello
description: In the center of the plot is the ambitious actress Chiara Mastroianni. All kinds of directors of all kinds are trying to make a copy of her parents, Catherine Deneuve and Marcello Mastroianni, who are considered real idols of Italian cinema. The main character understands that she is very tired of this constant marathon and comparison. Chiara simply decides to live the life of her father. It would seem like a simple change, but a daughter who wants to be like her father causes a lot of reproaches from the people closest to her, as well as the press. This scandal practically reaches the national level, and the publications only write about it. Even the closest people of the actress ambiguously perceive her decision to live the life of her father - the famous Marcello Mastroianni. Some are surprised, others are outraged, and advise the girl to see a psychiatrist. But when the audience sees a miracle on the screen, an embodiment that would be envied by the best actors, even the most ardent skeptics begin to believe that the nation's favorite actor continued his art in his daughter, showed his talent through her.

title: Police Academy 4: Quarterly policing
description: Commissioner Lassard decided to make his city safer. After the recent events, he realized that it would be better if ordinary people could patrol the streets and help those in trouble. He decides to increase security and therefore creates duty wives. Now they will have to patrol the streets and try to do everything as their leaders tell them. Academy graduates are becoming them, who have to show that the streets are sometimes dangerous. How will it all end and will it be possible to stop the flourishing crime?

title: A hellish summer
description: In the summer camp, the counselors face a terrible threat - a maniac in a mask begins to chase them. In an atmosphere of fear and tension, the young mentors try to protect the children and survive themselves when they realize that they cannot trust anyone they know. Every step turns into a test, and everyday activities become a thing of the past when danger appears on the horizon. The camp, once filled with laughter and joy, now becomes an arena for fighting for life. The counselors are forced to unite and find ways to stop a psychopath obsessed with a thirst for violence. As they try to understand the killer's motives and his true purpose, conflicts erupt between them and suspicions begin to destroy friendships. Tensions mount as the first victims appear, and each night becomes an ordeal that puts not only their lives at risk, but the lives of the children as well. Will the counselors be able to overcome not only fear, but also internal contradictions to win victory over evil?

title: A killer American marriage
description: An alarming call to the rescue service and a terrible picture of a bloody crime discovered at the scene immediately called into question the circumstances of the death of Jason Corbett - an Irishman, a loving father of two children, who had already experienced the loss of his first wife and, it would seem, found a second chance for happiness. After years of pain, he managed to feel the warmth of love again — this time with a young American woman who came into his life as a housekeeper. Their connection quickly grew into a romantic relationship that looked like an example of perfect love from the outside. Everyone around saw a happy family where harmony reigns, but the reality turned out to be completely different. The tragic night of August 2, 2015 put an end to this idyll. Jason was brutally murdered in his own home, and suspicion immediately fell on his new wife, Molly Martens, who desperately denied her guilt. An investigation began, which step by step revealed eerie and shocking details of their life together. Behind the facade of a happy couple, there were tensions, disputes and hidden struggles, which no one around knew about. With each new testimony and proof, it became clearer that the tragedy that rocked the two countries was the result of long-accumulating tensions that finally exploded in the most terrible way.

title: Life after the party
description: Young and carefree Cassie enjoys life to the fullest: parties, alcohol, new acquaintances - her days are full of drive and chaos. But during another loud party, everything does not go according to plan - due to an excessive dose of alcohol, she passes out in the toilet, falls, hits her head... and dies. However, this is not the end of her story. Waking up in a mysterious space, she meets a stranger named Val, who introduces herself as her temporary guardian angel. Val informs Cassie that her soul is suspended between heaven and hell, and she has only five days to correct her earthly mistakes or face eternal damnation. Given a second chance, Cassie returns to earth as an invisible observer to try to mend broken relationships, apologize to those she's wronged, and prove that even a tarnished reputation is not a sentence.

title: Seven veils
description: A young theater director, Janine, is given the difficult but extremely important task of bringing to life a stage production of Salome, the legendary opera created by her late mentor, a man who had a profound influence on her formation as an artist. Immersing herself in the process of rehearsals, she gradually discovers not only the power of the work, but also forgotten emotions and personal memories emerging from the depths of consciousness. These experiences force her to rethink everything she believed in before and to question life and professional convictions that seemed to be unshakable. Each day of rehearsals becomes not only a step towards the restoration of a great work of art, but also part of a deep personal transformation. Confronting the painful moments of her past—suppressed dreams, the pressure of expectations, and the fear of being herself—Janine begins to free herself from her inner limitations. This creative path turns into an intimate journey to self-awareness.

title: Grandma
description: A man who has survived the loss of his mother decides to take a bold step in her honor. He opens an Italian restaurant in which real grandmothers become the main chefs. This project not only symbolizes his love and gratitude to his mother, but also creates a space where the flavors and aromas of Italy come alive through the art of experienced women, each of whom brings her own story and passion to cooking. A restaurant becomes more than just a place where food is served; it is a culinary journey in which guests can enjoy the atmosphere of home comfort, warmth and care. Each dish on the menu is a tribute to the traditions and memory of the past, as well as an opportunity for visitors to touch the culture and heritage of Italy. The man realizes that despite his loss, he can create something meaningful by bringing people together through the love of food and communication.

title: Karol G: Tomorrow was beautiful
description: In this candid documentary project, the successful and world-renowned Colombian singer shares a deeply personal story behind her bright performances and stage presence. For the first time, she invites viewers to her inner world, where not everything is as bright as it seems from the outside. Her path to fame was far from easy - constant obstacles, doubts and life trials stood in the way of big dreams every time. However, thanks to determination, perseverance and deep talent, she managed to turn difficulties into a source of strength, giving her fans music that resonates with the souls of millions. The documentary reveals the invisible side of a star's life - moments of doubt, fatigue, struggle for an emotional balance between the stage and personal space. Viewers will see how the artist copes with the pressure of constant touring, recording new albums and at the same time seeks harmony in everyday life. She shares personal thoughts, emotions and moments of vulnerability, showing that behind her confident image is a genuine, sensitive and deeply human personality. This is a story not only about success, but about the power to remain yourself despite everything.

title: Britain and the Blitz
description: History comes to life on screen thanks to carefully selected color archive footage, which transports the viewer to the thick of the events that took place in Great Britain during the Second World War. This deeply emotional and at the same time factually accurate documentary project creates the effect of complete immersion in the reality of the past, giving an opportunity to see not only large-scale historical events, but also the human destinies that stood behind them. Through the unique testimonies of eyewitnesses who were at the center of the raging events, the viewer gets access to the story as it really was - without embellishments and simplifications. The stories of people who saw everything with their own eyes open the veil over the little-known facts that changed the course of the war and became decisive in the struggle for freedom and dignity. The focus is on the fateful decisions of political leaders, on which the future history of the world depended, and the chronicles of the lives of ordinary residents who survived under continuous bombing. Secrets that remained in the shadows for decades, and some of them were deliberately hidden from the public in order not to cause even greater shocks, are gradually revealed. This film is not just a chronicle of the war, but a real journey into that dangerous and heroic period when the fate of millions was decided. The past inevitably resonates with the present, showing how the mistakes, choices and victories of that time echo in our time, opening new facets of the truth that has been silenced for so long.

title: Bad influence
description: In the center of the plot is the story of an orphan named Eros, who, hardened by the harshness of the streets from an early age, gradually plunges into the world of crime and hopelessness. His life is rapidly falling into the abyss, until fate gives him a chance to make amends - a rich and influential man hires Eros as a personal bodyguard for his daughter Reese. At first, the relationship between them is formal, but over time, a mysterious connection develops between the young people, which develops into a forbidden feeling. That romantic intimacy quickly turns into a risk: dark secrets are hidden in the past of both, and the surrounding world is filled with lies, conspiracies and deadly threats. From now on, Eros and Reese are not just a guard and a ward, but allies in a dangerous game where every step can be fatal.

title: Aliens in America
description: The incredible adventure comedy tells the story of a medieval knight and his loyal servant who accidentally find themselves in the modern world. Due to the fatal mistake of the sorcerer, Count Thibault and servant Andre are transferred from the 12th century to the stormy and incomprehensible Chicago of the 21st century. Unaccustomed to technology, cars and everyday modern habits, they get into a series of comical situations, causing complete chaos on the streets of the metropolis. Fortunately, Thibault's great-great-granddaughter Julia comes to their aid, who tries to help them adapt and find a way back in time. But it is not so easy to do this when you are armed with a sword, do not understand what a mobile phone is, and sincerely consider the shower to be a magical device. This story is a hilarious kaleidoscope of adventure, misunderstandings and culture shock in which two travelers from the past learn new things without losing themselves.

title: Dead mail
description: On a lonely, remote road, where there is not a soul, a wounded and bound man crawls with the last of his strength to a lonely mailbox. His goal is to have time to send a cryptic message with a desperate plea for help before he is overtaken by a sinister figure relentlessly stalking his victim. This strange and disturbing letter soon ends up in the post office of a small county, where it is received by Jasper, a meticulous, focused and experienced employee who specializes in investigating cases of lost or missing correspondence, returning letters to their rightful addressees. However, this time the letter arouses more than just professional interest in him. Jasper plunges into a creepy investigation, unaware of how deep and dangerous the case will turn out to be. Everything gets complicated when he meets a new neighbor - the mysterious and somewhat eccentric Trent, who recently moved into his house. At first reserved and silent, Trent begins to raise more and more suspicions, especially after he suddenly appears in Jasper's office. It becomes apparent that this man knows much more about the ominous note than meets the eye and has dark intentions of his own.

title: Strong nut 3: Die with a song
description: In the third part, the events take place in the American New York. Police officer John McClain is standing guard here. It was he who was destined to become a strong nut in the fight against a wild terrorist who planned to commit an act of revenge against his old enemy and the entire city as a whole.
