The thing is that Simon is simply a genius in the field of explosions and all the devices necessary for their organization. He calls John on the phone and demands that all conditions be clearly fulfilled, otherwise the huge metropolis will simply blow up. And in parallel with these events, a group of robbers robbed the National Bank of the United States. Now one of the worst days of their entire career has come for the cops. The film "Die Hard 3: Die with a Song" (1995) will be a must watch for all fans of the Bruce Willis film series.

title: Strong nut 2
description: The story takes place on Christmas Eve. Once again, our hero, a motorcycle cop from Los Angeles, does not get along with his wife. Weather conditions threw him to a snowy airport. And, surprisingly, terrorists appear there like snow on one's head. Their goal is simple, to free the drug lord. The authorities, as always, show their incompetence. And the indefatigable John McClane comes to the rescue. We suggest watching the movie "The Strong Nutcracker 2" (1990) in Ukrainian for lovers of classic action movies about the Strong Nutcracker.

title: Saving
description: An aging boxer who was once a famous and successful athlete is trying to break out of the restricted world of his small town. Now his fights are not in the ring, but in his own life, full of emotional and personal problems that he has to deal with on a daily basis. Step by step, he tries to restore what was lost and finds new dreams and relationships that help him feel the meaning of existence again. But as soon as he manages to put his life back together a little, he finds himself in a dangerous situation that threatens everything he has achieved. Finding himself in the company of people who begin to destroy his peace, the boxer is forced to make an important decision that will determine his future.

title: Tick-tock... Boom!
description: The action of the film takes place in 1990 in New York. John will soon turn thirty. He works as a simple waiter and continues to move towards his dream. All his free time, the hero works on creating a musical, which, in his opinion, will conquer the hearts of the audience and critics. John believes that his work will become a real hit that will be staged on Broadway. But gradually he begins to lose confidence, as the pressure from those around him only increases. His beloved Suzanne is tired of waiting for him to succeed, and his best friend Michael decided to leave his dream of becoming an actor and chose a stable job in an office for himself. (2021) in Ukrainian for fans of biographical dramas and musicals.

title: Lost bullet 3
description: The south of France becomes the place where the tense life of the main character — Lino, a master of escapes and a man with a complicated past — unfolds again. An ex-convict and petty criminal, he specializes in the development of unique vehicles designed specifically for high-risk criminal missions. This time he returns for a reason - another large-scale adventure awaits him ahead, which promises to be a real test not only of his skills, but also of endurance. In the heat of passion and surrounded by allies who share his goal, Lino prepares to implement a new grandiose plan. However, fate has prepared for him a whole series of complex obstacles that stand in the way of the desired result. Labyrinths of treachery, sudden dangers and tense moments become part of a new game in which not only freedom is at stake, but also the future. Everything he has built and strives for is threatened, but Lino is not one to give up. Step by step, he overcomes difficulties, moving towards the goal, despite increasingly confusing circumstances.

title: Adjacent room
description: The long-standing friendship between Ingrid and Marta is shrouded in memories of a carefree youth, when they spent almost every day together, sharing dreams and secrets. However, over time, life separated them, and each of the friends chose her own path. Ingrid found success in literature, winning the hearts of readers with her novels and essays, while Marta devoted herself to journalism, risking her life at the front to reveal the truth about the war. Their destinies, it would seem, diverged forever, and each of the women plunged into her own world, completely forgetting about the friendship that once connected them. Unexpectedly, after many years, fate brings them together again, but in an environment full of heaviness and bitterness. The circumstances that led to their reunion leave no room for joy: both friends face the consequences of tragic events that require understanding and support. Most often, it is at such moments that the true power of friendship and the ability of people to help each other cope with difficulties is manifested. In these meetings, they find not only solace, but also an opportunity to rethink their lives, to understand what it means to be there in the darkest hours.

title: Doolittle
description: The dark-skinned doctor, after discovering in himself a supernatural ability - understanding the language of animals, decided to go far outside the city and become a village doctor. It was here that he was able to develop a unique gift in himself, practicing to his heart's content in communicating with four-legged friends. Enjoying life in the village, the veterinarian treated wild animals every day, which, having learned about his talents, came straight from the forest in order to treat the general condition of the body, feeling unwell. But one day the doctor decided to make a long journey after hearing on the news about monkeys suffering from an unknown disease. The animals were dying and no one dared to help them. Then the doctor packed his suitcase and went to Africa, hoping to make it in time and save most of the hairy mammals. But the trip turns out to be far from easy. Plus, some furry friends from the farm volunteered to go with him to help with this. The man will get into many dangerous situations, from which he will not be able to get out alive without the help of good animals. And the animals, feeling that strangers are a loyal friend, ready to come to the rescue at any moment, invariably go into battle, saving their friend from the threats of the wild jungle.

title: Louis CK Live at the Beacon Theatre
description: Louis C. Kay's first independent stand-up concert is a sincere, sometimes ruthless reflection on topics that touch everyone. The comedian openly shares his thoughts on parenthood, the challenges of growing up and his inner desire to change himself for the better. His look is both tough and funny, full of irony, introspection and characteristic immediacy. In this performance, Louis is not afraid to bare his soul to the audience, making fun of his own shortcomings, everyday realities and the absurdities of life. This is not just a set of jokes - it is a deeply personal monologue that combines laughter with reflection, leaving behind not only a smile, but also a space for inner conclusions.

title: Flying over the cuckoo's nest
description: The main character of the dramatic film is Randle Patrick McMurphy, whose life was far from the best. Years ago, he embarked on a criminal path, rapidly transforming into a pathological criminal. So, by doing arbitrariness, he thought that he would go unpunished. But it wasn't here. On one of the usual days, he falls into the hands of representatives of law enforcement agencies. Following this, he soon finds himself on the dock in court, and then ends up in a colony. However, everything did not end there, but only just began. After all, in a short period of time, Randle, who turns out to be an incorrigible rebel, is transferred from the colony to a psychiatric hospital. The purpose of all this is to find out - is McMurphy mentally ill or not? Randle himself, finding himself among the mentally ill, decides to have fun in this clinic to the fullest. And soon his rebellious nature suddenly begins to infect many other patients...

title: Friend
description: This is a moving story filled with feelings of love, friendship and loss, as well as the search for inspiration and healing. The main character is a talented writer whose life changed after the death of her close friend and mentor. As his inheritance, she gets a large and good-natured Great Dane, which was his faithful companion. At first, the woman experiences difficulties in her new role - she needs not only to take care of the pet, but also to cope with the grief of loss. Gradually, a strong bond is formed between her and the dog, which helps her open up to new feelings and experiences. Interaction with Durg brings her not only joy, but also inspiration for creativity. With each page of the life they write together, the writer understands that love and friendship can heal wounds, opening new horizons. This process becomes not only a way to survive difficult times, but also an opportunity to find yourself anew, to find inner peace and confidence in the future.

title: Fatal message
description: A widowed mother's first date after a long break takes a dark turn. During a romantic dinner, anonymous threatening messages begin to arrive on her phone. These ominous messages cause her anxiety and make her wonder who might be behind this haunting. Her new acquaintance, charming and attractive at first glance, suddenly becomes the object of suspicion. The mother finds herself in a situation where she has to figure out if he really could be involved in this bullying or if it is just a coincidence. The tension builds and she tries to stay calm despite her growing sense of anxiety. Internal experiences and fears begin to overshadow the pleasant moments of a date, turning it into a test. In this difficult situation, she has to make a choice between trust and the instinct of self-preservation, which leads to unpredictable consequences for her future.

title: Another simple service
description: The story follows Stephanie Smothers and Emily Nelson, who head to the picturesque island of Capri in Italy. This trip is connected with the grand wedding of Emily, who is getting married to a successful Italian businessman. On the eve of this important event, the friends enjoy the charms of the island, its picturesque landscapes and unique atmosphere. Against the background of the blue sea and bright flowers, Emily prepares for her important day, and Stephanie, as a faithful friend, provides her with moral support and help in organizing the wedding. At the same time, they encounter various surprises that only add color to their journey. Their joint activities, such as walking through the narrow streets of Capri, visiting local cafes and meeting interesting people, open new horizons and give special meaning to this important moment in Emily's life. The story of friendship, love and celebration of an important event fills these days with joy and warmth, creating unforgettable memories that will stay with them forever.

title: Lessons from Mr. Penguin
description: In 1976, a disillusioned Englishman named Tom, in search of a new purpose in life, goes to Argentina, where he gets a job as an English teacher at a local school. He is met with a cold reception: students are not interested in learning, ignore new knowledge and make their teacher's days difficult. Despite this, Tom does not give up and tries to change the approach to teaching, investing in his work sincerity, patience and faith in the best. And gradually, step by step, he manages to change the situation - the students begin to respond, open up new horizons for themselves and really learn the language. The turning point in his life comes when one day he accidentally finds a penguin on the shore suffering from oil. Tom rescues the animal, cleans it of dirt and takes it home, without even suspecting what role this act will play in his future fate. Penguin, having shown loyalty and gratitude, no longer leaves his savior, becoming for him not just a pet, but a true friend. Their unexpected partnership changes the teacher's life, helping him to find meaning, inspiration and faith in people again. Against the background of the country's complex reality, this touching friendship between man and animal becomes a symbol of hope, devotion and warmth capable of changing even the most weary heart.

title: A place under the pines
description: Luke Glenton is a talented motorcycle stuntman who travels all over the country with a tour. The main character moves from one province to another, showing his incredible tricks. This is his main activity that brings some income. One day he meets his ex-girlfriend named Romina, who says that he has a one-year-old child, Jason. Luke decides to tie up his career as a motorcycle stuntman and start raising a child. He gets a job with the mechanic Robin, but the money is still not enough. Then Robin offers him to rob a bank. The movie "A Place Under the Pines" (2013) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of dramatic and crime films.

title: The biggest fan
description: Lana Cruz is an energetic actress from Mexico who dreamed of Hollywood since childhood. After a catastrophic failure overseas, she is forced to return home and work on local film and TV series projects. Determined to prove her own skills, Lana agrees to a role in a new film, believing that this is her chance to remind the world of her talent and one day conquer the big screen. But an unexpected gift of fate - a devoted fan of Polly - turns the job into a real nightmare. At first, mild interest quickly turns into obsessive control: Polly follows Lana wherever she appears, interfering in the filming process and the actress' personal life. What should have been a creative victory turns into a whole series of trials, forcing Lana to fight not only for the role, but also for her own peace and safety.

title: Curse of the Sin Eater
description: Rick Malone, an ordinary construction site worker, unexpectedly finds himself at the center of events that radically change his life. After a chance encounter with bedridden billionaire George Drayton, Rick is offered a deal he can't refuse: he must eat a meal made from the billionaire's latest donations. Wanting to provide for his family and gain access to incredible wealth, Rick agrees to this terrifying condition, not even imagining the price he will have to pay. Immediately after the strange dinner, his world is filled with luxury and opportunities he never dreamed of. But along with the legendary fortune, Rick becomes the bearer of Drayton's moral sentence - the shadow of past crimes and immoral decisions begins to haunt him every day. Now the former builder will not only have to master the new rules of the game in the elite circle, but also face the curse that lives inside - the temptation of power and wealth, capable of destroying even the strongest soul.

The main character is named Mac Enslin, known as a writer who works in the horror genre. This time he again took up a new book in which he writes about poltergeists and unusual phenomena in hotels. At the same time, our main character does not believe in the existence of an afterlife at all. In order to make sure of this once again, Enslin decides to settle in hotel room 1408, which already has a bad reputation. For many years there have been rumors that incomprehensible things happen in this room and ghosts live there. Despite the warnings of the hotel's general manager, the main character stays in the room without fearing the consequences. Upertyukh still does not predict what this night will turn out to be for him... The film "1408" (2007) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror, thrillers and fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: Invitation
description: Laura was always extremely close to her daughter Kate, even when she moved to another city to start a new life. They talked every day by video call, discussing every detail of the wedding, from the dresses to the script of the ceremony. From the outside, it seemed that Kate was happy and confident in her choice: Max showed care, gave flowers and supported her in everything. However, Laura was more than once disturbed by something elusive in his look and behavior - small hints of impatience and hidden anger that did not fit into the image of an ideal groom. During one of the video calls, Kate suddenly froze in a strange position, as if listening to extraneous sounds in the room. Her face turned white, fear flashed in her eyes, and she rushed to the door, clamoring and pleadingly looking over her shoulder. Laura rushed to call out her name, but the connection was lost at the moment when her daughter was already climbing the stairs. All that remained on the screen were the dark contours of an empty room and the muffled sound of a lock closing...

title: Stranger / Delusion
description: Residents of the city were shocked by the news of the cold-blooded murder, which shook the public. Even more shocking was the fact that the criminal managed to avoid punishment, because there were almost no traces left, and there was little evidence. The police did not have a clear version, and every day hopes for justice melted away. The last chance to reveal the truth was an experienced law enforcement officer who agreed to work undercover. His task was to establish confidential contact with the main suspect and extract a confession from him. His every step is controlled from above, because the success of the operation depends on a delicate psychological balance. In the film "Deception", the fine line between truth and lies becomes a test not only for the suspect, but also for the police officer himself.

title: With the arrival of autumn
description: Michelle is the perfect grandmother and caring neighbor who happily spends her days in an idyllic Burgundian village. Anticipating the guests' visit, she decides to go mushroom hunting with her friend Marie-Claude. She has plans for a family dinner with her daughter and a long-awaited vacation with her beloved grandson. However, an unexpected event disrupts all her plans, depriving her of joy and peace. Against the background of what is happening, Vincent, the son of Marie-Claude, who was recently released from prison, takes responsibility for the situation. He decides to find his own way to fix the problems that have arisen and bring back Michelle's happiness. This decision will be the beginning of new trials and difficult choices for all participants in this story, forcing them to think about the values ​​of family, friendship and forgiveness. Events develop, and each of the characters faces the consequences of their actions, which makes this storyline deep and unforgettable.

title: A winning combination
description: In the center of events are two twin sisters who, although they have the same appearance, have radically different personalities. One of them is a quiet, vulnerable and very withdrawn person who does not know how to open up to others and constantly experiences internal emotional storms. It is difficult for her to trust people, she avoids risk and lives in her own world of fears and doubts. The other is her complete opposite: open to new experiences, brave, determined and always seeking adventure. She is not afraid of the unknown, she easily accepts challenges and lives to the fullest. One day, a charismatic and rich businessman starts courting her reserved sister. His attention seems sincere, and his intentions are serious, but behind the external charm hides an unstable nature. The man suffers from uncontrollable outbursts of anger, which burst out from time to time, scaring not only his beloved, but also those around him. Over time, his dark side begins to manifest itself more and more often, and the situation suddenly gets out of control. What started as a romantic story turns into a real psychological drama, in which not every hero can remain unscathed.

title: Chameleon
description: Knoll Ashby is a middle-aged realtor who long ago left agencies, preferring to work independently. Relying only on experience, intuition and charm, he stayed afloat for a long time in a competitive business. But over time, success stopped bringing him pleasure. The monotonous routine, endless meetings, hustle and bustle around clients and real estate began to wear him down, turning life into a gray existence devoid of drive and meaning. Feeling an inner emptiness, Knoll sets out in search of new sensations that can awaken true life in him. In pursuit of adrenaline and unusual emotions, he eventually crosses the line, peering into a completely different, gloomy and dangerous world.

title: 2B: Fair community
description: At the center of events is a tangled story of deception, manipulation and the struggle for survival. Vaughn, an ordinary man, finds himself embroiled in a dangerous life insurance scam. When he tries to escape from this criminal plan, everything ends tragically - he dies. His death becomes the trigger for a series of events that drag other people into a vortex of fraud, changing their lives forever. Aspiring actor Kato accidentally becomes part of this scheme. He is sent on an extremely risky mission, which turns into a real nightmare for him. He finds himself trapped, without a way out or support, forced to fight for his own life in the shadow of other people's secrets. While an experienced FBI agent investigates a crime, he accidentally steps on the trail of a secret society where its residents enjoy luxury built on insurance fraud. Among them is a woman who, wanting to help, hides Kato, not even realizing how dangerous her involvement is. With each step, the revelations gain momentum: deception, betrayals, losses and moral trials force the heroes to look at themselves and their surroundings in a new way.

title: Dirty animals
description: A day in the life of two losers who prefer surfing, smoking and hunting wild animals. These friends spend time on the coast catching waves and enjoying freedom, although they don't always manage to get the ideal surfing conditions. Their passion for surfing, despite a series of setbacks, remains an important part of life. After that, they decide to relax with a cigarette, discussing their thoughts and dreams. However, the day does not end there - they go hunting to test their luck and test their skills. Hunting becomes for them not only a way to spend time, but also a test in which they strive to succeed. In the end, despite all the difficulties, they stay true to their passions and find joy in the simple moments they share together.

title: Wicked
description: Jerry Fenn is a journalist who learns about strange events that happened in a small town. Alice is a deaf and mute girl to whom the Virgin Mary appeared. After what she saw, she hears again and begins to speak. After some time, the girl herself performs a real miracle, healing a seriously ill child. Believers begin to arrive in this place, and the local bishop, who is Alice's uncle, launches a rather large-scale action. But Jerry does not believe much in the reality of what is happening. He decides to conduct his own investigation, hoping to establish the truth. The film "Wicked" (2021) will be enjoyed by all fans of detective horror films in Ukrainian.

title: Real pain
description: Since childhood, cousins ​​David and Benji have been inseparable. They shared everything with each other: walks, studies, dreams about the future. Their plans to attend the same university seemed unwavering, and their parents tried to do everything to keep them together. However, fate ordered otherwise. Because of work, the boys' families moved to different countries, and the connection, despite attempts to maintain it at a distance, gradually faded. Years later, having grown up, the brothers decide to restore the lost closeness. Through correspondence, they arrange a meeting for a trip to Poland - the country with which their childhood dreams and memories of their beloved grandmother are connected. There they want to honor her memory and try to return what once connected them. But the trip, which began as an attempt to reunite, turns into a difficult drama. Long-forgotten secrets from the family's past surface, jeopardizing not only their journey, but also the possibility of rekindling their friendship.

title: A story with a necklace
description: Adventurer Jeanne Lamotte is related to the former royal French house of Valois through the son of Henry II. She planned to take possession of an expensive necklace, which was made for the mistress of King Louis XV, but at the same time to be deceived. Since the king died, the necklace remained unrealized. Jeanne, being the mistress of Cardinal de Rogan, and presenting herself as a close friend of Queen Marie Antoinette, arranged dates for the cardinal and the queen. But the role of the queen was played by another woman. The cardinal did not suspect anything suspicious when the "queen" asked him to buy a necklace on loan. The Cardinal, on behalf of Marie-Antoinette, was handed forged loan letters... The film "History with a Necklace" (2001) will be enjoyed by all fans of historical dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: Madly in love
description: The story of the young couple is interrupted by a cruel and fateful event, when the boy goes to prison for 12 years. Starting their relationship with boundless dreams and plans, the teenagers face a harsh reality that puts their feelings to a serious test. Life suddenly separates them, leaving the girl alone to struggle with the new state of affairs, while her lover must learn to survive in the conditions of isolation and the prison regime, where every day endangers his well-being and human dignity. While the boy faces the pressure and cruelty of prison life, the girl tries to support him morally, keeping faith in their future together. They try to maintain their relationship through letters and rare meetings, but the distance and the changes that happen to each of them make their bond increasingly fragile. This story explores how the pressure of circumstance changes human relationships and reveals how deep and enduring love can be when faced with hardship and separation.

title: A little family drama
description: In the center of the plot is a Mexican family that has been running a small but famous restaurant for generations. On the eve of the annual family dinner, which is supposed to honor the memory of the late grandfather. However, this time they are not only waiting for a celebration, but also an explosion of emotions, old grudges and unexpected confessions, which can endanger not only the harmony in the family, but also the business itself. The old dream of a taco truck unexpectedly becomes a catalyst for change, forcing everyone to think about their own priorities in life. But when family secrets begin to surface, trust and love are put to the test. Despite the tension, the heroes gradually realize the value of supporting relatives and the power of unity, even in the most difficult moments.

title: Empire waist / Empire silhouette
description: The story revolves around Lenore Miller, a shy, chubby teenage girl who suffers from self-doubt and constantly hides her talent for fear of being misunderstood. The sudden support of a determined and courageous classmate opens a new world for Lenore - the world of fashion, where she discovers her true calling. Her unique vision of inclusive style not only makes people pay attention to her, but also puts the girl in front of a choice: follow her dream or be afraid of the opinions of others. Despite the support of her loving father, who believes in her abilities, the girl has to fight the judgment of her mother, who is obsessed with her appearance and is afraid that her daughter will be "not like that". But Lenore's greatest struggle is with herself: inner fears, rejection of her own body and constant loneliness poison her every new step. Only by creating clothes that allow others to be themselves, she begins to approach the most important thing - self-love. And only time will tell if the girl will have the strength to destroy stereotypes and allow herself to be happy as she is.

title: Interview with a vampire
description: The story of the tape begins with the fact that the journalist is visited by none other than Vampire, demanding to describe his life in all the details ... A long time ago, a young guy named Louis was an ordinary person. Later, he became a farmer, raised a family and, one might say, was quite happy. But grief comes to the life of a young farmer - his wife and daughter die. The film "Interview with a Vampire: Chronicle of a Vampire" (1994) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and fantasy films in Ukrainian.

title: The great fugitive
description: Without warning the staff of the nursing home, he secretly leaves its walls and goes to France, a place where the fate of the world was once decided. Its purpose is to honor the memory of comrades who gave their lives during the landing in Normandy exactly 70 years ago. Ignoring his advanced age and possible difficulties, he boldly walks down memory lane, returning to the place where young soldiers once fought for freedom. His courage and determination do not leave indifferent those whom he meets on his way. Will he be able to fulfill his plan and bow to the memory of the dead?

title: Novocaine
description: The film is about a man whose life changes dramatically after a chance meeting with a woman in danger. The main character is a dentist who leads a bourgeois life, filled with professional worries and ordinary affairs. Everything changes when a patient who seemed completely normal comes to see him. The woman asks him to help her hide from the threat, and not knowing how it will turn out, he agrees. Pretty quickly, the hero finds himself at the center of a complicated story in which he will have to make difficult decisions, breaking the law or his own moral principles. Caught in a world full of deception and violence, he is forced to fight for his freedom and safety, facing the consequences of his actions. With each step, he realizes more and more that his life has been full of illusions, and now he is forced to decide what is more important to him: to save himself or to help the one who was caught in a deadly trap.

title: Winter, spring, summer or autumn
description: Remy is a brilliant student with an impressive intellect and a bright future. She lives according to a clear plan, where every step leads her to her dream university. But one day her life changes when she meets Barnes, a carefree dreamer and musician who seems to have neither purpose nor ambition. Despite their absolute opposites, a strange but sincere friendship develops between the teenagers, which gradually develops into something deeper. Together they overcome difficulties, discover new emotions and learn to see the world through each other's eyes. The seasons change, and their relationship grows with them: cold winter gives birth to warm trust, spring gives hope, and the summer sun ignites the first feelings. However, the approach of autumn presents them with a choice: Remy must leave the city to study at the university of his dreams. For the first time in her life, she doubts whether it is worth sacrificing love for the sake of a career? Together with Barnes, they try to understand what is really important to them and whether it is possible to keep feelings at a distance when life calls in different directions.

title: Wild stories
description: In 1987, in sunny, but at the same time explosive Oakland, California, four, at first glance, completely unrelated stories are intertwined. This is a journey into the depths of human feelings, where each hero in his own way experiences love for music, movies, places, people and memories that remain beyond the usual perception of the world. The story gradually reveals many themes and moods to the viewer: from nostalgia for the past to painful revelations about the present. On the screen, a bright basketball star, a corrupt policeman who has long gone to the dark side of the system, a female rap group trying to break out of the underground, local teenage punks who accidentally fell into the vortex of events, aggressive neo-Nazis and an influential tax collector collide on the screen. debts All of them unwittingly become part of a deep social conflict, which quickly turns into a dangerous game without rules. Despite the chaos engulfing the city, each of the heroes tries to find their place and keep themselves in the world.

title: Out of jurisdiction
description: Sarah, a battle-hardened special forces soldier, arrives in Frankfurt to visit the US consulate with her young son. But this seemingly ordinary trip turns into a real nightmare: the child disappears without a trace, and disturbing, incomprehensible things begin to happen within the walls of the diplomatic institution. Instantly mobilized, Sara joins the search, realizing that she has found herself in a place where neither the outside authorities nor the German services have jurisdiction. Leaving the consulate means losing the chance to get my son back. Disobeying the order to evacuate, she hides in the internal corridors of the institution, where every step can be fatal. Labyrinths of the premises, shrouded in paranoia and secrets, lead her to shocking discoveries - at the epicenter of the diplomatic establishment lurks a conspiracy that threatens not only her family, but also national security. Sarah finds herself on the edge of human possibility, defying forces she doesn't understand—in a battle against time, fear, and betrayal. But nothing will stop a mother who is ready to go through hell for the life of her child.

title: Lizzie
description: On August 4, 1892, the estate of the prosperous Borden family thundered with terror and fear. The corpses of the owner of the house and his wife were found in a bloody mess, as if someone had tried to erase all traces. The bodies were mutilated with dozens of ax blows, causing horror and disgust in all who saw this gruesome sight. The investigation did not reveal any evidence that would indicate a motive or the presence of the robbers. However, all fingers pointed to the girl from the family whose parents were victims of this brutal murder. This legend of cold-bloodedness and cruelty will remain in the memory of many generations, surprising and shocking with its incomprehensible prohibition.

title: Neighborhood watch
description: A young man with mental disorders is convinced that he witnessed the kidnapping of a woman. However, when he turns to the police for help, his words are not understood, and the law enforcement officers refuse to take his statement seriously. In desperation, he decides to turn to his neighbor - a former security guard, who, despite his retirement, can offer his help. The young man hopes that his neighbor's experience will help him understand this confusing situation and find the missing woman. They begin a joint investigation that uncovers not only the details of the disappearance, but also the many dark secrets lurking in their county. As they immerse themselves in their quest, difficulties arise and their friendship is put to the test. The neighbor, for his part, begins to realize that behind this event there may be much more serious things than just abduction. Thus, their joint work becomes not only a search for the truth, but also an opportunity to understand their own fears and misunderstandings.

title: Ash
description: A woman wakes up on a distant planet and the entire crew of her spaceship has been brutally destroyed. In an attempt to understand what happened, she begins her own investigation, which leads to many unexpected and disturbing discoveries. Each new piece of evidence reveals to her the dark secrets behind the deaths of her comrades. The insidious forces behind the crime are not going to leave witnesses, and her actions become increasingly risky. It is up to the woman to find the strength to face ancient threats and uncover the truth before it is too late. Each step along this dangerous path awakens in her new emotions and ancient survival instincts that will help her cope with the horrors that await in the dark.

title: Umami Star Chef
description: This film immerses the viewer in an intense and dynamic night in the life of a talented chef who works in a prestigious restaurant in the center of Istanbul. It all starts with small difficulties, but events quickly become chaotic, turning a working evening into a series of trials, misunderstandings and conflicts. The hero must simultaneously keep control of the kitchen, respond to management pressure and maintain a high bar in an establishment where every detail counts. But it is even more difficult for him to balance external success and internal contradictions, because in parallel with professional challenges, he has to face painful personal experiences. The atmosphere of tension does not subside for a moment, because even the closest people in the kitchen begin to set him new, no less difficult tasks. In this struggle, the hero appears not just as a cook, but as a person who strives not to lose himself in the frantic pace of life. His dream is not only a perfect restaurant, but also harmony with himself. To achieve it, he must go through many emotional and professional challenges, make painful choices and rethink the past. This is a story not only about cooking, but also about a deep inner transformation that happens in one but decisive night.

title: Nosferatu
description: In the center of the story is a mysterious girl, whose life is covered by the shadow of mysterious events. Inexplicable events begin to haunt her like ghosts from the past, depriving her of peace and confidence in the future. In this gloomy and disturbing world, she encounters an unusual creature - a vampire, whose gaze is full of deep feelings. A strange connection arises between them, which awakens hope and confusion. He becomes her protector, ready to fight against the dark forces that want to possess her soul. However, their love is in danger as the world they have entered is full of dangers and trials. Each step forward requires courage and determination from them, as well as a willingness to face their own fears. Excitement fills their hearts when they realize that their destinies are intertwined not only with love, but also with ancient secrets that haunt the girl. After going through many trials, they must learn to trust each other in order to resist the forces that seek to separate them forever. Ultimately, their story becomes a search not only for love, but also for inner peace in a world full of mystery and danger.

title: Alto Knights / Wise Guys
description: New York is a city where the mafia thrives, while remaining completely unpunished. Until recently, Frank Costello and Vito Genovese were best friends. The men loved to drink in the evenings, share ideas and play golf, enjoying the company of a smart person. But at some point, a cat ran between the two biggest New York mobsters. Their enmity did not bode well for the city and its inhabitants, because the number of crimes and murders would inevitably increase. Control over the city should belong to only one, and yesterday's comrades are ready to tear their throats to become the leader. A series of betrayals, deceptions and envy - all this leads to a conflict that fundamentally changes the mafia system. As long as one is alive, the other will not be able to find peace for himself, neither here nor anywhere else. But their opposition will cause many armed conflicts, during which dozens of innocent people will die. Blood will flow through the streets and no one will be able to stop it.

title: Devastation
description: A detective searches for the missing son of an influential politician and investigates a complex conspiracy. This story develops against the background of intense events, full of intrigue and unexpected turns. The main character, having outstanding analytical abilities, faces many obstacles and secret forces that try to hinder his investigation. He interacts with various characters, including witnesses who may have key information and suspects from the missing person's entourage. During his investigation, the detective gradually uncovers the dark secrets of the political world, which can threaten not only the career of an influential person, but also the safety of many people. With each step he gets closer to the truth, but he faces risks and troubles that complicate his task. After all, he has not only to find the missing person, but also to expose hidden plans that can change public opinion and shake the foundations of power.

title: Thelma and Louise
description: Louise works as a waitress in a fast-food restaurant. She has a lover - a musician who tours roadside haunts, while often forgetting about her lover. Energetic and cheerful in the past, Thelma, after marrying Darryl, realized that a woman should be in the kitchen, and a man should be in front of the TV. This kind of life does not suit women, and one fine day they decide to go away from their husbands. On the way, they are forced to commit a number of crimes. They are declared wanted, and the girlfriends have no other choice but to reach Mexico in time by any means. The film "Thelma and Louise" (1991) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers, adventures and dramas.

title: Divorce in black
description: A critical moment comes in the life of Eva, a young bank employee, when all her hopes and usual joys begin to crumble like a house of cards. Her husband, with whom she made joint plans and dreamed of the future, suddenly decides to break up their marriage. This betrayal leaves Eve in a state of deep mental desolation and sadness. However, despite the looming hopelessness, her heart is determined not to give in to circumstances. Eve begins to look for ways to rebuild her life, considering each step that will help her overcome grief and return to happiness. As time passes, Eve encounters unexpected discoveries that question her previous ideas about life. During her journey, she manages to uncover secrets related to her loneliness and loss, which radically changes her perception of reality. This new knowledge leads to unexpected meetings and the awakening of real emotions, forcing Eve to realize that her past and future intersect in an amazing dance of fate. Each new challenge she faces reveals her hidden strengths and desire to find her soulmate. Eva's journey becomes an important stage of self-discovery, full of trials and hope, which gives her the opportunity to rethink her life.

title: I spit on your graves 2
description: Young beauty Katie dreams of becoming a model and moves to New York for this. But her dreams were not destined to come true. One day, rapists break into the girl's apartment. Having mocked her, she is taken to another country and continues to be tortured there. Having miraculously survived, Katie decides to devote herself to revenge. She finds everyone who has hurt her and pays them back in spades. Now the inhumans sob in pain and dream of dying. But the heroine will not have a single drop of compassion, in her opinion, they are worthy only of a painful death.

title: Shiny dreams
description: A dark-skinned boy named Killian Maddox shares an apartment with his seriously ill veteran grandfather and works at a grocery store near the house. But the hero's most cherished dream is to shine on stage and be a bodybuilding star. Not being able to cope with his own emotions and control the anger that bursts out, the poor man even received a court order. He is forced to attend social therapy sessions. He expels the accumulated anger in frantic training, subjecting the body to colossal loads. Emotional and physical overstrain can provoke irreversible consequences. The use of steroids has a detrimental effect on health, but Killian flatly refuses to stop there. An obsession turns into an obsession. But will the hero be able to turn his dream into reality or will he bitterly regret not being able to retreat in time?

title: Side effect / Side effects
description: When Emily's husband was behind bars, her life fell apart. Stability and comfort turned into chaos and loneliness. The walls of the house have become tight, and the days are endlessly long without his presence nearby. After four years of trials, the man is released, but for Emily it does not become salvation. Depressive thoughts cover her, making her feel hopeless and helpless. She looks for a way out of the impasse and finds it in a new drug that promises to change everything. No longer listening to the psychotherapist, she decides to trust her inner voice and try the unknown, hoping for the best.

title: The most exotic hotel "Merigold"
description: The film tells the story of a group of British retirees who decided to "go to rest" in less expensive and much more exotic India. Lured by advertising for the restored Marigold Hotel and anticipating a life of pleasure and idleness, they arrive, only to discover that the hotel is, in fact, a pale shadow of its former glory. But despite the fact that the surrounding environment is far from the luxury they imagined, joint adventures irreversibly change each of them, and they realize that you can start living anew and find love if you let go of the past ... The movie "The Most Exotic Hotel "Marigold" (2011) will be enjoyed by all fans of romantic and melodramatic comedies in Ukrainian.

title: Love is evil
description: Marvin Gable succeeds in his career as a realtor, working in a prestigious suburb of Milwaukee. His life seems exemplary, full of success and confidence. But one day he is faced with an unexpected outrage to his peaceful existence: he receives a letter from Rose, the woman he once betrayed, leaving for certain death. In the letter, she informs that Marvin is being watched by his brother Knuckles, who is engaged in criminal activities. From this moment on, Marvin will have to face the reality of his past. Despite his outward respectability and success in his work, he hid his connection with dark affairs from everyone. The discovery of his true identity leads to a series of complex trials that endanger his career and personal safety.

title: Honey in the head
description: Old veterinarian Amandus Rosenbach is having a hard time coping with the death of his wife, with whom he lived a long, happy life. Against the background of grief, the old man's Alzheimer's disease gradually progresses, he loses his memory and often does not recognize those around him. His son Niko brings his father to his house, but despite love and care, the old man causes a lot of constant trouble. Daughter-in-law Sara constantly feels a wary expectation of a sudden disaster, because the poor father-in-law forgets to turn off the gas and puts books in the refrigerator. However, granddaughter Tilda devotedly loves her grandfather and is ready to spend all her free time with him, listening to fascinating stories with pleasure. One day, looking at an album with photos of her young grandmother, the girl learns that it was in Venice that her family's successful story began and immediately suggests that her grandfather go to the place where he was so incredibly happy. A couple secretly runs away to make a trip full of difficulties and adventures to the most beautiful city in Italy. Niko and Sara, worried about the safety of their loved ones, immediately set off after the fugitives, not yet knowing what miracle awaits them ahead.

title: Comatose
description: A group of talented but overly daring science college students embark on an extreme experiment that goes far beyond the boundaries of formal science. Their goal is to find out what happens after death, and for this they voluntarily agree to a risky experiment: under the supervision of professionals, they are immersed in a state of clinical death. Bodies remain motionless, and consciousness goes beyond the boundaries of the real world, into a space where the usual laws of nature do not apply. They do not suspect that a trip to the afterlife can leave an imprint not only on the soul, but also on the physical state - with consequences that cannot be predicted. After returning to life, everything changes. Teenagers, who at first perceived the experiment as a scientific adventure, face a series of terrible events that begin to destroy their psyche and threaten their lives. The feeling that something is following them becomes a reality, and the manifestations of the unknown become more and more aggressive. The secret they were trying to uncover turns out to be too dangerous, and now each of them must find a way to save themselves not only from the other world, but also from themselves. The experiment, which was supposed to answer the eternal question, turns into a struggle for life.

title: In search of light
description: After a terrifying fall that leaves 13-year-old Max with no memory, his life changes dramatically. The reality he once knew no longer has clear boundaries, and now every day for him is an attempt to assemble his own identity from the fragments of an unknown past. Everything that used to seem ordinary now turns into a mystery that the boy tries to solve, embarking on a dangerous journey to himself. In this battle for lost memories, he tries to reveal not only the facts of his life, but also to understand more deeply - who he was, who he is now and who he wants to become. The echoes of the past become more and more vivid, but at the same time more disturbing. Max begins to question whether these memories are really his, or if someone has tampered with his past, twisting the details, erasing the truths and leaving only fragments? Time is pressing, and with each step towards the truth, something is revealed that the young hero may not be ready for.

title: Love is timeless
description: An American woman named Chelsea, while in England on official business and studying an ancient, legendary estate as a potential object for a profitable real estate investment, while inspecting the basement rooms, notices inexplicable and mysterious lights coming from the very depths. Going down to the basement, she is surprised to discover a strange passage, like a window leading to the distant past, namely the end of the 18th century, where she sees a wonderful picture: an elegant and aristocratic owner of the manor, busy with his affairs. A completely unexpected incident that happened at that moment leads to the fact that this gentleman, whose name is Charles, mysteriously enters the modern world.

title: Adventures of Paddington in Peru
description: The cheerful and restless bear cub, who was named Paddington, became an integral part of the Brown family. Once lost and lonely, it found its home and true support among new loved ones. Now this friendly family embarks on a far-flung and adventurous journey to Peru to fulfill the bear cub's dream of visiting his own Aunt Lucy. The road promises to be difficult: harsh tests in the mysterious Amazon jungle, climbs to the sky-high peaks of the Andes and encounters with many dangers await. But despite all the difficulties, Paddington and his family are ready to overcome any obstacles for this touching meeting. After all, ahead of them is a reunion that will be remembered forever.

title: Franz
description: The action of the film takes place in 1919 in Germany. Anna is a young girl living in a small provincial town who mourns her beloved Franz, who died during the First World War in France. The parents of the deceased provide her with enormous support, but this does not make her any easier. Anna made huge plans for their future together, and now she can only visit him at the cemetery, where one day she meets a mysterious guy. This is the comrade-in-arms of the deceased - the Frenchman Adrian Rivoir. He perfectly understands that it is not desirable for him to appear in the town, since the local residents see him as an enemy who had a hand in Franz's death. His appearance turns Anna's life upside down, and also reveals many secrets, the existence of which the girl did not even suspect... The film "Franz" (2016) will be enjoyed by all fans of military and historical dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: Another person
description: In the center of the plot is a young actor named Edward, who lives in noisy and multifaceted New York. His dreams of a brilliant career and sincere love push him to decisive action. Trying to become more attractive to casting directors and others, he makes a serious decision to change his appearance with radical surgery. Throwing off the shackles of his former life, Edward feels that his dream is finally beginning to come true. However, when the joy of his new appearance comes to him, he is faced with a reality that turns out to be far from as bright as he had hoped. A dark enlightenment comes when Edward loses the role in which he has invested all his soul and effort. His desire for success turns into an obsession, and he furiously searches for ways to get back what was taken from him. The inner struggle of the hero intensifies, and with it questions arise about true identity, about what it means to be loved and accepted. To make matters worse, he realizes that he may have lost not only his career, but the very essence of who he was. Edward finds himself on the edge, and his obsession becomes his worst enemy.

title: Cleaner
description: In modern London, one of the most prestigious companies organizes a large-scale gala ceremony, which gathers hundreds of guests - managers, investors, employees and service personnel. The celebration, which was supposed to be a demonstration of success and prosperity, is interrupted by a brutal attack. A group of armed extremists seizes the building, turning the event into an arena of terror. They state that their goal is to expose a global corruption conspiracy involving the owners of the corporation. The situation becomes increasingly tense - the invaders threaten mass murder, and any attempt to escape may cost the lives of the hostages. Among those present, by chance, is a former military man who left the service a long time ago, but now he is forced to join the battle again. He is the only hope of salvation for those who find themselves in a deadly trap. Will he be able to stop the terrorists and get people out alive while they are only minutes away from disaster?

title: Fyre Rises / Fyre's Rebellion
description: Richard Fire leads the life of a pacifist, does not enter into conflicts and resolves all disagreements exclusively peacefully. But the debts piled up on Richard force him to look back at the mercenary's past, with whom Richard so wanted to tie the knot. An extremely outrageous personality looms on the horizon of events, who immediately takes an interest in Richard - Priest makes him a risky offer in exchange for very transparent conditions. Richard just has to eliminate a couple of people who interfere with his life, and in return he will receive a complete clearing of his name and past. Richard agrees to a crazy offer, not even suspecting that the flames of his past will be stronger than the pure urge to clear his name. Richard once again goes through all the stages that once led him to the business of a mercenary, realizes himself and tries to keep his core in himself until the end, but the tests that fell to his fate are not so simple... Fire realizes himself at the point of no return and, not wanting to come to terms with his past, which cannot be washed away by another sin, rebels against his own mind and breaks the system built by his pacifism.

title: Sex, marriage, murder
description: What to do if you suspect that your boyfriend is a real maniac? The main character is faced with this troubling question as more and more evidence leads her to believe that one of the men she is dating may be a brutal killer. An elusive maniac is at work in the city, because of which the residents live in constant fear. The police are powerless: the criminal is always one step ahead of them, and his actions cannot be predicted. The atmosphere in the city becomes so tense that some people begin to leave their homes. However, why exactly did the heroine decide that one of her suitors was involved in these terrible crimes? Are her suspicions based on something real, or is it just a play of imagination fueled by fear and the unknown? She has her own system of logic, and although the situation seems hopeless, the girl is determined to get to the truth. But can she do it without putting herself in mortal danger? What if her fears are not unfounded, and the maniac really chose her as his next victim? This tangled story turns into a real game with fate, because every decision can be the last. The main character decides to go to the end to find out if her suspicions are true or if it is just a coincidence that could cost her life.

title: Thieves 2: Panther
description: After completing a difficult case, an experienced and ambitious policeman nicknamed Big Nick goes to Europe, where he stumbles upon the trail of a dangerous criminal, Donnie Wilson. This criminal genius is preparing to implement another plan for a large-scale robbery, and Nick intends to prevent his plan at any cost. However, the situation quickly becomes complicated when a ruthless mafia enters the game, ready to do anything to achieve its goal. Big Nick finds himself drawn into a web of deadly intrigue, where every step can be the last. A criminal group is planning a robbery of the largest diamond exchange, and now Nick must gather all his strength, skills and years of experience to stop the criminals. Faced with a skillfully organized opponent who is always several steps ahead, the policeman realizes that the game is at the limit of his capabilities. Time is running out inexorably, and the danger is growing. The enemy is preparing to strike a decisive blow, trying to neutralize the steadfast pursuer. Great Nick, regardless of the risk to his life, confidently goes to the goal, ready to fight to the last to stop the activities of criminals. However, his enemies are cunning and ruthless, and the slightest mistake can be fatal. Will he be able to stop the criminal group and not become another victim of this dangerous game?

title: Little things of life
description: The action of the film takes place in 1985 in a small Irish town. Bill Furlong, who is engaged in the sale of coal and is a caring family man, is preparing for the most intense period of his career. A few weeks before Christmas, he brings coal to a local monastery and unexpectedly becomes a witness of shocking events taking place outside its walls. During his observations, Bill gets acquainted with the "Magdalene laundries" - institutions created at monasteries, where women who find themselves in a difficult life situation end up. These institutions, hidden from the public, become a kind of prison for those who have faced difficult circumstances. Awareness of this secret forces Bill to reconsider his views on life and relationships with others, as well as to think about questions of justice and humanity.

title: Bob Dylan: A complete stranger
description: The story in question immerses us in the creative path of one of the most influential musicians of the 20th century - Bob Dylan, who in the mid-1960s managed not only to win the hearts of millions, but also to change the musical landscape of his era. In 1965, he could already be considered a symbol of his generation, a real idol of folk music, capable of raising deep social and cultural issues in his works. The breakthrough was the album "Bringing It All Back Home", which presented listeners with a new sound that mixes elements of folk and rock. This transition was not only an important step in his career, but also caused significant changes in the perception of music by a wide audience, opening new horizons for the genre. However, the real revolution came with Dylan's first electric concert, which caused both delight and indignation among his fans. The change from acoustic sound to more aggressive electric rock caused a stormy reaction, and Dylan had to face a feverish confrontation between old and new fans. Despite the criticism, the artist did not retreat, on the contrary, he attracted the attention of an even larger audience, strengthening his position on the music scene. Thus, Bob Dylan became not only an icon, but also a symbol of the changes experienced by the world in which he lived and created, opening a new chapter in the history of music.

title: Ghost trap
description: Young lobsterman Jamie's life is turned upside down in an instant after a tragedy occurs aboard a boat when his girlfriend is seriously injured. From this moment on, his entire existence is reduced to one thing - to return her to a normal life. He fights for its restoration, sparing neither time nor effort, and gradually loses control over his own destiny. The fishing business that was once a pillar of life is threatened by a dangerous confrontation with another clan, leading to a brutal struggle for control of the waters. Things are further complicated when Jamie unexpectedly develops feelings for another girl, finding himself in a moral trap. Torn between loyalty and new feelings, he faces an inner conflict as he tries to find the right path in a world where justice seems illusory. Meanwhile, the competitors do not stop - his traps are destroyed, and the tension grows every day. And now Jamie must make difficult decisions to save not only business and love, but also himself, before it's too late.

title: The Jenny Pen Rule
description: An influential and determined retired judge finds himself in a quiet boarding house, where he becomes an accidental participant in a mysterious game played by one of the other residents. This man believes that he has met the most dangerous opponent in his entire life. The stakes in the game are constantly rising, and the ingenuity of the enemy rapidly reduces the chances of salvation, turning a peaceful boarding house into a place of terrible trials. At stake is not only his reputation, but also his life. The judge is forced to use all his intellectual and strategic skills to unravel the plans of the mysterious rival and find a way to get out of this deadly trap. Every decision he makes can be fatal, and his trust in his own instincts is severely tested.

title: Dangerous Henry: The Movie
description: This film takes us into the world of Henry Hart, played by Jace Norman. Henry leaves behind his adventure-filled days as Dangerous Little and becomes a local hero in the dystopian city of Dystopia. His life is now full of privilege and admiration from fans, including photo shoots, interviews and public appearances. The bright lights of fame eclipse the peaceful life he once knew in Swellview. Suddenly, his world changes with the arrival of Missy Martin, a devoted fan who enthusiastically admires Henry. Missy is extraordinary: she has a keen sense of every aspect of Henry's life and is sure that she can "help" him cope with the pressure of fame. But Missy's methods turn out to be far from ordinary, and her interference becomes a source of trouble for Henry. Faced with internal contradictions, Henry tries to decide whether he will remain true to his heroic alter ego or return to his old life. With Missy determined to make him an even brighter star, Henry finds himself in a difficult position trying to keep the qualities that made him a hero. He is faced with a choice that will determine his future and must figure out if he will remain who he always thought he was.

title: The Jungle Book
description: A two-year-old boy accidentally gets lost in the jungle, but not only survives, but also becomes a strong young man. Mowgli is rescued from Shere Khan by a family of wolves who accept a human cub into their pack. Now Mowgli is brought up according to wolf laws on a par with all wolf cubs. However, the boy still has a human mind, which helps him survive in the difficult conditions of the jungle and stand out among the other members of the pack. Over the years, the little boy becomes a strong and brave young man who knows all the laws of the jungle, but he cannot get out of his head an irrepressible tiger named Sher Khan. The boy leaves the wolf family, but meets new friends in the form of the graceful panther Bagheera, the good-natured bear Baloo, the python Kaa and the orangutan King Louie. Will Mowgli, with the help of his friends, be able to cope with the sworn enemy?

title: Bridget Jones: In love with a boy
description: Continuation of the well-known story about a successful and independent woman who is forced to start a new chapter of her life. Having lost her beloved husband during a dangerous mission, she once again found herself alone with herself, trying to cope with loneliness and the burden of responsibility for children. Despite all efforts to be a perfect mother, fatigue and the feeling of emptiness do not recede. In search of even the slightest consolation, she decides to give herself a chance at new happiness and installs a dating app. Now her days are filled with an endless search for someone who can give long-forgotten feelings and bring joy back into life. Having almost lost hope, she unexpectedly comes across a profile of a young man who instantly catches her attention. He does not seem to be the one she was looking for, but you can't tell the heart. Under pressure from her family, who insist that it is time to move on, she plucks up the courage and agrees to the meeting, not even imagining the changes that await her.

title: List of goals
description: Five scientists announce sensational news — they have succeeded in creating a revolutionary cure for cancer. The whole world freezes in anticipation, but instead of recognition and glory, the researchers face the dark side of big business. The quiet life of the heroes is destroyed in an instant - their discovery becomes a threat to powerful pharmaceutical corporations that are not ready to lose billions of profits. The real hunt begins. Three project participants are brutally killed, and the two who manage to survive have to flee, hiding not only from the killers, but also from the law enforcement officers. After all, now they are the main suspects. The investigation believes that a conflict arose within the team over control of the opening, which led to bloody massacres. But the truth is much scarier: in the shadow of influence and ruthless capital, the fate of those who dared to change the world is decided.

title: The perfect predator
description: A small passenger plane crashes in the picturesque forests of Louisiana. Now, without communication or help, the surviving passengers face a real threat. Mobile communication is unavailable, and the only route to salvation is a dangerous path through a swampy area that has become home to aggressive alligators. These predators are characterized by high mobility and an excellent appetite, which makes the situation even more tense. Making their way through dense thickets and swamps, the heroes face dangers at every step. Every movement can attract the attention of predators, and they have no time to think. Each of them must rely on their own strength and ingenuity to survive this difficult challenge. There is atmospheric silence around, disturbed only by the sounds of wild nature, which emphasize the seriousness of their situation. Time is against them, and only courage and determination can lead to salvation from this dangerous place.

title: The royal tide
description: On a remote island, where life is slow and measured, the head of the village discovers a child on the shore with amazing supernatural abilities. Local residents, stunned by this phenomenon, conclude that the boy was sent to them to fulfill an important spiritual mission. A cult instantly forms around him, and people begin to revere him as a divine being. They believe that his presence will bring them prosperity and protection from all troubles. Worshiping the child quickly becomes the center of village life. Residents change their customs and rituals to express their devotion and belief in her divine purpose. While most believe unconditionally in her sanctity, some begin to doubt and search for the truth about the child's origins and her true powers. These searches lead to the revelation of disturbing secrets that could change the lives of the community forever.

title: Explosion in Oklahoma City: American nightmare
description: An impressive and deeply emotional film that reconstructs with painful accuracy the events of one of the most terrible acts of domestic terror in the history of the United States - the explosion of the federal building in Oklahoma in 1995. What started as a normal day in the city center instantly turned into hell when a powerful bomb detonated, claiming almost two hundred lives. Unsuspecting civilians became the victims of a pre-planned attack that destroyed not only the building, but also the peace of many families. The film reveals the gruesome details of this crime, showing not only its mechanics, but also the psychological prerequisites behind the attacker's decision. Through footage of archival records, eyewitness accounts and painful stories of the victims, the viewer gets into the very essence of the tragedy, which has forever left a mark in the national memory. The day became a symbol of a deep wound that changed the country's political and security landscape, reminding the world of the fragility of peaceful life and the cost of human cruelty.

title: Hostage in the Apple store
description: In the heart of Amsterdam, a real-life suspenseful story unfolds when a gunman breaks into a customer service center, turning an ordinary day into a real nightmare. Inspired by the shocking events of 2022, the film tells the story of an ordinary Bulgarian unexpectedly falling into the epicenter of a deadly threat. Accidentally trapped, he is forced to fight for his life under the crosshairs of a mentally unstable assailant who is ready to do anything to realize his dark plans. All events unfold against the backdrop of complete uncertainty, where every minute could be the last and every step fatal. Inside the building, other hostages remain, trying not to draw attention to themselves, while the special services carefully plan the release operation. The police, risking everything, try to prevent a tragedy and bring people back to safety. The story is presented through the prism of several points of view: the fearless attacker, the frightened hostages, and the rescuers who were the first to arrive on the scene.

title: The Last Showgirl / The Last Showgirl
description: A professional dancer who has devoted thirty years of her life to the stage is faced with a difficult test - her show is suddenly closed. For her, this is not just a job loss, but a painful farewell to a whole stage filled with passion, energy and dedication. Now, left without a stage, she is forced to review her own goals and look for a new destination. The past, full of bright performances, applause and achievements, remains behind, and ahead - uncertainty and the need to build the future almost from scratch. However, instead of sinking into despair, she begins to see this as a chance - an opportunity to turn the experience into a new beginning. She thinks about how to use her skills in new directions: maybe it's time to teach dance, educating a new generation of artists, or try her hand at choreography, creating her own productions. Immersion in other forms of stage art is also possible, where her sense of movement and rhythm will find a new expression. Despite the pain of change, she understands: the end of one path is only the beginning of another, and there are many exciting turns ahead of her.

title: Ghoul
description: Blake is going through a difficult period in his life when everything around him seems to be falling apart. His marriage to Charlotte is on the verge of breaking up, and the sudden disappearance of his father only worsens the situation. After the death of his father, a man inherits an old family estate in Oregon, where no one has lived for many years. Hoping to save the relationship, Blake, together with his wife and daughter, decides to move to this house where he spent his childhood. However, their journey turns into a nightmare: the car is attacked by an unknown creature, and Blake himself is mysteriously injured. Having reached the house, the family barricades the door, hoping to hide from the threat. However, the real horror is just beginning - Blake's wound awakens the beast in him, and he begins to transform into a werewolf. The lives of his loved ones are threatened, and the struggle for survival turns into a terrifying reality.

title: School of magical animals 3
description: In a cozy town, hidden from prying eyes, there is a school that enrolls children with unique abilities. That's where Ida ends up, but her adaptation to a new life turns out to be difficult. The girl feels isolated and lonely, as her magical powers have not yet manifested, which makes her an object of ridicule from her classmates. However, fate soon brings her together with Benny - the same outsider. These two find support and understanding in each other, overcoming difficulties on the way to friendship. Ida and Benny begin to discover the world of magic when their pets - a faithful fox and a wise turtle - become not only companions, but also true mentors, telling them how to cope with the problems that arise. In this school there is not only an opportunity to develop their talents, but also incredible secrets that are waiting to be revealed. There is a magical pet store in the town, where the owner, having a deep knowledge of magical creatures, shares important secrets with the children. Suddenly, a threat arises in their world - a thief appears in the school, disturbing the peace and harmony. Ida and her new friends decide to join forces to find out who is behind this crime and restore peace to their school. Each step opens new horizons of friendship and magic to them, leaving traces of hope and faith in their own strength in the hearts of the heroes.

title: Tales of Babylon / Tales of Babylon
description: In the heart of the metropolis, where life and death intertwine in a dance of cruelty and betrayal, the fates of four hired killers unexpectedly intersect. They faced an unusual task that led them to join forces: to eliminate the same goal. Although their methods differ, their goals are the same, and this creates a tense atmosphere of rivalry and mistrust. As they develop plans and strategize, it becomes apparent that not all of them trust each other, and each moves forward with their own secret intentions. In the process of carrying out the task, each of the killers reveals their true motives, and a psychological game begins in which the stakes rise significantly. Bloody skirmishes and unexpected plot twists force them to reconsider their moral principles and rethink their lives. Trapped in a trap with only one way out, they begin to realize that their own demons may be more dangerous than the target they are trying to eliminate. This intriguing conflict not only endangers their lives, but also exposes their inner contradictions, forcing them to think about the price they are willing to pay for their profession and choice.

title: Rob Peace
description: In the center of the plot is a young man named Rob, who, despite impressive academic success and a diploma from a prestigious university, finds himself a prisoner of his father's legacy. His life becomes a real test when he tries to combine the desire for a brilliant future with the dark shadows of the past, involving criminal cases. The desire to help his imprisoned father leads Rob to make risky choices, plunging him into a world full of danger and immorality. He imperceptibly finds himself involved in the drug trade, which quickly turns into not only a mistake, but also an exciting, but scary immersion in a ruthless world, where friendship can become the cause of betrayal, and moral principles are blurred. With each new step, Rob's internal conflicts become more and more acute. He begins to understand that his decisions can have devastating consequences not only for him, but also for his loved ones. When he finds himself in a situation where every action requires a difficult choice, he is faced with the inability to determine what is good and what is evil. Increasing pressure from the environment and his own fears call into question his desire for redemption. Against this background, the drama unfolds about how our actions shape our destiny, emphasizing the importance of responsibility for our own decisions and the impact they have on the lives of others.

title: The flight has taken off
description: We meet a professional mercenary who is used to taking on risky tasks. Another mission forces a man to drop everything and buy a ticket on a passenger plane. There is a person on board who needs to be killed as soon as possible. At first, it seemed to the mercenary that he would complete the task without noise and dust, but the appearance of dangerous competitors turns everything upside down. Realizing that death threatens them both, the killer and his victim join forces. In order to repel numerous opponents, the boys have to become a team and postpone their conflict until better times. Will the heroes be able to cope with the enemies and not endanger ordinary passengers? Or is the plane destined to reach its destination? Crazy events are coming that will make the mercenary remember all his skills and talents.

title: Fallen leaves
description: In Helsinki at night, dusk merged with the lights of the city, creating an atmosphere of mystery and romance. In this world of loneliness and longing, two hearts, lost in the hustle and bustle of the city, meet by chance, like stars in the sky, remaining bright spots in the darkness. They did not know that they were looking for each other until their paths crossed. Their eyes met in an instant, filling their hearts with warmth and hope. Together they went in search of their first and last love, overcoming obstacles and tests of fate. In their arms, they found comfort and understanding, finding strength and faith in happiness.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
description: In a world where changes are constantly taking place, life does not stop moving forward. Some destinies end and others begin, and in this cyclical flow there is always room for new conflicts and disputes. Humanity more than once finds reasons for disagreements, and to protect those who cannot protect themselves, real heroes always come to the rescue. They are guardians of justice, law and order, ensuring peace in this ruthless and changing world. Despite all efforts to ensure security, enemies always appear, ready to implement their plans and create new threats to the planet. And although humanity has long understood the importance of defenders, sometimes even the greatest heroes cannot avoid unexpected challenges.

title: A tempting offer
description: Unmanned devices are taking the lead in the military industry, representing the lion's share of innovative developments that can bring tangible benefits on the battlefield. Reaper manages to practice flawlessly with such machines. The man understands the art of operating machines and can help his comrades from the control room.
