The next shift begins for him with ordinary events. The calm atmosphere allows you to monitor the situation in a relaxed mode, and watch a basketball match at the same time. Suddenly, the observer becomes an eyewitness to the emergence of a high-level freelance threat. A group of fighters led by young Kinney is in danger. The unit finds itself in a catastrophic situation in the Philippines. Surprised fighters cannot get out of the trap, but reinforcements will not be sent to them. The operation is on the verge of a fatal breakdown, and the members of the squad risk dying in enemy territory. Soon, a drone appears above the captives of the region, which facilitates their emergency evacuation from the trap.

title: A dark legacy
description: The rich and very influential father of the family dies suddenly. According to the plot of the film "Dark Legacy", his wife and daughter begin to understand the legacy he left behind. Plunging into her father's past, the girl learns about the will left for her alone. However, she does not suspect that she will soon face the truth, which will become a threat to her entire family. It turns out that the man led a not entirely honest lifestyle during his life and all his wealth was earned illegally. But whether the widow and her daughter will be able to figure it all out remains a question, the answer to which can only be obtained by viewing. The film "Dark Legacy" (2020) will be enjoyed by all fans of dramatic thrillers in Ukrainian.

title: Dirty dancing
description: The summer of 1963 was filled with exciting events for 17-year-old Frances, known as Baby. She went to rest with her parents in a luxurious resort hotel and there she met the mysterious Johnny - a charming professional dancer. The charm and passion of dirty dancing seemed to enchant the girl, making her forget about everything except momentary emotions and unique love. Under rhythmic music and enchanting movements, Johnny and Baby become inseparable in dances and in each other's hearts. They become a student and a mentor, partners and lovers, plunging into the world of passion and tenderness. A summer full of love and dancing will leave unforgettable memories in their hearts that will warm their souls for a lifetime.

title: Operation "Black Case"
description: The Wodehouse family gained wide fame in their country, because their life was devoted to the service of the state. George is a legendary intelligence agent who for many years carried out complex and secret operations, protecting the interests of his country. His wife, Catherine, is also a highly skilled agent who has worked side-by-side with her husband in tasks that required impeccable skill and dedication. But their established world is shattered when Catherine finds herself under suspicion of treason. How can a person who has been risking his life for the sake of the country's security for years turn out to be a double agent? George is faced with a difficult choice: to believe the woman he loves or to trust the evidence that speaks against her. Caught between loyalty and duty, he is forced to make a decision that will determine not only his future fate, but also the future of the country.

title: Another shot
description: This is a tense action movie with elements of a thriller, which tells the story of a simple worker from a workshop, whose life turned upside down after events that, like lightning, pierced his peaceful and calm life. In everyday life, the boy was extremely neat: his superiors would not say a bad word about him, and he himself was very decent and punctual. But is it really that clean? It turns out that he managed to hide the subtleties of his personal life very delicately. All his secrets of the deep past, the love of his life and the deception of people close to him - all this was reliably hidden under a pile of lies, skillfully constructed thanks to the intellect and a hanging tongue. However, trouble comes from an unexpected place: a stranger on the Internet somehow knows too much about the main character's life, but most importantly - from where? Who thought of "digging" under an ordinary worker and even more so blackmailing him? The stranger is not asking for money or something worse, he is just informing with details, but how long will he keep this manner of dialogue?

title: Conclave
description: In an atmosphere filled with religious awe and political tension, every step counts. Lawrence must maintain order, prevent leaks, and prevent internal conflicts or disputes from disrupting the sacred process. However, as events unfold, he discovers the shocking truth hidden behind the facade of the Pope's death. The secret revealed by the cardinal not only casts a shadow over the past of the pontiff, but can also change the course of the vote and affect the fate of the entire Catholic world. It turns out that this truth directly affects one or more potential candidates for the throne, which leaves Lawrence with a difficult choice between faith, duty and truth.

title: I'm still here / I'm still here
description: In 1971, in the very heart of authoritarian Brazil, a former deputy and outspoken opponent of the military dictatorship was forcibly removed from his home in Rio de Janeiro without any explanation. The authorities said only that he should testify - after which the man disappeared without a trace. Neither his wife, nor his children, nor his friends ever found out what happened that day: whether he was arrested, executed, or simply disappeared in the shadows of government structures that knew how to hide the truth as quickly as they removed its bearers. This deeply personal and at the same time political drama is based on the memoirs of Marcelo Rubens, the son of a missing man. It tells not only of the pain of loss, but also of the continuous struggle of his mother, Eunice, who for decades has not stopped looking for answers, defying the system. Her path is an example of the indomitable strength of a woman who refused to put up with a lie.

title: OK
description: After the death of his father, the writer Lui returns to his hometown. At first, he came with a purely practical purpose — to collect things from his parents' house. However, the very atmosphere of familiar streets, memories of his former life and unexpected meetings with people from the past evoke deep emotions in him, forcing him to relive those feelings that were once carefully hidden in his memory. With each new conversation, Louis begins to realize how much his work was permeated with fragments of real stories - the pain, joys and secrets of other people.

title: Turkish fruits / Turkish delights
description: Dutch sculptor Eric accidentally meets Olga, a charming, spontaneous and emotional girl who instantly captures his heart. Passion quickly flares up between them, and without wasting time, the couple decides to get married. However, not everyone is happy with this news: Olga's mother, a woman with strict views and a strong character, believes from the very beginning that Eric is too frivolous and will not be able to provide her daughter with a stable future. And later, these fears begin to come true: jealousy, misunderstandings and personal ambitions split the marriage that once seemed ideal. After the divorce, Eric tries to move on, and even numerous novels and attention from other women cannot drown out his feelings for Olga. Time passes, but the image of his beloved does not leave his heart. And when their paths unexpectedly cross again, a familiar spark ignites in the air. However, the long-awaited meeting takes place under difficult and painful circumstances, which make them both think about what they lost and whether it is possible to return it.

title: Code "Black Canary"
description: The carefree life of Avery Graves passes calmly, giving many unforgettable moments. The chosen one becomes her support, adds confidence, inspires to implement interesting projects. The happy couple is building a spacious, cozy house, planning future purchases and trips. A sudden tragic turn forces you to abandon your former priorities for the sake of survival. Terrorists send a threatening message to a woman. The attackers claim that her husband has been kidnapped, is in terrible conditions of captivity and needs immediate help. The only chance to return the hostage alive remains the undisputed fulfillment of the terrible demands. Criminals act cold-bloodedly and do not give the interlocutor time to think. She needs to betray the interests of the state and her own professional oaths in order to reunite with her husband. Blackmailers force you to discard morality, concepts of loyalty and honor for the sake of love. A distraught wife is on edge when she is presented with such a painful choice.

title: Charisma killers / Charismatic killers
description: In a small town, where life flows measuredly, seven mercenaries with unusual characters gather for an unexpected reason. Their old mentor, a man with an iron will and strict principles, delivers the shocking news - he has only a few months left to live. However, instead of being sad, he challenges his students. He offers them to fulfill his last task - to carry out a series of acts of revenge against those who have long deserved punishment. Each of the seven mercenaries has his own style and motivation. One acts with cold calculation, the other - like an artist, turning every thing he does into a real show. The third is obsessed with the idea of ​​justice, the fourth seeks to atone for his past sins. These different approaches create tension in the group, but the common cause unites them, forcing them to work together. In the process of completing the task, old grudges and personal secrets surface that threaten to destroy their fragile alliance. As the night draws to a close, and the goals are almost achieved, the mercenaries realize that their mission was not only revenge. It became a chance for each of them to deal with the past and find something more than just skill in themselves. Not everyone lives to see the dawn, but everyone leaves their mark in the history of this gloomy night.

title: Sheriff
description: The story follows the main character nicknamed "The Sheriff", whose full name is Sheriffuddin Hussain. He is a deputy superintendent of police, sent by his superiors to investigate the activities of a group of police officers in the department. Among them is inspector Nazri, his sister, police officer Syazlin and fellow policeman Faruk. Along with newly transferred Assistant District Attorney Jennifer Wong, the Sheriff is determined to uncover the true identity of the "Methamphetamine Dealer Killer."

title: The way, my way
description: Bill is a middle-aged man who has long since lost his sense of joy and purpose in his own life. His days were similar to each other: a job that had long ceased to bring satisfaction, an empty relationship that was only a shadow of its former warmth, and an endless stream of grayness that suffocated from within. He felt himself a prisoner of his own routine, as if locked in an invisible cage where even time seemed frozen. But one evening, while aimlessly flipping pages on the Internet, Bill came across stories about the Camino de Santiago pilgrimage route, a path that gave hope to thousands of lost souls. Stories of spiritual discoveries, encounters with oneself, and cleansing from the past touched something deep in his heart. And that's when he made a decision that would change everything. Having put only the most necessary things in his backpack, Bill left the usual world behind and set off on a journey of 800 kilometers through the magical landscapes of Spain. This path turned out to be not only a physical test, but also a journey to one's own self. Along the route, he met a wide variety of fellow travelers — from former businessmen who fled the glitter of a successful career in search of peace of mind, to young seekers of meaning who were just beginning to understand themselves. Each meeting brought a new experience, each story echoes other people's pains and hopes. And although each of them had their own motive for the pilgrimage, they all had one thing in common - the desire to find a true life.

title: The mystery of fire
description: Brothers Geisel and Jody, along with their friend Alice, decide to bake a berry pie to help their sick mother. According to the magical recipe, you need a special speckled egg to make the treats. However, when they arrive at the store, it turns out that the last box of such eggs was bought by a mysterious stranger. Without thinking, the friends decide to go in search of him in order to get the necessary ingredient for their pie. On their way, they meet Alice - a fairy of fire, who has a deep knowledge of forest secrets and secrets. She willingly agrees to help the boys on their difficult journey. Together they overcome various obstacles, encounter magical creatures and discover a world full of mysteries. Each step brings them closer to their goal, and friendship becomes an important support in their endeavors.

title: I left my heart in Colombia
description: Two friends go to Medellín, Colombia, under the pretext of a friendly business trip to an acquaintance who is already waiting for them there. The main purpose of their visit is to close the financial issue. They have to meet with a person who is faced with the task of solving their debt obligations. This meeting promises to be tense, because important financial interests are at stake. On the other hand, the one to whom they owe has prepared an unexpected turn of events for all participants of the meeting. This adds unpredictability to the development of the situation and puts the friends in a situation where each of their decisions can cause new challenges. Thus, the trip promises to turn into a series of unexpected and tense events.

title: Gerald's game
description: After her husband collapses with a heart attack in the midst of intimate play, a young woman is left bedridden. But her loneliness will not last long. All the fears that she has ever felt in her life will immediately return to the secluded house, where they instantly turned into a sinister torture chamber. The movie "Gerald's Game" (2017) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and thriller films in Ukrainian.

title: Destroy Them / End of Grazing
description: Michael is the last son of a shepherd family who takes care of Ray's sick father. He lives in complete isolation, hiding a terrible secret that does not give him peace. One day, Michael faces a conflict with a rival phenimist, Gary, and his son, Jack. This conflict causes a chain reaction that leads to tragic consequences that change the lives of both families. Under the pressure of circumstances, Michael has to face the horrors of his past, and this confrontation requires courage and determination from him. New tests force him to reconsider his attitude to life, as well as to the people around him. Conflict opens not only old wounds, but also opens up new opportunities for forgiveness and understanding. As a result, Michael and his neighbors find themselves at a crossroads, and their destinies are forever intertwined, forcing each of them to think about their true values ​​and what is really important in life.

title: Mickey 17
description: Adapted to the screen, the novel by one of the most famous writers reveals to the viewer the complex history of the scientific mission. A group of scientists sets out to create a new consumable for future research and sends one of the subjects on an expedition to colonize a remote icy planet. If the subject dies, his consciousness is automatically transferred to another body to continue the mission. At first, everything goes according to plan, but one day one of the crew members begins to notice strange changes in his own perception and behavior. The realization that his experience is significantly different from previous ones and that the experiment is out of control prompts him to independently search for an answer. Scientists, worried about this failure, are trying to find a solution, but each time the situation becomes more dangerous and unpredictable. When one of the last regenerations goes awry, it appears that the entire mission may be in danger of being derailed. Now not only the success of the research, but also the lives of all participants are in question, as the situation becomes increasingly chaotic, and strange events begin to question the foundations of the scientific experiment.

title: Promised hearts
description: Niyala is an ambitious and determined young woman who dreamed of becoming a doctor since childhood. Her persistence and dedication were not in vain: later she achieves her goal and begins to work according to her calling, fully immersing herself in a responsible and at the same time noble business. Her days are filled with patient care, and each successful diagnosis seems like a small victory. However, behind the external success hides another side of life - the one about which she would prefer to remain silent. To support her family and establish stability, Niyala agreed to an arranged marriage with a man for whom she has no real feelings. At first, she thought that luxury and status compensated for the lack of love. But over time, this agreement begins to destroy her from the inside. Marriage, which at first seemed like a profitable compromise, turned into a trap, where every day is a struggle with emptiness, misunderstanding and inner pain. Family pressure, limitations in personal life and lack of sincerity become unbearable. Immersed in hopelessness, Niyala realizes that she no longer wants to put up with a fake life. She dares to take a step towards freedom - despite fear, risk and possible consequences, because true happiness is worth courage.

title: The best-selling kind of love / Love is a bestseller
description: The main character has recently gone through a divorce and, trying to leave the past behind, decides to radically change her life. She moves to sunny Miami, hoping to find a new beginning and inner peace there. At first, Stephanie has a hard time adjusting — she barely makes ends meet while trying to find a steady job. Soon, the woman receives an unexpected but attractive offer - to become a private tutor for the two young daughters of a successful architect named Harry. They quickly find a common language, and the main character begins to teach the children, bringing to their home not only knowledge, but also long-forgotten warmth, care and spiritual support. Harry's family experienced the loss of their mother, and this wound has not yet healed, so the arrival of a new woman in the house is perceived by children with suspicion and anxiety. However, over time, sincere feelings begin to emerge between Stephanie and Harry, which become more and more obvious even to those around them. The architect's daughters, fearing that their lives may change drastically again, decide not to stay away. They devise a cunning plan to get Stephanie out of the house as soon as possible and to sever any possible connection between her and their father. However, they do not yet know that something real has already begun to sprout in the hearts of adults, and even the most cunning pranks cannot always stop love.

title: Learning to love / Learning to love
description: After a painful divorce, the main character wants to start life with a clean slate. In search of new opportunities, she moves to sunny Miami, where for the first time in a long time she begins to feel inner peace and hope. Faced with financial difficulties, she accepts an attractive offer - to become a tutor for the two daughters of a successful architect, Harry. Working together quickly brings them closer, and her warm approach to learning and life gradually restores harmony to a home that has long lost its joy after the loss of their mother. However, the girls have a hard time coming to terms with the appearance of a new woman in their world. Despite the positive changes, they perceive Stephanie as a threat to the fragile peace that has finally begun to recover. And when sincere romantic feelings begin to appear between her and their father, the sisters decide to act decisively. They come up with their own plan to force the woman out of their home—before the relationship blossoms into something more that could change their family forever.

title: be my bride
description: Young and irresponsible Benoit once again finds himself in a difficult situation - debts, as always, follow on his heels. With no options and no time to think, he decides to resort to tricks and tells his rich parents that he is going to marry a model named Emily. In fact, this is not true, and Benoit expects that the news of the wedding will soften the hearts of his relatives and allow him to quickly get financial help from them. Emily agrees to the game, and everything goes according to plan, until she abruptly pulls out right before the flight to Morocco, where Benoit was supposed to introduce her to her family. Stuck at a dead end, he quickly convinces his chatty, eccentric Uber driver named Fiona to play the part of the bride. She, without thinking too much about everything, agrees that it starts a whole avalanche of absurd and funny events. Her bright, frank and wild behavior contrasts with the aristocratic manners of the Benoit family, creating many comic situations. But as the lie grows, Benoit realizes that getting out of this story is going to be a lot harder than he thought. And now he has to not only support the fiction, but also to deal with the consequences of his own imprudence.

title: Goldfinch
description: The life of a 13-year-old boy from New York is split into "before" and "after" when his mother dies in a horrific terrorist attack. He himself miraculously survives, but the loss leaves a deep mark on his soul. Soon, a wealthy family takes him under his care, trying to give him a new chance for a happy future. However, the past relentlessly pursues the boy, preventing him from forgetting the pain and losses. It would seem that he has everything to start life anew, but an unexpected impulse pushes him down a path from which it is difficult to return. Theo makes a risky act - steals a priceless work of art, which becomes for him a kind of symbol of lost harmony. But this ill-advised step opens the door to the underground world of crime, where the line between art and crime is blurred. Now he finds himself in a vortex of dangerous scams, intrigue and deception, where every wrong move can be fatal. Will the boy be able to escape from this dark labyrinth, or will he remain a part of it forever?

title: Tattoo on the heart
description: Shaw Landon, a quiet and modest student, arrives in a new town and falls into the field of vision of Rule Archer - a local bad boy, a tattooed biker with a bad reputation. A young man is used to getting everything he wants, and a girl is no exception. But she is not like former motorcycle racers. She does not give in to his charm, which further ignites his interest. Their relationship begins stormy and passionate, but full of contradictions. Rul lives one day at a time, he does not want a serious relationship. The heroine is looking for stability and true love. They quarrel, reconcile, diverge and converge again. Gradually, the hero understands that Landon is not just another girl in his list of victories. She changes him, makes him think about his life, about his future. He tries to be better for her.

title: Monkey
description: At first glance, it was just an old toy hidden in a dusty attic. But when brothers Bill and Hal accidentally find a toy monkey that once belonged to their father, they have no idea that this find will change their lives forever. Intrigued and unsuspecting, the boys take her with them, not even realizing what dark power they are awakening. At first, everything seems a coincidence - strange shadows, strange sounds, the feeling that they are being watched. But when cruel and inexplicable deaths begin to occur around, it becomes clear: this monkey is not just a toy, but an ominous tool of some terrible plan. Every day turns into a fight against an invisible horror, and the longer the brothers delay, the more they are drawn into the vortex of dark events. Now their everyday life turns into an endless nightmare, and there seems to be no way out. Their only hope is to unravel the mystery of this cursed object before it takes everything from them.

title: Companion
description: At first glance, it seems that the girl with the gun in her hands is a dangerous fan, and the boy in front of her is a defenseless victim. But the situation quickly turns: now it is he, a ruthless kidnapper, who keeps her in handcuffs, forcing her to endure his provocations, enjoying wine and food right in front of her eyes. Her attempt to escape turns out to be a fiasco - the girl is caught and rudely turned back, but even in these circumstances it is not completely clear who really has the power. In this chaotic union, where games of death and passion intertwine into a single stream, the line between fantasy and reality gradually blurs. Each of them is convinced that he is in control of the situation, but their actions turn into dangerous provocations that can have fatal consequences. The surprising and unpredictable twists and turns of their story question whether they can stop themselves before they cross the point of no return. The spark between them ignites more and more, and it is difficult to say whether it is passion or a flame that can destroy them both.

title: Rubicon
description: In 2056, the world was on the brink of extinction due to environmental pollution. Rare areas of land, where the air could still be breathed, became the object of hunting for the wealthy elites. On the Rubicon space station, scientists from different parts of the planet tried to find a solution to this problem, conducting research that could change the future of humanity. However, when communication with the command on Earth was interrupted, panic broke out on the Rubicon. A poisonous fog has engulfed the planet, forcing scientists and astronauts to fight for survival.

title: The fifth of September
description: In 1972, an American television company began to show events related to the capture of Israeli athletes during the Olympic Games in Munich. This dramatic incident, which happened at an international sports event, caused a huge response around the world. Professional journalists worked around the clock to provide up-to-date information on the situation, covering every step of the negotiations and actions of the rescue services. During this tragic event, there were many fears and tensions, which led to a large-scale discussion of security issues at international events. The reaction of government structures and the public around the world was also quite diverse - from sympathy for the victims to calls for action. These events marked an important stage in the history of the Olympic Games and had a significant impact on the perception of such events, adding elements of political tension and the need for increased security.

title: Holland
description: The life of a woman in the beautiful town of Holland, located in the state of Michigan, seems perfect and cloudless, until she discovers a shocking secret about her husband. Everything she thought was strong and reliable begins to crack at the seams when unexpected facts appear that question their relationship and trust in each other. This news becomes a real test for her inner world and life values. She is forced to reconsider not only her family, but also every moment of her life together with her husband. Anxiety and confusion overwhelm her, and now she must decide what to do next. Can she restore the broken trust? Or will this secret become an insurmountable barrier between them? Against the background of this emotional tension, the woman begins to look for answers both within herself and in their shared history, and in the end she has to make a choice that can change her life forever.

title: Professional
description: Levon Cade has long said goodbye to the past, full of dangers and dark affairs. He chose a quiet life, got a job in construction and tries to be an exemplary father to his daughter. His goal is to leave behind everything that once made him a formidable figure in the world of shadow operations and live as if it never happened. Every day, he manages to take root more and more in a new reality, where there is no place for violence and a constant struggle for survival. But the past does not let go so easily. When the daughter of his former boss disappears under mysterious circumstances, Levon realizes that he cannot stay away. Intuition tells him that the case is much more complicated than it seems, and the usual methods of investigation will not help here. Once again, he is forced back into the game using the skills he tried so hard to forget. The trail will lead him to the epicenter of a large-scale conspiracy involving powerful people and deadly threats. Now he will have to decide how far he is willing to go for justice, and if he can then return to the life he has spent so long building.

title: Banger
description: A former popular DJ, who has long since left the scene, unexpectedly finds himself at the center of a dangerous game. The police turn to him with an offer he can't refuse: to take part in a secret operation to expose a bizarre criminal group. Having no other choice, he agrees and gradually plunges into the world of intrigue, risks and dangerous investigations. At first, this mission seems simple, but the further he advances, the more he becomes entangled in the webs of a conspiracy that hides more than meets the eye. The situation gathers new momentum when the hero realizes that this whole matter is closely connected with his old rival. This discovery forces him to act even more decisively, because now he sees the mission not only as a risk, but also as an opportunity to regain his lost glory. He plans to brilliantly complete the operation, prove his superiority over the competition and once again declare himself in the world of music.

title: Soldier Jane
description: Jordan O'Neill was to become the first woman to be allowed to undergo training and become a member of the elite squad. The training takes place at a military base located in Florida. The commanders are highly demanding of the cadets, and their training methods can be called cruel. Many strong and well-trained men give up positions, unable to withstand physical and psychological stress. The statistical figures are relentless and clearly show that most of the cadets will not be able to reach the finish line.

title: Lolita
description: 1947 year. A European professor of French, Humbert Humbert, moves to the United States. He rents a room from the widow Charlotte Gaze and her daughter Lolita. This teenage girl is extremely lively and not very shy, but this is exactly what causes Humbert to develop feelings for Lolita, which scares him very much. Soon Lolita informs Humbert that her mother likes him very much and, indeed, Charlotte puts him before a choice - a wedding or he leaves her house forever. Humbert is forced to agree to the marriage because he wants to stay closer to Lolita. One day, Charlotte finds Humbert's diaries, in which he describes in detail his passion for Lolita and how much Charlotte disgusts him. Soon she dies as a result of an accident. The film "Lolita" (1997) will be enjoyed by all fans of Ukrainian dramas.

title: Passenger
description: Lately, Randy has been finding some peace in the shadows, avoiding the attention and dangers that once dogged him at every turn. It seems to him that the turbulent past is behind him. But the peace does not last long. When his long-time friend Benson unexpectedly loses control and becomes a source of rage and destruction, Randy is forced to return to the path of struggle. Torn between fears and memories, which he tried so hard to bury in the depths of his consciousness, the hero understands: escape is no longer an option. In order not to perish in this cruel maelstrom of events, he must make a painful choice and put everything he values ​​at stake. With every minute, the situation becomes more and more threatening, and ruthless reality erases the boundaries between the past and the present. Caught in the middle of a bloody disaster spiraling out of control, Randy can only rely on his own willpower and determination. Despite the terrible truth that unfolds in front of him, he must move forward, because delaying can cost his life. A once-close friend turns into a deadly threat, and now it's not just personal salvation that's at stake—it's about stopping an imminent disaster. Time is running out, and with every second the chances of survival melt away in the gloom of events that go far beyond the ordinary.

title: Portraits of dangerous women
description: Three people who have never met before meet by chance due to an unusual road accident. In the chaos of the first moments after the event, they decide to deal with the problems that have arisen on their own, without the involvement of the police. This choice leads to the emergence of unforeseen alliances between them. As events develop, it begins to appear that each of the participants has their own hidden stories and motives. As their pasts are revealed, an unexpected sense of mutual understanding and connection emerges, deepening their relationship. As a result, they find not just random acquaintances as a result of an accident, but also reliable allies in the most unexpected circumstances.

title: Jurassic Park Adventures 3: Return to the Wild
description: While filming a documentary, the team comes across a mysterious door leading to the world of dinosaurs. Here they find and catch a small dinosaur, which they decide to call Spike. Inspired by the idea of ​​fame and fortune, the members of the film crew are going to show Spike to the world, dreaming of fame and success. However, the brother and sister, Ethan and Madison, do not share the enthusiasm of the adults and begin to carefully consider the plan to save Spike. They understand that the dinosaur must return to its native habitat, and that the mysterious door must be protected to prevent possible threats to both worlds. Along with several friends, Ethan and Madison decide to join forces to bring Spike home and keep the secret of his world safe.

title: Kiss of happiness / Kiss of a loser
description: Ashley always lived under a lucky star - beauty, intelligence and charm opened all doors for her. Her career went up rapidly, her friends were always there, and luck accompanied her in everything. It seemed that nothing could destroy her perfect world, until one night she met Jake, a boy whom fortune seems to have bypassed. His life consisted of constant failures, and every step he took was accompanied by problems. However, one accidental kiss at a party changes everything. Suddenly, Ashley finds herself at the center of a series of misfortunes, and all her successes disappear as if they never happened. Meanwhile, Jake begins to feel all the magic of luck that used to belong to her. Now the girl must figure out what happened and find a way to get her luck back before she finally finds herself at the bottom. But is this possible, or is her fate already decided?

title: Rise of the Sinister Dead
description: The main character misses her sister, as she has not seen her for a long time. Beth decides to visit her. So the girl finds herself in noisy Los Angeles. Ellie lives in this metropolis and huddles in a very small apartment with three children, whom she raises alone. The girls are happy to meet and remember the past. But the situation changes when they find an unusual book where various dark rituals are described. Of course, the heroines do not really believe that spells have any power. The girls read one of them, awakening evil forces. Demons who have gained access to the human world do not know pity and compassion. They are ready to torture and kill anyone. This is how the heroines find themselves in a deadly situation that could cost them their lives. We recommend watching the film "Rise of the Sinister Dead" (2023) in Ukrainian for fans of fantasy horror films and thrillers.

title: Twilight 2. Saga: New Moon
description: "Twilight 2: The Saga: New Moon" is the continuation of the "Twilight" saga. At the birthday party, Bella accidentally injures her finger, and her blood makes Jasper so dizzy that he attacks. He is reassured, the conflict is resolved, but Edward feels guilty about Bella. He decides that the best way to protect the girl is to get out of her life. When parting, Edward says cruel words about not loving her. Bella is crushed morally. After many months, she will forget everything, her devoted Jacob helps her in this. Young people spend a lot of time together. One day, a fragment of a vision from the future comes to Alice: Bella jumps off a big cliff. She decides that the girl brought her hands on herself. Edward, learning about this and not wanting to live without her, decides to end his immortal existence with the help of the Volturi clan. He goes to his death. Will Bella be able to save her lover at the last moment? The film "Twilight 2: The New Moon" (2009) will be enjoyed by all lovers of fantasy about vampires and love.

title: soul eater
description: In a shadowy corner of the world, where old legends do not die, but live on in the mouths of local residents, disturbing events begin. A quiet village that has lived a peaceful life for a long time is suddenly enveloped in a gloomy atmosphere when one by one children begin to disappear. The ancient myth of the Eater of Souls, thought to be nothing more than a fiction to scare brawlers, suddenly begins to seem like an eerie reality. Local residents are horrified to admit that the old stories may not be so far from the truth. The arrival of two detectives from the city brings a new wave to the conversations about these strange disappearances. Skeptics by nature, they are determined to use all their skills and technology to solve this mystery, brushing off local superstitions like annoying flies. But with each new day spent searching for the missing children, they begin to encounter events that are difficult to explain logically. The evidence leads them closer and closer to the terrifying idea that the Soul Eater may indeed exist, and its thirst must be quenched somehow.

title: That's how she found me
description: A real turning point began in the life of a school teacher from Philadelphia. Everything that she dreamed of and what she was striving for, collapsed at once. Her marriage fell apart, and her adoptive mother, whom she considered her real family, passed away, leaving only a complete vacuum. And then a real mother suddenly appeared, eccentric and unpredictable, who swept through her established life like a tornado. But the most unexpected thing was the romance that broke out between the teacher and the father of one of the students. It was a forbidden fruit that could destroy everything she had built for so many years. She found herself at a crossroads where every choice could lead to irreversible consequences. And in this chaos of emotions, she had to find her way, her truth and understand what is really important in this life.

title: Closed hotel
description: The American cycling team arrives for a training camp in a quiet European town, hoping to spend time in a peaceful atmosphere surrounded by picturesque nature. But the idyll quickly turns to horror when a thick fog appears over the city, bringing death to all who dare to enter it. In a panic, the athletes look for shelter and eventually find an old hotel on the outskirts, which seems to be the only safe place. However, even here they do not manage to feel relief, because the situation is becoming more and more dire every hour. While darkness reigns outside, something even more terrifying begins to spread inside the hotel - a mysterious disease affecting the team members. Some are losing strength, others are behaving more and more strangely, and the atmosphere is intensifying, turning their shelter into a trap. Suspicion, fear and panic are growing, because no one knows what is really happening. Not only will they have to find a way to escape, but they will also have to decide if they can trust each other as the fog gradually drags them into limbo.

title: The season of evil
description: A group of experienced detectives is on the trail of a serial killer whose activities lead them to an abandoned psychiatric hospital. They hope this will be just another incident in their careers, but things quickly take a terrifying turn. The maniac, who leads the game a few steps ahead, turns out to be not just a criminal, but a brilliant manipulator who defeats even the most experienced of them.Finding themselves in the premises where dangerous patients once stayed, the heroes begin to feel that behind all the tracks is not just a killer, but something much more creepy and complex. Time becomes their main enemy, because every moment can become fatal.

title: Twig
description: Dublin is drowning in blood and lawlessness, where criminal gangs leave no room for peace. Every day is a new shootout, another act of violence, another broken destiny. In this chaos lives young Twig, who has long since lost faith in the future. She dreams of a life without shots, without fear and a constant struggle for survival. But her own brother is at the head of one of the most dangerous gangs, and this makes her a hostage to a cruel world from which there seems to be no way out. Every day she wakes up in anxiety, feeling that at any moment she can lose everything. As the city shuddered again from the brutal attack, Twig realizes that he can't wait any longer. She decides to run, hoping to escape from this hell, but the cruel reality quickly brings her back. The tragedy that unfolds after another wave of violence forces the girl to forget about fear. She is no longer the helpless victim she once was. Her heart burns with hatred, and now her only goal is revenge. She will challenge the most dangerous figure in this ruthless world - Queen Leona. And this time nothing will stop her.

title: Nightmare in Argus
description: Fear is spreading in Los Angeles - a mysterious serial killer, nicknamed the Wet Slasher, mercilessly preys on women, leaving only chaos and panic in his wake. Meanwhile, Millie Barker, a talented but unhappy stand-up comedian, is going through a difficult time in her life. Once she was one step away from winning a popular reality show that could change her fate, but an unfair expulsion from the competition forced her to flee her own failures to the remote desert town of Argus. Years of rejection and bitterness have fueled her thirst for revenge, and now she's hatching a daring plan to kidnap the wife of the show's producer who ruined her chances of success. But what started as a personal vendetta quickly spirals out of control. In the dark and strange Argus, the paths of Milly, her victim Andrea and the cruel Regina Worthington intertwine in an unpredictable knot, where the sinister Slasher has already set his traps. The town becomes a stage for true chaos, where jokes turn into screams, and comedy turns into a struggle for survival. In this maelstrom of danger, everyone has their own motivations, but no one knows who will be the next target in this terrifying spectacle.

title: My dead friend Zoe
description: A female veteran who went through the ordeal of the war in Afghanistan leads a life filled with memories of her best friend in the service, who was tragically killed. Their connection remains mysterious and deep, and she continues to feel his presence in her life. Fate brings her to the ancestral nest near a picturesque lake, where she meets her grandfather - a veteran of the Vietnam War. This meeting becomes a turning point that opens the door to the past and allows you to look at your own experiences in a new way. In a conversation with her grandfather, she finds not only support, but also many questions related to lost lives and their memory. Their conversation awakens in her thoughts about the sacrifices that have been made on the altar of war, as well as how history repeats itself from generation to generation. This interaction helps the woman understand how important it is to remember the past in order to move forward, accepting her fears and losses. In the end, she realizes that despite heroism and loss, true strength lies in being able to move on and find new hope.

title: My mother stole my life
description: Susan finds herself in a desperate situation when her life turns into a real nightmare. She is forced to look for a way out in order to escape from the pursuer who does not give her peace. Having no other choice, the woman decides to take the risky step of adopting the identity of her daughter, with whom she has long lost contact. Believing that this is the only way to hide from danger, Susan realizes that her decision could have serious consequences. However, the fear of the future forces her to act, because every day in her real life could be her last. However, even after changing her personality, she does not get the expected peace. The further she runs away, the more problems arise on her way. Her past continues to haunt her, and the man she tried to escape from eventually comes back to haunt her. Finding herself in even greater danger than before, Susan realizes that there is no escaping fate. Now she will not only have to fight for her life, but also face the consequences of her decision, which may turn out to be even more terrible than the pursuer.

title: Adventures of Paddington 2
description: In the second part, the bear, who came to England from the sleepy forests of Peru in search of a new family, lives cheerfully and carefree in the Browns' house. Paddington even received the status of an honorary member of the local club. Besides, he found a job. After all, the hero really needs money to give his aunt, who is preparing for her centenary, a unique gift. In an antique shop, a caring nephew saw a very rare old edition and decided that he should look for a better gift for a round date. But while he was collecting the required amount, the tome was stolen. Bear turns to the Brown couple for help in finding the thief. And then the events developed rapidly and the Peruvian guest suddenly found himself involved in an interesting adventure and adventure.

title: River of Blood / Lost in the Jungle
description: Four kayaking enthusiasts made the wrong decision by choosing a route along a river that led into a dense jungle. On this dangerous path, they had no idea that they would wander into a territory inhabited by ferocious cannibals representing a local tribe. Their adventure turned into a real test, and soon they realized that they faced a threat that they could not even imagine. Gradually, the kayakers began to realize the seriousness of the situation, when strange sounds began to be heard around them, and the shadows of local residents appeared on the horizon. Their lives are in real danger and they have to rely only on their survival skills and team spirit. Confusion and fear gripped the group, and they knew they had to join forces to get out of this predicament.

title: List of dreams
description: The main character, despite the difficulties of adult life, decides to return to her childhood aspirations and finish what she once started. She decides to achieve her old goals set in her youth, and now, having become an adult, she understands that this task will require a lot of effort from her. However, despite all the fears and obstacles, she is ready to face her greatest fear and face unexpected dangers in order to make her dreams come true. Step by step, she returns to the planned path and is determined to go to the end, despite all the difficulties. Over time, she finds herself in a situation where the achievement of her childhood dreams opens up new horizons for her and leads to completely new, unexpected opportunities. It becomes not just a process of achieving old goals, but a real exciting journey that radically changes her outlook on life. All the tests she goes through on her way expand her boundaries and lead to new discoveries. With each step, she becomes more and more ready for change and ready to take risks for the sake of her goal, because now she understands that achieving her dreams is not only a matter of a goal, but also the opening of completely new opportunities for herself.

title: Festive list
description: The death of the mother-in-law becomes a heavy blow for the main character, because this woman was the real backbone of the family, which held everyone together. After her departure, the family begins to fall apart: everyone dives into their own world, trying to cope with the loss on their own. Mutual resentments and unresolved conflicts only increase alienation, and soon relatives become almost strangers to each other. Realizing that it cannot continue like this, the main character decides to use the festive period to restore harmony in the family. She devises a plan to get everyone under one roof for Christmas. But reconciling people who have accumulated so many grudges turns out to be more difficult than she expected. Armed with patience and faith in a bright future, she does everything possible to make the family whole again.

title: Mom is a con artist
description: The plot of the film reveals the dramatic story of a successful chef who did not know his biological mother all his life. In 2020, he receives a letter from a woman who claims to have been looking for him for years after her son was taken away at the age of two. Shocked by this news, the man decides to trust her and accept her as his own. It seems that fate gave him a chance to restore the lost connection, and their life together is filled with moments of happiness. However, over time, he has doubts about her true intentions. Inexplicable contradictions in her stories and strange actions make him wonder: is this woman really his mother, or is she just a skilled fraud? Step by step, the hero gets closer to the solution that will change his whole life.

title: Awakening
description: The last ten years of John and Mary's life were like an endless nightmare, full of pain, fear and hopelessness. Their only daughter, 14-year-old Claire, has disappeared, leaving behind nothing but emptiness and endless unanswered questions. They struggled with despair, clung to hope, hoped for a miracle, but time passed inexorably and the police were unable to find any clues as to her whereabouts. Each new day turned into a test, even more difficult than the previous one, and the feeling of powerlessness only intensified. And so, after ten years of obscurity, Claire unexpectedly returns home. Mary is torn between happiness and shock, unable to believe her eyes, while John views her appearance with suspicion. He is not sure that this girl is the same Claire who disappeared years ago. With doubts in his heart, he begins to search for the truth, gradually discovering secrets that can change everything. With each passing day, the tension in the family grows, and the past, which seemed to be forgotten, begins to come to life, enveloping their lives in the eerie shadow of a hidden truth.

title: Elite Squad 2: The Enemy Among Us
description: Robert Nascimento is one of the best law enforcement officers. Therefore, he deservedly receives a promotion and becomes a lieutenant colonel. The criminal part of Rio de Janeiro is not happy about this news. They understand that now it will be much more difficult to conduct illegal business. Drug lords are trying to find a way to get rid of the main character. While they look for an opportunity, Robert goes on another assignment. There is one prison. Especially dangerous criminals are kept there. Recently, it is increasingly difficult for the guards to control the prisoners. They organize riots and riots. Everyone hopes for the help of the central character. After all, this is not the first time he has encountered something like this. However, the young man did not suspect that a trap was being prepared for him. The situation reached a peak and a bloody slaughter began in the detention area. As a result, Robert was charged with the crime. He was removed from his post, which means the bandits got their way. But it will not seem so simple.

title: Christmas cowboy
description: Mary, an experienced real estate developer, faces a unique opportunity to earn $1.2 billion. This prospect brings her back to her hometown, where she will have to face family differences and competition. In her native places, not only old problems await her, but also unfinished business with loved ones that need attention and resolution. However, returning home opens up unexpected horizons for Mary. She begins to realize that the real values ​​of life are not only in material achievements. In the process of communication with relatives and old friends, she again finds joy, forgiveness and true love. In addition, meetings with local horses give her a sense of comfort and connection with nature. In this way, Mary not only solves financial problems, but also discovers meanings that she left behind a long time ago.

title: A killer game
description: Joe is a successful contract killer who always completes his tasks quickly, professionally and without undue attention. However, his life changes when doctors give him a fatal diagnosis. Resigned to his fate, Joe decides that he does not want to live with this burden and hires his colleagues to carry out his last order - to take his life. However, after all the details of the operation were agreed, it turns out that the hospital mixed up the test results, and in fact Joe is completely healthy. But the problem is that the mercenaries have already begun to carry out the order. Now Joe finds himself in a deadly trap, where he has to fight for his life against those who were just yesterday his colleagues. A whole group of killers starts hunting him, and he is forced to face them alone, trying to survive. However, his problems do not end there - he must also protect the life of his beloved, who is in danger. Joe faces a terrible confrontation with brutal killers to defend his right to life. The atmosphere of tension, fear and danger accompanies the hero at every step, turning his struggle into a real test.

title: Auditor
description: The tape presents an exciting story about an unusual auditor whose mathematical abilities lead him into dangerous situations. Christian Wolf is not used to standing still, so when his life begins to be threatened by the security services, he decides to leave his criminal clients and turn to a law-abiding company for help. But the case he undertakes to investigate turns out to be much more complicated and dangerous. As Christian plunges into the world of finance and corporate greed, his life begins to be threatened. Each new step leads him to new mysteries and dangers, and he realizes that his own mental abilities may prove to be both his best and most dangerous weapon. As he tries to solve the mystery of a financial crime, Christian discovers that behind every number there is a human life, and he must solve it.

title: Pet Cemetery: Blood Tracks
description: The audience is transported to 1969, where the story unfolds through the character of Jud Crandall, who lives in the town of Ludlow, Maine. The dark secrets of the Crandall family, shrouded in the secrets of ancient evil, prevent Jud from leaving the borders of his hometown, leaving him in the grip of terrible circumstances and an unknown force. In the center of the story - friendship and blood ties, which are put to the real test in the conditions of eerie events and encounters with paranormal phenomena. Jud and his childhood friends defy the sinister force that has ruled Ludlow since its founding in an effort to protect their lives and those of their loved ones. With each new discovery, the heroes plunge deeper and deeper into a world of horrors in which the line between reality and nightmares blurs. The plot of the film is built on the dynamics of fear and incredible tension, offering the audience to see how family secrets and ancient evil affect the destinies of the main characters, forcing them to fight for their lives in the fight against the darkest fears.

title: last breath
description: Diver Chris Lemons descends to the bottom of the ocean near an oil field to repair equipment. At this moment, a serious technical failure occurs on the vessel to which he is connected by a hose cable. The ship starts moving and the gas hose supplying Chris with oxygen breaks. The diver finds himself in complete darkness on the seabed, remaining with a limited supply of air, which is calculated for only a few minutes. The team on the surface rushes to take measures to save Chris. They understand that there is very little time left, and every second counts. The situation demands from them speed and accuracy of actions, as well as full concentration. A diver's life is at stake, and his friends do everything they can to bring him back to the surface. This trial will be a test not only for Chris, but also for the entire team, which must unite in a determined effort to overcome this critical situation.

title: To die before death
description: Adi is a young vlogger from Dorset who has become famous for his pranks and extreme challenges. He is so engrossed in his Internet audience that he hardly spends time with his wife and young daughter. To keep the attention of subscribers and attract new viewers, he is forced to constantly invent more and more dangerous tests. One day, after receiving a provocative proposal from one of the fans, he decides to take the riskiest step in his career — to spend three days underground in a buried coffin with a minimum supply of water and oxygen. But what started as another spectacular experiment quickly turns into a struggle for life. In complete darkness, with no way out, Adi begins to understand that he may not be dug up.

title: Juror #2 / Juror number two
description: Justin Kemp, a devoted family man and juror in a brutal murder case, finds himself faced with a complex moral dilemma. In the course of a high-profile trial, he begins to suspect that he may be involved in the victim's tragic death, although he himself did not realize it. Day by day, these guesses become stronger, and Justin begins to see himself as one of the possible culprits of an event that radically changed someone's life. Hostage to his own doubts and fears, he plunges into the struggle with internal contradictions, trying to understand whether he is really responsible for what happened. Justin must make a choice: save himself by shifting the blame to others, or follow the truth, even if it destroys his life. His decision will be a test of strength of conviction and strength of spirit.

title: 3391 kilometers
description: It's a story about a long-distance romance where the main characters, separated by 3,391 kilometers, find a way to bond. Long months of night and day conversations fill their lives with emotions and dreams, despite the lack of physical contact. Izmir is a young girl from Turkey who lives in Izmir. She is socially awkward and has practically no friends. Everything changes one night when she receives a message from a stranger from France named Aeghe. His simple offer to "go to bed" becomes the beginning of their communication. Ege also faces loneliness, and his unusual character turns out to be in tune with Izmir's inner world. Gradually, a deep connection is formed between them, which allows them to share experiences and dreams, despite the distance. With each new conversation, they discover in each other support and understanding that were not available before.

title: I am an Elf
description: Trip, an eccentric elf builder, isn't in much demand at Santa's factory because of his preference for creating unusual weapons instead of normal toys. But fate brings him together with Elia, a strange boy from an Italian mountain village. Their initial mistrust of each other quickly turns into an alliance when they must join forces to save Christmas from a ruthless businessman whose sinister plans threaten to ruin the holiday for the entire world. Trip's creativity and bravery are combined with Elia's wonderful imagination in this unusual and exciting story.

title: Emil from Loneberg
description: The family film "Emil of Lönneberg" is a kind of screen adaptation of the works and tells about the adventures of a young boy from Sweden, who manages to get into funny trouble time and time again. The blond boy with clear blue eyes like the sky, does not like to sit in one place and has never been a calm child. Inquisitive Emil seeks to learn as much useful information as possible about the world around him, because there is so much interesting happening around him. In a small Swedish village, life goes on in its own way, unhurriedly and measuredly, and only the restless Emil makes a noise in the whole district with his antics!

title: Counterattack / Counterattack
description: During a hostage rescue operation, Captain Guerrero and his team of elite fighters face a new enemy. Unexpectedly, a carefully planned ambush organized by a dangerous criminal group is on their way. The situation is getting tense and the team will have to show all their skills and experience to survive this critical moment. Every move requires caution and strategic thinking, as enemies use every possible tactical technique to achieve their goals. Adjusting plans on the fly and maintaining morale among the soldiers becomes an important task for the captain. The conflict escalates, and every second counts, because the lives of the hostages hang in the balance. Guerrero and his team must work together to overcome obstacles and ensure the safety of those they are trying to save. This encounter with a criminal organization requires not only physical strength, but also the ability to work as a team in a brutal confrontation.

title: turn me on
description: A young couple decides to abandon the use of special pills that suppress human emotions and begins to feel real feelings. They enjoy every moment, discovering joy, love and passion. However, soon their idyll encounters the dark side of emotions, which they did not suspect. With each new experience, the realization catches up that together with happiness comes bitterness and fear. In the process of discovering their true feelings, they face internal conflicts and problems that challenge their relationship. The couple finds themselves on the edge where they will have to learn to cope with both beautiful moments and difficult trials in order to maintain their connection in this complex and unpredictable world of emotions.

title: Under Cover
description: This story is based on the true events that happened to Aransas Berradre Marin, known by the pseudonym, when she worked for the national police. At the age of 20, she received an extremely dangerous task - to infiltrate the radical terrorist organization ETA. Introducing herself as an activist of the Movement of Conscious Rejecters in Logroño, she was able to win the trust of the nationalist left movement and found herself at the very epicenter of events. Being the only woman among the leaders of ETA, she constantly risked her life, because any exposure meant imminent death. In order to complete the mission, she was forced to break all ties with her family and completely immerse herself in the dangerous world of conspiracies and preparations for terrorist attacks. Its main goal was to neutralize the Donostia commando at the moment when the organization pretended to declare a truce. Each day of her stay among the terrorists could be her last, but she went to the end, sacrificing her personal life for the sake of saving others. This is a story about incredible courage, willpower and a difficult choice that changed her destiny forever.

title: Presence
description: Rebecca, Chris and their children Tyler and Chloe are a typical family that faces everyday problems and challenges. After moving to a new house, they begin to experience strange events and unfamiliar sensations that cannot be explained. At first, everything seems normal, but soon they begin to feel that there is something unknown and mysterious in their lives. Each member of the family begins to notice small details: rustling in empty rooms, shadows flickering at the edge of the field of vision, and unexpected changes in the usual environment. Tyler and Chloe, filled with curiosity, begin to explore the house, hoping to unravel its mysteries. Rebecca and Chris, for their part, try to stay rational, but with each passing day, the awareness that something unusual is happening in the house grows. The family turns out to be involved in a chain of events that force them to reconsider their views on life and attitudes towards each other. The question of what exactly lies beyond their understanding becomes more and more pressing, prompting them to search for answers.

title: Little Siberia
description: The peaceful life of the inhabitants of a small remote settlement is abruptly interrupted by an incredible event - a meteorite falls on their land, piercing the roof of a parked car. This find immediately attracts the attention of the whole city, and local authorities see it as an opportunity for economic development. For safety reasons, the wreckage is temporarily placed in a local museum, where a priest named Joel begins to look after it. He is not only the spiritual mentor of the community, but also a veteran of the peacekeeping service, so when criminals start circling around the artifact who want to steal it, the man takes care of its protection, preparing for any threats. But the meteorite becomes only the beginning of dangerous events. Joel finds himself at the center of a struggle between greedy treasure hunters and scientists who want to take the stone to London for research. But while he protects the artifact from numerous encroachments, his life becomes even more dramatic - unexpected news from his wife should make him happy, but instead pushes him into a vortex of internal contradictions and trials. The meteorite, which seemed like a simple find, becomes a catalyst for change not only for the entire town, but also for Joel himself, forcing him to face his personal demons.

title: Protocol-7
description: In a small town, a family lawyer, a dedicated woman, faces an extremely difficult case. She learns about the activities of a powerful pharmaceutical corporation that puts profit above people's health. To prove the truth and bring the guilty to justice, she teams up with those who also seek justice. Her team is joined by a doctor suspended for exposing medical malpractice, as well as an experienced virologist working in a leading laboratory with important inside information. Together, they engage in a dangerous struggle where every step can be fatal. Their opponents are ruthless corporatists, ready to hide the truth at any cost. Exposing machinations and deception, the heroes try to stop a large-scale scam that threatens the lives of thousands of people. They understand that only after getting to the truth will they be able to save defenseless patients who have become victims of a cruel game played by science and human health.

title: Wicked: Enchantress
description: Elphaba remained a sweet and kind girl. But she is very different from the representatives of all her age. It's all the fault of the unusual color of the skin - green. Many are shocked by her appearance and do not miss a chance to release scathing comments at her. It is not surprising that over time, an irresistible desire for revenge and hatred appears in the soul of a kind and cheerful young lady. She does not trust others and always feels a trick when communicating with them. Gradually, she turns from a princess into a dangerous witch. From now on, not a trace of the good-natured person remains. And soon the beauty enlists the support of new acquaintances. Together, they form their own vicious tandem capable of wreaking havoc and destruction.

title: How to become popular
description: Beckett, who dreams of glory on the screens of V-TV, tries his best to make his way to the top, but success remains out of reach. Everything changes when he meets the mysterious artificial intelligence Mr. Viral, who instantly turns him into a star. However, the rapid rise to popularity turns to a dark side: behind the glow of fame hides a sinister AI plan that threatens not only Beckett, but also the most precious people in his life. Will he be able to save everything that is important to him, or will the game with the virtual devil prove fatal?

title: Witch hunters
description: In a medieval kingdom ruled by a wise but strict monarch, real horror breaks out. The once peaceful inhabitants of the forest turn into terrifying demons, and in the very heart of darkness stands a mysterious sorceress who weaves her eerie spells. Fear and panic grip the city, because no one knows how to stop this influx. One of the first victims of dark magic is the son of a famous warrior, whose fate changes forever in one fateful night. Overwhelmed by rage and a desire for revenge, the experienced warrior gathers a squad of the bravest fighters, among whom a master swordsman stands out, ready to accept any challenge. They embark on a dangerous journey full of deadly traps and encounters with terrifying creatures. However, as their steps lead deep into the enchanted forest, it becomes clear that the enemy is much more cunning than they thought. The witch has prepared for them a terrible test that will test not only their strength, but also their will to live.

title: Night conversations
description: Every night, the hero hosts his show and shares unusual stories with listeners. Thanks to the presentation of the presenter, the program is very popular and does not even think about losing ratings. One day the main character realizes that he is tired of telling stories. He invites listeners to share their interesting stories that would attract the attention of an audience of thousands. That's how strange people, thirsty for attention, start calling the live broadcast. Their stories awaken sincere shock and fear in the host. Following this, incomprehensible phenomena begin to occur around him, which do not promise anything good. Can a frightened man survive this night shift and keep his sanity? And what will happen if legends and myths take physical form and force the hero to fight for survival?

title: Panda patrol
description: At the heart of the plot are an actor specializing in action films and his faithful assistant, who find themselves involved in an exciting and dangerous operation codenamed "Panda". The purpose of their mission is to rescue a mysterious individual named Pi, who is a world-famous superstar. With each step, they face new challenges and dangers that threaten not only the success of the operation, but also their own lives. Intrigues and unexpected twists await at every turn, forcing the heroes to show all their skills and abilities to cope with the situation. As they immerse themselves in the world of spies and crime, a complex web of intrigue and manipulation unfolds around them, in which no one can be completely sure of their allies. The actor and his sidekick must not only be able to catch the villains, but also figure out their own feelings, motivations, and loyalty to each other. This fascinating story is full of drive and unexpected moments that make the audience hold their breath and worry about the fate of the characters until the last minute.

title: Armor of God 3: Mission Zodiac
description: The legendary actor Jackie Chan continues to delight the audience with his new directorial and acting work in the exciting action "Armor of God 3: Mission Zodiac". In the center of the plot is a hardened thief and treasure hunter JC, known in certain circles by the nickname Hawk. He receives an offer from one well-known antiquarian - to steal six ancient figurines representing the signs of the zodiac. Bronze figurines are scattered all over the world, and their owners are avid collectors. But not all figurines have owners, several pieces are lost in the ocean waters near tropical islands. Hawk accepts the offer, for which he will be very well rewarded, and first of all he goes to Paris, where he must steal two statuettes from the castle of a famous collector. On his way, he makes both dangerous enemies and friends in the person of the charming Chinese student Coco and the bankrupt aristocrat Catherine. The movie "Armor of God 3: Mission Zodiac" (2012) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedy action movies.

title: Paternity
description: Rohan and Josh decide to rent a country house for a family holiday. They hope to create a pleasant environment for communication with loved ones, but despite their expectations, the event turns out to be extremely stressful. In the midst of the party, a 400-year-old spirit suddenly awakens, leading to chaos and unexpected turns of events. Now Rohan and Josh are faced with a situation they could not have foreseen. Their desire for quiet gatherings turns into a struggle with otherworldly forces.

title: Dangerous flight
description: The center of attention is an experienced air marshal, who is entrusted with the responsible task of escorting a dangerous criminal on board a small plane. This mission could be considered routine if not for one disturbing moment: during the flight, the marshal begins to suspect that the pilot piloting their ship is not who he says he is. Every moment turns into a test as the tension builds, and by playing hidden roles, not only their lives are at risk, but also the safety of the entire operation. Trying to unravel the plans of the mysterious pilot, he finds himself immersed in a world of dangerous manipulations and possible betrayals. Every sound and movement is now worth its weight in gold, and there is a tension in the air that does not leave them even at the height. The marshal faces a difficult task: to understand who can be trusted and how to survive in this confusing confrontation where the stakes are incredibly high. The pattern of events is rapidly changing, opening up new horizons of danger and unpredictability.

title: Pollyanna
description: Optimistic young orphan Pollyanna finds herself under the care of her strict aunt, who runs the business in a small American town with an iron hand. Despite the strict rules and restrictions of her new home, Pollyanna does not lose heart thanks to a special "Joy Game" developed by her father. The idea of ​​the game is simple: to find positive aspects for joy in any state of affairs. Starting with an obsessive enthusiasm that seems obsessive, her unquenchable optimism gradually spreads among the local residents, beautifying their lives and completely changing the atmosphere in the city.

title: Vampire Academy: Blood Sisters
description: The fantasy film "Vampire Academy" is based on the novel of the same name by the American writer Rachel Mead and tells the story of an unusual educational institution in which vampires and dia-vampires are taught all the wisdom of magic and supernatural powers. A vampire girl from the ancient Moro clan, Princess Vasilisa "Lisa" Dragomyr, also comes to the college located in the state of Montana. But she did not come here alone, but with her best friend and faithful protector Rosemary Hazeway, who swore to always protect Lisa, even at the cost of her own life. However, in addition to the difficulties in communicating with the students of the academy, the girls face much bigger problems, because for a long time there has been a brutal war in the world between the Moro and strigoi - vampires who have gone over to the side of evil, who are not stopped by any law. The film "Vampire Academy: Blood Sisters" (2014) will be enjoyed by all fans of fantasy-horror about vampires in Ukrainian.

title: Fools / Family of Fools
description: Stanley Dumb lives up to his name: he thinks the post office is sending him letters from a villain called "The Sender" and is convinced that his trash is being stolen every night. He decides to pretend to be a tree to find out what is happening to his trash, and ends up at a meeting of the world's arms smugglers. Joan, Stanley's wife, and their children, Buster and Petunia, set out to find Stanley, who constantly outwits the trained assassin.

title: Party king 3
description: Arriving at his new college, Vahn is alarmed to note that all the girls have taken a vow of celibacy. This discovery causes him a real panic, because such a situation is unacceptable for him. He decides to act actively to change the state of affairs and free the educational institution from these "sexual shackles". Van understands that it will not be easy to cope with the task, but he is ready for any challenges. However, in this task it is important to act carefully and not to overdo it. Vahn begins to come up with different ways and approaches to get the girls back interested in romance and relationships. Using his talents and ingenuity, he strives to make changes that will enable everyone to overcome past limitations and find freedom in their feelings. Now on his shoulders lies the responsibility to kindle the spark of love in the hearts of fellow students and create an atmosphere in which everyone can be happy.

title: Party king 2
description: His dream is to continue the family traditions and become a member of the prestigious organization "Fraternal Guild of Foxes and Dogs". A meeting with Pip Everett, the leader of the guild, puts his plans in jeopardy when he is refused admission to the club. However, Taj does not lose hope and creates his group "Rooster and Bulls", uniting students with unusual talents and unconventional approaches. He aims to prove that even without the recognition of "Foxes and Dogs" it is possible to achieve success and become an influential member of the university community. Can the newcomers conquer Camford and change the rules of the game, or will they have to accept the terms of the established order?

title: Ven Wilder is the king of parties
description: Ven Wilder has been in college for six years and still hasn't graduated. The reason for his long studies lies not in the lack of intelligence, but in his boundless love for a carefree student life, full of fun and adventure. He enjoys every minute, spending time with friends and participating in various activities, forgetting the real reasons for his stay in the educational institution. One day, Wen finds himself in a terrible situation: his father informs him that he is no longer going to finance his long studies. Now Wen will have to make a choice: either find a way to pay for the seventh year of his student entertainment on his own, or finally focus and finish his studies by becoming a graduate. This difficult decision makes him think about his priorities and the future, because the fun student life may end, and it's time to move on to the next stage.

title: Obsessed with control
