description: The plot of this story revolves around a young woman, Valerie, who is a recognized self-improvement superstar, a beacon of motivation and empowerment, whose brand Unstoppable made her famous. With a huge following, bestsellers and a busy performance schedule, Valerie seems to have it all. But just as she prepares to embark on a high-profile nationwide tour that could cement her legacy, cracks begin to form in her carefully constructed image. At home, Valerie struggles to mend her relationship with her husband, Robbie. The couple dreams of a child to bring them together, but instead Valerie is filled with growing anxiety. Deep down, she is not sure that motherhood is the future she really wants, although she has a hard time admitting it even to herself. Beneath Valerie's flawless exterior is a kinovibe.co woman still haunted by the mysterious and traumatic death of her mother when she was just a child. The past she's been suppressing for years now threatens to come out, forcing her to face the darkness she's avoided for so long. As the pressures of her professional and personal life mount, Valerie begins to feel something strange - a constant itch in the back of her head. What begins as an occasional irritation soon becomes excruciating, constant torture that no medication can relieve. Combing brings short-term relief, but soon turns into open wounds, making it impossible to hide Valerie's growing pain. Desperate for answers, Valerie turns to her estranged father, Sangu, hoping to uncover the long-buried truth about her mother's death and her family history.

title: The good side of the bad
description: At the heart of this deep drama is the story of Florence, a young photographer who faces a difficult challenge. She is diagnosed with schizophrenia, and this diagnosis changes not only her life, but also the lives of her family. Older brother Peter and sister Sarah do not hesitate to join forces to support her and help her find a way to recovery. However, this path turns out to be full of difficulties, misunderstandings and trials, which force them to rethink not only their attitude towards their sister's illness, but also their own opportunities to fight for her future. The situation is complicated by another family tragedy - their mother suffers from dementia, so they cannot count on her help. This adds even more responsibility and pain to them, because they are forced to make important decisions on their own. This emotional story raises difficult questions: How far are we willing to go to save the ones we love? Is it possible to force a person to accept help if he himself does not want it? The film subtly and truthfully shows difficult family relationships, the struggle with inner demons and the power of support that can be crucial in the darkest times.

title: Brooklyn Love Story
description: In the center of the story is Mike, who faithfully manages the family store, which he inherited from his father. Golden Gate has become more than just a business, but an important part of the community, where local residents have found fresh produce and warm conversation for years. However, their peaceful life is threatened by ambitious developers who intend to demolish the old quarter and turn it into a modern complex. Although they promise comfort and development, residents are not ready to part with the place that has become their home. Banding together, the community decides not to give up without a fight and devises a cunning plan to save the store and street they love so much. It is during this difficult period in Mike's life that Hani appears - a girl who understands his anxieties and supports him in the most difficult moments. Their mutual sympathy ignites against the background of the fight for justice, and Mike gradually realizes that the Golden Gate is not only a family heirloom, but also a symbol of hope that cannot be lost.

title: Good bad girl
description: The main character is a successful marketer. One day he goes to London, where he meets a girl named Joan. This beauty eventually becomes his mistress. The main character spent unforgettable days in the British capital, but the business trip ends, and he returns to his native Copenhagen. This man has a permanent girlfriend. The hero swears to her that she is the only woman for him in the whole world. The main character has already forgotten about his quick affair in London, but Joan, unlike him, remembers everything perfectly. She liked this lover so much that she is not going to give him up just like that. Joan decides to go to the capital of Denmark after the main character. This girl is resolutely ready for any actions to stay with the man she loved with all her heart. The main character started an affair with her in vain, because now this cute-looking girl has turned into a real stalker. Joan will do anything to ruin his life. The situation for the main character no longer seems soft and light, now he will learn what a real burden is...

title: Yorkshire werewolf
description: Young Jenny was always not like everyone else - stubborn, headstrong and independent, she was often perceived as a rebel. But the real reason for her unusual behavior was witchcraft, which opened the door to the world of mysticism and chaos. One day she encounters a mysterious force that changes her life forever. When Jenny wakes up, she finds that her body is no longer her own - she has become a tiny dog. Confused and scared, she tries to understand what happened to her and searches for a way to return to her true form. However, this strange transformation is only the beginning of her trials. Higher forces intervene in her fate, forcing her to take part in a deadly confrontation between werewolves and criminal gangs.

title: Black diamond
description: In the center of the plot is a young woman whose carefree life with her boyfriend, who works in the financial sector, is suddenly threatened. Everything changes when she meets a charismatic artisan cowboy, leading to a tangled relationship filled with passion and obsession. At first, she admires his free lifestyle and skills that make him special in her eyes. This acquaintance awakens in her feelings that she could not understand in her former, stable, but predictable existence. With each new day, her admiration for the cowboy becomes deeper and deeper, and soon she will have to choose between the safety and familiar comfort with the financier and an exciting, but risky life with a new acquaintance. In this triangle of emotions, a game of survival begins, where not only feelings are at stake, but also lives. In the end, obsession leads to unforeseen consequences, and a dark story of betrayal and murder emerges from an ordinary romantic story, which calls into question the true motives of the heroes.

title: Moorish
description: Mohammed Ould Slahi led the life of an upstanding citizen, but September 11, 2001 changed his life forever. The hero was accused of having ties with Osama bin Laden and sent to prison. There was no evidence against him and the prosecution was based only on suspicions. Nancy Hollander is a lawyer who is outraged that Mohamed has been in prison for several years without any legal arguments. She begins to deal with his case, hoping to achieve justice. Only she has to face many difficulties, because for society he is a real criminal. But the heroine is not going to give in to emotions and believes only in facts. Will she be able to achieve a fair trial for Mohammed? All fans of dramatic thrillers will enjoy watching the movie "The Moor" (2021) live in Ukrainian.

title: Cloak of the Wizard
description: In the dusty attic of an old grandmother's house, three friends—Jack, Olivia, and Charlie—find a mysterious yellow cloak. At first, it seems to them to be ordinary junk, but soon it turns out that this thing has unique properties. Anyone who dares to wear it is suddenly transformed into the giant Augustus Semprini. Once upon a time, this man stole a cloak from the powerful witch Gertrude, for which he was cursed to be forever stuck in his own past. His soul is doomed to wander through time until the artifact finds a new bearer. Danger does not make you wait: it is only necessary for friends to try on a cloak, as they find themselves in the very center of mystical events. The witch and her ominous servant had already sensed a disturbance in the balance and set off in search of the children. Now Jack, Olivia and Charlie must unravel the mystery of the enchanted clothes and find a way to free Semprini before the dark forces wipe them off the face of the earth. It will be a struggle where not only their lives are at stake, but also the future of the cloak itself, capable of changing the course of history.

title: Smile while you kill
description: The story focuses on a man cornered by his own terminal illness. His name is Rico, and he is in dire need of an expensive treatment that could save his life. Desperation pushes him to extreme measures—he kidnaps a successful advertising executive, Terry, hoping to force him to help. But the demand is unusual: Terry must create a powerful online campaign that will raise funds for treatment, or accept the same fate that awaits Rico. This tense thriller abandons superfluous scenery and special effects, focusing on the psychological confrontation between the two men. Sharp dialogues and high tension keep the viewer in suspense until the finale, where it becomes clear who will be the victim and who will be the real predator.

title: Escaping from oneself / Escaping
description: A woman named Skye returns to her hometown in the Scottish countryside. The deaf expanses of her native land greet her with silence, but behind this seemingly calm surface hides a multitude of unresolved problems and secret tensions that she once left in an attempt to escape from herself. Skye decides to start from scratch, but every step is difficult for her. Old friends turned their backs on her, and her relatives, it seems, have never forgiven her past weaknesses. To survive this test, Skye has to learn to trust herself again, accept her flaws, and at the same time prove to her loved ones that she has changed. This path becomes difficult for her when her old deeds emerge from the past, the echoes of which still live in the souls of those around her. In the difficult conditions of a small town, where rumors spread quickly, the heroine tries to regain respect and a place in the community. Gradually, a woman finds strength in nature, which becomes a kind of refuge and source of support for her.

title: Bad connection
description: A young waitress decides to buy a stolen phone and unexpectedly finds on it a shocking video recording the murder of a person. This discovery puts her in an extremely dangerous position, as it turns out that the owner of the phone is a psychopath, obsessed with the desire to return his property at any cost. He is armed with a hunting knife and has no intention of stopping before eliminating those who stand in his way. The situation escalates when the maniac begins to pursue the girl, realizing that she has his secret. Time is running out and she must find a way to get rid of the stalker while protecting her life. Hiding from the madman, the waitress realizes that her only chance to survive is to face her fear and find a way to stop the threat. In this fight for survival, she has to find out what she is capable of when it comes to her life.

title: Winner
description: Akira, who is an ordinary worker, unexpectedly finds himself in a parallel reality, where everything happens according to the rules of a self-administered game. In this new life, he assumes the form of a character with the nickname "Mao", which becomes the beginning of his exciting adventure. During his travels, he meets a girl whose legs cannot perform the usual movements, and decides to take her with him on his journey. Together, they face many challenges, from confronting enemies to finding the necessary resources. Each step proves to be a difficult test, and as Akira progresses through uncharted territories, he begins to realize that his new figure, although powerful, hides ordinary human feelings and emotions. However, life in this new world is full of challenges. The country in which he found himself does not leave the mighty "Mao" in peace, sending a squad of priestesses in his direction, capable of wreaking havoc and devastation. Despite his fearsome reputation, Akira, now known as the Demon King, is still the same simple man inside. His inner conflict between his new status and his former life forces him to rethink his purpose and true goals. With each fight and each new acquaintance, he begins to reveal not only the secrets of the world around him, but also his true self. This journey becomes not just a battle for survival, but a search for understanding one's place in this strange and dangerous world.

title: Monsieur Aznavour
description: Charles Aznavour's life was a real creative journey, full of bright colors and unforgettable melodies. His music intertwined with poetry like a thread, inspiring and touching the hearts of fans around the world. Since childhood, he dreamed of becoming a star, and thanks to tireless work and inexhaustible passion for creativity, this dream came true. Traveling to concert halls and theaters, Charles Aznavour conquered the audience with his unique charm and talent. His voice sounded like a call to true feelings, and his songs became a hymn of love and passion. Encountering success and inevitable difficulties on his way, he remained faithful to his art.

title: Murders at Bear Lake
description: The sheriff of a small resort town decides to join forces with a detective who has arrived from a large metropolis to find out the cause of the mysterious deaths that occur annually in their area. At the same time, they are trying to unravel the mystery surrounding these tragic events. During their investigation, they begin to suspect that they are dealing with a cunning killer who is upping his game among vacationers and locals. Every year, when tourists arrive in the city, a new wave of suspicion and fear is ignited, and with each new case, the chances of the criminal being caught decrease. The sheriff and the detective plunge into the world of intrigue and lies, facing the dark side of ordinary life in a resort town. They have to untangle a complex tangle of evidence, overcome various difficulties and, perhaps, discover unexpected connections between the victims. Not only the solving of the crime depends on them, but also the safety of everyone who comes to this picturesque corner to relax.

title: The superiority of humanity / Human Suprematist
description: Natalie is an ardent defender of nature, who has devoted her life to the fight for animal rights and environmental protection. She is convinced that cruel treatment of living beings is unacceptable, and consciously chooses a lifestyle that does not harm the surrounding world. As a vegan, she carefully controls her diet and strives to spread her beliefs to others. When Natalie learns about an activist retreat that promises a new level of unity with nature, she doesn't hesitate to join a group of like-minded people. At first, everything seems perfect: a remote location, an atmosphere of harmony and a common goal. But gradually she begins to notice that the participants profess not just love for nature, but something much more fanatical. Over time, the retreat turns out not to be what it seemed. Natalie finds herself trapped in a cult whose members firmly believe that plants feel pain and suffering, which means that even eating the fruit is a crime. She is forbidden to eat any living food, and with each passing day the exhaustion becomes more and more severe. But the most terrifying thing is the experiment in which she has to take part in order to "achieve true unity" with nature. Realizing that she has become a victim of a terrible ideology, Natalie tries with all her might to escape, using all her experience and knowledge. What started as an innocent vacation turns into a struggle for survival in which she must find a way out before she becomes another victim of this creepy cult.

title: How to set up a family
description: Amelia, together with her son Rex, moves to a prestigious area, hoping to start a new life after difficult trials. The new environment seems ideal: luxurious houses, friendly neighbors and a carefree atmosphere. However, the illusion of well-being is quickly shattered when Rex is accused of an act that could destroy their family. Amelia is faced with a choice: blindly trust her son or accept the terrible reality that others impose on her. The situation escalates when the woman begins to investigate the hidden aspects of life in the community they have just entered.

title: Psychics / Crazy
description: On a hot August evening, wealthy teenager Roman makes a stop at his dealer's house before going to a night party. It would seem like an ordinary matter, but an unexpected meeting with a mysterious woman who is trying to escape destroys all his plans. A moment - and everything around begins to change. Inexplicable events are mixed with the action of a powerful substance that is already beginning to affect his consciousness. The world around becomes unstable, faces and sounds become distorted, and the line between reality and hallucination disappears. Roman tries to figure out what is happening to him, but every next step only plunges him into more chaos. Is this just a side effect of a powerful drug, or is he up against something far more dangerous? Ominous visions, confusion and uncontrollable fear turn this night into a bloody nightmare. And this is only the beginning - a long, brutal night ahead, where the line between hallucinations and terrible reality is completely blurred.

title: In the Kitchen / Grill
description: In the very heart of Manhattan, in a bustling restaurant in Times Square, there is a constant hustle and bustle. Visitors wait for their orders, cooks work at a fast pace, and waiters rush between tables, trying to please each guest. Now the man becomes the prime suspect, and the situation rapidly escalates. Suspicions increase when the owner learns that the cook is fond of the waitress Julia. She, despite sympathy, avoids relationships, but this discovery becomes a catalyst for the owner, who decides to take a risky step. His action can have unpredictable consequences that will not only change the lives of the employees, but also can endanger the existence of the restaurant. This story reveals the difficult reality of those who support the work of prestigious institutions, remaining in the shadow of the big city. They work tirelessly to achieve their American dream, even when it seems out of reach.

title: The Last Shooter / The Last Shooter
description: Overwhelmed by memories of the past, 92-year-old Artie Crawford, despite his venerable age, retains unshakable determination and fortitude. He feels a sacred duty to honor the memory of his comrades-in-arms who gave their lives during World War II. Neither obstacles, nor distance, nor any prohibitions will be able to stop him - he is determined to overcome the long way to France to bow to those who did not return from the battlefield. The pain of loss, but also pride for those who fought for freedom, is embodied in his every step. His heart is full of memories of the past, and his eyes are burning with determination to complete his last mission. His journey is not just a road across continents, but a symbolic path into the depths of his own memory, where brave warriors who have remained young forever live. With each new kilometer, their exploits come to life in his thoughts, the voices of those who died urge him to go on. Arti carries not only flowers and sorrow, but also fortitude, devotion and an unwavering belief that the memory of the fallen should live forever. His journey becomes a final act of devotion that echoes respect, love and gratitude to those who brought peace at the cost of their own lives.

title: Electric state
description: An orphaned teenager embarks on a journey through the retro-futuristic American West in the company of his yellow toy robot and an eccentric tramp. Their goal is to find the girl's younger brother, who has gone missing. Along the way, they encounter many unusual situations that require their ingenuity and courage. Each new stage of their adventure opens before them amazing landscapes and colorful characters living in this strange world, where elements of the past and future combine. They overcome difficulties, establish friendships and face inner experiences and torments that accompany their searches. Together, the heroes pass tests, learn to trust each other and learn the power of friendship. Their journey becomes not only a search for a lost child, but also an important stage in the search for their own place in this world. Each step brings them closer to their goal, but also opens up new horizons and opportunities for personal growth.

title: Betrayed
description: When Bala decided to have a casual bachelor party with his close friend Batista, he thought it would be a harmless pastime - just a little booze, a little laughter and a break from the routine. What he didn't expect was that this seemingly innocent decision would turn into a nightmare that would destroy his world. The night takes an unexpected turn when Bala is arrested in connection with the brutal murder of a woman - an exotic mistress that his wife Amarachi had no idea existed. The shocking discovery destroys their marriage, leaving Amarachi stunned and devoted. A once perfect life is suddenly thrown into chaos. But just when Bala's fate seems sealed, Amarachi receives a mysterious kinovibe.co phone call from an unknown number - someone insisting that her husband is innocent and that the truth is much more twisted than meets the eye. Against her common sense, Amarachi is drawn into a dangerous search for answers, fueled by doubts and the possibility that she has been tricked. Determined to uncover the true story, Amarachi turns to her longtime best friend, Tolu, a witty and savvy lawyer who is eager to help but wary of the tangled web of lies Bala may find herself in. With Tolu's legal expertise and the unexpected involvement of her attractive cousin Kunle, the trio embark on an investigation that will test their loyalty, put them in grave danger, and reveal secrets none of them are ready to face. As the lines between truth and illusion blur, Amarachi finds herself drawn into a dangerous conspiracy. With each step forward, she risks revealing secrets for the protection of which some are ready to kill.

title: A man with a scar
description: Tony is a mafia debt collector who has long been tired of his life. Daily affairs are reduced to intimidation and physical violence against those who did not return the debt on time, but this is not at all what he wants from the future. Although Tony has long dreamed of big money and respect, his reality is dirty work for people who will never let him rise above. Every day he wonders more and more whether there is a way out of this closed circle. He wants something more, but he knows that it will not be possible to leave the game so easily. However, a chance meeting and unforeseen circumstances force him to reconsider his life. Now Tony faces a choice: stay on the usual path or risk everything for a chance at a different future.

title: Heritage
description: Maya unexpectedly learns that her father was a famous spy. This discovery prompts the girl to unravel the secrets of his past, but soon she finds herself involved in an international conspiracy and becomes a target for dangerous criminals. Her difficult journey through many cities and countries begins, where she will have to independently overcome all kinds of dangers and develop her espionage skills, because she has neither mentors nor help. Despite this, Maya has a special gift that has been passed down to her, and she begins to realize her abilities. With each new task, her confidence grows, and she learns to make important decisions on which her life depends. This journey will not only reveal secrets about her father, but also help Maya understand her own strength and courage. In the end, she will be faced with a choice that will change her fate forever.

title: Input
description: The space station is now turning into a real prison from which no one is able to get out. Everything that goes into it never comes out again. In addition, none of the prisoners knows what is happening outside. But one day terrorists seize the entire station and send it to the capital of Russia. The only one who can stop it is the pilot and a young doctor of science. They have to unravel the entire system of the station and make the mechanism disconnect from automatic control. Only the ingenuity of the brave heroes could stop the direction of the station towards Moscow. Now this task becomes even more complicated, after the appearance of a former CIA agent at the station. It is he who has personal plans for this, which he will certainly turn into reality.

title: Stranger: Romulus
description: The Weyland-Yutani unmanned space probe investigates the drifting debris of the USCSS Nostromo spacecraft, locates and retrieves an organic object. Specialists open the facility, inside which is revealed a xenomorph curled up in the position of an embryo. Rayne Carradine, a young orphan woman, works in the Jackson Star mining colony with her adoptive brother Andy, a malfunctioning android reprogrammed by Rayne's father. When Rayne's employment contract is forcibly extended by the corporation, she accepts an offer from her ex-boyfriend Tyler to visit an abandoned Weyland-Yutani Corporation spaceship to steal cryo-chambers that will help Rayne, Tyler, his pregnant sister Kay, his cousin Bjorn, and Bjorn's girlfriend Navarro escape to the planet Iwaga. Andy's ability to interact with the spacecraft's on-board computer system is critical to this endeavor.

title: Hunt down a witness
description: Taylor was forced to hide people in her own house so that the influential mafia structure involved in the drug trade would not get to them. Amalia and her father are important witnesses in the federal case. The country's government guaranteed their safety. As they were being transported to the shelter under the protection of federal agents, the car was attacked. The girl's father was seriously wounded, while many members of the escort died. The surviving agent had to urgently look for a new shelter in order to be able to protect his wards. So the fugitives ended up in the house of the main character of the picture. As much as Taylor was afraid, she had to agree because she couldn't abandon a teenage girl in distress. Meanwhile, the pursuers find people who can reveal the secrets of the mafia to the court - they are ready to do anything to eliminate witnesses. The movie "Witness Hunt" (2021) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of dramatic thrillers and action movies.

title: The man who invented Christmas
description: The action of the film takes place in 1843 in London. Charles Dickens returns to London from a trip to America and faces a very difficult period in his life. In addition to financial problems, he is experiencing a creative crisis and is unable to write, since three previous books have failed. Gradually, inspiration returns to him and he decides to write a book called "A Christmas Carol". However, the publishers refuse him cooperation and the writer decides to pay for the printing on his own. But he has another very big problem: there are only six weeks left until Christmas, and during this time he must manage not only to write the work, but also to publish it. In addition to all this, the characters invented by him begin to live "their own lives", completely disobeying the author... The film "The Man Who Invented Christmas" (2017) will be enjoyed by all fans of biographies and historical dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: Heart eyes
description: Over the past few years, Valentine's Day has turned from a romantic holiday into a real nightmare. An unknown maniac, nicknamed the "Heart-Eyed Killer", wanders through the city. His target is couples in love, and every year he turns their love story into a bloody horror. This time, the threat hung over everyone who dared to celebrate this holiday. The killer does not stop, and every couple who dreams of spending a romantic evening can become his next target.

title: Lord of Chaos
description: Rebecca is a priest and together with her family goes to a small village where she has to work. The woman likes the setting, but the man feels uncomfortable. The harvest festival comes, the main character goes out, and when she comes home, she notices that her daughter has disappeared. Grace does not get in touch, the parents search, but all in vain. During the investigation, the main character finds out that local residents preach occult rituals and make sacrifices. No one agrees to look for the missing person, time is running out. Grace finds a secret basement, where she goes down and sees a bunch of tunnels. Having examined everything, she comes to the altar, where there are traces of human sacrifices. The mother urgently needs to find her daughter, because she will clearly be next, the parents are ready to kill everyone in their path.

title: Goodrich / Father of the year
description: The life of a successful art dealer, immersed in the world of high prices and exquisite exhibitions, suddenly changes with the arrival of two small twins. Andy, happily married to a young wife, finds himself in a difficult situation when his plans for the next three months begin to fall apart. The expected harmony and the opportunity to do business evaporate when he realizes that the eldest daughter is also pregnant. Now he will have to give up his usual activities for a while and immerse himself in the world of children's joys and worries. The internal conflict between personal ambitions and responsibilities as a father puts him in a no-win situation, and as it turns out, simply giving children a healthy diet and strict discipline is not enough to earn the title "Father of the Year". Every day Andy realizes that his ideas about raising children are fundamentally different from reality. Psychological traps, emotional changes and unexpected turns of events become his faithful companions in this difficult test. However, over time, he begins to realize that every interaction with children is not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for growth. Mixed feelings of joy and disappointment, chaos and moments of silence, lessons on how to be a real parent, all this forms a new reality.

title: My fault: London
description: An eighteen-year-old girl decides to change the situation and move from the United States to London with her mother and her new rich husband. In a new city, she faces many opportunities and surprises that await her at every step. At one of these events, she meets a young man named Nick. A sympathy quickly develops between them, which forces both people to think about their feelings. Nick is charismatic and self-confident, which gives her life in London a special meaning. The girl begins to discover not only the city, but also her own emotions, which begin to bloom like flowers in spring. However, as in any other hobby, there may be difficulties on the way to happiness that will have to be dealt with. This story is about love, finding yourself and how important it is to follow your heart sometimes.

title: Call me by your name
description: The events take place in Italy at the beginning of the eighties of the last century. A young man named Elio lives here. One day he comes to his parents' villa for the holidays. His father is a talented scientist, an American professor, and his mother is a translator from Italian to English. Now the boy is seventeen years old. He receives a good education, and his parents raised him in the best traditions. He spends his rest with benefit for the cause. A young man bathes in turquoise water and flirts with a beautiful girl named Marcia. And between these classes, he reads books and plays classical music. One day, a young employee of the department where Elio's father works comes to the villa. His name is Oliver. He is a very attractive American scientist. Everyone in the district is just crazy about the new resident. And Elio feels an irresistible attraction to him. And these feelings are mutual. The boys are of non-traditional sexual orientation. But in the eighties of the twentieth century, this was not yet the norm. If they confess to the professor, the young scientist will lose his place in science. The guys understand this and try to hide their relationship. The movie "Call me by your name" (2017) will be liked by all fans of romantic and melodramatic films in Ukrainian live.

title: Shoot them / Shoot them
description: Smith, the main character of the film, who lives only in memories of his tragic past, became an accidental witness of an attempt on a pregnant woman. In the course of a gruesome shootout, the woman is killed, and the newborn is saved by Smith. As a result of this event, he turns out to be involved in a government conspiracy. For help in caring for the baby, Smith turns to his acquaintance Donna Quintana, a prostitute who indulges all the depraved fantasies of her clients. Now they will have to save the child together and expose a conspiracy involving corrupt high-ranking officials. The film "Shoot them" (2005) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and comedies.

title: You can't teach love
description: A successful publicist unexpectedly finds herself in the role of temporary guardian of her little niece. Her usual rhythm of life is destroyed, because caring for a child brings many challenges for which she was completely unprepared. However, in this difficult situation, the woman finds unexpected support - the teacher of the kindergarten, where the girl goes, turns out to be not only a benevolent, but also a truly understanding friend. The young man helps her to look at herself, her fears and priorities in a new way. Gradually, the heroine begins to change: she learns to overcome difficulties, accept the spontaneity of life and see in it something more than a career and a clearly planned schedule. What initially seemed like an uncomfortable ordeal turns into a journey of self-discovery that changes her outlook forever.

title: Plus one
description: Lizzie is a young girl who adores her boyfriend. And one day, Marshall makes her an offer, which delights the heroine. Will she finally become a married woman and have a family? Not wanting to waste time, the bride immediately begins to prepare for the wedding. The joyful anticipation of the celebration turns into surprise when Marshall invites his ex-girlfriend to the wedding. Of course, such a decision of a loved one comes as a complete shock to Lizzie. But it is impossible to persuade the groom to abandon such a strange idea. And none of the boys could even think that the treacherous Marie would turn the happiest day of their lives into a real nightmare. With her antics, she will literally spoil everything, on which dozens of hours of time and a lot of effort were spent.

title: My two husbands
description: Brooke is a self-confident, successful woman who skillfully balances between two men, manipulating their feelings. One of them is her high school sweetheart, the charismatic and enterprising Stefan. The other is the influential, wealthy Dane, much older than her but able to open the door to a world of luxury and opportunity. Together with Stefan, Brooke develops a cunning plan: to exploit Dane's trust, cheat him of a large sum of money and escape, leaving him with nothing. Dane's daughter, who has long suspected something, unravels their scam and threatens to reveal the truth. Brooke finds herself in a difficult situation: any decision she makes can turn into a disaster. She must quickly decide who to trust and how to avoid fatal consequences, because the stakes are rising and the danger is becoming more and more real.

title: My husband's fatal affair
description: Unaware of the consequences, Michelle Clark decides to hire Melissa Juno as a nanny for her children, not knowing that she is opening the door to her worst nightmare. Melissa, who has a dark past and ties to Michelle through an inappropriate affair with her husband, Carlton Clark, finds herself not just a babysitter, but a hostage to his manipulations. Now that Melissa has become part of the Clark household, dark secrets begin to surface. Can Michelle uncover the truth before her family is in even greater danger? The answers lie behind the facade of the perfect life she tries so hard to maintain.

title: Danger on the fun island
description: Mel Dale is an experienced lawyer who is used to staying away from unnecessary emotions and unnecessary connections. Her life is clearly planned, and she values ​​peace and control. But one day her routine is shattered by terrible news: her younger sister, known for her love of risk and adventure, died under mysterious circumstances. The shock and pain haunts Mel, forcing her to relive the memories again and again. She goes on a long journey to retrieve her sister's body, but gradually begins to understand that something in this story is not right. The details don't add up, and the disparate facts lead to creepy assumptions. Her investigation uncovers a truth that turns out to be much darker than she could have imagined. The deeper she digs, the more she realizes: her sister's death is just part of a dangerous game where the stakes are too high. And now Mel herself becomes a target.

title: When mom is a killer
description: High school senior Ellie leads her debate team to victory, much to the delight of her principal father Nathan and teacher mother Marion. But Ellie's good-girl status is challenged when she makes eye contact with a handsome boy after the debate and secretly plans to join the club with "bad girl" Nancy, against her best friend Isley. Despite the fact that Ellie runs away from the kinovibe.co house very unsuccessfully and does not obey her parents at all, it is clear why she wants to escape: Marion is the personification of parental care, and simply suffocates her daughter with care. Nancy, who borrowed Ellie's jacket, throws an unknown killer off the cliff of Gib. Allie immediately catches her mother in a lie, but it takes several more events, such as Nancy filing a complaint against Marion, which put her on administrative leave, for Allie to begin investigating her mother's dark past... Suspicious: Why does Marion not like to be photographed and why does she insist that she not be on social media? Why do they never visit the family and talk about the past? Why is Marion so eager to infantilize Ellie? And why is she lying to Chief Jones about leaving in her car the night of Nancy's murder?

title: A woman in black
description: It is not easy for Arthur Kipps to leave his 4-year-old son alone, but urgent matters require the presence of a man. He intends to compile a description of the documents of the late owner of the Il-Marsh House estate in a short period of time, and then return home. Arriving at the place, Arthur is surprised - the local residents show inhospitality and do not make contact. He soon realizes that he has encountered an incomprehensible mystery. Deaths of children are constantly happening in the district, which no one can stop. Everything resembles a terrible accident, but Kipps is sure that something mystical and inexplicable is happening. At the cemetery, Arthur will see a woman dressed in black, but cannot communicate with the mysterious person, and leaves as soon as she realizes that she has been noticed. Next, a series of deaths that are chilling to horrifying continues. All fans of thrillers and horror films will enjoy watching the film "The Woman in Black" (2012) live in Ukrainian.

title: Love at your fingertips
description: Rosa, like all other residents of the province, was used to a measured lifestyle and there were no surprises in it. She was engaged to the most prestigious groom, her days were filled with worries about home and family. But meeting Louis changed everything. His mysterious eyes and attractive smile made Rosa's heart beat faster. Luis offered her a trip full of adventures and dangers. Rosa could not refuse such an offer - it was something new, unexplored. They set off, despite all the obstacles and displeasure of those around them. Together they had to conquer the whole world and discover new facets of strength and stability. Rosa was no longer tied to the province and her former life - now she was ready to start with a clean slate, next to Louis.

title: The most beautiful girl in the world
description: In order to receive the inheritance of his influential and wealthy father, he must fulfill his last wish - to find and marry the most beautiful woman in the world. Not wanting to lose the opportunity to get rich, the man decides to create a unique reality show in which he will become the main character, choosing his future wife from among the participants. However, everything changes when he meets Kiara, a self-confident, sharp-tongued producer of the project. Her strong character, intelligence, and charm quickly endear Ruben, and he begins to question whether he should follow the established rules. After all, according to the terms of the show, he must make a choice only among its participants. Ruben is faced with a difficult dilemma: to follow his heart and risk everything, or to stick to the plan and receive the dream inheritance. Will he be able to make a choice that will give him true happiness without losing everything he so longed to get?

title: The boys of the Mehta Family
description: Mehta's son Amai has been searching for his calling all his life. Although he is a smart and diligent professional, he lacks the confidence to prove himself at work. He moves around the office like a ghost, not having the courage to speak even when he has very valuable thoughts. His boss sees potential in him, but cannot convince him that he is important to the company. The only person who truly believes in him is his girlfriend Zara. She tries to support him and does not allow him to settle for mediocrity. She recognizes his talent and realizes that if he could overcome his doubts, he would achieve a lot. Meanwhile, Amay's father Shiv Mehta faces his own problems. He is a reserved person with firm principles, and he is haunted by grief from the loss of his beloved wife. Although he always followed discipline and tradition, the absence of his wife left a huge void in his life. Even in this state of mourning, he remains cold and cannot openly show his feelings. His relationship with his son has always been so dry that during his wife's funeral, he carelessly thanks even his own son for his presence. Amai, who lives in Mumbai, has returned to his hometown Navsari in Gujarat after the terrible news of his mother's death. However, the real turning point in the relationship between father and son begins when sister Amaya, who has been the link between them, makes a decisive decision. Understanding Shiva's loneliness and realizing his stubbornness, she decides to take the initiative into her own hands. She plans to move her father to the United States. But due to unexpected circumstances, Shiv finds himself forced to move to Amaya in Mumbai.

title: A delicacy
description: A wealthy German family decides to spend the summer holidays at a remote villa in a picturesque corner of France, seeking to escape from the daily routine and regain strength. They dream of enjoying silence, nature and feeling true harmony far from the city bustle. The vacation seems perfect until one day their peace is disturbed by an unexpected encounter. On the side of the road, they find an injured woman who was involved in an accident. Having decided to help a stranger, the family invites her into their home, not even suspecting that this noble act will be the beginning of a series of mysterious and disturbing events. At first, the guest seems to be the victim of an accident, but gradually the surrounding atmosphere changes, and the woman's behavior raises more and more questions. What began as an act of kindness turns into a real ordeal as dark secrets surface and the line between reality and hidden threats blurs.

title: Chaos: The Manson Murders
description: The film gradually reveals the dark and complicated case related to the murders committed by Manson's followers and questions the official versions of the events of the 1960s. In the course of the investigation, shocking details emerge: connections with government agencies, the possible influence of mind control experiments, and the role of key figures of the era who may have had a hidden influence on the course of events. Particular attention is paid to Manson's ties to the CIA, controversial trials and the controversial actions of famous figures such as Vincent Bigloosi and Jack Ruby. The tape reveals new facts that make you reconsider the established ideas about one of the most mysterious criminal cases, offering an alternative view of the events that shocked the world.

title: Man's best friend
description: The cheetah runs at an incredibly high speed. A chameleon knows how to disguise itself under the terrain of the environment. A cat can instantly climb the tallest tree. A bear is an incredibly strong animal. A dog named Max combines many advantages of representatives of the animal world, because he was genetically bred in a secret laboratory. It is quite possible that Max would have spent the rest of his days in the laboratory like this, if not for a coincidence of circumstances. TV journalist Laura Tanner managed to secretly enter the territory of the Max company, where she discovered the dog.

title: Live
description: The main character, Mr. Williams, is engaged in public service and is having a difficult time experiencing the loss of his beloved wife. This person, who has lost the meaning of life, sinks into depression, unable to find a way out of his inner darkness. Even the work that used to bring him pleasure loses its meaning. However, soon Williams' life is turned upside down again when he learns of a terrible diagnosis that predicts his quick death. This news becomes a heavy blow for the hero, which deprives him of his last illusions about the future. Being on the verge of despair, Williams manages to find support and inspiration in an unexpected source - his colleague Margaret. Her strength, optimism and life wisdom help a man to regain faith in himself and in the meaning of life. Margaret becomes for him not only a support, but also a source of new ideas and inspiration. Under her influence, the main character begins to see the world differently, rethinking his values ​​and priorities. Together with her, the man continues to work on his projects, finding a new meaning in his life in creativity and the desire for self-realization. All this leads to a new understanding of life, where hope and inspiration are born even in the most hopeless situations.

title: Boom
description: Vic, a teenager, faces new difficulties: she has started studying at a different school, wants to make friends and fall in love for the first time. Together with her friend Penelope, she wants to get to an important party, but her parents, François and Françoise, do not want to let her go. However, wise great-grandmother Puppet helps the girl find a way to get permission. While Vic is building a relationship with her boyfriend Mathieu, her parents are going through their own struggles. François cheats on his wife and cannot stand the pressure when his lover demands to spend one last night with him. He confesses to his betrayal, but Françoise does not remain indifferent: she begins an affair with the German teacher, Eric, and learns that she is pregnant by François.

title: Roadside club / Roadside establishment
description: An interesting story about how a person is ready to stand up for ordinary people. The main character is a young guy named Dalton. This man gets a job as a bouncer in a simple cafe. But not because of money or tips. The protagonist really cares about the peace of Missouri residents. Dalton makes sure that no one attacks or robs people. Therefore, he wants to exterminate all thieves, hooligans and murderers. This is why the man got a job in a cafe. To guarantee people's safety and restore justice. The main character really dislikes crimes and just bad deeds. And now he manages to show his authority in the city, and now the level of crime has decreased. Dalton cannot help but be proud of this. But now a new problem appears. The director of the institution where the boy works decided to cash in on his valiant name. Now the institution has gained an excellent reputation, due to this, the director tries to rob ordinary people, sometimes even with impure methods, threats and violence. Everyone in the city is afraid of this man and hopes that he will not come to them. And only the brave Dalton is again ready to help ordinary people get rid of this racketeer. Will the main character succeed in helping ordinary people avoid meeting with a criminal? Will he be able to secure the city alone?

title: Kon-Tiki
description: The adventure picture, based on the feat of the world-famous traveler Tur Heyerdahl, made an epic expedition in 1947 - crossing the Pacific Ocean on a small wobbly Kon-Tiki raft. Giant whales, fights with hungry sharks, a thunderstorm that rips the wind, a battle for life in the middle of the raging elements... The movie "Kon-Tiki" (2012) will be enjoyed by all fans of historical adventure films in Ukrainian.

title: Conflict of love interests
description: The focus of this story will be Scarlett - a young woman who knows how to make an impression. With an air of unwavering confidence, a dazzling smile and a sharp mind, she flits effortlessly through life, leaving a trail of charm and intrigue wherever she goes. Known among her friends as a heartthrob, Scarlett avoids emotional complications. To her, commitment is just another word for losing control, and she's too focused on her goals to let that happen. As a talented and ambitious photographer, Scarlett dreams of only one thing: landing her dream job under the esteemed Joan, an iconic figure in the world of art and photography and - coincidentally - the mother of her boss, Jenny. Scarlett knows that working with Joan will not only skyrocket her career, but also justify the years of hard work and kinovibe.co hustle she has put into her craft. But attracting Joan's attention is not easy. Scarlett realizes that the key to impressing Joan is to stay close to Jenny, her somewhat clumsy but sweet boss who seems to be perpetually unlucky in love. Jenny, unlike Scarlett, is a hopeless romantic. She dreams of candlelit dinners, walks in the rain, and someone who will kill her outright. Unfortunately, self-doubt always sabotages her dates before they can turn into anything meaningful. Sensing an opportunity to kill two birds with one stone, Scarlett volunteers to be Jenny's "assistant" and introduces her to the charming Lucas, who immediately catches Jenny's attention. But as Scarlett watches Lucas and Jenny grow closer, she begins to realize that she is falling in love for the first time in her life.

title: Brutalist
description: In search of a new life and unknown opportunities, a young couple decides to leave behind their familiar world and go to America, where dreams can become reality. Laszlo Toth, a talented architect, and his wife Erzbet, full of hope and ambition, strive to create a future that lives up to their high ideals. Their path crosses with a mysterious and influential client, Harrison Van Buren, who opens the door to a grandiose project for them. This charismatic businessman becomes the catalyst for their quest for success, promising that their joint venture will change not only their lives, but also the face of the entire country. However, this unexpected turn of events brings with it not only new opportunities, but also challenges that will threaten their relationship and life values. As they begin work on an ambitious modernist project, the couple faces tensions and sacrifices they never expected. The success that seemed so desirable turns into a burden that requires incredible effort and willingness to give up important aspects of their lives. Each step on the way to the realization of the American dream becomes a test that tests their creative potential and personal priorities. Gradually, an internal conflict grows between Laszlo and Erzbet, which forces them to reconsider their ideals and ask themselves what price they are willing to pay for their ambitions. Against the backdrop of magnificent architectural designs and picturesque landscapes, they begin to realize that the true price of the dream may turn out to be much higher than they assumed.

title: Rags / Rags
description: Charlie is an ordinary teenager who does not differ from other peers. More than anything in the world, he dreams of becoming a famous rock star, but the boy's stepfather is quite skeptical about his musical inclination. Young Cady Worth is a little more lucky in this regard, because, despite her age, she is already quite a well-known performer. Her songs have earned the recognition of listeners, and occupy the first places in various music charts. It would seem that she is doing well in the musical field, but this is only at first glance. The fact is that the young star's father, who is at the head of a reputable recording studio, in his desire to arrange his daughter's career, has long stopped paying attention to her personal wishes and preferences. One day, Charlie gets a job as a janitor in the same studio, and soon a strong friendship is established between him and Cady. Somehow fate gives the boy a good chance to prove himself: one of the producers working at the studio offers Charlie not only to record a test disc, but also to perform at an upcoming masquerade party, where his new acquaintance will also perform. Fearing his stepfather's reaction, the hero goes on stage in a mask, taking the pseudonym "Regs". Kady liked the mysterious artist so much that she decides to find him and asks Charlie to help her in this. While the girl does not even know that this person is very close...

title: Luck and excitement
description: The owner of a unique voice that could conquer world stages, Luigi dreamed of a career as a singer all his life. He envisioned standing ovations, tours, and raving fans, but the reality turned out to be harsher—talent alone was not enough to succeed. Left with nothing, he is forced to work as a cleaner in an elementary school, putting his ambitions on the back burner. However, everything changes after a random act — he saves a stranger from being hit by a motorcycle. Lonely and disillusioned, Luigi unexpectedly finds new friends who accept him unconditionally. Together they spend time playing board games and cards, and unexpectedly for himself he begins to win significant sums. Fascinated by easy money and attention, Luigi gradually drifts away from his old dream, plunging into a world of gambling that promises quick wins but hides dangerous traps.

title: Victory over the darkness / Defeating the darkness
description: Nate Williams, who is tormented by painful memories from his childhood, finds himself in a deep abyss. When his drama mentor, Mr. Dean, pulls him out of the prison walls and offers him asylum, Nate must face the shadows of his past. It becomes critical for him to deal with what oppresses his soul before this dark monster leads him to the final disaster. The teacher not only gives Nate a chance for a new start, but also opens the door to a world full of opportunities and threats. The student must overcome his inner fears and accept important lessons from his life in order to free himself from the burden that drags him down. It will be a difficult but necessary struggle, as Nate must understand that only through the awareness of his pain and acceptance of it will he be able to avoid ultimate destruction and build his life anew.

title: Lords of Chaos
description: In the Norway of the 1980s, a new musical trend is forming, which turns the idea of ​​heavy metal upside down. A young guy from a wealthy family, obsessed with black metal, renounces his past and takes the pseudonym Euronymous. Full of ideas about creating something truly extreme, he unites with like-minded people and founds a band that quickly becomes cult in narrow circles. But music is not enough for them - they strive to transfer their dark philosophy to real life. Burnt churches, shocking performances, ominous aesthetics and dangerous games with ideology gradually take them too far. What started as a challenge to society turns into a real series of creepy events.

title: Please Do Not Destroy - Foggy Mountain Treasure / Please Do Not Destroy: FOGGY MOUNTAIN TREASURE
description: One day, the French marine explorer Jean Pierre Leroche decided to steal the priceless gold bust of Marie Antoinette, which was kept in the Palace of Versailles. He stole the treasure and, escaping with it to America, discovered that he was terminally ill. Realizing that he will not be able to enjoy the money from the sale of the antique, he hid it before his death in the depths of the Misty Mountain, having previously created a key map that leads to the legendary treasure, with the hope that the most daring adventurer in the world will find it and, having managed to solve the riddle, provide himself with a safe life until old age. However, everything turned out to be completely wrong and the card accidentally fell into the hands of three carefree loser friends who recently turned twenty-six years old, and they, as before, lived in the same apartment as students and worked in a fishing shop as consultants. Realizing that fate itself gave them a chance to change their lives, they decided to go in search of gold, not knowing what a series of difficult trials they would soon have to face.

title: Here and now
description: In New England there is an ordinary house in which a simple American family lives. People were born, rejoiced and grieved here for almost a century. One of them was Richard, who was born in the 1950s. The boy grew up surrounded by the care of his parents. Time flew by, and soon he introduced his future bride to his relatives. Together with Margaret, they created a strong nucleus of society and had children. The living room became a place of joyful and sad events. Old age crept up imperceptibly, and the heroes became grandparents. Nyanchas with grandchildren, they understand that their time is gradually passing. One room holds the memories of entire generations. It doesn't take much effort to remember everything that happened within these walls. Only in your own home can you find support and realize how much you value moments surrounded by loved ones, regardless of the era.

title: Death of Putin
description: The Death of Putin is a profound, provocative and multi-layered film that deftly combines real events, satire and authorial reimagining to create a striking portrait of one of the most controversial dictators of our time. The tape reproduces dozens of key moments from Putin's life, highlighting not only the known facts, but also what remained behind the scenes - his weaknesses, complexes and baseness, which shaped his brutal policy. The film not only reflects the history of the formation of one dictatorship, but also allows the audience to look behind the scenes of propaganda to see the true face of the government, which for years kept the whole world in fear. The satirical tone of the film emphasizes the absurdity and tragedy of the regime that created destruction, chaos and death for millions of people. This is more than just a movie, it is a symbolic call for change, an opportunity to imagine the end of a bloody reign that has left deep wounds in the history of the modern world. The film becomes not only a work of art, but also an emotional response to humanity's long-standing desire to see the end of the era of fear, violence and impunity.

title: Bastion 36
description: An experienced police officer, who recently transferred to the organized crime unit, unexpectedly finds himself in a whirlwind of dangerous events. When two of his former colleagues are brutally murdered within a day, he embarks on his own investigation to find the culprits. The situation becomes even more tense when another ex-partner mysteriously disappears. Digging deeper, the man begins to understand that these crimes are only the tip of the iceberg. The real threat lies in a conspiracy that has permeated the very ranks of the police, and he will have to risk everything to get to the truth.

title: super girl
description: A young girl from Krypton arrives on Earth with an important mission - to find and return a powerful artifact without which her home world is doomed. This mysterious object, possessing incredible power, finds itself in the hands of a dangerous sorceress who seeks to use it to implement her ambitious plans. Armed with dark magic and the support of a loyal accomplice, she sets out to conquer the world, unaware that standing in her way is the heir to Kryptonian power. Having found herself in a new world, the girl is forced not only to adapt to life among people, but also to reveal her own potential in order to repel a powerful enemy. Extraordinary abilities help her in the fight, but the main test is not only in strength, but also in fortitude. The fierce battle for the artifact turns into a real war between good and evil, where every step can decide the fate of not only the Earth, but the entire universe.

title: In the company of men
description: In the center of the events of the picture, there are several main characters who have to deal with difficulties due to the global economic crisis. Bobby Walker is the vice president of a shipbuilding company, a forty-year-old businessman who supports a family, a huge house in the suburbs, an expensive car, and is fond of golf. And so this person immediately loses his prestigious job and former income, his shipbuilding company falls apart. Bob tries to prove to himself and others that the situation is under control and there are many companies that will hire him. But after some time he has to return to the very origins, as money is getting less and less, and the situation does not even think of stabilizing.

title: In search of wind
description: Ege Yaziji is a young man whose father owns a large company. Soon after completing his studies, the hero returns to his homeland and immerses himself in an atmosphere of complete carefreeness. He refuses his father's offer to join his company and devotes himself entirely to surfing. The situation suddenly changes when Asla's girlfriend arrives at Ege Bay. She is an incorrigible careerist who thinks only about work and money. Due to the financial crisis, her company was on the verge of bankruptcy, and now the heroine is doing everything to stay afloat. He offers Ege to build a large hotel on his bay, which would improve her financial situation. The guy answers with a refusal, not suspecting that some truly crazy events will follow.

title: Wrong way
description: Emily, a 30-year-old mother, has long felt lost in life. She is trying to make ends meet, but problems persist: financial difficulties, lack of support and a fight with her ex-husband for child custody. When an unexpected accident forces her to leave her own apartment, the only way out is to move into her wealthy brother's house. He is ready to help, but puts forward an unusual condition - his sister must participate in a sports competition with him. With no experience whatsoever, especially in winter sports, Emily initially finds the idea silly. However, with no alternatives, she agrees, not imagining that this adventure will turn her life upside down. What at first seems like a real challenge gradually turns into a chance to rethink yourself, find inner strength and open the door to a new future full of faith, determination and hope.

title: A stylish thing
description: Melanie Carmichael, a famous New York fashion designer, falls asleep at night thinking about a mysterious bachelor from the big city. It seemed to her that such a romantic ideal simply could not exist in reality, but one day everything changed. A meeting with this mysterious man turned her world upside down, forcing her to think about her past relationships. However, trying to understand herself and her feelings, Melanie finds herself in the very center of a whirlwind of the past. Remembering Jake, her ex-husband, she realizes that peace is not so easy to find. Having decided to close the door to the past forever, she goes to distant Alabama, hoping for a new beginning. There, not only memories await her, but also new challenges that will help her find her true happiness and understand what it means to be herself in this world.

title: Dogs - soldiers / Dogs-warriors
description: A detachment of British soldiers under the command of Sergeant Wells was sent to the wild forests of mountainous Scotland on a combat mission. At first glance, it seemed like just a training exercise, but soon everything turned into a real nightmare - the soldiers arrived at a secret military base and faced a terrible picture: the bleeding captain Ryan and the torn remains of his subordinates. The tension in the air was palpable, it seemed that every line of the sheet could be a harbinger of a new threat. Sergeant Wells and his squad were on the verge of panic, but they had to gather all their strength and solve the mystery of this nightmarish event. Strange sounds and shadows in the forest forced the soldiers to strain all their senses - every step could turn out to be the last. The war they waged was not only with an external enemy, but also with unknown forces lurking in the dark corners of the mountains.

title: Ad Vitam
description: In their own home, a former special services agent and his wife become victims of an attack by criminals. They find themselves involved in a dangerous game in which the hero will have to face the dark pages of his past. The attackers use shocking methods to force him to reveal hidden secrets, challenging his courage and intelligence. During this tense situation, the couple must show determination and ingenuity to survive and figure out who is behind these events.

title: Longing
description: In a big city, a successful businessman unexpectedly meets a woman from his past - his first and, as it turns out, unforgettable love. She came from a small settlement, and their chance meeting instantly takes both of them back to the days of their youth, when everything seemed simpler and their feelings were sincere and boundless. Memories of carefree days when they were together fill the heart with warmth, but this meeting brings more than just nostalgia. Suddenly, a man learns about the secrets of the past, which change his view of everything he believed to be true. What seemed like a finished story long ago, actually has much deeper roots. It turns out that there is an inseparable connection between them, which he did not even know about, and this truth instantly divides his life into "before" and "after". He understands that he is faced with a choice: to continue his usual stable reality or to risk everything for a new chance.

title: A love story in Copenhagen
description: The writer, who long ago lost faith in true love, unexpectedly meets a man who changes her life. He is a caring father, kind and considerate, and a deep bond quickly develops between them. The woman feels real feelings for the first time in a long time, but their happiness is overshadowed by a difficult test: the couple learns that they cannot have children on their own due to health problems. In search of a way out, they turn to an infertility treatment clinic, their lives change radically. Constant procedures, hormone therapy, and planned moments of intimacy begin to take a toll on their relationship, testing their love and endurance. But will they be able to overcome all the difficulties and keep what is really important to them?

title: You Hurt My Feelings / You insult me
description: Beth was always a strong and independent woman who was used to getting her way in any situation. But after her husband expresses his outrage over her new affair, she realizes that she no longer wants to be in a relationship where her talent and work are not appreciated. Faced with the decision to separate from her husband, Beth begins a new chapter in her life full of uncertainty and opportunity. She realized that now the door to new creative heights was opening for her and that she was capable of much more than just being a wife and muse for her husband. Having parted with the past, she felt that she was finding herself and her strength again.

title: Boom 2
description: The action takes the viewer two years forward after the previous events. Victoria has grown up, but her life remains full of problems. Her parents, François and Françoise, take care of their youngest son and other household chores. They cannot always understand their children and find a common language with Victoria. At the age of fifteen, the girl, like many of her peers, seriously experiences her emotions, thinks about great love, her first sexual experience and wants to become an adult sooner. Victoria wants to find her place in life, fearing that the best is behind her. However, a chance meeting with the attractive Philip gives her hope and inspiration for new dreams. The changes taking place in her daughter do not go unnoticed by the mother. Françoise understands that Victoria is approaching an important stage in her life, and will soon say goodbye to her childhood. But there is still time to influence your daughter, to direct her energy in the right direction, so that she makes a choice that she will not regret.

title: Cursed
description: Everything is so ghostly in this cursed life. Man lives in illusions, but still hopes for happiness and blessings of heaven. The story takes place in the 19th century. In the center of the plot is a widow who has to make an unrealistic choice. In the region where she lives, a brutal winter has come, this year is particularly cold, the inhabitants of the local village are warming themselves as best they can. One day a foreign ship sinks near the shores of this fishing village. It would seem that this is completely unrelated to the main character, the authorities should take care of such things. But since this fishing village is located in the middle of nowhere, you will not expect any emergency help. But how can the main character help a foreign ship sunk near the shores of her village? As it was said above, she faces a difficult choice, but that is always the case in a person's life. You need to learn to choose. Sometimes, a lot depends on the correct choice. The main character's life is supposedly divided into before and after, but she doesn't know how to be.

title: Mercy will win
description: Brian is stuck in the darkness of his own addictions, where the past presses down on him, making him unable to breathe. His lover stays by his side, hoping to show him the light beyond pain and despair. Together with an unusual psychologist who uses unconventional treatment methods, he dares to face his fears. His path is full of trials, but faith, support and the power of love become a saving compass for him. Step by step, he overcomes his inner shadows, finds harmony and experiences a deep spiritual rebirth.

title: Love without problems
description: The film makes us think about our true goals and priorities. Sophia, being an intellectual and a highly educated person, most valued spiritual growth and intangible values. She believed that she found her happiness in books and philosophy. She likes her life in Montreal and what she has achieved through hard mental work. The other main character is the complete opposite of the girl who received the title of professor and moved around in high society. Sylvain is a hardworking and kind man, he grew up in the Laurentian Mountains. He knows carpentry skills perfectly, but he understands little in the works of Spinoza and Kant. At the same time, he is a sensitive person, ready to help at any moment. Behind his external severity hides a sensitive and vulnerable soul. The meeting of the heroes forced them to reconsider their own priorities. They learn from each other unfamiliar things. Sofia rethinks her values ​​and understands - despite the differences and contradictions, she and Sylvain are made for each other. "The Nature of Love" is a story about how meeting a person who seems like a complete stranger can change you and your life. He shows that true love can overcome any differences and bring new meaning to life.

title: The treasure of the nation
description: A team of desperate treasure hunters led by a seasoned explorer uncovers an ancient legend that leads them in the footsteps of America's founding fathers. George Washington, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson allegedly left coded clues leading to a huge treasure hidden back in the formative days of the state. Solving complex puzzles step by step, the team embarks on a dangerous journey, where not only the secrets of the past await them, but also those who are ready to go to any lengths to get hold of the legendary riches.

title: Gorge
description: Two snipers, representing elite special forces, found themselves involved in a mysterious and risky operation. Their task is to guard the opposite slopes of a deep and inaccessible gorge, which hides many unknown dangers. Despite the fact that each of them is in complete isolation, both have no idea what threat awaits them at the bottom of this bottomless ravine. In these cruel and dangerous conditions, where every step can be the last, two people begin to develop an unusual bond. During the mission, they discover a kindred spirit in each other, seeking to understand and support each other. Sometimes even in the most critical situations there is an opportunity for humanity and warmth, which makes their interaction especially meaningful. Fearing for their lives and the lives of each other, snipers become not only protectors, but also a support for each other in this complex and harsh world.

title: Night on the 12th
description: In the corridors of the police department, it is often said that every investigator has such a case, which does not give him peace at all and gradually turns into an obsessive idea and obsession. The talented detective Johan was appointed head of the Grenoble department, which investigates particularly high-profile and complex crimes. Johan soon begins an investigation into Clara's strange murder, with a minimum of facts. As the gifted detective becomes obsessed with tracking down Clara's killer, he is forced to join forces with a mysterious man named Marco.

title: A quiet girl
description: The action of the film takes place in the 1980s. The main characters are a provincial family that lives very modestly and tries to fight poverty. The parents are more concerned with their own problems, and the little heroine, a quiet girl, remains deprived. None of the elders pay attention to her. Her quiet disposition turned not only into silence, but also into extreme timidity. In the summer, parents send their daughter to distant relatives, where she finds understanding and care, which she lacked so much in her native home. The film interweaves emotions hidden under the mask of indifference. This is not just a picture, but a meditative immersion into the inner world of the characters, their indescribable feelings and thoughts. In the opening and final scenes, you can hear the call of the cuckoo, a bird that throws chicks into other people's nests. This decision became a reference to the main problem of the story.

title: Escape for the weekend
description: He is special agent Alex Steele, known for his impeccable operations and the reputation of a man who has no impossible missions. She is Lana Cruz, the best transporter in the service of a dangerous criminal syndicate, capable of delivering any cargo, no matter how risky it may be. Their paths have already crossed in the past - they were not only partners, but also passionate lovers until they found themselves on opposite sides of the law. Fate brings them together again during a dangerous task: Alex must stop the smuggling of secret technologies that Lana is tasked with delivering. During the pursuit of cargo and rapid clashes with enemies, they will not only have to play a deadly game, but also fight against something stronger than them - with feelings that flare up again.

title: Sunrise / Dawn: A Song of Two People
description: An ordinary village farmer, who spends most of his time in the field with his cattle, meets a charming young girl on his way. The urban beauty charms him at first sight, and he can no longer imagine life without her. Now he is ready to give up everything and go after the lady of the heart, only another woman stands in his way - his wife. The new lover forces the man to get rid of the obstacle, and they come up with a plan of action. He must invite his wife to the lake for a boat ride, and when they swim away, throw her into the water. In this way, the woman's death will look like an accident, and no one will prevent them from being together. But can a man take this step? The film "Sunrise / Dawn: The Song of Two People" (1927) will be enjoyed by all fans of Ukrainian dramas.

title: Sniper: The Last Battle
description: In this dangerous mission, Beckett is faced with an unusual role for himself: now he will have to not only follow orders, but also give them, which becomes a real test for an experienced sniper. In his team, he finds an inexperienced sniper who needs mentoring and support. Beckett must not only teach the newcomer, but also cope with the pressure of being responsible for the lives of his comrades. In conditions of limited time and running out of ammunition, the squad will have to overcome many difficulties, including hostile terrain and confrontation with well-prepared opponents.

title: you again
description: Yes, in the lives of many people, school years were not the best, especially if your appearance was far from the ideal of beauty. The heroine of the comedy film You're a Young Girl Again Marnie does not want to remember her school days, because she was constantly bullied by one arrogant person JJ. Over the years, Marnie improved, became a real beauty, made a good career and took the position of vice president of the New York branch of a large PR company. Going to her native land for her beloved brother's wedding, Marnie is horrified to learn that her brother's bride is the same JJ who bullied her at school. Marnie's family accepted Joanna as their own daughter, which upsets Marnie, but everything changes when Marnie's mother Gail meets Joanna's aunt Ramona, with whom they were best friends in school, but had a falling out for unknown reasons. The wedding excitement is exacerbated by old resentments and reproaches of former classmates.

title: Elias
