description: A former special forces soldier who endured the hardships and stresses of serving in Afghanistan is facing a deteriorating mental state. Despite his experiences, he receives an offer to become a bodyguard for Amina and her daughter Noor. This is an important mission that requires not only physical readiness, but also emotional stability. Understanding the seriousness of the situation, he takes on his new role. Each meeting with Amina and Nur awakens in him internal contradictions and memories of the past, which become a real test. While ensuring the safety of the women, he begins to realize that his own life and safety also need attention. Being close to them, he tries to cope not only with the threats of the outside world, but also with his own demons. This story touches on important themes of courage, protection, and finding inner peace in the face of constant stress.

title: Mufasa: The Lion King
description: In the center of the story are Simba's loyal friends who stayed with him, only now the obsessed Timon and Pumbaa look after the young son of the young lion king. Once on a walk, they sat down a baby lion cub and told him an amazing story about his brave grandfather. Mufasa was born in an ordinary family of lions, but for his courage and strength, the beasts bowed down to him, and when the time came, they chose him as their king. The childhood of the future great king of beasts cannot be called happy. Mufasa himself learned to find food and survive in the harsh conditions of the wild, where danger awaited the lion around every corner. One day he falls into a raging current of water, there is nowhere to wait for rescue. Suddenly, Mufasa saw a branch floating past him, he grabbed onto it and kept afloat. While the brave lion fought for his life, his duel with the waterfall was watched by Scar. The brother was very different from the kind and fair Mufasa, who was loved by everyone around him. He silently envied him, but always waited for the moment when he could take revenge.

title: Death in a diner. Mysteries of Aurora Teagarden
description: The mysterious death of the owner of the diner becomes the beginning of a series of shocking events. Aurora Teagarden, one of the employees of the institution, finds herself at the epicenter of the scandal when her new boyfriend becomes the main suspect in the murder. Unwilling to believe his involvement, she embarks on her own investigation, plunging into a tangled world of secrets, deception, and ulterior motives. The more Aurora learns, the more dangerous her game becomes, because revealing the truth can change not only her life, but also the fate of many residents of the city. But, to her surprise, she realizes that this search for the truth brings her real excitement and awakens in her something more than just curiosity.

title: Dolce villa
description: Eric is a successful businessman who is used to controlling his life and making exclusively rational decisions. His career is on the rise, financial affairs are stable, and the future seems predictable. However, everything changes when he learns about his daughter's unexpected act. She intends to spend all her savings on buying an old, dilapidated villa in Tuscany. Considering this decision reckless and unacceptable, Eric postpones all matters and urgently leaves for Italy to stop his daughter before it is too late. He is confident that he will quickly manage the situation, but Italy is preparing its own surprises for him. Landscapes, atmosphere and unpredictable events make him look at life differently. Instead of simply dissuading his daughter from buying, he himself begins to change his priorities. An unexpected meeting with a person who awakens long-forgotten feelings in him turns his world upside down. Tuscany, which seemed to him only a background for solving a family conflict, becomes a place of rethinking and a new start. In this journey, Eric not only finds a common language with his daughter, but also discovers for himself what he always lacked - the true beauty of life, sincere love and the opportunity to start anew.

title: Keepers of the forest
description: A double life is always full of difficulties, and when mysticism is added to it, the situation becomes even more complicated. A boy named Karag, who at first glance seems like an ordinary teenager, carries a secret: he is a werewolf who can transform into a graceful and dangerous cougar. However, this unique ability brings not only advantages, but also numerous problems. The life of Karag, who grew up in the desert, changes dramatically after being invited to a special school for people like him. Here he is taught to control his transformations, discover the secrets of the werewolf community and meet new friends. It would seem that everything is starting to fall into place in the new environment, but peace is held on a thin line. The sudden appearance of a mysterious enemy threatens to destroy the already strained relationship between werewolves and ordinary people. Karag, together with his new companions, must overcome a series of trials to protect his loved ones and defend the harmony between the two worlds. Will he be able to find the strength for this struggle and maintain balance in a life that seems endlessly difficult?

title: Death before the wedding
description: When Maya decides to introduce her fiancé to the family, she has no idea how difficult this step will turn out to be. Her parents, deeply attached to their traditions, are not ready to accept the new reality so easily, because their beliefs, tested by time, clash with their daughter's modern views. But for Maya, this is not just an acquaintance - it is a test that will show whether her family can overcome their own stereotypes for the sake of her happiness. Tensions rise when it is revealed that the family dairy farm is on the brink of crisis, adding even more chaos to the situation. But even in the face of difficulties, each of them must make a difficult choice: will they preserve their principles at the cost of losing a loved one, or will they be able to open up to something new and find a compromise that will unite the family instead of dividing it?

title: Unexpected Oxford / Surprised by Oxford
description: When the gifted American Carolyn Drake learns that she has received a scholarship to study at Oxford, her joy is boundless. Having moved to England, she focuses on her goal - to get a doctorate, completely avoiding student entertainment. But fate gives her a surprise in the form of the charming Kent Weber, who unexpectedly bursts into her life. Carolyn, who had never thought about love before, is now faced with new emotions and experiences. For the first time, she begins to see that there can be room for something more in her life than just academic achievements. She learns to find a balance between learning and personal feelings, which leads to profound inner changes. Her story becomes an inspiring example of how career ambitions can be combined with the pursuit of personal happiness, and that true love can be a source of strength and motivation to achieve the highest goals.

title: derby You have a friend
description: The film tells about a touching story of friendship and mutual help. After the death of his parents, a boy named Bobby learns about his uncle's secret designed car, then together with a new friend, they decide to participate in the upcoming race with soap boxes. This film shows the importance of support, self-belief and the desire to win despite all difficulties.

title: Honeymoon with my mom
description: Life often throws up unexpected surprises, and for Lucas this surprise turned out to be quite unusual. On the day of the wedding, he is abandoned, leaving him in complete despair. But he is not the only one who finds himself in such a situation - his mother Lily also experiences a similar stroke of fate. And just when everything seems doomed, an unexpected opportunity appears on the horizon. Not wanting to lose the already planned trip, mother and son go together on their honeymoon to exotic Mauritius, which, of course, gives rise to a series of comical situations and misunderstandings. Finding themselves at the center of absurd adventures, they are forced to rethink their relationship, learn to look at life from a new angle, and maybe even find something more than just a vacation in this trip. Fun adventures, unpredictable challenges and many curious moments await them, which will prove that even in the most unexpected turns of fate, new meaning and true happiness can be found.

title: What we find on the road / On the road
description: On his eighteenth birthday, TJ receives an unexpected gift from his father, with whom he has not spoken for a long time. This is the key that opens not only the door of an old convertible from 1968, but also the way to a long trip across America. For the boy, this is not only an opportunity to see new places, but also a chance to find something much more important - answers to questions that have long troubled him. On the way, TJ meets unusual fellow travelers, each of whom leaves a mark on his life. Trials, unexpected discoveries and moments that will change him forever await him. But the main thing is that this journey can help him understand who he really is, and maybe get back what was lost years ago.

title: i see you
description: One day, in a small town located on the outskirts of America, where peace and tranquility reigned for decades, a ten-year-old boy disappears. The police, who set out to search, come to the conclusion that the child was kidnapped by the same serial maniac who operated here in the distant and long-forgotten past. Greg Harper, a talented detective who is going through a painful breakup with his hotly beloved wife Jackie, who betrayed him with his best friend, is assigned to investigate the case. Greg tried not to think about the broken marriage and the son who hated his mother for her treacherous departure. He focused all his attention on work, not suspecting that it was Jackie who would soon lead him to the place where the killer was hiding.

title: Intruder / Uninvited guest
description: A young man suffering from paranoia begins to believe that every night someone sneaks into his house. He becomes more and more obsessed with this thought, feeling paranoia take over his mind. Night silence and darkness begin to turn into sources of anxiety. Every sound causes him to panic, and he begins to check every corner of his home for evidence of his fear. The situation worsens when he begins to notice strange things - objects that move, noises that cannot be explained. Every day his paranoia only increases, and he loses touch with reality. Not understanding what is happening leads him to a state of exhaustion and anxiety. He tries to find support from loved ones, but even they cannot calm him down. In the end, his fears get the better of him, and he decides to find out who is really invading his space. This path will lead him to unexpected and disturbing discoveries.

title: Critic
description: In the heart of London, in 1934, events unfold that awaken true horror and curiosity. In the luxury of the hall of an elegant five-star hotel, two bright personalities meet: the brilliant actress Nina Land and the witty theater critic Jimmy Erskine. Their conversation, filled with irony and depth, affects not only the world of art, but also the threat that hangs over the city. A secret maniac, working in the night alleys, brings the entire capital into a state of fear. Trying to stay safe, Nina and Jimmy try to record their experiences and impressions, but every word spoken within the walls of this hotel becomes more and more significant against the background of impending danger. The interweaving of circumstances creates an atmosphere of tense anticipation, where every step can be fatal. Nina and Jimmy, whose lives are radically different, find themselves drawn into the same conflict with the dark side of human nature. As they explore the limits of trust and courage, they encounter a pernicious influence that could destroy not only their lives, but the very essence of society. In this unique collision of art and reality, they have to make a choice that will determine not only their destinies, but also the future of the entire city.

title: Princess
description: At the beginning of the plot, it may seem like a standard story about a girl locked in an impregnable tower, waiting for her savior. But in fact, the main character is a real princess who has to go through difficult trials. Against her will, they want to make her the wife of a cruel man who aspires to her father's throne. This union is beneficial only to a greedy applicant who sees the girl as a tool to achieve his goal. The princess realizes that it is useless to negotiate with a cruel groom, and she will have to protect the honor of her family and save the country from the future despot. Suddenly, a girl who knows martial arts becomes her ally. Together they begin a fierce struggle for freedom and justice. The heroine fights not only for herself, but also for the future of her people, showing that true strength lies in determination and courage. The film tells an exciting story about courage, self-sacrifice and fortitude. This is the story of how one brave girl defies fate and wins, defending her right to freedom and happiness. At the same time, she proves to the audience that even in the most difficult situations there is always room for courage and hope.

title: Life after the fight
description: In recent times, the world champion in martial arts, Alex Faulkner, opened his own sports school. However, his life changes dramatically when two schoolgirls go missing, and the police cannot reassure him with their actions. He decides not to wait for help and to figure out the situation on his own. During his search, he encounters a dangerous cartel engaged in child trafficking. This terrible discovery awakens in Alexey memories of what he was like in the past, when he performed at championships. He understands that he cannot stop until he finds the culprits and prevents the children from suffering further. The situation becomes a personal test for him, and he is ready to do anything to restore justice and bring the girls home.

title: Forgive me, Father
description: Mutilated bodies are found in a luxurious mansion, and an experienced detective begins to investigate, not even knowing how complicated the case will turn out to be. With each new piece of evidence, the tension grows, and the dark secrets of the past gradually come to the surface. But the real shock comes when an unexpected suspect appears, whose confession changes everything. Some secrets remain buried with the dead, while others become a danger to those who try to uncover them. The closer the detective gets to the truth, the higher the price becomes - and now not only the crime is solved, but her own life is at risk.

title: Night call
description: A student named Madi works as a locksmith and one day gets a call to help a girl open the door of her apartment. This routine order unexpectedly takes a dangerous turn when Madi finds himself on the doorstep of a robbed apartment, and the thugs start hunting him. They mistake him for an intruder and demand to bring them an accomplice who, according to them, ran away with the stolen money. Madi has only twelve hours to find the real criminal, clear her name and avoid serious trouble. There are not only bandits in his way, but also many obstacles that he must overcome using all his wits and cleverness. This situation forces Madi to show her best qualities: the ability to act in stressful conditions, find a way out of difficult situations and fight for her honesty. Every minute counts, and he is ready to do whatever it takes to get out of this crisis alive and unscathed.

title: Robbie Williams: Better man
description: Considerable attention to a cult personality in the music world, such as Robbie Williams, reveals before us an exciting path full of trials and triumphs. From early childhood, he felt isolated, which became the impetus for the desire for acceptance and love. Music was not just a hobby for him - it became a way to express his emotions and prove to his father that he is capable of great things. Joining one of the most popular bands of his time, Take That, gave him a chance to touch fame, but internal conflicts and mental trials constantly depressed him. The decision to leave the band and start a solo career marked a new stage in his life, opening the door to a real triumph. Each new album and hit only increased his popularity, but also exacerbated the inner demons that he had to fight. The confrontation with addictions and personal crises was invariably intertwined with brilliant performances on stage, which sometimes reached the limit. Despite his musical achievements, including the hits "Angels" and "Feel", Robbie continued to search for his true self. In the background of all this fame, he wonders what it's like to be human in a world that only sees him as a superstar. This struggle for authenticity becomes an important aspect of his story, reminding us that deep and sometimes painful emotional experiences lie behind the external brilliance.

title: Puppy love
description: This is a touching story about Nicole and Max, two people who were on the edge of despair in search of true love. Their first date turned into a real catastrophic failure, and they decided to break up, believing that they were not meant for each other. However, Nicole and Max's dogs, whose fates crossed in the park, bring them together. In a strange way, the furry four-legged friends begin to show incredible affection for each other, and their meetings lead to the unexpected union of two lonely hearts. When Nicole and Max try to separate their furry companions, they face serious difficulties. But as they learn to care for each other through caring for their dogs, they also begin to realize that they can find true love in each other. The movie "Puppy Love" teaches us that sometimes love comes into our lives through the most unexpected intermediaries and can change us forever.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
description: The employees of the secret organization "GON" get the documents of the mysterious "Shadow" project, which has not been heard of for many years. Under the labeling hides information about a hybrid hedgehog, whose genetic basis was combined with an aggressive race of alien creatures. Mad scientist Robotnik developed a unique Shadow from the DNA of the ruthless leader Black Doom, whose abilities intrigued the doctor. At the head of the extraterrestrial species is a collective mind that controls the wards, and the goal of the Black Arms is to absorb planets in the expanses of the galaxy. The creation of an anthropomorphic hedgehog is only a small part of a daring experiment in the development of original drugs. The robot is sure that the drug will be able to permanently eradicate deadly diseases, but the tests quickly get out of control. Eggman's "crown of 'creations'" turns out to be an arrogant and malevolent being endowed with immense power. Shadow considers himself an invincible champion, and the government sees a threat in a serious adversary. The military neutralizes the only instance of the experiment by placing it in a protective shell, but after decades in the capsule, the integrity is broken. Sonic is a black and red cruel hedgehog

title: Sanrei: A Fallen Soldier
description: A former soldier who lost his daughter under mysterious circumstances seeks to find and punish those involved in her death. He turns for help to his old friends, with whom he once shared a difficult service. Together, they begin an investigation to find the real perpetrators involved in this crime. During their search, they have to face a brutal crime syndicate that offers serious resistance. An influential and dangerous organization uses all available means to stop them. This becomes a test of their friendship and willpower. They must be united and determined in the fight for justice.

title: Christmas clouds
description: On the eve of Christmas, when the city was engulfed in pre-holiday commotion and anticipation of a miracle, fate brought two strangers together. They became accidental passengers on board the plane that was supposed to take them to their destination. Sitting in their seats, they had no idea that this flight would become something more than an ordinary trip for them. The sky faded beyond the portholes, and the lights of the cities below twinkled like distant stars until the plane entered the turbulence zone. Sudden jolts shook the cabin, causing the passengers to nervously look around for reassurances of safety. At this moment, amid the general excitement, the two strangers instinctively reached out their hands to each other for support. That accidental touch was the beginning of something bigger. What began as a gesture of mutual trust in a moment of fear gradually grew into warmth, understanding and feelings that unexpectedly changed their lives for both of them. Like a spark ignited by a light breath of wind, this meeting awakened something new in their hearts - the beginning of a story that could become a real Christmas miracle.

title: Asphalt jungle
description: The doctor's first year in Harlem began with many calls for gunfights, injuries from bad cops and hopeless cases with patients left to fend for themselves. Every day was a test for a young doctor who encountered black humor in the strangest situations where life and death went hand in hand. Despite all the difficulties and growing callousness, this doctor continued to fight for his desire to help people, realizing that in this area even a small good deed can change someone's life. The story of his first year of work became a story not only about medicine and street life, but also about willpower, about the ability to preserve humanity in the harshest conditions.

title: Boy in girl / Girl in boy / Boy in girl
description: Two neighbors who can't stand each other suddenly find themselves in a completely unusual situation. Woody Dean is the star of the high school football team, a confident handsome guy who is dating the most popular girl. Instead, Neilina Bedworth is a studious student who chooses books over parties and stays away from loud companies. They are from different worlds, and they seem to have nothing in common except mutual hatred. But one morning, everything changes - upon waking up, each of them realizes that they somehow strangely ended up in the other's body. Now Woody sees Neilina's fragile figure in the mirror, and she is forced to get used to the image of a carefree athlete. They have two ways: to use the situation to spite each other, or to learn to cooperate in order to find a way to return everything to its place. Having tried both options, they suddenly realize that there is no way back yet, and life in someone else's body turns out to be much more complicated than it seems at first glance.

title: Welcome to the trap
description: Ex-criminal Jacob Sternwood is forced to return to London from his asylum when his son is involved in a heist gone wrong. Detective Max Lewinsky gets a chance to catch a man who has always managed to escape. Rivals compete again, but they face a deeper criminal conspiracy. The film "Welcome to the Trap" (2011) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers.

title: Like pregnant
description: Lainey Newton dreamed of becoming a mother since childhood. Together with her best friend Kate, she staged a birth using dolls, and their games were a kind of way to overcome the pain of losing mothers. Lainey always played the role of the expectant mother who goes through all the difficulties, and Kate was there to support her. Many years have passed and now they live in New York, keeping in close touch. Lainey works as an English teacher in Brooklyn, and Kate... her classes remain a mystery. Their days begin with FaceTime calls, as a sign of an enduring friendship. But one day, Kate announces that she is expecting a child, and this news becomes a test for Laney. After a recent breakup with her boyfriend, she is forced to accept a new reality: her friend gets what she herself has dreamed of for so long. Jealousy, insecurity and bitter disappointment threaten to shake their long-standing friendship.

title: Castle on the sand
description: After a mysterious disaster, four people find themselves on a deserted island, which seems to them a temporary test. They hope to find a way out, but the more they try, the stronger the place seems to drag them into its dark vortex. The island awakens in each of them the fears that were sleeping deep inside, and forces them to face their own past, which they were so eager to forget. Instead of joining forces, they are overcome by doubts, suspicions and despair, and the mysterious events that happen around them only increase the sense of doom. Day by day, strength leaves them and hope fades, until they realize that the real danger is not a wild island, but something much worse that cannot be explained by logic. The past blurs the lines with reality, and dark secrets become as dangerous as the island itself. Will they be able to escape, or will this unexplored piece of land become a trap for them from which there is no way out?

title: I spit on your graves
description: The main character of the film is a young and very beautiful writer named Jennifer. To complete her new novel, she needs peace and solitude, so she rents a house outside the city. On the way, the girl stops at a gas station, where she has a small conflict with three local boys. Soon, this trio breaks into Jennifer's house and begins to brutally abuse the girl. However, she manages to break free and runs into the woods, where she meets the local sheriff, and together they return to the house. After looking around, the sheriff concludes that Jennifer is under the influence of alcohol and made it all up. He searches the girl and calls for help, but instead of the police, the same scumbags come, and then it becomes clear that the sheriff is one of them. Jennifer is raped, after which they decide to kill her, but the girl still manages to avoid death. And now she will brutally take revenge on her offenders.

title: The world is in my head
description: Melody Brooks is a bright, smart girl who sees and understands the world much deeper than it seems to others. She cannot speak or move on her own, which is why others often perceive her as helpless. At school, her abilities go unnoticed until a young teacher discovers the girl's true potential. Thanks to the support, she gets the opportunity to learn on an equal footing with her classmates, proving that her thoughts and feelings have weight, even if she cannot express them in the usual words. Her path is a struggle for the right to be heard in a world that is not always ready to accept those who are different.

title: Fury
description: 10 years ago, the former head of a criminal group lay down in the countryside, gave birth to a girl and enjoys simple female happiness. Since the woman does not know how to do anything useful, she is engaged in debt collection. Daughter Mai worries about this and dreams that one day they will open a fish farm, and her mother will no longer have to do this shameful work. Suddenly, Mai is kidnapped by an international organization of human traffickers, and the woman turns into a deadly fury - she will go to the end to save her daughter, and the scoundrels will have to regret their actions.

title: Gladiator II
description: The events of the film take place during the reign of Emperor Commodus, a man who betrayed his family for the sake of power. He, the ambitious son of the emperor Marcus Aurelius, seized the throne by killing his own father. More than two decades have passed since then, and Commodus still holds power in his hands, carrying out his cruel and insidious plans. However, there is one on the horizon who is ready to stand up to the tyrant. In the center of the story is the young nephew of Commodus - Lucius. After his family's home is seized by a despotic emperor, the boy decides to fight for freedom and justice, not only for himself, but for all of Rome. His path runs through the walls of the legendary Coliseum, where he is forced to overcome his fears and join in deadly battles. Every step brings Lucius closer to his goal - to restore the glory of Rome and restore people's faith in the future. It is a story of struggle, courage and dedication that can change the course of history even in the darkest of times.

title: Furies
description: Bee grew up in poverty and witnessed her prostitute mother killed by a drunk customer who initially tried to rape her. Years later, she leads an unremarkable lifestyle, getting into confrontations with men at every convenient opportunity. One day, Bi almost becomes a victim of rape like her mother, but at a crucial moment, brave Lin comes to her rescue. Lin takes Bee under his wing, helping her through a martial arts training course along with two other girls, Thanh and Hong. Training relentlessly under the guidance of Lin, the girls not only learn to defend themselves, but also prepare for a clash with local drug lords who traffic in women.

title: Vermilion
description: In the midst of the Second World War, 1944, against the background of brutal fighting and a frantic struggle for survival, one young soldier decides to change his destiny. Tired of the horrors of the front and the internal struggle, he deserts and finds refuge in a picturesque commune nestled in the mountains of the Italian Tyrol. Here, far from the war, he ends up in the home of a local teacher, where he is greeted by a friendly and warm atmosphere. The family, consisting of loving parents and three daughters of different ages, becomes a temporary shelter for him, where he can forget about the fears and worries that haunt him. The young man gradually finds a common language with the girls, each of whom has his own unique story and dreams. Relationships with them fill his life with new emotions and understanding that even in difficult times it is possible to feel joy and closeness. While the world is in chaos, a relationship is born in this secluded place that could change his life forever. But the time comes to make a choice: whether to return to the endless battlefields, or to remain in this shelter, where love and hope can eclipse the darkness of war.

title: The decline of newspapers
description: The film tells a dramatic story about the inevitable decline of the printed press, which is confidently supplanted by modern digital media. In the center of the plot is a famous New York newspaper that was on the verge of collapse. Its employees gather in a conference room to discuss the prospects of survival in a world where printed publications no longer have a place. The newspaper has been struggling financially for a long time, but the global economic crisis has only exacerbated the situation, forcing staff to prepare for the worst - massive layoffs and possibly complete closure. The editors face a harsh reality, where technological progress changes everything: audience habits, ways of obtaining information and business models. A team of journalists and management faces a difficult task - to find new ways to survive, while remaining relevant in a world that is constantly changing. At the same time, their struggle is complicated by internal conflicts, limited resources and the general uncertainty of the future. Will the collective be able to adapt to new conditions, or will this newspaper remain only a memory of the past era of the printed word?

title: Star Trek: Section 31
description: No one could have predicted such a development, but difficult times are coming. Humanity should always prepare for the worst, but at the same time, people constantly forget that fate can bring unpleasant surprises at the most unexpected moment. Things are so bad that even Emperor Philip himself joins a secret Starfleet unit. This unit is assigned a special task: to protect the united Federation of Planets. Emperor Philip is considered a brave ruler, a good man, but will he not be able to fulfill his mission to the end? What is the matter? You can guess for a long time, but you will never know the answer. The past haunts Emperor Philip as he comes face to face with the sins of his past while protecting the united Federation of Planets. The hero's life was different, and no one is immune to mistakes. But the fact is that such a meeting cannot lead to anything good. It will only open former wounds, make you remember that the hero was once wrong. But the power of the human spirit is an endless source of energy. The emperor must have it!

title: Schindler's List
description: "Schindler's List" is a historical drama about the times of the Second World War. In 1939, Oskar Schindler came to Nazi-occupied Poland. An enterprising German gets to know the highest ranks of the army by organizing lavish dinners with entertainment. He intends to engage in the production of enamel products. The man received all the permits, and it remained for him to recruit workers, obtain initial capital and organize the process. He turns to rich Jews with an offer - they are his money, and he is a commodity. Yitzhak Stern, one of the members of the Jewish Council, is appointed as a manager at the enterprise. He took this job to get out of the ghetto and help his fellow citizens. A young person helps others to get a job by using an official position and forging documents. The case is gaining momentum, a successful businessman is getting rich. But Amon Goeth, an SS officer, appears in Krakow. He puts representatives of the disagreeable people in the Auschwitz concentration camp. From this moment on, the main character is driven not only by greed, but also by a sincere desire to save doomed people. He decides to buy out his workers and send them to his factory in the Czech Republic. Together with an assistant, they compiled a list of workers who will be transported to the factory in Zwittau-Brinlitz. All income went to bribe the Nazis. But Germany was defeated and capitulated. The rescuer had to flee from the Red Army. The film "Schindler's List" (1993) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of biographical military and historical films with elements of drama.

title: Beginning
description: The film "The Beginning" in Ukrainian tells about the most cunning robbers who organized a hunt for ideas. Thieves are not interested in money, jewelry and other material goods. They penetrate into the depths of the human subconscious through sleep, constructing the reality they need. Unknowingly, victims share certain information. The main character Cobb is a professional in his field, but he has not seen his children for many years, as he is forced to hide abroad after the death of his beloved wife. The man is approached with an attractive offer. He must engender a new super idea in the mind of the heir to the largest corporation. Having completed the task, he gets freedom of movement and will be able to return to his family. Implementation is a difficult process that everyone can handle. The unfortunate father dreamed of returning home, dreamed of hugging the children, so he did not refuse the order, despite its complexity. He begins to assemble a team of experienced specialists who can provide him with assistance. Participants develop a plan of action: creation of a multi-layered reality, filigree processing of the client. But the edges are slowly blurring, and it is important not to get lost. The film "The Beginning" (2010) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for fans of fantasy and adventure with elements of drama.

title: To reach the heavens
description: Before this meeting, Rudy and Martin didn't even know each other existed, but it was this meeting that changed their lives. Arriving for an examination at the hospital, the main characters of the tape soon learn about their disappointing diagnosis - they have only a few hours left to live. The young guys are placed in the same ward, here they talk about their lives, and in the evening they arrange a farewell party to spend their last journey. Despite the words of the doctors, Martin is determined and does not want to end his life in the walls of the hospital, so he offers his partner to run away and go to the sea, which Rudy always dreamed of, but was never able to see. At first, Rudy refuses to run away, but his friend convinces him, since then there will be nothing to tell them in heaven. They escape from the hospital, steal a car and go to the coast. They just want to see the sea, but they don't even know what adventures await them on the way.

title: Tin and Tina
description: Spain, 1981. On the most important day of her life, Lola faces a terrible tragedy: during the wedding, she develops internal bleeding, due to which she loses her long-awaited child. The doctors deliver the terrible news – she will never be able to get pregnant again. After experiencing a deep blow, Lola falls into a depression that lasts for months. Her husband Adolfo, trying to restore her hope, offers to adopt a child from a nunnery near their town. At first glance, the decision looks like a great solution: Lola decides to adopt not one child, but two at once - twins Tina and Tina, who fascinate her with their beauty and musical talent. However, soon after the children move to their new home, it becomes clear that their worldview is deeply clouded by fanatical religious beliefs. They take every word of Scripture literally, without considering the context or consequences of their actions. Their obsession with the ideas of salvation, punishment and faith gradually transforms the peaceful family life of Lola and Adolfo into a complete nightmare, full of tension, fear and danger.

title: Program
description: The conversation about possible visits to our planet by extraterrestrials has undergone serious changes. In an interview with whistleblower Stephen Bassett in 2021, it was no longer the question of their reality that was discussed, but the reasons why this information remains hidden. Even the terminology has evolved: now it is not Unknown Flying Objects, but Unknown Anomalous Phenomena (NAF). The US government has officially confirmed its interest in the topic, focusing on its potential threats to national security. To investigate these phenomena, the Ministry of Defense created the Anomaly Resolution Office, whose task is to study the nature of these phenomena: whether they are of foreign or domestic origin, whether they are threatening, and whether they are of terrestrial or extraterrestrial origin. Transparency in this area is limited, because the results of such studies remain classified. It was this mystery that became the basis of James Fox's new documentary called "The Program."

title: Deadpool and Wolverine
description: The gripping film features collector Wade, who used to be a special agent. Work did not bring him money and satisfaction, so the man chose another path. He became a hired killer, ready to do anything for a big reward. His life was measured and saturated with numerous crimes, but suddenly Wilson falls in love. He enters into a relationship with a charming girl and is even going to get married. The mercenary is sure that soon everything will definitely change, but he has no idea that big trouble is already waiting for him around the corner. Wade learns that he has cancer. He had only a few months left to live. A disappointed and doomed man is ready to agree to anything in order to spend a few more decades on earth. Help comes suddenly. Wilson makes a deal with a mysterious man offering an experimental treatment. After the operation, Wade gains immense strength. This is how one of the most extravagant and extraordinary superheroes appears. Deadpool is distinguished by a heightened sense of justice and a strange sense of humor. He helps the needy, saves entire cities and does not leave people in trouble, but this time his enemies are much smarter.

title: BAM!
description: Young Americans are looking for any opportunity to earn a living, because most of them are still too young to work in a profession. Some do not have the proper education, others have the necessary connections for a prestigious job. In search of alternative ways of earning, they turn to non-standard occupations, such as delivery or sale of specific goods that are difficult to find in regular stores. Sometimes they have to go beyond the law to meet the demands of clients or complete complex assignments, but the result – a quick profit – always justifies the risk. Working with caution and maximum stealth, they are rewarded for their efforts. Augie always felt different. A non-binary individual, he struggled to figure out his own identity and feelings for other people, changing his style and appearance in search of himself. After moving to Chicago, Augie started working as a courier. His job was unusual - delivering toys for adults, which he did with amazing ease and without any prejudice. Eva and Dee, two newbies in town, fall in love with each other, not knowing how many secrets their partner is hiding. Meanwhile, Bibi and Sissy, dorm roommates, find common ground but face financial difficulties. Deciding to make money, they start selling drugs taken from a friend who is temporarily absent. Their underground business is gaining momentum, although the risks are getting bigger every day.

title: Lee / Photographer
description: Lee Miller's story is one of courage and resilience. A former model, she decided to leave the world of glamor and beauty to go to the front during World War II. The military correspondent decided to capture the horrors of war in a photo in order to show the world the true picture of what is happening. Her reports, filled with talent and passion, inspired and shocked the audience, but behind each frame there were personal traumas and fears, damned connected with the past. Miller faced the darkest sides of human nature, but her desire for truth and goodness was stronger. In search of the truth, she dared to go to any lengths, even if it cost her personal happiness and peace. And her story became not just a story about war, but also about the courage of a soul capable of overcoming the darkest trials. "Lee" is not just a biographical drama, it is a monument to the resilience and courage of women who change the world with their actions and ideals, despite all the obstacles.

title: Bloody star
description: Bobby lives by questionable methods of earning. Her childhood was not easy: her father left the family, and her mother disappeared, leaving her daughters alone. The girl's youth was spent in endless travels around the country, in search of ways to earn money and avoid poverty. The old Ford became both a home and a vehicle for her. After making another trip to visit her boyfriend in New Mexico, she receives a call from her sister, who is trying to convince her to leave her toxic relationship with her boyfriend. But Bobby refuses to listen. During a short stop at a gas station, she is caught up by the local sheriff, who intends to fine her for a minor speeding violation. Bobby decides to settle the situation quickly by offering to pay him in cash. However, while withdrawing money, she has no idea that this sheriff is a real monster. Protected by a badge and confident in his impunity, he has been hunting defenseless women for a long time, turning them into his victims. When Bobby realizes that she has fallen into the hands of a dangerous psychopath, the situation becomes critical. She will have to show great endurance to escape from his trap. This struggle becomes the most difficult test for her, the result of which depends on whether she can reach her destination alive.

title: The good old days
description: In their young years, Mellie and Nell were at the height of fame, surrounded by the adoration and admiration of the public. They were at the peak of their careers: talented, beautiful and famous actresses who enjoyed luxury and admiration. But gradually luck turned away from them, and their glory days became only memories. Now, after sixty years, the women are left alone with the questions of whether they chose the right path when they gave priority to their career, giving up personal happiness and love. Now they are trying to return the feeling of youth and charm of the film sets. After many years of thinking, Mellie and Nell decide to spend Christmas in a specially prepared house, while memories of the past stir their hearts. On this festive night, they are noticed by a security guard who is forced to work when everyone is celebrating. He promises to keep their secret and shares his dreams. Although he works as a security guard, his dream is to become an actor, although luck has never been with him.

title: The witch's book
description: August and Victoria work as night guards in a gloomy, almost empty building located in the heart of Los Angeles. Its cold corridors and ominous atmosphere resemble a dark cave where time seems to have stopped. Spending long nights together, they gradually become closer, although outside of work their lives are radically different, and communication practically does not go beyond the service. For Victoria, this period is especially difficult: she is experiencing the loss of a loved one, which left a deep wound on her soul. Outwardly, she is trying to hold on, but inside she is consumed by pain from which it is difficult to find relief. August knows about her grief, but she does not even suspect that Victoria is considering a radical step to free herself from suffering forever. She learns about the legend of the Witch's Book, a mystical artifact that supposedly gives power over death. In search of a ghostly hope, Victoria decides to seek out a mythical witch, hoping to find a book and change her fate. However, the path to achieving her goal is full of dangers and unknowns. Will she be able to overcome her fears, conquer death and realize her dream, or will this hunt only plunge her into even greater darkness?

title: Your Monster
description: In the center of the plot is a girl named Lara. She would be happy to never get into trouble, but that's life, you can't help it. When her boyfriend dumps her and Lara loses her job, her whole life flies to the damn mother. Returning to her apartment, the heroine realizes that a real monster has taken up residence there. This uninvited neighbor has no intention of vacating the territory and offers the main character his terms. No, of course, this monster is very attractive, but the audacity of this character sometimes scares the girl. The uninvited neighbor of the main character can disappear from her apartment only if Lara finds the strength and desire to start life anew, not to remember the sad moments of the past that cannot be returned. The attractive monster tells Lara that she must find the strength to move on, to feel happy and free again. What should a girl do now? She cannot agree to the monster's terms or try to find another place to live, because she cannot forget her loved one so easily. How will this story end for Lara?

title: About the drying grass
description: A young teacher, Samet, is completing four years of compulsory service in a village school in Anatolia and is eager to start a new chapter of his career in Istanbul. However, all his plans are ruined when two female students accuse him and another teacher of molestation. This unexpected incriminating incident undermines his confidence and life plans. Samet finds himself at the crossroads of his life, facing difficulties and challenges. At this difficult moment, his colleague Nurei comes to his aid, who helps him regain the meaning of life and overcome difficulties. Together, they face the challenges presented by the allegations and try to rebuild their reputations.

title: Jeepers Creepers 3
description: The third part of the tape begins with the fact that 23 years ago, Guyler Brandon lost his own son Kenny, who was eaten by a terrible monster. Now he needs to live all this time in a distant town so that no one finds him. He lives with his granddaughter Addison. But over time, the Jeepers Creepers monster appears again in their remote town on a terrible car. The movie "Jeepers Creepers 3" (2017) will be liked to watch in Ukrainian live by all fans of horror films.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
description: Edmond Dantes, a young man full of romantic dreams, meets a charming girl with whom he falls in love at first sight. Their feelings turn out to be mutual, and the couple begins to prepare for the wedding ceremony, enjoying happy moments. But joy immediately turns to tragedy when, during a festive day, Edmon is unexpectedly accused of a serious crime. He is framed, and soon it becomes known that he is sentenced to death. However, instead, he is thrown on a remote island, where life turns out to be a real horror, and he spends about fourteen years there. On the island, his only companion is another prisoner who shares information about treasures and the possibility of acquiring enormous power. Escaping from prison, Edmon finds these treasures and is convinced that the interlocutor's words are true. Returning to his hometown under a new name and mask, he plans to take revenge on those who betrayed his trust. Now he needs to implement a complex plan, punish everyone involved in his cruel fate, and restore justice for his own salvation.

title: Strangers
description: A stranger is a perfect organism. The perfect killing machine, whose physical superiority is matched by his phenomenal thirst for destruction. Officer Ellen Ripley and the crew of the spaceship Nostromo had already met such a creature once. All the fans of horror and fantasy films will enjoy watching the film "Aliens" (1986) live in Ukrainian.

title: Alien
description: In the distant future, a cargo spacecraft returns to Earth and intercepts an unknown signal from the planet. The crew, in accordance with the basic instructions, is obliged to find and investigate the source of the signal. Once on the planet, the astronauts everywhere discover unknown objects that look like giant cocoons. The movie "Alien" (1979) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: Heiress of Christmas
description: On the eve of Christmas, shopping centers turn into a real whirlwind of events - hundreds of people rush to buy perfect gifts for their loved ones. In large department stores, there is a hustle and bustle, and the counters are constantly filled with customers eager to find something special. In this chaos, the young heiress of a large family department store finds herself, who undergoes a difficult test organized by her grandmother. The wise woman wants the girl to learn how to manage the business, put all her strength and resources into it and become a worthy successor to the family business. However, for the heroine, who has never faced such challenges before, working during the Christmas rush becomes a real test. A continuous flow of clients, a busy schedule and constant challenges put her on the verge of exhaustion. However, she does not give up, trying to prove her ability and live up to her grandmother's expectations. At the same time, the girl seeks to attract the attention of the cynical but attractive manager who works nearby.

title: Back in action
description: Emily and Matt are a happily married couple. They got married just after they retired. For a long time, the heroes served in the Central Intelligence Agency of America. Agents spied on their country and worked undercover. No one guessed what these two fit, handsome handsome men were doing: a blonde and a black man. However, it is impossible to live with someone else's biography all your life, therefore, having retired, the spies decided to start a new life as decent, law-abiding Americans. An established civil life is unexpectedly interrupted by an unpleasant event. Someone revealed their spy activities, and now a deadly hunt begins for them. Unknown pursuers are on their heels, and a meeting with them is inevitable. Only returning to their former service will save them from death. They themselves must try to count out those who want their death and eliminate the enemy that lurks. Will the couple manage to find the intruders?

title: Time to live
description: Almut, an ordinary woman who is used to boring everyday life and monotonous routine, could not have imagined how her life would change dramatically after meeting the mysterious Tobias. At first it seemed that it was just a chance meeting, but gradually something more than just sympathy arose between them. Soon they decided to get married and start a new life together. A new house, the joy of having children - everything seemed perfect until the truth came out that could put everything in jeopardy. After several years of happy family life, Almut suddenly discovered that Tobias had been hiding important facts from her past. His divorce was not as simple as he told, and his past relationships left a deep mark on his personality. Suddenly, the pretended idyll collapsed, and the heroine faced a difficult task - to accept the truth and decide whether she could forgive and continue her married life with a man who hid such important moments from her.

title: Red rooms
description: High-profile legal investigations always attract the attention of the public or even legal professionals. The main character is a young girl named Kelly. She spends the night near the courthouse so as not to miss the hearing about the case that the whole district is talking about. The case of a psychopath, a true maniac, is being considered in court. Is this girl so desperate to get to court that she has to go to desperate measures? The thing is that she is literally obsessed with the identity of the criminal. Is there any explanation for this? Of course, because just like that, she would not be interested in a freak who killed a 13-year-old girl. But why is the main character so attracted to this story? Probably the fact that the 13-year-old killed is like two drops of water like the main character herself, and this confuses and confuses her. The young girl does not know what to think about this story. Therefore, she needs to get to the courtroom immediately. That is why the heroine spends the night near this building, so as not to miss the most important process in her life.

title: Unrestrained
description: The main character of the plot is the American wrestler Anthony Robles. It was always difficult for him, but despite the fact that fate treated him like a thief, the hero went to his success. The whole thing is that this person was born with one leg, but this tragedy did not prevent him from becoming a winner, a real hero of his time. The spirit of this man was so powerful that he was able to become a national champion. But before he got to such a high step, there were many falls, failures in his career, and in general, he was showered with misfortune after misfortune. But the main character always had such a powerful force that this crazy energy was enough not only to overcome all obstacles, but also to stand on the highest step, to win the national championship, which was held in the state of Arizona. It was a difficult test. A real test of what is called "hardening of steel". But the hero was able to harm all those who said that he would never succeed in this cursed life. He wanted to spit on someone's superstitions and gossip, he proved by his actions that a person can do anything!

title: Time hunter
description: In the center of the plot is a person who is reborn every time he makes the same mistake. This is some kind of curse for a woman named Agnes, who is forced to reincarnate after a fateful encounter. In each of her incarnations, despite the difference in age and circumstances, she falls in love with one man who is not right for her. The difference between her incarnations is so great that it seems that such different people cannot make the same stupid mistake for an eternity. But Agnes is "fed up", she "presses the same key", unable to stop. When will she be able to break this vicious circle of unsuccessful acquaintances? This woman should meet such a man who would be able to "rewrite her wrong program". He, like a skilled coder, must write a completely new program for her life, giving a different fate to the main character. But so far she meets only the wrong man, because of him everything goes to pieces, despite different continents, personalities and characters.

title: Dave's Bank 2
description: The stakes are higher, the opposition is no less ruthless, and the mission is more dangerous in this thrilling sequel, in which Dave Fishwick faces a new and formidable adversary: ​​the micro-loan companies known as payday lenders. In the second part of the story, already familiar to the audience Dave Fishwick (Rory Kinnear), a determined outsider from Burnley, who once fought the banking establishment to create his own community bank, now faces the modern scourge of financial predation - payday lenders exploiting the most vulnerable members of society. Dave is horrified to learn the extent of the damage caused by these predatory lenders, who charge astronomical interest rates that are out of control. Many of these payday loans have kinovibe.co interest rates in excess of a staggering 6,000 percent, pushing those who are already struggling even deeper into poverty and despair. For Dave, it's not just bad business, it's morally wrong. He describes their practices as "licensed thievery" and sets out to expose their greed and corruption. But this struggle is not one that he can handle alone. Dave enlists the support of Jessica, an ambitious and persistent American journalist who shares his sense of justice. Their plan is to shine a light on the payday loan industry's darkest practices by exposing the exploitative techniques used to lure desperate borrowers into a trap. As their investigation deepens, Dave and Jessica uncover a disturbing truth: the biggest players in the payday lending industry are based in the US, where they have been working with crime for years.

title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
description: Manel and his wife got into a car accident. The wife died, but the husband survived. Now he lives alone in the company of his cat. A person's depression does not stop, so he is not interested in what is happening around him and does not watch TV. Therefore, one does not hear about the fact that a strange virus began to spread in Spain and other countries. For this reason, the borders between the states began to be closed. The life of a widower continues, as if nothing is happening. He goes shopping in the store and sees that the people around him are emptying the shelves with products. A little later, his sister invites him to the Canary Islands. She wants Manel to spend time with her family. The brother agrees and buys a flight ticket. But suddenly the plane is canceled, an emergency is declared and the airspace of Spain is closed. People start to panic. The hero returns home. Gradually, all the neighbors around him evacuate, and the man stays and decides to survive, relying on his own strength.

title: Van Helsing
description: The events take place in a mysterious world called Transylvania. The legendary vampire hunter Van Helsing was destined to appear here. This gloomy town, where good collides with evil every day, is located deep in the Carpathians. As soon as the sun sets behind the horizon and darkness sets in, under the light of the moon and stars, bloodthirsty monsters come out of hell, which have been waging war between their clans for many centuries, as well as exterminating people. The movie "Van Helsing" (2004) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and adventure films in Ukrainian.

title: Emilia Peres
description: The story revolves around a lawyer who, despite her brilliant qualifications and rich experience, is forced to work for a large corporation, dealing with cases that contradict its principles. Her tasks are to protect clients whose actions are not only outside the bounds of the law, but also often harm society. One day, she faces a unique challenge - to help the leader of a criminal syndicate who has decided to leave his dangerous activities forever. This case goes beyond the scope of ordinary legal assistance. A man, realizing that his life is constantly under threat due to enemies and competitors, plans to carry out a radical transformation - to change his gender in order to finally disappear from the sight of his pursuers. The lawyer, understanding all the risks and the complexity of the task, decides to take on this unusual case, which becomes her greatest professional and moral test. Her client, who had carefully developed an escape plan over the years, making numerous improvements, was confident in his idea.

title: Dancer
description: The main character is a young, beautiful, talented dancer India Ray. She has been dancing since early childhood, she lives through dance and expresses all her emotions in dance. It is not surprising that the nightclub where she dances is always crowded, because the visitors cannot take their eyes off her. Every week, India takes part in a competition of dancers on the dance floor with the best DJs at the console, who mix completely different styles of music: from jazz to hip-hop. The biggest dream of this unique girl dancer is to dance on Broadway, but due to congenital muteness, she does not pass the final selection. However, there is a person, impressed by the beauty of the dance and the depth of emotions of India, who can help the girl to talk to the world around her.

title: Earthly girls are easy to reach
description: Three alien inhabitants: blue Mac, yellow Zibo and red Viplok have been traveling through space for quite some time. Admiring the bulges of earthly beauties on their wide-screen screen, the guys, fascinated by sexual fantasies, forgot about the need to control the space capsule, similar to a hair dryer, and plunged right into the pool Valerie covers. The pretty manicurist recently broke up with her boyfriend, who cheated on her, and the girl's heart is broken. Seeing the shaggy, unkempt guys with somewhat unusual skin color, the girl was scared at first. But after quite long hairdressing procedures, the boys acquired a look familiar to earthlings, and Valery, having examined the aliens from all sides, came to the conclusion that with them you can have a great time in the club - dancing, drinking cocktails and desperately flirting.

title: Mary
description: The fascinating story takes the viewer into the life of one of the greatest opera singers of the 20th century, who became a symbol of indomitable strength and devotion to art. Her path to fame, which peaked after the Second World War, was full of hardships, disappointments and challenges. Having grown up in difficult conditions, she faced the distrust of loved ones and numerous obstacles, but she did not allow this to stop her on the way to realizing her big dream. The action of the film unfolds in Paris in the 1970s, in the final days of the life of this legendary singer. Exhausted by a serious illness, she waged a heroic struggle to preserve her voice, which was her greatest gift and curse. Despite the inevitability of the consequences, she longed to return to the stage to once again feel the magic of performing in front of an audience. Living in luxurious apartments, surrounded by servants who fulfilled all her wishes, the singer gradually lost touch with reality. Constantly taking medication to control her emotional state increased her feelings of despair and chaos. But even in these moments, her talent shone, leaving a mark in the hearts of millions. This is a story about struggle, loss and the eternal search for harmony in life, which inscribes the name of this woman in history as a symbol of indomitable spirit and the power of art.

title: The best Christmas show ever
description: In the center of the plot of the film are six little hooligans from the Herdman family - Ralph, Imogene, Leroy, Claude and Gladys. They are called the worst children in the world, because they steal, lie, cheat and arrange real terror in a small town. Once the prospect of getting free food brings the young characters to the local Sunday school. Grace is going to put on a play, and unexpectedly, she chooses the Herdmans to star in the Christmas production. However, together with her husband Bob and daughter Beth, the heroine finds herself in a difficult situation, because the residents do not want this. Indeed, children can make a community look at Christmas in a different way.

title: Don't die: The man who wants to live forever
description: This film immerses the viewer in a world where the desire for immortality becomes not just a dream, but an obsession. The main character, tech millionaire Brian Jackson, uses his own body as a training ground for incredible experiments that aim to discover the secret of eternal life. Every day he defies the laws of nature, testing the limits of his body's endurance and looking for ways to slow down and eventually stop the aging process altogether. The film explores the inner world of the hero, his motivations, fears and radical changes that led to this extraordinary journey. In the process of experiments, not only his ambitions are revealed, but also complex relationships with loved ones who try to understand his decisions. The price Brian pays for his pursuit includes both personal sacrifice and colossal financial costs. The picture tells about the complexities that accompany this unusual way of life and highlights the challenges that the hero faced in his struggle with the inexorable passage of time.

title: Pipets 2
description: In the second part, after the death of her father, Mindy lives with her father's friend - Marcus. The heroine of "Pypets" promises her husband to end superheroism and start an ordinary life. The former Slayer begins to go to school, trying to adapt in an unusual environment for her. But it is not possible to stay in the image of an ordinary child for long. The film "Pypets 2" (2013) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedies and adventures in Ukrainian live.

title: Barbie
description: A real black streak has come in the fate of Barbie. Not long ago, her life was filled with bright events and colors, but everything changed suddenly. Fun beach parties and carefree pastimes are a thing of the past. Recently, she was warmly greeted by a crowd of friends, and every acquaintance dreamed of uttering a phrase of greeting. Now she found herself among the outcasts and was forced to leave the legendary Barbieland, because she suddenly stopped meeting the generally accepted standards of beauty. A naive blonde with a kind heart must go through many trials to overcome her inner fears. She will suddenly have a lot of complexes that prevent her from understanding her true purpose. She needs to go into the real world and make amazing discoveries. The methods of seduction and attracting attention known to her do not always work here, and external beauty turns out to be far from the most important weapon. You can achieve perfection only in the case of acquiring harmony, which allows you to find a delicate balance and stop feeling emotional discomfort. We recommend watching the movie "Barbie" (2023) in Ukrainian for fans of comedy and melodramatic films.

title: A love scam
description: This romantic comedy tells the story of how cunning intrigues can turn into real feelings. Two brothers from Naples, drowning in debt, risk losing their home, which means so much to their family. To save the day, they come up with a cunning plan: to win the trust and heart of a rich heiress in order to get her money. However, things don't go according to plan when true love comes into play, putting the brothers in front of a moral choice. The collision of their sophisticated scam with unpredictable feelings turns the story into a bright mix of humor, romance and family experiences, where every step is filled with unexpected turns.

title: Home Alone 3 / Home Alone 3
description: In the third part of the Christmas franchise, the plot revolves around a little boy named Alex. He was very guilty and he was destined to stay alone in a huge house. Meanwhile, three men and a woman bought a secret microcircuit from the robbers. The fraudsters decided to hide it in a small toy car and put it in a bag with the inscription "Parisian". Fate played an evil joke on them - the packages got mixed up. Now the fraudsters are forced to fly to Chicago. And here lives the same boy Alex with his family. The intruders are simply sure that the boy will open the door for them and let them into the house. But he does not intend to sit idly by and let the first people come by. The boy prepares a lot of traps and obstacles for uninvited guests. We suggest watching the movie "Home Alone 3 / Home Alone 3" (1997) in Ukrainian for lovers of Christmas comedies that tell about a boy and bandits.

title: Home Alone 2 / Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
description: In the second part of the cult film comedy, a little boy named Kevin McCallister is once again in the spotlight. This time he and his family left their home to fly to celebrate Christmas. However, he was destined to be alone again. He somehow got lost in a strange and miraculous way on a plane flying to New York. Only his old friends, bandits Harry and Marv, managed to escape from prison in some incredible way. As fate would have it, they ended up in the same area of ​​the metropolis where Kevin was. The boy will again prepare a lot of traps and obstacles in the way of bandits, and as always, he will be at the top. A boy is looking for Santa Claus to ask him to gather all his relatives in one place. We recommend watching the movie "Home Alone 2 / Home Alone 2: Lost in New York" (1992) in Ukrainian for fans of comedy and Christmas films.

title: Alone at home / Alone at home
description: At the very heart of the plot of the first part of the film "Home Alone" is an eight-year-old boy named Kevin McCallister. One day he will be left alone in a huge house. The large McCallister family is going to visit relatives in Paris. The boy wished to be left alone with himself. And so his dream came true. All relatives flew from Chicago to Europe. Now Kevin can turn all his dreams into reality. There is a gang of apartment thieves operating in the area. They are well aware that many have gone to celebrate Christmas with their friends, family and relatives. They seriously intend to clean the house. But the young brat is not going to sit idly by. He prepares a lot of traps and insurmountable obstacles for uninvited guests. We definitely recommend watching the film "Home Alone / Home Alone" (1990) in Ukrainian before Christmas, a comedy story about a boy who gave a good fight to two bandits-dovbny and turned their lives into hell.

title: My policeman / My policeman
description: Brighton, 1950s. A chance meeting of policeman Tom with museum curator Patrick unexpectedly turns into a passionate romance, but they are forced to hide their romantic relationship, because homosexuality is not only condemned in Great Britain, but also punished. Gays are beaten and abused, and are sent to prison, where they are sold to other inmates. Not wanting to put himself in danger, Tom decides to marry a teacher named Marion. However, despite the marriage, he continues to be intimate with Patrick...

title: Christmas by candlelight
description: Ellie Reddy, a talented perfumer, is tasked with creating a unique holiday fragrance that will win everyone over. To find inspiration, she decides to spend Christmas in her cozy family home, filled with memories and holiday spirit. There she meets the attractive writer Logan Osborne, who lives temporarily with his father in the old manor where her mother once made candles. After learning that their mother's candle business is on the verge of collapse, Ellie and Logan join forces to fulfill an important order. Their collaboration brings back the atmosphere of a real Christmas to the town, and an unexpected warm feeling arises between them, which can change their lives.

title: Take a chance on Christmas / Take a chance on Christmas
description: For Sutton, a single mother, finding a balance between work and family seems natural, even if it means spending the Christmas holidays looking for new clients for her publishing house. Her son Jay, however, is convinced that there is something important missing in his mother's life - maybe someone special. He insists that Sutton sign up for a dating app. At first, she ignores his offer to meet a single father named Mateo. But when it turns out that he can help close a promising deal that will change her career, Sutton decides to give this acquaintance a chance. And Christmas, as always, takes upon itself the creation of real magic...

title: Superman
description: From the distant planet Krypton, the only surviving boy, who was sheltered by a good farming family, comes to Earth. They raise him as their own son, without even suspecting at first of his incredible abilities. Later, the young man discovers in himself a strength that surpasses human capabilities, but at the request of his parents, he is forced to hide it from those around him. Now he leads a double life: by day a humble clerk, Clark Kent, and by night, a brave defender in a red cloak who stands guard over justice. His exploits do not go unnoticed: they not only bring help to the needy, but also charm one special girl. However, the peace does not last long. A dangerous enemy appears - Lex Luthor, who conceived a catastrophic plan: to destroy California with the help of an artificial earthquake. Now only Superman can stop the devious genius and save millions of lives.

title: Resurrection
description: Margaret is a middle-aged woman who is used to strict order and control in all aspects of her life. Taking the position of head of the biotechnology department at a large pharmaceutical company, she achieved great heights and earned the respect of her colleagues. In her personal life, the heroine also follows strict rules, raising her teenage daughter Abby, who will soon enter college. The woman is proud of her success both at work and as a single mother. Margaret also has a secret affair with a married colleague that does not involve any serious commitment. She is a strong leader at work, and at home she tries to create a comfortable and safe environment for Abby. But her established world suddenly begins to crumble when, at a conference in the city, she runs into David, a former lover, with whom she broke up more than twenty years ago. Realizing that the past has returned to her life, she begins to spy on her husband, trying to understand what he is up to. Fear and paranoia capture her, because this man once caused her a lot of pain. This film promises an exciting story filled with tension and emotional experiences, immersing the audience in the dramatic world of the main character, who is trying to keep her order and protect her loved ones from the past, which reminded her of herself again.

title: Love, wedding, repeat
description: The plot revolves around the preparations for the wedding of Hayley and Roberto, which is to take place in a charming Roman hotel. Jack, the bride's older brother, takes on the important mission of walking his sister down the aisle. Their bond is especially strong, because growing up as orphans, they always supported and protected each other. For Jack, this day should be a perfect holiday that will give Haley unforgettable memories. However, unexpected difficulties arise on the way to a flawless wedding. Uninvited guests are Haley's ex-lover and Jack's embittered ex-girlfriend, whose intentions are clearly far from friendly. Their arrival threatens to turn the celebration into chaos, but Jack is ready to do everything possible to ensure that no trouble overshadows his sister's important day.

title: Joe Bell
description: The true story of 15-year-old Jadin Bell, an openly gay man who is bullied at school and on social media. After a teenager does not find the necessary support from his parents, he commits suicide by hanging himself from the goalpost of a football field. His father, Joe Bell, finally realizing his mistake, leaves his hometown in Oregon, embarking on a long journey on foot across America, with the intention of drawing public attention to the intolerance of people with non-traditional sexual orientation.

title: The talented Mr. Dog
description: The film takes place in the small country town of Upson Downs, where 10-year-old Annie lives with her faithful friend, a dog named Runt. Runt, a former stray dog, has become an integral part of her life, and their friendship is an example of true devotion. Together they overcome all the difficulties and problems that arise on their way. When Annie learns that her family's farm is on the verge of closing due to severe financial difficulties and drought, she makes a big decision. The girl goes with Rant to London to take part in the local dog show championship, hoping to win. For her, this is the only chance to save the farm, and she is ready to give everything to achieve her goal. Only time will tell if they will be able to overcome all obstacles and achieve the dream victory.

title: I saw black clouds
description: The loss of a close friend is the beginning of a difficult and dangerous path for a young woman. Returning to her hometown, she strives to find answers to the questions that disturb her and unravel the circumstances of the mysterious death. Plunging into her own investigation, the heroine discovers eerie details of the past that were carefully hidden. Step by step, she realizes that the truth she so longs for becomes a threat to her own life. With each discovery, the dangers grow, and the secrets that surface may change everything she knew before.

title: Svyatogol
description: This film is a touching story of love, loss and the inescapable power of holiday magic. The story follows a creative young woman, Andi, who runs a thriving holiday decoration and planning company with her beloved mother, Mimi. Together, they have turned The Holiday Junkie into a local favorite known for transforming homes and event venues into magical winter wonderlands each Christmas. However, when Mimi unexpectedly dies, Andy finds himself facing his first Christmas alone, without his breakout star, business partner and best friend. As the holiday season approaches, Andy struggles to balance his grief with the need to keep The Holiday Junkie afloat. Determined to honor her mother's legacy of kinovibe.co, Andy throws herself into her work, taking on challenging holiday projects and trying to bring joy to others even as she feels her own light is fading. But running a business without Mimi turns out to be more difficult than she expected. Fortunately, in the midst of this chaos, Andi crosses paths with Mason, the charming house manager who is overseeing one of The Holiday Junkie's biggest decorating projects of the season. Mason is reliable and casually kind, but there is also a quiet sadness in his eyes.
