As they spend more time together, Mason becomes a constant source of support for Andi, encouraging her to rediscover the joy of the season as she gradually opens her heart. But when unexpected problems threaten to derail her plans and Mason's secrets come to light, Andi must decide if she should hold on to the past.

title: Tim Thaler, or Sold Laughter
description: At the epicenter of the plot of this story is a very strange boy. Tim Thaler has a unique ability to laugh infectiously. He can laugh out loud and cheer everyone up. One day, our hero comes to the horse races, where he meets a rather mysterious gentleman. The man offers the boy an unusual deal. The boy must sell the ability of contagious laughter, and in exchange he will get the opportunity to win on any pair. Yes, the ability to laugh contagiously has been sold, but whether our hero will win in a pair remains a big question.

title: Beloved
description: Two freshmen at a local college decide to wreak havoc by breaking up with their high school sweethearts at the same time. To implement this plan, they choose a special moment - a stormy night before Thanksgiving, known among students for its atmosphere of freedom and madness. Their plan seems simple: a separation that will allow each to start a new chapter in life. However, this adventure turns into unpredictable events that force the boys to look not only at their plans, but also at themselves from a different angle. Despite a carefully planned algorithm of actions, everything goes out of control when emotions and unexpected circumstances destroy their clear strategy. The heroes find themselves in a whirlwind of events that test the strength of their friendship, forcing them to think more deeply about what is really important to them. Their break-up contract turns into a chaotic adventure full of curiosities, new discoveries and casual humor. What started as an ordinary ruse becomes a vivid journey that reveals unexpected sides of life to them. This night becomes a turning point in their student life - full of laughter, emotions and unforgettable moments that will forever leave a mark in their hearts. What could have gone wrong? As it turned out - everything, but this is exactly what makes their story so special.

title: Claustrophobes: No sleep
description: These seven strangers have one thing in common - lack of money. It was she who forced them to participate in testing new drugs. A sterile, clean underground laboratory, a polite doctor who performs procedures - everything looks standard and professional. Participants in the experiment receive their doses according to the instructions. However, after a few hours it becomes clear that the medicine has a strange side effect: people can't fall asleep, and whoever falls asleep will never wake up again.

title: Battalion 6888
description: The film tells the story of the heroic contribution of the 6888th Battalion of the Central Postal Service, which consisted exclusively of black women. The members of this battalion not only struggled with the challenges of war, but also with the brutal discrimination, ridicule and injustice that persecuted them because of their race. Despite all the difficulties, these women made a real breakthrough, proving their strength, determination and ability to change the world. At the height of World War II, when hundreds of thousands of letters remained unsent and forgotten, they took on the difficult task of restoring order in the postal system. Letters awaiting delivery for three years were filled with hope, pain and anticipation, but remained unanswered due to the chaos and lack of coordinated work. Each unsent message hid a story of broken hearts, broken bonds, and lost hopes. The women of the 6888th battalion took on a huge responsibility - to streamline this process and restore people's faith in communication and support. Their perseverance, tireless work and dedication became a symbol of fortitude and indomitability, making a significant contribution to the war. This story is a reminder that even in the face of the greatest difficulties, you can achieve the incredible if you keep faith in yourself and your cause.

title: Night grace
description: The tragic loss changed John's life forever, plunging him into a deep crisis of faith and disappointment in himself. Daily memories of the terrible event did not allow him to leave the past behind, destroying attempts to return to a normal existence. In search of a way to cope with the pain, John decides to work at a crisis helpline, where he supports people around the clock in the darkest moments of their lives. However, as time passes, he realizes that his own problems begin to heal thanks to those who turn to him for help. An unexpected twist occurs when John meets a teenager named Calvin, a boy who is also going through hard times and searching for his place in the world. Their meeting becomes the beginning of an unusual friendship and changes the lives of both. Deciding to join the high school wrestling team together, John and Calvin embark on an exciting adventure. Joint efforts and support allow them to overcome obstacles, strengthen self-belief and restore lost hope. Their story shows that real help can come from the most unexpected side, and new connections can heal not only the soul, but also give strength to reach new heights. Through his friendship with Calvin, John gradually changes his life, finding harmony and inspiration to move forward.

title: Dogman
description: Douglas was definitely unlucky with his parents. But he managed to find friends, just not ordinary ones. His father brought him up very cruelly. Once the boy got fed up with his antisocial and unloving father, and the child was sent to the dogs. According to all the laws of nature, the poor man could be torn to shreds, perceived as a threat and get rid of him, but the pack decided to do otherwise: to protect the baby and allow him to stay, get food, shelter and warmth together. Nevertheless, the boy suffered from malicious adults, which had a negative impact on his psyche and development. Instead of society, he chooses dogs and spends all his time with them, without trying to find them among close people. The boy learned to manage his animals and bring values. He is not burdened by the status of an outcast and an illegal, but one day he and the dogs will become heroes and real saviors of the locals. Criminals are announced in the city, whose outrages will not be stopped even by the police. They are managed by the head of the drug cartel. The guy will try to fix the situation.

title: Human anger
description: The metropolis was shaken by a series of daring and brutal crimes. Collectors became the victims of bandits. Millions of dollars were stolen. The police are looking for any evidence and versions to find the robbers, but the results are not enough yet. The only clue is the similarity of the criminals' handwriting. It is quite likely that a mean and self-serving informant lurked among the employees of the collection service. Eich - a gloomy and silent man - gets to work there. Human anger, that's what feeling overwhelms a new recruit. People, performing any actions, good or evil, heroic or completely insignificant, rarely think about the consequences. The same goes for robbers, they theoretically understand that they are breaking the law and sowing evil, but they hope, having carefully calculated their steps, to remain beyond suspicion. Sometimes such a maneuver succeeds. But more often, retribution catches up with cunning dealers at the most inopportune moment. You have to pay for betrayal. A new member of the collection team starts work with this setup. Few people know about his true motives. Any of them can be guilty, and the responsible mission must be implemented as soon as possible. All fans of crime thrillers from Guy Ritchie will enjoy watching the movie "Human Anger" (2021) live in Ukrainian.

title: Shadow of revenge
description: Doss Jones is a Marine special forces veteran who spent his life serving his country believing in its ideals. However, his faith was shaken when he learned that the system to which he had devoted years was not always there to protect the citizens. After discovering that his mother's killer is on parole and his niece has been brutally beaten, Dos comes to the conclusion that the authorities are conniving with criminals, leaving their people defenseless. Frustrated and full of anger, he decides to act on his own. A former war hero, awarded with high awards, now becomes a defender of justice on the streets of his city. Doss is ready to challenge the unjust system, facing a series of dangerous trials and his own pain. Armed with experience and unwavering determination, he begins a war against those who sow chaos and destroy peace. Step by step, Dos cleanses the city of criminals, dreaming of restoring justice and giving the innocent a chance to live in safety. His struggle is a challenge to the system that failed him.

title: Dark night of the soul
description: Alex is a talented scientist involved in the development of a unique drug capable of stopping a global pandemic of a deadly virus. The disease quickly swept the planet, plunging humanity into a maelstrom of fear, chaos and devastation. However, fate deals her a cruel blow: after a tragic accident, a woman finds herself locked in her own car, with no hope of help. The world around has turned into a dangerous battlefield, where healthy people have become a rare exception, and survival seems almost impossible. Alex, isolated from the outside world, struggles with despair and fear, making superhuman efforts to survive. Holding the key to saving humanity in your hands is a heavy burden, especially when danger lurks around every corner. Her main task is to persevere, overcome numerous obstacles and complete her mission by giving the world medicine that can be the last hope for those who are still fighting for life. But while the virus continues to devastate everything in its path, Alex gradually finds himself on the verge of physical and psychological exhaustion, balancing between despair and an indomitable will to live.

title: The biggest heist of all time
description: The documentary reveals a fascinating story of a crime that has nothing to do with traditional robbery schemes. The spotlight is on a pair of hackers known as "Bitcoin Bonnie and Clyde," or Ilya Lichtenstein and Heather Morgan. In 2022, they were arrested for laundering $4.5 billion in bitcoins obtained from the daring hack of the Bitfinex exchange in 2016. Lichtenstein used sophisticated hacking tools to steal 120,000 bitcoins, which were valued at $70 million at the time of the crime. The tape immerses the viewer in the world of financial fraud, hacking tricks and stock market crises, revealing how digital crimes can turn the economy upside down.

title: Difficult trip 2
description: While serving time in prison, the members of Impaled Rektum face a harsh reality: the guitarist's father is gravely ill, and their family home and business are in danger of being demolished. At this difficult moment, they get an unexpected opportunity to perform at a prestigious music festival, which promises to be a chance for salvation and financial stability. The only problem is that they are behind bars, have no preparation for the performance, and time is working against them. However, this does not stop the desperate musicians - they decide to risk everything and escape from prison. The band Impaled Rektum is ready to fight for its future and restore its glory!

title: We were dangerous
description: In 1954, Nellie and Daisy attempt to escape from a girls' correctional facility in New Zealand, but are quickly caught. As punishment, they are sent to an isolated facility on a remote island. There, the girls are joined by Lou, a rich and cautious newcomer, and they form a trio as they try to survive under the strict supervision of the pious Matron. Despite the strict rules, the girls question the morality of the system and find strength in their friendship. But tensions rise as strange punishments are administered at night, filling island life with fear. In search of freedom, Nellie and Daisy plan a rebellion, but their relationship with Lou is complicated, because she is afraid to take risks to destroy the established order.

title: Freshness
description: Disillusioned by a series of meaningless and failed dates, Noah almost loses faith in the possibility of finding the perfect partner through dating apps. One day, during an ordinary trip to the store, fate brings her together with the charismatic and attractive Steve. Their meeting seems accidental, but so sincere and natural that Noah dares to give him her phone number. Their first date goes perfectly - she feels like she's found the one. Impressed by his care and charm, Noah without hesitation accepts the invitation to spend a romantic weekend with Steve away from the hustle and bustle of the city. However, during this journey, she encounters unexpected discoveries. Steve, the seemingly perfect companion, begins to reveal his true nature, which hides dangerous and sinister inclinations that threaten not only her hopes for happiness, but her very life.

title: Hands off!
description: Moshe Yehuda, a Hasidic rabbi and amateur dancer, must enter a televised dance competition to save his Jewish school from bankruptcy. His tango partner is sexy dancer Vivianna Nieves. But there is one problem: because of his orthodox religious beliefs, he is not allowed to touch women except his wife! At odds with his wife and five children, the chief rabbi of his orthodox sect, and Moshe's entire Hasidic community in Crown Heights, Brooklyn, Moshe sets out to seek advice from a Catholic priest, a Muslim imam, and a Sikh saint. Together, they devise a plan to help Moshe dance in the Tango competition without sacrificing his religious beliefs...

title: bumblebee
description: This picture shows California in the era of 1987. In a huge state at the city dump, the car found shelter for Bumblebee. And by a happy coincidence, Charlie lives in the same town. She will be eighteen very soon. She is trying with all her might to find her place in this difficult life. It was this wonderful girl who met our hero. It looked like a twisted and broken yellow Volkswagen Beetle. But in fact, it is not a simple car at all. And let him have an iron heart, but he can feel and experience.

title: Bad Girls / Cool Girls / Spoiled Girls
description: American youth film comedy about school, friendship and first love. Fifteen-year-old Cady Heron (Lindsay Lohan) comes from Africa, previously she was educated only at home. Now, having moved with her parents to America, she is forced to study in an ordinary school, in which, like in any other school, there is a group of popular girls - the school elite. So Cady gets into a world where strict laws and rules apply.

title: Marley and I 2
description: The film tells the story of Marley, an energetic and restless dog who always makes a mess in the house. His endless passion for entertainment leads to numerous adventures: he chases the cat, destroys furniture, tears pillows and even steals food from the kitchen table. However, despite all these antics, he brings not only problems to the home, but also incredible joy and happiness. One day, Marley and her owner Bodie Grogan go to an important dog competition. A real test for a dog, which involves not only competition, but also great difficulties on the way to victory. However, conquering the hearts of everyone around him with his devotion and charm, Marley even in the most difficult situations finds a way to surprise and impress all the participants, as well as the audience and judges.

title: The last kumite
description: At the center of this fascinating story is the struggle for salvation. The main character is a famous, strong and experienced martial arts master who, despite his fame and respect, leads an ordinary life as a loving father. Everything changes when he learns that his daughter is in danger, and to save her he needs to participate in one of the dangerous, illegal tournaments that are to be held in his hometown. Finding himself in a dangerous situation, he risks everything for her safety. All the obstacles he will have to face only strengthen his determination. Over time, he understands that the other participants of the tournament are fighting not only for victory, but also for their own dreams and happiness. Now he has to decide if he can overcome all the difficulties and become the winner in this fierce fight.

title: Night shooting
description: In the center of this unusual and fascinating film unfolds the story of students of a local college who are studying at the cinematography department. Totally dedicated to their craft, they live and breathe the art of filmmaking. One day, when it's time to present their special project, all their carefully laid plans are thrown into jeopardy. Unforeseen difficulties arise that call into question the completion of work on their documentary. All the students plan to present their achievements to the other participants, however, while preparing for the show, their paths unexpectedly cross with a mysterious group of people in a wooded area who are trying to remain unnoticed. The young filmmakers realize that they are being watched, and the situation takes an alarming turn, threatening to disrupt not only the project, but also their safety.

title: Defender of monarchs
description: The nature of our planet is rich in unusual species of flora and fauna that amaze with their diversity and beauty. Every corner of the Earth is full of wonderful and unknown representatives of the living world. The main character of this film is an outstanding activist and researcher who has dedicated his life to the study of rare species, including monarch butterflies. He believes that due to the carefree attitude of people to nature, these insects can disappear forever. He sought to convey all his research to the world, warning of the inevitable consequences for the ecosystem. However, his warnings did not find support, and he remained alone with his convictions. Suddenly, after the publication of the results of his many years of research, the man disappears from all information sources. This came as a shock to the research community that had supported his work for years. The mysterious disappearance of the activist raised many questions and left humanity in a state of tension. Who is behind this mysterious event and will he be able to cope with the danger that threatens not only him, but also the very butterflies that have become the object of his struggle?

title: Power of nature: Drought
description: More than twenty years have passed since the main character, now a successful federal detective, left his hometown, where he spent his childhood and found his best friend. Once inseparable friends went their separate ways, each choosing their own direction in life. Now the circumstances force the hero to return home to see his old friend on his last journey. This event coincides with a terrible crime that shook the whole town: a whole family was found dead in a small house. To find out what exactly happened, the hero undertakes an investigation. Returning to the places of childhood revives memories, but at the same time reveals new, disturbing facts. Unraveling a complex tangle of events, he encounters secrets that have been buried for decades, and the deeper he dives into the case, the more hidden threats and unexpected connections he uncovers.

title: Forces of Nature 2: Drought / Force of Nature 2: Drought
description: Against the background of picturesque mountains, a large-scale corporate meeting is being prepared, which the organizers planned to make not only professional, but also exciting. Participants are looking forward to team tasks and a fun quest, which should give relief and bring colleagues closer. However, what started as a casual celebration turns into a real test when one of the participants mysteriously disappears. At first it is perceived as part of the game, but later it becomes obvious that the matter is much more serious. The police were called to the scene, but the search was unsuccessful. Then an experienced federal agent joins the investigation and begins to unravel this tangle of secrets. With each step, it becomes more and more clear: there are hidden motives behind this story, and among those present there are those who are clearly hiding something. The game of survival becomes a reality, and each new piece of evidence reveals unexpected details, endangering not only the end of the meeting, but also the lives of the participants.

title: A million days
description: Humanity has approached the threshold of a historical breakthrough that could change its future forever. Long years of research, experiments and data analysis led to the preparation of a grandiose mission, which should reveal the secrets of the boundless universe. Using state-of-the-art technology and methods, a team of scientists and engineers considered all possible risks and scenarios in hopes of successfully completing this ambitious expedition. Under the guidance of an experienced astronaut, they go into space, where every action determines the future of civilization. However, at the most critical moment of the mission, it becomes clear that there are hidden dangers that can not only jeopardize the entire operation, but also destroy humanity's plans for decades to come. The expedition members are forced to act quickly, fighting against time and an unknown enemy that nullifies their chances of success. Will they be able to overcome these obstacles and complete the mission, which will be a decisive step for all mankind?

title: Madgaon Express
description: Three inseparable friends from childhood always dreamed of going to the distant and mysterious Goa. However, growing up in a deep province where poverty was a constant companion, their dream seemed out of reach. After graduating from school, they firmly decided that after receiving diplomas, they would make their wish a reality, but parental prohibitions again forced them to postpone their plans. Many years have passed, and now, having grown up, the friends decide not to give up and prepare for the dream trip with joint efforts. They are sure that everything will work out this time, but fate presents them with unexpected tests. Their path to their dream suddenly turns into a series of dangerous adventures that threaten to destroy all their plans.

title: Pulse
description: Working as a journalist in a world where shocking scandals and secrets of famous and influential people surface every day, the young heroine understood all the risks of this profession. However, the thirst for great achievements and the desire to leave a mark in history pushed her to choose this difficult path. Dreaming of a sensation that will make her name known, she boldly takes on a new task, not even knowing what dangers it will turn into. Faced with threats that threaten not only her reputation, but also her life, the girl finds herself in a whirlwind of events that force her to rethink her own priorities. The choice becomes extremely difficult: to take risks for the sake of a dream or to seek salvation, saving oneself from irreparable consequences.

title: Goodbye Buenos Aires
description: In the center of the plot is the owner of a small shoe store, who finds inspiration and comfort in music, playing in a local band. For him, music is an escape from everyday life, a way to regain strength and fill his life with emotions. But economic instability and the political situation in his native country force him to think about the future, which seems impossible under the usual conditions. The hero decides to change his life and move to Germany, hoping to find better opportunities for himself. However, going on this journey, he unexpectedly meets a young woman who changes his plans. Her appearance questions his decision and forces him to choose between the dream of a new life and a sudden feeling that turns everything upside down. Only time will tell if he will be able to find a balance between aspirations and unexpected emotions.

title: Isolation of fear
description: When an unprecedented epidemic hit the planet, mercilessly destroying everything in its path, the heroes were forced to seek refuge in a remote corner of the wild forest. Avoiding the danger that prevailed in the outside world, they created a new life in isolation, coming to terms with the fact that a return to the usual peaceful past is no longer possible. Without any connection to the outside world, the family got used to a new reality, where conditional security became the only source of peace. But everything changes when one day a stranger appears on the doorstep of their shelter. The risk of contact with him threatens to destroy the precarious balance of their existence. Forced to tread carefully, the heroes are faced with a choice: stay away or join forces with the alien to face a danger that may be closer than it seems.

title: Humane
description: Dawn is a famous chef, so the couple decides to invite their grown children to their home for one last dinner before saying goodbye to their lives. Among their guests are professor Jared (Jay Baruchel), who supports the kinovibe.co government's population reduction goals, a recovering drug addict, Noah (Sebastian Chacon) looking for redemption, struggling actress Ashley (Alanna Bale) hoping for a career boost, and pharmaceutical executive Rachel (Emily Hampshire), who faces trial for her role in a scandal that includes a consumer fatality. Rachel brings her daughter Mia (Sirena Gulamhaus) with her, adding to the frenzied dynamic of the evening. Tensions mount when Charles reveals his decision to the children, causing a family rift. However, the atmosphere becomes even more chaotic when Dawn suddenly needs to be weaned, meaning she won't be able to undergo euthanasia any time soon. The situation escalates when officials arrive, demanding to fulfill the signed contract for two bodies. Those in attendance must decide who will replace Dawn.

title: In search of money
description: A film that proposes to rethink the economic reality in which we live and to change the perception of money and its role in human life. In the center of the plot is a group of non-standard economists who challenge established ideas about finance, public debt and the nature of money. They investigate how economic mechanisms affect every sphere of human existence and strive to find new approaches capable of transforming society. The audience embarks on an exciting journey through the complex and little-known world of economic theories, where unexpected facts and connections are revealed. This story not only changes the perception of the financial system, but also raises important questions about how to overcome global challenges, opening the way to new opportunities and solutions.

title: Arcadian
description: After a catastrophic event that ravaged the world 15 years ago, the protagonist finds two children left defenseless in the face of chaos. Unable to leave them, he takes them with him on a difficult journey in search of a safe place. Time has passed, and now the man raises these boys as his own sons, trying to protect them from threats that become more active after dark. They live alone in a forest house, avoiding unnecessary contact with the world. The eldest son, Joseph, impresses with his curiosity and intelligence, while Thomas takes a risk by sneaking into a neighboring farm to see the girl who has occupied his thoughts. One day he does not return home on time, and his father, aware of the danger, goes in search of him.

title: Little ghosts
description: An inconspicuous and unsuccessful teacher in Modesto has a rare gift - he sees ghosts. However, his ability does more harm than good: constant problems at work and dismissal have become commonplace for him. Everything changes when he manages to get a job at a prestigious school, where his task becomes to help five troubled students to successfully complete their studies. However, there is one unexpected detail: these students died twenty years ago in a tragic fire that destroyed part of the school. The headmistress, exhausted by the presence of restless ghosts, puts all her hopes on Modesto, hoping that he can solve this unusual problem and finally bring peace to the walls of the educational institution.

title: Venom 3: The Last Dance
description: Eddie Brock is a talented journalist known for his investigations of high-profile and unusual cases. His life is turned upside down when he encounters a mysterious alien creature named Venom, which unexpectedly invades his body. This symbiote, possessing incredible strength and eternal hunger, gradually begins to change Eddie, turning him into a unique being with inhuman abilities. Along with this comes new challenges - both physical and moral. As Eddie and Venom learn to coexist, they go through many conflicts to finally become partners. Now they are a strange but effective team capable of operating outside the law. Venom gives Eddie superhuman powers and together they decide to administer their own justice, pursuing and punishing criminals from whom the public has not been spared. Their path is a dangerous journey through the cities of America, full not only of fighting with villains, but also of inner thoughts about the nature of good and evil. Eddie tries to find a balance between his former human way of life and a new reality where the symbiote demands its share of power and freedom. The mutual dependence between man and extraterrestrial being gradually turns from hostility to understanding, and their union turns out to be much more powerful and meaningful than they could have imagined. A new type of hero is born in this strange duo, where views clash again and again - not flawless, but resolutely ready to face evil.

title: Code name "Red"
description: A wonderful winter holiday is in danger of disruption and complete disappearance. Children will not receive the expected gifts, a miracle will not happen on the planet, and it will be impossible to revive the Christmas fairy tale. Trouble begins in the residence of the wise wizard Santa Claus. The subordinates called their leader Red, and just before Christmas he was stolen by unknown attackers. The criminals made their way to the house in the dark of the night, left no traces and did not make any demands. Santa's kingdom is in decline, chaos ensues without the patronage of a just ruler. Elves cannot cope with making and delivering presents. Callum Drift represents the Regional Security Service. The broad-shouldered agent must save humanity from its greatest disappointment and bring Klaus home. Going in pursuit of the sinister kidnappers, he cannot do without the tips of the sarcastic and narcissistic Jack O'Malley. The bounty hunter uses questionable methods to track down villains, but his tactics prove effective in a critical situation.

title: Rice boy is sleeping
description: The events take place in the 1990s, when a young Korean mother, left alone, tries to provide a better life for her son. In search of better opportunities for the child's future, she decides to leave her native country and go to America, dreaming of finding there what she always wanted. However, their path leads to the suburbs of Canada, where they start a new life in a completely unfamiliar environment. A woman desperately fights for a happy future for her son, overcoming all the difficulties of immigrant life. She brings up a teenager every day, trying to provide him with freedom and opportunities that she herself did not have. Her determination and willingness to take risks, even defy the system, show the depth of her love and indomitable spirit to give a child a real chance at happiness.

title: Diary of Anne Frank
description: In the late 1930s, the life of 13-year-old Anne Frank was filled with carefree moments. Together with her family, who lived in abundance, she leaves Germany, fleeing the fascist threat, and settles in Amsterdam. However, the Netherlands is soon occupied by the Nazi army. Anna's father, Otto, aware of all the risks, finds shelter for his family in an old factory located on the outskirts of the city. The Franks are forced to hide in the attic together with another Jewish family, not daring to go outside. Anna records everything that happens around her in her diary, creating an unforgettable testimony of those difficult times.

title: Angel-A
description: A 28-year-old man finds himself in a hopeless situation due to the debts he has accumulated before the dangerous bandits of Paris. When the deadline for payment approaches, and there is no help from the police or the embassy, ​​he decides to end his life. But on the bridge, his attention is drawn by a strange woman in a little black dress who jumps into the river. Without thinking, he rushes after her and saves her. As a sign of gratitude, the rescued woman offers to help him solve all the problems. She turns out to be unpredictable and resourceful, offering non-standard ways of earning and helping to settle matters with creditors, changing his life in an unexpected way.

title: Daddy's Daughter / The Forgotten Prince
description: Every night before bed, a father tells his young daughter fairy tales, creating a fantasy world with fairies, dragons and dangerous adventures together. In these stories, he always acts as a brave hero who protects his princess-daughter from all threats. But with the appearance of a new character - a classmate of the girl - the fairy tale changes, and the father finds himself in the gloomy land of Oblivion. Now he will have to find a way to return from this fictional darkness and become a hero again, which his daughter will appreciate not only in fairy tales, but also in real life.

title: Angus, thong and french kisses / Angus, thong and kisses by sucking
description: A fourteen-year-old girl faces all the difficulties and joys of teenage life. Her days are spent arguing with her parents, who she finds annoying, and trying to cope with her younger sister, who only adds to the chaos. At the same time, she dreams of becoming more beautiful, changing her appearance and, most importantly, finding a boyfriend who will make her life brighter. Experiencing a number of funny and uncomfortable moments, the girl discovers the world of her first passions, disappointments and the search for her own "I".

title: Outside the law
description: The events take place in New Orleans, where a DJ who is experiencing failures decides to make extra money by running over someone else's car. But his plans are ruined when the police find a dead body in the trunk, and he ends up behind bars. In the next cell turns out to be a pimp, who was set up by competitors, and now they are forced to coexist in a closed space. They are joined by a new cellmate - a cheerful Italian who hardly knows English, but charms with his love for American films and a sharp sense of humor. Despite their different personalities and circumstances, this trio comes together to pull off a daring escape from prison.

title: Rod-stuntman / Likhach / Well done
description: This young man has mastered the art of stunt work on his own, stubbornly working on every move and trick. As a child, his mother told him a story that struck his imagination: he is allegedly the son of one of the most famous racers and stuntmen - Evel Knievel. Persuasive stories from his mother made Rod believe in this story, and he began to look for a connection with his father. Despite the fact that his pseudo-father was a real hero and a famous stuntman, Rod learns that Evel died during one of the most dangerous stunts. Having lost his father, Rod decides to follow his example, despite all the difficulties. Immersed in training, he spends hours practicing each element, but the progress remains almost imperceptible.

title: Circles
description: After the events of Samara Morgan's ominous video, the tape continues to spread, as anyone who views it is forced to copy and pass it on to others to avoid a deadly curse. A subculture has sprung up around this ominous tape, where people, overcome with fear and curiosity, create so-called "rings" - groups that pass the video from one participant to another. The main character, Jake Pierce, becomes part of such a ring, preparing the next member, Tim, to take on the curse. However, things take an eerie turn when Jake begins to be haunted by horrifying visions of Samara, and her presence infiltrates even his dreams. Signs appear, such as a bruise on the hand, which symbolizes that Samara is getting closer. Can Jake break this cycle of terror, or is he destined to become another victim of an unrelenting curse?

title: Cross
description: Young girls disappear in Los Angeles, and this becomes a reason for the intervention of Kellen - a fighter for justice, endowed with the unique power of an ancient Celtic artifact. Together with a team of weapons experts, he embarks on an investigation, intending to uncover the reasons behind these mysterious events. In the process, they face a powerful enemy - an immortal Viking, who planned not only the destruction of humanity, but also the final victory over all that is good in the world.

title: A kaleidoscope of horrors
description: This tape is a unique anthology consisting of five separate stories, each of which reflects the eerie and inevitable essence of revenge. Presented as chapters of a comic read by a small boy, the events take place at different times, with different characters and circumstances. Despite the absence of excessive violence and a large number of special effects, the plot is permeated with an atmosphere that keeps the viewer in suspense. The script for this picture was created by the legendary horror master Stephen King, which makes it a special page in the history of the genre. The film demonstrates how even a simple approach to storytelling can send a real chill down your spine, forcing you to think about deeper issues.

title: Die for a dollar
description: 1897 year. Dealer Kidd hires Max Borland to track down his wife, Rachel, who has been kidnapped by an African-American soldier, Elijah. Teaming up with Sergeant Poe, Max begins a search for Elijah and his victim in Mexico, and very soon they discover that the soldier did not kidnap Rachel, but that they escaped together. Misled by Kidd, Max decides to help the couple, but they face three serious problems. The mercenary and the fugitives must face the local landowner Tiberio Vargas, who desperately defends his territory; gambler and shooter Joe Cribbens, who dreams of revenge on Borland; and Kiddu, who craves the blood of his wife and her companions...

title: All or nothing
description: In this picture there is an atmosphere of hopelessness, grayness and inner emptiness, which determine the everyday existence of the heroes. Phil, the head of the family, works as a taxi driver, but his mental pain and sense of hopelessness forces him to seek escape in secluded places, if only for a few minutes. His wife, Penny, who works as a cashier, spends her days without rest, diligently earning a living. Their daughter, Rachel, helps the family by cleaning the old people's home, while their son, Rory, is a lazy and selfish teenager who doesn't care about anything but himself. Penny's colleague, Maureen, has other difficulties in the family. Phil's colleague, Ron, is the sole breadwinner in his family, but his alcoholic wife, Carol, neglects even the needs of her own child. All members of these families go with the flow, not hoping for changes and not trying to find a way out of the situation. However, life changes when Phil's son suffers a heart attack after a fight at school. This tragedy forces the spouses to return to their feelings, and although small steps are taken towards mutual understanding, hope for the best appears again.

title: Helter-Skelter
description: Liliko is the epitome of feminine perfection, a supermodel whose face never leaves the covers of magazines and TV screens. She is the muse of photographers and the dream of designers, her beauty seems an unattainable ideal. However, a secret is hidden behind her flawless image: her appearance is the result of numerous plastic surgeries performed in her childhood. A seemingly perfect life begins to crack at the seams when past body changes make themselves known. Her impeccable image begins to crumble, and with it her psychological balance. Hysterics and fear of losing popularity turn Liliko into a prisoner of her own success. The threat of revealing the truth about the artificiality of her beauty is getting closer, because in a world where appearance is the currency, any stain on the reputation can ruin everything.

title: An Evening with Beverley Luff Lynn
description: Her thoughts are sometimes filled with the darkest ideas, including ideas about getting rid of her husband. Lulu cannot understand when exactly her life changed and why she no longer feels joy in what she used to do. One day, while watching TV, she comes across an advertisement for a unique show that is to take place in a nearby town - an event that will last only one evening. Her attention is drawn to the fact that her first love is among the participants of the show. Lulu makes an important decision: to secretly travel to this city, leaving her husband behind, to attend the show and perhaps be reunited with the man she once loved.

title: Alien 3
description: After the terrible events on the planet Acheron, where a bloody battle between humans and monstrous creatures unfolded, Ellen Ripley is once again the only survivor. Her escape pod crashes on a remote planet that once housed a foundry and is now a harsh men's prison for the most dangerous criminals. Together with Ripley, the Faceclaw enters the planet - a creature capable of giving birth to a new Alien. And when this happens, the prison turns into an arena of horror. Fear of an invisible predator grips the prisoners, who die one by one, and panic increasingly paralyzes those who remain alive. Helen, who is the only one with experience fighting the Alien, remains the last hope for salvation. She is forced to face the monster in conditions where there are no weapons and help is nowhere to be expected. In this deadly struggle, survival depends only on her determination, intelligence and courage.

title: Coincidence of circumstances
description: After being released from prison, a former criminal dies under mysterious circumstances on the very first day of his freedom. Insurance agent John Nolan unexpectedly decides to take advantage of this situation and pretends to be a murdered man. Immersing himself in a new role, he is gradually drawn into a dangerous web of someone else's past, which turns out to be much more complicated than he imagined. Over time, Nolan begins to understand that his adventure is turning against himself. Uncovering the deception becomes inevitable, but getting out of this game is almost impossible. Will he find a way to save his real life, or will his choice turn into a fatal mistake?

title: The fifth seal
description: The story unites the lives of four old friends who gather every evening in a cozy Hungarian coffee shop, enjoying wine and casual conversations about everyday matters. Their peaceful existence takes a sharp turn when the events unfolding around them force them to rethink their own values ​​and priorities. What begins as a simple everyday story gradually turns into a deep drama filled with symbolism and moral dilemmas. Against the background of historical upheavals, the heroes face questions about choice, responsibility, and the meaning of suffering. Their reflections intersect with the themes of self-discovery and spiritual search, opening a metaphorical path to understanding the meaning of life. Will they have the strength to overcome the challenges that lie ahead? Will they be able to find answers to the eternal questions that touch the very essence of human existence?

title: Bamboo
description: Alain and Anna are a married couple. He holds a managerial position in a bank, and she dreams of becoming a sought-after pianist, and also does not see herself in the role of a housewife and mother, despite Alain's desire to have a child. One day, a cute and restless dog named Bambu appears in the life of a married couple. Bambu quickly becomes a best friend for Alain, whose fatherly instinct has awakened, giving him support in his marriage with Anna, which is rapidly crumbling. When they decide to take a break from their relationship, Alain loses his job and sinks to the bottom of the social ladder, and the only one who can pull him out of a series of troubles is Bambu...

title: Who are you, Philip?
description: The events unfold in 1943 around a young Polish Jew who manages to escape from the horrors of the Warsaw Ghetto. Having found himself in the very center of Nazi Germany, he is forced to hide his origins, constantly teetering on the edge of exposure. His life turns into a dangerous game where every day can be his last. Philip finds refuge as a waiter in an elite restaurant that is part of a luxury hotel. He bathes in an atmosphere of wealth, enjoys the company of beautiful women and maintains friendly relations with people who have no idea of ​​his true origin. However, this illusory world begins to crack when the war mercilessly takes the lives of his loved ones. The impending reality forces Philip to face irreversible losses, and shattered dreams expose the fragility of the world he built.

title: Karaoke
description: Benedict, a famous opera singer, lives the life of a diva between Parisian palaces and social parties. After one too many nights, she sees her career in ruins. Fatu, also a regular at the palace, but as a cleaning lady, is the only one who lends her a helping hand. Passionate about singing, Fatu hatches one idea: to convince Benedict to take part in a big national karaoke competition. The perfect vocal skill of one and the tenacity of the other may well create a spark and take them very far.

title: Allied spies
description: World War II is going on. The main character's mission is to eliminate the German ambassador. The man meets a French woman named Marianne. She serves for the good of the Resistance. Special agents decide to combine their efforts and act as newlyweds to remove unnecessary suspicion. However, romantic feelings flare up between a man and a woman not only for the sake of the operation, but also for real. The operation was carefully prepared and successfully carried out. After that, the main characters of the picture appear in Great Britain. In London, they get married and live a happy life. A wonderful girl is born to them. A year after the wedding, the Canadian saboteur learns shocking details about his wife. It turns out that she is suspected of spying for German intelligence.

title: The Long Game
description: A group of enthusiasts decides to make their dream come true by creating a cozy golf club where everyone can enjoy the game without unnecessary pomp and privilege. Their idea arose as a counterbalance to the glitzy, prestigious venues where golf has become more of a status symbol than an actual game. The new club was located near an elite complex, causing ridicule and skepticism from the local elite, who were used to luxury. Despite the derision, the team is hard at work creating a space where gaming is fun, not an excuse to show off wealth. At their club, the main thing is passion for golf and sincerity in communication. Aiming to prove their strength, amateurs decide to compete in city competitions where they will compete with the best professionals. Dedication and belief in their own idea push them forward, but whether they will be able to overcome all obstacles and succeed will be known only during this exciting struggle. Their path promises to be difficult, but incredibly intense and full of surprises.

title: A global flood
description: An unexpected natural disaster changes the usual rhythm of human life, turning it into a desperate struggle for survival. The rain, which at first seemed ordinary, turned into a continuous downpour that covered most of the planet for several months. Powerful water flows flood cities, destroy infrastructure and leave millions of people homeless. Scientists, researchers and historians are unsuccessfully trying to find an explanation for this global phenomenon, but the nature remains a mystery. Meanwhile, the elements begin to generate new, even more dangerous disasters: landslides, floods, sudden storms. The world plunges into chaos, and the only task becomes survival. In the center of events is a woman who is trying to save herself and her little child. Forced to leave everything, she goes in search of a safe place, overcoming fears, dangers and despair. Time is working against her, and every step could be her last. Whether she finds refuge in a world that is changing before her eyes depends only on her determination and strength of spirit.

title: Life upside down
description: The events of the drama unfold during a week of strict quarantine in Los Angeles. Three couples, strangers to each other, are forced to spend this time in their homes due to sudden restrictions imposed by the authorities. Jonathan Wigglesworth, a gallery owner who has faced difficulties in business due to low sales of paintings, is sinking into despair. His lover, a college professor, Clarissa, is eager to introduce him to her friends Paul and his wife Rita. Floor, in turn, considers buying the painting while Jonathan and Clarissa spend time in a secluded room. However, when Paul's wife, Susan, shows up, they are forced to pretend to be strangers. The situation is further complicated when, after the failure of the exhibition, the gallery has to close due to the coronavirus pandemic. While Clarissa tries to maintain her long-distance relationship, she faces financial difficulties and cannot resist the charm of her tenant, Darius. At the same time, Paul's work on the book is interrupted by family problems, as well as a call from a nursing home, in which he learns about his mother's serious health condition. Each of these couples faces their own challenges and trials, while the coronavirus pandemic and quarantine make adjustments to their daily lives, forcing them to rethink their relationships, values ​​and priorities.

title: Life with leopards
description: The documentary opens the curtain on the life of two little leopards who take their first steps in the wild world of African spaces. Their story is a journey through trials and triumphs that shape them on the way from defenseless babies to true predators. The viewer witnesses their first games and attempts at hunting, watching the cubs learn to overcome difficulties, avoid dangers and find food. Their path is riddled with incredible discoveries: from the struggle for survival in harsh conditions to interaction with other inhabitants of the wild nature. The film not only shows touching moments of learning and growth, but also reflects the difficulties faced by young leopards in the struggle for their place in the world. The viewer experiences tense moments with them, when each choice can be decisive for their future. Exciting shots convey the beauty of the African landscape, as well as the harsh reality in which the life of these predators unfolds.

title: New Life
description: For several years of service, Elsa Gray brilliantly copes with any given task. Currently, the strong-willed and brave heroine has to deal with another assignment from the management. The woman still has no idea how quickly her life will turn around. She has to find and arrest a fugitive - a girl named Jessica Murdock. The latter is trying to leave the USA in a pickup truck. Jessica is heading for the Canadian border. Elsa begins to chase a pickup truck moving along the Pacific Northwest coast. But the pursuit is significantly delayed, which leads to irreversible consequences. Elsa, who simply went on an errand for higher management, finds herself involved in a fierce battle with her own amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, which causes paralysis and death of brain cells. Now she is trying to escape from an explosive case, but it is not so easy to do it. The girls themselves do not notice how their game turns into an event of apocalyptic scale. How the persecution will end remains to be guessed at.

title: For sale
description: In the center of the story is an ordinary real estate salesman, whose life is full of small affairs and dubious deals, because he is ready to do anything just to make money. His everyday life changes when a dubious company offers a profitable deal: to sell an old and, at first glance, completely unremarkable house, which has been empty for a long time. The conditions seem simple, and the promised reward is so attractive that the hero agrees without much thought. But behind the facade of an easy deal, a whole series of creepy secrets are hidden. The ancient house turns out to be a place that keeps terrible secrets of its past, which gradually begin to be revealed. Unfamiliar sounds, strange events and a feeling of constant threat make the hero realize that he is at the epicenter of a dangerous game where every step he takes can have fatal consequences.

title: Pair for release
description: Jess and Hannah, best friends and high school graduates, have been dreaming of their perfect prom for a long time. They imagined themselves in luxurious dresses, dancing with boys, with whom they are not ashamed to appear in front of the whole class. For them, this evening was supposed to be the culmination of school life, full of bright moments and unforgettable impressions. However, on the day before the prom, their plans are ruined - quarrels with the boys deprive them of their main companions of the evening and jeopardize all their ideal expectations. Now the girlfriends have only 24 hours to save the evening of their dreams. The girls decide that they cannot give up and accept the challenge. They plunge into a crazy whirlwind of events, trying to find new companions for the prom. Together, they learn to deal with disappointments, realizing that prom is not only about boys, but also about fun, friendship and the ability to find joy in the most unexpected moments. When prom night arrives, Jess and Hannah realize that perfection isn't about who you dance with, it's about how you feel in that moment. Their adventures in the last day not only help them find new partners, but also bring them closer as friends, showing that the main support is always nearby.

title: Chasing the Rhine
description: The main character is a soldier of an elite kind of army. He recently separated from his wife, who was also a former soldier. He is survived by a small daughter who now lives with his ex-wife. Once a woman was going to move to another city. But the father does not want this, he intends to do everything possible so that the child stays with her. All plans are changed by the misfortune that happened to their common child. A girl is kidnapped by a mafia group that trades in people. Now the parents urgently need to find the child, because if she is sold to someone else, it will be even more difficult to find the girl. Having united, the former spouse enters into a battle not so much for life, but for death with the brutal criminal world. At stake in this struggle is the well-being of the most precious thing they have. At the same time, they can rely only on their own strength, since the police will not be able to help them here.

title: Saiyan: Huntress
description: Chile is reeling from an environmental disaster. An international corporation, for its own benefit, is destroying the country's land and natural resources. Sayen, a brave woman of the Mapuche people, is not left out. She witnesses how the company destroys her family's land. Anger and pain for her native land pushes Sayen to fight. She enters a dangerous game against an influential corporation. Can she stop their destructive plans and protect her people's heritage?

title: your image
description: Anna and Zoya are twin sisters. They are very similar in appearance, but different in character. Hanna is quiet and modest, and her sister, on the contrary, is bold and self-confident. Once Anna meets a stock trader named Nick and falls in love with him. She is sure that this is her ideal man. The young man believes that he has found the woman of his dreams. And her sister did not like the boy very much. She was alarmed by his behavior and decided to find out the truth about him. At the same time, Zoya has the ability to penetrate into the essence of people and see through them. But what is behind her inexplicable hostility towards her relative's fiance? Maybe it's jealousy? Or she just wants to protect her, because she has repeatedly seen deception and betrayal from boys. The women began their investigation. They don't yet know what it will lead to. Will their bond, strong from birth, not withstand the tests of life and break under the pressure of those secrets that the girls know?

title: Final: Attack on Wembley
description: In the center of the plot unfolds a tense story about a decisive football match, which was supposed to be the climax of the competition between two teams - the national teams of England and Italy. The players of both sides were determined, because not only the championship title was at stake, but also the pride of their countries. Fans from all over the world fixed their eyes on the field, full of emotions and hopes. The atmosphere was so charged that every pass and every shot was met with loud cheers or sighs of disappointment. However, the match, which promised to be a grand spectacle, suddenly turned into chaos. Outside the stadium, where thousands of fans gathered, the tension reached a critical point. Some fans, not having tickets, decided to break into the stadium, and this disorder threatened to disrupt the entire order of the game. Events began to unfold so quickly and unpredictably that control over the situation seemed to be lost. It is this conflict between the sporting struggle on the field and the riots off it that becomes a key test for all involved, jeopardizing not only the match, but also the safety of the spectators and the very idea of ​​the sporting rivalry.

title: Thin wall
description: In modern houses, the walls are very thin, which leads to the fact that the level of hostility and aggression between neighbors involuntarily increases, conflicts often break out due to too high a noise level. Strangers involuntarily hear how someone else's life goes, witness dramas and fights, love, accidental passion, children's tantrums and other vicissitudes of life. No one wants to constantly know extraneous problems. Eavesdropping is attractive, but not often and not for an adequate person who needs peace. For David, this is also a professional need. He creates inventions and does science at home, and any sounds harm him, he cannot stand noises, and Valentina's neighbor has a piano. The girl began to study the art of the piano almost from scratch, which annoys the boy very much. They conflict, but after face-to-face acquaintance they try to find compromises. Communication smoothly turns into sympathy, and then into romantic feelings.

title: Turtles all the way to the bottom
description: This story is an adaptation of a dramatic novel by the popular writer John Green. inflicted by the closest people. Aza is torn apart by the desire to be good for everyone: her parents, her friends. It is important for her to be the best in the class, besides, she is haunted by obsessive thoughts that make her doubt her own mental health. to stop comparing yourself to everyone else and to understand that it is more important to be a person, an individual who is good on her own, not because she has the best grades in the class or helps her parents to the detriment of her own interests. That friendship is valued for human qualities, and not for school popularity?

title: 13 explosions in Jakarta
description: There are 13 bombs planted in the heart of Jakarta that are ready to explode at any moment. The city freezes with horror, and the authorities throw all their efforts into the search for criminals and the disposal of explosive devices. A task force with the best minds and advanced technology takes responsibility to save the city. They will have to go through a maze of evidence, solve tricky ciphers and stay ahead of time to prevent a catastrophe.

title: Monster / Monster
description: A new chapter of an incredible adventure unfolds in the expanses of endless ocean waters, where a young and brave girl, together with a powerful demigod, again plunges into a whirlpool of dangers. This time their path is full of mysteries, dangers and unexpected turns. Having received a mysterious call from their ancestors, who were once seekers of the unknown, they set off in search of long-forgotten lands and hidden truths. The journey is full of trials, where every wave brings new challenges, and every sea wind mysterious signs of fate. The heroes will face the forces of nature, mysterious creatures and mysterious events that will test their determination and strength of spirit. In this exciting journey, they must join forces to overcome all obstacles and find the answers they are looking for. Unexplored horizons, hidden secrets and a great challenge of fate await the brave seekers, forcing them to go to the end in this incredible journey that will change not only their lives, but also the legacy of an entire generation.

title: Sixth
description: The events of the film send the viewer to a turbulent time when unknown people capture the Capitol in Washington, trying to destroy the foundations of power. This is not only an attack on a government body, but also on an entire nation under siege. The city, and with it the whole country, turns into a zone of fear and tension. When the criminals start voicing their demands, the situation becomes even more critical. Everyone who got to the Capitol that day is forced to fight for their survival and find ways to save themselves. This is the story of people who survived those tragic events, with new views on reality, and are now ready to share the truth about everything that happened behind the walls of this highest state body. Fear, tension, struggle for survival and important decisions that later became a part of their lives changed their destinies forever.

title: Spanish courier
description: This is the story of a man who, starting from the lowest levels of the criminal world, gradually built his career and gained power in the very heart of corruption. The film examines his path in detail — from the first mistakes and trials to the moment when he became a dominant figure in criminal circles. Step by step, through betrayal, dangerous alliances and difficult decisions, the hero climbed the ladder of the criminal hierarchy to reach its peak. The picture reveals all aspects of his formation, showing that every success was achieved not only through ambition, but also through the willingness to sacrifice moral principles.

title: Ferrari
description: Difficult times have come in the life of Enzo Ferrari. The car business could go bankrupt. And Alfredo's son died of muscular dystrophy. The guy was treated for a long time, but the disease was constantly growing. Once a successful racer and constructor, he fell into depression. He is over sixty. The best time is over. The man needed a new challenge. A vital boost is much needed. The main character will be able to gather his strength. He will figure out how to fix his company's problems. It is necessary to take part in the race. City race fits. On it, you can show the capabilities of your machines in real conditions. To prove to people that cars are suitable for everyday driving. Enzo will sign up as a member. His determination will surprise many of his acquaintances. It was time for the speech. Ferrari needs to evaluate the route. Check the equipment and adjust. He did not perform for several years. If the plan works, then Ferrari will return the lost popularity. It was a battle to save a beloved cause.

title: I will fall at your feet
description: After a failed new album, a famous rock star goes on a road trip to get away from it all for a while. He hopes to find peace in Cyprus, away from constant attention and noise. However, even on vacation, he cannot avoid people who want to talk to him. The desire to escape from problems and find peace is replaced by a struggle with new difficulties that appear in front of him. This becomes the beginning of a new stage in life, when the musician begins to look at the world in a new way, opening up new opportunities for change. He has to decide whether he can find true happiness and how it will affect his future.

title: The wind blows cold
description: The story revolves around a young couple, Dina and Tasha, who get behind the wheel for the first time under the influence of alcohol, which becomes their first and fatal mistake. Shortly after they set off, their carelessness and confused thoughts lead to tragedy when they hit a man who was running down the road. However, instead of calling an ambulance and the police, the couple decide to dispose of the body, drive it away from the scene and bury it to avoid liability. Feeling guilty for the murder, the heroes become nervous and cannot find a common language, which leads to chaos and misunderstandings. Problems take a new turn when they are approached by a mysterious stranger who claims to have witnessed their crime. He offers them to remain silent in exchange for protection. Soon Dina and Tasha face even greater dangers, and the night that began with one tragedy seems to have no end. The situation becomes even more dire when the number of victims begins to rise.

title: Randel: Cycle
description: After losing his family to a heinous crime, Remo embarks on a path of revenge, donning the mask of the self-proclaimed Randel. His only goal is to destroy VALA, a ruthless corporation that, for the sake of profit, released deadly untested vaccines on the market. Remo, a former employee of VALA, tried to expose their criminal machinations, for which he and his family will be shot. As the sole survivor and obsessed with a thirst for justice, he is now ready to challenge the ruthless Christopher "Smiley" Cox, VALA's right-hand man. In this fight for the truth, a bloody spiral unfolds, awakening the ghosts of the past...

title: Massacre in the house of Amp
description: Social popularity has always had its dark side for those who choose to openly display their lives. Open existence in public allows strangers to penetrate into the most secret aspects of their existence. However, having won the favor of their fans, such people get used to being in the center of attention, even when it begins to threaten their safety. This time, their notoriety turns against them when a brutal enemy uses their openness to watch their every move, leaving their victims with little chance of escape. A group of influential people living in a luxurious house in the Hollywood Hills are trapped by a maniac who begins a deadly game of survival. Once their biggest secrets are revealed, there seems to be no way out. The killer brings everyone's darkest secrets to the surface, forcing them to fight for their lives.

title: Evidence of love
description: This is a heartwarming romantic comedy that skillfully uses science fiction elements to bring an estranged couple back together. In the center of the plot will be Marco Antonio (Fabio Porchat), who for the first time feels the bliss of falling in love and getting to know Laura (Sandy). As the story progresses, we see Marco Antonio's life a year after their painful breakup, which happened just before the wedding. A young man suffers a kind of curse. Every time the song "Proof" by Chitaozinho, Sororo and José Augusto plays, he faints and is transported back to the vivid memories of his time with Laura. These repeated trips into the past serve as a portal for Marco Antonio to relive important moments and reveal the reasons behind Laura's sudden decision to call off the wedding - something he previously could not understand. Each flashback brings Marco Antonio closer to understanding Laura's point of view and the underlying issues that led to their breakup kinovibe.co. He begins to see the mistakes he made and the misunderstandings that arose. These revelations give him the insight he needs to sincerely apologize to Laura.

title: Bride redemption
description: The film tells the story of Ace Ngubeni, a recognized master of negotiating lobola, a traditional practice where the groom's family pays the bride's family before the wedding. Ace became famous for his ability to successfully negotiate these negotiations, helping to lower the price of "lobola" for the families of the bridegrooms. His services were in high demand and he quickly built a thriving business. However, everything changed when one of his clients decided to take on the role of negotiator himself, asking Ace to personally conduct the negotiations, which was extremely risky. This meant that he had to be prepared for the groom to resort to deception about his family. Nevertheless, the high fee for the service prompted Ace to accept this challenge, which promised him a dangerous but profitable result.

title: Intelligence agent
description: In the center of the plot is a special operative group that protects the Earth from threats coming from space. The events unfold after the death of the group's commander during a clash with the Kenyans, a hostile alien race that appeared on the planet five centuries ago. Despite his death, the commander managed to digitize his consciousness, which is now stored in a special device. With this device, he can consult the team, explain complex situations and formulate tasks while connected to the body created for him. The operatives' new task is to find and rescue the captain, who, according to the data, is at a secret base where dangerous experiments using an alien substance were conducted.

title: Football star
description: The center of attention is a novice football player, whose career is at the start. He does not yet know what awaits him ahead and how the whole future fate will unfold. But it is all the more interesting to watch the unpredictable fate. Everything was going well and he got into a desperate fight and didn't end up on the bench. This becomes his fatal mistake, after which his further career may be on the verge of collapse. Not knowing how to behave in the situation, he decides to turn to a mentor. This person is a real recluse. He copes with various challenges on his way and knows no obstacles. Their communication becomes a series of new discoveries and allows them to find answers to many questions. They feel that from now on nothing will be impossible. And it is worth coming to terms with the fact that the world will change forever.

title: An evening of games
description: Pia, a passionate fan of board games, decides to invite her new boyfriend Ian to another night out with friends. This will be their first joint event in the circle of her loved ones, and the girl hopes that Ian will be able to fit into the company. The evening promises to be light and pleasant, until her ex-boyfriend appears - the one she did not expect to see. His visit instantly creates tension in the room. Pia's ex-boyfriend, who is met by friends with various reactions - from surprise to tense silence, tries to regain his place in the girl's life. Yan, feeling this pressure, tries to remain calm, but with every minute the atmosphere of the game turns into a battlefield not only on the board, but also for the attention of the chosen one. Under the mask of friendliness are hidden jokes and intense looks, and the game itself becomes a symbol of the confrontation between the present and the past. An evening that started as an innocent game turns into a confrontation where every move can change the balance of power. The heroine is faced with a difficult choice - to return the past or give a chance to a new relationship. Yang, faced with an opponent who has known the girl longer, is forced to show coolness and confidence in order not to make a mistake. The game is over, but the real stakes are much higher: Who will make the decisive move that will determine the future of their relationship?

title: Pete Davidson: Turbo Fonzarelli
description: After a three-year break, the comedian returns to the stage with a special performance full of candid stories and sharp jokes. He recalls funny moments from his childhood, including his admiration for a famous actor, shares his impressions of his 30th birthday, talks about living in isolation and a strange gift he received from a fan. There is a lot of self-irony in the performance: talking about experiences with drugs, jokes about his mother's personal life, including his lack of it, and honest stories about struggling with mental difficulties. Staying true to his style, he skillfully combines dark humor with life observations, making the audience laugh even at the most risqué topics.

title: The present day
description: Time... A mysterious substance, and people better appreciate it... The main character is an unusual boy who reveals a truly unique ability. He had never before thought that he could manage time with family value. What will the main character do with his unusual abilities? With the help of a family heirloom, the hero manages the most important element in the life of any person - time. Together with his brother and sister, the main character decides to travel to the past to understand the relationship of his parents, who are going through difficult times. The boy thinks that, being in the past, he will simply reconcile his parents, and nothing that happened to their family will simply not happen. But the boy did not take into account an important thing, managing time is not so easy. The point is that you need to know the measure. Will the main character be able to realize his plan, at the same time without breaking the delicate balance, because interfering with the natural course of time is a dangerous occupation. But the hero wishes well-being to his family, he is ready to take risks.

title: Nocturnal disappearance
description: A middle-aged man is going through a difficult time in his life when his marriage breaks down and the divorce turns into a bitter struggle where each side uses the worst methods to gain the upper hand. In the process, unpleasant details are revealed: he has a passion for gambling and has lost significant sums borrowed to renovate a country house, and she has struggled with drug addiction in the past. One evening, his children stay home with him while his wife goes on business. The day is filled with tension: a quarrel with an arrogant neighbor who defiantly flaunts a luxury yacht in front of the children, and the situation is aggravated by a visit from creditors who demand the return of debts and threaten to deprive him of his house. However, the real horror comes at night, when the man realizes that the children have disappeared from their room...

title: Wild wild Punjab
description: A young man named Hanna is going through difficult times and falls into a deep depression. The boy does not see further prospects and loses the meaning of life. Faithful comrades who do not want to leave a friend in trouble come to the rescue. They organize a joint event aimed at raising the spirits of their peers. The prank is connected with an exciting adventure and arrival at a place where the heroes have not been yet, but have long dreamed of visiting. Yes, the company goes to Punjab where they enjoy amazing scenic views and a fun weekend. Unforgettable emotions await the boys, forcing them to reevaluate their usual values. However, on the way, the four face unexpected tests that test their endurance and patience. Arora, Honey and Jane find themselves by Hanna's side and support him in every way. What will be the consequences of the trip and will the hero manage to find mental balance, despite the failures that haunt him?

title: Shahagaari / Herbivores
description: The lives of several ordinary people suddenly become intertwined when they find themselves involved in a series of dangerous and unpredictable events. At first it seems that their paths have nothing in common, but soon they find themselves at the center of a real nightmare, where each of them becomes part of a big secret that threatens their lives. It all begins with a mysterious series of murders, which are behind a ruthless enemy. The setting is a popular vegetarian restaurant run by a decent and respectable man named Subbanna. What should have been his pride and favorite thing suddenly turns into the scene of a brutal crime. As a result, under the pressure of new, incredibly dangerous circumstances, Subbanna finds himself trapped, where he can be charged as an accomplice to the crime. Every step he takes is now fraught with risk, and he finds himself in a desperate situation where he will have to find a way to get out of this deadly web.

title: Juanpis González: People's President
description: Juanpis Gonzalez is a rich and irresponsible man who is used to getting everything he wants. After a humiliating incident at one of the parties, Juanpis's grandfather challenges him to kinovibe.co to prove that he is worthy to inherit the family fortune. Since then, Juanpis has been paired with Camila, his grandfather's diligent employee, who is tasked with keeping him under control. As they work together, Juanpis begins to realize his mistake and strives to become better. However, he encounters numerous problems and obstacles on his way. Despite his initial resistance, Juanpis turns into a more responsible and caring person. As he navigates the complexities of his new responsibilities, he learns valuable lessons about humility, compassion, and the true meaning of wealth. The story delves into a journey of self-discovery and personal growth as Juanpis becomes president through his connections and navigates the treacherous waters of power. However, as he interacts with Camila and the people around him, he begins to understand the importance of honesty and compassion.

title: Sex positive
description: A young girl who lives an ordinary life begins to understand that her everyday life has become too monotonous. The daily routine, similar to a closed circle, completely absorbed her, robbing her of joy and inspiration. In search of change, she tries to find hobbies or activities that could give her new emotions, but none of the options bring the expected satisfaction. Everything changes when chance leads her to an unknown world, full of new sensations, freedom and unrestrainedness. Immersed in this amazing space, the girl finds what she was missing so much - the freedom to be herself. She meets a group of peers who live without restrictions and enjoy every moment of their existence. In their company, the heroine discovers a new lifestyle, which gives her not only thrills, but also a sense of unity with those who also strive to break out of the ordinary.
