Now, together with her new friends, she plunges into a world where emotions and freedom come to the fore, leaving behind fears and insecurities. This trip becomes a chance for her to find her true self and open the door to a life she never dreamed of.

title: How to go on a date with Billy Walsh
description: The childhood friendship of the main characters became the foundation of their relationship, which grew stronger over the years. They grew up together, experienced all the difficulties of life side by side and remained inseparable even in high school. Their mutual support and care became an example of true friendship, tested by time. However, the girl doesn't even know that her best friend has been feeling completely different, deeper feelings for her for a long time. After many years of indecision, the guy finally dares to open his heart. He decides to confess his love, hoping that it will change their future. But unexpectedly, his plans are threatened when a new exchange student arrives at their school. This charismatic and confident young man instantly wins the sympathy of those around him, including a girl who becomes the object of his attention. The guy understands that he risks losing the chance to tell about his feelings, but he has no intention of giving up. He will have to overcome his doubts, find courage and act to prevent his rival from taking away the most important person in his life. But will he have enough strength and time to take a decisive step when fate has arranged such a difficult test?

title: Goyo / Goyo
description: Goyo has been working at the Museum of Fine Arts for a long time as a tour guide and loves what he does. He would be an ardent fan of Van Gogh and always admired his work. Everything in his life is strictly according to schedule, since the young man suffers from autism and this is the only way he can feel calm in the world around him. One day, a charming girl named Eva gets a job as a security guard in the museum, and as soon as the main character saw her, he immediately fell in love. The girl herself is going through a difficult period due to the fact that her marriage broke up. She is disappointed in men and believes that love does not exist. When Goyo tried to give her signs of attention, she pretended not to notice anything. But gradually she was able to get used to this unusual young man and decided to give a chance to a new relationship.

title: Wars in the arena
description: In 2045, a group of convicted criminals get a unique chance to regain their freedom by competing in a brutal TV show where seven death chambers await them. Each room becomes an arena where participants must defeat one of the seven most dangerous killers in the country. Surviving each challenge brings them closer to freedom, but each step carries the risk of death.

title: Scotow
description: In the center of the plot unfolds the tense story of the professional activities of two detectives who are on the path to fight against an influential criminal cartel. The main characters, Sino and Mo, having received information about large-scale drug smuggling, decide to expose the criminals themselves and destroy their illegal schemes. They combine their efforts to penetrate into the very heart of a dangerous group, using all their experience and professional skills. The investigation leads them to a large-scale cocaine smuggling operation, which they must stop at any cost. However, in the process, they find themselves drawn into a deadly web of intrigue, where every step can be fatal. The heroes have to balance risk and caution, implementing new methods to track the actions of the cartel in order to expose its leaders. Events turn into a real test of the strength of their partnership and endurance. Their mission becomes more and more dangerous, and the question now is not only one of justice, but also one of survival. It depends on their courage and determination whether they can see the case through, protecting themselves and bringing the criminals to justice.

title: Kempton Manor
description: The writer intends to solve one ancient mystery. It is important for him to know the truth. But unexpectedly, the hero finds himself involved in a story related to mysterious ghosts. After that, his fate will not be the same and he has to put up with it. The man was not ready for such changes. But there will be no turning back. An exciting series of discoveries will give you a lot of bright emotions and will be the beginning of something truly beautiful. What will happen in the future? And what surprises should a creative person expect? He could not even imagine that this was only the beginning. And the most interesting, as before, awaits ahead. But now all problems will remain only a distant memory. An interesting story continues to throw up many different surprises and becomes the beginning of bright achievements. But this will only give him an opportunity to check his fortitude and make difficult decisions.

title: Monster High. Part 2
description: In the second year of study at the monster school, its students face new challenges. Claudine, Draculaura, and Frankie find themselves at the center of events when meeting new students and unexpected powers force them to reconsider their options. However, the real test is the threat that hangs over the school, capable of destroying not only their friendship, but also the usual order of the entire world of monsters. A sinister secret hidden within the very walls of the school requires the heroes to show all their abilities, courage and unity in order to face the danger. As they unravel the intricate mystery, Claudine, Draculaura and Frankie face challenges that force them to learn to trust each other and find solutions through mutual support. This adventure becomes for them not only a struggle for school, but also a lesson that true strength lies in friendship and unity even in the darkest moments.

title: The life of a dog
description: At the center of this exciting story is the integral role of our four-legged friends, faithful and devoted helpers of man. The plot of the film tells how one accidentally lost dog can change the destinies of several strangers, radically influencing their lives. The main character, becoming the accidental owner of a cute dog, has no idea that this small decision will turn into a big adventure. Rushing to help the dog, she finds herself at the epicenter of a series of mysterious events that occur in her life. The adventures of the heroine, which are intertwined with the search for a dog, lead to a series of unexpected changes in her life. This is a story about friendship, self-sacrifice and the incredible ability of animals to influence human hearts and destinies.

title: Labor Day
description: Derek Rais is a veteran who has been through several hot spots. He bravely served his country and expected that the Motherland would take care of him and his family in return. However, after returning home, the man found that his relatives were in a difficult situation. To help them get back on their feet, the former military man went looking for work. But now no one offers any favorable job offers for a person with his experience. And where they can still pay good money for work, they prefer to recruit employees with a different skin tone. For the descendant of Latin American emigrants in modern Texas, only two paths are open. Work on someone else's farm for pennies or join a gang. The veteran chooses an honest path and went to work in the field together with his new acquaintances. The employers looked quite decent and friendly people. So the workers easily fell into the nets. The owner of the farm turned out to be a real sadist who loves to organize migrant hunts for his friends. To survive in this hell, the main character will have to remember everything that the combat commanders taught him.

title: Heritage
description: An old millionaire gathers his relatives to hold a family reunion with them, which may very well turn out to be the last. He already has one foot in the grave. There is very little time left. Karol, Natalya and David are looking forward to the announcement of their beloved uncle's will. This is the only reason they wanted to meet. Relatives have not communicated for a long time. After numerous quarrels, each of them went their separate ways. And this circumstance upsets the old man very much. Vladyslav wants to try to reconcile everyone and for this he invents an unusual game. In order to receive an inheritance, all family members will have to unite and forget about old grudges. They will go to a luxurious mansion in which a millionaire has built many game rooms. Heroes will have to pass various tests and solve difficult tasks. At the same time, in a strange house, everything is specially arranged in such a way that it was simply impossible to reach the finish line alone.

title: I saw the light of the TV
description: Owen, an ordinary teenager from the suburbs, is just trying to cope with his everyday life. But everything changes when his classmate introduces him to a mysterious late-night program. The world of the supernatural unfolds on the screen, hidden behind the veil of generality. In the flickering light of the TV, Owen's reality begins to crack. The line between what he sees on the screen and his own life becomes blurred. Will he be able to solve the secret of the program, or will this other world swallow him up?

title: Stranger
description: In the ruthless world of the corporate game, the young and determined Rahul is faced with difficult choices that challenge his moral principles. His boss, the charismatic and uncompromising Veer, symbolizes power and success, but at the same time represents the complex ethical dilemmas that Rahul has to contend with. Veer runs the company with iron confidence, not shying away from risky decisions that pave the way for huge profits, but often cross the line of morality. When a big deal looms on the horizon, capable of bringing the company colossal revenue, Rahul is faced with a choice. The proposal threatens to ruin the lives of small suppliers, but at the same time promises him an attractive promotion and financial stability. Rahul feels torn between his own conscience and his desire for success, hoping to find a way that will preserve his values. However, Veer is steadfast in his convictions: to achieve a great goal, any means is justified. In a tense struggle between ethics and ambition, Rahul must decide whether it is more important for him to follow his principles or obey the laws of the cruel world of business.

title: Blessed are the dead
description: No one knows what is happening, but it seems to be the end of human civilization in the usual sense. Scientists refuse to believe it, ordinary people are completely shocked, but what happened? The fact is that the dead return to life in huge numbers. Now they roam the towns and villages like restless zombies. The government, of course, is at a loss, no one can do anything, the world seems to have frozen in terrible terror. The main character is Gustav, who decides to protect his family from the possible appearance of zombies. He recently buried his grandson, and now he wants to dig up his corpse so that he does not become a zombak in any case. In parallel with this, the story of Flora develops, who, despite her teenage years, is already quite a powerful psychic. The girl gets the task to make the zombaks return to their eternal sleep. But how will all this be implemented?

title: Take involuntarily
description: The documentary offers an incredible story about two sets of twins who were mixed up at birth in Colombia. Their destinies were such that each of them grew up in different families, unaware of the existence of their brothers. Only an accidental discovery many years later changed their lives forever. Encountering the truth becomes a real test for the heroes, because they have to accept the fact of substitution and comprehend the new reality unfolding before them. Seeing each other for the first time, the twins are faced with a mirror likeness that calls everything into question. The film focuses on the emotional experiences of the characters who are faced with the challenge of rediscovering their own identity, rethinking their past and building connections that did not exist before.

title: Mummy
description: In the endless expanses of the Egyptian desert, a company of desperadoes of various nationalities rummages in search of the countless treasures of the pharaoh, which are burdened by a terrible ancient curse. Next to the treasure rests the mummy of an insidious priest, brutally executed for the terrible murder of the mighty ruler of Egypt. Gold diggers have disturbed the centuries-old peace of the tomb, and the mummy rises from the grave to plunge the world into the realm of nightmare...

title: Casanova
description: The action takes place on the magical streets of Venice in 1753. The plot revolves around a young, incredibly seductive and polite young man - Giacomo Casanova. The film "Casanova" (2005) will be enjoyed by all fans of dramatic films and comedies in Ukrainian live.

title: Antigang / Detachment
description: Serge Buren is a policeman who believes that all means are good in the fight against crime. He often breaks the law, but it pays off, and the city's most dangerous criminals end up behind bars. His methods help him a lot in the fight against the criminal world and thanks to them he becomes a true legend. Together with his wards, Buren has arrested many dangerous criminals, and he is not going to stop there. His new job is to catch a brutal gang of robbers, who not only raid jewelry stores, but also kill innocent people who stand in their way... All fans of crime thrillers and dramas will enjoy watching the movie "Antigang / Squad" (2015) in Ukrainian.

title: Amsterdam
description: Two soldiers and a nurse first met in Amsterdam, where they swore to protect each other no matter what. Years later, fate brings them together. Only the heroes become prime suspects in the murder. They disappeared from the scene of the crime, but it was not difficult to track them down. Now the friends are trying to do everything possible to find the real killer and get rid of all the charges. But they have no idea what a dangerous game they have become involved in. We recommend watching the movie "Amsterdam" (2022) in Ukrainian for fans of comedic dramas and detective stories.

title: Red cap
description: Valeria - a girl in a red cloak - has to reveal who is a werewolf in her native village. Meanwhile, on the personal front, everything is not easy for Valery either: her mother wants to marry her off to a rich blacksmith, Henry, while the girl is in love with a pagan Peter, a local woodcutter. The film "Red Riding Hood" (2011) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and fantasy films in Ukrainian.

title: Grandma from the city
description: Charlie, a young student, returns to a farm in the suburbs of New Jersey. Charlie, who is studying to be a financier and has a completely different outlook on life than her mother, tries to find a common language and help in a difficult period. They are soon joined by Solange, Charlie's grandmother and Laura's mother, who long ago left the US and settled in France. An eccentric Frenchwoman and ardent feminist, Solange arrives after a long estrangement to support her daughter. Her unexpected visit becomes a challenge for everyone: three women, each with their own principles, vision of the world and unresolved family conflicts, are forced to learn to coexist under one roof. Interaction between generations, deep emotions and the search for mutual understanding turn ordinary family life into a real journey to acceptance and love.

title: Family affair
description: At the center of this unusual romantic story are three people whose destinies are unexpectedly intertwined in a complex love triangle. A young girl, her own mother and a powerful boss find themselves facing a difficult test where feelings collide with doubt and their identities are put to the test. This unexpected romantic confusion leads to unexpected and sometimes funny consequences that force each of the characters to reconsider their ideas about love, honesty and themselves. It gradually becomes clear that each of them is hiding something important, and their feelings may be far from what they themselves believed to be true. In this confusing game of hearts, each of them is forced to independently understand their emotions, find answers to deep questions and decide which way to go next. The atmosphere of this story is full of secrets, comic situations and unexpected discoveries that lead the heroes to self-discovery. Join this amazing journey full of tenderness, drama and fun moments with the main characters.

title: Substance
description: The film tells the story of Laura, a once popular fitness TV star who is forced to retire by her boss. Feeling forgotten and far from her former glory, the woman faces the crisis of aging and the loss of her former beauty and influence. But soon fate presents her with an unexpected chance: a mysterious organization offers her to try the unique drug "Substance", which every other week transforms her into a young beauty who thrives on health. At first, Laura enjoys her new life, receiving attention and admiration, which was not available to her for so long. She is once again returning to the world of fitness and show business, impressing those around her with her energy and unfading appearance. However, according to the terms of the agreement, once every 2 weeks she is obliged to spend in her true body, reminding herself that beauty and youth are temporary. This contrast between the two incarnations begins to cause deep inner feelings in Laura, forcing her to think about the true value of her self. Gradually, the woman realizes that the constant change of personalities and appearances does not solve her internal conflicts, but only intensifies them. She loses her sense of reality, feels dependent on the drug and tries to maintain her ideal image. Questions about who she really is and whether she should sacrifice individuality for the illusion of youth become central to her emotional and physical battle.

title: Jokes aside 2
description: Having different origins and their own, sometimes extraordinary, approach to conducting an investigation, two experienced detectives have repeatedly revealed very confusing and incomprehensible criminal stories together. The guys know how to extract information from silent witnesses or hardened bandits, they know how to act brilliantly under cover. The slightly shy Ousmane Diakite and the self-confident Francois Marie worked separately for a long time, but the need to trace the chain of large drug supplies in France brings the colleagues together again. The tandem of dissimilar detectives raises doubts among their former partners, but they are desperate to prove their effectiveness and are not afraid of the risks associated with an adventurous task. Gradually tracking the local drug traffic, associates advance to the Alps, where the trail of the syndicate is lost. Persistent searchers have to interrogate strippers, run away from fighting dogs and make dizzying pursuits in the hope of declassifying the activities of a large criminal organization. Curious adventures do not prevent policemen with the usual French charm from going to the goal.

title: Woman of the hour
description: Sometimes the fair sex can do really stupid things. They are so bored without love and affection that they are ready to trust the first person they meet. Such behavior can be very dangerous and has negative consequences. After all, a stranger hides his secrets skillfully. And all the same, beauties take risks. Cheryl Bradshaw was alone for a long time. She was fed up with this situation. She decided to meet someone. To achieve the goal, the girl takes part in the TV show "Dating Game". There she meets Rodney. She liked the young man very much. Cheryl also noticed his caring gaze. It seemed to her that fate had brought them together. However, she was wrong. After filming, they agreed on a date. In the cafe, the girl began to notice that her chosen one was a little strange. She had a mysterious premonition. The more they talked, the scarier she became. And not for nothing. After all, the guy turned out to be a cruel serial killer who was hungry for new blood.

title: Abandoned
description: The film "Abandoned" will send to the events that take place in December 1970. Barton Academy is considered a prestigious educational institution, where the children of wealthy and influential parents study. During the Christmas holidays, it is customary to go home to spend time with relatives and friends. There are a few students left in the academy whose academic success leaves much to be desired. They had to stay on campus because their parents couldn't take them home. The students have to be looked after by a hateful history teacher who inspires fear just by his appearance alone. Khanem is considered a representative of the old school and adheres to strict methods of upbringing. A local cook named Mary, whose son recently died in Vietnam, also has to face the holiday alone. A diverse company should spend time together, and close communication will lead to unexpected results. Revelations will make you reconsider your views on many familiar things, and people will begin to open up from a new angle.

title: Rumble through the darkness
description: The story takes place in the bleak lands of the Mississippi Delta, where life seems harder than anywhere else. In the center of the plot is a man who takes part in brutal fights without rules, relying only on his fists and an indomitable will to win. His struggle is not just about survival, but about a chance to correct the mistakes of the past. The hero tries to pay off the numerous debts that drag him to the bottom, and at the same time he fights for the preservation of the house that became a shelter for his adoptive mother. Each battle is a test at the limit of physical and moral strength, but for him it is the only way to protect what he considers his home.

title: Rookies
description: Four inseparable friends suddenly find themselves on the threshold of adulthood, which seems to them unexpected and too rapid. Just yesterday they were ordinary schoolchildren, carelessly enjoying their childhood, and today they are already preparing for their first party in high school. This event becomes a real test for them, because their status among their peers depends on it. The boys put all their efforts into being as ready as possible for this evening: from choosing clothes to creating the impression they want to leave. However, everything does not go according to plan. The party, which was supposed to be a pleasant experience for them, turns into a real whirlwind of events. Dances, new acquaintances, and unexpected adventures — all this is mixed into a single insanely bright night. Friends find themselves in the very center of chaos, where every step brings new surprises. What should have been a carefully planned holiday becomes a life lesson filled with laughter, unpredictability and moments they will remember forever.

title: Smile 2
description: In the new part of the film, the audience will meet an ominous demon, who this time will take the form of a small, innocent girl. His new victim will be a pop star named Riley, known for her charisma, energy and ambition. During her world tour, in an effort to gain new experiences and expand her horizons, she had no idea that she was being hunted by a terrible force. The curse not only follows her around the world, but also becomes practically unrelenting. Now not only career is at stake, but also life.

title: Groom for Christmas
description: In the center of the plot is a company of girlfriends. Christmas and the wedding of one of them are approaching. That is why the heroines go to the amusement park, where they intend to hold a bachelorette party. Soon, Zooey decides to take a desperate step and declares that she will get married. It's just that she doesn't have a suitable candidate. She recently caught her boyfriend with a friend and now she hates Christmas. While all the girls are happy with their husbands and their significant others, the heroine suffers from loneliness. Then the friends decide to find her a suitable candidate. There are quite a lot of applicants, but is there one among them with whom she can really become happy? The movie "Groom for Christmas" (2021) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of comedic and melodramatic Christmas films.

title: Couple on holidays
description: Holiday Couple is a romantic comedy about Tiffany Williams, who planned to reunite with her old friend and crush Brett, but discovers that he has a girlfriend, then reunites with Peter to get the love of their lives back.Tiffany Williams, full of hopes and expectations, prepares to reunite with Brett, an old family friend with whom she has a secret crush. for many years. However, her dreams are shattered when she finds out that Brett is now dating another girl. This discovery forces her to rethink her feelings and plans for the future. Meanwhile, Tiffany meets Peter, a man who is also experiencing disappointment in his personal life. Peter recently broke up with his girlfriend and is now suffering from a broken heart. In conditions of mutual loneliness and disappointment, Tiffany and Peter decide to join forces to help each other win back the affection of their soulmates. The film explores the themes of love, friendship and mutual aid. With his help, viewers will see how two broken hearts seek comfort and support in each other, and how this unexpected union leads them to understand that sometimes true love can be right next door. "A couple for the holidays" is a story about finding love, self-discovery and the importance of support in difficult times.

title: Only girls in jazz / Some like it hotter
description: Resourceful musician friends Joe and Jeri decided that it was too early for them to die, so they quickly jumped on a train heading to sunny Florida. And to make it harder for the Chicago gangsters to find them, the musicians change their men's outfits to women's and become the girls Josephine and Daphne, instrumentalists of a women's jazz band. Their friends are well accepted in the women's group, so they manage to hide from the bandits. At first, everything goes smoothly for Joe and Jerry, they find themselves in the company of beautiful ladies who are courted by gentlemen, and the musicians themselves are under the watchful eye of free-spirited men who do not know about their little secret. But already in Florida, the musicians find out that gangsters from Chicago will be staying in the same hotel with them.

title: See you next Christmas
description: The life of the main character unexpectedly gives her a unique chance to turn dreams into reality. Layla, a young woman determined to make her dreams come true, rushes into the thick of pre-holiday New York to buy a dream ticket to the main event of the season. Her goal is a concert by her favorite performer, which promises to be a real sell-out on Christmas Eve. For Leila, this is not just an event, but a chance to realize one of her most cherished dreams. However, time is not on her side. Layla is in a hurry, facing a variety of comical and unpredictable situations that force her to balance between hope and despair. She cannot afford a second of delay, because this chance is too valuable to lose. Passionate about her own aspirations, she overcomes obstacles and proves that dreams are worth chasing under any circumstances.

title: Bookworm
description: When her father, a professional illusionist who has been absent for many years, returns to the life of a young student, Mildred, he invites her on an unusual journey. Having given up magic tricks, he offers an expedition into the jungle in search of a rare species of panther. In the process of their joint journey along unexplored paths, Mildred and her father not only solve the mysteries of the disappearance of unique animals, but also find a way to restore their family ties.

title: A problemist
description: A designer from El Salvador seeks to realize his creative ambitions in New York, turning unusual ideas into reality. However, under increasing pressure due to the expiration of his work visa, he is forced to look for any opportunity to stay in the country. The only way out is a collaboration with an eccentric artist, whose exile from the world of art gives their collaboration a special color.

title: Caddo Lake
description: The disappearance of an eight-year-old girl on mysterious Caddo Lake opens a new chapter in the story of one devastated family, bringing to light long-forgotten secrets about the lake's dark past. As the relatives try to figure out what connects this disappearance to a series of unexplained deaths that happened there years ago, their relationship begins to crack at the seams under the weight of unbearable suspicions and shocking revelations.

title: How to fall in love before Christmas
description: A romantic story about a writer and CEO of a fashion brand, who in order to save her company is forced to team up with competitors and in the process rethinks her beliefs about Christmas and love. The main character of the film "How to Fall in Love Before Christmas" is a writer and CEO of a fashion brand who is faced with the need to save her company from financial collapse. In search of a way out, she comes up with the idea of ​​cooperation with competitors, which puts her in front of many conflicts and misunderstandings, but also opens up new opportunities for business development. However, the main turning point in her life comes when she has to write a column about how to fall in love before Christmas, a task that seems impossible given her skeptical view of the holiday and love. In the process of working on the column, the main character begins to revise her views, experiences inspiring moments and meets people who change her perception of Christmas and miracles. The publication of the column has a significant impact on the audience and contributes to the restoration of the reputation of its brand. "How to Fall in Love Before Christmas" is a warm and inspiring story about the importance of openness to new possibilities, understanding the true essence of the holiday and the magic of love, which fills the hearts of viewers with joy and hope.

title: American dreamer
description: Philip, a grumpy economics professor who dreams of a parking spot in the university parking lot and home ownership. One day he comes across an ad for a large, beautiful mansion, the price of which has been greatly reduced. With the help of his cunning real estate agent, Dillon, Phil buys a huge estate. But there is one catch. There is a clause in the contract that its owner, Astrid, will live there until her death. But his broker convinces him that the woman has health problems and her end is near. As soon as the deal is made, the professor immediately enters the house and finds that Astrid is far from her deathbed. She seems to be very motor, having at the same time a bad character. The woman claims that no one wants her to leave the house, but her children keep showing up. And the more Phil tries to untangle the situation, the less in that sense. But still, he decides to hire a private detective while trying to figure out his complicated relationship with Astrid and her skeptical daughter Maggie.

title: Peter Pan and Wendy
description: The classic story about a boy who didn't want to grow up has always remained a favorite among many generations. And just recently, fantasy film fans again immersed themselves in the magical tale of Netlandia. The tape tells the story of a teenage girl, Wendy Darling, who resists the idea of ​​going to a private school, preferring to stay at home and stay true to her inner child. One night, her life story changes dramatically when she meets the mysterious Peter Pan, who doesn't want to grow up more than anything in the world. An uninvited night visitor takes the heroine and her younger brothers to Netland, because it is there that children never grow up and play forever. But the fantasy and colorful country, which is also called "Neverland", does not always offer only pure joy and fun. The heroes engage in a frantic confrontation with Captain Hook, behind whom stands the entire crew of the pirate ship. Wendy, finding strength and courage in herself, becomes part of an exciting adventure that can forever change the inner world of the young heroine. The story will appeal to everyone who loves old fairy tales in a new way.

title: Student. Trump's story
description: The main character is a young and ambitious businessman Donald Trump, who deals in real estate in the elite areas of New York. His clients are influential businessmen, celebrities and dangerous figures from the criminal world. Understanding that reputation plays a key role, Trump is not shy about using questionable methods to strengthen his position. From a young age, he realized that in a huge metropolis, where power and money decide everything, it is impossible to achieve success without connections. Donald has everything necessary to become a top-level player: the ability to build relationships with any partners, from small businesses to large mafia structures. He is supported by the famous lawyer Roy Cohn, who helps navigate the complex network of business and criminal connections. But real estate is just the beginning. Donald is hungry for more, seeking to seize new spheres of influence. He dreams of becoming the king of New York, but can he stay on top in a world full of danger and intrigue?

title: Superman: The Christopher Reeve Story
description: The central theme of this film is the story of a famous actor who, starting his career from zero positions, did not imagine that he would be able to conquer the world of cinema. In his first steps in his work, he was an unknown beginner, who, however, thanks to unshakable self-belief, incredible perseverance and orientation to success, achieved worldwide recognition. His name has been on the lips of fans all over the world, and his talent has become a role model in the film industry. Throughout his career, he has played many roles, showing an uncanny ability to immerse himself in every character he takes on. His acting skills and the variety of characters he played brought him popularity and the love of the audience, who saw in him a real movie star. However, his path was not without tragedies. One day, while doing his favorite horse riding, he suffered a serious injury that forever confined him to a wheelchair. Despite losing the opportunity to act in films, the former superstar found a new meaning in life by helping people with similar difficulties. In the most difficult moments, he remained strong, continuing to support others and inspire them to fight.

title: Meet the goat!
description: In the beautiful France of the 17th century, among the elegant streets and restless life, there is an unpredictable world of law, where the most unexpected events take place. Master Pompignac, known for his sloppiness and impeccable clumsiness, carries out his duties as a lawyer, despite the fact that he has not yet won a single case. Into this vortex of the struggle for justice enters the charming Simone - the shepherdess Camila, who turns to him for help. But her appeal unexpectedly unfolds a high-profile case: Camilla's fiancée, the goat Josette, is accused of murdering the noble crown marshal. Pompignac agrees to defend the unjustly accused goat, despite the absurdity of the circumstances. Through this incredible story, the entire spectrum of human emotions will pass and it will be revealed that true justice can be hidden even in the most unexpected forms of protection. Will it be a victory in court, or a difficult test that will force you to reconsider your own concepts of justice and law?

title: Joker: Madness for two
description: Arthur Fleck was never a simple man. In his head there were always intricate plans that he tried to implement. His anger and resentment, along with obvious psychiatric abnormalities, terrified everyone who ever encountered him. The action of the film unfolds in a psychiatric hospital, where Arthur finds himself. He had to go through a difficult course of treatment, the doctors had to try to make him a normal person. Here something happens that will forever change Arthur's life, he meets Harley Queen in the walls of the hospital.

title: The long-awaited dawn
description: An Italian family is experiencing enormous financial difficulties. The father sees no other choice, so he agrees with his acquaintance that he will give his daughter in marriage. Mimosa did not know anything about this, so she was very upset, because she does not want to become the bride of an elderly man. She goes to the city, where an unknown person offers to experience her in the filming of a historical film. The main character does not want to return home, so she agrees. At first, people were needed for the costume, but the director saw talent in the young girl and offered her a key role. This is how Mimosa's career begins, she does well and begins to meet quite famous people. An attractive guy invites to a dance, after which they start a conversation. But the wedding must take place very soon, one cannot go against the will of the father.

title: A crazy date
description: The everyday life of the Foster couple turns into a heart-breaking adventure after they decide to spend the evening at a popular New York restaurant. In the hope of bypassing the long line, they impersonate others and introduce themselves under fictitious names, not knowing that this little lie will be the start of crazy events. They are mistaken for people who are wanted by both corrupt policemen and dangerous city gangsters. From that moment on, the couple is forced to run away through the night city, trying to escape from the chaos they accidentally got into and return to their peaceful life.
