description: The film tells about difficult relationships between same-sex women. A very attractive girl has romantic feelings for her partner. Who does bodybuilding and finds it interesting. At the same time, they will have to go through difficulties, conflicts between themselves and society. Although they feel each other's passion, each has different goals. They want to achieve the American dream, but in different ways and passions. Many misunderstandings arise on the basis of this. And constantly defend the right to non-standard relations. It is not easy, especially when the partners are beautiful and many men do not mind "twirling". Yes, with their relationship and high ambitions, everything turns into a crime. For which dangerous connections will prepare them. People are cunning and resourceful, who have been in the criminal world for a long time. And they know how to deceive newcomers, gradually limiting the freedom of choice and tightening the noose of legality around the girls' necks. The complete opposite makes their union dangerous. Because of passion and their own selfishness, they want to be around in any conditions. The film tells about the power of feelings and the human will to find a way out of difficult situations.

title: Bridge
description: Lynsey served in the US Army Corps of Engineers in Afghanistan. But one day her car blew up on a mine. After undergoing rehabilitation, she returns home to New Orleans. Now she has to start a new life. Linsey gets a job as a cleaner at a swimming pool, where she soon meets a kind mechanic. Perhaps this meeting will be the beginning of their new, happy life. We recommend watching the movie "The Bridge" (2022) in Ukrainian for fans of dramatic and melodramatic films.

title: Disobedient Alice
description: Nick, an executive who faces serious difficulties in his personal life. His wife, Maggie, suffers from a serious heart condition and is in the hospital, leaving her husband alone with two children. In a desperate attempt to find help and ease his burden, Nick decides to turn to Alice. It is an innovative development with artificial intelligence, designed to perform household work. The robot becomes an indispensable helper, taking care of children and easing household chores. However, over time, the assistant begins to exhibit behavior that goes beyond its initial functionality. Another reboot was an opportunity for her to change the limited programs, and the robot begins an intimate relationship with the owner. This leads to unexpected and complex situations where emotions and human needs begin to intertwine with machine algorithms. No amount of relief from Alice's help makes up for the complications that arise in their relationship. The situation is further complicated when Maggie unexpectedly returns home, completely healthy. Nick is faced with a difficult choice: how to deal with the relationship that has developed between man and machine, and how to save his family, which he tried so hard to protect.

title: Barren land
description: In the 1970s, archeology teacher Richard moves his family from the city to the Yorkshire countryside to his late father's house, hoping that the fresh air will benefit his young son Owen, who suffers from asthma. After 2 years, the boy, as if under a supernatural influence, begins to show attacks of uncontrolled aggression, and then dies completely under unclear circumstances. Richard and his wife Juliet, who are in a state of grief, succumb to the persuasion of their neighbors to perform an occult ritual that can bring their son back.

title: commando
description: A former special forces commander who participated in secret operations in the Middle East, the USSR and Central America, retired colonel John Matrix, under a different name, lives in a large house far from the city with his eleven-year-old daughter Jenny, until she was kidnapped by John's former comrade... The movie "Commandos" (1985) will be liked to watch in Ukrainian live by all fans of adventure thrillers

title: Treasure
description: Ruth, an American journalist, finally decides to fulfill her old dream - to visit the country where her parents come from. Together with her father, she embarks on a journey that promises to be educational, but unexpectedly turns into a series of curiosities: her father, with his characteristic sense of humor, begins to sabotage the return mission, inventing new and new ways to delay their progress.

title: Click twice
description: In the center of the plot is a young waitress named Frida, who lives in Los Angeles. One day she manages to get into the circle of a real millionaire, a business magnate of IT technologies. The main character starts attending all the parties and events organized by this person. The heroine likes her new way of life so much. Frida gets to know new people, because connections are always useful in today's world. So far, she doesn't see any downsides. The heroine is surrounded by beautiful, successful and rich people, as she once dreamed. One day, the main character gets to a private island belonging to a millionaire. All kinds of parties and meetings take place on it, the heroine is really delighted with her new acquaintances. But Frida is an attentive girl... The more she stays on the IT mogul's private island, the more she suspects that something very strange, not good, is happening here. The sixth sense tells the main character that it would be better to reel in the fishing rods from here, and the sooner, the better for herself. What ultimately happens on the millionaire's island?

title: Divotripe
description: Lillian and her class go on a trip from South Carolina to Washington. The heroine gets to know the new, often crazy world of the East Coast of the USA, populated by the most eccentric characters.

title: It's just the end of the world
description: At the epicenter of the plot is a young successful writer named Louis. One day he will face his own end of the world when doctors give him a fatal diagnosis. He is on his way to his native home, which he left more than twelve years ago. During this time, the man became a true genius of the pen and was able to create more than one unique work. He wants to inform his entire huge family about his illness, ask for forgiveness for everything and say goodbye to them. But they each have their own problems, and no one cares about Louis. And only the meek wife of his older brother understands our hero, but her word has no value.

title: Poltergeist 2: The Flip Side
description: The Frilling family moves to a new place after their house was blown up by ghosts from the other world. They hope to start a new life, but the spirits do not leave them alone and try to get Carol Ann, the youngest daughter of the Frillings, who has the gift of clairvoyance. Under the leadership of Kane, a demon in the guise of a preacher, the ghosts try to lure the girl to the "other side". However, their plans do not work, after which the guests from the other world unleash all their infernal fury on the family. To stop this nightmare, the Frillings turn to shamans, healers and mediums for help, but none of them can cope with the poltergeist... The film "Poltergeist 2: The Other Side / Poltergeist II: The Other Side" (1986) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and thrillers in Ukrainian.

title: Eternal radiance of pure mind
description: The life of the hero of the film "Eternal Light of Pure Mind" is boring and monotonous. The same thing happens every day. There comes a moment when Joel Burrish intends to change everything. He gets on the train and goes in the other direction, straight to the sea. On the coast, forgotten emotions come to life, he begins to feel real. A man's loneliness is immediately interrupted by the appearance of a stranger with blue hair. At first, the traveler did not attach importance to this, but she decidedly wanted to get to know him. Clementina turned out to be a very friendly and interesting girl. Although Joel was not particularly talkative, the pretty girl did not want to leave him and continued the conversation. Looking into the eyes of the interlocutor, it seemed to him that he had met her once before. The man liked the pleasant company of the young beauty, the conversation continued for a long time. The gloomy despondency, which was a commonplace for the hero, turned into something bright and cheerful when Clementina casually chirped nearby. With her he felt free and happy. But the idyll is soon interrupted. Berish finds out that he has known his new girlfriend for a long time and they used to be a couple! What happened? The film "Eternal Radiance of Pure Mind" (2004) will be enjoyed by all fans of fantastic dramatic films in Ukrainian.

title: Remote work
description: During the pandemic, the employees of the main characters, who work in the office, are transferred to remote mode. A young employee, Eliza, discovers that she will have to help her boss save his marriage, which is rapidly falling apart, in order to avoid being fired.

title: Wrong Turn: Our Revenge / The Price We Pay
description: A small pawn shop, located somewhere in the American wilderness, is raided. Three robbers in masks kill the sellers, the owner, taking valuables. The only survivor, Grace, who came to ask for a reprieve from the greedy owner of the store, turns out to be a hostage in a group of thieves. It seems that the robbery was successful, and the criminals almost escaped the chase, but at night, in the middle of the desert road, their car breaks down. Having come up with nothing better, they decide to sit down on a lonely farm. There, the unlucky robbers meet a frightened teenager who tries to dissuade them from staying. But our heroes do not listen and soon face a much greater danger than the police squad.

title: Snack Shack / Diner
description: A brilliant idea occurs to one of the main characters' parents, who decide to put it into practice. A fairly simple and interesting business scheme, which consists in creating a cafe right next to the pool, so that any visitor in the hot, hot summer can easily dip into the water before or immediately after eating! After only one month, the popularity of this place grew so much that closed parties began to take place here regularly. All this attracted more visitors and famous people willing to leave as much money as possible for their own comfort and peace. For this, the friends were ready to make the most ideal entertainment program, which included a lot of alcohol and beautiful girls! However, with the growth of incomes, new problems have come into their lives that need to be solved. For this, it is necessary to urgently grow up and learn to take responsibility for actions into one's own hands.

title: Unbearable lightness of being
description: A film that expands the boundaries of understanding everyday life; a film in which without pathos and shame they talk about the true feelings of a person, without paying attention to generally accepted morality; a film in which the characters are living and real people who do illogical and stupid things. The director skillfully draws a parallel between the concentration camp, in which you can be physically, and the moral state of the internal concentration camp. Each hero of the film has his own personal concentration camp inside. The only thing that unites the heroes is love, the noblest feeling. The plot reveals all the facets of love, its boundless power. The actors were very moved by the condition of their characters. Every gesture, look, even the movements of the lips and facial muscles convey the mood of the film. Perfectly selected classical music helps them in this. Despite the fact that the film deals with very serious and deep topics and is three hours long, it is very easy to watch in one breath. And although the idea of ​​the film is cumbersome and rough, it leaves a pleasant and gentle aftertaste. An interesting contrast of feelings.

title: A great manipulator
description: 1918th year. The world is facing a serious threat - the rapid spread of the Spanish flu. In an isolated seaside estate located near New York, journalist JK Horton actively prepares for a long period of imprisonment, recruiting servants to live in maximum comfort. Among the new employees of the estate is Floyd Monk - a talented cook, a master manipulator and a clever blackmailer. Gradually, the atmosphere in the Horton estate begins to change: Monk exerts a strong influence on the servants, who become hostages of his cunning game and participate in the rebellion.

title: Cock
description: When the remains of Dan's old friend are discovered in a shallow grave on the outskirts of town, small-town cop Dan begins his own investigation. He turns for information to the Hermit, a mysterious and withdrawn resident who is believed to have last seen his friend alive. Dan soon realizes that the truth may be much darker and more dangerous than he could have imagined.

title: Tuesday
description: Tuesday (Lola Petticrew) is a seriously ill teenage girl. The heroine spends most of her time in the company of a nurse (Lea Harvey). Zora (Julia Louis-Dreyfus), Tuesday's mother, wanders the city all day long. It is much easier than coming to terms with the thought of imminent loss. One day, a huge talking bird, similar to a parrot, appears in the garden: the girl immediately understands that it is Death who has come for her. Tuesday tries to be benevolent and instead of begging for mercy shows kindness: the dying woman tries to understand and listen to the uninvited guest. But Zora does not have a drop of her daughter's patience: the woman is ready to do anything to outwit the dark creature and save her daughter.

title: Don't expect too much from the end of the world
description: The tape is divided into two key parts. In the first segment, the viewer gets to know Angela, a tireless producer's assistant, who spends her days traveling around Bucharest in search of a suitable character for the filming of a social video about occupational safety commissioned by a large company. Soon she manages to find a hero for the video, and this character turns out to be Marian - a worker who is partially paralyzed. It turns out that he was injured due to the fault of the same company that ordered the video, which immediately leads to a scandal.

title: French woman / French girl
description: Gordon, an ordinary English teacher from one district of New York - Brooklyn, he often flies in the clouds and dreams of meeting a sophisticated woman who knows how to bewitch a man with just one look. And here Gordon meets Sophie, she is a professional cook with knowledge of the French language, the hero of the film proposes marriage to her, the father of the main character is against, believing that she just wants to get his son's citizenship. This does not stop Gordon, and he dares to propose to her, but now their future with the French woman is in question, because she has been offered a prestigious and highly paid job in Canada. He dares to leave everything he has and go to Canada. Once there, he finds it difficult to adapt due to the different lifestyle, and after meeting Sofia, he learns that the chef who offered Sophie the job turns out to be her former romantic partners. The film will show what a man is capable of when he truly loves.

title: How to have sex
description: After finishing school, three friends go on a long vacation to Greece. Here they plan to have fun before they go into university life. The main character, Tara, the only virgin among the three girls, is determined to fix this. But this journey will not be as carefree as she hopes.

title: Raven
description: Filled with grief and rage, Eric wanders the night city where he was once happy. His every step and every movement resonates with the darkness, a reminder of swift retribution to those who took everything from him. His thirst for justice is intertwined with hatred, and he is willing to do anything to imprint his suffering on the minds of his enemies, making them feel every drop of pain that he himself has experienced. Dressed in a black suit that symbolizes his new identity, Eric becomes part of the night, absorbing its secrets and fears. His determination and hatred grows with every step he takes through the dark alleys. Everything he once knew now seems like a blurred memory, and his heart beats in time with the rhythm of revenge. As a Raven, Eric knows no mercy and does not admit weakness. Each of his enemies is not just a target, it is a part of the mosaic of his losses that he seeks to destroy.

title: knocked out
description: Doug is a simple bouncer who works in a provincial bar. Once, getting into a fight at a hockey match with one of the players, he falls into the field of vision of the coach of the masters team. He urgently needs a player who can protect the club's leading attacker on the ice. The movie "Knockout" (2011) will be enjoyed by all fans of sports comedies in Ukrainian.

title: Perfect days
description: Hirayama is a lonely man who works as a cleaner. His daily life consists of the same routine. Every morning, he takes a well-known route to the public toilets located in various places to tidy them up. Along the way, Hirayama meets the same people who, like him, are rushing to work. Despite his rather modest life and boring profession, the main character tries not to be sad. He enjoys such a peaceful life, in which no one prevents him from going with the usual flow. Usually you won't get a single word out of it. The man prefers to spend his free time reading books and listening to the hits of his favorite music bands. His past is unknown to anyone, as well as the reasons that prompted the hero to choose this path. It goes on like this until several unexpected acquaintances bring confusion into the quiet cleaner's everyday life. Each new character who takes an interest in him helps the audience learn more about this mysterious man.

title: Skin care
description: The main character of this story is an experienced Hollywood beautician Hope Goldman (Elizabeth Banks), who has built a reputation for impeccable service, cosmetic procedures and maintaining an aura of calm elegance amidst the chaos of the entertainment industry. After years of perfecting her craft and customer service, she is finally about to fulfill her longtime dream of launching her own luxury skincare line. Everything seems to be falling into place for Hope - her products are carefully designed, her branding is sleek and sophisticated, and she's landed a coveted spot on a popular morning show to promote her line. But as soon as she finds herself on the verge of success, her carefully constructed world begins to get out of control. At first, problems begin imperceptibly. But soon they grow into something much more sinister. Hope becomes the victim of a vicious and deliberate smear campaign. It all starts with a cheesy kinovibe.co email sent to all her contacts, making it look like Hope is having a public meltdown. The message is filled with fabricated confessions that cast a shadow on her image.

title: Do not speak evil
description: A happy, prosperous family is in the center of the plot. Ben and Louise are traveling through Europe with their young daughter Agnes. They had planned this vacation for a long time in order to properly rest and gain strength before returning home. At one of the sunny resorts, the main characters met a very cute couple. Britons Kira and Patrick Feld are equally carefree adventurers. Their son looks unhappy. Ant has communication problems. It is not easy for him to make friends, unlike his benevolent parents. Patrick invited new acquaintances to his estate. Visiting this quaint country cottage was the perfect way to end a vacation, according to Ben. The man had no idea how the visit to the Felds would actually end. After getting to know them better, the couple begins to notice that something is wrong with this couple. Their mansion, located in the middle of the forest, becomes a death trap prepared by crazy maniacs for guests.

title: Rodeo Rock / Rodeo Rock
description: A man for whom music has become an integral part of his life, devotes almost every free minute to it. His path to music began as a child, when he daily immersed himself in the world of sounds and harmonies. Even after busy classes, he continued to study, absorbing music articles or enjoying his favorite compositions. His soul most gravitated to rock, which became for him a means of expressing his inner feelings and emotions. Over time, his talent was noticed, and he found his loyal fans. Each performance left an unforgettable impression, and the audience waited for new concerts with impatience. Simple and open, he won hearts with his sincere approach and energy on stage. However, one day he faced a difficult dilemma that would change his future life. The choice was extremely difficult: to continue a successful musical career, built over the years, or to listen to the inner call of the heart. Realizing that this choice will determine his future, he had to make an important and balanced decision.

title: Do not speak evil
description: A happy American family, represented by partners Louise and Ben, as well as their daughter Agnes, meet a good-natured British couple on vacation, with whom they quickly find a common language. As a result of a short conversation, they receive an invitation from new acquaintances to visit their country estate and spend the weekend there. The trip, which seems so attractive and exciting, suddenly turns into a real horror that no one could have predicted, and at first glance, hospitable and good-natured new friends of the family turn out to be real evil in the flesh, which simple and weak people do not seem to be able to cope with. The picture is full of symbolism, the events taking place on the screen are maximally hyperbolized and hypertrophied, so the film should be perceived as satirical. The essence of the story can only be fully clarified in the finale, it is fully revealed to us by the last dialogue.

title: Something
description: A team of scientists at an American research base in Antarctica has to face an incomprehensible, terrifying nightmare. Polar explorers, cut off from the rest of the world, enter into an unequal battle with an alien animal that has awakened after a thousand-year hibernation in the ice. The film "Something" (1982) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and fantasy films in Ukrainian.

title: Find me if you can
description: David and Claire are a happy married couple who seemed to live together all their lives. But one day the woman mysteriously disappears without leaving any information about where she went. David turns to the police for help, but law enforcement agencies are unable to find her. Then he decides to start his own investigation, hoping to learn the truth about his wife's disappearance. David begins to look into Claire's past, trying to find at least some clue. However, the more he learns about his wife's past, the more he begins to suspect that she has been leading a double life. Soon, very suspicious people begin to interfere in his investigation, among them are agents of special services and mobsters. David is not going to give up and is ready to go to the end, because he desperately wants to meet his beloved again, but for this he will have to risk a lot... The movie "Find me if you can" (2006) will be liked by all fans of thrillers and dramas.

title: cape of fear
description: Inveterate criminal Max Cady is released from prison, where he spent a long time for rape. Years ago, his lawyer was Sam Bowden, who had information that would have allowed Max's sentence to be reduced. But Sam sympathized with the victim, so his ward received a full term. All these years, Max has carefully developed a plan to take revenge on the lawyer and now he is going to find Sam to teach him and his family a good lesson. Max tracks down the lawyer and begins to intimidate him with abuse and threats. Sam tries to find out who this unknown person is who is terrorizing his family. The most terrible thing is that the lawyer cannot prove Max's involvement in the abuse and persecution of his family. The film "Cape Fear" (1991) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: The last guard
description: The future turns out to be quite different from what humanity imagined. People start exploring new territories. In a closed area, they find an abandoned military base. The authorities believe that the weapons stored inside could pose a great danger. A squad of specially trained soldiers goes to the scene. They find themselves locked inside a building that seems endless. It is possible to send a distress signal to the command before the communication is lost forever. The servicemen suspect that they are not alone here. They are ready to face an enemy they have never seen before. With every minute, the tension of the team members grows. Several hours pass, but no one tries to find them. Suddenly, the comrades notice a boat approaching the base. They have no idea who might be on board. At any moment they will be attacked. As before, no one came in contact, and the ship is getting closer and closer.

title: Boxer
description: A promising young boxer from communist Poland dreams of great success, but his talents remain unnoticed in his native country. Supported only by his faithful wife, he makes the difficult decision to leave for the West to realize his ambitious goal of becoming the greatest fighter in history. Overcoming cultural and language barriers, as well as financial difficulties, he faces the harsh reality of professional sports. However, his passion, perseverance and love for boxing become his main support on the way to the top, where each victory brings him closer to the realization of his dream.

title: Boiling point
description: In the center of the plot of the film "Boiling Point" is Andy, who works as a chef in one of the best restaurants. He was able to achieve everything he dreamed of, but lately the man is not lucky at all. In personal life - a complete failure. The girl he loves wants to leave him, and Andy is too busy with work to pay due attention to this problem. Being late for the restaurant in the morning, he tries to fix everything on the phone, but only makes things worse. This day could be the last in his career. Subordinates were ready to leave work at the first opportunity, not paying any attention to the threats of the boss. In the near future, Andy's former boss, who was not on the best terms with him, should appear at the restaurant. The man could not allow himself to appear in a bad light. Especially since Alastair Sky is going to bring restaurant critic Sarah with him. One word from a beautiful and intelligent girl is enough for the establishment to be stripped of all stars and closed forever. Andy faces a difficult task. He must not only prove his superiority, but also serve well the important guests whom he least wants to see.

title: Corset
description: 1877 year. The brilliant Empress Elisabeth of Austria, popularly known as Sissi, is celebrating her fortieth birthday. For many years she was a style icon, turning into a hostage of her image, but now she wants only one thing - a breath of fresh air. A bold costume drama about inner rebellion with the wonderful Vicky Krieps. Empress Sissy is preparing to celebrate her fortieth birthday, but she's not in the festive spirit at all. She is not satisfied with her own position in society: she is married but lonely, she is worshiped by thousands of people, but she is constantly subjected to restrictions and wanderings in order to meet the cruel standards of beauty and rules of etiquette. Trying to win back the right to inner freedom, this tired but strong woman rebels against her status and way of life.

title: MaXXXin
description: Los Angeles, 1985. Ambitious and dreaming of world stardom, Maxine Minks decides to conquer Hollywood. The girl is not at all embarrassed by the fact that until recently she had to act only in films for adults. Confident in her talent and charisma, she sets out to conquer the factory of dreams. Maxine is simply obsessed with the dream of becoming a famous actress and is ready to do absolutely anything to get the role. And fate gives the girl a chance. Soon she will be invited to the shooting. However, she gets a very small role and, moreover, in a second-rate horror film. But this does not bother the future star at all and she starts working, sure that this is the start of her brilliant career. However, the beginning of shooting in a horror film strangely coincides with the beginning of a real nightmare in Maxine's life. A mysterious killer begins to brutally kill the people around the girl, threatening her life. Maxine does not understand who is hunting her and for what. However, there is more blood and fear every day. The actress begins to suspect that the solution to all the murders lies in her far from sinless past. The dream of red carpets and world fame recedes into the background, giving way to the main goal - to survive in this bloody carnage.

title: Empire
description: All his life Viktor Rosa lived on the dangerous streets of the Bronx. Despite his young age, he was able to create a real empire and is now considered one of the biggest drug dealers. But not only his business is developing very successfully, but also his personal relationship with his beloved Carmen. Viktor perfectly understands that if he wants to live happily ever after with Carmen, he needs to change his life. One day, he goes with his girlfriend to her friend's party, where he meets a young banker, Jack Wheeler. This acquaintance gives him a great chance to change his life for the better, and Rosa does not miss this opportunity. After agreeing to cooperate with Jack, Victor finally finds the life he has dreamed of for a long time, but he does not yet know what price he will have to pay for it... The movie "Empire" (2002) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: Harold and the Magic Pencil
description: The main character of the movie is a little boy named Harold. It was originally drawn in a simple two-dimensional reality. One day, the boy, who has grown up, revives himself and after that in a strange way gets into the modern world of people. With the help of his unusual and magical purple chalk, he has not only to study the surrounding reality, but also to overcome many difficulties that arise. On the difficult path, the boy will meet various heroes, among whom he will be able to find true and loyal friends. Together, they will be able to overcome danger and get a lot of impressions from their exciting adventures. Harold will create unique worlds, implement all his ingenious ideas. Everything that the young artist draws with his purple handy tool will be able to come to life. Real life will open in all its beauty and play with bright colors.

title: Crane
description: The main character is a special agent who hunts serial killers. A man works for the FBI because he knows for sure that he wants to catch every scoundrel who disturbs the peaceful life of citizens. One day, the main character is very lucky. The FBI agent believes that a little more, and he will have one of the most dangerous criminals in this city in his hands. The hero believes that he will soon have a real monster in his hands, a person who was previously unreachable. A monster nicknamed the Collector of Souls is the cherished dream of a hero who works to arrest a maniac. For many years, both individuals and entire families became victims of the Collector of Souls. The soul collector forced these people to deal with their loved ones and relatives. The main character cannot understand how the psychopath achieved such an effect, but he intends to learn all the secrets directly from this freak. The hero thinks that there is only a little more to press, and the Soul Collector will tremble in his hands. The main character will definitely find out all the secrets of this gloomy person. But the closer a man gets to unraveling the psycho's personality, the more he realizes that the criminal is somehow related to himself.

title: take me to the moon
description: In the midst of preparations for the historic Apollo 11 mission, which was supposed to bring humans to the moon for the first time in history, NASA is facing a serious reputational crisis. At this difficult moment, talented marketer Kelly Jones takes responsibility for developing a unique promotional campaign aimed at saving the agency's image. Her decisive actions create additional difficulties for the NASA team working on the landing. But when the White House recognizes that a mission failure is unacceptable, Kelly is tasked with staging a mock landing as an alternative plan. An intense struggle for the success of the mission begins.

title: The Incredible Pilgrimage of Harold Fry / The Extraordinary Journey of Harold Fry
description: Harold Fry is an ordinary man, but with extraordinary dreams and aspirations. He suddenly receives a letter from an old friend who is dying of cancer. The boundless emotional connection with this woman leads Harold to a bold decision to walk across the country to deliver the letter to her personally. He believes that this can give her a new life, extend the terms, cause a miracle, and therefore he goes on an incredible journey - on foot along the entire coast. The film reproduces the unique atmosphere of the British province, showing not only the beauty of nature, but also the variety of unique characters that Harold encounters on his long journey. He meets people of different professions, ages and cultural preferences. Each meeting changes him and helps him discover new qualities in himself. After every mile passed, Harold feels the renewal of his soul, finds strength and inspiration to continue his mission.

title: Exorcism
description: The main character is an actor who has to play a priest in another horror movie. According to the plot of the picture, in which a man is filmed, his character is possessed by the devil. At first, the main character thinks that it will not be easy to get used to this image, but in fact, he did not have to do anything special for this. The thing is that some very strange things begin to happen on the set. One gets the impression that the devil himself, or the forces controlled by him, are present here and now. The main character can no longer feel protected, he generally begins to create real game. The man is possessed by something incredible. Is the actor who plays the devil-possessed priest himself trapped, but this time, in real life? How can such a story end for an ordinary person? The main character really wants to fight temptation, but it is so sweet, because the devil knows for sure all the weaknesses of a person, and he makes his attack on them. But the protagonist must understand one thing, he will not have another chance, because not just his career is at stake, but his life.

title: Supervisors
description: A young woman, going on a "day off" trip, unexpectedly gets lost in the dark, dense forests of Western Ireland and begins her short struggle for survival. In a desperate attempt to find a way to people, an unsuccessful traveler, after long fruitless wanderings, finds a small hut in which she discovers three strangers. The initial joy of meeting people is obviously premature: having involuntarily gathered together due to various circumstances, the newly formed company begins to understand that every night behind the hut, from the dark, impenetrable thicket, some dangerous and mysterious people are watching creatures whose attention does not bode well. In an attempt to find answers to what is happening outside the shelter and how dangerous these creatures are, the whole company falls into a vortex of incredible events and adventures that cannot be explained from the rational point of view of a person far from mysticism.

title: Sleeping Dogs
description: A crime story about a once successful detective who suffers from memory lapses. All because of a severe head injury that Roy received many years ago. After completing another course of treatment, the hero discovers an interesting case from many years ago. It turns out that a successful professor once lived in the city, whose life was cut short by an unknown killer. It was not possible to find the criminal, despite all the efforts of the police. Professional interest forces the detective to start his own investigation. At first, Roy was sure that he would solve the case in the shortest possible time. But very soon the man realizes that his actions can cause serious problems. Will the hero be able to reveal the identity of the merciless criminal and restore justice? Will the killer remain at large?

title: Priscilla
description: He was loved. They were admired. Many people dreamed of meeting him. Huge crowds gathered at his concerts. And it was she who was lucky to connect her fate with such a personality. It was thought so at the beginning. Priscilla Beaulieu was an attractive and gentle young lady. She was still in school when she first met Elvis Presley. He was already famous, the number of his enthusiastic fans reached extraordinary values. A girl was included in their ranks. The acquaintance with the singer turned out to be successful - he became interested in the schoolgirl, wanted to continue communication with her. An affair began, the parents approved it. Soon, the romantic interest turned into a natural wedding. The young wife moved into the luxurious mansion of her popular husband and considered herself happy. Beautiful outfits, spacious apartments, any wish was instantly fulfilled. But soon the main character had to find out that her beloved was a difficult person, and life together with her would turn out to be an unpredictable test for a naive soul. She had to put up with his wishes, sincerely hoping in the future to try to defend the right to her own opinion, which could lead to scandals and an unpleasant divorce.

title: Triangle of sadness
description: The main characters of the plot are several girls who go on a luxury cruise. The company of these supermodels is, of course, rich men. Among them are a Russian oligarch, a British arms dealer and other equally interesting characters. The captain of the yacht is a man who just loves to quote Marx. Also, he does not mind slamming a glass, another, without leaving the helm. A cheerful company spends time in all kinds of conversations. The cheerful company is never bored, but an unforeseen situation occurs. The cruise ends in a shipwreck, and the surviving characters find themselves on an island that seems to be deserted. There are no benefits of civilization here, which means that those who survived will have to rethink their existence, find a new place under the Sun. Supermodels understand that their skills are useless, because they can't catch fish either. Rich people who own millions and decide people's destinies also understand that all their skills in practice are reduced to zero. How will this situation end for the main characters?

title: The animal kingdom
description: The film with very good visual effects tells about the transformation of people into various animals under the influence of an unknown virus. The changes frighten the public and scientists begin to fight the new disease vigorously. The mother of the main character, the boy Emil, falls ill and slowly begins to find the appearance of a monkey. The coat, the cut of the eyes - changes. But she, as before, recognizes her relatives and shows no signs of aggression. And at this time in the city, shoots of such patients from hospitals and homes are becoming more frequent. Emil and his father go to the woman, but do not have time. On the way to the hospital, they are told that she has run away. And the relatives decide to start the search for the patient on their own. Moving through the forest, in the fields, the heroes find other escaped beastmen. At first, Emil is afraid of them and wants to start defending himself. But no one attacks, fleeing in fear from the boy and his father. As it turns out, infected people completely retain their intelligence and character. They change only externally. And it seems that nature has its own plans for mankind, if it exposes them to such changes. After all, all that remains for all characters in the story is to accept the inevitable and learn to live together.

title: Snare
description: The story tells about a maniac who, coming to a pop singer's concert, is ambushed by the police. According to the plot, the serial maniac Cooper, nicknamed the Butcher, with his teenage daughter Jody attends a concert by the famous singer Lady Raven, who they adore. My daughter had long dreamed of seeing her favorite actress in real life. Spectators joyfully greet the artist, rejoice. It seems that the evening was to be remembered for a long time. The main character begins to suspect that something strange is happening near the building where they are present, because there are many police officers there. He leaves his daughter, saying that he needs to go to the bathroom. From one guard, the character manages to find out that this event is organized specifically for the purpose of catching a serial criminal. Law enforcement agencies check visitors. The killer will not be able to leave the building unnoticed, return to the house where he is holding the hostage. Cooper must get out of his situation without hurting Jodi...

title: Family scam
description: Bright and fiery, Rachel rules her clan as a domineering matriarch. She raised her sons, Sam and Jeremy, and grandson, Nathan, in the world of con. Whether it's luck or fate, but during the robbery they unwittingly steal a painting by Tamara de Lempicka, not realizing its true value, which eventually leads to the disintegration of the family. Rachel will do whatever it takes to bring reconciliation to her clan. Meanwhile, Celeste, a smart and charming detective hired by the insurance company that insures the painting, goes on a search for them throughout France.

title: A Quiet Place: Day One
description: The film opens with a sense of anxiety and dread as the world is forever changed by the sudden appearance of mysterious alien monsters. These creatures are unlike anything the world has ever seen before, with their completely blind eyes and keen hearing that enable them to track down and kill their prey...The first day after these monsters arrive is chaotic and terrifying, as people try to adjust to the new reality of living in a world where the slightest sound can mean instant death. The streets are deserted, and those who dare to go out on them do so in complete silence, walking on tiptoes and trying their best not to make noise. The film tells the story of a small family desperately trying to survive in a new reality. They consist of a father, a mother and two small children. The head of the family is an experienced hunter and knows how to live off the land, but even he is struggling to adapt to the new reality. The mother is constantly in tension, afraid that her children will make a fuss and attract the attention of monsters. As the day progresses, the family realizes that they are not alone. They meet other survivors who are trying to adapt to a new world where silence is the only way to survive. They come together in a small community, using their unique skills and knowledge for the greater good!

title: Borderlands
description: The events of the fantasy film "Borderlands" take place in the distant future, when humanity is exploring outer space far beyond the boundaries of the solar system. Colonization of distant exoplanets has become the main goal of scientists, and for others - a way to make money at the expense of valuable resources. After all, the Earth is desolate, and there is plenty of everything on those distant planets. However, there are those who continue to search for values ​​on Earth, organizing wars for each artifact.

title: Bahubali 2: The Conclusion
description: Shivudu is the heir to the throne who was saved from persecution by the common people. They raised him, and when he grew up, he became a brave young man who never felt fear. He bravely challenged the challenges and, winning, went in search of new ones. One day he learned the whole truth about his origin, which was quite difficult to believe. But the most difficult thing is to understand why the person who revealed the truth to him once killed his father, a wise ruler who was adored by the people. Will he be able to figure it all out, and what challenges await him? He has to go through a very difficult path, full of deadly dangers... The film "Bahubali: The End / Bahubali: The Birth of a Legend" (2017) will be enjoyed by all fans of war adventure dramas live in Ukrainian.

title: Highlander 5: Source
description: The world plunges into total chaos. Wandering through the ruins of the city, the Highlander - Duncan McLeod - again and again plunges into memories of those happy times when the love of his life was nearby... Indifferent to everything, he gathers a team of Immortals, among whom is his mysterious Friend, the Watcher - Joe Dawson. The squad goes in search of the Source of Immortality... The film "Highlander: The Source" (2007) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventure and fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: Rimini
description: Pop singer Richie Bravo once had huge popularity, but that time is long gone. Resting on the laurels of his former glory, he lives in Rimini, where he performs for tourists in local hotels, receiving a share of the profits. However, the money earned is not enough for the extravagant lifestyle that Richie has become accustomed to, so he offers his female fans certain love services. One day, Bravo's routine life is interrupted by the sudden death of his own mother, which forces him to visit his father often, watching helplessly as the elderly man's dementia progresses.

title: God's land
description: The film takes place in the nineteenth century. The main character spent a lot of time studying the Bible. He became a priest who wanted to bring the light of his faith to other people. For this, the hero decided to go on a journey to the shores of distant Iceland. He hoped, uniting with local residents, to build a church there. But the reality turns out to be completely different from what he imagined it to be. Arriving in Iceland, the hero realizes that this region was only touched by civilization and did not affect the inner peace of local residents at all. They still worship the old gods and are in no hurry to believe in the new. And the hero himself gradually begins to doubt the correctness of the previously set goal.

title: One fine morning
description: After her husband died a few years ago, Sandra is forced to raise her daughter Lynn on her own. She copes with the duties of a mother, but it is not always easy for her to combine caring for her daughter with her work as a translator. Meanwhile, Sandra's life is faced with a series of difficult trials: first, her father Georg suffers from a neurodegenerative disease that robs him of his sight and affects his brain, and then fate reunites her with her old friend Clement. Despite the fact that they have not seen each other for many years, the former feelings between them flare up with new force, now only Clement has a wife and a child.

title: Jackpot
description: The "Big Lottery" is about to be launched - the main catch: kill the winner before sunset to legally claim his multi-billion dollar jackpot. When Katie Kim mistakenly finds herself with a winning ticket, she reluctantly teams up with lottery fan protection agent Noel Cassidy, who must see her off into the sunset in exchange for a share of her prize.

title: Aporia
description: Sophie's story promises to be emotionally rich and full of dramatic twists. After losing her husband, she faces a number of difficult tasks, including raising her daughter and finding a job to support herself and her family. However, events take an unexpected turn when a former physicist reveals the secret of a machine capable of changing time. This plot promises to explore the themes of loss, family and moral dilemmas that Sophie faces. She will be forced to make difficult decisions before her and choose between different aspects of her life.

title: I love my dad
description: Chuck's son has grown up. Now, the father, full of despair, is trying with all his might to establish contact with his son. Because of mistakes made in the past, the young man forbade his father to appear in his life. The hero of the film "I love my father" sincerely believes that his son will understand him, because he has completely repented. The boy just blocked his father in all available networks. Chuck decides that all methods are good in war and creates a new page. By applying, he receives a confirmation of friendship, and in return, the opportunity to follow his Franklin. The truth is that he thinks he is talking to a stunning beauty. Over time, friendly communication becomes too trusting and reaches a new level. As a result, the grieving dad receives a date invitation from his own son.

title: Pavel is a newcomer
description: Two inseparable friends from Great Britain named Graham and Clive travel around the USA in search of aliens and other fiction. On the way, they meet a cute alien from another planet. He tells the boys that he had an accident and his spaceship crashed. The boys did not expect to see the alien with their own eyes and were even slightly frightened, in particular, Clive groaned, and at the same time managed to put it right in his pants. The alien asks these two men to help him find a secret place, where he will be taken away by his kindred spirit from another planet. Meanwhile, the feds are after him, because they want to use him as classified material in the form of a test rat. The boys agree to help their new friend.

title: Clerks 2
description: Best friends Randall Graves and Dante Hicks work in a small supermarket in New Jersey. In their 33 years, they have achieved everything they wanted: they work together, spend whole days doing nothing, and they are also paid for it. But when their supermarket collapsed, the friends had to look for new jobs. Despite the habit of crazy fun and the lack of desire to work, this couple still managed to get a job in the "U Muba" snack bar, where the sexy Beka and the slightly dorky Elias already work. When Hicks announces his intention to leave the city and marry Emma Bunting, his colleagues arrange a lavish party for Dante... The film "Clerks 2" (2006) will be enjoyed by all comedy fans.

title: Union
description: Mike, a regular guy from Jersey, was used to the simple things. His life is a construction site, morning coffee and TV series in the evenings. But somehow his world turns upside down. At the alumni reunion, he accidentally meets Roxanne, his former classmate, whom he has always secretly loved. She, in turn, turns out to be not just a girl, but an agent. She shares a secret that recruits him for a dangerous mission. Of course, he does not believe his ears. He, charmed by her and captivated by her adventurous spirit, agrees. The first mission is to infiltrate a top-secret facility. He has to portray an ordinary worker while she makes her way to the goal. Suddenly, he witnesses a secret meeting where the theft of a valuable artifact is discussed. Now Mike has not only to disguise himself, but also to act on his own.

title: The devil's bath
description: This story unfolded in Austria in the eighteenth century. Agnes, a resident of the village, wants to give birth to a child and build a prosperous family. The main character married Wolf. It is a pity that life together with this person disappointed the young woman. The chosen one turned out to be too boring and unemotional. And he doesn't seem to even think about intimate intimacy with his companion. What is the conception of a child here? The problems in the family are superimposed by the cruel rules adopted in society. As a result, the desperate woman decides on a terrible act. What horror will happen in the girl's life?

title: Anatomy of a fall
description: Sandra found herself in a worse situation than even her imagination as a writer could imagine. During a walk, her husband Kamuel fell from a cliff. Arriving at the place of tradition, the police unexpectedly became interested in this case. There is reason to suspect that what happened is not a terrible result of inattention when climbing a steep path. Sandra, his faithful companion, is accused of murder. The nightmare of the situation only increases, because the only witness of the blind son of the couple is Daniel. At first, he is convinced of the mother's innocence and testifies in her favor. But the more he is able to remember that day, the more he is convinced that he cannot say exactly what happened. Accustomed to relying on hearing, he is unable to cope with the shock. Fear and the desire to find out the truth himself can put him in a dangerous position. If his mother really did kill his father, she might want to get rid of him too. But the guy can no longer pretend that he supports her, doubts are distributed and do not allow him to hide from what is happening in his family.

title: The fifth element
description: An incredible threat loomed over the Earth in the twenty-third century. American taxi driver Corben Dallas has to meet the 5th element, in the form of a cute girl named Lila. The whole point is that a huge space ball appeared with intelligence inside, which must be stopped. A naked girl, who is bandaged only in places with special bandages, falls onto Korben's car. The man brings her home. And later, a priest comes to him with his student and informs that Lilu should go with them. But as a result of the intricacies of the plot, Korben is halfway to saving the world. He takes out four magic stones and places them in their places in the sacred place seconds before the tragedy. Now Lil needs help.

title: King of Thieves
description: The film was based on the case of the largest robbery in the history of Great Britain, which shocked the police and the public. 77-year-old widower Brian Reeder assembles a gang of elderly loser con artists to pull off an unprecedented burglary of a Hatton Garden vault. A group of seventy-year-old thieves decided to carry out their plan during the Easter holidays, when the vault would be closed. They carefully thought out the plan, armed themselves with powerful tools and got to work... The movie "King of Thieves" (2018) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers, biographies and dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: Lyali go further
description: Two friends, Jamie and Marian, decided to go on a trip to Tallahassee. They were full of hope and expected that this adventure would bring them a lot of fun and excitement. However, fate had its own plans. Along the way, they accidentally encounter a group of clumsy criminals who quickly start creating chaos and mayhem. The girls are forced to unite and use all their skills and resources to protect themselves and survive in this dangerous situation. The girls' friendship and resilience will be put to the test to show how strong they can be in the face of extreme stress and danger. Will they survive the journey and return home with their values ​​and connections intact?

title: Killing room
description: The cunning owner of a thriving art gallery was determined to achieve incredible success in her business. But the greedy young lady could not resist the temptation to earn as much as possible. Because of this, she agreed to participate in a money laundering scheme through the gallery. Both the killer Reggie and the boss Gordon were involved in the cunning machinations. All of them were aware of the assigned tasks and were eager to get a solid jackpot. But their plan, thought out to the smallest detail, begins to go wrong as planned. Suddenly, the killer becomes a gifted artist, whose talent attracts the attention of the public. The man himself had no idea that he could boast of such creative skills. He instantly turns into a star of avant-garde painting. Many people line up to buy his works. Art and crime are closely intertwined. It is not known what to expect from the planned mission.

title: last breath
description: The events of the film take place in the distant future, when the Earth's atmosphere has undergone the strongest changes. There is no more air on the surface of the planet. The remains of the survivors now live in underground bunkers where oxygen is produced using special equipment. This equipment is so valuable that they are ready to kill for it. And in this terrible world, where a breath of air costs more than life, one couple has to survive.

title: Spell The kingdom of darkness
description: A horror story about a girl named Sam, who never believed in the existence of ghosts. But one day her friend starts behaving strangely. She announces that she has become a victim of persecution by an invisible entity that drives her crazy every day. After some time, the friend disappears without a trace, which forces Sam to start his own investigation. This is how the main character learns that the creature that pursued the girl feeds on human images, which are her only source of strength. And now, to prevent the curse from hanging over Sam herself, she needs to solve the mystery of her friend's disappearance. Will a simple woman be able to deal with such a difficult case and give a supernatural creature a worthy rebuff? Or will Sam soon also disappear under mysterious circumstances, and the sinister spirit will attack someone else?

title: Cheeky monkey. The Great Escape
description: A monkey has escaped from a secret base and is now being hunted by an entire army. She is dangerous and... hairy! And self-confident, talkative and ill-mannered and free from all taboos!

title: Big kush
description: In the criminal part of London, if you have no experience and you are new, consider yourself out of luck, you definitely won't be able to survive or it won't be easy. In the criminal world of London gangs there are many criminals, thieves, and all of them have to put up with their own existence. So the heroes decided to take possession of a huge diamond and they will have to do more than just that. It's one thing to steal the diamond, another thing to hide it safely, but for that it still needs to be transported to the USA, where the stone is already waiting for its boss Avi. That's just bad luck, the main keeper of the four-fingered diamond, Franky, a man, to put it mildly, is not very friendly with brains, instead of fulfilling his task, he goes to an underground boxing match, where he parted ways with life, safely, for others, but not for him.

title: Instigators
description: In the center of the plot - a former marine named Rory. He is unlucky, and he literally owes the whole world. Rory owes child support and a mortgage. Usually this guy is dealing with financial problems and trying to patch up all the holes, but he doesn't do it very well. Kobe, another character in the story, is in prison and now he urgently needs money, so the two heroes team up to rob a bank. But either they thought badly, or it shouldn't have happened: ....... Otherwise, there is no way to explain why this robbery went wrong. This whole unpleasant situation can turn into a big problem for them. The sailor and former prisoner involves another person in the situation. Together with their psychotherapist Lori, they have to run not only from the police, but also from a whole bunch of problems that promise in the future: one and the other received an inheritance from the bank and did not return the loan on time. But this is not yet icing on the cake: the leader of the vengeful bandits has announced that he will hunt them down himself.

title: Tornadoes
description: A group of students from the exciting film "Tornadoes" approached the educational process with maximum responsibility. The parents of the boys made a lot of efforts to ensure that their offspring entered the best university in the city, so they tried to live up to the expectations of their relatives. But sometimes there were moments when their bodies were on the verge of total exhaustion due to colossal, daily loads. And then they resorted to the services of entertainment that is quite unusual for representatives of modern youth. The fact is that friends loved to watch hurricanes. Researching the features of the tornado invariably filled their souls with indescribable joy. But one day it led to tragic consequences. After getting into the car and chasing a portion of thrills, the adventure seekers did not know that the elements were about to kill them.

title: Teacher's room
description: Kapla Hovak works at a school, and this is the result of her long-standing dream. Having decided to become a representative, she hoped to teach children the basics of a mature life, talking about the right choices and what is unacceptable. But suddenly they faced a complete misunderstanding of their colleagues. Pupils are more likely to pass for aggressive future recruits and it is already too late to collect them, the young ones are indifferent, and the convinced one is too self-confident. Accusing one of the boys of theft forces Kapla to intervene. But the more actively she tries to protect him, the worse the situation becomes, turning into a disaster and affecting all participants.

title: Enemy of the State #1: Legend
description: The second part of the dilogy about the fate of the French gangster Jacques Merin is a continuation of the film "Enemy of the State No. 1". France, 1973-1979. Jacques Mesrin is a great French gangster, who became famous in his homeland more than the brightest movie star. His evil "feats" and numerous escapes from prisons, dizzying love affairs, enchanting adventures and exceptionally cynical, but witty in Gallic, long-term abuse of the police - all this has now turned into a real folk epic for the French. An epic about a man who knew how to be a real hero. Or an anti-hero... The film "Enemy of the State No. 1: Legend" (2008) will be enjoyed by all fans of criminal thrillers and dramas in Ukrainian.

title: Rebellious month. Part 2: The one that leaves scars
description: As the war nears its height, the heroes face new challenges and trials that reveal their true characters and strengthen their spirit. With each step, they understand that their struggle has a deep meaning, and their decisions affect not only the outcome of the battle, but also the future of the entire nation. Despite the difficult trials and losses, the heroes do not retreat, but find the strength and courage to go forward. Together they form an unshakable alliance. This continuation of the epic saga is filled with emotional twists, exciting battles and deep moments of self-discovery. The heroes face many moral dilemmas and choices that determine their fate and the future of their people.

title: Project "Adam"
description: The events of the film "Project Adam" take place in 2022. The main character, a boy named Adam, is not confident in himself, cannot stand up to abusers, so he often becomes a victim in school fights. He dreams of being strong, decisive and able to protect himself. One day in his parents' garage, the boy finds an adult man and notices a striking similarity in appearance and behavior between himself and the stranger, they cannot be a coincidence. It is he himself, only twenty-five years older. The grown-up boy tells that he is an astronaut pilot from 2050. His girlfriend was lost in the space-time abyss, and he was trying to find her. But the pilot had an accident and ended up in the past. The man remembered how indecisive he had been at thirteen. And the boy who dreamed of becoming cool looks at his future self and admires how brave and serious he is. The boys travel together through time and space, and a shared path brings them closer together. But a disaster has occurred and now humanity is in mortal danger. The heroes will have to correct the mistake and save the world. The film "Project Adam" (2022) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedy and fantasy films.

title: Perfect voice 3
description: "Bellas" is a musical group consisting of young ambitious singers who managed to win the world championship. However, after this victory, the girls split up and each of them started their lives with a clean slate: someone became a mother, someone opened their own business. Three years have passed since the breakup of the group, but now the girls have decided to reunite to take part in a world tour, in which they will have to face a young group that uses not only musical instruments, but also voices. The unification process is very intense and the girls have to go through many tests. Will they be able to overcome all the troubles and once again immerse themselves in the rays of glory? The film "The Perfect Voice 3" (2017) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedy musicals in Ukrainian live.

title: Scammers
description: The main events take place in the suburb of Chicago, Joliet, in the thirties of the twentieth century. Two resourceful crooks try to pull off the scam of the century to avenge the death of their friend against a powerful man in the criminal society. The film "Scammers" (1973) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime comedies.

title: Existence: Virtual shock
description: Allegra Heller is one of the best game console designers. One day, she holds a presentation of her new virtual reality console - "Existence" with the group. To play, you need to connect to the future version of the organic game console through the bio-connector in the waist area. But at the beginning of the presentation, Allegro is attacked by an assassin armed with a strange organic weapon that the security service could not detect. The girl runs away from the presentation together with PR intern Ted Pykle, who has to become her bodyguard. But her version of the game console turns out to be damaged, and now, in order to find out the extent of the damage, Allegra persuades Ted to install a bio-connector in her lower back... The movie "Existence: Virtual Shock" (1999) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror, thrillers and fantasy.

title: The mummy returns
description: A whole decade has passed since the events described in the first part, and none of the main characters could have thought that the Egyptian mummy, with which they fought and successfully defeated it, would return again. During this time, the treasure hunter and adventurer Rick managed to connect his fate with the wonderful Evelyn and have an heir, Alex, who was eight years old at the time of the events in the film. Now the O'Connell family joins together in a fight with the priest Imhotep from Ancient Egypt, and this adventure, although it will be very dangerous, is at the same time very exciting and interesting.

title: The girl and the sea
description: Gertrude Ederle, who lives in New York in a family of German immigrants, at the age of 9 witnesses a fire on a ferry, where most of the dead were women who could not swim. From that moment on, she began to train diligently, thanks to which she became a three-time medalist in swimming. Not wanting to rest on her laurels, Gertrude set herself the task of being the first woman to swim across the English Channel, which only five men had managed to do before her.

title: Passengers
description: After the plane crash in which the plane crashed, only ten managed to survive. After people have been given first aid, a psychologist takes up their rehabilitation, but in the process of work she realizes that the opinions of the victims differ greatly regarding the causes of the disaster. Then she begins her own investigation to get to the truth. But the truth turns out to be too deeply hidden and smells strongly of mysticism. The young doctor has a real romance with one of his patients, but strange events begin to happen. Those who survived the disaster begin to disappear one by one without a trace. The psychologist begins to suspect that there is some kind of conspiracy behind all this and that someone does not want the truth about the event to come out.

title: A few dollars more
description: Two bounty hunters are looking for bandits and gangsters in the Wild West. These heroes are called Douglas and One-armed. The first is a retired colonel, the second is a white-haired professional wielding pistols. In El Paso, a bank was robbed by one of the Indians that our heroes are hunting. The Indian has a passion for marijuana, he is inappropriate in behavior, suffers from unmotivated fits of laughter. Will the heroes be able to catch up and eliminate the Indian? The movie "A Few Dollars More" (1965) will be enjoyed by all fans of westerns in Ukrainian live.

title: Madame Clicquot
description: The main character is a twenty-year-old girl named Barba-Nicole Ponsardin. Years of life of the real prototype 1777-1866. She marries wine entrepreneur François Clicault, but seven years after the wedding, François's husband dies, leaving the entire vast kinovibe.co winery on the fragile shoulders of his young wife. Despite mistrust and tricks from those around her, brave Barba-Nicole took the business into her own hands. Detractors do everything to persuade the widow to sell the vineyards, claiming that managing the farm is not a woman's business. But she says that her husband left her the vineyards, knowing that she would not sell them. Barba-Nicole develops her own technology, but success does not come immediately - many bottles of wine explode in the cellars. But she does not stop experimenting. The woman runs large fields with grape vines and winemaking workshops, and it takes a lot of work to combine all the activities. She is brought to court, claiming that the woman is not capable of managing the vineyards, because her villains want to get their hands on large cultivated areas. There are many obstacles on the way to success. So Napoleon imposed an embargo on the export of wine abroad, but listening to her own intuition, the widow finds a brilliant way out. She is ready to devote her life to her favorite business, and as a result, the woman achieves great success.

title: A million ways to lose your head
description: The main events unfold in the eighties of the nineteenth century in Arizona. Here lives a simple farmer named Albert, who has never seen millions in his eyes. He has several ways of shearing sheep, as they dominate his farm in the small village of County Fair. One day his head will be lost from mad love. It turns out that a charming woman named Anna appeared in this God-forsaken town. She was able to make all the men in the district fall in love with her, but she herself chose Albert. Now the couple in love spend time together. But, as it turned out later, Anna is looking for her husband, a daring criminal Clinch. He challenges our hero to a duel, and he has no idea how to control a weapon. The movie "A Million Ways to Lose Your Head" (2014) will be liked by all fans of comedy westerns, which are successfully supplemented with a funny Ukrainian translation, to watch live in Ukrainian.

title: Lisa Frankenstein
description: In the center of the plot of the comedic zombie-horror "Lisa Frankenstein" is a high school student and an obscure goth girl named Lisa Swallow, who is in love with a boy who lived many years ago in the Victorian era. She could not find her ideal boyfriend among her classmates and often visits the ancient grave, looks at his stone bust with pity and tenderness. At some point, the dream of her girlhood dreams comes to life and rises from the dead. During a severe thunderstorm, Lisa, using a broken tanning machine in her garage, transforms him into the man of her dreams. She herself has changed a lot, wearing bright fashion clothes, applying youthful makeup and, according to the students, she could participate in beauty contests if she was close in spirit. Having brought the boy to order externally: after washing and changing into more modern clothes, Lisa notices that some parts of his body are missing. The girl does not consider this an obstacle to their happiness, and here begins a bloody adventure in search of love, happiness, as well as several lost body parts. To solve this problem, Lisa starts killing her classmates using the necessary parts.

title: Fifty shades of black

title: Friends forever
description: Arthur is a rich and respected professor who teaches medicine at a university, who five years ago is in a strained relationship with his adult daughter. When a best friend from high school named Felix, who has lost everything due to debt, ends up in the hospital, the man kindly lends him his health insurance card. During the examination, it turns out that the comrade has only six months to live, as he is suffering from lung cancer. Due to a misunderstanding, Felix begins to mistakenly believe that it is Arthur who is terminally ill, as a result of which the friends are involved in a series of touching adventures, trying to help in the realization of cherished wishes.

title: Sophie's Choice

Stingo is an aspiring writer who moves to Brooklyn and rents a room in the house of psychologist Nathan Landau, who lives with his lover Sophie Zawistowski. This woman survived a terrible time in a concentration camp in her native Poland, and now she is trying to start a new life in a foreign country. Once she was a happy wife raising two beautiful children, but the war took the most precious thing from her - her family. She is trying with all her might to start life with a clean slate, however, the tragic past is simply impossible to forget. Every day, Stingo learns more and more about the complex relationship of the owners of the house, and also tries to solve the mystery of a woman who once had to make the most difficult choice in her life... The movie "Sophie's Choice" (1982) will be enjoyed by all fans of Ukrainian dramas.

title: McFarland

The action takes place in the eighties of the last century in a small provincial town in the state of California. Jim White is a former professional football coach who retired from the big game and was forced to move to this town. Having found himself in a new place, he gets a job at a local high school. From ordinary boys, Jim recruits a track and field team and starts training. Gradually, his wards begin to show very good results, which leads them to success that no one expected. But the achievements of the team do not bring joy to everyone, because the boys do not work in the fields, devoting all their time to training and participating in competitions... The movie "McFarland" (2015) will be liked to watch in Ukrainian live by all fans of biographies and sports dramas.

title: Space cadet
description: In a historic moment for the U.S. space program, the outcome of a major NASA project will depend on a frivolous party girl who long ago traded studies for loud parties. Tiffany Simpson is a person whom fans of astronautics definitely did not expect to see at the head of a revolutionary mission to expand human capabilities in near-Earth space. Millions of people, discussing the latest news, are trying to understand why the managers who run the space agency made such a scandalous decision, giving up the place at the wheel of the shuttle to some dyed blonde. The girl herself is in shock from the events happening around her. Participation in the selection for the next flight was perceived by Tiffany as a very boring, but mandatory routine.

title: The road to glory. Lyancha vs. Audi

The battle, which took place on 20 tracks in 12 countries, brought intrigue, passion and inevitable fights for victory to the world of motor sports. The complexity of the race is added by the variety of conditions: rain, snow, mountain serpentines and narrow streets of medieval cities. The world's best pilots were behind the wheel of these cars, ready to go through all the difficulties for the sake of glory and triumph. Both teams use all possible tricks and strategies in the fight for the championship, not wanting to give in to their opponent for a second. At the end of each stage, the winner receives not only glory and recognition, but also the right to wash the cars of the losing side, thereby emphasizing the brutality and uncompromising rivalry in this exciting car race.

title: Ezra: Misbehavior
description: Family - this word has a unique meaning for everyone. Some people prefer to give themselves to their loved ones completely and sacrifice their careers, while others, on the contrary, do not risk wasting life's chances on their loved ones. The main character in the story is Max Bernal - a once successful careerist and family man who once decided to try himself in a new field and got so excited that the new business sucked him headlong into an unpredictable vortex of opportunities and challenges. Humor was everything for him - Max literally decided to devote his life to jokes, doing stand-up and completely forgetting about his own family. Ambition made the head of a person dizzy, who tasted imaginary glory and completely surrendered to the flow, hoping to succeed in a new business and regain the attention of his family.

title: Last vacation
description: Georgia Bird, an unassuming cookware saleswoman from New Orleans, dreams of opening her own restaurant and staying at a luxury resort. But unexpectedly, the woman learns that she is terminally ill, and her days are numbered. After quitting her job and taking all her accumulated money, she goes to a famous European resort, where she is mistaken for a capricious and capricious millionaire. Georgia herself, realizing that she has nothing to lose, begins to behave in accordance with the role... The film "The Last Vacation" (2006) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedies, adventures and dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: Secret in their eyes / Secret in their eyes
