But one day the usual flow of their lives is disrupted by a terrible tragedy - an unknown person brutally kills the daughter of investigator Jess. Despite all efforts, it is not possible to find enough evidence against the suspect, and he is released. It seems that this case will remain unsolved, but Jess's partner, who is hopelessly in love with their boss, is not going to give up and is trying in every way to get to the truth. And now, only ten years later, they have the opportunity to reveal the mystery of the girl's murder. The film "Secret in their eyes / Secret in their eyes" (2015) will be enjoyed by all fans of dramas and detectives in Ukrainian live.

title: Infernal surfing
description: Four female surfers decide to go to an exotic island known for its perfect waves and wild nature. Despite the warnings of the locals about the bad reputation of Skull Island, the girls cannot resist the temptation to explore this mysterious place and enjoy unforgettable adventures. From the very beginning of their journey to the island, strange and inexplicable events begin. Local residents tell them legends about an ancient tribe that lives on the island and worships the god of death. They warn that anyone who dares to violate the sacred boundaries of the tribe risks knowing the full fury of their deity. However, the girls perceive these warnings as nothing more than superstitious tales. They set up camp on one of the beaches and begin to explore the island. The nature of the island amazes with their beauty and diversity, and the waves are perfect for surfing. But soon they discover on the shore strange symbols and totems carved from the skulls of animals and people. Their curiosity takes over, and they decide to find out what is hidden behind these mysterious artifacts. Soon, the girls encounter an ancient tribe that strictly guards its territories. The tribe considers the island a sacred place and sees uninvited guests as a threat to their god of death. The girls find themselves in the center of a brutal hunt, during which they begin to understand that the legends about the god of death and his fury are not just fiction. Trying to save themselves, Lindsay, Sarah, Kate and Mia are forced to fight for their lives, facing ancient rituals, traps and superstitions of the tribe. Every wrong move could be their last, and they begin to realize that getting off the island will be much more difficult than they could have imagined.

title: Pride, Prejudice and Zombies

The undead come out of their graves and roam the entire territory of the country, devouring everyone they can catch. The film "Pride, Prejudice and Zombies" (2016) will be enjoyed by all fans of horror and fantasy films in Ukrainian.

title: Breakthrough dude
description: The loss of close relatives pushed the young man to make fatal changes in his life, because after losing his own family, his existence practically lost any meaning. The treacherous and corrupt head of the dynasty treacherously ended the family of the main character, who, having met a real enemy for the first time, reacted like a beast that saw a man for the first time: he managed to escape into the dark jungle that became his home. What awaits him ahead? How can he survive? Who will show the right way? Finding himself in the middle of gloomy and mysterious forests, where tropical trees intertwine with vines, and beasts reign and do not divide, the young man was doomed to death, but he appeared - a mysterious hermit who became a mentor for the fugitive. A new friend taught the protagonist martial arts, so when the time came for the young man to leave the cozy home, he was ready to go out into the crazy world as a new person.

title: The Queen's Gambit
description: The events take place on the territory of England, in the Tudor era. Now the power in the country belongs entirely to Henry VIII, so people are scared to the limit. The ruler is particularly cruel not only to his subjects, but also to his own wives, two of whom were executed by beheading. Another wedding of Henry is planned. This time, Kateryna Parr, a woman with extraordinary appearance and strong character, is the bride. She understands that this marriage may cost her life, but she is no longer able to change the circumstances. Henry sees only enemies around him and continues to influence others through a system of strict restrictions and punishments. He does not yet assume that his new wife is already full of forbidden passion. But everything secret sooner or later becomes obvious. Now Kateryna will have to make a serious effort to win over her own husband. After all, not only power is at stake, but also priceless life.

title: Kings of the streets 2

Kingston is not going to close his eyes to these atrocities and joins forces with a young and daring detective from the homicide investigation department to achieve justice and punish the criminals. However, during the investigation, shocking secrets are revealed and it turns out that many of those involved in this case are government officials and police officers. Many of them are mired in corruption and dark affairs, and now secrets are beginning to come to light that will force the detectives to face revenge and betrayal. But Marty intends to go to the victorious end in this case. The film "Kings of the Streets 2" (2011) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: Bone collector

Now everyone who conducts the investigation finds himself under suspicion. Suspicion and mistrust seep into the ranks of the police and the FBI, complicating joint efforts to apprehend the criminal. Ortega realizes that he must act quickly to not only save his niece, but also to prevent further murders. His search leads him to dark secrets hidden in the past and to shocking discoveries about people he trusted. With each step, the detective realizes that the killer is not just a maniac, but a cunning and prudent opponent, ready to do anything for his own survival. The investigation turns into a tense game of survival where the stakes get higher every day. Ortega must use all his professional acumen and personal courage to uncover the true criminal and stop a series of gruesome murders.

title: Children

She accompanies her to the clinic and is present at the birth of the baby. What happened somewhat stunned and saddened Eden: after all, her friend had already had a second child, and she had never experienced the role of a mother. A high-speed rush radically changes a woman's life. It turns out that after a night spent together with a young man she did not know, she became pregnant. She has nothing left to do, except to turn to the same friend for help. Only she can help her survive all the difficulties and hardships of an unplanned pregnancy. After all, Eden herself has not yet understood whether she wants to become a mother or not.

title: Remove the curse

In an effort to ease his father's suffering, Ted devises a cunning plan to rig the results of the games with the help of Marty's friends. At this very time, Marianna appears in his life - a charming woman who rekindles Ted's passion for writing. The events described in the picture take place in 2379. The film "Star Trek: Revenge / Star Trek: Retribution" (2002) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventures, thrillers and science fiction in Ukrainian.

title: Star Trek: Rebellion

Many Federation government officials are willing to sacrifice much to obtain the secret of immortality. Agents of the Federation secretly enter into an alliance with one of the races and try to reveal this secret of the planet. The crew of the starship Enterprise-E, led by Captain Picard, discovers this secret activity, which defies the non-interference directive. Picard decides to stop this activity on the planet by all possible means. Justice remains above all else for Captain Picard, so he must rebel against Starfleet to save the life of the planet Ba Ku and its inhabitants. The movie "Star Trek: Uprising" (1998) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventures, thrillers and science fiction.

title: Star Trek: Generations

This man named Soran is one of those who managed to survive after the incident on El Auria. Picard tries with all his might to stop the villain. The brave Captain Picard has no choice but to go after the debts to thwart their insidious plans and change the course of our history and destroy the threat of destruction of our planet. The film "Star Trek: First Contact" (1996) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventures, thrillers and science fiction in Ukrainian.

title: Mind and feelings

Older sisters - romantic Marianna and pragmatic Elinor are still unmarried. Having moved to the cottage, the Dashwoods get to know their new neighbors, including Colonel Brandon, who really liked Marianne, but the girl shows no interest in him at all. One day, while walking in the forest, Marianna twists her leg. She is helped to get to the house by the London lover John Willoughby, with whom she falls madly in love... The film "Mind and Feeling" (1995) will be enjoyed by all fans of Ukrainian dramas.

title: Crime fiction

A cruel and domineering boss does not like when someone tries to contradict him, and even more so he does not like deception. He entrusts all the dirty work to Vincent Vega and his friend Jules Winfield. They are the ones who deal with his errands, take part in showdowns and collect debts from debtors for him. But it is difficult to call the two friends ordinary bandits, because after completing the next case, they go to a bar, where they have casual conversations until the morning, tell various stories, discuss their deeds and simply enjoy excellent drinks. To combat crime related to fairy-tale characters, a special department was created in the police department. This is where the hero of the picture works. But the successor turns out to be not so good and fair. He establishes tyranny and strict rules in the clan. Dozens of people disappear from the city every day. But Stella is convinced that this nightmare will end. One day, an unexpected event in her life forces her to leave everything behind and return home. But with the beginning of 1944, the situation in Berlin and throughout the country worsened a hundredfold. Will our heroine survive this ordeal and protect her family?

title: Pearl Harbor
description: Danny and his friend Rafe, with whom he has been good friends since childhood, always dreamed of becoming pilots. Having grown up, the young people decided to fulfill their old dream. They both find themselves in the aviation of the United States of America. An important event turned the lives of the main characters. But these are not the only changes. Rafe managed to meet his beloved. He developed feelings for a pretty nurse named Evelyn. The couple never managed to stay together. The main character is urgently sent to England, where there are active battles with German soldiers. And Evelyn and Danny are ordered to go to the Hawaiian Islands to carry out their operation. After some time, the heroes receive sad news about the death of Rafe. Against the background of general grief, Danny and Evelyn fall in love with each other. A high-ranking Japanese military officer reports that one of the soldiers, a so-called phantom, is collaborating with Korean guerrillas. His name will be announced by twelve o'clock the next day.

It all begins with an innocent find, which seems to him strange and inappropriate to the everyday life of the district. This sets off a chain of thoughts and assumptions, until Darren comes to the conclusion that he has encountered a conspiracy, the scope and consequences of which could shake the whole city. Deciding to get to the truth, he begins his own investigation, becoming a kind of detective from his world. Immersion in the world of intrigue and secrets leads him to meet characters, each of whom could become the hero of a Hollywood film: corrupt officials, sure that their power and influence will make them untouchable; cynical Hollywood producers for whom real life is just another script for a movie; and mysterious do-gooders whose good intentions are only a mask to hide their true goals. With each step, Darren realizes that his search for the truth endangers not only his own safety, but also the safety of those close to him. But this knowledge only strengthens his determination to reveal the full scale of the conspiracy and bring those behind it to justice. His investigation, full of dangers and unexpected turns, transforms him from an ordinary pool cleaner into a true hero ready to challenge the system.

title: Neighborhood. On the warpath

One day, an art contest is announced in the cafe, and Modigliani and Picasso decide to take part in it. Now, to restore his reputation, the agent has to make a high-profile deal, and for this he needs to find the most gifted newcomer. Jimmy finds a way out of the situation in cricket, which is similar to baseball, where the players also serve the ball well. Everyone knows that the best cricket players live in India, where the sports agent goes... The movie "Hand for a Million" (2014) will be liked by all fans of biographical and sports dramas.

title: Martian child / Child from Mars

He really liked the little boy Dennis, who behaved in a rather strange way, not like ordinary children. When all the children were having fun on the playground, Dennis sat in a cardboard box, believing that sunlight was harmful to him. A six-year-old child decided that he was an alien from Mars. Gordon decides to help the boy find a connection with reality, relying on his literary abilities in dealing with the fictional world. All fans of comedies and family dramas will enjoy watching the film "Martian Child / Child from Mars" (2007) in Ukrainian live.

title: Crocodile: Marriage season

Having decided to find her brother on her own and save him from possible dangers, the girl turns to a local, quite eccentric and skeptical detective. Now, seeking to free her brother from a terrible trap, she is ready for anything. Ellie suspects that her brother may be involved in a mysterious story related to recent events and a local legend of a human-alligator hybrid monster. In order to solve all the mysteries of this spooky story, they must find answers to numerous questions. Realizing that time is short, the main characters begin an investigation that should lead them to their goal. Suddenly, a series of strange and mysterious events begin in their lives, which stand in the way of saving their brother. Only time will tell if they will be able to overcome all the difficulties and free him from the terrible trap.

title: Ceremonial dance

Soon, serious troubles will appear in the fate of the young heroine. She will have to grow up and decide a lot. Mom disappeared. The search for her will begin. It is not clear to anyone where the woman went. The daughter is frightened by what happened. A teenager cannot live independently. This is prohibited by law. These guys spend most of their time online, showing people how amazing life is around them. One day, someone from this company comes up with a brilliant idea to visit an abandoned mansion. The latter is commented on very cautiously, because it is known for its incomprehensible phenomena and disappearances of people. Once inside the house, the bloggers study it from the inside and marvel at how old it is and how believable their idea can be. It soon turns out that the short-sighted teenagers have awakened a powerful force capable of destroying everything in its path. Demonic entities will appear before all guests of this structure, and those who are lucky enough to survive will forever remember this visit. There is always a chance to restore everything to its place, but will the heroes have enough strength to restore everything to the way it was? Time is running out and it is terribly short.

title: Blood-red sky

It is on this person that the heroine places her last hopes. She believes that it will help to get rid of a strange disease that causes a constant thirst for blood. However, a group of armed terrorists, who are used to mercilessly killing their hostages, also appear on this flight. Nadia has no choice but to release the creature hiding inside her body. Who will be victorious in this bloody confrontation? Blood Red Sky (2021) will be interesting to watch live for all horror and action fans.

title: Beast
description: In the world of the future, people found an opportunity to get rid of unnecessary emotions thanks to the DNA purification method. Gabrielle, who decided to undergo this procedure, discovers an amazing journey through her previous lives, where she meets Louis at every stage of her life. In each of her past lives, Gabrielle feels an instant mutual attraction to Louis, but at the same time, there is a premonition of something terrible that may happen. The journey through Gabrielle's past incarnations and meetings with Louis make her rethink her attitude to the past, present and of the future She is faced with questions about her own identity, timeless bonds, and the inner contradictions caused by the desire to realize her feelings in a world where emotions try to control and suppress.

title: The house at the end of the street

title: Verdict / Conviction

Without putting much effort in the search, they make the audacious man Kenneth Waters guilty, and sentence him to life imprisonment. And only one person believes in the convict's innocence - this is his younger sister Betty Ann Waters. She devotes her whole life to the search for evidence that would justify her brother's name. Betty is already a grown-up family woman, but for the sake of her brother she leaves her husband, since she cannot stay with him, she simply does not have time for him. The heroine enters a law school and goes to study. But it turns out that it is not so easy to upset the system. 16 long years go to Anne for this unequal struggle with the system, and finally a spark of hope is visible in the darkness... The film "Verdict / Conviction" (2010) will be liked by all fans of biographical dramas in Ukrainian.

title: Bruce Almighty
description: Pessimist Bruce Nolan is a popular and well-known TV news anchor. He is not interested in anything: not the girl Grace, not his own reports. But one day Bruce is fired. The disappointed hero challenges God and unexpectedly receives an answer from the Almighty. God offers Bruce to switch places with him for a week and see if Bruce can make the world even a little bit better.

title: Despicable messenger
description: The film will tell about the events taking place in England after the end of the war. Peaceful life gradually began to improve, and many are trying to forget the horrors of the bloody confrontation. In a small town called Littlehampton lives a religious and pious woman. Neighbors consider her a kind and sensitive person, incapable of evil and meanness. Edith recently started receiving offensive messages with obscenities and swear words. After receiving the nineteenth letter, the head of the family gets nervous. The father decides to go to the police station and make a statement in order to get the perpetrator punished. He insists that he knows the name of the insidious sender very well. The main suspect is Rose Gooding, who recently moved with her daughter from Ireland. She has a rough and tough character, is distinguished by directness and openly expresses her own opinion. Her temper and love of swear words are well known to those around her, and her inability to control her emotions causes constant trouble.

title: Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F.
description: Detective Axel Foley returns to the familiar streets of Beverly Hills, but this time the stakes are higher than ever. His daughter Jane's life is in danger, forcing him to start the game again. Axel teams up with a new partner, Detective Bobby Abbott, and reconnects with his old friends Billy Rosewood and John Taggart. Together, they form a team ready to confront a criminal underworld that turns out to be more complex and dangerous than they imagined. In pursuit of justice, they uncover a conspiracy that could change Beverly Hills forever. What price will Axel and his team have to pay to protect the most precious thing he has?

title: Among the willows
description: John was once the most dangerous criminal. But the handsome man got bored of such a life, and he hastened to leave. After that, a completely different period began. Each day turned out to be similar to the previous one, and there was not a town left for danger. But somehow a tragedy happens. She knocks the usual world out from under his feet. Dangerous bandits from the past kill all his loved ones. Revenge does not make itself wait long. An angry man is ready to go to any lengths to destroy everyone involved and make them suffer. In addition, it is necessary to save your granddaughter. She is the only one who managed to survive in a difficult situation. The criminals are preparing to meet the man and figure out how to deal with him. Only then will the hero remember the past and start his game.

title: Benji
description: Carter and Frankie are a brother and sister who live with their mother in New Orleans. They are forced to spend every day after school alone, as their mother works a lot, trying to provide the children with everything they need. Carter often becomes the object of attacks by older and stronger boys, but he tolerates everything and keeps it a secret. One day he meets a stray shaggy dog ​​on the street who also suffers from bigger dogs. He takes the children to the house and they decide to keep it to themselves without telling their mother. Brother and sister have no idea that a new four-legged friend will soon become their savior...

title: Night fangs
description: Benny, a student, lives with his brother in Los Angeles and works as a driver in his spare time. One day, the hero of the horror film "Night Fangs" receives an order for the whole night. Two young sexy beauties are going to hang out until dawn and plan to attend a bunch of parties. While driving around the city, Benny has no idea what dangerous adventures await him, because his passengers are not quite ordinary girls, around whom some kind of game is happening.

title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
description: Batman is a powerful and fearless guardian of Gotham, who has repeatedly saved his city from various villains. But this time, he is not worried about criminals, but about the fact that the actions of Superman, the savior of Metropolis, can get out of control, which will lead to sad consequences. Batman challenges a superhero, while the rest of the world is about to decide which of the heroes it really needs. While the defenders of the world are busy at war with each other, humanity begins to be threatened by a new danger that it has never faced before in its long history. Will someone be able to stop the threat and save the world? The movie "Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice" (2016) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of action movies and science fiction.

title: Racer
description: Young driver Jimmy Bly won five races and now leads the championship. Last year's championship winner Bo Brandenberg believes that his relationship with his fiancee Sofia prevents him from achieving high results in races, so he is divorcing her. Now Bligh's results are starting to deteriorate, so the team manager is going to bring back former driver Joe Tanto, who should replace Bligh's partner. Bly himself at the same time tries to take care of Sophia, which makes Brandenberg jealous, who eventually asks Sophia to return to him and she agrees. But soon the team leader again makes a decision about a replacement - to bring back his old partner Jimmy Bligh instead of Joe Tanto... The movie "Racer" (2001) will be enjoyed by all fans of sports dramas in Ukrainian.

title: Furiosa: Mad Max. Saga
description: This story follows the capture of young warrior Furiosa from the picturesque Green Lands, which leads her into the hands of ruthless bikers led by Warlord Dementus. After passing through the barren expanses of the Wasteland, they unexpectedly come across the Citadel, which is the stronghold of the power of the immortal Joe. However, when two tyrants begin a battle for hegemony, Furiosa faces many challenges as she tries to find her way home through this perilous land of power and chaos.

title: Gangster
description: After the death of a gangster, a Harlem crime boss, his quiet driver Frank Lucas, decides to create his own criminal empire. Having changed his specialty, Lucas begins to transport drugs from Southeast Asia. He works without intermediaries and money pours into him like a river. Lucas considers himself a good businessman and adheres to capitalist competition by offering goods to his competitors at a lower price. Lucas manages to capture the entire drug market and earn millions a day. But he does not yet suspect that a rare bird has fallen on his tail - Richie Roberts, a rare, honest policeman who is hated even at work... The movie "Gangster" (2007) will be enjoyed by all fans of criminal thrillers, biographies and dramas.

title: Битва за планету Мавп
description: The earth is under the complete rule of the apes, and the human race is forced to hide in dungeons to avoid total destruction. However, there is a split among the main race, and some of the apes want to make a truce with the humans to end the bloodshed once and for all, while the main part of them dreams of getting rid of humanity once and for all. But people are not going to just wait for their death and are ready to engage in mortal combat. Soon, a series of terrible disasters is approaching the planet, which can destroy both biological species, after which humans and monkeys have no choice but to join forces. The film "Battle for the Planet of the Apes" (1973) will be interesting to watch online in Ukrainian for lovers of fantasy about monkeys.

title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes / Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
description: The film takes place twenty years after Cornelius and Zira managed to escape from the Planet of the Apes. After a terrible epidemic, all cats and dogs died out on Earth, after which people began to breed domestic monkeys. Having discovered their ability to learn quickly, they began to train them to perform simple housework. By 1991, America was once again a slave-owning country using primate labor. Soon the owner of the circus Armando arrives in Los Angeles, and with him Caesar, the only son of monkeys from the future, whom everyone thought was dead. After some time, the authorities, who resumed the investigation into the case of Zira and Cornelius, arrest Armando. At the same time, Caesar decides to defend his relatives, who are treated so unfairly by people. The film "Conquest of the Planet of the Apes / Conquest of the Planet of the Apes" (1972) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of action movies about monkeys.

title: Escape from the Planet of the Apes
description: In the distant future, on one of the planets, two of the most advanced monkeys have gone very far in their research and discovered a way to travel through time. Then they decided to find out why there was so much unrest on their planet, and went back in time. So Zira and Cornelius, together with Dr. Milo, end up in Los Angeles of the 20th century. People are surprised by the appearance of three monkeys that came out of the spaceship, but they are even more shocked by the primates' ability to talk. According to the stories of the unexpected guests, people begin to understand that they came from the future, and this greatly alarmed the government, and after it became known about Zira's pregnancy, the people decided to get rid of them, because they perfectly understood that if the highly developed monkeys began to reproduce, then the end of human civilization would come. From this moment on, the real hunt for guests from the future begins. The movie "Escape from the Planet of the Apes" (1971) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for fans of action movies about the Planet of the Apes.

title: Under the planet of the apes
description: A group of astronauts, going in search of a missing spaceship, crashes, in which only Sergeant Brent manages to survive, who, like the missing group, ends up on the planet of the Apes. After he manages to find Nova, he notices Taylor's locket on her and tries to find out where the missing astronaut can be found. She couldn't answer his question, but she led him to the monkey city, where Brent learned the necessary information after meeting with Cornelius and Zira. Now the sergeant will have to go to the Forsaken City to find Taylor. However, it will be very difficult to do this, because many deadly tests await him ahead. The movie "Under the Planet of the Apes" (1970) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for fans of fantastic action movies that have motifs about monkeys.

title: Planet of the Apes
description: In the year 3978, several earthlings find themselves on a distant planet after their spaceship crashes. They did not even know about its existence and were amazed that it is very similar to the Earth. They soon learn that the planet is inhabited by intelligent monkeys and humans who have degraded to the animal state. After some time, the monkeys capture the team and start torturing each of them. By chance, one member of the team manages to escape with a cute chimpanzee girl who tells him about the most terrible secrets of this planet. Will they be able to hide from persecution and save their lives? The movie "Planet of the Apes" (1968) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of action movies about primates.

title: Skelly
description: The main character, a little boy named Skelly, lives with his parents and his ninth-grader brother in a small town. An ancient oak branch falls on his house during a thunderstorm, leaving his family homeless. The heroes try to come to their senses and recover from this loss, but this causes a series of dramatic events that reveal family secrets, test their mutual understanding and love. The film "Skelly" makes the viewer think about the value of family, the power of forgiveness and the importance of justice.

title: Temptation
description: During the time of the plague, the historical drama about Benedetta Carlini, who enters a monastery in Tuscany, unfolds. Endowed with mystical abilities, she gains respect among the nuns, but her life is complicated by erotic visions and sexual fantasies. The main character faces a deep internal conflict between her spiritual calling and earthly temptations, and is forced to make a choice.

title: Way of retribution
description: After the unexpected death of her father, a woman, a former special agent, inherits the family bar - a place full of memories and stories of the past. But her new role as owner quickly turns from simply managing the business to something more dangerous when she comes face-to-face with a brutal gang wreaking terror and destruction across the city. With each passing day, tensions rise, and she is forced to mobilize all her fighting skills and leadership qualities to protect her bar, her patrons and her family's legacy. How will she deal with this threat and what will be the consequences of her confrontation with the gang, will it change her life forever?

title: An unsung hero
description: The events revolve around a boy named Ichira Gomen. He devotes his whole life to filming. He is a novice producer who helped the director record sounds. He worked for the Gaia company. But the experience turns out to be insufficient, because of which he loses his own job. Moreover, he no longer has the opportunity to engage in production. Wishing to convey his own dreams of great stardom to the young singer, the man tries to help him achieve his goal. Every day he grasped a new process of learning his position, but soon he failed. But the main character's personal life changes drastically when he notices the performance of Jem Hiiragi. He decides to seize the moment. Ichira turns to the boy. Then he spoke for the first time before a small group of homeless citizens. They were on the same street where the hero lived. Together with the beautiful performer and her personal troubles, Gomen and his new ward decided to stage a confrontation with the entire professional music industry. They carefully prepared for their next performance. Trying to do everything necessary, he had to go through a lot of different events. But the truth lies somewhere inside.

title: Imaginary friends
description: The life of the young heroine was not easy, but everything changed from the moment she realized that she was able to see imaginary friends - beings who once helped children in difficult situations, and then were forgotten and abandoned after the same children grew up. After some time, she finds out that she is not the only person who has such an amazing gift. There is one more - a man named Cal. During the acquaintance, he asks to help him in one important mission. He wants to find lost imaginary friends and give them new acquaintances so that they do not disappear into oblivion, which happens to every forgotten friend when he finally loses contact with a loved one. However, Cal does not rule out the reunion of lost acquaintances, which is what he suggests to the heroine. She agrees to this. Going on a long journey together, they not only get to know their lost friends, but also learn that some can turn to the dark side in the absence of love for a long time.

title: Blind
description: In his childhood and youth, Phil Roberts had to go through many difficult moments related to his family. His father worked most of the time in the fields, trying to feed the children, and his mother suffered from a mental disorder and was often treated in a special clinic. At this time, the hero stayed at home for the main man and was responsible for his sisters and brother. At that time, Phil liked to play sports and even managed to become a quarterback. Many believed that he had a great future associated with American football, but soon the grown-up Roberts started his family and left the sport. But there comes a period when the main character has many problems, he tries to distance himself from reality with the help of alcohol, and this only worsens the situation. In addition, he has a new friend, but communicating with him further distances Phil from his loved ones.

title: tarot
description: When a group of friends ignores the ban on using someone else's tarot deck, they accidentally release the evil that has been chained to those cursed cards for years. Confronting their own predictions in turn, they begin a desperate fight for survival, trying to change their fates and circumvent the prophecies of death.

title: Maternal instinct
description: Ordinary housewives from a small American suburb, Celine and Alice, lead a quiet, measured life. Each of them has a caring husband, a large cozy house and beloved children, a settled life and a pleasant routine. But, despite the well-being and prosperity, at one moment everything is destroyed before our eyes. Due to one accident, their relationship and communication completely breaks down, turning into enmity and hostility. Celine's son's death divides their lives into "before" and "after", leaving the mother inconsolable and grief-stricken. Trying to save herself from despair, she finds salvation in her daughter Alice, but she is against the woman interfering in the life of their family and scaring the child. So benevolent neighbors become sworn enemies who do not want to seek reconciliation. In their small world where order and propriety are of great importance, both women are caught in the trap of public condemnation and are literally forced to maintain and fuel the feud.

title: A thought about you
description: Sophie is a woman with life experience who recently turned forty. Her days are occupied with raising her 15-year-old daughter and searching for love, which she does not find. She believes that she deserves happiness and is sure that it will definitely find her, despite all the obstacles. The ex-husband has already found new happiness with a young woman and practically turned his back on Sophie and their daughter. One day, the daughter expresses a desire to attend a music festival, and Sophie does not hesitate to offer her support. This decision leads them to a place that enchants a large number of music lovers. Here, Hayes appears on her path - a self-confident young man from a well-known musical group. Unpredictable feelings arise between them, and this presents Sophie with a serious choice: should she give her heart to a boy who, it would seem, could be her son?

title: Under the heel
description: In a quiet and prosperous suburb, where life flows measuredly and carefree, one housewife decides to carry out repairs in her house, starting with the bathroom. This decision leads her to a meeting with a contractor who at first glance seems to be the perfect candidate to carry out the planned works. However, soon after starting the renovation, the woman faces a series of unpleasant surprises. The contractor, using his mastery of manipulation, begins to subtly and skillfully introduce psychological terror into her life. Every day brings new challenges, and the housewife finds herself locked in the cage of her own house, where every corner reminds her of her helplessness in the face of the threat hidden behind the mask of friendliness and professionalism of the contractor. The situation escalates to the limit when the woman realizes that the only way to regain control over her life is to outwit the manipulator with his own weapon. A complex game begins, in which not only the restoration of her home is at stake, but also the struggle for personal freedom and self-respect. In this battle of wits, where every move can lead to unexpected results, she must use all her ingenuity and willpower to decipher her opponent's intentions and predict his next moves. This story is a tense psychological thriller about overcoming, self-discovery and the triumph of the human spirit over manipulation and control. In the process of confrontation, the housewife discovers in herself not only unprecedented depths of courage and determination, but also the understanding that true strength lies in the ability not to break down and emerge victorious...

title: Strangers: Part One
description: Maya and Ryan are a young couple. Full of dreams of a happy future, they drive across the country to their new life together in the Pacific Northwest. Suddenly, their car breaks down on the way, and the couple has no choice but to stay overnight in a secluded house in Oregon. Here, a long night of terror awaits them from three masked strangers.

title: Bahubali: The Beginning
description: Bahubali is one of the sons of the Taksashil king, who repeatedly fought with his brother and eventually conquered all his lands. He was a true hero and a wise ruler who was respected by the common people. However, after another victory, he renounced the throne and became a monk. Many legends and epics were written about what happened to him later. There are rumors that in a state of meditation, Bahubali could stay in one place for a very long time, completely motionless. During this time, plants sprouted through him, wrapping around his body and beard, and birds howled their nests on his head, absolutely not afraid of the monk... The movie "Bahubali / Bahubali: The Beginning" (2005) will be enjoyed by all fans of war adventure dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: It's an amazing life
description: George Bale lives in a small town. Now he is beset by some failures, and the main character is so upset by his problems that he thinks of committing suicide on Christmas Eve. George always dreamed of leaving his hometown and seeing the world, but circumstances and his good heart prevented him from realizing his dream. John collected every cent, and all this money went to his brother's education. He also tried to keep his family afloat, married a beautiful girl and lives with her. His life was mundane, sometimes he took out loans and fought with the local evil banker. Standing on the bridge, not thinking about how bad it will be for his relatives and relatives without him, John prepares to jump... The film "It's a Wonderful Life" (1946) will be liked by all fans of family dramas.

title: Retirement plan
description: Matt leads a free and carefree life far from civilization and the noise of big cities. Having settled in the Cayman Islands, he hoped that no one would disturb him in this heavenly secluded place. But fate had its own plans for the retired hero. Ashley and her teenage daughter Sarah find themselves on the brink of disaster. They are pursued by criminal elements - bad boys who know no pity, fear, or remorse. In a desperate attempt to save herself and her family, Sarah embarks on a dangerous journey all alone. She wants to meet her grandfather Matt. The hero, having learned about a dangerous situation, reluctantly enters the case to protect his family from the criminals who pursue them. However, when Matt begins to easily deal with enemies, his daughter wonders: who is her father?

title: The perfect crime
description: Recently, there was news about the disappearance of a successful entrepreneur who enjoys authority and respect. The circumstances of the event raise many questions, and searches for hot leads do not bring positive results. The man was considered the heir of a wealthy and powerful family, and numerous rumors and conjectures only worsened the situation. Two young investigators, who are ready to work without rest or weekends, take up the investigation. They intend to solve the mystery of the disappearance and do everything in their power to solve the case. They will have to face a whole series of different dangers, which will put their well-being in serious danger. With each step and getting closer to the solution, the feeling of imminent disaster grew stronger. Representatives of law enforcement structures should understand how far they are willing to go to reveal the truth.

title: Abigail
description: Abigail is a 12-year-old girl who is the epitome of fragility and grace, especially in her snow-white ballerina dress that gives her the appearance of vulnerability. But this image hid an unexpected power, which revealed itself at the moment of extreme danger, when the girl fell into the hands of determined and daring kidnappers. They, dreaming of getting rich quick, decided to steal Abigail from her wealthy family, not knowing who they were dealing with. Abigail's father, a man of considerable authority and considerable finances, made his fortune years later by engaging in illegal activities. When the criminals contacted him, demanding a ransom of fifty million dollars, he, angry and indignant, promised to find and punish those who dared to touch his child and threaten his well-being. However, the development of events took a completely unexpected turn. It turned out that Abigail had hidden vampiric abilities, which until this moment remained unknown even to herself. These abilities manifested themselves at the most critical moment, and now Abigail was no longer the victim, but her captors became hostages of circumstances. At night, when the kidnappers were supposed to guard Abigail to prevent her possible escape, everything changed. The girl turned into a real vampire, full of thirst for blood and revenge. She was ready to use her newly acquired powers to take revenge on those who dared to encroach on her freedom. Thus, the criminals, who were counting on easy prey, faced something much more terrifying and powerful than they could have imagined.

title: Something in the water
description: A company of best friends goes on a dream trip, hoping to enjoy the sun and the sea. Filled with joy and anticipation of adventure, they rent a small boat and set off to explore remote corners of the coast. But their carefree trip unexpectedly turns into a bloody nightmare when the girls are attacked by a huge shark. In one moment, everything idyllic turns into chaos. The boat capsizes and they find themselves in the open sea, cut off from shore. Panic grips them, but survival requires coolness and determination. Hours pass, and strength and hope quickly run out. Each of them struggles with fear and despair in their own way. One recalls the lessons of survival, another tries to maintain the morale of the team, the third looks for signs of salvation on the horizon. They understand that they can count only on themselves and on each other's support. Gradually, the girls begin to act in concert, developing a rescue plan. Meanwhile, the shark continues to circle, its shadow a symbol of impending doom. The girls try their best to avoid her attacks, using everything they have left: the wreckage of the boat, improvised weapons and their wits. When it seems that all hope is gone, they notice a ship approaching in the distance. This gives them a new impulse to fight, and by joining forces, they decide on the last desperate step to salvation. With the help of signals and shouts, they try to attract the attention of the crew, keeping afloat with their last strength.

title: Lesson plan
description: In the center of the plot is a former policeman who gets a job at school. In it, his deceased friend taught, and the hero intends to do everything possible to get even with the gang, which he considers responsible for the teacher's death. Will he be able to achieve the desired result and is he not wrong in his assumptions? We recommend watching the movie "Lesson Plan" (2022) in Ukrainian for fans of crime thrillers and dramas.

title: Tactics of love
description: A romantic comedy that tells a beautiful story of sincere feelings. Yes, Asl successfully ran her blog and achieved certain results. Thanks to her advice, many women around the world managed to solve various problems in love relationships. They managed to get the perfect chosen ones and become much happier than before. But everyone wonders why Asli herself can't find true love? After all, she understands relationships so well and can boast of expertise. Soon advertising manager Kerem appears on her path. He does not believe in love and sincerity, often questioning all romantic feelings. Asli offers him to test her tactics developed over the years. And the handsome man decides to agree. Together they get to know a completely different, amazing world, filled with the brightest achievements...

title: Fighter
description: One day, ten thousand kilometers above the earth, a deadly confrontation unfolds. A group of terrorists armed to the teeth, bypassing the security in some inexplicable way, infiltrates a passenger airliner and takes hostage dozens of people on board: a stewardess, a commander and a flight attendant. The invaders demand that the state fulfill their conditions and provide them with a private plane, bags of money at the border and not prevent their escape. The authorities decide to plan a soft capture of the criminals, but the operation unexpectedly fails and forces the bandits to stage a vendetta. However, at the last moment, one of the ordinary passengers stands up to protect the hostages, but no one suspects that in the past he was a military serviceman and part-time professional operative of the intelligence group.

title: The paradox effect
description: Faced with many life trials, which seriously affected her formed life, the girl Karina seriously regretted the period when she connected her path with drugs. Struggling against addiction to a number of prohibited substances, the girl herself went through a difficult path, by no means expecting to see a terrible crime committed by local mobsters who wanted to deal with an unwanted witness by opening a hunt for her. Barely hiding from the pursuit of thugs, she could not imagine that she would learn about the connection of her beloved boyfriend with a criminal organization, who was under the complete control of killers who wanted to use her to carry out another attempt. Having no other way out, the girl herself follows the lead of the criminals, starting to think of a plan to save her loved one, not at all afraid to enter into a fight with dangerous bandits. Thus, committing a number of crimes, Karina herself becomes a participant in several criminal cases, which push her to enter into a confrontation with the kidnappers of her beloved husband, as well as the police themselves, who are hunting her.

title: A quiet night
description: The main character is Mike, the happy father of a large family, who one day finds himself in the epicenter of gang fights by accident. During the shootout, the children and the man's wife were killed by bullets, and he himself was wounded in the hospital. Mike is released from the hospital, but he will never be able to speak again. The only thing the man wants now is to take revenge on the villains. After a year of intensive training, deprived of the closest people, the hero becomes a nightmare for a gang of gangsters. Now this mute person is excellent with weapons and hand-to-hand combat.

title: Last stop in Yuma County
description: The events take place in Arizona in the 1980s. A knife dealer travels by car, offering his goods to customers. The situation gets complicated when he suddenly runs out of gas in the middle of the hot desert. The only gas station in the district is without fuel. A fuel truck should arrive here after some time. The traveling salesman is forced to stop at a small roadside cafe. He's just going to grab a bite to eat and refuel the car before continuing on his way. But his plans were not destined to come true. Bank robbers arrive at the restaurant, fleeing with the loot from possible pursuit. They also need fuel, and the hero of the film and the waitress accidentally recognize the criminals. Now they are both hostages who can be killed at any moment. The problem is that there are still unsuspecting customers in the cafe. Criminals and their victims have to act as if nothing out of the ordinary is happening.

title: North Pole: Open Christmas Day
description: This is the story of Mackenzie Warren, who shines as a successful business woman. However, when she receives an incredible inheritance from her aunt - a cozy hotel in a quiet town, Mackenzie's life changes. Located in the place where she once spent carefree childhood days, the hotel awakens waves of nostalgia in her. Mackenzie forgets about her business career, wanting to restore those feelings of joy and happiness. However, she is faced with an important decision: sell the hotel and continue her usual life or open a new chapter by reviewing her priorities. Thanks to work, Mackenzie is forced to choose between the comfort of the past and an unknown future, being on the verge of losing everything she has built for many years.

title: After. Forever
description: Hardin wrote a bestseller about his complicated relationship with Tess: how he gained fame and lost love. To come to terms with the past, he flies to sunny Lisbon, where he meets his ex, Natalie. It's time to turn the page and let Tess go - now forever... or not? The final chapter of the popular youth melodrama with Hero Fiennes Tiffin based on the books by Anna Todd. Also in one of the main roles is the star of "Sexual Enlightenment" Mimi Keane. Is it a good idea to release a novel about the most personal? Tess doesn't think so, because her writer boyfriend Hardin flaunted their shared history without asking her permission. After parting, she advises him to live his life. However, Tess was not the only girl he offended. He manages to find the beautiful Natalie, who suffered because of his cynical prank. At the same time, Hardin is looking for inspiration for a new book, working on mistakes and never stops dreaming about Tess.

title: When evil hides
description: In a quiet and secluded corner of the countryside, where life was measured and calm, farmer brothers Pedro and Jaime encountered an event that radically changed their perception of the world. One day, while walking through the forest adjacent to their lands, they came across the mutilated body of a demon purger - a man with a rare and dangerous gift of exorcising evil from the possessed. Research revealed that he was on his way to a nearby house to complete his mission and exorcise a demon that had possessed one of the locals. Realizing that they are dealing with an evil force that requires a special approach and knowledge of secret rituals, Pedro and Jaime team up with their neighbor Ruiz to prevent further spread of evil. They decide to take the infected person away from populated areas and leave him there, hoping that this will help avoid new victims. However, on the way to their destination, the possessed suddenly disappears, leaving the brothers and Ruiz in confusion and fear. The next day, tragedy strikes Ruiz's house - a demonic force destroys him and his pregnant wife, leaving behind only destruction and despair. Shocked by what happened and realizing that evil continues its course, the brothers decide to leave these places to save themselves and prevent new victims. Continuing their difficult hike, the team met a homeless, exhausted dog. This determined and uninvited companion seems to have chosen Mikasl Lindnord as his leader. The presence of this loyal and tenacious dog changed the dynamics of the trip. Despite the team's initial surprise and discomfort, they couldn't help but be moved by the dog's unwavering desire to join their ranks.

title: Ghostbusters: The Frozen Empire
description: Egon Spangler devoted his entire life to the fight against otherworldly evil. For this, he even founded the legendary Ghostbusters team in New York. However, every year the city became less and less unclean, the Hunters were asked for help less and less, until their famous team turned into a legend. Deprived of his usual occupation, Spangler himself was forced to move from New York to an old farm in the town of Summerville. Igon chose this place to live not by chance. In the town for a long time there was a mine, which, according to the Hunter, hid evil forces waiting for their time to break free. Igon still managed to trap one of the underground spirits, but the fight with him cost the legendary Hunter his life. During his lifetime, Spangler bequeaths his modest house to his daughter Kelly and grandchildren Trevor and Phoebe. Sorting through old junk after his death, Phoebe finds an incomprehensible object that turned out to be a detector of supernatural activity, and then discovers the ghost trap itself, which she inadvertently opens and releases a dangerous ghost capable of freezing all living things. Realizing that they can't handle it themselves, Kelly and her children rush to New York to join forces with the Hunters and stop the spirit before it turns the world into an icy desert.

title: Borat 2
description: The storyline of the film "Borat 2" continues the story of the famous Kazakh reporter Borat Sagdiev, who after his past adventures became a real star. Now it is problematic for him to interview famous personalities, since he himself is far from an average citizen, and constantly attracts the attention of passers-by. How to hunt for the next story here? Borat finds a way out of the situation quickly - he will disguise himself, pretending to be other people. Disguised, the reporter goes to the USA, where he is expected to meet with the most famous political figures, representatives of pop and cinema, and none of them will know who he is talking to. Borat will take his daughter on the trip, who considers her dad a real hero. Together, they will have to face a lot of ridiculous situations and show that even the coronavirus is not an obstacle for the famous journalist ....

title: My spy
description: The main character of this action comedy, intended for family viewing, is named JJ. This is a big man who wants to be inconspicuous because he works as a secret agent. He just doesn't succeed in acting quietly without leaving traces. Every time he leaves corpses, destruction, and other traces behind him. In the CIA, the superiors are already tired of correcting the consequences of Jay's work, but he is still endowed with valuable qualities, so it would not be worth losing him. Management gives him one last chance to prove that he is worth something. But even here our hero got caught on camera by a 9-year-old girl who asks him to make her a spy. The movie "My Spy" (2020) will be liked by all fans of good and funny comedies in Ukrainian.

title: Books of blood
description: A woman has lost her beloved son and cannot cope with the pain of loss. She dreams of only one thing - to see or hear her boy again. Such a desire pushes her to a desperate step. The heroine turns to Simon, who calls himself a medium, for help. The woman does not particularly believe his words, considering him to be an ordinary charlatan, but she is not going to lose the last drop of hope. Meanwhile, a young girl faces a serious crisis in her life. As a result of several events, she finds herself in the house of a rather nice family. But will her first thought turn out to be correct? The film "Books of Blood" (2020) will be enjoyed by all fans of dramatic horror in Ukrainian.

title: Are you here, God? It's me, Margaret
description: The diversity of New York changes for a young high school girl to the suburbs of New Jersey, where she has to get used to the established rules of the community, a new reality. Adolescent questions are increasingly common at home, but parents try not to put additional pressure on the child, do not demand the impossible. Refusing to subject their daughter to religious torture, relatives hope that she will take a dignified path of self-determination and will be able to cope with the trials of faith. Margaret approaches the problem in a measured and thorough manner, learns to explore her own feelings about prayers, familiarization with certain rites. The girl contributes to the organization of a peer group, where interlocutors share love experiences, discuss painful topics that are sometimes forbidden in the family circle. Gradually, the student gets acquainted with the important canons of Christianity and Judaism. An active grandmother wants to play the main role in her upbringing. A real Jew, Sylvia Simon is slightly angry with her son for his choice of a wife, but she sincerely believes that her adored granddaughter will definitely want to follow in her footsteps and become the continuation of a glorious dynasty.

title: The territory of evil
description: The special purpose team "Delta", called to carry out particularly dangerous assignments, goes on another mission to a small town located in the Southern Philippines. Experienced fighters find themselves in the very center of the tropical jungle, but they have no thoughts of rest. A squad under the command of Captain Sugar is tasked with freeing hostages held captive by bandits. But simply freeing the captives is not enough. Together with the former hostages of the squad, it is necessary to leave the dangerous place as soon as possible. But it turns out to be extremely difficult to do this. In the jungle, "Delta" is ambushed by rebels. After a fierce battle, the unit is trapped and loses most of its weapons. Experienced commander Shugar refuses to leave his wounded soldiers. He decides to move on with the freed hostages, relying only on the help of the Reaper drone operator, who from this moment on becomes the eyes and ears of the small detachment. It is Reaper who now supports the Delta group from the air.

title: An imaginary friend
description: Every childhood has an imaginary friend, a faithful companion in the world of fantasies and secrets. Eventually, children grow up and forget about their invisible friends, leaving them alone, without faith and love, invisible to others. However, a girl appears in our story, who is able to see and communicate with these forgotten creatures, whether they are fluffy, funny, kind, or capricious characters.

title: School party
description: A teacher becomes the victim of an unfair dismissal due to the false accusations of his former students, he decides that it is time to answer for his anger. When he accidentally learns about a party organized by these young women, Ty is called for revenge. His anger and thirst for justice know no bounds: he is ready to take any measures.

title: Pop star: Never stop without stopping
description: Since childhood, Conor's life was connected with music. Despite evil incitement and envy, he became a pop star in the future, never stopped at what he had achieved and never stopped delighting his listeners with new compositions. His CDs sold at breakneck speed, and the royalties were incredibly high. Conor could easily afford a big house, a cool car and carefree fun with attractive girls. But because of this, he lost all his student friends, with whom he started his musical career. Unexpectedly, the next disc of the hero turned out to be a complete failure, which greatly affected his career.

title: Daddy for Christmas
description: Four sisters do not get along for a long time. Everyone is busy with their own lives and practically does not mention blood ties. Perhaps everything turned out in this way, because there was no example of a happy family in front of them. Father left the family many years ago, without even saying goodbye. On the eve of Christmas, one of the girls decides to gather her relatives in her luxurious mansion to celebrate the wonderful holiday. She is sure that they need to forget old grudges and start participating in each other's lives. But immediately everything does not go according to her plan. The heroines argue and fight again, and the mother spends most of her time with her young boyfriend. Moreover, their father comes to them, who suddenly after many years decided to spend the holiday with his relatives. However, a young blonde wife comes with him, which clearly will not smooth out the appearance of the ancestor. We suggest watching the movie "Daddy for Christmas" (2021) in Ukrainian for lovers of comedy and family films.

title: Operation "Hyacinth"
description: The events of the film "Operation Hyacinth" take place in Poland in 1985-1987. This period, which coincided with the rule of the communist regime in the country, has so far been little covered, hidden behind the notorious iron curtain. It is not difficult to assume that the repressions affected many people from all walks of life and occupations. One of the operations of law enforcement officers were raids, the result of which was the creation of a database of slightly more than 11 thousand people belonging to sexual minorities. Against the background of police arbitrariness, the young detective Robert investigates a murder committed in one of the Warsaw undergrounds. He is not satisfied with the official "disclosure" of the case, which the Polish secret police insist on. It is for this reason, guided by his own principles and dictates of conscience, the boy continues to delve into the details of what happened at his own peril and risk. The investigation brings him into contact with Arek. Wanting to extract information from the detective, she does not think seriously about the consequences of such cooperation for him. And it is not only about career and work, but also about personal life. Will it be possible to track down a serial maniac who chose a gay victim? The movie "Operation Hyacinth" (2021) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of crime and drama films.

title: Godzilla. Minus one
description: The end of the Second World War. Koichi, a Japanese kamikaze squadron pilot, cowardly lands his plane on an island near Japan, citing a technical malfunction in his plane. At night, the pilot is attacked by Godzilla, a giant unknown monster, and is knocked unconscious in the plane. Koichi returns to Tokyo and learns that his family has died. The hero is tormented by guilt for being alive. He works in demining and takes care of a lonely girl, Noriko Oishi, and a little girl, Akiko, whose parents have died. Meanwhile, the United States conducts nuclear tests, and Godzilla mutates to giant size and acquires the destructive power of heat rays. Godzilla begins to destroy warships and heads for Japan. State-of-the-art Japanese tanks rise to fight Godzilla, but the heat rays released by the monster cause a nuclear explosion, resulting in massive human casualties. All kinds of tricks, deception and even sacrifices are used to destroy the angry Godzilla. It takes incredible effort to destroy a monster. But the story does not end with the victory over the giant panther.

title: Passion of Joan of Arc
description: The presented picture is a work of art based on the sad fate of a famous girl who devoted herself to the service of the English crown. And for this, the ruling authorities condemned the heroine to be burned at the stake on the charge of witchcraft. In ancient England, this reason was quite popular, because the accused had practically no chance to avoid trial. If the monarchs were not satisfied with the victim, everything was done to make an innocent person a follower of the devil. The whole point is that the image of Joan of Arc threatened to become a symbol of freedom. This could lead to a rebellion among the population, so that the representatives of the crown had no choice but to get rid of her. "The Passion of Joan of Arc", created in 1928, was banned from being shown in the homeland, because in the film royal soldiers acted as executioners and torturers, and the main character herself was an innocent victim of the system. For a long time, the presented picture was unknown until a few decades later the film was discovered in a psychiatric hospital in the city of Oslo. The tape was preserved in excellent condition, after which it was shown to the world. The film is full of fear and anxiety, but the spirit is unbroken. Even when on the verge of life and death, a person's true faith is unshakable, and no amount of torment could change that. The film "The Passion of Joan of Arc" (1928) will be enjoyed by all fans of biographies and historical dramas.

title: A million miles away
description: The story of Jose Hernandez is the story of an ordinary farmer who works diligently every day cultivating his land in the hope of a bountiful harvest. His life flows in the rhythm of rural work, and he dreams that luck will smile this year. However, in addition to his daily work, Jose Hernandez always had a great passion and dream - the dream of space. He believed that even an ordinary farm worker could reach the stars and travel to space. His perseverance, faith and self-sacrifice inspired him to take steps towards this dream. And so, thanks to his constant dedication to his goal and willingness to do his best, Jose Hernandez was able to fulfill his incredible dream and conquer space. His story is an example of the fact that no matter what profession or status a person has, with faith and diligence, even the most incredible goals can be achieved.

title: Godzilla and Kong: The New Empire
description: The film is about monsters with incredible power, who will face each other in an equal battle. Godzilla was considered the result of a failed experiment. People tried in vain to tame her. The giant tortoise was sent to a secluded island, where specialists continued to work with it. Scientists decided not to destroy the monster. It could serve for the benefit of humanity, but for this it was necessary to find a way to make it stand on the right side. During the alien invasion, Godzilla became the secret weapon of the people, which led them to victory over the aliens. This time, an even greater danger loomed over the Earth. The legendary Kong returns, able to destroy a huge metropolis in a few hours. People have nowhere to hide from his wrath. Normal weapons are powerless against the monster. Only an equal can repel him. The whole world is watching the clash of two giants. There is almost no chance of salvation, because no one is able to fully control the titans.

title: Beast in the jungle
description: The plot of this film takes place in a fashionable Parisian nightclub at the turn of the millennium. From the end of the 1970s for 25 years, until the beginning of the 2000s, a man and a woman taste fate, which, as they feel, is approaching some grand event that can change everything - both for the better and for the worse. He is the charismatic and serious John (Tom Mercier), she is the charmingly anxious May (Anais Demoustier). They will constantly meet while people around them dance wildly as if tomorrow will never come. This unique film does not have a plot with a typical story for the audience, but is more like an experiment. A huge mass of people who continuously and frantically dance like possessed people to the rhythm of different music, fashionable in different periods of time, is a metaphor for modern life, in which everything must be urgent, everything must be done quickly, where there is no peace at all. Against the background of this hypnotic, amazing, crazy rhythm that hypnotizes attention, only two people remain motionless - John and May. Every weekend they sit on the sofa above the dance floor, watching from the balcony those who move below them, who will die, but not now. It seems that the main characters know more than others, understand the meaning of what will soon happen, and realize the irreparable consequences for everyone present in the nightclub. John, with a stunned face, utters dialogue that no one wants to hear and is not going to take seriously. And John himself does not seem to be convinced that his speeches are not hallucinations. John can't leave the club, and together with May, they can no longer leave each other and this place, which is in Paris.

title: Daddy's daughter
description: Burning with the desire to start a strong and happy family from an early age, the boy Etienne persistently continued his search for his princess, who would be able to change his man's life for the better. Having immersed himself in studies, the student could not have imagined that a chance meeting in the university corridor would change his life forever. Having begun to feel a strong attraction to Valeria, the boy did everything possible to achieve reciprocity on the part of his chosen one, who decided to marry him. Making all the necessary efforts to build a carefree seed life, the girl herself had no idea that at one moment she would feel unhappy, having decided to leave her lover with her newborn daughter Rosa. Having tried on the duties of a single father, Etienne himself was not at all upset by what happened, enduring all the difficulties of raising a child alone. Trying to support the aspirations of his beloved daughter in everything, he was glad for her admission to one of the best universities in the country, preparing for the upcoming departure of a person dear to him. At the same time, Rosa herself faces unexpected facts about the past of her mother and father's relationship, daring to find out family secrets before the upcoming move to another city.

title: Outsiders
description: In the center of the plot is football star Jacen Jennings, known by the nickname "Two Jays", who, having committed a violation of the law, faces the possibility of imprisonment. Instead of being behind bars, the main character agrees to perform community service. Jennings is heading to his hometown of Long Beach in the state of California, where he takes on the role of coach of a small American football team called "Underdogs". For the main character, whose interests are primarily related to restoring his image, the fate of the football players remains in the background. He is faced with the task of turning a failing Underdog team into champions, which unexpectedly forces him to reminisce about the past: meet up with former teammates, reminisce about old loves and rediscover his passion for the game.

title: Close
description: The dramatic film "Close" tells the story of two teenagers, Leo and Remy, whose unbreakable friendship is severely tested as they enter adolescence. Growing up and the changes that come with it begin to split the bonds of their connection, causing the heroes fear and uncertainty. Leo, wanting to rectify the situation, establishes a close relationship with Remy's mother, Sophie. At school, he and his friend face bullying from their classmates, and soon a tragedy occurs that seems inevitable. This event makes Leo think for the first time about what is happening around him, and why they, previously so united, suddenly became strangers. The film promises the viewer a deep story about love, vulnerability, forgiveness and betrayal, where not only feelings and emotions, but also the internal conflict of the characters play an important role. Will the boys be able to restore their friendship and restore their former trust? What role do love and feelings play in this? These questions are the depth and tension of the film "Close", which immerses the viewer in the world of internal battles and the search for the true meaning of life and relationships.

title: Break the bank
description: The head of the most influential and largest gangster group in the city and the country named Mason is a real master of theft and a born adventurer. Several dozen professional bandits work under his leadership and unceasing control, who are able not only to get their way and choose a victim to the letter, but also to stand up for themselves and their cause. Without calculating his strength, the man gets involved in a risky enterprise. He is sure that the case is doomed to success and is preparing to act according to a preconceived, almost flawless plan. But in practice, everything goes wrong almost immediately. Wanting to help his weak brother, Mason enters into a confrontation with much more influential and dangerous people. A bank robbery turns into a game of survival, from which only one side can emerge victorious. At the same time, fate decides to remind him of the past in the form of his former lover, who acts as an interlocutor for the police in this situation.

title: To kill Mubarak / Congratulations, this is murder
description: There is a private club in Delhi, where an ordinary person cannot get into. Guest check-in is by invitation only, very well-to-do people arrive. Some want to relax with their family, while others come to be alone. In one of the evenings, a murder occurs, which forces the police to be called. Bhavani arrives in the next hour and starts inspecting the crime scene, there is nothing suspicious. The inspector goes through the property and finds out that there are no cameras here. You have to work the old-fashioned way and question everyone who is in the building. It takes almost a day, but many interesting facts appear. The main character suspects several people. The young guy attracts special attention, because he was the last one to see the murdered man, but he has defenders.

title: Invitation
description: Evie lost her mother, after which she was left alone. She does not know any other relatives and decides to take a DNA test. Thanks to this, the heroine finds her lost cousin, whose existence she did not suspect. Soon, the newly acquired family invites her to a wedding, which will take place in the English countryside. The heroine is seduced by a sexy aristocratic host, but gradually begins to realize that she has become involved in a deadly game, as some dark secrets of her family became known to her. We recommend watching the movie "The Invitation" (2022) in Ukrainian for fans of thrillers and horror films.

title: Night swim
description: Ray Waller was a member of Major League Baseball and loved his profession. The man married the beautiful Eve, who gave birth to his daughter Izzy and son Elliot. Everyone thought that the player had a great future, but his career ended due to an illness that suddenly became active. The degenerative disease disrupted the functions of the athlete's body and he began to struggle to return to his usual life. Having decided to move, the Waller family bought a private house with an abandoned swimming pool in the backyard for little money. The husband decided to repair it, because he secretly hoped to restore his own body to its former condition with the help of swimming. The husband told his wife that the children would benefit from swimming. Eve, worried about the state of her other half, went to meet him in this matter. The renovation of the pool required some effort and cash infusions, but when it was completed, everyone appreciated the opportunity to swim without leaving the home plot. Izzy has already found a friend and invited him to swim alone in the evening. The teenage girl's game with Ronin was fun until the young man suddenly disappeared. Soon, Ray's daughter realized that their family had awakened a terrible force, which betrayed the appearance of another victim.

title: Wanted
description: Travis Johansen is an experienced detective, but his work methods are increasingly causing scandals with management. After another case, a video of a policeman brutally beating a suspect went viral. To at least somehow restore the reputation, Chief Hernandez sends Travis on a special mission to Mexico. The disgraced detective will need to pick up two girls who witnessed the murder of two agents. They worked undercover, penetrating the very heart of the drug cartel. However, the task does not go according to plan when Johansen's car is ambushed. Witness Rosa, who survived, rescues the wounded detective and takes him to her brother's house. There, Travis learns the shocking truth: according to the girl, the killing of the agents was not a simple failure, but a planned tactic of the special services.

title: Mr. Clex's Academy
description: "Kleksa Academy" is a modernized version of the classic fairy tale by Jan Brzehva, which is addressed to children in terms of form and content, but can also interest older viewers who still remember the cult classic version of the 1980s. The film tells the story of a seemingly ordinary girl, Ada Nezgudka, who enters the Academy of the same name to explore the world of fairy tales, imagination and creativity. With the help of her crazy, gifted teacher, Professor Ambrosia Clex, she develops her unique abilities and stumbles upon a clue that will help her solve the family's biggest mystery...

title: Mother of the bride
description: The film "Mother of the Bride" is a comedy of generational errors. When Lana's daughter Emma returns from a year studying abroad in London, she surprises her mother: she is getting married. On the island. Next month! Things only get worse when Lana learns that the mysterious man who stole her daughter's heart turns out to be the son of the man who broke her heart years ago.

title: Driven in
description: After their boat sinks, a group of migrants find themselves in the hands of wealthy Europeans who offer them refuge on an attractive island. At first it seems like salvation, but paradise quickly turns into a nightmare. The rescuers' secret plan is revealed when they turn into ruthless human hunters, forcing the migrants to fight for survival in the harshest conditions.

title: Trap
