description: The plot of the film unfolds in the world of intelligence and special services. Skilled and experienced agent Louis, who performs his work flawlessly, interrogates a dangerous criminal in a secret location - a trap, in which his task is not only to obtain valuable information, but also to save the criminal's life in order to use him as bait for other dangerous criminals. But everything changes when unknown agents enter the trap and seek to eliminate the witness himself. Luis finds himself trapped in a safe house, becomes the main target and contagion guard of his own life and the life of a witness. Enjoy exciting chase scenes, unexpected plot twists and intense duels between the main character and mysterious agents.

title: Royal exclusive
description: The picture tells about the exclusive interview that Prince Andrew gave to the famous BBC presenter - Emily Maitlis. A member of the royal family of Great Britain talked about his relationship with a famous businessman from America - Jeffrey Epstein. The man was convicted of crimes of a sexual nature. After a frank conversation, a large-scale scandal broke out. Prince Andrew has been removed from the duties he previously performed as a member of the royal family. The film also tells the story of women - journalists, who for many years negotiated with representatives of Buckingham Palace in order to get a long-awaited interview. And how then the reputation of Prince Andrew collapsed, in particular, because of the relationship with Jeffrey Epstein, which he talked about during the conversation.

title: Curse of Baghead
description: In the old basement of the house lives an age-old werewolf witch who hides her face under a sack. It is under her power to give people the opportunity for two minutes to meet and talk with those who have gone to another world, assuming the appearance of any person from the world of the dead. However, breaking the two-minute rule triggers a sinister force ready to abduct the offender into the shadow world. Young Iris becomes connected to this evil influence when she inherits a house with a witch from her father. Now she has to control the sinister entity and unravel the mysteries before she herself becomes its victim.

title: Monkeyman
description: Forged on the merciless streets of Mumbai, Mankiman becomes an unstoppable force of vengeance willing to overcome any obstacle to avenge his family. His life balances between brutal underground battles, where masked fighters fight to the last breath for money, and work in a luxurious nightclub, a gathering place for the richest and most depraved. Plunging into this hidden world, Mankiman meets criminal bosses and corrupt politicians on his way, who parasitize the lives of ordinary people.

title: Butchers
description: At first glance, an ordinary family moves to a remote province. Many people go to such places to find peace and escape from the hustle and bustle of metropolises. But the heroes have their own plans, in which they do not initiate their few acquaintances. The thing is that they are real sadists who cruelly abuse their victims. They lure visiting tourists into their tents, and after torturing them, kill them and process them for meat. Will these monsters go unpunished, or will there be a person who can escape from captivity and tell about their atrocities?

title: Maze Runner: Trial by Fire
description: In the second part, Thomas, Teresa, Minho and the rest of the Gladers bravely run through the treacherous labyrinth, they realize that this was only preparation for a more difficult event. The bloodthirsty monsters living in the labyrinth and the insidious traps that the boys met at every step are no match for the test prepared for the boys by the secret organization VICE. This time, she sends teenagers to the sandy expanses of the impassable desert. The boys have to overcome the heat of the extreme conditions of a sandstorm. And these are far from all the obstacles that await the heroes in this area of ​​space. Obstacles await them, which require incredible dexterity, speed of reaction, cleverness and coordinated actions of all participants in the competition. There are no competitors here.

title: Agent-9: Do or die
description: A talented and purposeful agent, together with his team, decides to confront one dangerous group. She is also in the field of view of dangerous representatives of the authorities. Everything gradually turns out to be subordinated to one single important goal - it is necessary to establish a new world order. New developments are emerging on the side of Russia. More and more questions arise. However, the situation continues to escalate to the limit. And it will not be possible to avoid difficulties. The world is radically changing and it is worth being ready for existing changes. From this begins the time of the most incredible achievements. What awaits you next and what surprises will you have to face? One way or another, you will be able to find answers to all questions and understand what to do next.

title: Murders in the star town
description: An employee of the theater called the police station and reported that she had discovered the body of an unknown person. The investigation began, the examination established that the death was violent, however, the criminal used strange methods, which had not been encountered before. Sue deals with the case together with her assistants and understands that everyone's knowledge will be needed, the situation is too complicated. Over the next week, it was not possible to find out anything new, but another body with similar injuries was discovered. There were already three similar cases, all victims did not have similar external features and led different lifestyles. The main character assumed that the maniac had no motive, but was just having fun and wanted to challenge the detectives investigating him. A fourth corpse was reported, but this time it was the first clue. Now there is an opportunity to put the culprit in prison, but a terrible message comes from him.

title: Butchers 2: Raghorn
description: The spin-off of the movie "Butchers" in the style of horror will take the viewer to the cruel world of Raghorn, a universe of endless bloodthirsty abuse of people and flourishing cannibalism. The car accident became a real tragedy for the main characters, they became victims, finding themselves in the hands of cruel killers. Four men, former prisoners, kidnap a simple student for profit. They want to get a round sum for her from her parents as a ransom. Their goal is to travel to an American province to meet with their customer. Suddenly, a moose jumps onto the road and blocks their further path. Having broken the car, they were left without transport and go deep into the forest. They have no idea that in the thick of the forest, two inhuman psychopaths are waiting for them, who are aggressive, see profit in everyone who comes within their reach, and want to massacre all foreigners. They are armed with a rifle and a cleaver, they truly consider themselves invincible.

title: Parallel
description: A grief-stricken woman decides to move to try to cope with the loss of her son. With the support of her husband and his brother, she tries to regain her sense of normalcy, but a simple walk through the woods causes even more complications when she accidentally falls into a time loop.

title: Miller's favorite
description: A comedy-drama about a young, talented writer, Cairo Sweet, whose creative journey and relationship with her teacher lead to a series of complex personal and professional dilemmas. The film "Miller's Favorite" tells the story of Cairo Sweet, a young and gifted student writer, who receives an assignment from her mentor, an experienced Miller teacher, to write a literary project. This task becomes the catalyst for a series of events that further complicate their relationships and lives. Cairo, immersing herself in her work, begins to discover new aspects of her talent and personality, which leads to changes in her perception of the world and her own goals. The plot of the film covers both personal and professional dilemmas of the characters, exploring the boundaries between teaching ethics and personal feelings. Miller, in turn, begins to question his role in Cairo's life and the influence he has on her creative development. Their relationship turns into a complex network of emotional contradictions and unpredictable turns. The film touches on the themes of creativity, self-identification, as well as moral and ethical dilemmas in the relationship between a teacher and a student. With the development of the plot, the heroes are faced with a choice between their selfish aspirations and what they really value, which forces them to rethink their views on life. This film is a fascinating story about the complexity of human relationships and the influence of art on life.

title: The Three Musketeers: Milady
description: The brave provincial prevented a terrible court conspiracy, coped with the wiles of a cunning intriguer, and found friends in Paris. The Gascon hopes to rest after a tense fight, but soon faces a threat. Beloved Constantia falls into the clutches of merciless kidnappers, her fate remains unknown. From now on, the courageous musketeer has to seek support from an old enemy. The enigmatic, devious Milady de Winter waits impatiently for the moment when the boy comes crawling with pleas for help, because she also has a plan in her head to protect herself from trouble and loss in the future. The declared war can prevent the rescue of the captive, because Athos and his comrades must rush into the heat of battle. Porthos and Aramis are powerless to resist the order, and the king is under the control of the shrewd, skilled deceiver, Cardinal Richelieu. D'Artagnan is forced to turn to his allies for reinforcements to rescue Louis XIII from the nets of a ruthless puppeteer. Fighting for a noble cause, the allies risk falling into a cunningly laid trap, but valor and loyalty to the state will be their guide in the fight against enemies.

title: My beautiful wedding
description: After returning to Las Vegas, Abby and Travis often hit up loud parties or hit up all the local bars. One day, lovers suddenly find wedding rings on their hands. The guys suddenly remember that they got married last night. Of course, lovers are not going to part, and the best solution turns out to be a honeymoon trip. That is why they pack their bags, invite friends and relatives, and go on a romantic honeymoon in Mexico. Here, the partners want to celebrate the wedding on the shore of the clean sea and the most beautiful landscapes, but some events destroy all plans. Adhering to all marriage traditions, the newlyweds organize pre-wedding parties. While Travis is having fun with a hot boy, Abby is having an equally sassy bachelorette party. However, the fun time leads to unexpected consequences: instead of full confidence in their choice, the characters wonder if they got married too soon?

title: Split sky
description: Port and Keith Moresby, a young couple, embark on a journey to North Africa. Life brought them complete disappointments. The events of the Second World War also left their heavy mark. Together with their friend Tanner in 1947, they come to Tangier. Having parted with the usual benefits of civilization, they go to Morocco. Soon Port dies of typhus in a small French port in the middle of the Sahara. The cat is in complete despair and joins a caravan of Berbers, one of whom, Belkassim, soon becomes her lover and brings the woman to his native village. Kim finds herself in a difficult position, as she becomes a de facto slave of Belkassim and a constant object of abuse. The film "The Split Sky" (1990) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventure dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: Everything as you want
description: The threat of complete destruction by evil extraterrestrials looms over planet Earth and all of humanity as a whole. However, they give people in the person of the main character a last chance. The film "Anything you want" (2015) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedies and fantasy in Ukrainian live.

title: Without glaze
description: Comedy story based on real events. The confrontation between two product manufacturing companies is shown. There was a struggle for new ideas and leadership. Two firms were preparing to implement a product revolution. There will be only one winner. In 1963, they were leaders in the American food market. They decided to create a special cookie. Which will be possible to quickly heat up and eat. It remains to implement an interesting idea. Kellogg's had competitors. The Post organization also decided to make similar cookies. Whoever is the first to make it, will take the leading positions. Culinary novelty could make businessmen gilded. Everyone was aware of the importance of time. Competition at different levels. Industrial espionage. Owners' attempts to outwit competitors. Lots of humor and the most incredible characters. Comedy colors filled the film with light madness. In reality, food tycoons were fighting for their future. Only one of the companies achieves tremendous success.

title: School of Magical Animals: The Mystery of the Schoolyard
description: In a magical school where children learn the art of magic in the company of their magical talking companions, it is time to prepare for an important event - an anniversary. During this period, students have to face various difficulties and worries. However, ordinary problems take a back seat when strange events begin to happen at school - mysterious tunnels appear in the yard every night. Together with their faithful magical companions, the children must uncover a secret that is hidden deep underground. An exciting adventure opens before them, filled with dangers and amazing discoveries.

title: Neanderthal secrets
description: The science department at BBC Studios has created Neanderthal Mysteries, an exciting new documentary that tells the story of the new discoveries and advances in science that are leading us to a deeper understanding of our closest relatives. Neanderthals lived for over 300,000 years, but somehow they disappeared and we stayed. This archaeological adventure aims to understand how they were successful for so long and why they disappeared. It launches on Netflix on Thursday, May 2 worldwide.A few seasons in, they make a shocking discovery - a new body, "Shanidar Z." This is the first articulated Neanderthal skeleton found in the region in almost a quarter of a century. The film follows leading paleoanthropologist Dr. Emma Pomroy as she painstakingly excavates these precious remains and begins assembling them with a team in Cambridge.

title: Night strangers
description: The story of two strangers is an exciting picture that transports us to the amazing world of chance meetings and unexpected turns of fate. The main characters, Aymeric and Natalie, meet in a busy Paris metro, and no one could have guessed that this coincidence would turn their lives upside down. In just one night, these two strangers will go through a whole kaleidoscope of emotions and events, affecting important aspects of their own lives. Conversations about children, family, sex and coming of age turn out to be key factors, revealing the depth and complexity of human relationships. Both characters are faced with personal difficulties and choices, and this important evening becomes a turning point in their fate.

title: The ugly eight
description: The action of the film takes place in America after the Civil War. John Root is a legendary bounty hunter who was popularly nicknamed the "hangman". He is one of the best professionals in his field and always gets the job done. During the escorting of another prisoner, another bounty hunter approaches him, and soon all three are forced to hide from the snowstorm in one store located on the outskirts. A very motley company was already located here: a sheriff, a Frenchman, a cowboy, a general and a Mexican. Soon it turns out that one of the guests of the bench is not at all who he pretends to be. The film "The Despicable Eight" (2015) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers, westerns and dramas in Ukrainian.

title: Upgrade / Updated
description: Ana Santos is an ambitious intern at Erwins, an upscale New York art auction house. This venerable establishment is run by Claire, Ana's harsh boss, whose insufferably bitchy assistants Suzette and Renee are determined to make the woman's working life as unpleasant as possible. On her way to London for work, the eager-to-please Ana wants to impress her boss and earn herself a brilliant recommendation to open an art gallery in the future. At the airport, she learns that her heartless colleagues have deliberately reserved the most inconvenient seat for her. After witnessing such behavior, an understanding ticket agent transfers the girl to first class for free. In the waiting room, she meets charming William, who happens to be her neighbor on the plane. Claire's little white lie that she says she is the director of the Ervins leaves her in a bind. But after meeting with an eccentric actress, Willa's mother Catherine, the owner of a small collection of famous paintings, the heroine discovers that she has come to terms with deception.

title: Island of exiles / Hostages of the island
description: A married couple embarks on a long-awaited journey, which quickly turns into a real test. After a shipwreck, they end up on a deserted island near Antarctica, where the chances of survival are slim. They will have to face the forces of nature and wild animals, find food and shelter.

title: Dr. Doolittle 5
description: Abandoning her dream of becoming a veterinarian, Maya Doolittle and her faithful friend Lucky go to Hollywood to try their luck in this city, like everyone else. In Los Angeles, having an extraordinary ability to talk to animals, Travnia becomes the host of a show about animals, together with the popular Tiffany Monaco. And when Travnya despairs at the thought of being stuck in Hollywood forever, Lucky, his new girlfriend and a whole zoo come to the fore, barking, flapping their wings and stomping their hooves to save the day! The movie "Doctor Dolittle 5" (2009) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedy and fantasy films.

title: Dr. Doolittle 4: The tail equation
description: Maya grew up. She became a kind and sweet teenage girl who experiences serious difficulties in communicating with her peers. And all because of the opportunity to talk with animals that were passed down to her from her father. Parents claim that there is nothing wrong with this. But her classmates clearly consider her abnormal. No matter how she tries to hide her talent, animals often turn to her and incidents occur because of this. To give the daughter a break and relax, dad and mom send her to their friends who live on their own farm. Here the girl tries to behave differently, not to reveal her capabilities. She worries that the boys she met will also start to think she's crazy. However, the residents of the ranch quickly understood who they could talk to about everyday matters. She made many new friends. And then Maya learns about the impending trouble. Hospitality hosts can lose everything, and only a young girl will be able to help them. The movie "Doctor Dolittle 4: The Tail" (2006) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedy and fantasy films.

title: Dr. Doolittle 3
description: Dr. Doolittle's daughter Maya unexpectedly discovers her father's talent - the ability to talk to animals. Looking for herself, she goes to the ranch of her parent's friend, where she makes friends with the local fauna. And when the girl finds out that the owners of the neighboring land encroach on the property of the owner who sheltered her, Maya turns to her new friends for help. The movie "Doctor Dolittle 3" (2006) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedies about animals.

title: Dr. Doolittle 2
description: The plot of the comedy film "Doctor Doolittle 2" again tells about the life of Dr. John Doolittle, who has the gift of understanding and talking to animals. This time, the doctor had the difficult task of becoming a family consultant and a sexologist in one person. He needs to help the brown bear establish an intimate life with his bear girlfriend. The matter is not simple because the bear has lived most of his life in the circus, and he has only heard about the wild nature and has no idea how to behave with a free girl. The movie "Doctor Doolittle 2" (2001) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedy and family films.

title: Dr. Doolittle
description: The comedy film "Doctor Doolittle" tells a funny story that happened to an ordinary city dweller. Dr. John Doolittle feels great in this life: he has a beautiful loving wife, good children, an excellent career as a doctor and a beautiful house. A great deal with partners is planned at work, but John has awakened a gift that he had as a child. And this gift consists in the ability to understand and speak the language of animals. Having thus cured one animal, everyone in need began to turn to Dr. Doolittle, chasing him and demanding help. John's life turns into a real circus! The movie "Doctor Doolittle" (1998) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of comedy and fantasy films.

title: Spider's lair
description: The main character lives in a residential complex in a French suburb. This building seems to have been forgotten by the authorities and neglected by the institutions. Here, the electricity is often cut off, the elevator almost never works, and the lights are never fixed. In addition, there was some ominous slime-like substance on the landing that no one cared about. Caleb's whimsical neighbors contribute to the development of the plot. Among them is Caleb's older sister, with whom he has a good relationship due to the death of his mother, an annoying drug addict, a kind old woman and several children. Caleb makes a house for Rihanna from a shoe box, cutting a small hole in it. As expected, Rihanna needed just that. The spider climbs out of its home and lays eggs - a huge number of heirs. In just a few hours, one spider turns Caleb's house into an abode of unspeakable horrors with a colony of spiders. The main problem is that Rihanna is not an ordinary spider. It can kill a person with a single bite and multiply to thousands in an instant.

title: Exhumation
description: After a series of supernatural occurrences, a wealthy family living in Los Angeles hires two shamans, Hvarim and Bon Gil, to save their newborn child. Upon arrival, Hvarim feels that the dark shadow of the ancestor has attached itself to the family. To excavate the grave and free the ancestor, Hvarim enlists the help of top-class geomancer San Dok and undertaker Yeon Geun. An ominous energy begins to emanate from the excavated grave. Exhumation entails terrible consequences.

title: Flora and son
description: Single mother Flora is ready to do anything to provide her only beloved son Max with everything he needs and give him the best childhood. In search of a suitable hobby for a boy, she accidentally discovers a guitar thrown by someone in the backyard. Just wanting to give her son an opportunity to test his musical ability, she unknowingly puts the real key to success in the hands of the teenager. The boy turns out to be a born musician with a perfect ear and a talent for songwriting. This is how he finds not only an outlet and passion, but also his life's vocation, and later he decides to assemble his own group and record the first debut album just in the home kitchen.

title: American literature
description: Thelonious "Monk" Ellison is a black college professor with mixed teaching methods and a writer with insufficiently interesting novels that do not attract publishers. Forced to take a break from teaching, Monk returns home to Massachusetts, where he bumps into Sinatra, a popular, privileged writer who made a name for herself with a novel about black people. Inspired by the gang movie and Sinatra's story, Ellison begins work on a new novel, in which the plot consists of an intentionally demeaning story about black life. Unexpectedly, the novel attracts the attention of influential publishers...

title: Pump up your health: Secrets of the gut
description: If ever there was a "star gut doctor," it must be Julia Enders. She is the face of this documentary, a German scientist who studies and writes extensively about the gut, and the aforementioned user of the word "scratch," which sounds a little funny because of her accent. The use of this word helps set the tone for Secrets of Your Gut, which is not without its inherent and undeniable comedic bathroom humor. In fact, one of the various gut scientists who appear in this film uses the phrase "populate" when discussing a new treatment for gut bacteria called "faecal microbiome transplantation." However, puns and the like don't necessarily detract from the seriousness of the film's main theme, which is four people struggling with familiar and understandable gut-related health issues (and not at all understandable, but still objectively fascinating). So we have Maya, a Michelin star who struggles with anorexia and feels lousy if she eats anything but vegetables and supplements, which means she can't even eat her own treats, like this crazy macaroon-covered tower cake. Daniella is a psychology student whose poor diet choices have left her dealing with a host of digestive issues; now she can only eat about 15 different foods that don't cause her pain. Kimmy's situation is familiar to many - she has been diagnosed with "morbid obesity" and is unable to lose weight despite various diets, exercises and medications. And then there's a guy you've probably heard of, Kobayashi, a world-renowned competitive eater who devoured inhuman amounts of hot dogs, slices of pizza, etc., and now, perhaps to some people's surprise, is no longer hungry and worried that his highly specialized career has taken a toll on his body.

title: Monster hunt 2
description: Uba is the secret heir to the entire monster kingdom and the subject of a prophecy in which he is recognized as a long-awaited unifying force meant to restore equality between humans and their monster brethren. Things are looking up for the hero because no one is trying to kill him, but he misses his human mom and dad, who have made a difficult decision. In their opinion, Uba should live with his people in the Land of Monsters because it is dangerous for him in the human realm. The hero lived happily in the forest, where the monsters built a small village for themselves, a place of laughter and songs, where everyone is happy and everyone can dance happily all night. This continues until evil monsters reappear in search of Uba, destroying the village and forcing him to flee to the human world. Meanwhile, Tianyin and Xiaolan search for Tianyin's long-lost father, a famous monster hunter. Both heroes do not want to admit how much they miss little Ube, and dream of returning to the Land of Monsters for him. In his search for Tianyin and Xiaolan, Uba joins a very odd pair of random heroes, the rogue Tu and his monster sidekick Benben.

title: On the edge of the blade
description: Paris at the end of the 19th century, 1887 - an era of romanticism, art, science, but also strict social and honor. At this time, when a person's word and his honor were valued above all else, a duel was considered an act of courage, but also a necessity to protect one's name. Clément Lacaze, a charismatic and unsurpassed swordsman, became a legend thanks to his skill with the sword. His life was a story of countless victories in a fair fight, but the new law, which forbids him to participate in duels, cast a shadow over his future. Marie-Rose Asti de Walser, a brilliant and strong-willed representative of high society, also faced injustice. Being a woman in a world where rights were defined by gender, she had no opportunity to challenge her abuser to a duel and restore justice. Fate brought together Clément and Marie-Rose, two people who seek revenge, but are deprived of the right to decisive action. However, by joining forces, they found a way to bypass social restrictions and principles of honor at the time. Using his unique knowledge and skills, Clément taught Marie-Rose the art of swordsmanship, and she, in turn, helped him find loopholes in the laws that allowed him to summon duels through intermediaries or even arrange secret meetings outside the jurisdiction of the Parisian authorities. In the course of their collaboration, something more than just friendship developed between Clément and Marie-Rose. They discovered qualities in each other that they had not paid attention to before, finding common interests and views on life. Love, which had eluded them for a long time, finally found its way to their hearts. With each duel, each swordsmanship lesson, and each general challenge, their feelings deepened. They learned not only to trust each other on the battlefield, but also to open up to each other, sharing their innermost thoughts and dreams.

title: Agent game / Agent games
description: A dynamic thriller of 2022 that immerses the viewer in the world of espionage and covert operations. The main character is an experienced agent who faces a new challenge – to expose betrayal in the ranks of his own agency. High stakes and danger around every corner make his mission nearly impossible. As a result of the investigation, the hero reveals not only other people's secrets, but also confronts his own demons. The struggle for trust and the search for the truth turns into a series of betrayals and unexpected turns.

title: Hypnotist
description: The main character investigates crimes. Once there are several bank robberies in the city, and the authorities task him with finding the culprits. However, when Rourke begins his duties and begins to unravel this case, he quickly comes to an unexpected conclusion. Some time ago, the detective's daughter disappeared, and now he understands that her disappearance is connected to this series of robberies. The hero is trying to find his child and hopes that this will shed light on his latest investigation. We recommend watching the movie "Hypnotic" (2023) in Ukrainian for fans of crime thrillers and science fiction.

title: Burial
description: Jeremy is an elderly man who owns his own funeral home. Just yesterday, the business brought good money to the hero, but the sudden appearance of a competitor turns everything upside down. Jeremy faces an unequal battle with the corporate giant, due to which the man loses a huge number of deals. Soon the office has to be closed, which awakens the protagonist's thirst for revenge. To achieve justice, he turns to a well-known but somewhat eccentric lawyer for help. This is how the boys find themselves in a tangled story woven of corruption, deception and total lies. It seems that there is simply no chance of victory, but the partners still gather their strength and enter the fight against the huge system. Will they be able to cope with the richest people in the country and not lose all chances for a normal life?

title: Lucky numbers
description: Russ Richards is a meteorologist and local celebrity in a small town in Pennsylvania. However, the hero's reputation and financial situation are threatened by an excessively warm winter. The fact is that Russ recently opened a snowmobile shop, confident that it will pay off quickly. And the fraud with the insurance on the advice of Grig's friend generally enrolls the failed businessman in the debtors of the criminal authority. In order to at least somehow deal with the situation that has developed, Russ agrees to Grig's new adventure. The boys are attracted to the meteorologist girlfriend Krystal, who cheats on the lottery numbers.

title: Tear maker
description: After a difficult experience in an orphanage, Nika and Rigel accidentally find themselves in the same foster family. Gradually, they realize that there are special feelings between them that are difficult to ignore. Having met in a new environment, they begin to understand that they are attracted to each other.

title: The Anti-Social Network: Memes and Chaos
description: For better or for worse, The Anti-Social Network doesn't seem to be pointing fingers, almost taking the position that the unchecked power that 4chan wielded was doomed to corruption, and therefore we shouldn't blame any of the people caught in the web. Including one of the interviewees is taken off the hook in terms of personal responsibility in a way that can be frustrating. These people still made their choice. Much of the activity on 4chan may not have created giant rifts in society in 2024, it certainly didn't help by amplifying garbage like Pizzagate in the actual national debate. Yes, Anonymous has brought attention to issues like privacy and income inequality, but the cavalcade of conspiracy theories and outright lies for clicks has dumbed down the country, no longer knowing what is true in a world where so many people believe Q exists.

title: Bob Marley: One Love
description: A unique journey into the world of a musical genius who transformed the world with his vision of love and unity. Discover the fascinating story of Bob Marley on the big screen, where every chord, every word, every step is a stepping stone on the way to musical greatness, connected with life and its incomparable magic. Immerse yourself in the world of the fascinating musical legend with the film "Bob Marley: One Love 2024". This emotional and moving film reveals the story of the greatest reggae artist of all time through the lens of his music and life's trials. From young years to world fame, you will witness the ups and downs, joys and pains that accompanied him on his way to recognition. "One Love 2024" is not just a story about a musician, it is a look at the true essence of a person who changed the world with his music and sense of unity.

title: Irish desire
description: Maddie, who dreams of her boyfriend, is faced with a difficult situation when she finds out that he is going to marry her best friend. At first, she tries to suppress her feelings in order to support the bride at the wedding, but soon realizes that this is impossible. While visiting an ancient stone in Ireland, she makes a wish and suddenly her fate begins to change. The magic of the stone begins to work, and Maddy finds herself in an unusual situation where she is given a chance to change the course of events. She understands that she has the opportunity to influence her future and decides to take advantage of this chance. In this new turn of events, Maddy faces many difficulties, but she is willing to go through all the difficulties to find her true happiness.

title: Sixty minutes
description: An experienced fighter faces a crucial choice in his career and personal life. Deciding to give up a key match to attend his daughter's birthday, he unexpectedly finds himself embroiled in a conflict with dangerous people from the world of martial arts. Having fallen into the path of powerful enemies, he risks not only his career, but also the safety of his family. In an effort to retain custody of his daughter and provide her with protection from an imminent threat, the fighter is forced to choose between duty and love, facing serious consequences of his decision.

title: Melancholy
description: The first part will be about Justine's wedding. She is not impressed by the celebration and therefore neither her relatives nor guests understand her. In the second part, the character Claire, who is Justine's sister, begins to care for her sister, who develops clinical depression. At the same time, she feels fear from reports that the mysterious planet Melancholia is approaching. As the planet approaches, the sisters switch roles. Now Claire is so panicked that she needs care herself. Desperate, they have already prepared to accept the inevitable.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's
description: The main character found himself in a difficult financial situation and agrees to any job. Somehow he gets his hands on an advertisement for a vacancy for a night guard in a family pizzeria. The position seems quite suitable for him, and Mike Schmidt gets a new job. However, the very first night spent at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza gives him an unpleasant surprise. It turns out that at this time of the day, all the mascot characters come to life. They behave completely unfriendly to people and are ready to destroy anyone who is in their territory. Mike and his daughter, whom he so recklessly took with him on the very first day of his duty, will have to make every effort to get out of here alive.

title: Ash
description: Ashes are what is left of the bright flame with which people burned during life" - so began the mysterious novel, accidentally found by Gyukche on the desk of a writer husband who owns his own publishing company. Her life was like a fairy tale. Many years ago, her husband created a small firm, not knowing that many influential investors would be interested in it, and now they lived in a luxurious country house with a huge swimming pool and they were raising a little daughter. Hyukche was completely happy, but she did not think that her curiosity would soon turn into tragic consequences. Turning one page after another, she immersed herself in a strange reality full of unanswered questions, and after reading the lion's share of the manuscript, she was ready to take a fatal step beyond the very border that divided the human world into two realities.

title: A love story in Soweto
description: A Soweto Love Story boasts a star-studded cast including Duduzile Ngcobo as Bongekile, Lunga Shabalala as Sandile, Sparky Zulu as Menzie and Ray Neo Buso as Skye. The film tells the story of a mother who, deeply rooted in her faith, wants her three sons to settle down in a family. When her sons remain unmarried for a long time, she takes matters into her own hands. She challenges them: whoever gets married first will inherit the family home. As the sons compete for their mother's approval, they also race against time to prove they deserve the family home.

title: Puppet animation
description: Suzanne Black is a puppeteer animator who is preparing her latest film for release. Only the arthritis that affected the woman's hand does not allow her to work normally. Therefore, she is forced to involve her daughter Ella in the work. The girl openly declares that she has too much work and simply cannot cope with it, but her mother insists that Ella help her. Suzanne suddenly has a stroke and ends up in the hospital. All the work on the film should be finished by Ella. Although she does not have a burning desire to do this. But, there is no choice. The girl's lover offers her to move in with him, but she refuses this idea. To continue working on the film, she moves to another apartment, where she meets an extraordinary girl. The neighbor, having learned what Ella does, decides to give her advice on a new scenario. She frankly believes that the story that Ella is filming is banal and boring. It would be more interesting if she filmed about a girl who got lost in the forest.

title: Shirley: The Fight for the White House
description: The events are unfolding in 1972, soon the next election for the post of the president of the USA will begin. Women have never run for office, but Shirley Chisholm decides to change that and runs for office. She has been in Congress for a long time and has been fighting injustice. Rich people take advantage of their position and enjoy life while the poor look for a way to feed their children. The main character wants to build more factories and make it possible for ordinary workers to earn so that they do not need products and basic necessities. Holds several meetings, the number of fans is growing rapidly. Previously, competitors did not perceive it as a real threat, but now they understand that they were very mistaken. They plan to ruin Shirley's reputation, but she is ready to go to the end.

title: Dune: Part Two
description: A brave young man goes to the expanses of a distant planet to observe local events and understand the peculiarities of the population. The descendant of the great Atreides dynasty has no idea how dangerous and unpredictable the terrain of Arrakis remains for an unprepared foreigner. The desert area teems with strange animals, treacherous predators. The sands also hide the desired substance, which gives the owner almost miraculous properties. Thanks to the melange, you can push the limits of consciousness, get rid of oppressive pain, fatigue, and fly to any distance through the universe. The guest gradually discovers the charms of staying in a wonderful region, gets to know the charming Chani, understands her wise teachings and advice. The guest intends to become one with the Fremen. The people of the region inspire admiration and respect in a foreigner. The old-timers revere the new ally, see him as a true deputy, able to prevent bloody wars, protect from disaster, suffering and attacks by mad rebels. Understanding the intricacies of political intrigue, Paul tries to effectively fulfill the mission assigned to him.

title: Henry Poole is here
description: The story of a man who learns that he has only six weeks left to live. Henry Pool had a comfortable life and a charming bride until he visited the doctor's office, where he already learned about a terrible diagnosis. The film "Henry Pool is here" (2019) will be liked by all fans of dramatic comedies in Ukrainian.

title: Troy
description: It already happened in the ancient world that all great wars started because of fatal women. The king of Troy, Paris, encroached on the beautiful Helen, the wife of the ruler of Sparta, Menelaus. The man simply kidnapped the beauty. King Agamemnon decides to intercede for his brother's honor. He had long dreamed of taking an impregnable fortress, which no one had ever conquered in history. And here is such a great reason. He gathers an army led by the fearless Achilles, who according to legends is considered immortal. The siege of the city lasted more than ten years. In this futile and senseless war, many warriors were left lying on the battlefield. Meanwhile, the great nation was forced to accept its fatal end and go down in history.

title: I love to hate you
description: The main character of the movie Who's Good But You is a pretty young girl named Bea who hates her boyfriend Ben. Antipathy unites young people. And before they loved, and they had a wonderful date. The world is imperfect and sometimes unfair. What happened and became the reason for the appearance of scattered roaches. They did not meet for a long time, until they appeared at a wedding celebration in distant Australia, at which the side was present. In front of them, the couple will have to pretend to be in love. They master their fate perfectly, smiling at those around them and walking hand in hand despite the fact that they feel nothing but burning hostility. Friends gradually change. They get into the most interesting and ridiculous situations. All this becomes a certain catalyst. A ray of hope for the emergence of a new mutual friendship begins to shine on the horizon. Perhaps the fire of true love, which shines with charm, will flare up very quickly.

title: Argyle
description: A woman named Ellie Conway is a famous sandbag who prefers a factory lifestyle. She became popular after the publication of a series of books about the espionage work of one super-preparatory special agent. She herself likes to spend her time in solitude, working at the computer. The girl's company consists only of her favorite pet - a thick cat named Alfie. One day, the literary woman learns that there is much more truth in her works about an agent with a call sign than her fantasy. In the books, the spy was on a mission to uncover the activities of a global spy syndicate. A man who calls himself Aiden appears in Ellie's life. He claims to be a spy who must protect the woman from a possible kidnapping or murder. As a result, the heroine, together with cute animals, find themselves involved in an amazing adventure story with incredible plot twists, difficult tests and different. The woman could not imagine how her usual life could change. For a certain period of time, the spy suffered from amnesia, completely forgetting his own skills and abilities. When the memory returns, he wants to report to an organization called "The Unit".

title: No pressure
description: Olivia, an experienced chef from the big city, finds herself in a difficult situation when she is tricked into giving up everything and returning to her grandmother's farm. It is necessary to save the farm from financial collapse and closure, which is not so easy, given her love for city life and profession. Gradually, Olivia begins to get used to life on the farm, understanding the value of family traditions and working on the land. In the process, she meets a mysterious and attractive farmer who has a secret that could change everything. As Olivia immerses herself in the rural atmosphere and faces the challenges of farming, she also begins to unravel the secret of the handsome farmer. This secret could affect not only her future, but also the fate of the entire farm and their relationship.

title: Rest in peace
description: This film is a poignant portrayal of a man's desperate struggle to keep his family afloat amidst enormous financial problems. The action takes place in Buenos Aires in 1994. Sergio Dayan finds himself caught in a web of debt and deceit as he tries to protect his loved ones from the harsh reality of their dire circumstances. Meanwhile, Sergio is torn between the desire to provide for his family and the crushing burden of his financial obligations. Despite his best efforts to keep it a secret from his family, he faces the threat of losing everything he holds dear. As Sergio's debt continues to grow, he is forced to make difficult decisions and face the consequences of his actions. He has not been able to pay the workers at his factory for several months, leading to their discontent. Tensions come to a head at his daughter Florencia's kinovibe.co bar mitzvah, where he comes face to face with the ruthless consequences of his relationship with Hugo Brenner, the head of a local loan firm from which he borrowed a huge sum. Sergio's wife, Estela, is always by his side, offering support and understanding in the face of enormous difficulties. The turning point in this story is the explosion of a bomb targeting the Jewish community. This throws the Diane family further into chaos when Sergio goes missing. A deeply shocked Estela arrives at the scene in search of her husband, but his body is nowhere to be found. After some time, he is declared dead, but Estela continues to hope for his return. But no matter what, she has to accept the life insurance left by her husband.

title: Woody the woodpecker goes camping
description: Woody, a restless and energetic woodpecker, faces an unexpected challenge when he is forced to leave his native woods. This forces him to go in search of a new place to live, where he could settle down and start over. His adventures lead him to Woo-Hoo's camp, which seems like the perfect haven for a misfit like Woody. Convinced that he has found the perfect place for a new home, he sets about setting things up with enthusiasm, unaware of the impending obstacles. However, his dreams of a peaceful life at Camp Wu-Hoo are quickly shattered when it becomes clear that the place is under threat of closure due to the actions of a mysterious inspector. In the process, Woody not only makes new friends, but also learns resilience and perseverance, showing that even in the most difficult situations, you can find a way out if you don't give up.

title: Zoo
description: Young Tom and his friends are trying their best to save animals from the local Belfast zoo, which was hit by German bombers in 1941. The movie "Zoopark" (2017) will be enjoyed by all fans of military and historical dramas.

title: Underground / Underground
description: The plot of the film tells us a story that began during the Second World War. We see on the screen the main character Mark, who is creating his underground enterprise for the production of weapons. Prudent and intelligent, Mark convinced all the workers, including his friend, that the war was still going on. And they, hoping that their work was not in vain, continued to produce weapons even after fifty years, at a time when Mark was already living in luxury. But the moment came when the workers began to suspect something was wrong, and they decided to leave the underground "asylum" in which they had spent so many years.

title: Paying for fear
description: An oil well unexpectedly catches fire in the middle of the desert in the Middle East, endangering a nearby refugee camp. Oil company experts conclude that the only way to extinguish the fire is to blow up the well with a large amount of explosives, which must be done in less than 24 hours. Four intrepid mercenary adventurers, who have received a generous reward, undertake to deliver two trucks with nitroglycerin to the site of the explosion. The protagonists must overcome 800 kilometers of hostile territory strewn with minefields and controlled by armed insurgents.

title: Great game
description: Mel, a living legend of English football and a former star of the London club "West Ham United", has been leading the team of homeless football players of England for the 12th year in a row. To increase the chances of victory, before sending the coach includes an arrogant, but extremely talented attacker named Vinny in the team. The latter, for his part, must come to terms with his difficult past and learn to be part of the team.

title: Bloodrain
description: The story takes place in Romania at the beginning of the 18th century. Rein is a child born between a vampire and a human with extraordinary abilities. It contains the power of immortality and the human soul at the same time. The girl is half vampire, but she can live without drinking blood. Raine is the daughter of the vampire leader Kagan, who raped her mother and later killed her in front of her daughters. Orphaned, she finds refuge in a traveling circus. For a long time she lived without knowing who she really was. Until she tasted blood. Her next victims were vampires, as she could not kill humans for their blood. Kegan begins to gather a powerful army to exterminate people. To gain immense power, he must collect three talismans of Beliar, the ancestor of vampires. They will help to resist the main weaknesses of the vampire: water, sunlight and crucifixion. When vampire hunters belonging to the Brimstone clan learn of Raine's existence, they decide to persuade her to become a member of their faction, since only she has the power to kill the king.

title: Angels and Demons
description: The universe is in unbearable anticipation of the completion of the ancient ceremony - the election of the Pope, but the mighty power of Angels and Demons, who are the enemy of the Catholic Church, intervenes. This is some kind of Illuminati order, whose representatives are very mysterious individuals. Candidates for the post are subjected to merciless persecution, great danger threatens the entire Vatican, so they have to turn to Professor Robert Langdon for help. He is an experienced specialist in religious symbols, soon he is looking for evidence of the revival of the strongest secret brotherhood, exterminated in the Middle Ages. Together with his charming partner Victoria, Robert starts an investigation that takes him into the labyrinths of crypts, dungeons, and ancient temples. Scientists are gradually moving towards the solution, they discover many shocking facts, they are forced to face mystical scary phenomena.

title: The Da Vinci Code
description: In the center of the plot of the film "The Da Vinci Code" is Robert Langdon, a famous and influential professor specializing in symbolism. Having vast experience, he receives an invitation to the Louvre, where the curator of the museum was killed in cold blood. It turns out that before his death he managed to leave a message encrypted using the Fibonacci sequence. And now, in order to decipher its content, the police captain invites Robert to study the crime scene. At the same time, Sophie, a talented cryptologist and the granddaughter of the murdered man, appears with them. She is also invited to decipher a mysterious message. Sophie informs Robert that he is on the list of prime suspects because his name is marked in the last record of the deceased. She helps him hide from the pursuit of the police, as she is sure that he will be able to solve the mystery of his grandfather's death. Putting their lives in danger, the main characters of the film "The Da Vinci Code", which you can watch online right now on our website, continue their investigation. They soon discover a secret society that guards an ancient secret capable of changing the way people view human history.

title: Michael Kolhaas / Michael Kolgas
description: The action of the film takes place in the sixteenth century and tells about Michael Kohlhaas - a great horse trader who lives with his family in the mountainous area of ​​France. He was always a noble and honest person who never did harm to other people, but one day his life changed dramatically. One day he bought new horses and had to bring them across the border to drive to his farm. It is here that he faces huge problems, and completely illegally disposes of his property. An attempt to deal with this legally did not bring any results, and then he gathered his own army, with the help of which he began to fight for justice... The film "Michael Kolhaas / Michael Kolgas" (2013) will be enjoyed by all fans of historical dramas in Ukrainian.

title: Confused Hanna / Confused Anna
description: The premiere of the film took place on August 24, 2007. True fans of this genre will appreciate the beautiful design and execution of the film. The plot of the film: the main character named Anna is an artist, she is twenty-one years old, she lives on the shore of the island in a cave with her father. Everything was fine and flowing until her paintings were noticed by the Frenchwoman Justine, who tried to persuade Anna to move to the mainland. After moving to the city, the main character finds a new gift in herself: she can keep the memories of many women who lived in different eras and who died violently at the age of twenty-two. Hanna manages to immerse herself in hypnosis and go to the past, where she finds out that all those girls are her... The film "Bentezhna Hanna / Bentezhna Anna" (2007) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedies, detectives and dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: What did Jennifer do?
description: The feature-length documentary explores a brutal crime that rocked a quiet Canadian town. Through footage of police interrogations and testimony from those involved, What Jennifer Did unravels "a web of complications that no one expected." In November 2010, Jennifer Pen called the police and said she was at home when gunmen broke into her home with her parents, tied her up, shot her parents, and fled. As police investigated the shocking crime, they soon it turned out that Jennifer Pen knew more than was initially thought.

title: Future
description: In 2011, we were able to see a new creation by director Miranda Julai. This 37-year-old writer, actress and director conquered the Cannes Film Festival with her debut film a few years ago. Her new picture turned out to be no less interesting and spectacular. By the way, the script was written by Julai herself. The film was shot with the help of American and German cinematographers. The picture leads viewers to think about the nature of time and its connection with fate. A real high-quality drama was released, watching which is unlikely to cheer you up, but it will definitely make you think about a lot of things. A few words about the development of the plot of the picture. One happy couple decides on a reckless act. Having met a homeless cat once, they decide to shelter the poor cat in their house. Now they will have to pass a test of faith in each other. Their lives change, and the couple is forced to constantly undergo strength tests.

title: Robbery in Italian
description: John Bridges is the head of a criminal group specializing in robberies. Now John is going to his last case and contacts his friends and colleagues to discuss all the details of the upcoming robbery. Charlie - a good friend of John and a real generator of ideas in their team, develops a plan for an operation to seize a large batch of gold bars. The robbery is just brilliant, according to pre-planned actions, but soon everything changes. One of the team members, Steve, turns out to be a traitor and decides to take over the entire batch of gold. But the surviving members of the team join forces and, together with the daughter of the murdered John, prepare for a new robbery and revenge on Steve.

title: Informant
description: Mark Whitaker is a promising employee of a large agro-industrial corporation. In the production of the main character of "Informator!" some problems arise, and he decides to save his skin by becoming an informant for the FBI. The film "The Informant" (2009) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers.

title: Scammers Dick and Jane have fun
description: Dick Harper and his young wife Jane are used to a good and secure life. But at the moment when they decided to complete the swimming pool in the yard of their luxurious house, the company in which Dick worked went bankrupt, all their savings were burned, and the Harpers were left with no means of subsistence. No matter how hard Dick tried to make money, nothing came of it. And when there were only 24 hours left until the family was evicted from the house for non-payment of fees, Dick and Jane decided to go on a crime spree.

title: Perfect voice
description: Thanks to various television shows, people get to know more and more new talents, and young people begin to get excited about choreography and vocals, creating new groups. Beca Mitchell enrolled at Barden University. She dreams of working at one of the record companies in Los Angeles and is passionate about writing music. The girl clearly does not sympathize with various student fraternities and clubs, but falls into the sphere of interests of one of the women's groups. The fact is that Beka has a beautiful voice, and the women's team really needs a new soloist. The members of the group are doing everything they can to lure her into the team, because they have an annual competition at the competition of young performers...

title: There are no fools
description: Careerist Danica wants to find a guy who would meet her long list of requirements - with a six-figure salary, no children and problems with the law and drugs. She believes that Charlie is the right person for this role - a wonderful man whom she met on the Internet, but has not yet met in real life. When her crazy younger sister Tanya is released from prison, Danika allows her grieving relative to stay with her until she gets back on her feet. The more down-to-earth and practical Tanya quickly finds out that Charlie is not who he pretends to be and tries to protect her sister from a dangerous relationship...

title: My girlfriend is a robot
description: Arian, who has always dreamed of finding the perfect woman for a serious relationship, suddenly finds that his dream is coming true in the person of Sifra, a mysterious and beautiful girl he met during a business trip to the United States. Their mutual attraction seems destined, and Arian is quickly consumed by this new and exciting feeling, certain that Syfra is the one he has been looking for for so long. Their relationship develops quickly, filling Arian's life with joy and anticipation of a happy future. However, Arian's dreams are on the verge of destruction when he is faced with a harsh reality: their ideal romance has no chance of existing in the real world. As the truth about Sifru and the limitations she carries slowly unfolds before him, it forces him to rethink not only their relationship, but the very possibility of finding a perfect partner. This experience turns into a profound lesson for Arian about life and love, emphasizing that true happiness often lies not in the pursuit of perfection, but in embracing imperfection and finding beauty in unexpected places.

title: Tangerines
description: The action of the film takes place in a small village in which Estonian immigrants lived in 1992. At the beginning of the Abkhazian war, most of the inhabitants left these places, and only a few remained in their native land: the owner of the mandarin grove, Markus, doctor Yuhan, and the owner of the container workshop, Ivo. The war gradually spread to this place, a battle between Georgians and Abkhazians took place in the village. The battle ended and the armed militants left the village, leaving many corpses on its land, among which Marcus and Ivo found the remains of the Chechen mercenary Ahmed, who is fighting on the side of the Abkhazians. They gave him first aid and took him home to Ivo, and they themselves decided to bury the remaining dead soldiers. After some time, they manage to find one more survivor, he turned out to be a young Georgian named Nika. They took the wounded man to Ivo's house, where they provided him with the necessary assistance. But can two people who were not long ago the worst enemies, ready to kill each other, get along under the same roof?

title: Life or something
description: "You will die next Thursday." Of course, it was possible to pay absolutely no attention to this prediction of the homeless soothsayer. Only he guessed that there would be hail in the morning and even with what score one football match would end. And this means that in exactly one week you will die... most likely. Correspondent Lenny was not at all lucky, because it was she who was addressed by this phrase of the mysterious homeless fortune-teller. Lenny wants to live a long time, she has a boyfriend that she probably loves. Only if there is only a week left to live, then all this is now completely unimportant? You have to do something, because you can probably change your life. Or not?

title: Love with the risk of life / Love with the risk of life
description: Jimmy Pritchard is a seventy-five-year-old man who has spent most of his life fighting crime. However, the years took their toll and he was dismissed from the post of sheriff. All he has left in his life is an adult son, for whom he is ready to do a lot. However, the old man does not want to stress him with his problems, so he decides to live separately. He came to his son's house for his things while he was not at home. Not even suspecting that he would meet his death there, at the hands of an armed robber. Jimmy lived a long life, but despite this, he has an opportunity for a second, new life. A group of scientists resurrects an old man. He becomes a kind of copy of Frankenstein and receives not only great strength, but also youth. Now he is trying to do everything possible to find out who killed him and what caused it? But he does not have much time, because his son's life is in mortal danger ...

title: Flaming sky
description: Leon is a talented writer to whom inspiration suddenly comes. He decides to change the situation and go to a country house, where a calm and peaceful atmosphere always prevails. The husband's plans are unexpectedly disrupted. He cannot concentrate in any way, although the constant noise and twilight remain in his native Berlin. In a small town on the shore of the Baltic Sea, it is always calm and sunny, but nothing evokes strong emotions in Leon. The house is owned by the parents of Felix - the creator's best friend. Usually you don't meet anyone in the mansion, but his old friend comes for the holidays. A frivolous girl wants to know absolutely everything about Leon's future romance. With her questions, she prevents him from concentrating on work. Forest fires interfere with young people's plans. They ignite with new power and become closer and closer. Friends find themselves in a fiery trap from which it is almost impossible to get out. It is necessary to learn to act in a team to increase the chances of rescue.

title: Warlock
description: 350 years ago, Catherine Miller, a witch from New England, managed to free her daughter from the power of a demonic warlock. In order to gain immortality, he needed the blood and soul of Catherine's daughter, and she herself would forever become the Bride of Darkness. The sorcerer managed to sneak up to the present day to finally finish the ancient ritual. Chris Miller grew up an orphan and one day found out that she was the owner of an ancient house of the 16th century. In this house, Chris felt very strange, the girl began to be haunted by visions and nightmares. Chris invited her friends to a housewarming party, and in the midst of the party, a mysterious stranger appeared. It was a sorcerer who was going to take Chris's soul, but the problem is that the girl has to give it up voluntarily.

title: Without defects
description: In the 60s, one of the largest jewelry companies in the world is robbed. This crime was committed by her own employees. At that time, England was a very conservative country, in which all management positions were occupied by men, and women were engaged in the house and family life. But even in those days there were women who, forgetting about their personal lives, managed to make a good career. One of these women turned out to be Laura Quinn, who holds the position of top manager in the same jewelry company. Here Mr. Hoobs worked as a cleaner for about thirty years. He openly sympathizes with the girl, watching how she is late for work every day. For a long time, the elderly man contemplated a plan to rob the company to which he had given most of his life, earning a decent reward. In the person of Laura, he saw an accomplice capable of committing this audacious crime...

title: Detective Gourmet: Enjoy life while you can

When one of the owner's sons dies, Maggie and Henry begin their investigation again, finding themselves in the middle of a feud between the heirs over the family fortune. The movie "Detective Gurman: Enjoy life while you can" (2017) will be enjoyed by all fans of detectives and dramas in Ukrainian.

title: Asterix and Obelix: Middle Kingdom
description: In the comedy film "Asterix and Obelix: Middle Kingdom", restless friends from the mighty Roman army that rebelled, villages in Gaul continue their travels through the ancient world. Another coup d'état took place in a distant empire across the steppes and deserts. As a result, the heir to the throne, the daughter of a powerful lord, ended up in prison. Inexplicably, the defenseless girl managed to escape from the separatists. It is difficult to find a better refuge than the territory that was later called Europe. By chance, she ended up in a settlement where her friends were already bored from idleness. Xuan-di had no choice but to ask for help from the foolish Gauls. Of course, it is impossible to refuse. They are happy to go to unknown China. After all, Panoramamix provides magical potions that make the owners of incredible power. They would have handled the mission without difficulty, but there was a problem. Caesar learns about the unruly state. The famous commander cannot come to terms with the existence of an independent country. At the head of several legions, the primordial enemy, who had been humiliated many times by them, set out to conquer the territories behind the Great Wall.

title: Deadly Labyrinth

According to the plot of the film, a mysterious organization invited them all to play a quest. Our heroes were lured into this game thanks to a solid profit, which the winner will receive at the end of the quest. However, very soon all six participants of the quest realized that they were not chosen for this game by chance. They found themselves involved in someone's game with death, where they are mere pawns. They are in real danger, and their precious lives are at stake.

title: Mary - Queen of Scots

According to the plot of the film, in those distant years, the country was not ready for serious disasters and a sudden coup. Sisters Elizaveta and Maria grow up in the royal castle. As direct heirs to the throne, they are given special attention. Elizaveta has an excessively cruel character, and Maria, despite her defiant character, has an incredible mind. Among the people, they became famous under the famous names of Bloody Elizabeth and defiant Mary Stewart.

title: Random visit

His life is full of difficulties, but one day everything only gets worse. Quite by accident, he learns one secret, after which his entire circle is in danger. The movie "The Accidental Visit" (2022) online in Ukrainian will be interesting to watch for fans of crime thrillers.

At one fine moment, he decides to change his life and restore relations with his own father. They have not communicated for several years, so it is very difficult to establish contact. Soon, Jude learns the terrible news that his friend Teddy has died of a drug overdose. But he also learns that Eliza, a friend of the deceased, is carrying a child from Teddy. From this moment, Jude and his father try in every way to help the girl grow up and cope with pregnancy... The film "Ten Thousand Saints" (2015) will be enjoyed by all fans of comedy musicals and dramas in Ukrainian live.

title: 6 days

The "Iron Lady" has been the prime minister for a year and is trying to do everything to solve many urgent problems. On April 0, several militants took over the Iranian embassy in London and took all the employees hostage. Criminals demand the release of ninety-one Arabs in Iran, but it turns out to be an impossible task. As a result, the negotiations are delayed for six days, after which the government decides to storm the embassy... All fans of detective thrillers and historical dramas will enjoy watching the movie "6 Days" (2017) in Ukrainian live.

title: Horrible Family: Returns
description: For several years, the family has been fighting crime in an unfamiliar city. And soon, the time comes: now the relatives need to pack their things and go to their homeland. However, not all families are happy with such a schedule of affairs, but they do not have to choose, because there are other people waiting for the heroes to return home, who already need the help of the fighters for justice too much. Having found themselves in their native lands, young and not so good people start a new life again. One of the daughters finally makes friends, a boy who is always worried about his studies returns to the walls of his favorite school, and restless teenagers, who are always looking for adventure on their own ass, once again dream of becoming saviors of society. This not particularly joyful trip takes an unexpected turn when the heroine encounters Jean, an extremely eccentric school friend, at the airport. What adventures await former friends in sunny Portugal? And how will the trip change their lives?

title: Who is in your bed?
description: The mayor of a small town in the north of France, Jean Leroy, plans to run for the next term. Conservative and reserved, he is nervous on the eve of the election campaign. Edith, the hero's wife, lived with him for 40 years and has three adult children. All this time, something has been bothering her, and she finally finds the courage to share it with her husband. The fact is that the heroine always felt like a man. She had time to think about everything and finally she dares to make a transgender transition. She agrees to wait and not reveal her secret until the election, so as not to interfere with her husband's political career. The film traces the complex emotional experiences of the main characters and their loved ones when they face such a deep and personal problem as transgender transition. The couple must overcome doubts and prejudices and find the strength to understand and support each other at this important moment.

title: Little Dixie
description: The deal between the head of the drug cartel and the corrupt governor of the state of Oklahoma is almost signed. It remains to settle some nuances. Unexpectedly for representatives of the shadow business, Richard Jeffs becomes the initiator of the arrest of the brother of a drug lord known in criminal circles. His friend, a former special agent, does not understand why Richard put his head in the hornet's nest. It is not possible to dissuade Jeffs, who promised the voters to administer the next lethal injection to Dalo himself. It comes to the point that the criminals kidnap the man's daughter, baby Dixie. What will a desperate father have to do to save his daughter?

title: Ricky Steniki
description: The three friends have great communication and meet often, telling their spouses that they have gone to see Ricky Stenicki. But there is one secret, because in reality such a person never existed. Many years ago, the main characters accidentally set fire to a house and could end up behind bars. The lawyer came up with this theory so the guys would blame it all on their 4th mystery friend who got away. It really worked, I had to not tell anyone about it in the future. The lovers are tired of not seeing Ricky in person and invite him to the upcoming party. Men understand that everything can be revealed, so they turn to the actor. He agrees to take over Ricky's duties for a large sum, but this leads to problems. He makes up too many stories, praising himself and now it is necessary to prove them.

title: Madame Web
description: In a mystical universe, where there are many superheroes and villains, lives a young woman named Alexandra. This ability to see the future and foresee danger makes her stand out from the crowd. Known as she sees, Oleksandra feels both fear and admiration from those around her. Over time, she realizes that her gift can serve a great purpose - the protection and well-being of people. Overcoming her inner fears and doubts, she decides to become a superheroine, using her abilities to fight evil. Her unique abilities do not go unnoticed. Spider-Man, seeing her potential and strength, invites her to join his team of superheroes. The one who sees, understanding the importance of such a union, agrees. She becomes a key member of the team and together they face numerous threats. Bachacha battles villains by using her unique abilities to foresee dangers and help prevent disasters. But as events unfold, she discovers that her gift has a dark side that threatens her life and the well-being of those she seeks to protect.

title: We are all strangers
description: Cheerful Adam has changed a lot after the terrible tragedy. The parents died in an accident, the son decided to move to another city and focus on his career. It really succeeded, thirty years later the main character became a screenwriter. He is known in many circles and plans to write the story for his upcoming project. However, he cannot let go of the past, friends advise him to return to London to forget about the horrors forever. This is exactly what a celebrity does, buying tickets for the nearest plane. Upon arrival, he finds his family's house, but before he gets inside, an unknown person speaks to him. Harry lives next door and warns of imminent danger.

title: The color is purple
description: In the epic panorama of Celie's life unfold not only suffering and struggle, but also inspiration, the power of true love. Her path, riddled with trials and an incredible persistent spirit, becomes a reflection of the struggle for her own place under the sun in a world full of obstacles and opportunities. Surrounded by hardships and challenges, Celie takes a journey through decades of change. Her life is a canvas of tears of joy, heartbreaks and moments interwoven into a unique symphony of female power. The main character of the drama "The Color Purple" does not just go through troubles, she becomes a symbol of steadfastness and courage in the face of difficulties. Behind every challenge, behind every tear, there is a story of perseverance, desire, sincere desire for freedom. Celie not only fights for her place in this world, she creates her own mark, leaving a mark in the hearts of the audience.

title: Garfield
description: Garfield is an example of what an ordinary cat should not be. This red ball is full of self-love, he is very cynical and does not see any cat equal to him in the district. Full care and the best food, and also a minimum of movements, because you can injure yourself in this way. Should I mention Garfield's reaction when a dog appears in the house? And it is not important that this is just a small puppy, because he is also able to attract all the love to himself. Jealousy and dislike for dogs do their job, and Garfield tries in every way to survive the dog. To his surprise, he succeeds very quickly, only Odi does not go, and he is kidnapped. Garfield would have sighed and calmed down, accepting this as a decision of fate, but only then he realized that this small creature was his own, and that he was almost responsible for him. Now his main goal is to return Oda to the house and take revenge on the kidnapper. We recommend watching the film "Garfield" (2004) live in Ukrainian to all fans of comedies, in particular to the younger generation, and even better to watch with the whole family.

title: Adventures of Pinocchio
description: A carpenter named Geppetto grows old, regretting that he did not manage to have children. And although the master is considered one of the best in the district, he does not feel happy. The character from the movie "Pinocchio" wants to take care of someone. One day Geppetto is going to start his new job. However, suddenly he begins to hear a loud child's voice. This seems strange to the master and therefore he decides that he is troubled by a violent fantasy. But soon the voice becomes so expressive that the carpenter can no longer deceive himself. He manages to discover that the tree, which lies opposite him, is having a conversation with him. Geppetto starts processing a piece of wood and soon a real boy appears in front of him. The child becomes the long-awaited son of the hero. Now the wooden boy observes the world around him every day. The child wants to go outside and make friends. However, Geppetto is skeptical of the idea, fearing that his son might get hurt or lost. But the boy is persistent. Having a thirst for knowledge, he goes in search of adventure. Amazing journeys and new friends will await Pinocchio. All fans of good animated films will enjoy watching the cartoon "The Adventures of Pinocchio" (2019) in Ukrainian.

title: Ghost trap

Helping them with the sheep is hardly an exciting prospect for a city boy like him - but that is if you don't consider his introduction to Belle, a huge dog who is cruelly treated by her owner. Willing to do anything to fight injustice and protect his new girlfriend, Sebastian will spend the craziest summer of his life
