description: An artist named Carl Nargle has spent the last 30 years working on television and hosting his own show about painting. But at some point, the rating begins to drop rapidly, and in order to save the situation, the studio hires a new young artist. And he first of all steals Karl's image and everything he ever loved. But Karl Nargle is not ready to give someone his life so easily...

title: Father
description: Anthony is an elderly aristocrat who has lived in London all his life. His condition worsens every day, and he can no longer take care of himself. With this, the hero burdens his daughter Anne, who is forced to sacrifice her own personal life. But one day she meets her soulmate. The woman decides to take a serious step in her life and go to Paris with her lover. She hires the young and naive Laura as a nanny. Gradually, the eighty-year-old man, lost in time and his own memories, becomes very hot-tempered and suspicious. But the worst thing is that he is not able to understand what is happening around him. The movie "Father" (2020) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of quality dramas with elements of thriller, because this movie won 2 Oscars: Anthony Hopkins - best actor and Florian Zeller - best adapted screenplay!

title: Gloria / Gloria
description: The action of the film takes place in the sixties of the last century. Gloria Stein is a professional journalist who has always had an active attitude in life. She began to defend women's rights with great enthusiasm, enthusiastically taking the side of feminists. It is safe to say that she became the face of this movement. How did she live and why did she choose such a path for herself? Why did women all over the world suddenly decide to stand up for their rights and what difficulties will they have to face? How do feminists act now and what do they have to go through? And how did the activity of the founder of their movement affect their lives? You will learn all this while watching the film. The film "Gloria / Gloria" (2020) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of biographical dramas.

title: Hypnotherapy
description: Jenn is a young girl who is going through a professional and personal crisis. The heroine cannot get out of this situation on her own, so she decides to seek help from a specialist. A well-known therapist who uses hypnosis in his practice attracts her attention. The doctor makes a good impression on her, and the heroine decides to undergo a course of therapy. But soon she begins to realize that she has found herself in the center of a deadly game, from which it will be extremely difficult to get out?

title: Summer camp
description: Troubled teenager Will Hawkins is in trouble with the law and is facing a juvenile detention facility. But he has an alternative: he can go to a Christian summer camp. At first, Will does not like it there, but gradually the boy's heart melts, and he falls in love with a regular guest of the camp. Unexpectedly, Will finds his place in a world that seemed completely alien to him. All fans of family musicals and dramas will enjoy watching the movie "Summer Camp" (2021) live in Ukrainian.

title: Castle at Christmas
description: Sophie Brown is a writer who has published 12 bestsellers in recent years. She is proud of her achievements, but somehow she gets bored, so she decides to radically change the plot of the new book. The writer kills the main character, intending to start a new round of the plot. But a flurry of criticism and negativity suddenly falls on her. Fans are not happy with this twist of the plot. But these are not all Sophie's problems. Her husband leaves her, leaving her alone. Wanting to relax a little and regain her inspiration, the heroine goes on a trip to Scotland. The movie "Castle for Christmas" (2021) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of comedic and melodramatic Christmas films.

title: Uninvited guests
description: Two inseparable friends and business partners, Jeremy Gray and John Beckwith, love a good walk. But not somewhere, but at the weddings of complete strangers. They come to the church for weddings, invent stories about their lives and are invited to the wedding celebration. They are a bright spot at any wedding. Friends behave very nice, participate in everything: cutting the cake, dancing with the bride, and are not deprived of the attention of beautiful women. They drink champagne, eat and at the end of the evening find themselves in the bed of beautiful women who have been thinking about marriage for a long time. But their key action is to disappear in the morning without a trace. And so it continued until they found themselves at the wedding of the daughter of the Secretary of the Treasury. There they set their sights on the other two daughters. But it will not be another party! They do fall in love and their celibacy ends.

title: Trip
description: A couple in crisis head to a remote cabin to reconnect with each other, but each has plans to kill the other. Before they can carry out their plans, unexpected guests will arrive and they will face greater danger. The movie "The Trip" (2021) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of comedy thrillers and horrors.

title: Beckett / Beckett / Beckett
description: Beckett is an American who went to Greece with his beloved. They expected to spend a wonderful vacation, enjoying the magnificent views of this country. But their romantic trip is interrupted by a car accident. Immediately after her, Beckett has to flee, because law enforcement officials involved in an incomprehensible political conspiracy want to kill him. In addition, the hero's lover has disappeared, and he cannot find out exactly where. Now Beckett's task is to get to the embassy to get help and try to figure out what happened.

title: Hangover: Part 3
description: The adventures of friends continue, although this time they had to meet under tragic circumstances. Alan lost his father and friends came to the funeral to support him. They suggested that everyone go to Las Vegas together to distract themselves from bad thoughts. After all, Alan completely stopped thinking soberly, succumbing to depression, which affected his refusal to take the drugs prescribed by the doctor. The guys wanted to have a good time and just relax. All the planned plans changed dramatically after the meeting with Mr. Chow. It was he who made old acquaintances get into trouble. Having succumbed to his persuasion, they got into trouble. Now everything is much more complicated, because they need to get out of prisons. But how did they end up there? They need to come up with an escape plan, after which they will find themselves in a real firefight. The result of the adventure will be the purchase of a giraffe. Will the fun company manage to get out of this situation? After all, their families are waiting for them at home, and they worry about the heads of their families. Will this meeting be their last? As the years go by, one should become more serious, but the main characters, apparently, are not going to do this, continuing to have fun to the fullest, although they should already become more sensible and devote themselves to wives, children and work.

title: Hangover 2: From Vegas to Bangkok
description: The adventures of four inseparable friends who had previously thrown a grand party in Las Vegas. The same guys continue to travel the world in order to remember their pastime forever. This time, the friendly quartet is going to the picturesque capital of Thailand, where the wedding celebration of one of the friends is planned. After the events of the last trip, they no longer want to test fate for strength, hoping for quiet and peaceful gatherings in the circle of family and loved ones. Stu's desire to play a lavish but safe wedding is supported by associates. But can this four be calm when everyone is together? As always, everything doesn't go according to plan, because the seductive Thai nights and chastity are incompatible concepts for the old, promiscuous "peppers". What happened in the United States of America will remain there, and here they are waiting for new achievements that cannot go without attention. Inspired by the simple curious stories of the past, the main characters go on the road, towards unbridled fun, alcohol and all-consuming madness, forgetting about relatives and everyday affairs. Their motto is to take everything from life!

title: Hangover in Vegas
description: On the eve of his wedding - Doug goes with a group of friends to Vegas to have a bachelor party there. But, coming to his senses the next day, the company does not remember anything, plus discovers that the culprit of the celebration is lost. Next, they try to restore the timeline of events. In addition to the fact that the groom's friends do not find Doug, they have a lot of additional problems. Phil, Stew and Alan do not remember what happened last night, and the posh hotel where they stayed is in total chaos. By the way, they find an unknown child there. In an attempt to reconstruct all the events, the trio faces all kinds of adventures and learns about the enchanting details of last night.

title: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
description: Interstellar adventures in a galaxy far, far away continue. Barely recovering from the defeat in the previous installment and losing the Death Star - its main weapon, the Empire decides to strike back. The positions of resistance find themselves under heavy fire from opponents of democracy. The rebels are losing planet after planet in such an unequal battle. Experiencing significant losses, the main characters are forced to separate. Princess Leia and Han Solo are heading to the cloudy city. Luke Skywalker arrives on the planet Dagobah to meet the last representative of the Jedi Order - Master Yoda. Young Skywalker has to tame the Force, which is the connecting spiritual link in the universe. If he succumbs to the temptation of negative emotions, then the Dark Side of the Force will consume him, which once happened to Darth Vader. Civil war between the Empire and the rebels, the horrors of endless space, betrayal and hopelessness - this is what awaits the heroes on the way. But the main test will fall on the shoulders of Luke Skywalker: the confrontation with the secret of his origin.

title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
description: Tatooine is a desert planet where Obi-Wan Kenobi met a young boy named Luke Skywalker. Rebels confront the Emperor. On the way, the mentor and student accept new members into their team - Han Solo, a brave pilot, and a couple of droids R2D2 and C-3PO. A motley company is on its way. Their main goal is to find the leader of the rebels - Princess Leia. Meanwhile, the dangerous villain Darth Vader intends to strike.

title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Hidden Threat
description: Brave Jedi Knight Qui-Gon Jin sets out on a journey to rescue the noble Queen Amidala. However, by the will of fate, he is brought to the small planet Tatooine. There he meets the little slave boy Anakin. Now the hero has no doubts that an incredible amount of power is concentrated in his new friend. Perhaps Anakin will have a great chance to restore the balance of good and evil in this galaxy. Freed from slavery, the handsome man begins to undergo training that will enable him to become invincible and incredibly strong. Everything doesn't always work out the first time, but the handsome man steadily continues to follow the path to great happiness. Meanwhile, new unrest begins in the Galaxy. Everything is to blame for the appearance of the Sith, who want to seize power. For this, they are ready to go to any lengths. And that is why a creature is needed, capable of repelling their blow and restoring the former state of affairs. Will the boy cope with the task?

title: John Carter: Between Two Worlds
description: At the epicenter of the plot is a veteran of the American Civil War. John Carter was "lucky" to balance between the North and the South. After the end of the war, a man tries to try his luck in the gold mines in Arizona. But the Indians kill him. However, thanks to the magical power of some artifact, he ends up on Mars. The film "John Carter: Between Two Worlds" (2012) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventure fiction in Ukrainian live.

title: Hitch's method / Shooting rules: Hitch's method
description: In this picture, we will talk about the legendary New York detective Alex Hitchens. According to the plot, Alex has already helped many men to achieve reciprocity with women. The film "The Hitch Method" (2005) will be enjoyed by all fans of dramatic comedies in Ukrainian live.

title: A beauty all over her head
description: At the epicenter of the plot is an ordinary girl who is obsessed with her appearance. The heroine of the film "Beauty on all heads" does not consider herself the most beautiful, but does everything to become one. Eternal diets, grueling training, fasting and other restrictions - this is a completely ordinary average day for her. She did not get out of the gym and plunged headlong into training to make herself, if not a top model, then at least an attractive girl. And the Gods and the universe seemed to hear her thoughts and calls for help. She flew off the exercise bike and hit the back of her head hard. Since then, she literally switched to another channel. Now she does not sit on diets and does not go to the gym, because she considers herself the most beautiful girl in the whole white world.

title: Teacher
description: A typical American comedy from the category 18+ will tell the story of an attractive and carefree middle school teacher. The main role is played by the beautiful Cameron Diaz, and she is joined by Justin Timberlake and Jason Segel. The audience will not see anything new in this comedy - typical American humor "for those who are older", unobtrusive plot and cheerful, slightly worried characters. This film is worth watching only because of the sexy Cameron Diaz, who appeared on the screen in the image of a real "bad girl". Elizabeth Halsey works as a simple school teacher. At the same time, the girl simply hates her work: she does not respect both colleagues and students. In general, it is difficult to call her a teacher: Elizabeth behaves like a socialite, likes to drink and smoke weed, and the cherished dream of her whole life is to increase her bust, and the girl diligently collects money for the operation.

title: John Farnham: The Voice of Australia / John Farnham: In Search of a Voice
description: The definitive theatrical documentary about John Farnham, Australia's greatest singer. We follow his journey from innocent suburban Melbourne to 60s pop stardom, through incredible ups and downs, and finally to record-breaking success as The Voice of Australia. This is the story of how the singer and the national audience found and believed in each other. John Farnham was 38 years old when the song "Whispering Jack" was released. No one ever doubted that he could sing, but the journey to finding his artistic voice and becoming Australia's most loved artist took half a lifetime. His album Whispering Jack is still Australia's best-selling album, and this documentary traces the personal and public life that led Farnham to become, and remains, Australia's biggest music act.

title: Witch's house
description: A group of high school students, missing the adventures of their ass and were going to spend Halloween night in an abandoned house, but as soon as they entered, they became victims of a demonic witch who caused their anger. The movie "The House of the Witch" (2017) will be enjoyed by all horror fans in Ukrainian.

title: American star
description: The events of the film tell about an experienced mercenary who is used to not asking unnecessary questions. He simply does the work that others refuse to do. At the same time, the mercenary has rare skills for his profession, which makes him a useful ally for both entrepreneurs and politicians. The next task confronts the hero with serious questions. First, he finds himself on an isolated island, and then he learns about a shipwreck that claimed many lives. The man does not know the name of his future victim, nor her location. However, he must eliminate this person under any circumstances, because not only money is at stake, but also reputation in the criminal world. Will the main character be able to track down the mysterious victim and justify the trust of the esteemed customer?

title: A fugitive from birth
description: The story of the abduction of a daughter and the forgotten past, which suddenly surfaces, promises to be intense and emotionally rich. Reverend Jeremiah Jacobs and Martha are faced with the terrifying reality and incredible complexity of the situation, but they decide not to give up. Their determination to uncover the truth and hope for a better future, despite all the difficulties and dangers, creates the potential for a gripping drama where the characters fight for justice and reunification with the lost child.

title: Einstein and the bomb
description: A documentary combining archival material and staged scenes to explore key moments in the life and career of the eminent scientist Albert Einstein. The film immerses the viewer in a journey through the life of Albert Einstein, starting from his early years and ending with global recognition. Through unique archival footage and carefully staged scenes, audiences witness key moments in Einstein's life, including his theoretical discoveries, scientific controversies, personal trials and political convictions. The film also touches on his complex relationships with family, friends and colleagues, as well as his contribution to the development of the scientific community and his role in the historical events of the 20th century. "The Life of Einstein" not only tells about the scientist's scientific achievements, but also seeks to show the man according to formulas, his human qualities, dilemmas and aspirations, making his character closer and more understandable to a wide audience.

title: Boss Level: Save the ex
description: Roy Palvel is a former commando who has accomplished many feats in his life. He left the service and now enjoys a quiet life without constant risk. But one day he finds himself in mortal danger. Several professional killers start hunting for the hero. He has to face ruthless killers who will stop at nothing to achieve their goal. The worst thing is that the hero cannot avoid death, no matter how hard he tries. But every time he comes to his senses and finds himself on the same day when this nightmare began. Will he be able to figure out what is happening and get out of the time loop? The movie "Level with the Boss / Quantum of Time" (2021) will be enjoyed by all fans of crime thrillers and science fiction.

title: Self-sufficiency
description: Tommy, a young man, faces the most unusual and dangerous challenge of his life. He receives an offer to participate in a game where the ultimate prize is a million dollars. The gist of the game seems simple, but extremely risky: Tommy must avoid falling into the hands of a group of hunters who are trying to kill him. Realizing that the hunters attack him only when he is alone, Tommy tries to constantly be in the company of other people. But the task is complicated by the fact that none of his friends or relatives believe in the reality and seriousness of this game, considering it just a joke or a bad joke. Tommy is forced to fight for survival in complete solitude, without support and understanding from those around him. He must learn to act quickly and decisively under pressure and constant threat. His every move is closely watched by hunters, making his life one of continuous flight and stealth. In this deadly game, where the main prize is his life and a million dollars, Tommy must use all his skills and knowledge to outwit his opponent and stay alive.

title: Can you keep secrets?
description: Everyone has their secrets. But sometimes, you want to share the most secret with a random fellow traveler. The main character of the film finds herself in an unpleasant story that she could not have imagined. One day she was flying on a plane, and a very handsome stranger was sitting next to her. A conversation started between the two heroes, during which the girl revealed her innermost secrets to a stranger. She hoped that they would never see each other again after the plane landed at its destination. As you know, it is much easier to trust strangers with the innermost secrets than to tell about them to your acquaintances, and even more so to close friends. The main character told her secret to this man, but she had no idea how tight the world was. Very soon, the completely unexpected turns out. The handsome man from the plane turns out to be the main character's new boss. The girl feels extremely uncomfortable, because for her this situation is a complete fiasco. You should never share your innermost secrets with strangers, because everything said can turn against the speaker.

title: In the arms of lies / Greta
description: Frances is a young and pretty girl who moved to live in midtown Manhattan to make a fresh start in life. The main character of "In the Arms of Lies" rides the subway very often. One day she noticed a purse that someone had forgotten. She found the owner's business card in her purse. Frances decided to return the bag to her hostess. This is how our heroine met Greta, a lonely middle-aged widow. Between Frances and Greta, a friendship developed and they began to spend a lot of time together. But this continued until the girl realized that she had fallen into the arms of the lies of a crazy woman.

title: Transit
description: The film repeats the plot of the book of the same name, but has a cardinal difference in the time period where the events take place. Instead of World War II, the action unfolds in modern Europe, where the role of Jews has been replaced by illegal refugees from the Middle East, and the punitive squads of the Third Reich are police raids. The main protagonist is the immigrant Georg, who escapes from government arbitrariness and temporarily moves from Paris to the port city of Marseille. Only those who have permission to leave the country under the pretext of a transit stay are allowed here.

title: Cadaver
description: Working in the police turns out to be much more difficult than it seems. This is just a real nervousness! Perhaps that is why there is such a turnover of personnel in law enforcement agencies, because not everyone can withstand such extreme stress. A strange and incomprehensible situation is happening with one of the employees of the police department. The woman had just come out of rehabilitation and wished to return to the service as soon as possible. She loves her work, which definitely affects her results. But maybe if she had known in advance what would happen to her on the very first shift, then she would not have been in such a hurry to go to work. In fact, such a situation can even drive her crazy... After all, it is not every day that a person can see a corpse that has come to life, and even under very mysterious circumstances. The girl who died during the rite of exorcism did not initially raise any doubts about the main character. This corpse arrived during her duty. But after some events, it began to seem to the policewoman that an evil spirit lives in this body, which has now decided to drive the poor heroine crazy. The policewoman must do everything in her power to understand what is really happening.

A former customer deceives three mercenaries. Angry at the man who decided not to pay the fee for the completed assignment, the criminals go to the American province to collect their money themselves. The accomplices managed to find out that the customer keeps savings in a local bank, which they plan to rob. At the same time, we get to know the main characters of the film - two police officers. They are usually busy patrolling the streets, but this time they become educators and spend time with a difficult teenager. Driving away with the schoolboy in a police car, the men try to explain to him how important it is not to spoil his life now, in his youth. At this moment, an alarming message arrives. "Code 211," the police radio broadcasts, meaning a bank robbery. By coincidence, the partners are in the next block, so they are the first to arrive at the call. A colleague of Mike Chandler is injured, so he has to fight the criminals almost single-handedly. You have to wait too long for help, so Mike and the teenager are forced to fight the robbers to prevent them from escaping.

title: my angel
description: Life always has such sufferings in store for a person, which will be the most painful. In the center of the film is a girl named Lizzy. She is a single mother who raised her child by her own efforts. She would have been an ideal mother if not for the tragedy that happened to her newborn daughter. The pain was too strong, and even after seven years, the heroine continues to mourn her daughter. A terrible fire took the life of a little girl. During this time, Lizzy finds out a very important thing. It turns out that time does not heal at all. The girl loses touch with reality because she thinks that Lola is her dead daughter. Sometimes everything gets confused in a person's head, and in such situations it is very difficult to find a way out.

title: Duplicate
description: Among the millions of residents of Manhattan, Jonathan seems like an ordinary person. A young guy, successful at work, modest and diligent - quite an ordinary young man. But no one knows the main thing - as soon as Jonathan falls asleep, a duplicate wakes up in his body, that is, another personality. Wakes up to lead an active life all night. These two "neighbors" know each other and even exchange video messages. But one day something happens that will break the fragile balance that has been established between both Jonathans. And this violation will end not just in a small quarrel, but in a real war of destruction. That's just who will get the victory, because both Jonathans have the same body...

title: Crazy vacation
description: A woman named Marion, who has been in her thirties for several years, is at the center of the plot. Being a self-sufficient person, she is not particularly concerned about her sexual relations. She loves men. A lady's list of lovers can be endless, and modern dating applications only help her expand the variety of men. She is used to dating in such applications, and it is not difficult for her to find a boyfriend for one night in order to have fun with him properly. Husband Ben is a very serious person who knows what the word routine is. There is nothing between these two heroes but an established dating app and romantic Paris. Marion and Ben fall in love on their first date. Crazy passion hit their heads, and the sweet couple planned a vacation together. But this vacation will be a real horror, because each hero has his own opinion of what the best vacation should be.

title: French gigolo
description: The hero of the French film comedy is an elderly man whose peak popularity has long passed. From his youth, he was a handsome and sweet boy, young girls and even their mothers were delighted with his charming face. Alex was so pampered by women's excessive attention that he imagined himself as an unsurpassed handsome man, able to charm any person in a skirt. And so the frivolous butterfly fluttered all his youth from one flower to another, from a rich mistress to the most luxurious and generous lady. Years passed, the man lost his luster, he was replaced by tanned sports guys, and almost no one cared about the old-fashioned lovelas. But the inveterate protagonist did not want to admit his defeat and continued his love adventures. And when his roommate got tired of keeping the worm, he came to his sister. It is difficult to get used to the unusual environment and conditions of living in someone else's apartment, but he still hopes to hook another wealthy lady...

title: White god
description: After her mother's departure to Australia, the main character stayed with her father, and her father is not happy with her dog Hagen. In addition, the dog is not registered, and the sanitary inspection begins to hunt for it. After running away from his mistress, Hagen goes through a series of fights, and then ends up in a dog shelter, where he starts a rebellion against the inhumanity of those who work there. The film "White God" (2014) will be enjoyed by all fans of thrillers in Ukrainian live.

title: Agency of broken hearts
description: A cynical journalist recklessly ventures into therapy for broken hearts in order to write an article, but ends up falling in love with a charming therapist.

title: A Hero's Story: The Making of Percy Jackson and the Olympians
description: Along with a passionate cast and crew, follow Walker Scobell, Leah Sava Jeffries and Ariane Simhadri as they enter worlds fit for the gods, battle unforgettable creatures and perform legendary stunts.

title: thanksgiving day
description: Residents of Plymouth, located in the state of Massachusetts, are waiting for Thanksgiving. Their desire is especially fueled by discounts that local stores regularly hold on holidays. One of the owners of a local shop decided to hold a big sale in order to make a profit. On the appointed day, a bunch of people, who want to make a good purchase and save money, burst into the hall with products and a tragedy occurs. Due to the haste of the crowd, some shoppers died from the stampede. The government turns a blind eye to this event and declares it an accident. A year passes, and the shocked victims have already forgotten what happened last year. Immersed in the hustle and bustle of the New Year, people learn that a killer has arrived in their city, who has already managed to take the lives of several victims. Will the police be able to arrest the serial killer who wanted to destroy the atmosphere of magic and the holiday?

title: Missing
description: June is an ordinary 18-year-old girl. The mom recently announced that she wants to go to Colombia to spend a short vacation with her new beau. At this time, her daughter was having fun at parties and talking with friends. But at the time of the return, the father did not appear at the airport, which caused great concern. The woman and her lover did not answer the calls, and the authorities could not help find the American woman in a foreign country. Worried about her loved one, the young heroine decided to conduct a search on her own, using all the possibilities of the Internet.

title: Bone breaker / Bone breaker
description: At first glance, Harry leads the life of an ordinary middle-aged man. He works as a coach at a school and is no different from thousands of others like him. And few people know that in recent years the man does not live, but exists. A few years ago, a terrible tragedy happened in Harry's life. His only teenage daughter was kidnapped by a gang of smugglers and killed. The bandits did not pay for the death of his child. Harry lost the meaning of life, and an eternal sense of guilt settled in his soul. The news about the disappearance of one of his students helps him to get out of a state of deep depression. Harry begins to suspect that the girl has also become a victim of the same smugglers who killed his daughter. Disappointed in the actions of the authorities, he decides to start his own investigation. Realizing that time is working against him, Harry spares no means to get on the trail of the bandits. Relying only on his own strength, he administers justice, following only his principles and is obsessed with the desire to take revenge for the death of his daughter. And it does not matter to him that his justice does not correspond to the laws. The main thing is to save the girl and punish the criminals.

title: Survivor
description: In the main role is the virtuoso sergeant Richard Mirko, who faces a difficult task: to save the family of a defenseless American preacher. An insightful story unfolds in a dusty desert shrouded in danger and betrayal. Mirko, who remains a warrior at heart and soul, must overcome the difficulties of not only fighting enemies, but also his own inner demons. His willpower and steadfastness are tested to the limit as he risks sacrificing everything to save strangers. Will and compassion intertwine in this gripping cinematic opera as Mirko finds himself in a heroic confrontation with powerful enemies who know the sands of Afghanistan well. The question is whether the War Horse will be able to overcome all the obstacles that he will have to face on his dangerous path, and ultimately save the preacher and his family. Do not miss this unforgettable film that fills the viewer with the energy of action and emotional power, and which will give you hours of exciting cinema at the highest level. From the burning desert of Afghanistan to the thrilling finale, War Horse will let you experience the true meaning of service, courage and love.

title: A knock on the door
description: The family decides to go on a short trip to relax in nature. They settle in a house in the middle of the forest. Parents and their child are having a great time until a few strangers appear in their lives. In the evening they knock on the door of their house. The men are armed. One of them, introduced by Leonard, tells the heroes that a real apocalypse is coming to Earth. But the family can save all of humanity, for this only one of them will have to sacrifice his own life.

title: The players
description: Mack, a sports journalist from New York, has never fallen in love. Together with her friend Adam, she developed several schemes for a successful pickup. But the conquered boys did not stay with her for long. She made them fall in love with her and threw her away after achieving a certain goal related to their wallets or simply quenching their desires. By and large, she and her friends were con artists who broke the hearts of people who fell into their traps. One day, the girl falls in love with one of the victims of a successful dating scheme - Nick. Now she will have to find a way to keep her lover and go through this game called family life to the end, leaving frivolity in the past.

title: Kill me if you dare
description: In the mysterious world of 2024, where technology is intertwined with emotions, an impressive story of love and devotion is born. "ZABIJ MNIE, KOCHANIE" is a fascinating journey into the depths of the human soul, where broken hearts search for answers to questions about the true essence of love. In this film, we follow two lovers - Eliza and Max - it's like listening to the beating of their hearts, which beat to the mysterious rhythm of the future. They are like poles, attracted to each other, despite the fact that danger and mystery stand between them. With every look, every touch, they reveal their darkest and most intimate fantasies, but will they be able to survive in a world where every moment could be their last? Picking together small scraps of their past and present nightmares, the film offers viewers a deep reflection on how strong love can be, as well as the price we pay for our desires. This film is a cry of the soul that reverberates in the echo of the future, leaving a mark in the hearts of the audience forever.

title: Love in the square again
description: When a new job begins to interfere with their life together, the relationship between a famous journalist and a pragmatic teacher is threatened. We recommend watching the movie "Love in the Square Again" (2023) in Ukrainian for fans of comedy and melodramatic films.

title: Army of thieves
description: This film is a prequel to the story told in Army of the Dead. Ludwig Dieter is a simple bank employee who turns out to have a unique talent. That is why they decided to go to the groom's hometown in order to meet the future mother-in-law. The strict and authoritarian Viola was not used to disobedience on the part of others, so she was outraged by her son's obvious audacity. The potential daughter-in-law caused absolutely no sympathy in the woman, as she planned to choose a worthy couple for the heir at her discretion. But seeing Kevin's mood, the mother did not dare to openly expose her chosen one to the threshold. She preferred to act with the help of cunning and meanness, doing everything possible to ensure getting rid of the young lady. Viola drew up a plan of action, trying to disrupt the wedding of lovers and forever discourage her son's desire to act without her knowledge and intrusive participation in all moments.

title: A boy for Christmas
description: When Christine, the main character, was a little girl, she asked Santa Claus to give her the perfect boyfriend for Christmas. Grown-up Christine has long since forgotten her childhood wish, but the magic of Christmas knows no bounds. Fate presents her with an incredible surprise - a real gentleman appears on the doorstep of her house, as if fulfilling a child's request. The film is ideal for family viewing on the eve of the holiday. The current atmosphere, delicate storyline and charismatic characters make it a great choice for those who want to watch a light and good movie. The film is available to watch online on various streaming platforms.

title: The boys in the boat
description: This story is related to sport, which has always been the basis of a happy life. In particular, it will be about strong and brave young people who managed to accomplish a huge feat. The main characters of the film are nine amateur rowers. They won the Hitler Olympics. These young people studied at the University of Washington. They simply adore sports and consider it an integral part of their lives. In 1936, the boys realized their main dream. They managed to win the championship at the Olympics in Berlin. Self-belief never left these young people. They confidently went to this difficult victory and reached great sports heights in their field. These guys are fun to watch. They draw attention to themselves thanks to their steadfastness of spirit and ability to fight for their goal.

title: Lily's return
description: In the enchanted world of lost memories and restless thoughts, the film opens the door to the heart and soul of the main character, who is searching for her truth in the sea of ​​oblivion. Lily, young and talented, lost her memory after a tragic event that shook her world to its core. With a passion for uncovering her past, she embarks on a journey through the prism of her own memories to find answers to the questions raging in her soul. Around every corner, unknown secrets await, revealing new aspects of her personality and past. Each broken fragment helps her to piece together the mosaic of her story, but along with it new questions and challenges appear. "Bringing Lily Back" is a journey of self-discovery, discovery and reconciliation with the past. This film reminds us that true strength lies in the ability to accept and experience even darkness, as it can be the key to light and new beginnings.

title: Detective Arthur Haley
description: At the center of the plot is the inner drama of a man who worked as a policeman for many years, but, having caught his old enemy - a brutal serial killer, radically revised his outlook on life and decided to become a spiritual father. Ainsley - a police officer with experience - neutralized many criminals, but his main feat was the capture of a crazy maniac and a soul killer who managed to take many innocent lives. To catch the villain, the detective risked his life, health, career, loved ones and now wants to go on a well-deserved rest. However, fate makes a sharp turn: the murderer, sentenced to death, wants to open his soul and explain to the detective the motives of his actions.

title: Fourth
description: A company for the production of unique robots cooperates with a CIA agent whose moral principles leave much to be desired. Soon, four combat vehicles are sent to a small settlement located in the Golden Triangle. There is an assumption that narcotic drugs are produced here. The robots have to prove their combat effectiveness in action, which, if successful, will bring very profitable military contracts. At the same time, six doctors who arrived on a humanitarian mission appeared in the village. They witness the killing of civilians, which makes them a new target for war robots. Will the heroes be able to save their lives? The movie "The Fourth" (2020) will be enjoyed by all fans of science fiction and action movies about robots.

title: Charlie Kulya
description: In the center of the plot is a famous character named Charlie Swift. He is a true cold-blooded serial killer. If you have difficult problems, immediately contact this hero! He will definitely solve everything. The hero worked for many years for the boss, one of the main figures in the country's mafia, but the sweet time ended when his colleagues decided to deal with the crime boss. A big fight broke out, but the main character managed to escape. Now, in order to avenge himself and his dead boss, Kula enters into a fight with the same scumbags as himself. No one knows how this story will end, but the hero already knows that it will be difficult. However, the protagonist receives unexpected support from the ex-wife of the criminal he killed. This woman becomes his ally, and from that moment they turn into a "sweet couple" of criminals who take revenge on everyone they don't like. To everyone who stands in their way.

title: May, December
description: Twenty years ago, the romance of a young teacher with her student caused a real scandal and became the main topic of discussion in all the tabloids. Despite everything, Joe and Gracie were able to overcome public condemnation and kept their love alive. Now they are a happy married couple who are raising twins. However, their peaceful life changes when their story becomes the subject of cinematic interest. The actress chosen to play the role of Gracie strives to understand and experience every moment of their story in order to convey it as accurately as possible on the screen.

title: Ambulance / Urgent care
description: Comic book artist Josh sees the woman of his dreams, but every time he doesn't dare to talk to her. One day he pulls himself together and even manages to say a few phrases to a woman named Cheryl. When Cheryl, who suffers from diabetes, unexpectedly collapses in the street, Josh calls an ambulance and then plans to visit the woman at the clinic after work. However, in the evening, the artist finds out that Cheryl is missing, but police lieutenant Spencer does not want to believe his story. Soon, the main character learns that Cheryl is not the first person with diabetes to go missing...

title: In the land of saints and sinners
description: The main character was connected with the criminal world for a long time and worked as a killer. He still managed to cope with all the tasks, but later the man began to notice that it was increasingly difficult for him to be given such work, and therefore, it was time to go to rest. Finbar decides to retire from business and settles in a small town where life flows quietly and calmly. However, everything changes when a gang appears and starts terrorizing the local residents. Finbar takes the side of his neighbors and prepares to fight back against the criminals. But the main difficulty is that he has to think not only about himself, but also about his loved ones.

title: Beekeeper
description: The events of the story take place in a quiet suburb where coziness and peace reign. Mr. Clay is an ordinary beekeeper who helps his neighbors. The peaceful life of the man is destroyed after the death of a close friend of the good-natured pensioner Mrs. Parker, who became a victim of fraudulent deals. The unfortunate woman settled accounts with her life, which in turn awakened within Clay a sense of revenge. In the past, Clay - a former operative of the underground mercenary organization "Bees" - has gone missing. The influence of the mysterious organization is incomparable and its employees are not just professionals, they are the best in their field, and Mr. Clay is no exception. He returned, but not with the purpose of continuing mercenary activities further, but with the purpose of destroying injustice and betrayal. Now the man himself will fight against a dangerous enemy, not realizing that his actions can lead to large-scale losses. An international war is approaching, and hundreds of thousands of lives are at stake.

title: Family plan
description: The main character lives in a small town and sells cars. He is happy with his wife Jessica, with whom he has three children. At first glance, their family seems quite ordinary, but it turns out that Dan is hiding a secret from his past even from those closest to him. The man once worked for a government organization and was a hired killer. Of course, during this time, he accumulated a lot of enemies, so the hero had to try so that after he left the business, he would not be found by bandits. Until now, Dan Morgan has been doing great, but recently he found out that his enemies had leaked his location. In order to save his loved ones and at the same time not to reveal the secret of the past, he offers to go on vacation together.

title: SuperAlibi 2
description: Greg once owned an agency that provided clients with an alibi for money, but after meeting the honest and impatient of any lies Flo, the hero seriously revised his views on life and changed his line of work. In addition, the hero soon decided to propose to his girlfriend. But before he can arrange the wedding, he needs to introduce Flo to her parents, which is very problematic. Knowing his fiancee's attitude to lies, Greg cannot allow her to meet relatives who make money by running scams. Then the man decides to remember the past and turn again to the experience of "SuperAlibi", which previously solved similar problems.

title: Wonka
description: Somehow Willy will become incredibly rich and happy, he will achieve his dream - he will build his own chocolate factory. It will be very popular, the products will sell out with a bang among buyers from all over the planet. Every little fan of his candies wants to personally visit the place where such a miracle is made. Young lovers of sweets will be indescribably delighted when "Wonka" kindly provides them with such an opportunity, including the amazing boy Charlie, with a delicate soul, strength of spirit, not broken by all the obstacles and difficulties that haunt their family. But there is still a long way to go: the owner himself was also a child. The famous creator of chocolate, strange and outrageous, creative and passionate about his work, was first and foremost a simple boy who dreams of sweets. His father is a dentist. The doctor did not give sweets to the child at all. Knowing that teeth are extremely expensive, and there is clearly not that much money for them, he forbade the baby to consume harmful products. Craving for chocolates became uncontrollable and greedy, but it gave birth to a famous business project that brought the author a mountain of money. And at first, the poor man just wanted to taste as many goodies as he could, and his soul hoped that he would be able to find his life's work.

title: Bad gnomes. Christmas debacle
description: Bill moves with his children Nora and Lucas and his new wife Carol to Norway, where he has inherited his late uncle's estate. Teenagers, in particular, are not too happy to leave America. In this country it is cold and snowy, and the Internet is bad, and there is little entertainment in their small town. Lucas discovers a mythical gnome's pantry inside the barn. He asks one of the locals about him and is warned that elves don't like bright lights and loud music. They also oppose any changes in their home. The family manages to break all three rules, as a result of which the evil dwarf and his associates endlessly terrorize them. Elves are cruel, but sometimes very stupid. After receiving a gun, one of them looks straight down the barrel, despite having just fatally shot one of his buddies. Bursting through windows and falling down chimneys, they are like garden toy rabbits that never run out of energy. Bill and his family urgently need to find unique ways to fight back.

title: Farang
description: Sam, once a shining boxing star, lost his sporting glory because of his mistake, ending up in prison. Leaving the past and his native land behind, he goes to Thailand, a peaceful and joyful paradise, to start afresh. But Farang's heart is still burning with thirst for blood and revenge. Inside him is brewing the determination to take just revenge on those who deprived him of happiness and prospects. Now Sema must become a relentless crime fighter who has taken control of Bangkok, a nest of the most dangerous murderers and rapists. The Farang, reborn into this world, becomes an avenger who brings fear and terror to those who flout the law and keep others in fear.

title: Champions
description: This film tells the story of a wonderful coach who uses basketball to help his students overcome the challenges that people with developmental disabilities face. His team becomes part of the players of the Special Olympics and begins the fight for the title of champions. The coach gives all his vital energy to help athletes overcome their fears and doubts. But will they be able to achieve the heights of sports glory? Most importantly, this story teaches us that nothing is impossible in life if there is a willingness to work and faith in one's abilities. Will this hero be able to change his pets for the better and help them realize their dream of becoming a champion?

title: Marvel's
description: The main character always dreamed of becoming a pilot, but somehow she got into an accident caused by an alien ship. As a result, Carol lost her memory and ended up in the Kree Empire. There, she trains to become a Star Force pilot, a special intergalactic unit. However, while performing another task, the girl is captured by terrorists. When she is free again, she attracts the attention of SH.I.T. employees. So Carol turns out to be a member of a team of superheroes who save the Earth from Thanos, who brings evil to all mankind. However, the fight against the enemy leads to serious changes in the universe, and now the heroine, together with her friends, must do everything to save her.

title: Retribution: The Road to Revenge
description: The main character takes his children to school every morning. However, when he leaves the house this time, he receives a strange call on his mobile phone from an unknown person who claims that there is a bomb under the man's seat. To prevent it from exploding, Matt needs to follow all the criminal's instructions exactly. But what are the terrorist's goals? Does he only need money or is it not about money at all? One thing is clear, the main character will have to break many rules and do everything to save himself and his children.

title: Saltburn
description: The art of confronting privilege and desire blossoms in the story of Oliver Quick, a young student at Oxford University whose ambitions collide with the world of oligarchs. Oliver, not from the world of the rich, strives not to stand out among his peers, but his life changes when he strikes up a friendship with Felix Catton. Together, they plunge into the world of wealth, where every wish is instantly fulfilled. The summer holidays are approaching, and Oliver accepts an invitation to spend the summer at the Saltburn Cattons' ancestral estate, with no chance to refuse. Meeting the eccentric Catton family proves to be a challenge for Oliver, but his determination and independence make them reconsider their prejudices. A trip to the nest of aristocratic oligarchs leads to the destruction of stereotypes and the enrichment of mutual understanding. Comedy drama "Saltburn" promises a dynamic plot, explosions of feelings and exploration of the limits of ambition and friendship.

title: Father Stu
description: The plot of the film is based on the real story of Stuart Long. During his life, he tried himself in various professions. He was a boxer, but suffered a jaw injury, tried to become a screen star, but was never able to get a significant role. He even got a regular job, but almost immediately after that he got into a terrible accident. During his recovery, Stewart discovered religion. He believed in God so much that he decided to become a priest. Although the man could only move on crutches, he preached so earnestly that people flocked to him.

title: A Christmas adventure
description: In winter, secret dreams come true, because everyone celebrates the main holiday of the year. Only the pragmatic resident of the metropolis does not believe in such things. After finishing school, she immediately left the unpromising province and rarely saw her backward relatives. She was successful, and soon she will have to marry a rich guy, which the heroine has been trying to do for a long time. But first, he asks her to go to her hometown for a day. There lives an emaciated ski resort, which he does not mind buying. Elizabeth hoped to return one day without even visiting her parents. But an unexpected meeting with his sister forced him to stay to spend Christmas together. And suddenly she realized that she was fascinated by this place. And after meeting with the owner of the resort, who refused the deal, she is no longer sure whether she wants to return.

title: Rise
description: Cyrus is the mastermind of the Lift team, an experienced thief who is persuaded to cooperate with the government in an unusual heist. Interpol agent Abby Gladwell has his number and wants to recruit him for a very high-stakes mission. But he will act under her own control, she is convinced that it is necessary to give the scoundrel and his team a chance to whiten their reputation. A passenger plane is carrying $100 million worth of gold and they have to steal it. If the robbery is not successful, it will lead to a terrorist attack. It can cover the whole world, but with a special focus on London and Zurich. The group of Cyrus includes: the master of disguise Denton - his close friend and Camila - the steering team, an incomparable getaway driver who will always steer in the right direction. Of course, this does not necessarily mean that she is ready to fly on a private plane, but who knows how things will turn out. So, a dangerous journey is being prepared and the lives of many people depend on its outcome.

title: Christmas menu
description: Molly Frost takes her first steps in the restaurant business. She tries her best to make her guests satisfied and want to come back for dinner. Somehow she gets a unique opportunity to declare herself. The heroine becomes a participant in the biggest event of the year. Her team needs to hold a banquet service for an event that will be attended by influential and wealthy people. Will she be able to cope with all the doubts and overcome her inner fears?

title: Wild river
description: The main characters go rafting. Of course, the trio expects only positive impressions from a joint vacation. In the beginning, everything really goes according to plan, and Gray, Joey and Trevor get to enjoy the fresh air and beautiful scenery. But the cheerful mood abruptly ends when the heroes get into trouble. In the turbulent waters, they encounter dangerous eddies, strong currents and sharp rocks, forcing them to fight for their survival. In addition, at this moment, the worst traits of Trevor's character begin to emerge. The boy acts selfishly and makes bad decisions, while Joey and Greg face their own fears.

title: Napoleon
description: The story of Napoleon Bonaparte's rise to power is a story not only of great military victories, but also of a changing relationship with his true love - Josephine. Throughout his career, Bonaparte struggled for power and prestige, but Josephine's love and devotion were his reliable support in all life's storms. Their relationship was complicated and sometimes even tragic, but the girl was always there, supporting him in everything. Her comfort and loyalty were necessary to him, and his story became an integral part of the legend of Napoleon. Through the prism of their volatile relationship, a more human side of this great politician and military leader can be seen, seeing how love and passion can change the course of history.

title: Exorcist: Faithful
description: Tener long ago separated from his wife, who went to another. He raises his daughter himself and tries to do everything so that the girl does not need anything. However, he soon begins to notice that something strange is happening to her, and an ordinary person cannot behave like this. Has a demon taken over his daughter? The man turns to Chris Manil, who once faced a similar opportunity and after that began to help other people. When a woman sees a teenager, she understands that everything has already gone too far, and she poses a serious threat to those around her. Chris is ready to seal the monster, but will Tanner himself agree to the proposed option?

title: Sweet sorrow
description: The film "Sweet Grief Online" will tell the story of a guy, a popular artist, who recently lost a loved one, a famous writer. On the way, he becomes a witness to unusual stories and learns many heart-wrenching details of the life of his other half, about what creepy secrets he hid, and why he led a double life. When everyone was alive, they had fun together, met mutual friends and enjoyed every moment. But loneliness leaves its mark, and the hero tries to find the strength to live on. Moving to a new place, playing sports with an attractive instructor, new relationships and philosophical reflections on the essence of his stay on earth bring positive results, and the man comes to his senses, "comes to life" and begins to act. The incredible pain of losing a loved one can be compared to the loss of a mother. Over time, it subsides little by little and the hero finds the strength to continue living and creating.

title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
description: In the past, a warrior from an ancient family failed to restrain the rebels, since then the situation of the heirs of this family has deteriorated so much that they began to be threatened with the loss of their last savings. Their only hope was one of their kind, who knew perfectly well how to survive in this cruel world. Time passed and Coriolan Snow was appointed as the honorary trainer of the players at the Hunger Games. His student was Lucy Gray Bird, a representative of the 12th District. She is suspicious of her coach, and he himself is not happy about her candidacy. However, the man soon realizes that, to his surprise, the audience likes the charm, originality and determination of the warrior. At the same time, the heroes can achieve victory, but the way to it lies through many dangers and difficult trials.

title: Snow community
description: An autobiographical picture about a plane crash in the middle of the Andes mountain range. Only 29 of the 45 passengers who boarded in Chile survived. But not all of them will be able to see their relatives and friends. The airline was on a regular flight and had a rugby team on board. Before the flight, everyone joked a lot, took pictures, enjoyed life and was determined to win the game. But fate makes its corrections, and the passengers found themselves in the middle of a snow-covered desert that is difficult to pass, with a minimum amount of food and water, without communication and the ability to contact the outside world and send an SOS signal. In order to survive, it is necessary to join forces, stop disputes and introduce strict restrictions. Who will be able to survive in such extreme conditions, what is a person capable of for salvation, what path to choose, waiting or fighting the elements in search of a way out. The heroes face the cold, meager rations, diseases and other torments. Not everyone will be able to resist.

title: Daughter of the Swamp King
description: Are you ready for a tense thriller that will keep you on your toes? Then "Daughter of the Swamp King online" is what you need! Set in a deep, dark swamp, the secrets of Helena's terrifying past are revealed in this exciting film. As a child, she lived in fear under the despotic hand of her treacherous father, the infamous "swamp king". But now that she's finally got a new loving family and stability, her scary story takes an even darker turn! When her father is released from prison and begins to persecute her loved ones, Helena must use all her criminal methods to stop him before it is too late. So pop your popcorn and watch as Helena fights to save her future from her vile past.

title: Journey to Bethlehem
description: Christmas bright story. A musical that shows the audience a classic biblical plot. It tells about the birth of a baby, about whom the whole world will soon know, Jesus Christ. The life story of a young woman named Maria. She has a huge responsibility on her shoulders, because she has to not just become a mother - her newborn child will be completely unusual - the son of God. The man, whose name is Joseph, is going through not the easiest period. He is constantly torn between strong feelings - love, faith, honor. Difficult relationships that develop between spouses in an amazing and unbelievable situation. The heartless, cruel and merciless King Herod is ready to commit any action and crime in order to maintain maximum power, unquestioning submission from his subjects. The story of the most famous and greatest event in the history of mankind. The musical accompaniment allows you to get deeper into the festive mood, it includes traditional, well-known Christmas tunes and new pop songs. A serious topic is diluted with fun jokes, funny moments.

title: The art of deception
description: Madeleine gives the impression of an attractive person with good taste. But no one even guesses what she does for a living. Madeleine deceives the richest people in Manhattan, thanks to which she can not refuse anything. So far, the heroine has always been lucky in her scams, but she is too smart to understand: it won't always be like that. The girl knows very well that at any moment she may end up behind bars. It is for this reason that she decides to tie the knot with the frauds, but before that to solve the last case, which should provide her with money for the rest of her life. In addition, Madeleine meets a man who earns the same way as she does. Fraudsters decide to join forces. But what will come of it? Will they be able to achieve their goal or will they fall into the hands of the police?

title: Creator
description: Artificial intelligence created by humans in the future helped humanity to cope with some problems, but later the program underwent changes that caused terrible consequences. A nuclear bomb was detonated in downtown Los Angeles. After that, a brutal confrontation between humans and robots began for the remaining resources. Somehow, agent Joshua receives an important task: an artificial intelligence has developed some secret weapon, and now the man must destroy these developments. The hero goes on a journey and as a result finds a robot child who behaves like a human, but can control any electronic systems. Joshua understands that he is dangerous and at the same time does not want to destroy him. Perhaps it is this child that will help the hero and all of humanity to understand the true intention of the Creator, because of which the robots arose?

title: Rebellious month. Part 1: Child of Fire
description: In the future, a single government concentrates all power from other planets in its hands. It relies on a strong army that brutally suppresses any resistance. The ship of the main character Cora, who is traveling in space, suffers an accident, as a result of which the girl ends up on a planet where the inhabitants are engaged in farming and lead a calm, measured lifestyle. But somehow, by order of the general, soldiers arrive here with the task of conquering a new planet. They kill those who helped Corey. The woman decides to stop the invaders, because she was once a warrior, but she realizes that she cannot cope with them alone. Then the heroine flies to other planets to recruit a squad of fighters who want to take revenge on the government.

title: Bring me back for Christmas
description: Renee spends most of her time in a small shop where she sells lunches. The girl is tired of this, because she wants a different career. Somehow she says it out loud and an unusual elf approaches, after which she rings the bell and informs that it is necessary to make a wish, then it will definitely come true. The main character does not believe in such words, but for the sake of a joke she decides to try. Already in a moment she is sitting in New York and is the owner of a large company. Rene realizes that everything turned out to be true and now he really begins to enjoy his fate. Only in the evening does she realize that she has lost her husband, because in this reality he does not know her at all. It was not possible to talk to him, he did not believe such a story and said that he would contact the police if the harassment continued. The wife is not ready to give up, so she remembers the secrets of her lover that others do not know. So you can prove your words and be together again, but you can't remember anything.

title: Asteroid City
description: The year is 1955, a small fictional town located near a crater left by an asteroid impact thousands of years ago. Every year, a meeting of young astronomers is held here, in which students, their families, teachers, and even military personnel participate. Another such takeoff is abruptly interrupted by events capable of changing the world. We recommend watching the film "Asteroid City" (2023) in Ukrainian for fans of comedy and melodramatic films.

title: talk to me
description: Mia is going through a difficult period in her life. Very recently, the girl lost her mother and cannot come to terms with this loss. But it becomes a little easier for her after meeting Joss and Hally, who conduct various magical rituals. Often a company of boys gathers in the evenings to summon spirits. A mummified hand with incomprehensible inscriptions is used for this ritual. To get the desired effect and establish a connection with the other world, you need to constantly touch the artifact. This enables the spirit to enter the human body. But the ritual has strict time limits - 90 seconds. If this rule is broken, the ghost will remain inside the summoner. During one of the sessions, Miya, wanting to contact her dead mother, breaks contact with the artifact in time, which leads to terrible consequences.

title: Nowhere
description: A married couple makes a difficult decision to permanently leave Spain, where totalitarianism is gaining strength. The couple plans to go to Ireland, hoping that there is still some freedom left there. In order to carry out their plan, they pay money to smugglers who have to transport them across the ocean in cargo metal containers. However, when the heroes arrive at the shipyard, an armed squad arrives there. As a result, Nico is forced to stay, and Miya manages to get on the ship. Thus, a woman who is also expecting a child finds herself in a difficult situation. But everything only gets more complicated when, during a storm, the container is washed into the open sea, and Mia is left face to face with the raging elements.

title: Maestro
description: Leonard Bernstein is a famous American conductor, composer and teacher. Even at a young age, he became interested in music, but his father considered this activity useless, and the hero had to earn money himself to pay for the first classes. Later, Bernstein graduated from Harvard University and the Curtis Institute of Music, and later the doors of the largest concert halls in America and Europe opened before him, and all this time the composer continued to work a lot, including writing musical works. So he wrote the famous "West Side Story" in 1957. A large part of the film is devoted to his relationship with his beloved wife Felicia Montealegre, who was his muse and supported her husband in everything.

title: Taming wayward 2
description: A young couple, Kaska and Patrik, are happy together, but they have problems when the woman goes on a business trip from Poland to America. For some reason, everyone is sure that she will not return to Patrick again. Neighbors, friends and just acquaintances constantly hint about this man. And if Patrick takes the trip relatively calmly at first, then he becomes jealous and even calls his beloved, forgetting that it is five in the morning in New York.

title: Taming wayward
description: In the center of the plot is a female scientist who was never able to establish a personal life. She had a relationship, but it left her with only a broken heart. The heroine wants to start life with a clean slate, for which she returns to her hometown. But her brother wants to sell the joint land. Realizing that his sister won't go along with the deal, he decides to play a trick and hires a handsome stranger to set her up.

title: Shaggy peppers
description: Reggie is an ordinary purebred dog. He adores his master, although he treats his pet with disgust, invents all sorts of offensive nicknames for him and tries to get rid of him. Reggie came to him by accident: he was once picked up as a puppy by the owner's girlfriend, and since then he has remained here. But one day, for some reason, the man takes the dog away from home. Left alone, Reggie gets to know homeless dogs like himself. Friends quickly explain to him what abuse is and how he was actually treated by the former owner. After that, the dog, with the support of his new friends, decides to take revenge on the offender. It turns out not to be so difficult, because the dog perfectly knows all its secrets.

title: Unstoppable 4
description: The Unstoppable team includes only the best professional mercenaries, who are assigned a new difficult task. This time, the heroes have to stop an influential leader of a terrorist group, who makes money by selling weapons. A criminal is preparing a plan to seize a nuclear arsenal that is being transported on a ship. Barney Ross instructs his assistant Lee Christmas to stop the terrorists, but he is also going to watch the actions of his team, especially since it has recently been replenished with new ones.

title: The illusion of security
description: While the main characters are having fun getting a well-deserved break outside of their cozy little world, the real end of the world is happening in a posh area of ​​New York City. This is a screen adaptation of Ruman Alam's bestseller, which tells about the last days of humanity and the attempts of cornered people to keep their minds and faith in a bright future, which does not fade even in such scary moments when everything around plunges into darkness. Amanda and Clay had been planning their vacation for months. A couple in love was going to spend it on Long Island and booked one of the mansions. However, a few hours after the main characters begin to celebrate this event, the owners return to their house with terrible news. They themselves do not understand what is happening on the planet. After a large-scale hacker attack, television and cellular communications stop working. The next blow is inflicted by power grids. The city remains without electricity. What is it? The start of a world war? A major terrorist attack? To find out, the heroes decide to go to the mainland and see what is happening in the "Big Apple".

title: A man from Toronto
description: Teddy is the simplest consultant from New York, who is often unlucky. A guy goes on vacation, but ends up in the wrong house by mistake. There he learns that they are waiting for a person from Toronto, and the hero decides to say that it is him. But at that moment, FBI agents burst into the house. title: Oppenheimer
description: The hero of the film "Oppenheimer" went down in history as a brilliant physicist who had many inventions to his credit.
