The film "Enola Holmes" (2020) will be enjoyed by all fans of detectives in the Sherlock style.

title: Generation Voyager
description: The action of the film takes place in the future. Humanity is on the verge of extinction, so a decision was made to go into space, to a habitable planet. Thirty young men and women go on an expedition to continue the human race. But soon the unexpected happens. Under mysterious circumstances, the head of the mission dies. The team soon discovers the dark secrets of the expedition, after which they are faced with primitive physiological consequences. Gradually, life on the spaceship plunges into chaos, in which all the crew members succumb to immoral impulses. The film "Generation Voyager" (2021) will be liked by all lovers of adventure and fantasy thrillers.

title: One more each
description: The story of the film "One more time" begins with a story about an unusual hypothesis, based on the fact that a person is unhappy due to a deficiency in the body of elements contained in alcoholic beverages. Some scientists are convinced that a small amount of alcohol in the blood opens the mind to the outside world and increases creative abilities, reducing the tendency to crises and stress. In the center of the plot is Martin, who works as a school teacher. He feels tired and too old despite his relative youth. It seems to him that everyone around him is against him, especially the parents of the students, who dream of getting him removed from conducting classes so that their children can raise their average score. Having learned about the theory of alcohol deficiency in the blood, the teacher from the movie "One More at a Time" and three of his colleagues are going to conduct an exciting experiment to regularly saturate the body with the required amount of alcohol. Martin is called to be a test subject and soon begins to show positive results. In a short time, an unusual experience turns into an academic study. The film "One More" (2020) will be enjoyed by all fans of dramatic comedies in Ukrainian live.

title: An ex from another world
description: Charles Condomine is a well-known writer who is experiencing a creative crisis. He cannot write a single line of a new novel and sees no way to fix it. Trying to regain his inspiration, the hero invites a famous medium to his house. Madame Arcata conducts a séance, as a result of which the restless spirit of Charles's first wife comes from the afterlife. She has always been very jealous, so she immediately begins to poison his new wife. No matter what, the ghost wants to win back the love of her ex-husband, which creates a very strange love triangle. What will be the end of these incredible events and what trials will the heroes have to face? All fans of comedies and melodramas will enjoy watching the movie "The Ex from that World" (2020) in Ukrainian live.

title: Be careful, Kangaroo!
description: Mark Uwe is a simple artist who lives on the outskirts of Berlin. He is constantly alone because of his regular migraine attacks. But one day he meets a very unusual neighbor. He becomes an active and cheerful kangaroo who came to Mark to ask for some ingredients for making pancakes according to his own recipe. A friendship developed between them, which eventually led to living together. They have fun together, but one day they learn that a large construction company is going to buy their neighborhood for a large-scale project. The heroes do not want to part with their beloved house so easily, so they are ready to fight for it to the end. Their first plan of action fails, but the kangaroo comes up with a new idea... The film "The Voice" (2020) will be enjoyed by all fans of unusual comedies in which animals are involved.

title: Mulan
description: The adventure drama "Mulan" offers its viewers to see a stunning story about a very brave and courageous young girl with a great destiny. In the center of the plot is a young girl who is alone with one of the strongest warriors of her time. She is determined, energetic and wants to be like her father in everything. The action begins its development at the moment when invaders appear from the northern lands. The girl wants to join the army, but the Emperor allows only men to serve. But when the ruler issues a decree that every family must send at least one man to war, the heroine understands that this is her chance to prove herself. She changes her appearance and joins the army. But the girl does not even suspect that she will become one of the greatest warriors of China. However, before that, she has to go through many trials and misadventures. The film "Mulan" (2020) will be enjoyed by Ukrainian fans of adventure fantasy.

title: Forrest Gump
description: Forrest Gump has always been an unusual person. Since childhood, he was diagnosed with mental retardation, and his knees were twisted and made it difficult for him to move his legs. The boy was raised by his mother and grew up a good child. At school, he was the object of ridicule and bullying because of his unconventional thinking and the special brace he had to wear on his legs. But still there was a person who treated him with understanding - his friend Jenny. Together they spent all their free time, climbing trees and fending off annoying hooligans who are trying to make fun of their friends once again. Being a teenager, the hero discovered a gift in himself. Once he had to run away from his classmates who were trying to crush a guy on a bicycle. With the force he used to run, the staples flew apart and his knees straightened. Forrest ran with incredible speed, impressing everyone he knew. Soon he was accepted into the football team, in which he played not according to the standard rules: he had to simply run to pass the ball. Then he was taken into the army, from which he was sent to the war zone in Vietnam. But even there, thanks to his peculiarity, the young man managed to survive. The hero's life was going well, even despite his mental abilities. However, the more successful he becomes, the more he distances himself from his childhood friend. The film "Forrest Gump" (1994) will be enjoyed by all fans of Hollywood classics in the genres of drama and comedy.

title: Bad Santa
description: In the plot of the comedy film "Bad Santa", an alcoholic, a lustful old woman, a loser, and also a former zak-bear cub - Willy, together with his partner, a black dwarf Marcus. They rob shopping centers every Christmas. Before the holiday, the criminals get a job in a large department store, Willy as Santa Claus, and Marcus as an elf. The criminals' plan is very simple. Marcus, using his small stature, hides somewhere, and after closing the department store, he turns off the alarm and, together with Willy, takes the money out of the safe. So they are provided for the whole year until the next holiday. However, this time the plan did not work. Willy began to drink a lot, not controlling his actions, bad Santa became simply unbearable. He sends children, shouts at the people around him and has sex in a fitting store. But also a chubby boy who does not believe in the existence of Santa, stuck to Willy like a leech, and the security service of the shopping center began to suspect something. The film "Bad Santa" (2003) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of Christmas comedies with pepper.

title: Avengers 4: The End
description: In the previous part, Thanos practically destroyed life not only on his planet, but also in the entire universe. In the final part of "Avengers", the audience is waiting for a historic battle between legendary superheroes and an equally legendary supervillain. If everything is clear with Thanos - he wants to destroy the universe and become its sole ruler, then there are still quarrels and hostile relations in the team of superheroes. Thor and Captain America will lead the Avengers in the final battle. They will be joined by other team members, as well as their allies.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
description: The Avengers have proven their effectiveness. Their actions turned out to be enough to fight the invasion from space, which caused the partial destruction of New York. After recovering from the battle, the forces of the defenders of the Earth were needed in the battle with Ultron, who organized a mass attack of thousands of robots on one of the states. He almost achieved his goal, but the bravery and coordinated work of the heroes made it possible to stop the end of the world. The next threat came from the past, associated with the terrorist organization "Hydra". What happened led to the division of the union into two parts, forced to stop interacting with each other. The passions subsided, the life of the planet began to enter the usual course, but the news of a powerful evil reached the ears of the Avengers. Destroyer of galaxies and lord of time, Thanos, sitting calmly on his throne, decided to break the truce. In his hands are the Infinity Stones, which give almost unlimited power. Everyone will have to go against him, including Star Lord and his team. There must be a final battle that will end the dangers and restore peace within the solar system. It takes total dedication bordering on suicide and courage to defeat a formidable opponent who has yet to taste defeat. The movie "Avengers: Infinity War" (2018) will be enjoyed by all fans of science fiction and action movies from the Marvel studio.

title: Doctor Strange
description: The hero of the movie "Doctor Strange" is an excellent neurosurgeon, which gave him some pride and narcissism. Colleagues respect his talent, pay tribute to his professionalism, but hate his arrogant behavior and vanity. Stephen Strange adores his collection of watches, and during the operations he dances and asks the medical staff to participate in the "guess the melody" game. But one day the ambitions of a brilliant neurosurgeon were destroyed in a car accident that happened on a mountain track. The injured hero underwent about ten operations, but now his fingers are not able to hold not only a medical scalpel, but even an ordinary pencil. And without that, the difficult character of the doctor has completely deteriorated. Nurse Christine Palmer, in love with the hero, could not tolerate Strange's antics and left him in despair. Trying to regain his old life, Stephen sought out a former patient who was able to miraculously get out of a wheelchair. The man gave the hero advice: to go to the foot of Everest, to Kathmandu, where the Kamar-Taj is located, headed by the Elder. Strange sought out the place, but the Elder refused to restore his hands to health. Instead, he offered the hero to become an apprentice and learn the most ancient magic. It turned out that Stephen is talented. Soon he will face a fight with the Elder's former student. Caecilius turned to the side of darkness, making a deal with the monster Dormammu, who came from an alternate world. The doctor has to fight with thieves and curb his pride, without which the knowledge of magic is impossible. The movie "Doctor Strange" (2016) will be liked by all fans of fantasy, science fiction and action movies.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy 2
description: The main character of the exciting story-continuation of "Guardians of the Galaxy 2" is still the intelligent and cunning Star-Lord. In fact, the young man's name is Peter Quill. When the hero was a child, he was abducted by aliens and he grew up to be a real crook who makes money by selling stolen artifacts. One day, fate brought Peter together with several aliens, with whom he later organized a team of Guardians to defend the Galaxy. In addition to Quill, this included the very nimble raccoon Rocket, his strict tree friend Groot, Drax the Destroyer and the adopted daughter of the supervillain Thanos - Gamora, who chose the side of good. Together they went through many trials. Now they will have to face the revenge of Nebula - Gamora's half-sister and Thanos' own daughter. Nebula is very strong: she easily incinerates enemies, leaving only a handful of ashes from them. The heroine skillfully disguises herself, blending in with the environment. Nebula was not sure that Gamora should die, so the villain does everything to destroy Quill's friend. In addition to confronting the villains, Star-Lord has to learn the secret of his birth, which will be related to his favorite player. The movie "Guardians of the Galaxy 2" (2017) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of adventure fantasy and action movies from Marvel.

title: Venom
description: Among the many threats that await humanity, not the last step is occupied by the influx of alien organisms, famous for their gluttony and heartlessness. The endless space hides various forms of life that can seriously compete with Earth's inhabitants. Venom will be one of these strangers. The creature requires a carrier with which symbiosis is created for full functioning. Such cooperation provides a number of advantages, which include supernatural abilities. They have to be paid for by alleviating the hunger that torments the newcomer. Reporter Brock has to become an involuntary member of this union. The man is not on the best account in the newspaper, has a bad character and is engaged in digging up dirty laundry. A meeting with an interstellar mutant will radically change the life of a pen and camera operator. Sensing new opportunities, the hero experiences them on the streets of his native metropolis. Intoxicated with sensations, he will take on an unexpected role - a replacement for Spider-Man. Using bloody methods to solve problems, the protagonist will get a dark reputation, frightening both criminals and decent residents. The film "Venom" (2018) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of comedy fantasy.

title: The Avengers
description: The struggle between good and evil continues. Earth once again becomes the object of a catastrophic threat. This time the horror is caused by a new arrival, the evil god Loki. He succeeded, thanks to a deal with the Chitauri race, which in exchange for the "Tesseract", an endless source of energy, provides a powerful dark army. With the numerous support of warriors, the cruel deity from the movie "Avengers" will get the opportunity to enslave humanity and become the sole ruler of the planet. To resist the villain, you need the help of special people who have powerful energy flowing in their veins instead of blood. The head of the S.H.I.E.L.D. agency. Nick Fury understands that an ordinary person cannot cope in this fight. He decides to immediately assemble a team consisting of the most powerful heroes of the entire globe, possessing supernatural power. Company leaders will go in search of these individuals. After some time, the whole team is assembled. They are joined by the invincible Thor, who is Loki's older brother. Like no one else, he is familiar with all the tricks of his relative. In turn, his brother carefully prepared for the meeting of the Avengers. The main characters must leave their ambitions in the past, join forces and act unitedly. This is the only way to save the world and defeat the insidious Loki. The film "The Avengers" (2012) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of action and fantasy about superheroes from the Marvel studio.

title: Captain Marvel
description: According to the plot of the film "Captain Marvel", the Earth was going through a difficult period. She was involved in a clash of galaxies. A serious armed conflict begins between aliens of different races. The main character was a professional air force soldier. Quite by chance, the girl was in the center of events. She gets into a terrible accident when her plane crashes. An explosion of an unknown device occurred during the fall. A young person gets superpowers and becomes simply invincible. Carol did not expect such a turn of events. Now she has to get used to her new talents and learn to manage them. Eventually, the main character decides to join the Kree alien race. Here she joins the Starforce combat unit and becomes the strongest hero on all planets. From now on, the lives of all earthlings are in her hands. The girl understands that she is not an ordinary pilot Denver, but a brave Captain Marvel. Does the possibility of stopping the conflict that has arisen depend only on her? The movie "Captain Marvel" (2019) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of action and fantasy with elements of adventure.

title: Torus
description: In the film "Thor" the king of Asgard and his sons become the main characters. The coronation of Odin's eldest son is soon to take place. Young Thor, the god of lightning and thunder, must succeed his father and take his place on the throne. However, the solemn coronation of the heir is interrupted by the Jotun giants, who want to return the ice box with the power embedded in it. Only thanks to the sentinel Destroyer, their plan fails. Angry Thor intends to punish the giants, but the king forbids his son to start a war with them. But Loki, the youngest son of Odin, persuades his brother to disobey his father. The arrogant heir goes to the trickster. The brothers with a small group of warriors still go to Jotungheim. However, they are not destined to win this battle and only Odin saves his children from death. An angry king deprives Thor of his throne and sends him into exile, and his mighty hammer falls to Earth with him. The movie "Thor" (2021) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of science fiction and fantasy about superheroes.

title: Deadpool 1
description: The first part of the fantastic action movie with comedy elements about Deadpool became very popular. Being a professional hired killer, the protagonist of the film, Wade Wilson, becomes a victim of incurable cancer. Realizing that he has very little time left to live, he gives permission to use his own body for military purposes to create a secret biological weapon. Experiments are being conducted in the laboratory, thanks to which it is possible to obtain superhumans with unique abilities. As a result of the experiment, Wilson's body is able to regenerate cells killed by the disease, but at the same time it was not possible to defeat the disease itself. In addition, the results of experiments on the nervous and cellular systems of the former mercenary turned out to be inadequate, as a result - a completely unpredictable and crazy superman who cannot be controlled. Now Wilson has every opportunity to find the person who ruined his life... The film "Deadpool 1" (2016) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of comedy action movies about superheroes.

title: Spider-Man
description: An ordinary teenager from the category of losers, of whom there are thousands all over the world, lives with his aunt. Every day the hero of the movie "Spider-Man" goes to school, where he receives a new portion of mockery and bullying from his peers. Mary Jane, with whom the high school student is secretly in love, simply does not notice him. And his only friend is Harry Osborn, who is much richer and more popular than him. However, one day everything radically changes. Peter never refused school trips where new knowledge could be gained. Therefore, the excursion to the science laboratory inspired him a lot. The boy listened carefully to the teacher and tried to draw Mary Jane's attention to himself, until he noticed that he was bitten by a special kind of spider. Parker did not focus on this and continued his business. And only after coming home, Peter realized that strange things began to happen to him: he found inhuman strength, good eyesight and the ability to climb walls. Parker is crazy happy about the changes and the first luck in life. Only then does he understand that the gift was revealed to him not just like that, power requires responsibility. Meanwhile, crime on the streets of the metropolis continues to grow. The film "Spider-Man" (2002) will be interesting to watch live for all fans of the legendary story about a boy who received superpowers after a spider bite.

title: Thor 2: Realm of Darkness
description: The main character of the film "Thor 2: The Kingdom of Darkness" will once again be a young god from Asgard. The wielder of the mighty hammer is now busy restoring order to the Nine Worlds. Thor is with his family again, but Loki is no longer with them. Now the youngest son of the tsar is in prison, where he was imprisoned for vile acts. However, Thor does not forget his beloved Jane, whom he met on Earth, in exile. Through the Rainbow Bridge every day, he conducts surveillance on the girl. But one day the Guardian of the Gate informs the heir to the throne that Jane has disappeared from sight. Thor goes to Earth to find his beloved. He learns that she happened to be near the powerful Ether. Jane has turned into a living vessel that stores an unearthly substance, the power of which is capable of altering matter. The son of Odin takes his beloved to his world, where Frigge, his mother, takes her under his patronage. However, the Dark Elves and their leader Malek, awakened by the Aether, decide to attack Asgard in order to regain the source of their power. The movie "Thor 2: The Dark Kingdom" (2013) will be liked by all fans of science fiction, fantasy and action.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
description: Oh, and it's not easy for Scott Lang recently, who is forced to literally tear himself apart, trying to combine the image of a loving, caring dad and superhero activities. The main character of the fantastic action movie "Ant-Man and the Wasp" has already managed to demonstrate his skills on several occasions, for which he received a unique opportunity to join the ranks of the valiant team of Avengers. And yet, the righteous desire to be as close as possible to his unsupervised daughter has kept the man in San Francisco until now. But, as you know, opponents do not sleep, preferring to plot intrigues and plan new sophisticated crimes, pursuing their insidious plans. Scott's desire to fix his life completely crashes against the harsh reality. The brilliant biochemist Hank Pym once again turns to an old friend, and this time the task will be incredibly difficult and confusing. Mr. Lang has to get hold of the miracle suit again, which allows its owner to shrink to microscopic size, because a cunning enemy is close. But the partner of our brave superhero will be the charming Hope, who will appear in the form of a super-fast and resourceful Wasp. The movie "Ant-Man and the Wasp" (2018) will be liked by all fans of fantasy with elements of adventure and comedy.

title: The first avenger
description: In the movie "The First Avenger" the main character is a simple guy from Brooklyn - Steve Rogers. From the very beginning of the war with Germany, he volunteered for the army, dreaming of selflessly fighting the enemy. But Steve fails to pass the medical board. A fragile physique and illness prevent him from getting to the front. But one day fate gives him a chance that the young American does not intend to miss. Rogers meets Abraham Erskine, who works for the US government and develops a special serum. The Bavarian scientist offers Steve to take part in an unusual experiment to create a super soldier. The boy agrees and is transported to a secret base in New Jersey. There, Erskine injects Rogers with his serum. She changes the boy's body, making him powerful and very strong. Steve is given the nickname "Captain America". And soon, alone, he goes to the enemy's base to rescue a friend from captivity. But there Steve meets the dangerous mutant Johann Schmidt, who can only be defeated by a superman like him. The film "The First Avenger" (2011) will be liked by all fans of adventure, fantasy and action.

title: New Spider-Man
description: In the movie "New Spider-Man" Peter Parker becomes the main character. He is an ordinary seventeen-year-old teenager who, after the disappearance of his parents, is raised by his closest relatives for many years. Young Peter is seriously interested in science and always takes the side of the weak. One day he finds a briefcase with documents from which he learns that his father was a famous researcher and engaged in important genetic experiments. Deciding to learn more about the work of his father and his colleague Dr. Connors, the teenager infiltrates the Oscorp laboratory. There, he is unexpectedly bitten by a spider that scientists have worked on. And already on the way home, Parker notices that his body is beginning to change. He finds unusual abilities that no other person in the world possesses. Soon, the tragic death of his uncle from a criminal's bullet forces Peter to take the side of good. Having sewn the hero's suit, the young man begins his long battle with evil. The film "New Spider-Man" (2012) will be liked by all fans of action movies and fantastic adventures about superheroes.

title: Fantastic four
description: The plot of the fantastic blockbuster "Fantastic Four" is based on the comic book Marvel Comics and tells about the adventures of an unusual team of superheroes. Fascinated by physics and moving into parallel dimensions, a young boy, Reed Richards, creates an apparatus called a "biosubstance shuttle", which is able to move simple substances from one place to another. Most of all, he dreams of becoming the first person who will manage to teleport himself, and years later, Reid's dream is fulfilled. He successfully completes the work of his invention, after which the turn of laboratory experiments comes. Reed meets associates Franklin Storm, his son Johnny and daughter Susan, as well as Victor Von Doom, who started the teleportation project long before Reed's findings. Another experiment is successful, but the team is forbidden to conduct research on moving to a parallel dimension on itself. But this does not stop the boys at all, who decided on the biggest adventure that will change their lives forever. The film "Fantastic Four" (2015) will be enjoyed by all fans of adventure fiction in Ukrainian live.

title: Ant-Man
description: Henry Pym spent all his best years working on a unique project, constantly overcoming difficulties and failures. And one day his patience and diligence were rewarded. The scientist from the fantastic film "Ant-Man" managed to develop two unique formulas. One of them reduces any person to the size of an ant, and the second can return the usual size to its former size. This is not all success! In order for a reduced human person to be able to understand the language of insects and even control them, a genius invented a special helmet. At first, Henry tested his amazing suit on himself, subjugating ants and turning them into indispensable assistants, but over time he realized that he was too old and weak for new discoveries. Scott Lang was recently released from prison. He is a kind and sensitive guy, but very unintelligent. Pym watched the loser for a long time and decided that he could not find a better candidate for the heir. The least that remains is to convince the incredulous boy that Ant-Man really exists, and he can experience all his power and influence on his own. While the negotiations were going on, there were many people who wanted to try on this interesting costume. We recommend watching the film "Ant-Man" (2015) live in Ukrainian to all fans of comedic action films and science fiction.

title: Iron man
description: In the movie "Iron Man", billionaire Tony Stark actively cooperates with the American government, developing modern types of weapons. The military supports the patron's bold ideas. Another ingenious idea is embodied in the Jericho rocket, whose destructive power has no analogues in the world. Naturally, in order to obtain a unique weapon, terrorist organizations are ready to pay huge sums of money. But Mr. Stark works exclusively for the benefit of his native country. They plan to test the new device on the territory of Afghanistan. Lieutenant Colonel James Rhodes comes to the aid of the rich genius, but Tony is kidnapped by unknown people on the lands of a foreign country. The terrorists demand that the hostage create a weapon of mass destruction, otherwise the American citizen will face inevitable death. Making a deal with fanatics means putting the world at risk, but refusing is not an option either, because one's own life is at stake. Stark secretly creates a high-tech suit, which is a strong armor, capable of lifting a person into the air and moving over long distances. Time is not rubber, and there is only one attempt to escape. The movie "Iron Man" (2008) will be enjoyed by all fans of action and fantasy from Marvel.

title: Black Panther
description: The events of the film from Marvel Comics take place in Africa, in the town of Wakanda. It was here in the film "Black Panther" that scientists discovered a deposit of a unique metal that easily absorbs vibrations. Masses of people and scientific expeditions were thrown into its extraction. All of them, like barbarians, destroyed buildings and villages of local residents. But, the spirit of the legendary panther animal, revered in these places, always came to the aid of the aborigines. There were even legends about her that were passed down from generation to generation. Years passed. They began to forget about the unsuccessful attempts to take possession of the magical metal. People prepared carefully, enlisting the support of modern science and technology. Well-armed, with the last squeal of innovation, the invaders again arrived on the territory of Wakanda for the precious metal. The movie "Black Panther" (2018) will be liked to watch in Ukrainian live by all fans of action and fantasy produced by the Marvel studio.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: As a child, Peter Quill, who survived the recent death of his mother, was abducted by aliens, after which he joined a friendly pirate team engaged in robbery and robbery. Later, he left his place of residence and started working for himself. After visiting another abandoned sanctuary, the character of the film "Guardians of the Galaxy" found a mysterious artifact. We didn't have to admire the loot for a long time, because armed mercenaries appeared, who are going to take the relic. Having escaped from competitors, the boy headed to one of the prosperous worlds to sell his find. Here he was already awaited by bounty hunters, the tree-like Groot and the desperate misanthropic raccoon Rocket. Gamora, the Green-skinned warrior, one of the former subordinates of the powerful villain Ronan, also got into the rework. He conceived an insidious plan to take revenge on former enemies, having received the blessing of Lord Thanos. A quartet of unlucky heroes end up in a maximum security prison, where they meet Drax, a trained fighter who has lost all loved ones in a military conflict. Comrades unwittingly, having learned about the true purpose of the extracted artifact, plan to escape in order to stop a cataclysm of an unprecedented scale, which is already approaching the world. The movie "Guardians of the Galaxy" (2014) will be liked to watch in Ukrainian live by all fans of science fiction and action films from the Marvel studio.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
description: In the film "Avengers: Age of Ultron", the audience will meet again with their favorite superheroes, who have united in one team to protect humanity from enemies. But now there is an unexpected split in their ranks. Under the influence of the mutant Wanda Maximoff, Tony Stark decides secretly from his friends to finish the Ultron project, which in the future should provide the Earth with the protection it needs. But it turns out that the artificial intelligence hidden in the scepter stone has no intention of saving humanity from destruction. Ultron comes to life and decides to end all people on the planet. He seizes control of Iron Man's suits and escapes from Avengers Tower. An artificial intelligence is sent to a former Hydra laboratory to create an army of drones to destroy humans. But the superheroes, even after learning that Tony Stark himself is responsible for creating a new threat, still decide to continue the fight as a single team. After all, only together the Avengers can prevent Ultron and stop the war he started against humanity. The movie "Avengers: Age of Ultron" (2015) will be liked by all lovers of fantasy, action and adventure.

title: The First Avenger: Confrontation
description: The Avengers, led by Captain America, found themselves involved in a devastating conflict of international proportions. As a result of such events, the first persons of the state are seriously thinking about regulating the actions of people with paranormal abilities, according to the adopted act on the registration of superheroes. Of course, every ordinary person wants to remain a mysterious person. It is also clear to the heroes of the fantasy thriller, but the government begins to force the saviors of the world to reveal superpowers, which means waiting for trouble. No one wants to be a public figure, let alone work under the instructions of government special services. The purpose of superhumans is to protect all innocents and fight evil. But now evil is at the top, wanting to conquer everyone. Observing the violation of civil rights in the bill, there will always be a leader, leading like-minded people to resist another team of gifted people who agreed to the conditions of the secret services. Therefore, dissenting rebels need to avoid punishment and save the world. All this leads to an inevitable war between the two clans. While there is a split between the warring parties for the right, the mysterious Baron Zemo organizes a dangerous project. The people around them cannot believe what is happening. The movie "The First Avenger: Confrontation" (2016) will be liked by all lovers of bright and fantastic action movies from Marvel.

title: Iron man 3
description: Over the years, Tony Stark has saved the world more than once. Everything is fine in his life: he is smart, rich and lives with his beloved woman. However, at one fine moment the world finds itself in danger again. The main enemy of Iron Man is the mysterious Mandarin, who uses the power of the rings of the McLuhan alien race. When a thief threatens our planet, all people rely on Iron Man, and he does not let them down. But after some time, the Mandarin begins to threaten Stark himself, trying to destroy his inner world. Now Tony can rely only on himself and his unique suit, because he has no one to turn to for help... The movie "Iron Man 3" (2013) will be liked by all fans of adventure and fantasy.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
description: Once upon a time there was an ordinary boy... Do you think this is how a fantastic story about a child with superpowers should begin? Maybe it shouldn't, but that's how Spider-Man: Homecoming begins. The main character of the picture was an ordinary boy until he was bitten by a strange insect - a radioactive spider. Now the teenager has many wonderful skills. Wounds on his body do not linger for a long time, because the cells of the body have the ability to regenerate super quickly. The boy can lift heavy objects hundreds of times his own weight. And special glands appear in his body, which allow the child prodigy to release webs directly from his limbs. description: This wonderful biographical sports drama tells the story of Michelle Payne, the first female jockey to win the Melbourne Cup. According to the plot of the film, the most prestigious equestrian tournament - the Melbourne Cup - is held only once a year in Australia. This is a luxurious holiday, where the beauty of ladies' hats is inferior only to the splendor of the races themselves. For everyone, the main character of this picture is an upstart, a girl from the hinterland, who has no place in the sport of kings. And for the right to participate in the Cup, she will have to risk everything, even her life.

title: Countdown
description: Today, you won't surprise anyone with a fancy smartphone and newfangled applications. According to the plot of the film, a young nurse downloads an application to her smartphone, which allegedly predicts the date of death of a person with an accuracy of up to a second. The girl jokingly launches it and finds out that she has only 2 days left to live. In a panic, the nurse deletes the creepy game, but the application keeps appearing on her smartphone, and her life is overcome by that fateful moment called the countdown. Will our heroine be able to stay alive or her days remain a matter of life and death.

title: Little red dress
description: During the busy winter sales in one London store, a unique item appears that is cursed. Any representative of the fairer sex would like to associate her life with this little red dress, because it fits perfectly to everyone who tries it on. But just by passing from hand to hand, it turns the life of its owners into a nightmare. The point is that this dress makes any woman desirable and charming. However, a very high price must be paid for all this. And often this price is not affordable for many women.

title: Terminator: Fatum
description: In this part of the legendary picture, Sarah Connor turned into a real terminator hunter and is now engaged in the destruction of killer robots from the future. According to the plot, the woman believed that the most important thing in her life was to prevent them from getting to John, her only son. However, now Dani Ramos appeared, whose life also depends on the fate of John and all of humanity as a whole. Together with her, the mysterious girl Grace, who is a mixture of man and machine, enters the battle with the merciless terminators. If you are a fan of the terminator theme, then you will like watching the movie "Terminator: Fatum" (2019) in the Ukrainian translation.

title: A perfect lie
description: The main character of the detective drama "The Perfect Lie" turns out to be a swindler named Roy Courtney. All his life he is only engaged in deceiving gullible victims. Most often, Roy prefers to connect with rich and naive people, but over the years it becomes more and more difficult to find them. Despite the fact that the man does not really believe in luck, he is sure that fate itself has sent him a big windfall. It happens at the moment when Roy meets a wealthy widow named Betty on the Internet. After learning that she has a huge fortune, the fraudster decides to pull off a complex scheme. After that, he is going to leave cases of this type. Soon Roy begins to put his plan into action. Betty opens to him not only her house, but also her life. But when the main character is close to completing the mission, he catches himself thinking that Betty causes warm romantic feelings in him. He wants to take care of her. And this turns the initial fraudulent scheme into a difficult tightrope walk. Roy has to make a difficult choice.

title: Games with fire
description: The main character of the comedy film "Games with Fire" is Jake Carson, who works at the fire station. He has been saving human lives for a long time, and therefore, for his merits, he rose to the position of head of the unit. Jake is brutal and cool. And everyone knows this very well. One day, an elite team under the command of the main character saves several children who were near a large-scale forest fire. Despite the fact that Jake is sure that soon they will have to return to their duties and give the children to their parents, everything happens completely differently. The head of the unit and his subordinates have to become the nannies of the rescued. Firefighters are horrified to realize that no complex training has given them experience in caring for and raising children. They try to find the children's parents, but face many obstacles. That is why firefighters have to be babysitters until relatives are found. And at this time, the entire depot is turned upside down due to the unpredictable behavior of children.

title: Downton Abbey
description: The movie Downton Abbey 2019 tells about a unique place that is located far from the big city. Here, in a picturesque town, it has been showing off for many centuries in a row. And only representatives of high society were destined to enter the territory of the abbey. Once upon a time, the aristocratic Crowley family, consisting of several generations, flourished here. And with the onset of the 20th century, they continued their coexistence, facing dozens of intrigues and scandals. Having survived all possible troubles, the noble family left the abbey, leaving it in the care of servants. But now, after many months, a royal dinner will be held again on the territory of the building. George V and his wife Maria intend to visit the abbey in the near future. In order for the meeting to go well, dozens of residents of the abbey are preparing. Not only servants, cooks and waiters from all over the world gather here, but also members of influential families. People who have not been in contact with each other for so many years in a row will gather at one common table. And this cherished meeting will not be without snide remarks and new intrigues. Moreover, it becomes known about the upcoming attempt on the king.

title: Prey
description: The teenager has been suffering from personality disorders for a long time. The main character's parents have already tried all methods. Doctors cannot help the boy, nor do conventional methods work. Their only hope is an eccentric doctor, whose methods are said to bring impressive results, but they are quite unusual. Exhausted parents agree to everything. Thus, the boy goes to a deserted island, where, according to assumptions, there are no people. He will have to take care of himself and no one will prevent him from figuring himself out. But when the boy tries to find a place to stay at night, he realizes that the island is not so empty.

title: Doctor Son
description: In the epicenter of the plot of this dramatic thriller with elements of horror is a clairvoyant boy named Danny Torrance. Many years have passed since the main character of "Doctor Sleep" experienced a nightmarish season at the Overlook Hotel, where he witnessed the madness and death of his father. Having grown up, but not recovered from childhood trauma, our hero leads the life of a marginal alcoholic. Another "shining" girl, Abra, establishes a connection with him. She needs Danny's help to avoid becoming a victim of the so-called "True Knot" - a group of hunters for gifted children.

title: Mr. Olympia
description: The storyline of this biographical drama centers around two brothers, Joe and Ben Wider. The main characters of "Mr. Olympia" are professional trainers who have been involved in the popularization of bodybuilding all their lives. In 1946, they founded the International Federation of Bodybuilding, which later grew into a powerful and influential organization. It was our heroes who discovered young Arnold Schwarzenegger in Austria and persuaded him to move to the USA. This drama will tell how the Vader empire was built and what they had to sacrifice to make their way to the top.

title: Time matrix
description: How often we want a bad day to end! While Samantha cannot count on this, stuck in the most terrible day of her life forever! The film tells about one girl who was given everything by fate. The main character named Samantha Kingston is a smart and charming girl who has a beautiful family, a loving boyfriend and good prospects in the professional field. But after a terrible car accident, the girl's life stops for one day. On the day of the disaster, something incomprehensible and terrible happens. Tomorrow will be Friday again and everything will happen again. Samantha has to live this day and the terrible event forever, day after day, without a chance for a perfect tomorrow and a happy future. In order to move from a dead point, the main character has to think about her whole life, starting with family and friends, as well as friends from school. Will Samantha be able to break the cycle of mystical events and escape from a terrible day?

title: Substitute teacher / Alienation
description: Adrien Brody's stunning performance in "Substitute Teacher" is more humanistic than the performances of stars who have tackled the subject before. But this may be due to the fact that his hero, Henry Barth, can afford to perceive all the horrors of modern pedagogy "philosophically", because he is a "replacement", today here, tomorrow - there, he does not need to worry about his influence on students or suffer because of the broken fate of students. Soon this school will remain only a stage in Henry's life. But Brody plays in such a way that makes the viewer suffer, empathize, and think. In addition, his Henry Bart has a fresh look at the problem, his "eye has not yet become dull" from long contact with the same teenagers. To all fans of "school problems", to everyone who respects Brody as a high-class master of acting - we recommend watching "Substitute Teacher" online!

title: Mr. Nobody
description: The main character is a 118-year-old man, the last mortal man on earth. He calls himself Mr. Nobody or Mr. Nobody. The few days remaining before his death became the subject of a TV show watched by the immortal population of the planet. Around the old man are people whose cells are renewed artificially, thereby stopping aging, and as a result they are immortal. On the eve of the end, a journalist comes to him, and Niki tells him his story, jumping from one life to another, parallel, dying several times during the story.

title: Geostorm
description: Many powerful hurricanes, continuous rains fall on the planet. As a result of such terrible natural disasters, many people and the entire planet suffer. To eliminate this problem, the government decided to make a project with which it will be possible to fight against natural phenomena. After some time, they created a project called Geostorm. It was a network of satellites that were in the orbit of the planet. This innovation fulfilled all the hopes of scientists. Two years after this unique invention, everything was quiet and peaceful on the planet. One day, one of the satellites broke down. To cope with it, a man who was one of the creators of the project is sent to the satellite. He had a brother who also created this invention. But the brothers did not get along with each other. They will have to find a common language to fix the breakdown.

title: Saw 8
description: The plot of the eighth part of the film about Pila begins with the story that psychologist John Kramer's dream was to conduct experiments on people. To find out if they will be able to live their lives lightly and carefree, while learning to appreciate what they have. John decides to make his dream come true after learning that he is terminally ill and doesn't have much time left. He created a maze with terrible and deadly traps, forcing him to pass the kidnapped people. John was a cruel and unpredictable person. Even after his death, some people were horrified when they heard his name. One of John's victims was oncologist Lawrence Gordon, who managed to get out of the maze alive.

title: Baystryuky / Who's our dad, dude?
description: Kyle and Peter are twin brothers. Their mother raised them alone. The boys, without a man's hand, grew into carefree lovers of fun parties and beautiful girls. Suddenly they learn that dad did not die under tragic circumstances, as they thought all forty years of his life. The mother lied all these years, not daring to reveal the truth so as not to traumatize the boys. The truth is, where he lives and thrives is unknown, as the mother cannot say for sure from whom she became pregnant four decades ago. There are many versions, so the brothers go in search. The fact is that in the seventies of the twentieth century, my mother had short affairs with various "guys", celebrities who appeared in one of the nightclubs. No wonder she hid such details. The father of the twins could be a singer, athlete or actor, or some other star.

title: Judge according to conscience
description: After completing an internship, during which he helped death row inmates, young lawyer Brian Stevenson decides to devote his whole life to this case. He moves to Alabama, hires Eva Ensley as his assistant and begins to deal with the case of Walter "Johnny Dee" McMillian. Johnny Dee was found guilty of murdering a teenage girl based on the testimony of only two unreliable witnesses. Brian believes that it will be easy for him to prove the client's innocence, since he was far from the scene of the crime at the time of its commission. However, the lawyer did not take into account the extent to which the authorities of the "white" state did not want to release a convicted black murderer to the streets. They do not recognize even the strongest evidence and facts that are designed to justify Johnny Dee, but Stevenson is not going to back down...

Military drama by Sam Mendes, the action of which takes place during the First World War in the year nineteen seventeen. The plot of the picture tells about two soldiers of the British army, Scofield and Blake. Our heroes have an impossible mission: to get into the very heart of enemy territory and deliver a message that will save them on duty, including Blake's brother, from a deadly trap. Here you can safely ask the question: will these guys be able to carry out the order and stay alive? You will find out the answer to this question by watching this video.

title: Knives naked
description: The ancient luxury estate became a place for unbridled fun when the famous crime writer decided to celebrate his 85th birthday. Harlan Tromby prepared an event with special chic, where his entire family gathered, but the man could not have guessed what tragic consequences awaited his relatives ahead. The joy of the meeting turned into despair for the guests, the old birthday man died immediately after the end of the festive evening. Representatives of law enforcement agencies arrived at the scene, convinced by the family that the man died of natural causes. The police understood that a murder had been committed, and it is quite likely that the murderer is one of the people present. An experienced and fair detective, Benoit Blanc, was invited for the investigation, only he is capable of solving such complicated and complicated cases. The family of the murdered man did not look depressed, they wanted to get out of the mansion as soon as possible, and then gather for the announcement of the will, where someone will get the lion's share of all the property of the insured author. The detective began to study the evidence, but he was constantly hindered by family members and loyal servants of the deceased.

title: Suspiria
description: The plot revolves around an American ballerina named Susie. The main character flew from America to the capital of Germany with one single goal - to enter a famous dance academy. The girl dreams of dancing in a legendary troupe with famous ballet stars. Only Suzy, from the very first minutes of being in the walls of the dance academy, began to notice something ominous and supernatural. And a little later, she began to realize that she would become another victim of the curse if she could not solve the secret hidden within the walls of the legendary academy.

title: Rampage
description: At the very heart of the events is the primatologist Davis Okoy. The main character of the movie "Rampage" avoids human society in every possible way and is friends with a huge gorilla named George. This is his real friend, whom he raised in the conditions of a genetic experiment from an early age. They don't need anyone in this life, because they are just happy together. But, one day the irreparable happens, which will force the man to reconsider his relationship with this animal. And the following happened. Primatologist Davis Okoya is at the heart of the events in the laboratory where he was housed. The main character of the film "Rampage" avoids human society in every possible way and is friends with a huge gorilla named George. This is his real friend, whom he raised in the conditions of a genetic experiment from an early age. They don't need anyone in this life, because they are just happy together. But, one day the irreparable happens, which will force the man to reconsider his relationship with this animal. And the following happened. In the laboratory where George was, an unforeseen malfunction occurs, which led to a sudden surge of gorilla activity. The alpha male has become a cruel and unruly beast. But the whole horror of what is happening is that there are a huge number of such monsters. They broke free and began to terrorize the entire city, destroying everything in their path.

title: Witch: Mistress of Darkness
description: She never wanted to be mean. She simply protected the weak and disadvantaged in her magical forest. On her own experience, she encountered manifestations of human cruelty. And it changed her. The heroine of the fantasy film "Sorceress: Mistress of Darkness", disappointed in people, decided to leave the human world. But he himself caught up with her. And then she had to fight back her abusers. Despite the fact that Maleficent once cast an evil spell on the young and beautiful princess Aurora, she herself saved her and gave her the opportunity to live and make others happy. And that's why a mysterious and mutual connection has developed between them. Aurora is preparing to become a future queen and is studying the etiquette of aristocrats. She wants to be a good ruler and is therefore interested in the life of courtiers. And Maleficent continues to help the weak and disadvantaged, protecting them from humans. Soon she will have to face new enemies. But along with them, new allies will appear. If you like fairy tales and want to see the continuation of the previous fantasy part, then do not miss the family film "Sorceress: Mistress of Darkness".

title: Ibiza
description: The storyline of this comedic story revolves around an elderly and conservative doctor named Philip. It is not for nothing that they say that every age is subject to love, so the main character of "Ibiza" fell in love with a pretty woman named Carol. A man tries to win the support of his two teenage children with his new lover. He hopes to spend a family vacation with them by the sea, but the young people choose Ibiza, where the lover of a quiet holiday will have a hard time. Here's what you can't do for the sake of your beloved woman, and our hero has no choice but to pack his bags.

title: Roll into the asphalt
description: The action of the crime-drama action film "Roll into the Asphalt" with elements of a thriller, shot by the joint efforts of American and Canadian cinematographers, begins at the moment when the elderly Ridgeman, who has a lot of experience in finding criminals, as well as his friend Anthony, who is distinguished by a special contempt for laws and norms, find themselves in a difficult situation. This happens at the moment when a video is leaked on the global network, which shows footage of how they brutally extract a confession from a person suspected of committing a crime. Immediately after that, the friends are removed from the police service. Former policemen are horrified to realize that their reputation is too badly tarnished, and they can earn money only by serving in the police. Having no means of livelihood, the friends decide to try their hand at the world of crime, which they have been fighting all these years. But they did not take into account that at the same time the man they once put behind bars was released. And now he wants to take revenge on the offenders.

title: Atomic blonde
description: The action of the film "Atomic Blonde" takes place in Berlin at the end of the eighties of the last century. There is a special tension in the city, and the local residents understand that irreversible changes will soon take place. Many are waiting for changes, but no one knows whether they will be for the better or have a negative impact. At the heart of the story is Lorraine Broughton, an experienced MI6 agent. With an extensive track record behind her, she is rightfully considered an elite agent of the highest level. Regularly proving her professionalism, she takes part in the most difficult operations. Lorraine heads to Berlin in order to identify and destroy a spy organization whose members eliminated one of the agents who worked undercover. She is ordered to work with David Percival, head of the Berlin residency. Having formed an unstable alliance with him, Lorraine puts her entire arsenal of skills into action, hoping that she will have time to prevent a national-scale danger that threatens an intelligence operation arranged by Western countries.

title: Wheel of Miracles
description: The action of the film "Wheel of Miracles" takes place in America in the fifties of the last century. At the very beginning, we meet a young and pretty woman named Karolina. She comes to the local amusement park to try to escape from her problems. Her marriage led to her learning a great deal. And now she is being hunted by dangerous people. Then we meet Gini, who works as a waitress. She has a young son from a previous marriage that was destroyed, leaving her with guilt. The point is that Ginny truly loved her boyfriend, but emotionally put pressure on him. As a result, she herself destroyed the relationship, getting entangled in her lies. And now she is again in a difficult relationship. Ginny begins a new romance with a young graduate student who works as a lifeguard in the summer. The dramatic film "Wheel of Miracles" is a story of violent passion, betrayal, love and cruelty, which tells the story of four different heroes, whose lives are completely randomly intertwined in the active life of a popular and sought-after amusement park.

title: Project "Florida"
description: Mooney lives with his family in an old hotel called "Magic Castle", which is located near the famous Disneyland in Florida. According to the plot of "The Florida Project", a spoiled six-year-old girl is on her own until her poor mother tries to make ends meet. Sometimes Mooney's mother resorts to very original methods that go against the law. Moony's best friends are the neighborhood kids Jens and Scoota. Together with them, the girl likes to wander around the neighborhood without supervision and without a specific goal.

title: Cafe of wishes
description: The French comedy-drama film "The Beautiful Age" or "Desire Cafe" introduces us to a man named Victor. In the past he was a professional artist, but now the hero is going through an acute crisis. And all because his marriage with Marianna got out of control. In addition, Victor is too impressed by the change in the world around him. It is difficult for him to live with modern technologies. Viktor understands that they are putting pressure on him. Maksim, Viktor's son, notices that his father is depressed. He turns to his friend Antoine, who works in a company that organizes unique evenings. The company's employees mix historical reenactments with theatrical elements to immerse people in another era for a short period of time. Viktor reluctantly agrees to participate. He asks to create for him an entourage of mid-1974, when he met his beloved. And when the appointed day comes, Viktor falls out of reality and is mistaken in his memories.

title: Amityville Horror: The Awakening
description: The story happened back in the fall of 1974. The Defeo family was killed on the street of one of the towns. The police immediately go to the scene of the murders and realize that they have all been killed. The family was sleeping and none of them had any idea that someone would come and shoot them. Ronald is the man who killed them. When we get to know him, we understand that he is a father and a husband. When they started asking him about all this, he didn't even deny anything, and could tell about his own actions in detail. After a while, he starts telling law enforcement agencies quite scary things. Something very scary lived in this house. The voice said that it was necessary to kill everyone in the house, because if he did not do this, then he would have serious problems.

title: Bridget Jones's Child
description: In the third part of the incredible adventures of the charming blonde, she will again find herself in the very center of events. After a long time after the events shown in the first two parts, Bridget Jones never legalized her relationship with Mark Darcy. Although they are close friends, she has no intention of tying her fate with this man. Her career is on the upswing, she has a luxury apartment in the center of London. Plus, she will learn that she will soon become a happy mother. The girl still does not know who the father of the child is. After all, she met with Mark, who became a successful lawyer, and with a solid billionaire.

title: A true lie
description: James Cameron's wonderful action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. The film became truly cult, it was after it that Schwarzenegger stopped being perceived exclusively as the Terminator. His scenes with Jamie Lee Curtis, especially one of them, cause a sincere smile and admiration. Cameron's beautiful direction, mischievous lightness in the behavior of the characters and a simple plot make it possible to consider the film a wonderful family movie. For his family, Gary Tasker is a loving husband and father, a modest and absent-minded computer salesman who does not grab the stars from the sky, but is a real example for his family. In fact, Harry is a special intelligence agent who carries out the most important secret missions with the risk of life. He is a real genius, polyglot, has all kinds of weapons, and can defeat any villains.

title: Atlantis
description: The events of the film "Atlantis" develop immediately after the end of the First World War. The ship approaches a desert island located at the very edge of the Arctic Circle. It is far from any shipping routes and isolated from civilization. Despite this, the research conducted here has practical significance. At the heart of the story is a meteorologist who accepts an invitation to work for one year on this remote island right in the middle of the ocean. He is thrown to the edge of the earth, where he must find a meteorologist whose annual shift is coming to an end. However, coming ashore, he does not meet anyone. The lighthouse keeper does not come out to greet the first person in a year who set foot on this place. The main character tries to find him, but does not find any traces. But all this will turn out to be a trifle after he spends the night in a small wooden house. When night falls, strange creatures will begin to lay siege to the island.

title: Braven / Wild
description: In the center of the story, told by the authors of the film "Braven", is Joe Braven, a humble woodsman living in the wilderness. He leads a secluded lifestyle, like a Wild one, together with his family. Joe never bothers anyone, but in case of danger, he is ready to stand up for himself. Meanwhile, he and his family members live in harmony and peace together with wild forest animals. The situation changes when a group of drug dealers who are hiding from justice appear nearby. They know that the police are looking for them in the nearest cities and on the road, so they have no choice but to wait a few days in the backwoods. And thanks to chance, they find Joe's house. Without thinking for a long time, the criminals decide to wait right here until the police clear the road. Only Joe has no intention of sitting around and waiting for them to leave. He is not going to sacrifice his freedom and his home. Joe plans to fight criminals. The drug dealers themselves have no idea that they need to be afraid not of wild animals, but of the forester who watches over them.

title: Dr. Nock Scam
description: The events of the film "The Fraud of Dr. Nock" take place in France in the mid-1950s. In the center of the story is an experienced pickpocket and incorrigible adventurer named Nok. Being a born swindler and manipulator, he easily deceives those around him. But one day the situation gets out of control, after which NOK has to leave. After some time, the protagonist finds himself in a small provincial town. Hiding from his past, he cannot escape from himself. Nok decides to take advantage of the fact that he has no acquaintances in the new city. He introduces himself as a doctor and begins to treat people who are not sick with anything. Thanks to his behavior, the gift of persuasion and charisma, he easily imposes his opinion on the patient. Soon the main character becomes a local celebrity. Crowds of patients come to him every day. Unexpectedly for himself, Nok falls in love. At the same time, an old acquaintance appears in his life, ready to reveal the truth about his past to everyone.

title: Infinity
description: The main characters of the movie "Infinity", Justin and Aaron, find themselves in a sect. Despite their young age, they understand that they want to live differently. Tired of what is happening here, the brothers decide to run away. And soon they will be able to hide from the followers of a mysterious cult. From this moment, a new life begins for the heroes. Exactly nine years pass, and the brothers practically do not remember what happened to them before. They are happy and do not want to change anything. However, one day both receive a mysterious letter written by members of the sect from which they managed to escape. The brothers understand that they have been known about them all this time. Sectarians were watching them, but they did not make themselves known for nine years. But what happened? Why now? This question worries Aaron, who wants to find out everything. He manages to persuade Justin to return. Once there, the brothers witness events that they cannot explain in any way. Something strange and supernatural is happening here. What the members of the cult believe in takes real shape.

title: Gran Torino / Gran Torino
description: True hard film "Gran Torino" about American life, concerning the national question. This is a film about a strong man, about a patriot who did not live his life in vain, found wisdom, and at the end of his life, at the most difficult moment, chooses the most correct path, does his last heroic act. Not so long ago, his wife left for another world. The woman asked Walt to fulfill her last will. She wanted her husband to confess. Only the man himself, who went through the Korean War, is sure that he has nothing to confess and repent of. In addition, there is no such person next to him who can be completely trusted. No acquaintance deserves as much trust of the main character as his faithful dog named Daisy. Many of the people he once knew have long since left for another place or died. Next to him live emigrants whom Walt does not like very much. The man is not happy with what he sees around him. Teenagers who put themselves first are constantly roaming his street. And although Walt Kowalski despises his neighbors, immigrants, he soon gains respect for their friendly family, who continue to honor family traditions. Talking with them, he is surprised to realize that he has much more common views and interests with this family than with the families of his children.

title: Horror stories 2: Ghosts of Halloween
description: In the second part, the viewer is waiting for a plot no less exciting than in the previous series. Young guys, as well as all residents of the city, are destined to face a restless Halloween. The thing is that the teenagers found a rather strange book by R. L. Stein in an abandoned house. The boys soon realized why it was hidden from prying eyes. It turns out that it was necessary for our heroes to open it, as the whole city was overrun by various monsters, vampires, werewolves, witches and other characters from horror films. Now the boys need to do something urgently before tragedy strikes.

title: Horror stories
description: The first part is about a young man named Zack, who moved with his parents to a provincial town. One day he will release hungry werewolves, ill-mannered zombies, aggressive garden gnomes, a giant unbalanced snowman and other representatives of the horrors that were on the pages of Robert Stein's bestsellers. The whole thing is that Zack was able to meet a girl of the same age named Hannah. She lived in a rather bleak house that exuded quiet horror. It was in her home that Robert Stein's books were found, which our heroes accidentally opened and released the monsters outside.

title: Togo / Togo
description: The plot of this dramatic picture is based on the real story of a sled dog from Alaska named Togo. In 1925, when the city of Nome was engulfed by a deadly epidemic, the little husky Togo, together with his master Leonard Seppala, became one of the leaders of the rescue mission to deliver medicine. On a difficult snowy and icy road, experiencing frosts and storms, our hero showed record speed and endurance. In a team with other sled dogs, Togo, despite the terrible weather conditions, was able to deliver a parcel with an antitoxin to the city, which stopped the spread of the disease.

title: Tulip fever
description: When Sophia came of age, the abbess advised her to marry a rich citizen, Cornelius. But the heroine did not feel any feelings for him. Once, in order to conquer the girl's heart, the man wished that her beautiful features were reflected in the portrait. For this, a young artist Yan was invited, to whom the merchant promised a handsome sum for his work. Mutual attraction flares up between young people. Meanwhile, the girl's husband begins to take care of Maria, who is widowed and raises a small child. The paternal feeling extends to the mother as well. Meanwhile, one of the maids finds Sofia with Jan. The heroine breaks up with Cornelius and moves into the artist's small, poor house. At this time, there is a stir in the country around rare tulip bulbs. In one day, selling these plants makes crazy money.

title: Unknown
description: At the epicenter of the plot is a man who is forced to prove his ability anew and even return his former name. The main character of "Unknown" was in a coma for a long time. And at this time, his personality was brazenly appropriated by another person. After many days and nights, while the man was in a hospital bed in an unconscious state, he was lucky to wake up. Only the surrounding reality plunged him into a real shock. He lost himself as a person. Even his own wife does not recognize him as a man. Then the hero of the picture, in the hope of returning everything to its place, goes on an exciting adventure. And he is helped by a young woman who works as a taxi driver in a local taxi park.

title: We are the Millers

description: The storyline of this crime drama tells about young, but very dangerous people. They can safely be called the piranhas of Naples, because only the bravest can become the new kings of the criminal world of this Italian metropolis. They are distinguished from the gray mass by expensive clothes, tattoos and a cold look. They cut through the dense stream of cars on expensive scooters almost every day. Their friendship and honor are often tested in street skirmishes. They live life to the fullest, but they are ready to kill and die for their dream of power, money and love.

title: Illusionist
description: The main events take place in the capital of Austria at the beginning of the twentieth century. A man appears in Vienna who calls himself none other than an illusionist named Eisenheim. He creates such tricks in public that many may consider them to be witchcraft. But even more people believe that this is a banal miracle. One way or another, the man was able to become a famous artist with a very narrow focus. One day he attracted the attention of Prince Leopold himself, who came to one of the performances together with his future bride named Sophie. This girl was able to become quite a significant figure in Vienna, because at the moment when she appeared in the hall, strange things began to happen in the city based on the past.

title: Very bad mothers
description: The first part of the tape about "Very Bad Moms" begins with Amy Mitchell, who manages to remain an attractive woman. She manages to work two jobs, raise children, go to parent-teacher conferences at school, maintain a house, a dog and an obnoxious husband. At the regular mother-in-law meeting, she meets the housewife Kiki, who has no voice at all at home, and the stubborn and cheerful single mother Karla. Amy finds time to spend it in a bar with her new friends. Already, having had a good drink, they decide that it is enough to endure all this. Now the three girlfriends will live only for their loved ones. After that, many people cannot recognize them. From exemplary mothers, they were transformed into real desperadoes. The newly minted rebels now go all out, hang out in nightclubs flirting with men, drink until they drop.

title: The man who changed everything
description: The plot of the picture is based on the famous book by Michael M. Lewis. In it, he indicated a person who is capable of changing literally everything. It's about a baseball coach named Billy Beane. The man came to the Oakland team when it was not so famous. He devoted his entire conscious life to raising the boys from the baseball team to a new quality level. Of course, he had to go through the bitterness of disappointments, failures and mistakes. But they don't become champions without it. Billy firmly believed that he could create a competitive group of professionals. And he succeeded. His boys began to bring results, and at the highest level. The picture also shows what the coach and players had to go through before becoming great people.

title: It's a stupid love
description: Kol and Emily Weaver have been together for twenty-five years. However, luck came to an end when the wife announced on the wedding anniversary that she loved someone else and wanted a divorce. In desperation, a man goes to a bar. A guy in his thirties joins the hero at the table and introduces himself as Jacob Palmer. He is an excellent lover and a beautiful macho. He gives some good advice to the modest and shy Kol. This is how a decent family man turns into a conqueror of women's hearts. Only he still loves his wife and hopes that she will return to him. Meanwhile, Robbie's son is head over heels in love with his nanny Jessica. And this can be explained, because they are thirteen and seventeen years old, respectively. But the nanny has nothing to do with the young teenager, because she wants to build happiness with her employer, and he is already well over forty.

title: Midnight in Paris
description: The heroes of the film are a young married couple who came to the European capital from America pursuing different goals. The young man, Gil, is creative by nature, so his goal in Paris is to find inspiration for writing his next work. His young wife, Ines, sees the trip as an exciting entertainment trip. Where, if not in Paris, is it necessary to relax and go for a walk? Fortunately, she meets a couple of old acquaintances who support Ines in all her wishes. While his wife is having a lot of fun, Gil wanders the night streets of Paris, suddenly finding himself in the twenties of the last century. It is here that he meets Salvador Dali, Hemingway and Fitzgerald. What an unforgettable night it will be for our hero!

title: Training day
description: The main character of the film decides to connect his professional activity with the department that deals with the fight against the illegal distribution of narcotic substances. At that moment, he was an ordinary novice in such a difficult field. However, Jake Hoyt tries to learn quickly in order to please his superiors with his success. On his first working day, the main character of the film faced various obstacles. He became a participant in a lot of ridiculous situations. As luck would have it, he was given a not-quite-honest policeman as his partner.

title: Sixth sense / The sixth sense
description: Malcolm Crowe is an experienced psychoanalyst. The hero of "The Sixth Sense" was even thanked by the city mayor for his good work in this field. One day, his former patient - Vincent - breaks into the man's house. He blames the man for not being able to deal with his problem, after which he shoots the psychiatrist, and then kills himself. Malcolm was knocked off his feet, because he begins to realize that the boy has lived his whole life in fear. Later, he meets nine-year-old Cole, the man realizes that the boy is as smart and intelligent as Vince, and he is tormented by all the same fears. After several sessions, a new patient tells the hero that the souls of people who do not yet understand that they have died come to him.

title: Rainy day in New York
description: He is from a very wealthy and influential family living in a good area of ​​New York. She lives in a small provincial town in Arizona. It seems that the main characters of the comedy film "A Rainy Day in New York" have nothing in common. However, fate will soon prove that this is not the case, and even two different people can find something that will bring them together, changing their lives. A boy raised in Manhattan wants to show his girl the city that made him happy. And he has such a chance. It happens at the moment when the girl goes on a business trip to interview a popular director. But a heavy rainy day changes a lot. Two heroes meet and understand that this meeting is not accidental. Soon he will meet his forgotten girlfriend, and she will drag herself into the bohemian world. And who knows what else is waiting for them on this gloomy day. Do you like comedy stories that tell about how cityscapes and bad weather change people's lives? Then we recommend paying attention to the movie called "Rainy Day in New York". We wish everyone a pleasant viewing.

title: Alice in the Looking Glass
description: The plot of the second part revolves around a cute and charming girl who constantly appears in the most incredible stories. This time, Alice was destined to go on a journey through time. She will definitely end up in the magical country of the Looking Glass. Here she will meet new friends, obstacles, traps and even enemies. And all because the girl's best friend, the Mad Hatter, got here earlier. It was in search of him that the young lady went to the magical land. She is not afraid of meeting with fairy-tale characters who are not always benevolent. Many of them do not want to help the main character. But, there are also such specimens that are ready to provide assistance in the search for the lost Mad Hatter.

title: The stars are to blame
description: The plot of this picture is based on the novel of the same name by the American writer John Green, which is rightfully considered a world bestseller. The main character of "Wine Stars" is a young, pretty girl named Hazel. All her external beauty is overshadowed by the fact that she is terminally ill - she has terminal cancer. Once the girl met a handsome young man named Augustus. He is self-confident and a little cynical. Cupid's arrow flew between the young people. This is their first love, which means it's real.

title: Slevin's lucky number
