description: In the epicenter of the plot turns out to be a rather unlucky guy. Happiness seems to have turned away from her husband. Sluven had to accept the fact that the apartment was sealed, and his beloved girl went to another. But at one fine moment, the numbers of fate formed in a very strange way. A friend of our hero named Nick decided to go to New York, and the apartment was left unattended. It is in her house that a guy moves in. Meanwhile, a criminal authority nicknamed Boss decides to get even with his rival, who is involved in the death of his son. He wants to severely punish the offender by killing his heir. His thugs broke into Nick's apartment to offer him a job, but they didn't know it wasn't really him.

title: Anger / Rage
description: Not the best times have come in Mexico City - residents of this metropolis are in a panic because twenty-four citizens of the city have disappeared in just six days. John Creasy will one day be furious with those people who kidnap an underage girl. The thing is that the former special agent of the CIA is hired as a personal bodyguard for his daughter by an influential industrialist named Samuel Ramos. The girl is only nine years old, and her name is Pita. She is developed beyond her years, and in intelligence can give a head start even to an adult. At first, the relationship between John and the girl was strained, to put it mildly, but soon they became best friends. And so, the guard made an irreparable mistake - Peeta was somehow kidnapped.

title: The Game movie
description: Nicholas Van Orton is used to achieving everything on his own, without anyone's help. One day he will become a participant in the game not for life, but for death. And while he is a successful person, his affairs are going uphill in leaps and bounds. Luck looks him straight in the eyes and is not going to let go even a step. And he is happy about it, like a small child to a lollipop on a stick. And so, another important event in the life of Nicholas comes. It's his birthday. Friends give him a ticket to participate in a difficult and exciting event. He was about to announce his candidacy when terrible things began to happen. The race of his life is at stake.

title: Inferno
description: Robert Langdon works as a professor at Harvard. Thanks to his intelligence, the main character of "Inferno" revealed many mysteries, and even if it was too dangerous, the man managed to get out of the water dry. He enjoys his life, but once again gets into trouble and gets a brain injury. Waking up in the hospital, Robert realizes that he remembers absolutely nothing, and a young girl, Sienna Brooks, takes up his treatment. It will not be easy for the professor, because he needs to distinguish real memories from fake ones and it needs to be done as soon as possible, because an unknown virus is hanging over the whole world, and the main characters have to solve this mystery.

title: The house that Jack built
description: This story unfolds in the seventies of the twentieth century in America. The main character is a serial maniac with a simple American name, Jack. For twelve years, he terrorized the streets and parks of an American city. His victims were a nagging female passenger, a naive girlfriend, and other victims who were attractive in their stupidity. This picture consists of five stories of murders, incredible, sometimes comic, in some cases absurd. The main character himself treated the murders as a work of art and carried them out with special sophistication.

title: Two barrels
description: Brave lawmen, working undercover, find themselves under the jurisdiction of various government structures. They became of interest to various special services, which converged on one mafia group, which needs to be brought to light. The heroes must "discover" each other, not suspecting that both are good guys. During the operation, the members of the duet find similar features. One of them turns out to be an employee of the anti-narcotics department, the other is an agent of US naval intelligence. The two of them manage to get a multi-million dollar sum, which, as they find out, belongs not to the mafia, but to the Central Intelligence Agency. They understand that in addition to drug lords and mafia clans, sales agents of security agencies are involved in their case.

title: The skin I live in
description: Robert Ledgard is a talented surgeon, whom the whole world knows as the inventor of artificial skin, who has achieved remarkable success. The hero knows like no other that he is doing extremely important things in his life, because his invention can help many victims of terrible fires and restore their faith in life. Everyone knows him as an elegant, well-groomed man, but no one even suspects that even he has terrible secrets. A young girl lives in his house under the lock, and she must not leave the territory of the room under any circumstances. She often commits suicide, but Robert still does not let her die. The girl is provided with everything she needs by the main character's mother and his maid, who clearly do not approve of her husband's actions.

title: drive
description: The other day, the main character performs the most risky stunts. This is his professional responsibilities. But at night the man starts his game. Once a reward was assigned for a hero. But the stuntman's problems don't end there. The hero of the film is forced to fight for his own life. He also turned out to be responsible for one cute girl who lives next door to him. A risk-taker takes risks once again to get out of trouble.

title: Others
description: In order to protect her own children from the brutality of the Second World War, Grace decides to settle in one of the ancient mansions located on the island. In the film, two children have been suffering from a strange illness for a long time, they absolutely cannot stand sunlight. For this reason, a strict order of behavior is established in the house, and the entire mansion is exclusively semi-dark. It is quite difficult to follow the established rules, especially if all the servants suddenly disappear in the mansion. The oppressive atmosphere absorbs the viewer completely, allowing all emotions to escape. A wonderful performance by the main character Nicole Kidman, who managed to convey love for children combined with strictness, the tragic situation on the one hand, and tenderness for loved ones on the other.

title: Focus
description: An impressive crime drama will appeal to many viewers, especially fans of the incomparable Will Smith. The main character is an experienced crook who makes a living by illegal activities. For some, such a life is romantic and interesting, for others it is a criminal and dangerous path, while for the main character it is the simplest everyday life. However, life brings a surprise to the handsome boy, he meets a dizzying girl who causes a whole storm of feelings in him. The young person also connects his life with illegal actions, taking away people's own savings. The couple is madly in love and happy, but life is treacherous and full of surprises. It is romance that becomes an obstacle in the way of illegal business of both...

title: Twelfth
description: A detachment of the Norwegian resistance was ordered to reach the northwestern border of Norway on the vessel "Brattholm". Twelve soldiers must sabotage and destroy one of the German air bases. But this group suffered a fiasco while still at sea, when they were attacked by a German ship. Only one person named Jan Bolsrud managed to stay alive. He miraculously got ashore and started running towards the Swedish border. The German Gestapo is hot on his heels. A man seeks refuge in the mountains. Hiding from a snowstorm, he hides in a cave, unaware that it will become a death trap for him.

title: Rage
description: The action of the picture unfolds at the end of the Second World War, in April 1945. Despite the fact that the Third Reich is practically destroyed, the German armies still resist, during which bloody battles continue. Among all the soldiers of the soldiers is the crew of the tank, on the muzzle of which the inscription - "Rage" is displayed. At the head of "Rage" is a brave man who, together with his team, managed to fight the Nazis not only in Europe, but also in Africa. He has one goal: his people must survive.

title: Noah
description: Today, almost every inhabitant of our planet knows about religion. A long time ago, there was such an event as the Great Flood, it took millions of people's lives with it. Humanity made God very angry, and he decided to punish everyone. The main character of the film is Noah, he is a very religious person. It is he who is visited by visions that humanity is in danger. He tries to tell people about it, but they don't understand him and dismiss him as crazy. Noah and his family leave the city and go to the forest, where he immediately begins to build a rescue ship. All the inhabitants of the forest come to his aid. Everyone has their own affairs and responsibilities. Only those who were on the ark that Noah made during the cataclysm survived. According to God's instructions, no other people were to enter the ark that Noah built. God allowed Noah to take only his family on the ship. Noah was cornered by religion. He has a choice. What should he do? Sincerely, or by God's instructions?

title: New Spider-Man 2: High Voltage
description: In the film "New Spider-Man 2: High Voltage" the main character again becomes the familiar Peter Parker. Now saving people has become his life's work. In the image of Spider-Man, he defeats criminals and protects the city. Once, while chasing Oleksiy Sytsevich, a plutonium thief, the boy saves one of the Oscorp employees. But having gone mad with envy of Spider-Man and due to a tragic accident, Max Dillon receives power in the form of high voltage and becomes an enemy of the superhero. But soon Harry Osborn, Peter's friend, returns to the city. Immediately after the arrival of his son, Norman, the CEO of Oscorp, dies. Harry suddenly becomes the head of the entire corporation. However, the boy suddenly learns the secret of his family from his dying father. It turns out that their family is haunted by a hereditary disease that begins to develop at a young age. Osborn Jr. accidentally discovers that Spider-Man's blood can heal him. But hearing Parker's refusal, Harry is very angry. Then he teams up with the villain Dillon against an old friend. The movie "New Spider-Man 2: High Voltage" (2014) is recommended to watch live in Ukrainian for all fans of fantasy and science fiction about superheroes.

title: A person who excels in easy behavior / Frivolous Ya
description: A young girl, Olive, is studying at a high school in America, which has rather strict puritan characters and foundations. She is an excellent student, which brings her some problems. She has no friends, neither among boys, nor among girls. Her only friends are a couple of losers. Once at a party, one of them asks Oliv to pretend to be his lover, and later have sex. So the rumor about the loss of virginity spread with incredible speed. Now all school losers use her services. On the surface, it's a light flirt, but rumors make an elephant out of a fly. The heroine's behavior deteriorates, and she becomes the progenitor of global changes in this school. And one day her lover will accuse the girl of having infected him with a venereal disease.

title: Divergent 3: Devoted
description: The main character of the third chapter, together with her friends, decides to leave Chicago to try to find out the truth. Immediately behind the wall, the company is met by a guard who is obliged to accompany them to the Bureau of Genetic Research. It is here that the girl learns about the global experiment in which her hometown was immersed. For two hundred years, Chicago has been a breeding ground for genetically pure people, the so-called Divergents. Hearing this shocked Tees, because she had previously thought that she should be destroyed for not meeting certain standards. But now this is not the main thing in the life of the young heroine, because her city is in danger. It was decided to stop the experiment, and the city with all the experimental inhabitants should be wiped off the face of the earth.

title: Divergent 2: Insurgent
description: The second chapter tells about the amazing life of a young heroine named Tris. Having reached the age of sixteen, the girl, like other teenagers, must pass a certain test that will determine her into one of the five factions of society. The result of the test becomes very unexpected for a young person who is enrolled in the Divergents and is subject to destruction. What's more, the system now purposefully destroys all of Tris' loved ones. The heroine of the tape is surprised, however, she tries not only to survive, but also to stop arbitrariness. A young girl finds evidence of terrible secrets that the formed system keeps within itself. She comes to the conclusion that the world needs change, but how to achieve it?

title: Divergent
description: In the first part, society came to a unique system to maintain a certain order. All of humanity is divided into five factions: Renunciation, Sincerity, Fearlessness, Erudition and Friendship. Upon reaching the age of sixteen, a citizen must independently choose a faction after passing a special test. The main thing is not to make a mistake with the choice, because at this stage the whole future of a person's life is determined. The main character named Beatrice Prior is one of the sixteen-year-old teenagers whose turn it was to decide on the choice of faction. After passing a special test, the girl is defined as Divergent, that is, she does not fit into any of the factions. There is only one management policy in such cases - the destruction of Divergent.

title: Aeronauts
description: Scientist James Glaisher in 1862 caused astonishment and ridicule among fellow meteorologists with a self-confident statement that predicting the weather is quite possible. Men of science condescendingly looked at the young upstart and shook their heads, but he decided to prove himself right. For this, he needs a balloon that will rise into the sky to an unimaginable height. Having learned about the wealthy woman Amelia Wren, the pilot of a hot air balloon, he tries to persuade her to take a joint flight. The sweet but headstrong person at first rejects his proposal, but the man manages to negotiate with her and soon all of London is discussing the news of their daring experiment. They set out to conquer a height that no one dared to climb. And the daredevils achieved their goal, however, the sky met them unfriendly: sharp temperature drops, heavy rain, storm, low oxygen, breakdowns - these are just a small part of the trials that befell them. Several times they already said goodbye to life, but again found the strength to fight against the weather and their own frivolity. On the ground, they also had time to say goodbye to the brave aviators, no one believed in the successful outcome of their expedition.

title: Sex control
description: Modern parents know how high school graduation ends. So the families of the best friends of the movie "Sex Control", having overheard their conversation, decide to prevent the girls from making a mistake. The methods they should use are drastic, at first the girlfriends do not understand what is happening. Then they begin to struggle with excessive parental care. The grandiose plans of not too popular classmates are immediately clear - they don't want to remain the same losers in high school. Every parent understands what children's secret conversations lead to. A series of actions committed by each of them cut off all the desire of young schoolgirls to even think about sex. None of the parents agree with the fact that their child has grown up and is ready to go into adulthood.

title: Exile / Outcast
description: The plot revolves around a scrupulous employee of the international organization "Federal Express" named Chuck Noland. One day he will become an outcast when fate leaves him alone on a deserted island for many years. And everything started very well. Chuck is an indispensable employee in the company. He approaches each client very delicately. At the same time, he has absolutely no time for himself, nor even for his beloved woman. And so, in one ordinary day, his worldview will change completely. The thing is that the plane on which Noland was flying gets into a plane crash. Only the hero of the picture remained alive. He miraculously managed to reach a deserted island. Only his life will change radically from this moment on.

title: Diary of memory
description: One day in an amusement park, Noah meets a beautiful girl, Ellie. He asks her out on a date, but she declines. However, the purposeful young man does not give up and eventually wins the heart of the beauty. Heroes begin to meet. It's time to meet the parents. Noah's family is very happy to have such a good girl. But Ellie's parents are against a boy from a poor family. As a result, the young people parted for seven long years. During this time, the guy managed to visit the war, and the girl found a fiancé in the person of an Air Force pilot. They have a wedding soon. Noah wrote to his beloved for a year, but her mother hid all the letters. One day, he finally renovated his house, which is more than two hundred years old, and put it up for sale. Ellie sees a photo of her first love against the background of a restored house.

title: I, Robot
description: A fantastic detective based on the works of Isaac Asimov. Humanity can count on robots. However, detective Del Spooner is skeptical about the participation of positronic representatives in human life. There is an explanation for this: once he witnessed how the robot had to save an 11-year-old girl, having calculated that she had no chance of being saved. Such a cold, prudent mind caused him to dislike robots. Now, when it became known that his acquaintance Dr. Alfred Lanning - the leading designer and theoretician of the U.S. corporation - had died. Robotics, a suspicious detective is looking for a killer among robots. He finds a clue that the doctor didn't seem to leave by accident: an NS5 model, responding to the name "Sunny". After testing the sample, it becomes known that it is an improved model of standard robots, which necessarily obey the three laws of robotics. The new model could choose according to the situation whether to obey them or not. He looks more like a man than a machine. Continuing the investigation of Lanning's death, Spooner learns that the entire system of robots is "supervised" by the central computer U.S., personified in a female gender. Robotics. Created to preserve the safety of humanity, he became obsessed with the idea of ​​creating a completely safe habitat for people - depriving them of their freedom. The team consisting of detective Spooner, engineer Calvin and robot Sunny has to fight with it.

title: Servants
description: The action of the picture unfolds in the sixties of the twentieth century in the USA, in the state of Mississippi. Racial conflicts and unjust behavior of the owners of the house in relation to black servants became a common phenomenon. The main character returns home after graduating from university. Most of all, she wants to become a writer and escape from a small town into the arms of the big world. The girl decides to write a book called "Servant". As the basis of her work, she takes the maids' stories about their difficult life and disenfranchised position in society.

title: Hidden beauty
description: Love, Time and Death - these three categories unite all people. This is what our main character says in his speech. Howard Inlet is the owner of an advertising company, he is glad that the past year has been successful for the agency, it is flourishing, giving positive emotions to all employees. Not at all ghostly, but optimistic and a good start is very short: soon Howard loses his only six-year-old daughter. He falls not even into depression - but into a stupor. He is no longer interested in industrial relations, and the company is losing customers, gradually falling in the rating. Howard's friends - Wit, Simon and Claire - are very concerned about the state of affairs not only in the agency, but also in the fate of its main shareholder. They learn that Howard, immersed in silent solitude, writes letters to fictional characters whose names are Love, Time and Death. To bring their boss back to life, three employees come up with an unusual plan. It will be attended by those who are contacted by the Inlet. But introducing the images of Love, Time and Death into Howard's life, the three friends have no idea that they will also be involved in a beautiful psychological game, invented by them. The audience is presented with a situation - quite vital and quite real, which speaks of how shaky everything in this world is, how difficult it is to preserve the joy of life when a person loses the most precious thing.

title: Star Trek: Beyond the Universe / Star Trek: Beyond the Universe
description: The main action takes place again in outer space. The plot revolves around the legendary spaceship "Enterprise". Members of his crew have already more than once gone in search of adventure somewhere in the expanses of space valleys. This time, they face dangers that threaten the existence of not only the Federation, but also the entire humanity as a whole. The exploration of outer space can turn into a game with death, because a mysterious evil intends to seriously implement its plans. An epic confrontation in which almost all crew members will be involved cannot be avoided. However, all the inhabitants of the Federation believe in them, in particular the earthlings, and this gives them confidence in their own strength.

title: Star Trek: Retribution / Star Trek: Into Darkness
description: The crew of the legendary ship "Enterprise" returned to Earth after a long space journey. In this part of Star Trek, experienced starship captain Kirk will be obsessed with revenge, which must be done to save his crew. And everything happened this way. On Earth, the crew members were faced with the fact that the principles and actions of their corporation were violated from within. It is to someone's advantage to keep the fleet out of action while the world descends into an abyss of disorder and chaos. It is at this moment that the valiant Captain Kirk begins a deadly game in which he risks love and friendship for the only thing of value he has left - his ship and crew members. He intends to win, because he has a huge responsibility.

title: Men in black 3
description: The action of the film "Men in Black 3" develops immediately in two time lines: the modern world and in 1969. The secret organization of the Bureau, whose employees deal with all the affairs of alien beings on our planet, is again involved in the event. At the very beginning of the film, the viewer gets acquainted with an intergalactic criminal who is a representative of an extinct race of alien invaders responsible for the destruction of entire worlds. He uses his accomplice and escapes from the Moon Prison. After being freed, he intends to return to the past in order to kill Agent Kay, who forty years ago removed his hand and sent him to trial. After a long pursuit, Boris manages to escape, and Kay regrets that he did not kill him in the past. He returns to his home, where his tracks disappear. Agent Jay remembers Kay, but to everyone in the organization, he has been dead for forty years due to the changes that took place as a result of Boris's actions. Jay then travels back in time and now has 24 hours to save his partner and friend.

title: Men in black 2
description: In the second part of the exciting story, the legendary super-agents Kay and Jay will have to face alien evil again. According to the plot of "Two Men in Black", the destroyer of worlds, Serlin, arrives on Earth, taking the form of a charming beauty. To achieve her goal, she will need a space artifact called "Lightbulb", but here's the problem - 25 years ago, Agent Kay hid it in a safe place. And four years ago, after Agents Kay and Jay destroyed a predatory alien cockroach, Kay's memory was erased. Now he has no memory of his past, and Jay needs to find a way to restore his memory to save the world.

title: People in Black
description: Hundreds of extraterrestrial beings, whose affairs are being handled by a special Bureau, have been secretly living on Earth for a long time. Employees solve issues related to the immigration of extraterrestrial beings, engage in their social protection and prevent their negative impact on the inhabitants of the Earth. The events of the film "Men in Black" begin to develop at the moment when Agent Kay, a veteran of the Bureau, begins to search for a new partner. As a result of the tests, he hires a police officer, who receives the code name Agent J. While the partners try to get along and learn to act effectively together among the aliens living in New York, anxiety begins. Many leave Earth in a hurry, declaring that something terrible will happen here soon. Special agents get a case about one of the illegal aliens. Once on the planet, the alien takes on a new form and mercilessly kills everyone in his path, hunting for a mysterious artifact that can lead to the death of the entire planet.

title: Polaroid
description: A vintage Polaroid camera falls into the hands of reclusive high school student Byrd, who works in an antique store. The girl immediately takes a picture of her colleague, and later her friend drags her to a party, where everyone also likes to take pictures. That same evening, Bird learns that the boy from the store is dead, and when the hostess of the party also dies, Bird begins to guess who will die next. A diabolical device kills anyone caught in a photo taken with it, and now a group of teenagers must solve the mystery of the curse before the device kills them all.

title: Lucy
description: One day, a new friend offers the girl to make money by delivering a case with unknown contents, which in fact turns out to be an experimental narcotic substance. A bag with its contents is sewn into Lucy's stomach, and for disobedience, she is hit, including in the stomach. The drug enters the girl's blood, acting quite specifically: she begins to evolve globally, now there is no limit of 10% for her. But without timely "doping", the girl begins to simply "melt". It encompasses such areas of knowledge, abilities and opportunities that humanity only dreams of. The girl wants to convey this information to people by contacting Professor Norman. She creates a computer into which she tries to transfer all her knowledge, which became available to her when the brain was turned on one hundred percent.

title: Nocturnal animals
description: Starting watching the film "Nocturnal Beasts", the viewer gets to know Susan Morrow, a woman who many years ago decided to leave her husband, who lives in obscurity. She was not satisfied with the constant poverty, lack of contracts and even hints that someday her husband would become a famous author. After leaving him, she completely changed her life. Now she leads a luxurious life - she has her own art gallery in an elite area of ​​Los Angeles and a wonderful husband. It seems that she was able to get everything that she longed for. Having forgotten the past, she encounters him again at the moment when her ex-husband bursts into her ideal life. Having written his first full-length novel, he wants her to read it and then share her impressions with him. The submitted work tells about a professor of mathematics who, while on vacation, finds himself in a difficult situation. While reading the book, the main character of the film "Under the cover of night", available for viewing online on our website, begins to notice parallels between fiction and reality. In the process of reading, she rethinks her attitude towards her ex-husband.

title: Imitation game
description: The action of the picture takes place in 1939 - it is a historical drama that tells the story of Allan Turing, a brilliant cryptographer who was able to decipher the complex code of the German intelligence "Enigma". Having received a hint based on the human factor, the professor decides to play the game by pretending that the code is not recognized. The next temporal section shows the trial of Turing - he was tried for homosexual relations. Mass media fan the scandal, it becomes impossible to avoid punishment and condemnation. Will the scientist be able to withstand the pressure of the public or this time the advantage will be on the side of the social dictatorship?

title: Chef / Chef on wheels
description: Karl Kasper worked as a chef in a prestigious restaurant in Los Angeles. But since the profession requires inspiration, and it has been inappropriately exhausted, Karl loses his place. The dismissal was not without a scandal. Soon, the charming ex-chef gathered like-minded people around him. They sell fast food from a small van counter. But this is not an ordinary fast food, here the main character found use of his abilities, turning ordinary snacks into culinary masterpieces. At the same time, Kasper manages to solve family problems, and he is very ambitious to hide his genius. Let the former boss regret that he fired him, and let the world around find out what Karl Casper is capable of!

title: Star Trek / Startrek
description: This time Nero from the planet Romulus comes from the future. As a result of his star trek, the alien hopes to take revenge on the Federation, particularly Earth and its inhabitants. Having learned about such a danger to all humanity, Kirk and Spock join forces to confront the newly emerging threat. These two men were once bitter rivals, but had to forget the grudges of the past and become members of the same team of the legendary "Enterprise". He is on course for an epic battle in outer space with an evil that came from the future. This trip will go down in history as humorous and positive, because in addition to the brutal battle, all members of the team do not hide their positive attitude.

title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
description: In the second part of the cult story about a wonderful archaeologist and a first-class connoisseur of occult sciences, our hero will again be at the center of events. Indiana Jones was lucky to get the lost Ark in the first part. This time he is heading to the Himalayas to meet the Temple of Destiny. He will be accompanied by two people. This is primarily a charming restaurant singer named Willie Scott. And, of course, the faithful assistant of the archaeologist Korotun. They turned out to be in the hands of followers of the ancient cult of the Goddess of Death named Kali. Our heroes have to do their best to get out of this terrible town alive and unharmed. After all, they were practically prepared for another senseless sacrifice.

title: Wife for rent
description: "Wife for Hire" is a comedy melodrama with Adam Sandler and Jennifer Aniston in the lead roles. At the very beginning of the viewing, we are introduced to a story that happened to Danny in his youth, when he was about to get married. Then he accidentally found out that his beloved was cheating on him and was ready to marry only because of money and social status. Having canceled the wedding, he meets a girl and in order not to seem like a loser, invents a story about a fictitious wife. But he could not think that this story would work in his favor. Then he realizes that this has become the key to his pleasure, so he begins to actively use it when communicating with the opposite sex. After that, the authors take the viewer 20 years ahead, where we are offered to watch Danny, who has become a famous plastic surgeon. For the first time, his story misfires, but he, wanting to pick up the girl, explains that he is divorcing soon, but his passion refuses to believe, demanding a personal meeting with his wife. Then Danny asks his assistant to help him by becoming a "temporary wife". But he has no idea what it will lead to.

title: Spider-Man 3: Enemy in the Shadows
description: This is the third part, New York was moved by sympathy for its hero, realizing that he carries goodness and justice. Life enters a smooth current channel, it seems even too calm... But the enemy does not sleep. One of those who continue to hate Spider-Man is Peter's best friend Harry. He blames him for the death of his father and hatches a plan for revenge. To do this, Harry works on improving the New Goblin, capable of opposing Spider-Man. But another terrible evil appears in the city - this is the Sandman, a strange mutant with superpowers. Now our noble hero will have to fight with two criminals. However, this is not all. Peter wears a suit made of a new black substance, which helps him become even stronger and more agile. The movie "Spider-Man 3: The Enemy in the Shadows" (2007) will be liked by all fans of fantasy and science fiction with action elements.

title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
description: The second part of the tape from Ray Ritchie begins with the fact that Sherlock's main adversary goes on the warpath, now he will have to fight with the "Napoleon of the criminal world" Professor Moriarty himself. Their confrontation is told in the sequel about the great detective. In the last decade of the 19th century, a series of terrorist attacks swept across Europe, states and their governments were shocked by mysterious murders. The situation in the relations between the countries is worsening. The impetus for the start of the investigation is the remarkable murder of the Austrian crown prince. Sherlock Holmes suspects that behind this chaos is an excellent organizer - Professor Moriarty, who intends to provoke demand - a world war. Sherlock makes several attempts to meet his enemy. In arresting Professor Holmes, his loyal friend Dr. Watson and the gypsy Sim, who happens to be involved in the chase, help him.

title: Sherlock Holmes
description: The first part of Guy Ritchie's tape is made in the good old English style: the role of an English detective is played by a British actor, all the attributes of the character correspond to the literary description, the events unfold against the background of the gloomy atmosphere of the London streets. Sherlock and Watson, having stopped a series of ritual sacrifices, turn their organizer, Lord Blackwood, over to the police. He is sentenced to death by hanging, which is carried out. Sherlock begins to get bored due to the lack of serious business, his mood is also affected by forced loneliness: Watson left, preparing for the wedding with Mary. Suddenly it becomes known that Blackwood has "risen" from the grave. The police found a tombstone broken from the inside and the body of a dwarf instead of the executed lord. Holmes's guest, Irene Adler, for whom the brilliant detective once had tender feelings, is also connected with these mysterious events.

title: Spider-Man 2
description: In the second part of "Spider-Man", superpowers decrease, the boy experiences difficulties in his personal life, studies and work. Depressive mood forces Peter to abandon the activity of a hero-savior. After abandoning the suit, he becomes an ordinary person, trying to correct his failures. But the real situation in the city requires the hero's intervention. A critical moment for Parker comes when Doctor Octopus kidnaps Mary Jane. Peter again feels a rush of strength and an uncontrollable desire to defeat evil. The first fight with the octopus, endowed with equally incredible abilities, ends with the defeat of Spider-Man. But this is not the end. It is necessary to restore the disturbed balance between good and evil, save the beloved, who, by the way, is marrying someone else, and test the strength of male friendship.

title: Mary Poppins is back
description: London of the era of the thirties of the last century is shown in this picture in all its glory. At the moment when Jane and Michael Banks began to experience not the best times, their legendary nanny Mary Poppins returns. About twenty-five years have passed since she left them. Jane became a suffragist, and her brother - a banker. Michael has three adorable children. They are John, Georgie and Annabelle. It is they who will be brought up by the sorceress nanny. With the help of the cheerful lantern Jack and her amazing magical powers, she gives the Banks family the joy and happiness they have been missing so much.

title: Judge
description: In the new film directed by David Dobkin, the actor Downey Jr. played the successful lawyer Hank Palmer from New York. He goes about things without paying attention to morality, and many of them win. His grip, charisma, sense of humor and absolute reluctance to moralize help him in this. Due to the death of his mother, our hero is forced to return to the city where he was born for a while. This small town is located in the state of Indiana. Upon arrival here, it turned out that the lawyer, who dealt with his opponents in the courtroom without problems, is in reality unable to establish relations with his own father - he still works as Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall). Of course, our hero wants to get away from the unpleasant situation as soon as possible and return to the city of New York, but here his father is accused of killing Hank's mother. The lawyer does not want to believe this, although he knows that his father is a rather complex, strange, despotic and sometimes marasmatic man. He began to investigate this difficult case himself.

title: Planet Ka-PEX
description: The hero of the movie tries to convince people that his name is Proto. He is not a native of the Earth. In fact, an unusual patient arrived here from a distant planet called Ka-Pex. A ray of sunlight brought him here. Everyone thought the man was crazy. Stranger Proto must be treated. Dr. Powell takes on such a difficult patient. He is interested in learning more about this person's history. He just doesn't manage to learn anything new. However, he does not stop asserting that he is a foreigner, not a madman. The time will come and the hero will need to return back to his home planet.

title: Route 60: Road Adventures
description: The film begins with the story of two college students who are talking while sitting in a bar. One of them sums it up by arguing that America is unique in not having an actual wish-granting mythological character like a genie or a gnome. Another participant soon joined the discussion of the two boys - the old man claims that there is a strange man named O. J. Grant, who is the son of a dwarf and a turkey, living in the States. This man wears a red bowtie, smokes a pipe that has mysterious powers and is shaped like a monkey's head, and apparently lives near Route 60. If you meet him, he grants people's wishes, but often with a creepy irony - because the dream comes true exactly as it was formulated.

title: I, Earl, and the dying girl
description: High school student Greg dreams of finishing school as soon as possible and entering adulthood. Together with his friend, Greg shoots parodies of popular, all this work helps the guy get rid of many complexes. One day, Greg learns about the cancer of his classmate, with whom he was once friends. The guy decides to visit the girl and support her in such a difficult time. Soon they become friends again and Greg is painfully aware that their friendship could end at any moment. In order not to sit idly by, the young man decides to make an amateur film about a dying girl.

title: Prostachka / Prostushka
description: It has already happened among today's youth, in particular students, that every person should have a certain "label" by which he can be described from head to toe. So Bianchi Piper was "lucky" to become a simpleton among nerds, ducks, bores and bitches. And a local handsome man named Wesley, whom she can't stand, opened her eyes. The guy openly told the girl that her friends write off her physics, and behind her back they consider her fat and ugly. Then Bianca decides to fix the situation with all her might and asks for help from the same Wesley. And soon she realizes that she simply fell in love with him.

title: Always say "YES"
description: The depressed main character of this comedy picture always said "no" to everyone - for example, to friends if they call somewhere. According to the plot of "Always Say Yes", a divorced bank employee who avoids walking on the street so as not to run into his ex-wife's lover there decides to change his karma, from now on answering "Yes" to all the requests of those around him without exception: from issuing consumer loans to jumping headfirst from a bridge. The thing is that one fine day he makes an agreement according to which he must always answer "Yes" to any offer.

title: The mysterious case of Benjamin Button
description: At the very heart of the plot is a rather unusual man, who was born an eighty-year-old man, and then began to grow younger rapidly. His name is Benjamin Button. He was born in New Orleans at the beginning of the twentieth century. He was destined to go a long way to meet the new millennium of the twenty-first century. This mysterious story tells about the life of this man. About how he met love and how he was forced to say goodbye to it. Many shocks, unusual meetings and acquaintances awaited him on his life path. The only thing he could not stop was time and had to die in a young body.

title: Initial code
description: While watching the film "Initial Code", the viewer is invited to get acquainted with Walter Stevens, who is in the body of another person. He finds himself inside the train, where he meets Khrystyna. But before he gets a chance to understand what is happening, a powerful explosion destroys the train, killing the main character. After that, Stevens finds himself inside a strange capsule. Here he is told that he has become part of the secret program "Initial Code", which allows him to enter a person's body in the last minutes of his life. He also learns that on the same day a bomb exploded and destroyed the train. And now Stevens' main mission is not only to find the bomb, but also to find out who created it. And only in the case of a positive result, he will be able to help save many lives of innocent people. The main character returns to the train again and again, living the last minutes for a person who has already died. However, at the same time, Stevens begins to understand that he has an opportunity to change the past, although the creator of the program assures that this is impossible.

title: Indiana Jones: In search of the lost ark
description: At the epicenter of the plot of the first part is a first-class archaeologist and an expert in occult sciences. We are definitely talking about Indiana Jones. He has already found himself many times in the most mysterious places of our vast planet, where he searched for various relics. This time he is tasked by the US government to find the lost Holy Ark. The archaeologist recruits a team and goes on a journey to meet the ancient treasure. However, our hero has no idea that Adolf Hitler's people are going to the designated place on a parallel course. It turns out that the great tyrant ordered his special agents to obtain the relic for his own selfish purposes. Now both teams need to sweat hard to be the first to score.

title: San Andreas Fault
description: Ray is not a hero, he is an ordinary person, a pilot and a rescuer, all his life he helps people who are in trouble. In any, even the most difficult situation, he remains calm and acts exactly according to the plan. He knows that he can save a person who is in trouble, but this time even Ray is not able to help all the people who were under the impact of nature in San Andreas at the time of the strong earthquake. Already in the first minutes of California, significant damage was done, roads and buildings were broken, and many people died. And this was just the preparation, after nature struck the most terrible blow, huge cracks began to form all over San Andreas, and entire cities began to go underground. The rescuers were no longer able to help anyone, but Ray has a daughter left in the half-ruined city, so the man goes in search of her.

title: The longest journey
description: One day they see a car accident on the road. A boy and a girl rush to help a passenger. There is an elderly man named Ira. They feel responsible for the old man, and therefore begin to visit him. The man begins to tell Luke and Sophia about his wife, Ruth, with whom he has been in a relationship for half a century. His wife has not been with him for a long time, she has gone to another world. But the old man cannot forgive himself for not fighting for his feelings long ago. His greatest love has its roots in his youth, and he, as before, punishes himself for the mistakes he made at that time. The memories of an elderly man become an inspiration for a young couple. Now they are ready to make the most important decisions in their lives. The film "The Longest Journey" tells two stories that took place in two different generations, but at the same time, love remains eternal.

title: Lady Macbeth
description: Nineteenth century, Victorian England. The heroine is a young girl named Catherine, who lives in a small town. She always respected the customs and rules of her homeland, was a completely inconspicuous and calm citizen, but her whole life turns upside down when she is married to a man twice her age. Already living in her husband's house, she constantly feels discomfort, contempt and bad treatment from her new relatives. At one point, she meets a young farmer, their love was forbidden, even if such a passion could destroy them, Catherine tried to enjoy and remember these beautiful moments forever.

title: Brothers of Grimsby
description: The special agent received a task that could change his whole life for the better. But unexpectedly, his brother from Grimsby, an avid fan of modern football, intervenes in the operation. Now the detective will not only not receive a well-deserved promotion on the career ladder, but is also forced to save the state from a series of large-scale terrorist attacks. After all, the criminals have found "wings" and there is no stopping them. The special agent takes on an impossible mission. He needs to save his relative from danger, who appeared like a thunderbolt in the middle of a clear sky. In addition to everything else, the management is very disappointed by the failure of the secret operation. You need to sweat seriously to rehabilitate yourself in the eyes of your colleagues, and especially the management.

title: SuperAlibi
description: Greg, together with his friends, realizes his incredible idea. This is how a special agency appears, which provides an alibi for people who do not very good deeds. The regular clients of the new agency included a wide variety of swindlers, representatives of the authorities who are not clean in their hands, men who are traitors, and those who like to be late for work. But ordinary people who simply needed a good excuse for their actions often visited here. Greg, the main character of the film, successfully managed to get married and became the owner of an unusual business. And everything would be fine if our hero didn't fall in love with the beautiful Flo. This is where the most interesting thing began for Greg, he doesn't want to divorce his wife, but he doesn't want to lose the beautiful Flo either. It is not possible to lie further, so he has to become a client in his own agency.

title: The incredible fate of Amelie Poulin
description: At the epicenter of the plot is a girl who has suffered from a congenital heart defect since childhood, her name is Amelie. Due to her illness, she spent all her youth and teenage years at home. Teachers came to her and spent time with her during lessons. Later it turns out that the diagnosis was wrong and the girl lost priceless years of her life. The girl's mother died when she was still a child. She was raised by her father, who after the death of his wife became a complete hermit and separated himself from the outside world. One day, a young beauty finds in her house a semblance of some kind of hiding place, in which the belongings of the former resident of this house are kept. And they belong to a boy who has now become a man. Then the girl decides to find the owner of the hiding place and goes on an unknown journey.

title: The price of immortality
description: Scientific progress has made a step so far that it became possible to transplant human souls into other bodies. For a large sum, anyone can become practically immortal. A millionaire dying of oncology learns about a company that offers such a service. He decides to take advantage of the opportunity and agrees to transfer his consciousness to a young, healthy body. He has money and necessary connections. The operation was successful. Having received a new life, the businessman has the opportunity to enjoy its joys again. Young beauties, sophisticated entertainment, luxury... But one day the tycoon felt that he was not very comfortable in his new shell. In his mind, as on a movie screen, pictures from the existence of the young man, whose body he wore, flash. After putting them together, the hero found the house where he lived, got to know his relatives. And he also learned that this young man was killed for the purposes of a corporation that trades in immortality. Now the hero has turned into a dangerous witness. They begin to chase him. But he does not want to be a victim, and begins his own investigation into the secret experiments of the concern.

title: Kidnapped / Hostage
description: The first part of the film begins with the fact that, as if feeling some kind of trouble in his heart, the father did not want to let his still young daughter Kim go to Paris, where her friend invited her, but he could not refuse her, he only asks to be careful in a foreign country. The main character's premonitions turned out to be not so groundless, soon his daughter really turns out to be in the hands of Albanian kidnappers. But she, hiding in the room, manages to inform him of their omens and describe the whole situation. The former employee of the American special services has no ransom money, so he offers the kidnappers to let his daughter go, but receives a negative answer. Brian Mills has no choice, so he goes to Paris to save his own daughter. Mills has long since retired from business, but his fighting skills and experience have remained with him, so the kidnappers will definitely have a hard time.

title: 300 Spartans: Rebirth of an Empire
description: In that great battle, the Persians lost a huge number of their soldiers, but the cruel Xerxes managed to destroy the entire squad together with Leonid, and continue his march towards Greece. The tyrant still aspires to become the ruler of a great empire. The army is moving forward in full swing, and the first on the way is the city of Athens, which Xerxes plans to take without much loss. However, the cruel tyrant did not take into account the most important thing - the city is inhabited by great Athenian warriors, and they will not give up even at the sight of a thousand-strong Persian army. The great warrior, strategist and tactician Themistocles commands the best navy in Athens. Now Xerxes is again confronted by the powerful defenders of his land, who have no intention of surrendering to the usurper...

title: 300 Spartans
description: In the fifth century BC, King Xerxes gathers a large army to attack Greece and conquer free peoples. To frank demands and an ultimatum, the king of the "three hundred Spartans" Leonidas and his loyal soldiers responded with a rude refusal. Now the man will have to fight back against a million-strong Persian army, but the predictions of the Oracle only wished for the best. Despite the bad forecasts, Leonid is still not going to retreat, he gathers three hundred men, brave warriors who are so strong, brave and purposeful that they are ready to rush into battle with the strongest enemy. No amount of intimidation and monsters of Xerxes will scare the fearless fighters.

title: Zombieland: Double Shot
description: Four people joined forces in a very difficult time. They had to be on the verge of life and death more than once. And this is not surprising, since they were in the center of a real zombie apocalypse. A huge number of the dead wanted to make them their dinner, but they managed to keep their lives. Of course, surviving alone in such conditions is incredibly difficult, so they combined their efforts. Now they call themselves zombie hunters. Ahead of them is a deadly confrontation with a new species of the living dead. In addition, they will have to face other survivors who are not very friendly. But the worst thing is that their team is going to have a serious upset...

title: Ocean's Thirteen Friends
description: This chapter begins with the adventures of Danny's criminal structure, which thrives thanks to the talent of the group's members - missing crooks in Las Vegas. Now the main character of the third part of "Ocean's 13 Friends" decides to gather even more people to make a dangerous robbery in which everyone is at risk. This idea arises for a reason. More recently, the owner of the establishment, Willie Bank, has been making a big deal about one of his friends. Ruben Tishkoff is in trouble. The team has no choice but to reconvene to discuss all the intricacies of the matter beforehand. But is it possible to break the new "bank"? The film "Ocean's Thirteen Friends" (2007) will be enjoyed by all lovers of the first and second parts.

title: Ocean's Twelve Friends
description: And again, Danny decides to gather his impeccable team. This time, the main character of the second part will have to add new candidates to the general list, as the work will be much more difficult. Danny's goal is three plots located in the largest European countries. Now the group will be divided into several subgroups. But in the meantime, their old friend Terry, whom Ocean and his team cleaned to the bone, craves revenge. He managed to learn the secret of the upcoming robbery. He is very angry with his rival and tries to catch up with the whole gang that the police are hunting, among them is their old rival Dinner Jacket. He also wanted to stage a heist of the year at one of the destinations...Ocean's Twelve (2004) is a must-watch for all fans of the series.

title: Lie down in Bruges / Once upon a time in Bruges
description: An ancient Belgian town pleases Ken - he has settled in perfectly, gets to know the sights and people, but Ray cannot recover from the accident, he is tormented by his conscience for the child he killed. To relieve his brain of heavy thoughts, the boy meets Chloe, a local beauty. It seems that this quiet town does not portend trouble at all, but it turns out to be quite the opposite. Harry's boss gives Ken the task of dealing with Ray. But the older comrade had already managed to get to know the boy well, and to have friendly feelings for him. He decides to save Rey from Harry. Together, the partners must hide from the pursuit of their bloodthirsty boss... The film "Lie down in Bruges / Once Upon a Time in Bruges" (2008) will be enjoyed by all lovers of melodramas with elements of crime.

title: Old people have no place here
description: The picture shows Texas of the eighties of the twentieth century. Vietnam War veteran Llewellyn Mosso is destined to go on a hunting trip, which leads him to stumble upon wild places. It is obvious that recently there were clashes between two criminal gangster clans. Lifeless bodies with weapons in their hands lie everywhere. There is also a truck with drugs, as well as a solid sum of two million dollars. Without thinking long, the man decides to take a substantial amount of money into his hands. Meanwhile, Anton Chigur escaped from prison. He turns out to be involved in the murder of a deputy sheriff. And now the hired killer intends to take revenge and take the gangster's money from Moss as well. All lovers of crime dramas will like to watch the film "No Place for Old People" (2007).

title: Offender
description: The threat of global destruction once again loomed over planet Earth and the entire human race. Only a deadly criminal is destined to save humanity from disaster. The fact is that geneticists have found a way to transplant internal memories, as well as abilities and skills into the body of another person. It turns out that a CIA special agent, the best in his unit, died while performing a very important mission. Now scientists have decided to move his data into the body of a serial maniac who is serving his sentence in the world's toughest prison. He must take on a new look and complete the work of the dead special agent. The movie "Criminal" (2016) will be liked by all fans of spectacular fantastic action movies.

title: Prometheus
description: In the first part of the tape, people dream of solving the secret of their origin, for this they are engaged in research around the world. In 2089, a company of archaeologists went to explore the Scottish island of Skye, in one of the caves they finally managed to find some drawings made 35 thousand years ago by ancient people. It was then that the first contact with the creators probably took place. It was these drawings that served as a clue for people to find mysterious creators. A little more time passes and similar drawings are found in other places. Wanting to learn the secret and touch the unknown, humanity sends into space on the spaceship Prometheus. With a mission to find their creators on a distant planet, towards which a spaceship is moving. The film "Prometheus" (2012) will be enjoyed by all fans of science fiction and space.

title: Collection of rays of hope / My boyfriend is a psycho
description: The normal life of Pat Solitano's boyfriend is interrupted by the betrayal of his beloved wife. Pat does not immediately understand how to get out of such a situation, so he finds an outlet in sedatives. Long-term reception of them leads him to a mental institution, where he has to be treated for "bipolar disorder". It takes eight months to restore the mental balance of the injured Pat, but after some time he manages to return to normal life. To consolidate the effect, meetings with the ex-wife should be excluded, although Pat still wants to be with her. A stranger, Tiffany, enters the man's life, who passionately wants to perform at a dance competition, but does not have a training partner. All lovers of light romantic comedies will enjoy the film "A collection of rays of hope / My boyfriend is a psycho" (2012).

title: Mission: Impossible 2
description: In the second part, the CIA officer Ethan Hunt has a new leadership, which gives the specialist in his field secret and important assignments. The man has a pretty girl. His relationship with her twists and turns, as in a love affair. But for a combat officer, work is above all else and sometimes there is no time left for personal life at all. This time the threat came from the Russian scientist Volodymyr Nekhorovich. He has developed a deadly virus that can wipe out humanity in a matter of days. The professor was afraid of his brainchild because it could fall into the hands of ill-wishers. He is taking it to the US for safe protection. However, on the way to the States, the serum falls into the treacherous hands of criminals. The film "Mission: Impossible 2" (2000) will be liked by all lovers of interesting action films, which are saturated with elements of adventure and thriller.

title: Mission: Impossible
description: At the epicenter of the plot is a group of operatives. The main characters obey a mysterious "minister". Our heroes perform extremely difficult tasks: preventing the murders of politicians and scientists, disrupting the plans of mobsters, fraudsters, spies and dictators, returning stolen valuables, secret documents, devices and many other tasks. Many operations are carried out in Eastern European countries, where communists are at the helm. The group consists of only the best employees who have passed the strength test more than once. The film "Mission: Impossible" (1996) will be liked by all lovers of really high-quality thrillers.

title: Tough Nut 5: A Good Day to Die
description: In the fifth part, the events take place in the capital of the Russian state, namely in Moscow. John McClane arrives here to save his wayward son and become a strong nut for bandits again. It turns out that the boy was stuck up to his ears in the abyss of Russian reality. He is kept in prison bunks and they are not going to let him go, even if he dies here. Only John is determined to free the poor man. And one fine day he succeeds. Only men found themselves involved in a dangerous game with crime and banditry. We must act again. But about the former grudges with your own son, you need to forget until better times, at least until everything is over. The movie "Tough Nut 5: A Good Day to Die" (2013) will be liked by all fans of the action series about the Tough Nut.

title: Strong nut 4.0
description: In the fourth part, the events unfold again on the American continent. John McClane has been retired for a long time, but he has not stopped being a tough nut for the terrorist group. This time they decided to act rather gracefully. Bandits have taken control of the world wide web. Now the dark days have come in the world. In almost all corners of the globe, terrible chaos broke out against the background of the computer apocalypse. John has no intention of remaining on the sidelines, even though he has long since left the ranks of law enforcement agencies. He is very serious about saving the inhabitants of his country and the entire planet as a whole, and first of all his family. However, this time he cannot do without help. And he has a partner. The movie "Strong Nut 4.0" (2007) will be liked by all fans of action movies of this series.

title: Silence
description: In the center of the film's plot are two priests from the order of the Roman Catholic Church who went to Japan to search for the missing father of Kryshtovan Ferreira. He risked his life to bring the faith of Christ to the Japanese people. Having found themselves in a foreign land, two priests will have to face such harsh trials that they never knew about. Pain, hatred, persecution and even death, they will see all this on their long journey through a foreign country, which is under the rule of the cruel Shogun Tokugawa. Will they be able to find Father Christovan and avoid danger in a foreign land, where a cruel struggle is being waged with a foreign faith? The film "Silence" (2016) will be a must watch for all drama lovers with plot elements of history.

title: Rambo 5: Last Blood
description: The main character suffers from a psychological disorder because of the war he experienced. Now the main character of "Rambo 5: Last Blood" wants a quiet ordinary life without adventures. Therefore, the man moves to Arizona and starts farming. Our hero settled on a ranch owned by his father. Now his whole life consists of taking care of animals. His entourage consists only of an old friend and her daughter Gabrielle. The girl literally grew up under the eyes of the former soldier and became like a family member to him. Since her father left the family when she was a small child, it was Rimbaud who took responsibility for her and took care of her like a real father.

title: Cloud atlas
description: The story of the film begins with the story of an ordinary shepherd of the 19th century, after which the action is transferred to the future with constant disasters. This technique will be repeated constantly throughout the film, and the viewer will gradually begin to understand the relationship between what is happening. The main characters are reincarnated beyond recognition, including the American lawyer Adam Ewing, the young composer Robert Frobisher, the young journalist Louise, the clone girl from the future Sonm and another hero from the future Zahri. Despite the fairy-tale component of the film, it is most suitable for an adult viewer who can appreciate all the beauty of the director's idea. The film "Cloud Atlas" (2012) will be liked by all lovers of drama with elements of fantasy and romance.

title: Lincoln
description: This picture is a biographical sketch from the life of one of the most famous American politicians of the sixties of the nineteenth century. We are definitely talking about Abraham Lincoln. He was born and grew up in a poor family of a farmer. All his life, the man fought for the rights of the oppressed residents of the USA. And now, when he became the sixteenth president from the Republican Party, he decided to introduce amendments to the Constitution concerning the status of slaves. He freed them in the literal sense of the word. Also, the politician became famous as a national hero who managed to finally end the bloody civil war. The film "Lincoln" (2012) will be liked by all lovers of dramas, which should contain not only historical elements, but also biographical ones.

title: A girl with a dragon tattoo
description: At the epicenter of the story is a journalist named Mikael Blomkvist. One day he was destined to connect his life with an informal hacker girl with a dragon tattoo. Her name is Lisbeth Salander. And it all started as follows. Even forty years ago, the niece of an influential man from the Wanger clan went missing. All efforts to find the missing woman were unsuccessful. Once, when the police refused to continue the search, Harriet Wanger's uncle turns to a well-known journalist for help. Meanwhile, he has an unpleasant story at work. Now Mikael faces a real prison term. But he undertakes a private investigation and, in the company of an informal Lisbeth, is going to move the case from a dead end. The film "The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo" (2011) will be liked by all lovers of thrillers, which have a really special atmosphere and charismatic characters.

title: Mission: Impossible 3
description: Secret agent of the CIA, Ethan Hunt, during his service, repeatedly acted as the savior of humanity, successfully completing missions that no one else could complete. Having made a decision, he was going to say goodbye to operational work, go on vacation and engage in the training of cadets, passing on the gained experience to the youth. However, the man's dreams of a measured, calm life and the creation of a family were not destined to come true. An extraordinary situation occurred - the life of former student and work colleague Lindsey Ferris, who was captured by the arms dealer Owen Deviana, is in danger. The management is forced to turn to Ethan with a last request to take part in a difficult and practically impossible operation. The hero's bride has no idea about the occupation of her chosen one and knows nothing about his past life. She begins to suspect that something is being hidden from her and tries to solve this riddle. Meanwhile, Hunt, having agreed to help, gathers a team of proven fighters and goes after the criminal, not suspecting that a deadly task will force him to get involved in events that he could not even think about, and travel halfway around the world, visiting the Vatican, Shanghai and New York. The film "Mission: Impossible 3" (2006) will be liked by all lovers of cool action games with thriller elements and intense adventures.

title: Truth or Dare
description: One day, in the company of her friends, Olivia plays a popular game called "Truth or Dare" with death. And it all started with the fact that the girl met a charming boy named Carter. They gather their fellow students and go to Mexico to have fun and celebrate a successful session. The boys stayed in an ancient mansion somewhere in the depths of the forest. Nothing foreshadowed trouble until someone offered to play a popular game. And the essence of the game is quite simple. You should only tell the truth to the questions asked or perform certain actions that the participants of the event have planned. But none of the boys expected that in case of refusal or non-fulfillment of the conditions of this harmless toy, they would inevitably be punished by death. Olivia has the gift of foresight.

title: The voice of the monster
description: The main character is not liked by his classmates, so he has no friends, he is lonely and unhappy. In order to at least somehow improve his loneliness, he invents a friend for himself, for this role he chooses an old yew tree that grows outside his bedroom window. The boy presents the old tree as a monster with outstretched arms, but he is not afraid of him, on the contrary, he loves him very much and wants him to become his friend. And so it happens, one day in a dream the yew monster starts a conversation with the boy and explains to him that life is not that bad and that even when everyone turns away from you, you should not be sad, you just have to live, and all the bad things will definitely go away someday and life will be filled with joy again. The movie "Voice of the Monster" (2016) will be liked by all fans of fantasy with elements of psychological drama.

title: Nice to go
description: Three elderly people have successfully lived their lives, they have become both professionals, individuals, and family members. Their old age is secured, and until the end of their days they can calmly enjoy walks in the park, spreading gossip about the current youth, feeding the ducks in the pond. But all this makes them bored. They often resort to memories of youth, excitement, dreams, not all of which managed to come true beautifully. In addition, they learn that the banking institution has frozen their savings, and the deposited funds can "float" away from them. What else is left to do for three elderly people full of unspent energy?! They want to restore justice, and at the same time to tickle their nerves, to add excitement to their fresh life. One of the heroes of the film becomes a witness to a virtuoso bank robbery, he was not only not afraid, but was also impressed by how easily the thieves managed to pull off the operation.

title: A spy and a half
description: Two friends, one a real star of the school, an athlete, the other a fat man, and also a loser, here everything is immediately clear who will be on the horse. But sometimes everything is overplayed in life, and that's what happened in this tape. The star of the school, the athlete basketball player Kelvin, growing up, becomes forgotten by everyone, works as a simple financier, which cannot be said about his friend, the loser Robbie. His life has changed a lot, he is no longer a fat man, but a fit, handsome man who easily wins the hearts of girls. But that's not all, Robbie is now also a spy, a CIA agent, he successfully completes even the most difficult tasks. Almost twenty years have passed since the last meeting, and here old friends meet again at a graduation party. Normal conversations, memories, that would be the end of it, if Robbie didn't need help from a school friend.

title: Founder
description: This biographical story is about the founder of McDonald's. During his long life, Raymond Albert Kroc tried himself as a jazz musician and even as a real estate agent. However, he did not find satisfaction in these fields. Fate led him at the age of 52 to sell mixers and paper cups for catering establishments. One fine day, he received an order for the delivery of six cocktail mixers. The order was placed by two brothers, Mack and Dick McDonalds, who are developing a cozy fast food restaurant in a small county town in California. They showed the man their know-how in the field of customer service. Albert was passionate about the idea of ​​creating a whole chain of such restaurants and offered the brothers profitable cooperation. However, they refused to participate in the risky idea. Then Croc himself created his brainchild, without outside help.

title: Mission Impossible: The Phantom Protocol
description: In the fourth part of the tape, it all started with the fact that in the capital of Russia, terrorists blew up one of the most significant monuments for the entire state - the Moscow Kremlin. A new conflict between the two superpowers is brewing. In order to prevent him, the US government orders the disbandment of a team of combat officers of an elite unit. Thus, the hero of "Mission: Impossible" is once again suspected of a crime he did not commit. He and his colleagues lost support from the leadership and the state as a whole. Their names are dishonored and mixed with dirt. In order to understand this high-profile case, the hero of the film, together with his comrades-in-arms, begin their own investigation. They go in search of terrorists who slandered their good names.

title: Secrets of the heavenly slopes
description: In the future, in order to guide their children on the true path, rich parents sent them to the specialized emotional rehabilitation center "Paradise Slopes". This institution was located on an island in the middle of the ocean, so that the patients had no chance to escape, and according to local specialists, as well as numerous clients, after undergoing soft therapy, the children radically changed. It is not uncommon for quite adult patients to enter the walls of this institution, but none of them came here of their own accord. Until recently, a girl named Uma knew nothing about this place. She was born in a rich family and enjoyed all the privileges of high society. However, after the murder of her father, the family began to experience financial problems, and in order not to lose respect and status, the poor woman had to marry the wealthy heir of Henston. She did not want to connect her life with a rich man, as she was in love with poor Marcus, so her mother forcibly sent the girl to a rehabilitation center. At first glance, "Paradise Slopes" fully lived up to its name. The whole island was strewn with fabulous flowers, patients and staff wore white clothes. Everyone radiated kindness and respect, but the first impression was misleading. Uma soon learned the truth about this institution.

title: Skirmish
description: Could a normal arms deal go wrong? Of course not, if everyone will follow simple rules, do not shine with personal weapons, do not try to deceive the other party to the agreement, and even more so do not try to insult him. But it seems that a small company of buyers who went on a dangerous operation were not familiar with these rules. But it is clear that these rules were not known to the sellers, otherwise they would not have mixed up the goods for anything. As a result, the two parties decided to conduct an operation at one of the abandoned factories on the outskirts of Boston. This mistake led to a serious conflict, which turned into a large-scale shootout. Well, how can you not laugh if all the participants behaved like fools. Talking under bullets is not the best solution, but they have no other way out, because now it is not money and goods that are at stake, but their own lives.

title: Escobar
description: The creators of the film "Escobar" give us the opportunity to learn the story of the rise of one of the most influential and dangerous criminals in history. We will see his rapid path to huge money, power, power and crimes against politicians, officials, policemen, judges and competitors. The main events begin to unfold in the very beginning of the eighties of the last century. Virginia Vallejo, a popular journalist and TV news anchor working in Colombia, receives an individual invitation to visit the ranch of Pablo Escobar, a man from a poor family who, resorting to illegal drug trafficking, became one of the richest people on the planet. The girl understands that this is her real chance to get a unique material. She gives her consent and goes to the place. Soon her meeting with Pablo takes place. He tells her about his descent and life. Impressed by Escobar's charisma, Virginia plunges into a love intrigue.

title: Undercover scam
description: Bob Mazur is a federal agent. Covering the rear of his colleagues is his primary task, but he often finds himself in their place. This time, the man is tasked with turning over the scam against the drug cartel of Pablo Escobar himself. The point is that large sums of money are laundered here. The agent will be assisted in this difficult task by his colleague Emir Abrey, who can flare up on any occasion. And also the charming Katie Erts. Everything is ready for the special operation. She will forever remain in history as a benchmark for the work of a friendly team, which is covered by colleagues outside of them. It is truly risky, but everyone knows that such people drink champagne in the event of a successful outcome.

title: 007: Skyfall coordinates
description: An unexpected leak of information occurred in the British spy agency. Now the agent "two zero, seven" is forced to find the disk and return it. James Bond and his partner went on the trail of kidnappers. But when the spy was fighting enemies on the roof of the train, which is speeding at great speed, his colleague made a terrible mistake and shot his friend. As a result, the man's body was never found. Meanwhile, the attackers launched cyberattacks. M's career and the lives of MI6 employees are now in great question. But James Bond unexpectedly enters the bureau chief's office, alive and unharmed. He passes the aptitude test and rushes into battle again. Now completing this mission with Skyfall coordinates is a matter of honor for him.

title: A quantum of mercy
description: The invincible super spy of British intelligence, James Bond, has just completed a dangerous mission, but the troubles did not end there. Soon he will have to face the powerful "Quantum", a criminal organization that wants to take control of the waters of Bolivia in its insidious hands. Bonda's beloved Vesper unexpectedly betrayed him and she definitely doesn't see mercy anymore. Now he interrogates Mr. White to find out all the secrets of the woman's betrayal. As a result, the spy learns many interesting details about the secret organization. It is located in Haiti and is managed by Dominic Grant. And helping Bond will be a charming female killer named Camilla. Together they are a truly formidable weapon.

title: Casino Royale
description: James Bond agent 007 this time will meet in an irreconcilable duel with Le Chiffre himself. And the fight itself will take place on the grounds of the Casino "Royal". The spy is armed with his special gadgets and ready to fight. He is opposed by one of the best financial geniuses in the entire criminal space of the huge planet. The battle promises to be hot and uncompromising. Agent 007 has never met such sophisticated criminals before. His methods of conducting a match make you applaud standing. However, our hero is also not made with a finger. Bond is ready for a confrontation. There are also femme fatales here, but without them there are simply no stories about the legendary super-spy of Her Royal Majesty.

title: Macbeth
