description: There are many adaptations of William Shakespeare's famous play "Macbeth". As in the play, in the film, all the depths of human desire, in this case Macbeth, are revealed. He was close to King Duncan. But not just relatives, but those whom the king considered his friend and whom he unconditionally believed and trusted. But Macbeth won a good reputation not only from the king, but also from many subjects. Many liked the Scottish warrior. But that was not enough for him. Once he met three witches who prophesied to him the throne and power. After that, Macbeth lost all composure. From the inside he was consumed by the lust for power, glory and greatness. He wanted nothing more in his life than to seize the throne. His wife was a treacherous woman, not one to open her heart to. When the main character was still doubting the illegal seizure of the throne, his wife gradually sharpened his doubts and encouraged him to kill the king. She gradually, by flattery and trickery inspired Macbeth to carry out a treacherous plan. And at one point, he crossed the friendship and trust of someone who was always on his side. He and his wife have yet to answer for their crimes. When they hatched this plan, and then put it into action, they did not know what they were dooming themselves to.

title: Hidden figures
description: 1960 is the year of the twentieth century. Racism and patriarchy still reign in Hidden Figures. Only men were the main workers, and women were given minor positions. Despite the mental development and the ability to think out of the ordinary, women were always considered the weaker sex, and they were not counted on when making important decisions. There are a lot of smart women working at NASA, but none of them expect to be recognized. At one point, when the first flight into space was supposed to take place, three brilliant women, including African-American women, were assigned to work on mathematical calculations. Only the heroines will have to face discrimination more than once.

title: Brooklyn
description: Ellis Lacy was born in an Irish village. The girl decided to try her luck in America. And here she is in Brooklyn, where she is gradually getting used to living conditions in a big, noisy and active city. Here Ellis was given to know the taste of freedom, joys and difficulties of the first true love. However, tragic news was received from the homeland. The girl is forced to return to Ireland. Here there is a meeting with another man, which will force the heroine to choose between a new hobby and the love left in America...

title: Dressmaker. Revenge from couture
description: The events begin in 1926 with the tragic death of Stuart Pettiman - a schoolboy from a provincial town located in the Australian outback. The only witness to his death is schoolgirl Myrtle Dunnage. However, no one believes her words, as a result of which the girl is expelled from the city, accused of murder. After that, twenty-five years pass. Now Myrtle is an experienced seamstress. Escaping from the ghosts of the past, she changed her name to Tilly and never returned to her hometown. But life circumstances force Tilly-Myrtle to return to Dungatar to care for her sick mother. All the inhabitants of the city immediately learn about the return of the killer girl, which causes a lot of rumors. Trying to find out what really happened in 1926, the girl meets the local policeman Horatio, who turns out to be a lover of secretly dressing up in women's clothes. But her husband cannot help her, so the heroine tries to find out the details of that terrible day from her mother, who claims that she herself does not know what happened then. The townspeople plan to banish the girl again, this time for good. It would have happened, but the talent comes to the heroine's aid, with the help of which Myrtle quickly becomes the most popular person in the town.

title: Kung Fury
description: The most dangerous criminal of all time appears in Miami in the 80s - Adolf Hitler, nicknamed the Kung Fuhrer. Supercop Kung Fury decides to travel back in time to Nazi Germany to kill Hitler and end the Nazi empire.

title: Colony Dignidad
description: The events of the historical film, which was filmed simultaneously on three different continents, take us back to 1973 and tell about the difficult trials that befell a young couple in love. By the will of fate, they ended up in Chile at the moment when a military coup was taking place in the country. The heroes of the film "Colony of Dignidad" came here from Germany. The girl works as a flight attendant, and her lover Daniel works in a small German publication as a journalist. The hero's activities become the reason for his arrest. After that, the man spends a few days in the dungeons of the secret police, where he is tortured in every way, trying to extract a confession of cooperation with the rebels. Daniel is not guilty of anything, but the police do not consider this a reason to release him. The hero is transported to a small German colony, which pastor Paul Schaefer calls his charitable mission, created to help ordinary people. But in fact, this settlement will give a head start to the concentration camps of the Second World War. In order to save her lover, Elena goes to meet the shepherd. She tells Paul that she wanted to become a nun for a long time, because helping people is a higher good. In fact, the heroine wants only one thing - to save Daniel. She gets a place in the settlement, but she does not yet know that there is no way back from here...

title: Alluring, Bad, Evil
description: The main role in this story fell to a handsome and charismatic man named Ted Bundy. According to the plot of the film, no woman can resist his charm. So Elizabeth, who dreams of meeting true love, found her happiness in the arms of Ted. However, the happiness of young people did not last long. Once a man was charged with the brutal murder of several women. Now Elizabeth wonders: who is her loved one - an unfortunate victim of circumstances or a serial killer maniac? And the answer to this question must be very ambiguous.

title: Room
description: In the city of Akron, Ohio, 24-year-old Joy and her five-year-old son Jack live in a small shed. They call this shed a room. There is everything that is considered orderly living conditions: a bed, a toilet, a bath, a TV, a modest kitchen and a small window in the ceiling. These two are prisoners of Jack's father, Nick, who kidnapped Joy seven years ago. All this time he did not stop raping her. Joy tries to be an exemplary mother for Jack. She tells him that the whole world is in this room. But, the boy grows up and his curiosity one day leads to a risky escape plan.

title: Youth
description: Fred and Mike have been friends for more than half a century, and they are happy to meet on vacation amid the splendor of the Swiss landscape to reflect on their fate and observe the events of the people who live nearby. Fred is a former well-known conductor and composer who has long since retired and retired from activities to which he is not going to return. Even if the queen herself wants it. Mike is an Oscar-winning director, just about to end his career by making his last film. Just as he meets his friend, he is working on a difficult script. He is not so young anymore, and his thoughts are not so sharp and quick. On vacation, they talk a lot about the years they have lived, discuss their own children, believing that they live aimlessly. The names and activities of the two men are well known, so each of them has supporters in the hotel.

title: Cinderella
description: Finding yourself alone with unfriendly relatives is not an easy task. In "Cinderella", Ella lost her beloved mother, her widowed father remarried, and the choice turned out to be wrong. The evil Lady Trayman does not want her daughters Anastasia and Drizella to be in the background, and does everything to save the girl from home. The main thing is not to despair, Cinderella's slogan for life helps her a lot. The attempt to get to the dance with the family was unsuccessful, and her fairy godmother comes to the girl's aid. Having conjured up a magical dress and a carriage with horses, she gives the poor thing a chance to visit somewhere better than the basement. At the ball, the heroine meets a handsome prince, and immediately gives him her heart. Leaving him a shoe as a memory of herself, she returns home.

title: Ocean's Eleven friends
description: And finally it's time to leave the prison. The main character of the first part of "Ocean's 11 Friends" is awaiting execution of another criminal case. Now he plans to rob a Las Vegas casino. In the meantime, there will be 160 million dollars in the casino. The task of accomplices is to steal everything down to a penny and leave Terry Benedict with nothing. And Terry is most interested in Danny's wife. Now eleven specialists from different fields will have to do the impossible, since the casino was full of guards and almost every part of the establishment is monitored by a camera. The team has a first-class shooter who will play the first and decisive role. After that, the second, third and so on will go into action. But this crazy move will cost the friends their lives...

title: Catch me if you can
description: Frank Abegneil easily finds a language with people by putting his charm and beauty into action, wins the hearts of girls without problems and receives any award. But this is only half of all Frank's talents, he is also a great liar, so it will not be difficult for him to come up with an interesting biography for himself or to convince those around him that he is exactly who he pretends to be, and people believe him, which he actually uses. No one can catch him. He can easily turn into a pilot, and later a doctor, and then he will appear in court, defending his client. Frank's image and mannerisms are all so convincing that people have no doubt that they are really a doctor, a pilot or a lawyer. But one image is not enough for Frank, so to make life more fun, he also expertly forges bank checks, transfers them with ease and enjoys life moving around the country. Probably, the talented young man would have continued his fun and carefree life, but he only attracted the attention of the rather tenacious FBI agent Carl Henretty, who was very interested in Frank. The film "Catch Me If You Can" (2002) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of biographical and criminal dramas.

title: Knockdown
description: The life of people who have devoted themselves to sports is not easy at all, along with victories there are also defeats in the form of "knockdowns". The action takes place in the days of the Great Depression, it is at this time that the once successful boxer James Braddock is going through a very difficult period. The last fight ended in defeat and a lot of injuries for him, after that he cannot return to the ring, he understands that his career is dying out. Not everything is simple in the personal life of the main character, he loses not only his career, but also all the accumulated savings, hard times are really coming for him and his family. He doesn't want to see big fights, so he agrees to work as a porter. One day he still manages to agree on participation in a boxing match, the amount is small and the risk is high, but again he is unlucky, he breaks his arm during the fight. After this, the organizers disqualify Braddock and promise not to let him into the ring again.

title: Joker
description: The action of the crime-drama thriller "Joker", based on the character of the DC comics of the same name, begins its development in a gloomy city called Gotham. The crime rate here is always high, but the city has its defenders. But all defenders have their enemies. A comedian lives here. He wants to give people joy, but he himself is unhappy. All because he has to live with a sick mother, which forces him to walk around with a smile on his face. And it depresses him. However, he tries to hold on. The main character sincerely believes that it is necessary to bring happiness and joy to people. But every time he encounters manifestations of cruelty and violence. Injustice completely breaks him. He comes to the conclusion that the world is much worse than he previously thought. If the world does not want to receive a kind and sincere smile from him, then he will receive a contemptuous criminal smile in his direction. So begins the journey of one of the most violent and eccentric villains of Gotham. Want to see the formation of a popular antagonist of DC comics? Then we suggest that you do not postpone for later and enjoy watching the crime-drama thriller "Joker" with Ukrainian translation online on our website right now.

title: One day... in Hollywood
description: The events of this story take place in 1969. This time was a turning point for Hollywood. During these years, the "hippie" movement began to form, which influenced many aspects of American life. The young and successful actor Rick Dalton can't find a job. Once he starred in a high-profile multi-part project that allowed him to become a real star on TV screens. But after filming, no one was going to call him in other pictures. The same fate awaited the understudy of the actor - Cliff Booth, with whom the man became very friendly. Left without work, the heroes turn to their pregnant neighbor Sharon Tate for help.

title: Mission Impossible: Rogue Nation
description: The hero of the fifth part, together with his comrades-in-arms, more than once came to the aid of not only the state, but also the entire planet in difficult situations. The time has come when the country no longer needs to turn to the OMN for help. And it is simply dissolved. The officers were left to fend for themselves. Now each of them is forced to earn bread with another business. At this time, the hero of "Mission: Impossible" learns about the existence of a network of professional mercenaries who call themselves the Syndicate. This includes missing killers and abandoned special agents who have not found a place for themselves in a peaceful life. Any military department of even the strongest state can envy this squad of thugs. They are preparing a series of terrorist attacks in almost all corners of the planet. A squad of brave guys who are not afraid to face danger is needed.

title: In the heart of the sea
description: In the movie "In the Heart of the Sea" we will be able to consider the dramatic story that happened on the whaling ship "Essex". A crew of twenty men boarded this ship from a Massachusetts port, and it departed for whaling. Everything was going great, the hunting couldn't have been better, because for a year and a half they achieved great results, but everything was cut short in one moment, when the ship was suddenly attacked by a gigantic sperm whale. As a result, their whaling ship was badly damaged and they had to go down in lifeboats into the ocean. They fought for their lives for three long months. But still, hunger, cold, thirst and fatigue brought down most of the Essex team to their deaths. And only the most resistant managed to cope with these terrible conditions. Among them, the ship's captain and his assistant remained alive, and they decided to write down their life story on paper. The main role in the film will be played by everyone's favorite Chris Hemsworth, known to all of us for the films "The Avengers" and "Thor". The picture of the film is based on real events, which cannot but attract your attention. The film is based on the novel "Moby Dick" written by Herman Melville. This tragedy occurred at the beginning of the 20th century and has the same significance as the loss of the Titanic.

title: Eddie the Eagle
description: In the life of any person there were moments that he devoted to sports. That's how Eddie gave all fifteen years to jumping from the springboard. He was nicknamed "Eddie the Eagle". Only this did not help him to win any valuable award. The thing is that he was literally haunted by the curse of the last place. Wherever he participated, the man was always at the very tail. But one can only envy his tenacity. Anyone in his place would have given up sports a long time ago. He trains with faith in a bright future. And so, another competition is on the horizon. Behind a bunch of defeats, ahead are only flights to the podium of honor. At least the man sincerely believes in it.

title: Secret materials: I want to believe / Top secret: I want to believe
description: Six years have passed since Scully and Mulder completed the investigation of the last mysterious case. A young woman mysteriously disappears. FBI representatives connected to the event cannot understand what they encountered. Therefore, the management of the Bureau decided to turn to former employees of the Secret Materials Department for help. Agents of the secret service come to Dana, who now holds the position of a regular doctor in a hospital for the poor, and explain the essence of their request, which is for the heroine to contact Fox. If Mulder agrees, he will be rehabilitated as a reward and the background check, which is still ongoing at his former job, will stop. Meanwhile, the kidnappings continue. Several more women are missing, one of whom worked in the Bureau. Scully finds a former partner and tries to persuade him to join the search for the missing.

title: Devil's advocate
description: Kevin Lomax - a promising lawyer who won absolutely all cases, is interested in one legal company. John Milton - the head of this company makes the hero of "The Devil's Advocate" a profitable offer - to become his employee. Kevin gladly accepts the offer and soon moves to New York with his beloved. Milton does everything to ensure that Lomox has a big apartment, a good income and many rich clients who have committed many crimes. While Kevin plunged headlong into his new job, his wife begins to have nightmares. She is stressed by the situation in the apartment, which is why the girl wants to leave the city, but her husband does not share her concerns, but in vain. The film "The Devil's Advocate" (1997) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of detective dramas and thrillers.

title: Mind games
description: John is a real genius, he loves mathematics and is ready to devote a lot of time to it. While others are engaged in ordinary affairs, he studies numbers and the laws of mathematics. title: A walk at a height
description: This American historical film masterpiece tells the biographical story of French tightrope walker Philippe Petit. In the center of the plot of "The Walk" is a passage made by a Frenchman in 1974 on a rope stretched between the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center. Philippe Petit, standing on top of the torch of the Statue of Liberty, tells the story of his life. Since childhood, he dreamed of becoming a tightrope walker. Having received tightrope walking lessons from circus performer Papa Rudy, Philip gradually improves his skills. First, it crosses a small lake, then the towers of Notre Dame Cathedral. title: Untouchables / 1+1
description: Until recently, the rich aristocrat Philip had an excellent life that anyone could envy. Fate was kind to him, so he survived, but lost the ability to move, so now he needs an assistant, Philip is very demanding of the candidate, that's why he arranges a casting for the role of his caregiver. For this role, a black guy Driess, who was recently released from prison and is fond of rap, also falls into the list of candidates. But unlike other candidates, Driess does not plan to work at all, especially as a caregiver. The film "Untouchables / 1+1" (2011) will be interesting to watch online in Ukrainian for fans of incredible biographical dramas and comedies.

title: I am a Legend
description: Medicines have been found that can cure cancer patients. At the center of the plot of "I am a legend" is the lieutenant colonel of the medical service Robert Neville, who lives in a post-apocalyptic world. Patrolling the streets of the city with his dog, he searches buildings, hunts animals, collects abandoned supplies, and in his spare time conducts experiments, hoping to find drugs that can give humanity a second chance. Nocturnal people are infected everywhere because of their high and painful sensitivity to daylight, which kills them in a matter of seconds.

title: Titanic

It is difficult for the girl to come to terms with the fate prepared for her, so she readily accepts the gift of fate in the form of unbridled passionate love for the young artist. But all the romance is shattered by the tragic events that take place on the ship. The movie "Titanic" (1997) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of melodramas and thrillers.

title: Requiem for a dream / Requiem for a dream
description: He changed his views on life. In his dreams, the protagonist continues to see an ideal future. He wants Sara to be part of the popular TV show and finally find her happiness. description: Marty McFly is in college, skateboards, and plays guitar in his school's rock band. title: Classified materials: The fight for the future
description: Over the years of working with Mulder, plunging into familiarity with classified events, Scully has completely changed her view of the nature of many things, convinced herself that many things around her cannot be explained scientifically. Dana and Fox's efforts to prevent the explosion ended in failure. The bomb exploded. But that's half the battle. The girl dreams of introducing her boyfriend to his parents, the young man also hopes for a pleasant acquaintance. However, what the father learns about the chosen one, to put it mildly, does not please him very much and he cannot understand "why exactly his daughter chose him". Laird Mehew, that is the boy's name, is a millionaire, spoiled, self-centered and extravagant boy. His style of behavior shocks the girl's father: not only is his whole body covered in tattoos, he also has a habit of gossiping, throwing vulgar parties and, without being ashamed of the surrounding relatives, telling about the charms of his Stephanie. And this arrogant, uncomplicated guy hopes to make a heart-to-heart proposal. title: A wonderful seven

title: At any cost
description: Almost from childhood, two brothers, Toby and Tanner Howard, knew what it was like to be poor and have no money. Despite this, both brothers were best friends, but growing up, their paths diverged. The elder Tanner, tired of the lack of money since childhood, began to earn it at all costs and even dishonestly, it all ended sadly for him, he ends up in prison. The younger Toby chose a different path, started a family and began to earn his money honestly. But no matter how hard he tried, the money he earned was still not enough. And here is another problem, their mother has to pay a large amount to the bank, if she does not do it on time, then they will lose the house and land. Time is running out, so the two brothers team up again to help their mother get the money back. But how to do it if they don't have them themselves? The brothers find a solution, but for this they have to go against the law, but the honor of the family is higher, so they, without thinking, start robbing small banks.

title: Prestige
description: They were both young, they were both inexperienced, but that didn't stop them from surprising many in the audience. The girl's mother lives in Busan, where the husband and daughter are on their way from Seoul. Meanwhile, today is another birthday for her. She really wants the whole family to be together again on this holiday. However, unforeseen circumstances force you to look at life with different eyes. The fact is that an unknown virus has spread throughout the country, infecting all residents. Only in Busan there is still an opportunity to hide from the epidemic. Su-an and her father are more than four hundred kilometers away from the rescue city. But they still hope they can arrive before the virus reaches the express passengers.

title: American history H
description: Teenager Danny Vineyard has an older brother, Darek, who is serving time in prison. He is there for killing two black robbers who tried to clean his car. Of course, everything could be resolved in a more peaceful way, but since Darek was one of the members of a neo-Nazi organization, he killed the careless robbers who broke into his car without any remorse. The younger brother also did not go far from his brother, so he tries to copy Darek in every way. He is not afraid to express his beliefs openly, even while at school. In one of the literature lessons, he writes an essay about Adolf Hitler's favorite book, Mein Kapf. The black teacher, nevertheless, does not scold him for such a choice, does not cause Danny a scandal, he goes the other way, gives him the task of writing another work called "American History X". Once there, the heroes immerse themselves in the repair of the ancient building. And in the process, they accidentally discover a hidden secret room. Once inside it, the lovers learn that this room is able to fulfill any wishes of the visitors. Trying to test their assumptions, the heroes begin to ask the rooms to fulfill their various wishes. Originals by great artists, millions of dollars, expensive dresses and suits from the most influential designers - all this materializes with just one wish. title: Predators

Despite the suddenness and lack of prerequisites, the government immediately begins the urgent evacuation of local residents. All radio and TV channels actively broadcast information about the need to pack things and go to protected places, from which people are transported to safe areas. We meet a girl named Haley, who ignores all warnings and requests to start evacuation. Instead, she tries to meet her father, who has disappeared in this chaos. Finding him, Hayley is horrified that he needs urgent hospitalization. However, the situation does not allow them to find a doctor in all this commotion. Every second of delay leads to the fact that Haley and her father find themselves in a dangerous trap. But there is something scarier than water in their house. title: Nomis / Game of Hannibal

He manages to find and arrest a man named Simon, who suffers from a serious mental disorder. At first glance, it seems that the criminal is simply deranged, but everything is much more complicated. Examination shows that Simon gets along with several personalities at once. But the part of the criminal's consciousness that believes that he is Hannibal Lector is of particular interest to the police. When Simon is behind bars, the murders continue. title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
description: Those who have not read the preface to the famous book "Winnie the Pooh and All, All, All .." are unlikely to know that Christopher Robin is not a fictional character, but the natural son of Alexander Milne. Observing the life of the boy, his games, the author invented a fairy forest and settled in it funny animals known to everyone: the bear-philosopher, Piglet, the donkey Ia and many others. There is hardly a person who would not admire and laugh at the adventures of these funny, touching, selfless characters. Thanks to them, the writer became world-famous, and at the same time his heir. But the teenager himself did not enjoy unexpected popularity at all. He didn't really want to be constantly compared to a bookish, fictional boy. Especially since the release of the story caused ridicule from peers. This led to the fact that the relationship with the father deteriorated.

It seems that fate itself brought them together. They must be together, they have a wonderful future. And so it happened. After 45 years, they carried warm feelings, caring for each other. Then the magician decides to go to Earth to people to get medicine for his assistants, because Christmas is very close, and the gifts are not ready yet. The good grandfather flies to Paris and stops at a pharmacy. Santa walks in and asks for a medicine called Vitamin C. The pharmacist dispenses the medicine and asks for a certain amount of money for the product. However, the hero of the picture has no money, because he simply does not use it. Then, on the call of the pharmacist, a police team arrives and takes the cute grandfather to the police station.

title: Christmas with losers / Christmas with Kranks
description: The married couple Luther and Nora Crank are very annoyed by the preparations related to the celebration of Christmas. Their neighbors are very busy: buying a luxurious Christmas tree, decorations for it. In addition to all this, you need to tidy up the yard, mold a couple of snowmen. But the most important thing is not to forget to prepare a beautiful feast that everyone will like very much. The Krenky married couple believes that all these preparations are a waste of time. They are annoyed by children who go to collect sweets, performing various carols at the same time. The main characters have a daughter who is currently studying in college. Since she was not at home, Nora and Luther decided to celebrate this Christmas in an unusual way and go on a trip to the Caribbean. But the family's plans are ruined when they learn that their daughter is coming home.

Harvey Weinstein considered himself the "emperor of Hollywood". But his simply flawless and one might say ideal life was shaken under an avalanche of accusations: blackmail, harassment, rape. How could he go unpunished for so long? Just yesterday he was followed by millions, and today everyone has turned their backs on him.

title: Astral 4: The Last Key

She began to help people, but many simply do not want to believe in otherworldly forces. A new stage in the girl's life begins. She is preparing for a deadly battle with an ancient monster that rules the entire dark kingdom. This creature has been haunting her for many years. The heroine of the film is sitting behind books on meditation and looking for the keys to defeat her old enemy once and for all. Suddenly, the doorbell rings and she realizes that the time has come.

title: Astral: A New Dimension
description: Alex Harmany survived the loss of his own mother. Now he was fascinated by metaphysics and parallel dimensions. The young man studies astral projection very extensively and goes deeper and deeper into the world in which paranormal phenomena are manifested. The guy comes to the conclusion that, in addition to reality, there are other, new dimensions. As proof of his theory, he cites the fact that people increasingly began to meet otherworldly forces, see the sudden appearance of UFOs and incomprehensible anomalies. Our hero wants to penetrate into another world to meet his mother. He understands that he risks never coming back, but his love for his mother does not stop him.

A brave couple of journalists are fighting with the rival publication "New York Times" for the right to publish secret cases, materials and tell the world the truth of thirty years ago. Journalists must forget all disagreements and disagreements in order to print a real bombshell. They will have to work hard to study important documents. And at this time, competitors do not just give up without a fight. They, too, dive headfirst into the interpretation of secret archives that have been hidden from the public for a long time. The race for the right to be the best publication has begun.

title: Entertainment for adult girls

The purpose of the trip was rest and entertainment, but the girls had no idea what hot and emotional Miami would meet them. It is full of entertainment from night clubs with endless streams of booze to sex and full debauchery. How good it is to remember your youth and have a lot of fun! One of the beauties comes up with the idea of ​​renting an apartment and the services of a stripper. It would seem like old and banal entertainment, but the girls could not resist such a temptation. title: Very Bad Moms 2

Now, each of them has a loved one who appreciates them, they have become mothers, they are raising children, and all three are building very successful careers at work. And although they rarely have free time, they do not miss the opportunity to meet each other, drink champagne, remember the times of their former game. But the current family life suits them perfectly, and they are not going to change anything. Now, on the eve of Christmas, they do not like joint gatherings. Each of them is busy decorating the Christmas tree, preparing festive meals, buying gifts for husbands and children. But, like a thunderbolt in the middle of a clear sky, their mothers fall on them. Moreover, they all come to them on the same day, right before Christmas.

title: Zoo keeper's wife
description: The action of the film begins with the story of the married couple Antonina and Yana Zhabinsky. Their family business is a zoo located in Warsaw itself. War is coming to the country, but Antonina and Jan feel relatively safe because the zoo is located in the city. Terrible and incomprehensible persecution of Jews begins, who are either killed or sent to ghetto camps. The zoo managed to be maintained for some time, but it surrendered under the pressure of the war. Many animals run away, but the cages themselves become a refuge for the persecuted Jews. Antonina and Jan decide to use animal cages as hiding places for people. The only German who suspected the zoo owners of treason was Lutz Heck, who has strong feelings for Antonina. While she managed to use it to save as many Jews as possible.

title: Stay up until Christmas
description: Bartender Billy and businesswoman Lizzie meet under funny circumstances. They are completely different, but they still have one thing in common - insomnia. They have tried everything possible, but nothing helps. They did not know one. All that was needed to solve this problem was to find the perfect sleeping partner.

title: 12 Christmas Dates

In a strange irony, with the clock ticking late, she gets a chance to relive Christmas Eve one more time. This unique opportunity can not only help her correct the mistake she made on the first date, but also realize what a wonderful family and wonderful friends she really has...

title: Leon / Leon-killer

Probably, Leon would have avoided communicating with people, if one day in his neighbors' apartment there had not been a murder, behind which corrupt police officers stand, their leader is a certain Norman Stelfield, a burned-out drug addict and psychopath, who without pity kills anyone who does not like him. But in this massacre arranged by the police, a teenage girl Matilda survives by an incredible miracle. She has no one to ask for help and protection, so she goes to the reclusive Leon. The hired killer, accustomed to solitude, does not want to accept Matilda, but she convinces him and he agrees to help her. He teaches her the skills of an assassin, and she helps him in the household and teaches him English. The movie "Leon / Leon-killer" (1994) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of crime thrillers and action movies.

Iris Simpkins runs a popular column on wedding topics in the well-known publication "Daily Telegraph". She lives and works in London. She is crazy about a man who does not reciprocate her, as she has feelings for another. And at a distance of 10 thousand kilometers from Great Britain, in sunny California, Amanda Woods lives and works. The woman is the owner of a thriving advertising agency that creates videos for movie masterpieces. One day, she catches her lover in the act of treason.

title: Green Mile

Every suicide bomber took his last steps along a green corridor called the "Green Mile". One day, an unusual prisoner named John was brought to the prison where Paul worked. The huge giant John was sentenced to the highest degree for the rape and murder of two girls. To Paul, this conclusion immediately seemed strange, and later he was convinced of his doubts. John was not just an ordinary prisoner, this black giant was endowed with special abilities, first he helps Paul to recover from his illness, then in a strange way he brings back to life a dead mouse trampled by a vile prison employee Percy. The movie "The Green Mile" (1999) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of detective dramas and crime films.

title: Tully

After the birth of her third child, Marlo is on the verge of a nervous breakdown. Her wealthy older brother wants to give her a gift - to pay for a night nanny so that Marlo has the opportunity to just sleep. After serious doubts, she still gives in and calls for help, a girl named Tally was recommended to her. A young, slender and energetic nanny initially annoys the mistress of the house, who is dissatisfied with herself and her life. But after becoming friends with Tully, Marlo realizes how lucky her children and herself have been.

title: A blind date
