But nothing will stop the dreamer and persistent young man from achieving his goal - to work in a five-star hotel. Dozens and hundreds of people go through internships there, losing the opportunity to get a position every day. Sally trains hard at home so that no one at work suspects his problems, otherwise, he will never see his dream: after all, absolutely healthy people should work in the hotel. Concerned relatives and close friends dissuade the blind man from such a risky, self-confident act, but he submits an application for the desired vacancy and successfully passes the interview despite the difficulties.

title: Island of the damned
description: Shutter Island is not just a piece of land in the middle of the water, it is a prison where the most dangerous mentally ill criminals are and for them it is the last refuge on earth. The island itself is a real fortress, it is well guarded, so it is simply impossible to escape from here. It was thought so until recently, while Rachel Solando, one of the criminals convicted of murdering children, walks out of her room. This seems especially strange, since she was carefully guarded, and the door of her room was closed with all locks. But was there really an escape or did the criminal still not leave the fortified island? But if so, where did she go? Federal marshal Daniels and his partner Chuck Owl, who were sent to investigate the disappearance on this island, will have to find out. At first everything seems simple, but the more Daniels learns about this island and its inhabitants, the more terrifying the truth becomes.

title: The girl in the fog
description: An experienced psychiatrist named Augusto Flaresso is awakened by a phone call in the middle of a deep and foggy night. He quickly goes to the clinic. An injured man who had just been in a car accident was brought here. The new patient's name is Vogel. He is an excellent detective. Someone else's blood is on his shirt. However, no one was found at the scene of the accident, except for the operator. The psychiatrist asks him to tell everything that happened to him. And the man begins to gradually restore the course of events. He was invited to a mountain village in the Alps to investigate a high-profile case. On the eve of the bright holiday of Christmas, a young and unremarkable girl named Anna goes to the church for the festive service. Only she never reached the church. No one has seen her since then. The detective is sure that she was kidnapped. But the question arises: for what purpose, why not ask for a ransom? He is sure that the criminal is among local residents, although they assure the operative that the maniac is not local, and the woman has been dead for a long time. The investigation of the crime begins. Vogel is suspicious of almost anyone who smiles sweetly in his face. The offender is intelligent and very dangerous. He must be found before misfortune happens to the girl.

title: Constantine: Lord of Darkness
description: The hero of the tape - John Konstantin needs to monitor order, dividing the border between angels and demons. He rids the world of numerous unclean things. The man hopes that this will help him get rid of the gift in the near future. Eventually, he gets tired of the battle with evil forces and his hard life. The main character tries to forget about everything that is happening around him for a while with the help of alcohol. One day, a representative of the law - Angela, turns to John for help. Recently, her twin sister was killed in a very strange way. To deal with this matter, the hero and Angela begin an investigation that leads to the world of demons. Whoever enters this world cannot get out of it. The main character has to try hard to understand this difficult task.

title: Anna
description: The French thriller "Anna" with action elements introduces us to a strikingly beautiful girl. When she is in public, she always attracts the attention of those around her, who consider her a young flower that needs to be caressed and nurtured. She is admired by everyone she meets. Almost all the girls she knows consider her a vulnerable and very fragile nature. They have no idea how wrong they are. None of them even suspect that Anna's stunning beauty hides a shocking secret. The main character is one of the most dangerous and terrifying government assassins in the world. If the superiors entrust her with a task, then she knows that the target will be eliminated by any means. But even she sometimes has a hard time. An impressive and exciting trip awaits Anna ahead, which will test all her skills as an agent and a hired killer. Are you interested in action movies or action thrillers? Do you like the unique atmosphere of French action films? Then we are sure that the movie "Anna" will be an excellent choice for watching online. We wish you a pleasant viewing!

title: Green book
description: At one fine moment, a sophisticated socialite, a wealthy and very talented musician realizes the need for a personal driver and bodyguard. According to the plot of the film, he hires a person who is completely unsuitable for the job. The point is that Tony "Bazika" is an outcast with a boneless tongue. Don't put your finger in his mouth, just let him talk on any topic. But with all this, he perfectly holds the blow and swings his fists perfectly. It is with such a person that the musician goes on a tour that will forever change the lives of both heroes. The film "The Green Book" (2018) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of comedy and drama films.

title: Miss Sloane / Sloane's Dangerous Game
description: In this picture, we will talk about an unsurpassed lobbyist and "shark with teeth" in the world of American political business. This is naturally a charming woman who plays a dangerous game. There are legends about Elizabeth Sloan in all the states of America. She can beat any opponent. Her manner of conducting business only makes one admire and applaud standing. This woman is not used to giving up and stopping halfway. However, the stakes are very high in this case. At stake is not only reputation and career advancement, but also one's own life. And that's why you need to be extremely careful and weigh all the pros and cons.

title: A handsome boy
description: A tragedy happened in the family of David Scheffen. He no longer sees his son Nick as a thoughtful and handsome boy. The thing is that Nick has turned into a drug addict. David asks himself the question: where did such a bad habit come from? After all, he devoted all his time to education. Divorce with his wife went smoothly for his son. He still communicates with his mother, who lives in Los Angeles. David cannot find an answer to this question. He can only remember his son's childhood and youth, when he was a sweet, obedient and charming boy.

title: The theory of everything
description: While studying cosmology at Cambridge in 1963, Stephen Hawking led an active lifestyle. He rode a bicycle, liked to play croquet and sometimes appeared at student parties, although he did not really like loud companies and dances. Jane Wyeth, on the contrary, was sociable, and she got to a party where some classmates gathered by chance with her friend. The evening promised to be boring, but when Jane met the interesting boy Stephen, she was glad to be in this place. One day, Stephen felt that he was losing control of his body. At first he did not attach importance to the lost cup, but the situation quickly worsened, and when Stephen unexpectedly fell in the courtyard of the campus, the doctor made a disappointing diagnosis. The word "sclerosis" sounded like a sentence and did not bode well for the patient. The nervous disorder will gradually destroy the brain cells that are responsible for muscle activity, as a result of which in the near future Steven will not be able to walk or even talk, and his muscles will completely atrophy. In addition to the disappointing future, the doctor said that Hawking had a maximum of a couple of years left to live, and medicine was powerless in this case. By this time, Stephen had already started dating Jane, and after learning the terrible news, he tried to protect his beloved from future troubles. He honestly tried to break up with Jane, but the girl, realizing what her future life with a crippled person threatened, did not leave Stephen, and soon they became husband and wife. Fate gave Stephen more than two years of life, and he had time to have three children, but every day it became more and more difficult for him to communicate, and his young wife had to turn into a caregiver and forget about her personal life. Despite all the difficulties of life, Stephen and Jane try to be faithful to each other...

title: All the money in the world
description: There is no richer miser in the world than Paul Getty. Not all money can be earned - a wealthy businessman is sure of this, but he strives for it very much. He owns a multibillion-dollar corporation that brings him more than one million dollars every day. But as often happens, if everything is great at work, then in personal life, on the contrary, it is a mess. So the oil tycoon has a lot of problems in his family. He is disliked by almost all his relatives, who consider him a greedy person. The millionaire himself does not hide his unfriendly attitude towards his relatives and friends, considering them to be beggars and beggars. One day, unknown people steal the businessman's grandson right in broad daylight. They hope to receive a solid ransom, because the man probably will not spare a few million for the life of his relative.

title: Enemies
description: Events unfold in the Wild West. During the war, literally all military personnel bypass the enemies. During the long years of military conflict with the redskins, Captain Blocker treated every Indian with contempt. He saw in him a potential enemy, who took the lives of many of his comrades-in-arms and ordinary civilians. He is tasked with delivering a dying Comanche chief named Yellow Hawk to his homeland in Montana. The road ahead is not easy, and the man reluctantly undertakes this mission. He leads a family of Indians in shackles and chains. They walk on the plains of the enemy people. Here you need to be especially careful, because at any moment an unpleasant encounter with enemies can happen.

title: Jungle
description: Yossi Hingsber is still very young, he is only twenty-two years old. But, despite all this, he has already been to more than one war. The action takes place in the eighties of the twentieth century. Yossi decides to go to Bolivia. There he wants to investigate the Amazon jungle. When the boy comes to this country, he meets Markus Stamm and Kevin Gale. The former was a teacher, and Kevin was a very experienced and professional photographer. Karl Ruchprechter promises the boys an exciting tour in one Bolivian city. They decide to go through the jungle. After a while, the boys have trouble. The fact is that Marcus injured his legs. They decide to send him back to the city with the guide, while Hingsberg continues the journey with the photographer. But these were not the last bad events.

title: The space between us
description: A group of astronauts went to Mars to organize a scientific laboratory so that it would be possible to live there permanently. The crew commander - Sarah Elliott turned out to be pregnant. While on a foreign planet, she gave birth to a boy, dying in childbirth. Employees of the laboratory decided not to disclose this news, but to keep it a secret. Thus, a boy named Gardner became the first Martian. At the age of sixteen, Gardner has two vital desires: to find his father and to meet a girl from Tulsa, Colorado, whom he met during an online correspondence. To implement these plans, he will have to go to Earth, a foreign planet for a Martian, having overcome a huge distance in space. The young man flies to his mother and father's native Earth to get to know him better and find his father. However, according to researchers, his body is not adapted to the earthly way of life.

title: The Maze Runner: The Cure for Death
description: In the third part, Thomas is forced to find a cure for death in order to save his friends. In the previous parts, it was shown how Tom and sixty other teenagers ended up in a mysterious city called Glade, which was surrounded by a labyrinth that changes every day. There were terrible monsters in it, which did not allow anyone to pass. All the heroes do not remember anything from their past life, except their name. They decide to overcome the maze simply by running through it to break free. Not many succeeded. And now a new obstacle awaited them in the form of an impassable desert. Now Tom leads the group. During these long days, they became very close friends. All of them realize that only together they will be able to defeat the insidious organization POROC and break out into the normal world, in which their relatives and friends have been waiting for them for a long time.

title: The one who runs through the maze
description: The plot of the first part is based on the book of the same name by James Dashner. One day, the hero of the picture takes the elevator to avoid walking up the stairs. And as a result, he finds himself in a strange place in the company of sixty teenagers. All of them remember absolutely nothing about themselves, except their name. Our hero's name is Thomas. And the place where he ended up is called Gladen. The teenagers themselves call themselves Gladers. They are located in a square closed space, around which there is an impassable labyrinth. The main goal of all boys is to pass it, because this is the only chance to go back and remember their past. Every thirty days, a new teenager appears in a closed square, who also does not remember anything except his name. The heroes of the picture gradually run out of food, and the only way out is to go through the labyrinth. The difficulty is that it is inhabited by bloodthirsty monsters and changes its configuration every night. At one point, a girl who is in a coma appears. She manages to say that she is the last one to get here. Tom becomes a runner who must run through all the challenges and overcome treacherous traps.

title: Brave heart
description: In 1280, Scotland fought diligently for independence against the English state led by Edward. William Wallace, the hero of "Braveheart" lost his father during the attack of the English army, but fortunately his uncle Argyle takes care of his upbringing, who gave him a good European education. As an adult, William decides to return to his native Scottish village, where he meets a childhood friend. Because of the ridiculous laws about the first nights of marriage, the heroes decide to get married in secret, but their happy married life did not last long. English soldiers kill the boy's beloved, after which he starts an uprising. The movie "Braveheart" (1995) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for lovers of historical dramas

title: Cards, money, two barrels
description: Harry is not just a criminal authority and a gambler, he is a real cheater who can easily beat any card lover. In addition to gambling, the hero of the film collects antique firearms. However, Eddie is not a simple guy either, he is not used to giving up, so he intends to beat Harry and win a great jackpot. As a result of a dishonest game, Eddie loses the entire amount, and also turns out to be in debt to Harry. He has no choice, now he must get down to business and steal a valuable specimen firearm for Harry. A seemingly simple job turns into a real problem, in which Eddie himself and Barry's hired negligent performers turn out to be. Now they will all have to decide how to get out of the situation, because they need to not only pay back Harry's debt.

title: Alice in Wonderland
description: The plot of the first part revolves around a nineteen-year-old girl. Once a Victorian party was dedicated to Alice. Here Hamish Escot proposes to her to marry him. He is quite a wealthy young man, but at the same time he has absolutely nothing in his head to brag about. The girl did not answer and ran away from the castle. She saw an unusual rabbit and ran after him. Our heroine follows him into the rabbit hole, and immediately finds herself in a magical kingdom. Here it is called the Underground Country, in which various miracles take place. Soon the girl will meet very colorful characters and will be convinced that a fairy tale is sometimes a reality.

title: 30 crazy wishes
description: In this picture, hopelessness goes hand in hand with the brightest joys of life. One of the main characters of the movie "30 Crazy Desires" is a distrustful hypochondriac named Calvin, who works as a baggage sorter at the airport. He constantly invents non-existent illnesses to make himself seem even more miserable. Skye is the complete opposite of Calvin. She is terminally ill, she has very little left. But, at the same time, she does not give up. She is a walking holiday, the soul of the company. She wants to fulfill her wildest wishes before death takes her.

title: Lonely Santa wants to meet Mrs. Claus
description: The focus of the story of the picture "Lonely Santa wants to meet Mrs. Claus" turns out to be a single mother named Beth Andrews, who has long been disappointed in life and does not believe in miracles. For Christmas, her son demands a new daddy. It so happens that Nick, whose father is the real Santa Claus, comes to town at this time. But he decided to retire, so Nick has to replace him. But here's the problem, in order to fulfill the role of Santa Claus, Nick just needs to get married. This is where a funny and romantic story begins, when miracles tend to come true.

title: A mountain between us
description: The acquaintance of the writer Alex Ashley and the doctor Ben Tracy took place at the airport of the American city of Salt Lake City, from which they were supposed to depart on board the same plane to Baltimore. Everyone from the film "The Mountain Between Us" has their own plans ahead of them, which may fail, because the flight is postponed indefinitely due to bad weather. But they both can't wait - Alex rushes to her fiancé, with whom she should have a wedding, and to which guests have already been invited. As for Dr. Trace, he is in a hurry to see a patient who has to perform an emergency operation. Thanks to Ashley, a way out of the situation was found quite quickly. She agreed with the pilot of a private plane, who agreed to deliver her and the doctor to the appointed place for a substantial fee. Only during the flight the plane gets into a storm and crashes.

title: Rock-n-roller / Rock-n-roller
description: Night clubs and nightclubs filled with gangs, robberies and murders with gunfights are the dark side of London street life. Corruption, racketeering, arbitrariness reign here - the native element of criminal elements. The main business of these scumbags is drug trafficking and "operations" with real estate. Everyone wants to grab a piece from a well-established and profitable feeder. But in order to conduct business in this city, everyone needs to receive the blessing of the "big man" - Lenny Cole. Small robbers - members of the London "Wild Pack" gang, Russian criminal authority - oligarch Yuriy Omovich, his accountant - the crazy beauty Stella, and a rock-n-roller with his friends drug addicts revolve around this personality. All the listed characters constantly interfere in cases related to Omovich and Cole.

title: A shot into the abyss
description: Jacob "Many" Harlon is an entrepreneur who was involved in a car accident. The hero of the film "Shot into the Abyss" is accused of the crime and sent to prison. There, behind bars, the world is cruel and harsh, in order to survive, you need to prove that you have character, strength and will. Fortunately, Jacob's physical data allow him to stand up for himself. Soon a decent businessman will have to change his character and life principles. He becomes one of the members of the prison gang. His wife and son await his release. Will Harlon be able to return to his family and live his old life, or will the criminal world not let him go? Moreover, when he was released from prison, he received a task from his boss: to commit a major crime in order to deal with a rival group engaged in the redistribution of the territory of Southern California.

title: Good times
description: One day Connie lost his job. Attempts to get a job ended in failure. Everything would not be so bad, but a close person is under his care. The guy decides to attack the nearest bank branch. But in such a case you definitely need a partner. Having no suitable acquaintances, the hero takes a disabled relative to task and develops a simple plan. Only the robbery did not go as planned. Nick falls into a stupor and is not going to run away from the scene of the crime. Mature policemen put handcuffs on him without much trouble. But who will take care of him behind bars? After all, he is not even able to go to the toilet on his own. Concerned by such circumstances, the brother decides to immediately arrange an escape.

title: Fred Claus, Santa's brother
description: A comedy about Fred Claus, Santa's brother, who is his complete opposite. Fred grew up in the saintly shadow of his brother Nick and eventually turned into a grumbler who lost his faith in Christmas. One December, Fred flies to the North Pole (first class in a reindeer sled) and finds Nick in trouble as the efficiency expert decides to cancel Christmas forever! Fred saves Christmas and finds a taste for family again.

title: Intuition
description: An unfamiliar couple meets in a New York store while choosing the same pair of gloves. The Christmas sale in the hustle and bustle of holiday purchases inexplicably pushes a boy and a girl, already burdened by other halves, against each other. But an unexpected sympathy for each other pushes them to continue the unexpected meeting. They have a wonderful evening in the nearest restaurant, becoming more and more passionate about their mutual romantic feelings. There is an awkward pause when parting. Jonathan offers to exchange phone numbers, but Sarah decides to leave it up to chance. She writes cherished numbers on the cover of the book, which is immediately sent to the second-hand department. Her companion writes his combination on a five-dollar bill, and inspired by the unusual game, the pair exchange the bill at the register. Bets are made. New acquaintances part with a light soul, with little hope that the things marked in such an original way will be able to find their way back to the addressees. Seven years later, the happy groom receives a book volume from the bride as a gift and cannot believe his eyes. In another city, at this moment, girlfriends change purses in a hurry, and the banknote turns out to be in the heroine's possession. Lovers drop everything and rush to meet their own destiny.

title: while you were sleeping
description: Shyness prevents lonely Lucy from meeting the man of her dreams, whom she sees every morning. But chance helps, and the girl saves the stranger's life. Now she can admire him for days: the rescued Peter lies unconscious in the hospital. The family mistakenly takes her for a bride, and Lucy does not want to convince these nice people. After all, she had already managed to get attached to them, especially to her brother Peter. And while the unsuspecting "groom" sleeps, his "bride" no longer believes in a beautiful dream. Soon Lucy will have to choose between a magical fairy tale and such a real love...

title: Curly Sue / Curly Sue
description: Bill Dancer, a swindler, and his ward, a smart, curly-haired orphan girl, were thrown by fate into the very heart of Chicago. This time, luck smiled on Bill: his harmless scam leads them from a homeless shelter to a luxurious mansion. They stage Bill falling under the wheels of a car driven by a rich young woman. Fearing for Bill's life, she invites him and Sue to live temporarily at her house...

title: A new Christmas tale / Sknara
description: Another Christmas is coming, which is eagerly awaited by millions of people in all corners of the planet. On this significant day, we will have the opportunity to rest from the boring work and see our loved ones, giving them a maximum of positive emotions. But, unfortunately, in our world there are still callous people who simply hate this holiday. One of the most ardent haters of Christmas is the self-serving and greedy owner of a local TV channel, Frank Cross. All he cares about in life is the money he has been collecting for the past two decades. Pure profit and no emotions - this is his motto. He does not care at all about the fact that with his actions and words he often destroyed the lives of countless people. And even on this festive day, he arranges another scandal, which destroys several human lives at once. But this time there are those who, perhaps, will be able to return to the main character a sense of joy, which he has not felt since childhood. Several representatives of the other world will guide Frank through the corridors of time, allowing him to look at the most significant moments of his long life. This will allow the main character to look at many things in a new way.

title: Who is Santa?
description: In the center of the plot of the picture is Santa Claus, who, having fallen from a great height from his magical sleigh, forgot who he is and what he does in modern New York. On Christmas Eve, everyone is filled with a New Year's mood, Christmas trees are already decorated, toys and gifts are bought, and children all over the world are just doing what they are eagerly waiting for the arrival of Santa Claus. A TV reporter named Peter, who has been doing New Year's and Christmas TV shows for many years, does not expect anything new from this holiday. But suddenly someone heavy, old and dressed in red and white clothes falls on the hood of his car. This "someone" turns out to be Santa Claus himself. He didn't break anything, he's whole, healthy, but he doesn't remember anything at all. Santa has forgotten who he is, what he does and what his purpose is. Peter understands that now all the joy and fun of Christmas will be a complete disappointment for children, and therefore he decides to help Santa Claus find his relatives and friends so that they can help the old man restore his memory. At the same time, the elves led by the leader - Max, who wants more than anything in the world to return his old master, begin to search for Santa Claus. How will this adventure end for Klaus?

title: Dark times
description: Winston Churchill will forever remain in history as a controversial and dark man. He worked his way to the top of power for a long time and persistently, not being afraid of envious people and competitors. At that time, the role of Nazi Germany in the world was gaining momentum. Hitler saw a powerful opponent in the person of the Soviet Union. Then the leader of the fascists turns to the hero of the picture with a request to unite two powerful states against the USSR. However, a talented politician, foreseeing such a result of events, gives a sharp no to the Nazi. What was behind such a decisive step for the politician and for the country as a whole? Perhaps the hero decided in advance the future of his country, and if he agreed to the proposal of the German leader, it would be expected to take into account other countries enslaved by the Nazis. On the other hand, the young politician had to think about his place in the management of the state, because the decision made might not be liked by the English government officials, and the man could be retired before the deadline.

title: Lohan's luck
description: Native brothers from North Carolina dream of getting rich. Meanwhile, Clyde goes to a boring job at a local bar, and in the evenings he drinks beer in front of the TV, showing no interest in anything else and hoping for luck. In addition, he has an amputated part of his hand, which affected his closed nature. Jimmy Logan has recently been fired and is severely depressed. He doesn't want to put up with this state of affairs and is trying to think of a way to break the big bank. One day, a brilliant idea dawns on him. The guy remembered that at his old job there was a pneumatic mail, through which huge sums of money from sports bets passed. He convinces his brother that they can become millionaires if they can get into the vault of this money. But there is no way they can handle it together, they need a third person who has experience in this kind of work. The boys go through the memory of everyone who has anything to do with the art of thievery.

title: You were never here
description: Joe was the best in his squad and always rushed into battle in the front ranks. However, a combat injury forced him to take a well-deserved rest, and he was gradually forgotten. He slept every night with nightmares from his past life. When he was left without a job, he decided to become a hired killer, which he had never been. The man carried out various errands of wealthy people for certain rewards. He had no problems getting rich sons out of trouble who got into unpleasant situations or helped take part in showdowns with criminal authorities. The only woman who did not see him as a cruel mercenary was his old mother. She loves her son with a mother's love and always worries about him when Joe goes on a mission. This time, the senator himself turns to the man for help. His minor daughter named Nina is missing.

title: A guest at Christmas
description: The main character's name is Johnny, and one day he decides to volunteer for the army. The only trouble is that when they were sent to conduct an operation in the bay, he dies trying to cover his comrades. In the movie Guest for Christmas, you will see how a family is very hard to cope with the loss of a brother and a son. George's father suffers the most from the loss. The fact is that it was thanks to his father that he was raised in patriotic feelings and thanks to him the boy went to the service. When the family received the news of the death, it was Christmas Eve. A huge amount of time has passed since that tragic event, only the parents again receive terrible news from their youngest daughter about breast cancer. An operation and, of course, the unknown await. It is with such bad news that the family will have to meet Christmas. Only on such a day, even with the most terrible news, you continue to believe in a miracle. And the boy's parents are preparing for Christmas with hope for the first time in all these twelve years. They put up a huge Christmas tree, decorated everything and are preparing treats. After all, the holiday can come only to the house where it is expected. It comes in the form of a stranger whom George picked up on his way home and invited to spend the night. Surprisingly, the boy looks like his dead son and he, like John, served in Iraq. who is this guy Or maybe the son did not die? Miracles happen, and maybe this guy will be a Christmas present?

title: A promise at dawn
description: The picture is an adaptation of the autobiographical novel by the writer Romain Gary. As a small child, the protagonist of "Promises at Dawn" doubted his own strength. And only his mother believed that her son would grow up to be a successful diplomat and writer. A few years passed and her dreams came true. Romain was a laureate of the Goncourt Prize. Maternal love and unconditional support led our hero through numerous trials and adventures throughout his life, which is full of secrets, battles and incredible twists.

title: New Year's corporate party
description: The plot of the story revolves around a young man who lives his ordinary and calm life, not even realizing that his company is in big trouble. According to the plot of "New Year's corporate party", his sister, being the general director of the company, threatens to close the branch of her negligent brother if he does not raise the indicators. And then our hero comes up with a brilliant idea - it is necessary to throw a grand Christmas party in order to get a big client, the deal with which will save the company. But, apparently, a banal party turned into a real festive commotion.

title: Christmas vacation
description: The favorite holiday for all people on earth is "Christmas vacation", Americans treat it with special fanaticism and prepare for a whole month to spend the holiday with their family. In the house of the main characters, it is a time when everyone gives gifts and traditionally celebrates this holiday, the head of the Clark family is a ticking time bomb, he wants to raise the festive spirit and decorates the whole house with garlands, brings home a Christmas tree that he cut down in the forest, and also leaves the whole area without electricity, in general they managed to have a merry Christmas as usual.

title: Santa Claus 2
description: When Scott Calvin agreed to temporarily perform the duties of Santa Claus, he did not think that it would drag on for eight years. They flew by like one day, because the real symbol of the Christmas holidays had a huge amount of things to do that he would never even look back. The man works tirelessly and even got used to it, although before he did not even believe in the old man who brings gifts to the children. The next Christmas holidays are coming and there is more and more work to do. He must make lists of obedient boys who will be the first to receive the best gifts. However, as the new Santa discovered, his son Charlie is not on this list. Moreover, he is considered a hardened hooligan and the blame for raising a child falls entirely on his parents, that is, on him. But these are not all the problems of the main character. As it turned out, according to the contract, Santa Claus must immediately find Mrs. Claus. If he does not do this, then it will be a violation of all the rules. To deal with all his affairs, Scott entrusts the affairs to his doppelganger. When the man returned to his powers, he found that life at the North Pole had turned into complete chaos. Now he has to correct many more mistakes. Once again, Mr. Calvin is convinced that it is not so easy to be the most famous old man, and all matters must be solved by himself as they arise and not postponed for a long time.

title: Vox Lux
description: This story begins in 1999, when Celeste, a high school student, was lucky enough to survive a shooting by her classmate. The main character of "Vox Lux" under the impression of the tragedy writes a wonderful song, which immediately becomes a hit, and the girl herself becomes a famous star. Working with an experienced manager, as well as the public's thirst for details of the tragedy, made our heroine a superstar. She was at the peak of her popularity when a scandalous episode occurred at a press conference. Now her career is threatened with decline and even complete collapse.

title: Bridge of Spies
description: The events of this film take place in the sixties of the twentieth century. This is the time of the Cold War between the Soviet Union and the United States of America. Soviet spy Rudolf Abel is captured in the American state. He is sentenced to the highest degree of punishment. James Donovan is ordered to defend the man. He works as an insurance lawyer and has never faced such conflicts before. However, orders are not discussed. And he begins to prepare a speech for the benefit of his ward. Meanwhile, over the expanses of the USSR, an American scout conducts a survey of territories from an airplane. He is captured by the Soviet authorities. CIA agents are afraid of the beginning of a world conflict in connection with the leak of information. They convince the hero of the picture to start negotiations with the exchange of prisoners. Difficult business work begins, which brings the lawyer to East Berlin. It is here that he needs to fulfill a deadly mission and prove his ability to his management. He must demonstrate all his skill in conducting business negotiations. Will a simple lawyer be able to prevent the beginning of a world cataclysm between two superpowers?

title: Vik Adeline / Vik Adaline
description: The plot is built around an attractive woman named Adaline. She is more than a hundred years old. She only looks twenty-five. The secret of eternal youth is as follows: at the age of twenty-seven, the girl had an accident and was supposed to die, but fate and the Almighty give her a second chance to live until the end of the centuries, while being forever young. Despite her attractive appearance, a woman cannot build family happiness. As a result of an accidental connection, she had a daughter. It's just that she has aged a long time and now they are constantly confused when seen together, because the daughter looks much older than her young mother. This circumstance constantly depresses a woman and almost always throws her into trembling and tears. She dreams of finally finding her only man who can make her happy. And fate presents such a surprise.

title: 007: Spectrum
description: An unknown anonymous person sends James Bond a coded message. Special agent "Two Zero Seven" learns from him that he needs to fight Specter, a legendary criminal organization that is engaged in terrorist attacks around the world. Meanwhile, the spy bureau is to be liquidated. The relationship between Bond and the MI6 staff is heated to the limit. And M's management is trying to save its company from closure. And only Her Royal Highness's spy is on the case again. He must stop the activities of a criminal corporation. Chases, skirmishes, fights, shootouts - all this awaits the viewer in this picture. Well, of course, you can't do without femmes fatale. For the first time, Bond will be able to declare that he is not just a super spy, but also the best lover who has feelings.

title: Santa Claus
description: The grandfather who fell from Scott's house was not ordinary. In fact, he was a real Santa Claus. You could understand this by the deer that were parked nearby and by his clothes. The main character appears in Santa's sleigh. The deer immediately takes him to the North Pole. There, the man will have to meet the main elf, who is in charge of the Christmas holiday. It is he who will try to convince Scott that now he should replace Santa Claus. The real wizard has not been able to start work yet, as he is somewhat injured after the fall. At the beginning, Scott could not believe everything that was happening around him. However, he has to come to terms with his new position. The main character needs to learn a lot. Santa Claus is not someone who puts on a formal suit and listens to children's rhymes. He has more serious responsibilities. Very soon Scott will have a big belly and a white beard. He will turn into a magician that every child dreams of meeting.

title: By plane, train, car
description: A wonderful New Year's and Christmas comedy with the inimitable Steve Martin will take us to New York, where happy marketer Neil Page successfully held another presentation. He is extremely pleased with himself, because everything turned out for the best and now he intends to buy a ticket to Chicago and spend a simply wonderful Thanksgiving evening with his family. But unfortunately, such good plans were not destined to come true... As if to spite our hero, nature decided otherwise, due to bad weather conditions, all flights are canceled and Neil will have to find another way to get home. He is joined by a strange fat man, Deli Griffith, who also wants to get to Chicago faster. Together with his funny new friend, our marketer goes on a fun and long journey. So, will brave guys who are ready for anything be able to get home on time and spend Thanksgiving at the festive table with family and friends?

title: On needle 2 / T2 Trainspotting
description: A cult film that reflects a whole subculture, the spirit of England in the 90s, which was called "On the Needle". It was a sin for the authors to shoot the second part of the sequel. A quartet of friends, missing drug addicts in their youth, gets together again after a long separation. All this time Mark Renton was absent from Edinburgh. He missed his friends and now, finally, he is coming home. His parents are no longer alive, Kocheryzhka still uses drugs, because of which he is haunted by continuous problems, Simon "sniffs" little by little, continues to live the life of a criminal and a dealer, and tries to open a brothel. And Franko escapes from prison, robs houses along the way and wants revenge on Mark for stealing money (an event from the first part). Having met, all four unite with the idea of ​​engaging in the porn industry. Veronica, Simon's current girlfriend, joins them. They have no idea how dangerous this activity is.

title: On a needle
description: The heroes of the first part of the tape are worried about only one thing - where to take a dose. He clouded the head, deprived of intelligence and turned people into humanoid creatures. Friends who live in Edinburgh, Scotland, live one day at a time and get involved in the most ridiculous and terrible situations. Mark Renton is trying to "tie down": he locks himself in a cheap hotel room and goes through the process of "breaking". Having survived terrible torment, the boy returns to his environment. He meets a girl in a club and finds himself in bed with her. In the morning, Mark is surprised to learn that Diana, his sex partner, is only 15 years old. He wants to "drool", but under the pressure of her blackmail, he is forced to stay. Friends in search of money for heroin engage in robbery and theft. Renton manages to avoid prison, but he almost loses his life from an overdose. His parents, quite decent people, try to influence their son by demanding that he give up drugs and pass tests. Mark, not surprisingly, after repeated use of needles, has a "clean" test.

title: The night before the hangover / Christmas
description: For some time, Ethan's attitude towards Christmas has changed, and all because his parents died on the eve of this holiday. Now, as soon as the Christmas holidays approach, it brings him pain and painful memories. He no longer thought that he would ever be able to enjoy this holiday and celebrate it like everyone else. But one day in his life, his friends Isaac and Chris tried to change something. They organized a meeting of friends, where you could get drunk or join in the use of drugs. Later, the event, started by Ethan's friends, took root and became an annual tradition. Chris is now famous and he can't show his bad habits. Isaac got married and is expecting a new addition to the family, so he started leading a healthy lifestyle.

title: Foreigner
description: Min, having been released from prison, decides to escape to Hong Kong with his family. The seemingly prosperous city-state, unfortunately, also does not become safe for him, as for a foreigner. As a result of a raid by Thai pirates, the hero's two eldest daughters die. Shocked by the tragedy, the man decides to go to London, where, he hopes, it is possible to raise a child in peace. There he managed to open a small restaurant. Life is getting better, the beautiful daughter feels great in this country. Fears were left behind. But one day, as a result of a high-profile terrorist act, the last heiress Mina dies. The authorities do not burden themselves with the search for criminals as soon as possible. Few people are concerned about the death of foreigners.

title: Malibu Rescuers
description: Vacationers on the beaches of Malibu have nothing to fear, because there is always an elite division of lifeguards ready to help. Among those who professionally protect beach spaces and keep order on the coast is a team consisting of Mitch Buchannon and Matt Brody, as well as three charming girls who work together with them. Mitch is a lifeguard in the past, his exploits and muscular pumped-up body have gained sympathy and authority among beachgoers. He hires new employees for training, who after trial checks will become full team members. Among the contenders is former Olympic swimming champion Matt, who lost in the last competition. With these people, Mitch will not only have to save the drowning, but also the entire beach. While on duty, it turns out that the nightclub, located directly on the ocean and owned by Victoria Leeds, is engaged in the distribution of drugs.

title: To the stars
description: Clifford McBride lives in those times when people are actively exploring space. According to the plot "To the stars", flights to the farthest corners of the solar system became possible. Clifford, being not very sociable, but giving his all to the cause, managed to become one of the members of the space expedition. Their goal was to get to Neptune. Clifford flies away, leaving his little son Roy on Earth. Twenty years have passed since then. Roy became an engineer in the Army Corps. He decides to go on a space journey in search of his father, who never returned 20 years ago.

title: Shulga
description: Professional boxer Billy "Big" Hope leads the middleweight division. This guy even has his own original tactic called "Lefty". It is expressed in an effective, but at the same time tough offensive combat. Billy draws nourishment from his own feelings of inferiority. He desperately needs love, fame and money. He has a beautiful wife, Maureen, and a young daughter. Their family can be called exemplary, because harmony reigns here. The family has its own house and financial security at a good level. The man is at the peak of his career, but only he is starting to miss more and more shots. Maureen asks Billy to leave this activity, to leave boxing. His family needs him. Together with his wife, Billy goes to another party. And finally he says what Maureen has been waiting for so long. He is ready to leave sports and raise his daughter together with his wife. However, it is not possible for a married couple to calmly leave the party. A skirmish ensues, during which Maureen dies. Billy's life ends there. He cannot bear the loss of a loved one. All his time is now taken up by alcohol and prescription drugs. The court makes a decision to send the daughter to the asylum and Billy cannot prevent it in any way. And the house is taken away from him because of debts. Billy's future fate hung in the balance. A former boxer becomes his savior. He takes Hope under his wing and begins to train him. However, he gives Billy more than just a workout, completely changing him. Billy becomes thoughtful, loving and disciplined. Titus sees that Hope has a lot of potential and intends to get him back in the ring. This is the only way Billy can get his daughter and the house back. Titus himself had to stop boxing due to an injury that left him without an eye. Billy got a chance, which he simply has to use. It will not be easy to return my daughter and restore relations with her. But Billy was used to fighting to the last.

title: Bad Santa 2
description: When the main character began to suffer from depression once again, he thought about committing suicide. But he changes his mind after some event. He receives a message from his best friend Marcus. The fact is that he was recently released from prison. He got there not only because of robbing stores, but also because he wanted to kill Willy. During the time that the dark-skinned dwarf spent behind bars, he did not change one iota. Marcus asks the main character to forget all the bad things and return to the work they were doing before. After all, before the New Year holidays, stores are very full of cash reserves. This time, the dwarf offers his friend to commit a crime by robbing a charity organization. It focuses on raising money for those who do not have their own home.

title: Four Christmases
description: Kate and Brad have been together for three years now - a considerable period, but young people are in no hurry to tie the knot. According to the plot of "4 Christmases", both are convinced that a good deed cannot be called marriage, and the love boat must inevitably crash into everyday life. There are reasons for this: both he and she grew up in families where their parents divorced. Each of their parents found a new soul mate, and in total, Kate and Brad have four families, which means that on the eve of the holiday they have to visit all their numerous relatives. A young couple decides to do something different: go to warm countries and go diving. But, ironically, the flight is canceled due to bad weather.

title: Survive Christmas
description: Drew Latham is not lucky in his personal life, he has no relatives, and he had a fight with his girlfriend and broke up right before Christmas. Now he is very sad and lonely and he is thinking about with whom he will spend the brightest holidays of the year. Suddenly, an interesting idea comes to Drew's head, the implementation of which he immediately sets about. He goes to the city where he spent his childhood and finds the house where he lived with his parents. Now it is inhabited by people who are strangers to him - the Valko family, which is experiencing enormous financial difficulties. The boy asks this family to accept him as a son during the Christmas holidays, for which he promises to pay 250 thousand dollars.

title: Star Wars: Episode 6 - Return of the Jedi
description: In this sixth episode, the tape tells about the deadly confrontation between the Rebel Alliance and the forces of Emperor Palpatine. The evil Sith are building a second "Death Star" to destroy, which belongs to the unconquered Republicans, and Skywalker will have to fight in a duel with his father - the personification of dark forces - Darth Vader. This battle will end the civil war in the entire Galaxy. About what the dark lord his father, the young Jedi learned from the dying Yoda. But before his main battle, Luke, with the help of his loyal robots, must free the best pilot in the universe and his old friend Solo, frozen by Jubba's gang. The soldiers will have to fly to the impregnable Death Star on a trophy imperial ship and, having infiltrated the station, get involved in a deadly duel.

title: Phoenix
description: In the plot of the film, you will learn the story of Nellie Lenz, a woman who became a victim of the Holocaust. There was an incident in the concentration camp in which many people died, but our heroine was able to survive. But not everything ended well - she was injured and her face was badly disfigured. Nelly is going to Berlin, where she will undergo plastic surgery. She went there on the advice of Elena Winter, an employee of the European Agency. After a long rehabilitation and complete recovery, Nelly decides to find her husband Johannes. After a long search, our heroine will be disappointed, because her husband considers her dead and does not believe the woman who pretends to be his wife. But after some time Johan still agrees with Nelly that she looks like his "dead" wife. After such a turn of events, her husband takes a step that she could not even think about. Johan offers her to become his wife in order to get the property that she inherited. Our heroine did not expect herself to agree to this strange proposal.

title: Birdman
description: Riggan Thompson, known for his role as Birdman, the iconic superhero of the late 1980s, is trying to step out of the shadow of his character. Now, more than two decades after his success, he devotes all his strength to the Broadway production, which he hopes to regain his former glory. It will not be easy to do this - the hero is constantly pursued by all kinds of failures. In addition, in his head he constantly hears the voice of his character, Birdman, who has become his alter ego - he tries to force the actor to leave the theater in order to return to the movies.

title: Lady Bird
description: Khrystyna lives in a small provincial town of Sacramento with her mother. A woman is trying to re-educate an adult girl and make her a lady. Only adolescence and the negative influence of the environment affects the heroine of the film. She is confident in her abilities and dreams of entering a prestigious university, preferably in New York. Meanwhile, the girl is trying herself in the role of "Lady Bird" on the theater stage. At first glance, her performance causes a storm of applause and the audience applauds her. However, the aspiring actress has no prospects in this role. Then the heroine of the picture asks her adopted brother to help her escape from her mother and settle in New York. A young man tries to make a name for himself in front of his sister and helps her perform a daring act. When a girl gets to a huge metropolis, she immediately understands that she will have a hard time here.

title: Become John Lennon
description: "Becoming John Lennon" is a biographical feature film dedicated to the life of the great musician, the lead singer of The Beatles. Here you will learn details from Lennon's youth, when he was just starting to play in various musical groups. The film itself begins with the death of John's own uncle, and the teenager is left alone with his aunt, who is raising him. But she is a conservative woman who controls Lennon's actions, his studies, and tries to "guide him to the true path." John grows up a desperate hooligan, he does not feel much zeal for learning. He is more interested in communicating with the many girls around him. The film touches on the moment of founding the group together with Paul McCartney and George Harrison.

title: Star Wars: Episode 4 - A New Hope
description: In a distant galaxy, a war has been going on for many years between the Empire, which has enslaved most of the planets, and the Republic. The Empire possesses immense power and capabilities and is ready to break the resistance, which has left many Jedi lost and almost disarmed. The Sith, led by the bloodthirsty Darth Vader, are fighting on the side of the first. They have the most powerful weapon called the Death Star. Princess Leia, who is at the head of the rebels, was captured by them. But she manages to call for help by sending two droids to the planet Tatooine. There lives Obi-Wan Kenobi, who raises Luke Skywalker - a young man who has the power. With the help of a lightsaber, smuggler Han Solo and droids, he has to go in search of the leader of the rebels - Princess Leia. The battle will not be easy...

title: A relegation game
description: The plot of the tape is based on real events related to the economic crisis of 2008. The story tells how complex the financial system is and how cruel and unpunished people can be who are hungry for profit. Events begin to develop since 2005, long before the onset of the crisis. At this time, eccentric hedge fund manager Michael Berry looks closely at the American real estate market and discovers that it is on the verge of an unprecedented collapse. Since no one else notices, Berry realizes that this is a chance to make a lot of money.

title: Perfect strangers
description: Three perfect married couples and one bachelor are going to spend an evening together. They speculate that one of their friends' family fell apart because of an SMS message: the wife found out about the husband's mistress. Eva, a psychotherapist by profession, suggests that everyone lay out their phones and read messages out loud, and answer phone calls using the speakerphone. All members of the company, some with ease, some not too willingly, agree to this game. Only now everything begins... The first message came to Cosimo, it contained the message "I want your body". It confuses the husband, who was forced to justify himself to his wife Bianca. It turned out that it was a joke of a friend - Rocco. Next is more interesting. Gradually, carefully hidden skeletons of each participant of the evening come out.

title: Family man
description: A successful single investment broker, Jack owns the largest company on Wall Street, lives in a luxurious penthouse, drives an expensive latest model Ferrari and enjoys life. On Christmas Eve, he witnesses a robbery at a store, after which he unexpectedly wakes up in a strange house, with a life that is not his own, with supposedly his two toddler children, and the woman he loved years ago, before leaving for New York. It would seem great! He has a family, now he is not alone. But the hero desperately wants to return to his former luxurious life, when he had a lot of money, expensive suits and fancy cars. But it's not that they don't recognize him at his former job, they don't even know his name there. Now he is forced to sell tires in his father-in-law's car service, buy clothes in a supermarket and deny himself everything for the sake of his children. Over time, he understands that there is a lot of good in this life, and it becomes no less valuable to him than his first fate. But the day comes when a very difficult choice must be made...

title: Star Wars: Episode 3 - Revenge of the Sith
description: A clone army led by Jedi Knights is fighting against the droid hordes of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Sith Lord - the leader of the Dark Side of the Force seizes power and turns the Republic into the Galactic Empire. Anakin Skywalker, who became a student of Palpatine and took a new name - Darth Vader, is tempted to side with Darth Sidious. Yesterday's hope of the Jedi turns into a cruel and faithful servant of the Emperor. Almost all the space knights of the light order are destroyed, and the living are forced to hide in exile. Padmé Amidala secretly gives birth to twins Luke and Leia, dying at birth. Despite the overwhelming victory of the Sith, the Jedi still have hope for a better future: there will be someone to face the enemies. During this time, Vader watches the construction of the Death Star station. In this third episode, most of the game scenes were shot on high-resolution digital 24p cameras. The movie "Star Wars: Episode 3 - Revenge of the Sith" (2005) will be interesting to watch in Ukrainian online for fans of fantasy and action movies.

title: Star Wars: Episode 2 - Attack of the Clones
description: With the fifth series of the cosmic epic about "Star Wars" in the distant Galaxy, the author group pleased the audience with its adaptation of the second episode, three years after the release of the first. A conflict is brewing in the Republic. The separatists under the leadership of Count Dooku propose to the senate to create a regular army. Senator Padme Amidala, the former queen of Naboo, opposes this. An attempt is made on her by unknown people. Master Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi is tasked with finding out who ordered the murder. Padawan Anakin Skyoker is appointed as Amidala's protector, which the young man is very happy about. Obi-Wan, following his own investigation, ends up on the forgotten planet of Kamino, where he learns that clone warriors for the Republic army have been bred there for several years. The prototype of these creatures is the bounty hunter Jango Fett, he is the hired killer.

title: Who's at home dad 2
description: In the second part of the film "Who's in the House Dad 2", Dusty realized his mistake and decides to return back to the family. The children are very happy about this, they missed their father, but the mother, Sarah, has already remarried and now the children also have a stepfather, Brad. He loves children and is attentive to them, but he understands that now it will be much more difficult to win their love and attention. However, this is already behind, in the first part of the film. What events await the heroes now? The New Year's holiday is coming soon. "Dads" decided to celebrate this holiday with children and their mother. It is clear that the rivalry continues, but this time they will have more competitors. The fact is that their dads, therefore, Megan and Dylan's grandfathers, also wanted to join this fun company.

title: Who's home dad?
description: The plot of the first part of the movie "Who's in the House Dad" tells about Dusty and Sarah, who managed to have two children, Megan and Dylan, in their joint marriage, after which they quarreled and broke up. Of course, children suffered the most from this. They stayed with their loving mother, but they also missed their father very much. After some time, Sarah married a second time, and the children had a stepfather, Brad. He loves children very much, so he quickly made friends with them, trying to gain their trust. The children became attached to Brad, and they liked that he played with them and took care of them. But still they called him "uncle", and when their own father called them, their joy knew no bounds. New Year's holidays were approaching, and a real gift was prepared for the children for the holidays - their long-absent dad Dusty came to visit them on New Year's Eve. The children are delighted with this event, which cannot be said about their stepfathers.

title: Elf
description: The comedy story of one boy who climbed into Santa's sack and went with him to the North Pole. The curious kid always wanted to see how the elves live, but now he will have to live with them. One elf adopted a boy and named him Buddy. Years later, the boy grew up and now he needs to find his place in life. But this is easier said than done, against the background of the local elf population, he is like a giant and becoming a real elf does not shine for him, and he does not want to be a white crow Buddy either.

title: A gift for Christmas
description: Howard Langston, because of his busy schedule, cannot give enough attention to his young son. This greatly upsets Jamie, who practically does not see his father either at children's parties, where he performs, or at children's attractions, where he has repeatedly promised to bring. Now Christmas is approaching, and the son really hopes that his father will fulfill his cherished dream and give him the most popular toy among children - Turboman. The son's hopes melt like snow in spring, the father, as always, forgets his promise. The popularity of the toy leads to the fact that on the eve of the holiday it cannot be bought anywhere, because caring parents have long taken care of their children and bought up all stocks of Turboman. Remembering the promise, Howard rushes to find the toy, but all his efforts remain in vain.

title: A genius and a madman
description: James Murray is an outstanding philologist who does not hold a professorship. One day, a man comes up with an amazing idea to create a unique English-language dictionary, which is known as the Oxford Dictionary. The year 1857 is in the courtyard, when the population is just beginning to become civilized and it is clear that without proper knowledge there is nowhere. The genius begins work on another masterpiece. It is worth noting that the hero could not do without the help of military surgeon William Minor, who was recognized as insane and had already been treated in a clinic for insane criminals for several years.

title: Paddington / Adventures of Paddington
description: In the first part, the Brown family met a funny bear in a red hat named Paddington at Paddington Station in London. Moved by the bear's manners, the Browns decide to take him in, because the hairy guest had a token with a request to take care of the animal. The four-legged traveler decided to somehow thank his new friends for the shelter provided to him. He enthusiastically takes on various household chores. But, clumsy by nature, he is constantly faced with a problem: things literally fall out of his paws and the owners' house after each such "help" resembles the housing of victims of a hurricane or other natural disaster. Chuzhyntsev now has an incredible adventure in a completely unfamiliar country.

title: Avatar
description: In the epicenter of the first part is a former marine who was destined to become the "Avatar". Jake Sully is confined to a wheelchair and forced to live on a veteran's military pension. He has a twin brother named Tom. He is engaged in genetic engineering and performs an important mission for the entire state. He was killed during a robbery and now his brother is destined to live a double life. The thing is that Tom had to go to the planet Pandora, which is located in the constellation Alpha Centauri. The secret corporation RDA assigns Jake to replace his dead relative and fulfill his debt on this planet. And he must negotiate with the local Na'vi people there in order to take from them a mineral that is very necessary for the life of the planet Earth.

title: Goldfinch
description: The young Theodore Dekker turns out to be at the heart of the story line of this wonderful dramatic story. The protagonist of the film "The Goldfinch" is a young man who lost his mother during the terrorist attack in the Metropolitan Museum. Miraculously surviving the explosion, Theo receives from the dying old man a rare painting by the brush of Karel Fabricius and a ring. From this moment, his immersion in the underground world of art begins. The thing is that the gifts of the same old man in the world of art are practically priceless, and our hero can get a huge fortune for them.

title: A game of hide and seek
description: A young married couple goes to visit the husband's relatives. According to the plot "The game of hide and seek", the man's family is very influential, belongs to a respected clan, which has its own rules and regulations. They all respect traditions. Who could have thought what this banal meeting would turn into. A young girl will have to become a participant in a very cruel game, where a great prize is at stake - human life. Will she be able to cope with the horror that suddenly fell on her shoulders? Be that as it may, but it is necessary to fight, no matter what. After all, life is one and it is priceless.

title: The light of my life
description: The events of this fantastic drama began to take place eight years ago, when humanity was struck by an unknown virus that killed almost all women on earth. At the epicenter of the plot "The Light of My Life" is a man with a twelve-year-old daughter. In some strange way, this teenage girl was immune to the disease. Now our heroes travel through the forests of North America, approaching cities only when absolutely necessary. The father tries with all his might to protect the girl from the dangers that lie in wait for travelers at every turn.

title: Shazam!
description: There is a superhero in each of us, it just takes a little magic to make superpowers a reality. Fourteen-year-old Billy Batson had only to shout the magic word "SHAZAM!" in order to transform into the superhero Shazam. Billy becomes an adult man with superpowers. Only in his heart he is still a child, or rather, a confused teenager. He likes to lash out and take off at full speed, especially now that he has incredible power in his hands. But mischief will have to be put on the back burner, because a villain has appeared in the person of Dr. Thaddeus Siva. The movie "Shazam!" (2019) will be enjoyed by all fans of fantastic action movies in Ukrainian live.

title: Queens of crime
description: The events of this crime drama called "Queens of Crime" take place in New York in 1978. Three housewives live in a criminal district of a huge metropolis. It was they who had the great honor of playing the main roles in this project. In one moment, their mobster husbands were put in prison by the FBI. The most interesting thing is that these ladies have nothing in common, except for the desire to get their way, taking the affairs of the Irish mafia into their own hands. It turns out that even here they feel like fish in water in everything: from racketeering to eliminating competitors in the literal sense of the word.

title: Dora and the Lost City
description: At the epicenter of the plot is a rather brave girl. Dora had the great honor of being born into a family of researchers. She spent her entire childhood in the jungle. But no past adventures could prepare the girl for the dangers of high school - misunderstanding, rivalry, jealousy. In addition to all the trouble, our heroine's parents mysteriously disappear. First love, as well as old and new friends inspire a brave girl to go in search of her relatives. On the way to the goal, they will face a lot of challenges, as well as the icy blood mystery of the lost civilization, which is connected to the Lost City.

title: Plus one
description: Arriving at a wedding ceremony with friends alone forces you to answer uncomfortable questions for which bachelors are not always ready. Therefore, according to the plot of "Plus One", friends Alice and Ben are going to become fictitious "second halves" during exciting celebrations. Alice and Ben believe that this way it will be easier for them to cope with the situation. However, our heroes must gain some benefit from this innocent deception, which may change their perspective on the bachelor lifestyle. This wedding of friends will be remembered by young singles for many years.

title: Where did you go, Bernadette?
description: It often happens that from a person's point of view, life seems to be perfect. For example, Bernadette Fox, at first glance, has absolutely everything a woman can dream of, namely, a good profession, a loving husband capable of keeping a house alone, a full house, and a sweet daughter, the hope of her parents. It's just not all gold that glitters, and a woman feels unusually uncomfortable. Not only did she not succeed in the specialty of an architect, she also hates Seattle, where the Foxes live, with all her heart. The heroine puts all her soul and expectations of joy into the upcoming trip to Antarctica, but when this big trip breaks down, she suddenly disappears without a trace, and all attempts to find her mother and wife fail. However, Bee is not ready to accept the disappearance of her mother and continues the investigation.

title: The life and purpose of a dog
description: The story about the wanderings of a dog's soul in search of the purpose of life will interest movie lovers about animals and everyone who at least once wondered about the meaning of their existence. The film is an adaptation of the work of the same name by the American writer Bruce Cameron. For almost six months, this novel occupied the first lines among the New York Times bestsellers. In the story, the soul that originally belonged to Bailey's golden retriever, the boy Ethan, goes through a circle of reincarnations, returning in the person of a St. Bernard to its already adult owner. After her first death, she first lives in a sheepdog that has become the companion of a K-9 officer. Then in a short-legged corgi, which divides the life of a peculiar student. Then he shares the loneliness of Ethan, who has experienced a lot during this time.

title: Mint
description: The plot of this picture revolves around a woman who was immediately left without her family. The point is that the main character of "Mint" faced the indifference of the system, which turns a blind eye to murder. Then the desperate mother and wife decides to take justice into her own hands. She goes out into the streets of the city and mercilessly takes revenge on all criminals and corrupt policemen. She knows very well that revenge is the same dish that is usually served cold. Exactly the same as the mint flavored ice cream that her late daughter loved so much.

title: Macho on wheels
description: The plot revolves around an attractive man named Jocelyn.
