From an eccentric and very strange boy, Dwight becomes a world star, and Kenneth remains his loyal partner, friend and colleague. Are you interested in biographical stories that are based on real people and events? Then the movie "Rocketman" can become a real find and bring a lot of positive emotions. We wish you a pleasant online viewing.

title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
description: They have inhuman abilities. They are considered outcasts, but despite this, they save humanity from all threats. The main characters of the fantastic film "X-Men: Dark Phoenix", based on the Marvel comics, are always on the defense of the weak and disadvantaged. And they were all collected under the guidance of a wise professor who knows how to deal with supernatural abilities. But even he does not imagine what he and his wards will soon have to face. The action begins at the moment when Jean Gray, one of the most courageous and mysterious followers and students of Professor X, begins to find new abilities. Gradually, she becomes one of the strongest mutants on the planet. However, this transformation causes her to turn into the Dark Phoenix. From this moment on, Gray becomes dangerous both for himself and for others. Now the students and friends of the professor will have to understand what is really more important - the life of one of them or the well-being of ordinary people. We definitely recommend watching the movie "X-Men: Dark Phoenix" on the online site to everyone who likes adaptations of Marvel graphic novels and comics.

title: Aladdin
description: The events of the full-length fantasy film "Aladdin", intended for viewing by the whole family, begin at the moment when a young thief decides to become a real prince. But the trouble is that before the common people never managed to become part of the ruling family. However, Aladdin is not scared at all. He has a goal and he is going to achieve it. Aladdin wants to become a prince far from selfish beliefs. He is driven by his sincere love for a princess named Jasmine. And he wants to win her heart. And at this time, Vizier Jafar is developing a cunning plan, thanks to which he will be able to seize power in the kingdom. Only those close to him know about it. To implement his plan, Jafar needs to get a magic lamp, which, according to legend, is kept in the cave of real miracles. The problem is that access to this place is allowed only to the chosen ones. This chosen one is compared to a diamond that has not yet been cut. No one guesses that this very diamond is Aladdin. Do you like fantasy? Then the movie "Aladdin" will be a good choice for viewers of any age. We wish you a pleasant viewing in the family circle.

title: All new adventures of Aladdin
description: This picture is a continuation of the legendary story about Jin and his master. Aladdin was lucky to marry a beautiful princess. Now they live in charming Baghdad. One day, a dangerous Dictator appears on the doorstep of their Palace. This person has his eye on the Princess and the entire state. Now our hero must go on a dangerous adventure on a flying carpet. He needs to fly halfway around the world, find the legendary Magic Lamp and ask for help from his old friend Gene. And together with him to act as a united front against the treacherous Dictator.

title: Wholesale is cheaper 2
description: A wonderful film "Cheaper in a group 2" about how two large families can have fun together. How difficult it is to share a place at the kitchen table when you have two dozen children in two families. Children are of different ages and each has their own quirks. But can children prevent you from having a good time on vacation? They can do anything. How much trouble parents have to overcome in order to at least somehow calm their child. The young generation of the Baker family against the same rowdies of the Murtagh family. What will this conflict of interests lead to? Will children be able to learn to communicate normally? It is difficult to predict anything here. After all, no child will be bored with such a father. It's good that the children have a dog - it's a white miracle, although sometimes it makes you forget about children's antics. Competition is heated not only between children of both families, but also between parents. But they have an opportunity to fix everything and fight at local sports competitions.

title: Wholesale is cheaper
description: Tom met Kate while still at school. Since then, the lovebirds have always been together, getting engaged immediately after graduating from universities. At the same time, the happy couple dreamed of creating a friendly family, and it seems that the higher forces did hear their prayers, as God sent the couple as many as twelve children. Believe me, with such a crowd of children, trouble cannot be avoided, which does not help the main character's wife, who is vainly trying to concentrate on writing another bestseller. But the head of the family unexpectedly got a unique chance to lead the football team in one of the schools in the state of Illinois, where he himself once studied.

title: Men in Black: International
description: Ordinary people know that their peace is protected by special federal agents, operatives, police officers and patrolmen who keep law and order in the streets. But there are many secret agents whose faces are hidden from prying eyes. Every day they are engaged in saving our planet from an alien invasion. They will be discussed in the fantastic film "Men in Black: International". The main characters of the film are employees of a secret organization dealing with various issues related to extraterrestrial beings. They regulate their migration, monitor their movements, communicate with them and even do some business together. But first of all, they monitor safety and ensure that ordinary people do not know anything about the presence of aliens on our planet. Despite the fact that among the agents there are only those people who have non-standard thinking, even they have to face spies in their ranks. This time they have to uncover the largest spy network, which has taken deep roots in the affairs of the organization. We would like to recommend the movie "Men in Black: International" to watch online to viewers who like fantastic stories about aliens.

title: Police Academy 7: In Moscow
description: The rector of the police academy, Eric Lassard, with his combat cadets must complete another task. Their successes became known in post-Soviet Moscow, and now the police have to go overseas and arrest dangerous criminals on the territory of Russia. In Moscow at this time, Konstantin Kanalia, who is a mafia authority, who in a short time was able to spread the game called "the game" in the world, which became popular and brought him a lot of money, is committing his crimes. Konstantin has a programmer who is a computer genius. He created a program that allows his boss to connect to any computer through this game. This means that now Konstantin has access to large bank capital and finances of various enterprises. While mafiosi dreams of taking over the heart of Russia - Red Square. However, such a person as Konstantin should be feared, because for sure, he will not limit himself to this and his appetite will only grow. Will the students of the police academy, who are already used to performing difficult tasks, be able to save the situation?

title: Police Academy 6: City Under Siege
description: An outbreak of criminal activity began in the city. Now all residents are in dire danger. The criminals decided to completely capture the entire city so that it belonged only to them. No one can allow this to happen, and therefore the most experienced and brave guys from the Police Academy will try to do everything possible to stop them. They do not yet understand that the situation is much more dangerous than it seems to them. But they are not going to stop and will try to show that they serve in the police force for a reason. Ahead of them is a very difficult test, which most beginners have never even had to deal with.

title: Police Academy 5: Operation Miami Beach
description: The main characters go on a short vacation. They fly to Miami Beach, where the scorching sun, a lot of booze and beautiful girls await them. It turns out that Commissioner Lassard will be honored here. Naturally, they could not miss such an important event, and at the same time they will be able to relax. But criminals do not take days off and constantly come up with things that can harm people. And so they kidnap Lassard and now the boys have to change into their uniforms to get him back safe and sound. A difficult test awaits them, but they are ready to do so in order to get a positive result in the end.

title: Police Academy 3: Back to training
description: The city unexpectedly announced that only one of the two police academies will continue to exist. At the end of the year, the authorities will decide who it will be, and for now, each of the schools will have to demonstrate everything they are capable of. They will try to prove that they are the best of the best and that is why they should try to wrest this place. It will be very difficult to do this, because they will constantly interfere with each other. As a result, the situation may remain unresolved for a long time. Who in the end will be able to get this honorary position and become the only academy in the city?

title: Police Academy 2: The first task
description: A gang of dangerous criminals decided to gain power in the entire city. Every day on the streets they stage real riots and do whatever they want. As a result, these criminals will have to be challenged in order to settle the situation. Cary Mahoney came up with a plan of his own, which is very dangerous. He decided to get into this gang, so that he can then turn his brilliant plan around. If he is exposed, he will have big problems. Everyone understands this perfectly, but Mahoney is very serious. He will try to solve this case and save the city from the nightmarish fate that has been prepared for him.

title: Police Academy
description: There are real riots in the country, and there is a complete shortage of police officers, because no one can pass the strict selection process. As a result, the mayor of the city made a decision to remove all restrictions so that any resident could get a job at the academy without any problems. As a result of this, everyone who was not lazy began to come there. But of all these people, practically no one is suitable for the police. It will be necessary to try to carry out a more thorough selection, so that many will understand that it is not up to them. A difficult and difficult test awaits them, and it is not known who will be able to withstand this entire period of training.

title: Winchester. A house built by ghosts
description: The Winchester clan is literally mowing with a scythe. Many died at an early age, without having time to leave offspring. Sarah is a widow who lives in a huge seven-story building. She is the only heir to the family business in the form of an arms company. But, she is not into this enterprise at all. She is surprised by much more serious problems. A woman is sure that ghosts live in her house. And she catches them by building new walls and increasing the number of corridors in the building. They resemble impenetrable labyrinths. If you enter this building for the first time, you can easily get lost while walking in search of the right door. All doors are mirror traps. Sarah's visit is rare, but people still come. They are sure that the woman has simply gone mad along with her ghosts. But they are wrong.. Or not..?

title: Wrinkles of time
description: At the epicenter of the plot of the film "Wrinkles of Time" is researcher Meg Murry. Her father devoted his whole life to science, in particular to traveling to different temporal worlds. He is a famous inventor and scientist. Once he made a great leap in science and technology. The professor managed to break space and time. He was able to create a portal that allows you to easily travel several hundred years back or forward. And the man decides to experience all the beauty of his invention on himself. Such a talented genius of science disappeared without a trace somewhere in the expanses of other worlds. His daughter tries to find her dad and bring him back to the real world. A classmate and a cousin will help her on her difficult journey. They penetrated into mysterious worlds that were hidden from people under the veil of time. Mysterious creatures live here.

title: After
description: When two young people meet each other, it leads to different actions. Friendship, love, hate. But what if two characters with different temperaments and social status meet. Namely, a girl who studies exemplary and listens to her parents. And a guy who doesn't listen to his parents and lives a rich life. Their "worlds" are different: some believe in goodness and justice, and some believe in money and power. But when they meet, they not only create conditions for changing their lives, but also get into different situations. Sometimes love and relationships are stronger than parental influence or superstition.

title: The Ballad of Buster Scruggs
description: The plot of the film "The Ballad of Buster Scruggs" consists of six unrelated stories. The first gave the name to the entire film work. It tells the story of a singing cowboy who performs beautiful tunes for pleasure. The second story is called "Near Algodones". The story of a failed criminal who came down from the highlands. He can't steal cattle or rob a bank with brilliance. The third picture is called "Lunch Ticket". Here, the central figure is an actor and impresario who travels around the country as part of a traveling troupe. The fourth story tells about a treasure hunter who found a gold vein and at the same time avoided meeting with competitors. It is called "Golden Canyon". The fifth story is called "Damsel in distress". Here the plot revolves around a young girl who needs help. While one of the men was helping her, the other simply laid eyes on her. Well, and finally, the last picture called "Decomposing Remains" tells about five travelers who follow in an unknown direction on a stagecoach to a place where, probably, no one is waiting for them.

title: Child is a robot
description: A global cataclysm occurred on Earth, which led to the practical extinction of humanity. According to the plot of the movie "Robot Baby", an emergency program is automatically activated in an underground bunker, and the humanoid robot "Mother" grows a child from a human embryo. A little girl appears who grows up under the careful supervision of the "Mother". The child grows into a charming girl who has never seen the surface of the Earth or other people. But one day her world is turned upside down when a woman appears at the shelter's doorstep with a request for help.

title: Wedding guest
description: Muslim bride Samira, the heroine of the series "The Wedding Guest", is kidnapped on the eve of the wedding by a mercenary Jay, who is acting on the orders of her secret lover. Jay introduces himself as an ordinary guest, and no one even suspects that he is a mercenary. However, the customer unexpectedly changes plans. Now Samira's fate and freedom are in Jay's hands. Jay and Samira find themselves in a dizzying race against time. It is worth making one wrong step and everything will go to pieces. And the lives of our heroes are at stake. And you have to act very carefully to stay alive.

title: Taxi 5
description: In Marseille, a gang of criminals who drive around in expensive Ferraris is announced again. Robbers brilliantly clear pawn shops and disappear, because the police simply cannot catch up with fast cars. The mayor of the city, Zhiber, has to find a reliable and experienced policeman who can stop arbitrariness and stop the theft of valuables throughout the city. The former commissar does not differ in intelligence, but he decides to trust the newcomer, whose fame has already reached the local branch. Detective Maro is a dangerous opponent of the criminal world, he is fearless and cool, and most importantly, he is a unique driver, and he can catch clever criminals. However, he was transferred, due to his unbearable character, which constantly prevents the hero from doing his job cleanly and not getting into trouble. The boy had to find a fast enough car that could compete with Italian models in speed. A find for the cop is Daniel's taxi, who decided to entrust his beloved swallow to his nephew. Eddie is not at all like his uncle, on the contrary, he is afraid of speed, and he doesn't really know how to drive. But Maro persuades him to join in arresting the robbers, although one can only expect problems and big troubles from the boy. Will the hero be able to arrest the robbers and regain the trust of his superiors, or will Eddie become his bane in a complex operation?

title: Jurassic World 2
description: Many fans of the famous fantastic series of novels about the world of living dinosaurs were looking forward to the next, second part of the movie "Jurassic World 2". The focus will be on a group of people whose main goal will be not only their own rescue from angry dinosaurs. The plot was diluted with some innovations, including a change in the place of action, going beyond the island. Now the secret of the resurrection of prehistoric reptiles is owned by several corporations, each of which seeks to "outdo" competitors. Such a struggle leads to another disaster, which the main characters are tasked to prevent. The special feature of this part will be the raised issue of animal rights protection, which will make the film even scarier and bloodier.

title: Inveterate fraudsters
description: In the epicenter of the plot turns out to be a couple of swindlers in love, Peter and Harriet. Big money always revolves around the heroes of the film "Inveterate Scammers", because it is easy for them to rob any pro-business. They spend all their free time at the casino table. Poker and other card games are their forte. Once the couple owed a large amount of money to members of a mafia organization. As a result, they run away from the gambling table, hastily pack their bags and fly across the ocean to Los Angeles. This city is full of simpletons who can easily be circled around your finger. A man and a woman are well aware of this. They set their sights on a jewelry store. It is full of gold, diamonds and cash. If you rob it, you can solidly improve your financial situation.

title: Overboard
description: As you know, from love to hate is only one step. One day, a woman named Kate appears on board the yacht of the influential businessman Leonardo. She cleans the ship. Suddenly, an impudent and self-confident millionaire throws baseless insults at her. She does not intend to tolerate rudeness and responds accordingly. To offend or humiliate a person is an everyday trivial matter for Leonardo. And so the lovely woman fell into the hands of the owner of the ship because of the banal capricious character. At some point, the entrepreneur will fall from the yacht into the water. Because of this, he will lose his memory and will be forced to lie in a hospital bed. The doctors are doing everything possible to bring him back to consciousness. And at this time, Kate appears. She decides to take revenge on her abuser and presents herself as his legal wife.

title: Club of young billionaires
description: The film is based on real events that took place in Los Angeles in the early 80s. One company, led by a real genius, wanted to pull off a global scam where not millions, but whole billions of dollars are at stake. They go to the famous wolf of Wall Street and ask him to help them turn this case around. But such money never leads to anything good. And their new partner dumps the guys. Now the company owes a lot of money to famous people that needs to be paid back. It is necessary to come up with a new scheme and punish the former partner.

title: Tomb Raider: Lara Croft
description: The third part is based on the computer game "Tomb Raider: Lara Croft". In London, a young girl becomes the heir to a powerful corporation that belonged to her father. He has been missing for seven years. All his colleagues consider the man dead. Only she, Lara Croft, does not believe it. She wants to find her father and return to him the former name that he tarnished. He was spotted in Japan during the excavation of the oldest grave, and it was this circumstance that became the fulcrum for his search. The heroine went to the Japanese islands, to the place where her father was last seen. Here, Lara was met unkindly by the local natives, who do not like foreigners at all. Traps and wild beasts await her as a "tomb robber" at every step.

title: Wild
description: Sixteen-year-old Anna, the heroine of the film "Wild", spent most of her life locked up. She lived in a hut located deep in the forest far from civilization. A father who suffered from mental disorders convinced his own daughter that the world is full of dangerous monsters that prey on teenagers and children. The father assured his daughter that bloodthirsty monsters live on the street, ready to attack her at any moment if she only leaves the walls of the house. A naive person believed in a relative and did not leave the house for many years. It was here that she was found by a local policeman. Sheriff Ellen and her brother Ray came across an old dugout in the middle of the forest by chance. Looking inside, they found a frightened teenager. The confused girl was alone in the building and could not answer the questions posed by the sheriff. Without thinking, the law enforcement officer took the young person to her home - to find out the reasons for the girl's presence in such a remote place and establish her identity. The girl shared with the sheriff her fears about the existence of mystical evil creatures. A law enforcement officer together with a psychologist tried to explain to the girl that her fears were unfounded. According to the expert's forecasts, after a long stay with the psychopath, Anna was expected to undergo a long period of rehabilitation. But gradually the heroine begins to understand that the monster exists, and it is she herself. Will the girl be able to overcome the evil that lives inside her, or are the residents of the city now in danger?

title: Deadpool 2
description: This is the second part of the fantastic action movie about Deadpool. Now the man acquired a new body and incredible superpowers. One of them is that it can regenerate. But, these are far from all his unusual skills. He won the recognition of locals and residents of the entire planet for his bravery and ruthlessness in the fight against criminals of various directions. Deadpool's battles were merciless and bloody, but our hero came out victorious, who became the property of the whole world. Professor Colossus asks the man to accept the offer to join the squad of people with superpowers. However, he refuses such a great honor citing the fact that he will face evil in proud solitude and he will not do any good deeds with anyone else. The movie "Deadpool 2" (2018) will be liked by all lovers of adventure comedy fantasy and action movies.

title: Messenger
description: A former contract killer nicknamed "the messenger" is hiding from his past, traveling on his yacht. Fate brings him to a small Indonesian town and introduces him to a lively boy and a single mother. The bandits' car hits a child and the killer brutally kills the culprits. The victims turned out to be local pirates and their colleagues were very upset. Not only that, he became enlightened and for a long time searched for the killer of his parents, a criminal who wants to take revenge. The Mole Massacre begins...

title: Siberia
description: Any American will not have enough in Russia. The main character of the film "Siberia" came from the USA to the Russian Federation. He is an ordinary gem dealer. Here the man is going to meet with his business partner Peter to discuss some nuances. An American citizen is engaged in the sale of exceptional diamonds of rare color, shape and weight. Suddenly Peter disappears and does not get in touch. Naturally, he has the stones. Then our hero makes a bold attempt to go deep into Siberia to find his friend. That's when confused thoughts began to swirl in the American's head. Could his old friend set him up so cruelly? The answer to this question needs to be found here and now.

title: Silence
description: The legendary online site Netflix offers moviegoers another picture under the horror genre. According to the plot of the film "Silence", speleologists once discovered an ancient cave in Moldova. At that time, they did not expect that they would release unknown creatures that remotely resemble bats. These creatures do not see anything and are guided only by sound, fly with the help of leathery wings, and reproduce very quickly. The most important thing is that they are very bloodthirsty and threaten all of humanity, because these creatures have spread across the planet with great speed.

title: Pustoplyas
description: The resolute party man and the hero of the movie "Pustoplyas", nicknamed the Moon Dog, lives his own life, which is governed only by his own laws. At its core, the Moon Dog is a true beach bum. He thinks only about where to get booze and money for wild parties on the beach. In the past, our hero was a good poet, but he abandoned this business and slowly began to degrade. Everything changed dramatically when his rich wife died. Now, in order to inherit her fortune, the Moon Dog needs to complete a poem, which he has no interest in at the moment.

title: Intrusion / Uninvited guest
description: The plot of the film "Invasion / Uninvited Guest" revolves around a married couple - Scott and Annie Howard. The main characters at one fine moment receive a country house. They find a wonderful property, whose owner, a widower, named Charlie. He clearly put his soul into every strip of coinage and musty decor. And soon Annie and Scott are on site with a team of movers. But a few days after they've given their new home a little facelift, Charlie is still sticking his nose in unannounced at inconvenient times.

title: Dance with your heart
description: The French comedy-drama film "Dance with your heart" introduces us to young Joseph, who is fond of hip-hop. This music affects him to the core, and he practically lives by it. It is for this reason that Joseph decides to start dancing to his favorite musical style. And soon dancing becomes his main meaning of life. The crazy energy of the dance numbers, the strong pulse, the unstoppable rhythm of the drums - this is what Joseph lives for. One day, the main character learns that a large-scale festival will be held in the near future, which will gather the best hip-hop dancers from all over the planet. And Joseph does not want to lose his chance. He starts training, hoping that he will be able to achieve his goal. Soon Joseph finds himself in the capital of France. He meets a young and graceful girl named Chloe. She is fond of ballet and is preparing to join one of the best US ballet companies. A romantic relationship appears between them. They have to combine styles that many find too different and incompatible. Watch the French comedy-drama film "Dance with the heart" online, and you will see how the love of rhythmic movements changes the world.

title: Bounty hunter
description: A medieval warrior lives in a gloomy forest. The main character of the movie "Bounty Hunter" wants only one thing - to take revenge on the terrible creature for the death of his only daughter. Once the king sounded the alarm - terrible creatures started in the kingdom. Our hero takes his sword and goes on a hunt for the heads of these creatures. The man still does not lose hope that one day he will come across the very monster that was involved in the death of his daughter. Meanwhile, he cleanses the kingdom of bloodthirsty creatures that keep all local residents in fear and terror.

title: Miss Kulya
description: Gloria Fuentes, a young makeup artist from Los Angeles, returns to her hometown in Mexico to visit her best friend Suzy. The girl rejoices at the opportunity to see the only person dear to her again, because after the death of her parents, she was left alone. After an emotional greeting, the sultry beauties decide to have fun and go to a night club, where they plan to dance a lot. Unfortunately, the revelry is interrupted by the appearance of masked strangers who start shooting from machine guns directly into the crowd of vacationers. Gloria manages to escape, but in the commotion she loses her friend. When Suzy Ne doesn't pick up the phone the whole next day, growing anxiety forces the young woman to drop everything and go to the scene. There she is kidnapped by bandits, and their leader offers the hostage a deal: in exchange for help in finding the named sister, the proud owner of an American passport will perform several tasks for them. Refusal means immediate death, so the abductee agrees. The very first completed assignment entails the death of people, which is simply unbearable for a sensitive person, but criminals want to continue to use her in their dirty deeds...

title: American Pie 3: The Wedding
description: The comedy film "American Pie 3: The Wedding" tells about the fate of best friends who are invited to the grand wedding of Jim and Michelle. Stifler wants to be a boyar, and he won't miss a skirt. The pre-wedding preparations and the wedding itself include the following activities - a bachelorette party with girls, seducing women in the very juice of life in complete darkness, decorating a wonderful cake with hair from an intimate surface, Finch's sexual flash with Sitfler's mother. But Stifler himself is not far behind the program - a born great dancer and the main star of the wedding will appear especially tough.

title: Tolkien
description: The protagonist of the biographical film "Tolkien" turns out to be a very talented young man who makes friends with a group of fellow writers and artists. Together they form a society of people united by common ideas and the desire to do something truly beautiful. Tolkien does not even suspect that this friendship will become an inexhaustible source of inspiration and courage. Over the years, a group of friends not only does not lose contact, but also becomes even stronger, rallying each of them in difficult moments of life's trials. In their communication, they find support and mutual assistance. At the same time, the main character meets a girl with whom he falls in love at first sight. But when the First World War comes, Tolkien's relations with his colleagues, friends and lover are threatened. But the brilliant philologist is not going to break the connection that inspires him to write deep and well-developed works that have the potential to change the world.

title: Domino
description: Christian, the main character of the crime thriller film "Domino", serves as a police officer in Copenhagen. He perfectly understands that he has to work in difficult conditions. Every day, Christian is forced to risk his life. But for the peace of his fellow citizens, he is ready to do it regularly. And he is helped by his faithful partner named Lars Hansen. Together, they cleanse the city of criminals. One day, Lars dies. The official investigation states that the culprit of this tragedy is an international criminal named Imran. However, the protagonist soon realizes that everything is much more complicated. A cunning and corrupt CIA agent uses Imran as a cover, forcing him to be a pawn in his grand game. And now Christian will have to not only understand who really is the killer of Lars, but also to uncover a big conspiracy. Under these conditions, he needs to try to get to the truth and save the life of himself and his former lover, Larsa, who is trying to help solve this crime for the sake of revenge in the name of love. If you are fond of crime thrillers, then the movie "Domino" will be an excellent option. We wish you a pleasant online viewing.

title: Amusement park
description: The plot of the melodrama is based on the history of competing entertainment complexes. Both were built at the beginning of the twentieth century in Stockholm, and one is in the city center, which greatly limited the possibility of its expansion. The owners are two wealthy famous Swedish families who are at war with each other. At the beginning, the rivalry was reduced to increasing the number of attractions and improving the service in their territories. But in the future, it turns from an economic relay into a clan feud, in which all family members become participants. Adding fuel to the fire is an unexpected romance between Ninny Nilsson and John Lindgren, the young heirs of rival businessmen. Lovers are forced to defend the right to joint happiness, in conditions of general hostility to their union. The approach of the Second World War inflames passions, the events of forbidden love relationships are intertwined with military drama, conducting a ruthless test of the strength and sincerity of the bright feelings born in the hearts of loved ones.

title: Crazy couple
description: The comedy-melodramatic film "Crazy Couple" introduces us to a girl named Charlotte Field. She is considered one of the most influential women entrepreneurs not only in her country, but also in the whole world. Being intelligent, wise, purposeful and charming, the heroine succeeds in almost all her endeavors. At the same time, we meet a journalist named Fred Flarsky. He is talented, but slightly eccentric, which often leads to problems in communicating with others. Fred is prone to self-destruction and can't do anything about it. It seems that the two characters have nothing in common. However, they had a romantic relationship in the past. Charlotte was once Fred's first love and both remember it. And now, when they meet again, feelings arise between them again. Fred charms Charlotte so much that she decides to hire him as a speechwriter for her upcoming election campaign. This news comes as a surprise to both Charlotte's subordinates and herself. And who knows what can come out of it. Do you like comedy melodramas? Then don't miss the movie "Crazy Couple", which we recommend watching to every lover of funny comedies.

title: Pokemon Detective Pikachu
description: The action of the film develops after the mysterious disappearance of detective Harry Goodman. His son undertakes to find out the circumstances of the private detective's disappearance. Good-natured Pikachu becomes Tim's partner, who agreed to help the boy in his search for the truth. The restless and unpredictable merrymaker has a wild imagination. Surprisingly, soon the characters of the fantasy film "Pokemon Detective Pikachu" begin to understand each other and communicate, despite the fact that Tim is a person and Pikachu is a Pokemon. They collect evidence and facts on the streets of Rime City, where a fantastic world has united people and Pokemon. Many secrets are hidden in the bowels of the city.
